Padhai ke liye chhote, dikhne wale lakshya rakho. Agar sapno me khoyapan har kaam me badha hai — khana, taiyaar hona, school ka kaam — to ek baar salah lena theek rahega. Aam taur par lakshya aur dincharya se ye santulan me aa jata hai.
Bacche ka mann ek vishay me lagta hai dusre me bilkul nahi, kya ye aam hai?

Bilkul aam hai — har bacche ki pasand aur taakat alag hoti hai. Napasand vishay ke peeche aksar ek kamzor neev hoti hai — jaise ganit me peeche ke hisaab na aana. Us vishay ko peeche se, aasan star se shuru karo. Pasand wale vishay ko inaam ki tarah rakho — pehle napasand ka 15 minute, phir pasand ka. Napasand ko 'tum kamzor ho' ka naam kabhi mat do — baccha us vishay se umar bhar kat sakta hai.
Beti badi class me aate hi padhai se katne lagi hai, pehle achhi thi

Badi class me teen cheezein ek saath badalti hain — padhai mushkil, shareer aur mann me badlav, doston ka mahatva. Is umar me daant ka asar ulta hota hai. Dost bankar baat rakho — padhai ke alawa bhi uski duniya me ruchi lo. Kaun sa vishay mushkil lag raha hai wahan madad do. Uske samay ka samman karo, har samay jaanch mat karo. Ye charan sabke saath aata hai — sambandh bana rahe to padhai bhi sambhal jati hai.
Baccha padhai ke samay hi bhookh, pyaas, thakan sab yaad aata hai

Ye mann na lagne ke sabse aam bahane hain. Padhai se pehle khana-paani nipta do taaki bahane ki jagah na rahe. Phir ek niyam — 25 minute kaam, phir 5 minute me jo chahiye. Agar asal thakan hai to samay badlo — khane ke turant baad padhai kisi ko bhi bhaari lagti hai. Bahano par hasna ya daantna mat karo, bas niyam shaant rakho. Kaam aasan hisso me hoga to bahane khud kam honge.
Beta ko kitab se zyada video dekhkar samajh aata hai, kya ye sahi tareeka hai?

Video se seekhna aaj ka aam tareeka hai aur kai bacche dekhkar zyada achha samajhte hain — isme koi burai nahi. Bas teen baatein rakho — video padhai ka ho aur tay samay ka; dekhne ke baad wo apni bhasha me samjhaye ya likhe, warna video sirf manoranjan ban jata hai; aur kitab se padhna bilkul na chhute, pariksha likhkar hi deni hai. Dono ka santulan — pehle video se samjho, phir kitab se pakka karo.
Bacche ka padhai me mann lagta hai par dost aakar bula le jate hain

Dosto ko dushman mat banao — samay ka bandhan banao. Mohalle ke doston ke mata-pita se baat karke ek sa samay tay karo — shaam 5-6 khel, uske baad sab apne ghar padhai. Bacche ko sikhao ki dost ko 'padhai ke baad milta hu' kehna bhi dosti hai. Agar koi dost padhai ke samay roz aata hai to darwaze par aap vinamrata se wahi baat kaho. Samajik samay bhi zaroori hai — pura band karne se baccha chhupkar jayega.
Beti ko drawing aur gaane me mann lagta hai, maa-pita chahte hain sirf padhai kare

Drawing aur gaana uski taakat hai — use dabana galat hoga. Duniya me inhi se bade kaam hote hain. Santulan rakho — padhai ke tay samay ke baad ye uska hak hai. Kala wale bacche aksar bhasha aur rachna wale vishayon me achhe hote hain — us disha me protsahan do. Ek baat pakki — uski kala ki tareef mehfil me karo, sirf number par baat mat karo. Khush baccha padhai me bhi zyada mann lagata hai.
Baccha school ki padhai me mann lagata hai par ghar par bilkul nahi

School me mahaul aur saath hota hai, ghar me akele baithna padta hai — ye farak hai. Ghar ka samay school jaisa banao — fix samay, fix jagah, aur ho sake to us samay aap bhi paas me apna kaam karo. Homework ko 'school wala kaam' karke rakho, upar ka bojh kam. Dost ke saath kabhi-kabhi saath padhai (group study) bhi karwa sakte ho, bas khel na ban jaye iska dhyan rakho.
Beta 14 saal ka hai, padhai me bilkul mann nahi, sirf phone aur dost

14 saal sabse nazuk umar hai — is samay zabardasti sambandh todti hai, padhai nahi sudharti. Pehle sambandh banao — uski duniya me bina aalochna ke shamil ho. Phir bhavishya ki baat dosti se karo — use kya banna hai, uske liye kaun si padhai chahiye. Ek vishay ya ek lakshya se shuru karo, pura course saamne rakhkar use darao mat. Phone ke niyam uske saath baithkar banao. Agar mann bilkul ud chuka hai aur vyavhaar badal gaya hai to kisi salahkaar se baat karna samajhdari hai.
Bacche ko padhai me mann lagane ke liye teacher ki kya bhumika hai, baat karu kya?

Zaroor baat karo — teacher bacche ko roz dekhta hai, uski nazar aapko asal sthiti batati hai. Milkar ye puchho — class me dhyan kaisa hai, kaun sa vishay kamzor hai, kya koi baat pareshan karti hai. Ghar aur school ek hi baat rakhein to bacche par asar doguna hota hai. Teacher se shikayat ke lehje me nahi, saath milkar hal dhundhne ke lehje me baat karo. Kabhi-kabhi sirf aage ki seat ya ek zimmedari bhi bacche ka mann badal deti hai.
Beti ko padhna pasand hai par likhne me mann nahi lagta, ulta adhura rehta hai

Padhna aur likhna alag kaushal hain. Likhna use bojh lagta hai to pehle chhota rakho — 3 sawal likho, phir break. Likhne ko khel se jodo — dost ko patra, apni kahani, diary. Saaf aur sundar copy dekhkar bacche ko khud achha lagta hai — ek achhi copy sirf 'apne likhne' ke liye rakho. Pariksha me number likhne par hi milte hain — ye baat bade bacche ko samjhao, chhote ko aadat se sikhao.
Baccha naye school me gaya hai, tab se padhai me mann nahi lagta

Naya school matlab naye teacher, naye dost, naya tareeka — bacche ko samay do. Pehle mahine number ki ummeed mat rakho. Usse roz school ki baat suno — kya achha laga, kya mushkil. Ek dost ban jaye to aadhi dikkat khatm. Padhai ke tareeke me farak hai to teacher se milkar samjho. Ghar par purane school ki tulna mat karo. 2-3 mahine aam taur par lagte hain ghulne me — dhairya hi dawa hai.
Beta raat ko der tak jagta hai, din me school aur padhai me mann nahi lagta

Jad neend me hai — der se sona, subah ki susti, din bhar mann udna, ye ek hi zanjeer hai. Sone ka samay dheere-dheere peeche karo — har 3 din 15 minute. Raat ko phone-TV ka samay pehle band karo. Subah uthne ka samay ek sa rakho, chhutti wale din bhi zyada farak nahi. Ek hafta neend sudhre to padhai ka mann khud sudharne lagega. Neend se pehle koi ladai ya padhai ki behes mat rakho.
Bacche ka mann padhai me lagta tha, mobile milne ke baad se sab badal gaya

Ye aaj ke har dusre ghar ki kahani hai. Mobile ko dushman ghoshit karke pura band karna lambi ladai hai — samay aur jagah ke niyam banao. Padhai ke samay phone dusre kamre me, khane par nahi, raat ko bahar. Uske badle ke kaam bharo — khel, dost, hobby. Apna screen samay bhi kam karo. Dheere-dheere seema aadat banegi. Agar phone ke bina baccha bechain aur gusse me rehta hai to ye lat ke sanket hain — salah lena sahi rahega.
Beti har vishay me 'ye kis kaam ka hai' puchhti hai, mann nahi lagati

Ye sawal sahi hai, iska jawab imaandaari se do. Har vishay ka seedha kaam nahi hota, par har vishay dimaag ki ek kasrat hai — ganit sochna sikhata hai, bhasha bolna-likhna, vigyan sawal puchhna. Uske sapne se jodo — doctor ko jeev vigyan, dukaan wale ko ganit. Jahan asal istemal hai wahan dikhao — hisaab dukaan par, angrezi form bharne me. 'Exam ke liye hai' se bada jawab 'zindagi ke liye hai' hota hai — par kehna nahi, dikhana padta hai.
Baccha akela padhta hai to mann nahi lagta, saath koi baithe to padh leta hai

Chhote baccho ke liye ye aam hai — saath hona hi protsahan hai. Saath baithkar aap apna kaam karo (kitab, hisaab, phone nahi) — sirf upasthiti kaafi hai. Dheere-dheere saath ka samay ghatao — pehle pura, phir aadha, phir sirf shuru me. Bade bacche ke liye dost ke saath padhai ya library wala mahaul bhi kaam karta hai. Akele baithne ki taakat umar ke saath aati hai — zabardasti jaldi mat karo.
Bacche ko haar ka dar hai, isiliye koshish hi nahi karta padhai me

Ye bacche 'nahi aata' ki jagah 'karke dekhunga, galat hua to' se darte hain. Ghar me galti ka mahaul badlo — galti par hasna ya daantna bilkul band. Koshish ki tareef karo, parinaam ki nahi — 'tumne mushkil sawal par haath to lagaya'. Aasan se shuru karke jeet ka swad do. Apni galtiyon ki kahani sunao — aap bhi fail hue the aur phir sambhle the. Dar khatm hoga to koshish aayegi, koshish aayegi to seekhna hoga.
Meri saheli ke bacche ke 95% aaye, mere bete ke 70%, mann dukhi hota hai, kya karu?

Ye dukh har mata-pita ko hota hai, aap akeli nahi. Par do baatein yaad rakho — har bacche ki taakat alag hoti hai, aur 70% wala baccha apni jagah hoshiyar ho sakta hai. Apne bacche ki pichhli baar se tulna karo — 60 se 70 hua hai to ye jeet hai. Dusre ke bacche ki baat apne bacche ke saamne kabhi mat karo — use lagta hai wo aapke liye number se kam hai. Apne mann ki baat kisi bade se kaho, bacche par bojh mat dalo.
Baccha khud dusro se tulna karke rota hai ki mai sabse kamzor hu

Uske mann ki baat ko halka mat lo. Use uski apni khaasiyat ginakar batao — har bacche ke paas kuch alag hota hai. Class me pehla aana ek hi bacche ke hisse aata hai, baaki 40 kamzor nahi hote. Uski apni pichhli pragati dikhao — 'pichhli baar 10 spelling galat thi, ab 4 hain'. Khel ya kala me jahan wo achha hai wahan mauka do. Agar ye baat roz ki hai aur wo khud ko bekar samajhne laga hai to teacher aur salahkaar se baat karo.
Ghar wale bacche ki tulna uske bade bhai se karte hain, baccha chidh jata hai

Chidhna sahi hai — tulna sunne wale ko hamesha chubhti hai. Ghar walo ko akele me samjhao ki dono bacche alag hain, ek ki taakat dusre ki kamzori ho sakti hai. Bade bhai ko bhi samjhao ki chhote ke saamne apne number ki baat na kare. Chhote ki apni safaltaon ko ghar me utni hi jagah do. Jis bacche ki tulna hoti hai wo ya to bhai se door hota hai ya khud ko kam samajhta hai — dono rokna aapke haath me hai.
Bacche ko tulna kiye bina protsahan kaise du, samajh nahi aata

Tulna ki jagah teen cheezon par baat karo — uski apni pichhli baar se aage badhna, uski mehnat, aur uska tareeka. Jaise — 'pichhli baar se 8 number zyada', 'tumne is baar roz padha tha', 'tumhara likhne ka tareeka sudhra hai'. Ye baatein sach bhi hain aur bacche ko aage badhati bhi hain. Dusre ka naam liye bina bhi number par baat ho sakti hai — bas aadat badalni hai.
Teacher class me baccho ki tulna karte hain, mera baccha peeche mehsoos karta hai

Teacher se akele me, samman ke saath baat karo — baccha ghar par kya mehsoos karta hai ye batao, aarop mat lagao. Kai teacher bina soche keh dete hain, baat karne se badal jata hai. Ghar par bacche ko uski apni pragati ka aaina dikhate raho taaki class ki baat ka asar kam ho. Agar mahaul na badle aur baccha school se katne lage to school prabandhan se baat karna sahi hai.
Baccha har baat me dost se aage nikalna chahta hai, haar bardasht nahi hoti

Jeet ki chaah achhi hai, par haar na jhel pana aage dikkat karega. Ghar me khel khelo aur kabhi-kabhi khud haaro aur shaanti se lo — baccha dekhkar seekhta hai. Use samjhao — haar matlab khatm nahi, matlab ek aur tareeka seekhna baki hai. Uski mehnat ki tareef karo, sirf jeet ki nahi. Agar haar par wo rone-chillane lagta hai to use jeetne do kabhi-kabhi jaanboojhkar nahi — asal haar ko pyaar se jhelna sikhana hi kaam hai.
Pados ki aunty apne bacche ke number suna suna kar pareshan karti hain

Ye har mohalle ki baat hai. Muskurakar baat badal do — unse ladna bekar hai. Asal kaam ghar par hai — unki baat ka asar apne bacche tak mat pahunchne do. 'Aunty ke bete ke 95 aaye' ye vaakya ghar me kabhi mat dohrayo. Apne bacche ki khaasiyat par apna dhyan pakka rakho. Samay ke saath number bhool jate hain, bacche ka bharosa aur aatm-samman reh jata hai — wahi asal punji hai.
Baccha kehta hai mai hamesha dusre number par aata hu, pehla kabhi nahi

Use samjhao ki pehla aana ek din ki baat hoti hai, aage badhna roz ki. Uske dusre sthan ko chhota mat bano — wo bhi mehnat ka phal hai. Dekho kahan thoda sa antar reh jata hai — ek vishay, likhai, ya samay — wahi sudhar ka lakshya banao. Agar pehle wale se dosti hai to use dushman nahi, saathi banao — saath padhne se dono aage badhte hain. Aakhir me — uski keemat rank se nahi, uske seekhne se hai, ye use mehsoos karana aapka kaam hai.
Do judwa baccho me ek padhai me tez hai, dusra peeche, ghar me tulna hoti hai

Judwa hone se tulna aur zyada hoti hai, par dono alag insaan hain. Har ek ki alag taakat dhundho aur use jagah do — ek ganit me, dusra kahani ya khel me. Dono ki report alag-alag samay par dekho, ek saath rakhkar nahi. Rishtedaro ko bhi samjha do ki 'ye tez, ye kamzor' wali baat band karein. Jis bacche ko kamzor kaha jata hai wo wahi banne lagta hai — shabd hi sabse bada asar karte hain.
Bacche ke number kam aane par rishtedar taane marte hain, baccha sunta hai

Bacche ke saamne taane sunna use sabse zyada chubhta hai. Pehle to aise samay bacche ko wahan se hata do. Rishtedaro ko akele me saaf kaho — bacche ke saamne uske number ki baat nahi hogi, ye aapka niyam hai. Bacche ko baad me zaroor kaho — 'tum unke liye nahi, apne liye padhte ho, aur hum tumhare saath hain'. Ghar ka ye saath hi bahar ke taano ki dawa hai.
Beti apni badi behen jaisi banna chahti hai, khud ko kam samajhti hai

Behen uske liye aadarsh hai, ye achhi baat hai — bas 'jaisi' ki jagah 'apni tarah achhi' par le jao. Behen ko bhi shamil karo — wo chhoti ki khaasiyat ki tareef kare to asar doguna hoga. Chhoti ki alag pehchan wali cheez (uski drawing, uski kahani) ko ghar me jagah do. Umra ka farak bhi samjhao — 'wo 3 saal badi hai, tum uski umar me usse kam nahi hogi'. Samay ke saath apni pehchan banti hai, aap bas tulna ka khana band rakho.
Baccha sports me achha hai par padhai me peeche, log kehte hain padhai hi sab hai

Log kehte rahenge, aap apne bacche ko dekho. Khel me achha hona asal taakat hai — sharir, anushasan, team — ye sab wahi seekhta hai. Padhai me peeche hone ki wajah dekho aur utni madad karo jitni zaroori hai — par uski khel wali pehchan ko chhota mat karo. Santulan rakho — padhai ka tay samay, khel ka tay samay. Kai bacche khel ke anushasan se padhai me bhi sudharte hain — ek ki taakat dusre ko khinchti hai.
Mai khud apne bacche ki dusro se tulna kar baithti hu, kaise rokun khud ko?

Ye maan lena aadhi jeet hai. Ek chaal rakho — muh se nikalne se pehle rukho aur wahi baat bina naam ke kaho: 'uske 90 aaye' ki jagah 'is vishay me thoda aur abhyas chahiye'. Apne bacche ki ek khaasiyat roz mann me dohrao. Dusre mata-pita se number ki baat-cheet kam karo. Aur yaad rakho — aap bhi apni maa ke liye kisi aur ke bacche se toli gayi hongi; kaisa laga tha, wahi aaina hai.
Bacche ke dost ke paas sab mehenge saaman hain, baccha khud ko garib samajhta hai

Cheezo ki tulna paiso se judi hai, nazuk baat hai. Use jhoothi tasalli ki jagah sachhi baat do — har ghar ki sthiti alag hoti hai, aur cheezein insaan ki keemat nahi hoti. Uske paas jo hai uski keemat dikhao — dost, parivaar, uski kala. Ghar ki asal sthiti umar ke hisaab se thodi bata sakte ho — bacche samajhte hain. Agar koi khaas cheez chahiye to bachat ka lakshya banao — intezaar aur mehnat se mili cheez ki keemat alag hoti hai.
Teacher ne bacche ko class me 'sabse kamzor' keh diya, baccha tut gaya hai

Pehle bacche ko sambhalo — use batao ki ek vaakya uski pehchan nahi hai, aur aap uske saath ho. Phir teacher se akele me milo — bina jhagde, ye batao ki baccha ghar par kya mehsoos kar raha hai. Aisi baat dobara na ho, ye vinamrata se kaho. Ghar par uski taakat wale vishay se shuru karke bharosa dobara banao. Agar aisi baatein baar-baar hon to school prabandhan tak jana galat nahi — bacche ka aatm-samman sabse pehle hai.
Bacche ko subah jaldi uthana roz ki ladai hai, kya karu?

Subah ki ladai ki jad raat me hai — jaldi uthana hai to jaldi sulana hoga. Sone ka samay har 3 din 15 minute peeche karo, ek din me ghanta badalna nahi chalega. Raat ko sone se pehle screen band, halki kahani. Subah uthane ka tareeka — chillakar nahi, parde kholkar, halki awaaz me naam lekar. Pehla kaam mazedaar rakho — pasand ka nashta. 2 hafte lagege, par ghadi set ho jayegi.
Beta raat ko 11 baje sota hai, subah 6 baje uth hi nahi pata

11 baje sona school wale bacche ke liye bahut der hai — use 8-9 ghante neend chahiye. Peeche karo dheere-dheere — pehle 10:30, phir 10, phir 9:30. Raat ke aakhri ghante me TV-phone band rakho, roshni kam karo. Shaam ko khel-kood se shareer thake to neend jaldi aati hai. Din me lambi neend (2 ghante se zyada) bhi raat ki neend bigadti hai — dopahar ki jhapki chhoti rakho. Ek saath pura badlav mat karo, kadam-dar-kadam chalo.
Baccha alarm se uth jata hai par phir so jata hai

Alarm ko bistar se door rakho taaki band karne ke liye uthna pade. Uthte hi parde khol do aur chehre par paani ke cheente — aadhi neend wahi khulti hai. Ek niyam rakho — uthkar pehle brush-muh dhona, bistar par wapas letna nahi. Agar roz aisa hai to raat ki neend kam pad rahi hai — sone ka samay peeche karo. Bade bacche ko apni zimmedari ka ehsaas do — der se uthne ka natija (school ki daud) use khud jhelne do kabhi-kabhi.
Beti ko subah uthne ke baad taiyaar hone me bahut samay lagta hai, roz der hoti hai

Subah ki der ki taiyaari raat ko hoti hai — bag, kapde, joote raat ko hi jagah par. Subah ke kaam ki ek chhoti list banao — uthna, brush, nahana, kapde, nashta, bag — aur har kaam ka samay ghadi se jodo. Pehle hafta aap saath raho, phir use khud ghadi dekhne do. TV aur phone subah bilkul band — yehi sabse zyada samay khate hain. Der ka karan jo roz ka hai use pehchano — neend, dheere khana, ya kapdo ka jhagda.
Chhutti wale din baccha 10 baje tak sota hai, phir school wale din dikkat hoti hai

Chhutti me 1 ghante ki chhoot theek hai, 3-4 ghante ki nahi — pure hafte ki ghadi bigad jati hai. Ravivaar ko bhi aam samay se 1 ghante ke andar uthao. School khulne se 2 din pehle se samay theek karna shuru karo. Neend ka hisaab rakho — bacche ko kul 9-11 ghante (umar ke hisaab se) neend chahiye. Chhutti ka matlab din bhar sona nahi, khel aur ghumna hai — ye baat pure ghar ke liye rakho.
Baccha subah uthkar rota hai, school ka naam sunte hi aur rota hai

Pehle wajah — neend adhuri hai ya school ki koi baat? Neend adhuri hai to raat ka samay theek karo. School ki baat hai to shaam ko shaant samay me suno — dost, teacher, padhai, kya pareshan karta hai. Subah rote samay behes mat karo, godi aur shaanti se taiyaar karo. Agar roz ka hai aur pet dard/sir dard bhi kehta hai to pehle doctor ko dikhao — har baat ko natak mat samjho. Wajah mile to hal wahi se niklega.
5 saal ke bacche ko jaldi sulane ka tareeka batao, bistar par jaakar khelne lagta hai

Ek 'sone ki dincharya' banao — nahana/haath-muh, kapde badalna, kahani, bujhi roshni — roz ek sa kram. Dimag is kram ko neend ka sanket samajhta hai. Bistara par khilone mat rakho. Kahani ke baad 'ab sone ki baat' — zyada baat-cheet neend bhaga deti hai. Din me uski daud-bhaag (khel) puri ho to shareer khud neend mangta hai. Pehle hafta aapko paas rehna padega, phir wo khud is kram ka ho jayega.
Baccha dopahar me lambi neend leta hai, raat ko neend nahi aati

Dopahar ki neend chhote baccho (3-5 saal) ke liye achhi hai par 1-1.5 ghante se zyada aur 4 baje ke baad ki neend raat ko bigadti hai. Neend ka samay dopahar ke khane ke turant baad rakho aur jagana pade to pyaar se. Bade baccho (7+) ko dopahar ki neend ki aadat aam taur par nahi chahiye — uski jagah shaam ka khel rakho. Raat ko neend na aaye to subah jaldi uthana aur bhi zaroori ho jata hai — chakra ek jagah se sudharta hai.
Subah jaldi uthkar bacche ko padhane ki aadat dalni hai, par wo sust rehta hai

Uthte hi padhai par mat baithao — pehle 20-30 minute shareer ko jagao: muh dhona, halka nashta, thodi harkat. Subah sirf halki padhai rakho — dohrana, pahade, padhna — naya mushkil vishay susti me nahi ghusta. Agar baccha shaam ko tez hai to subah ki padhai ka dabav hi chhod do — har bacche ka tez samay alag hota hai. Neend puri karke uth raha hai ya zabardasti — ye farak sabse bada hai.
Beta sone se pehle bahut baatein karta hai, sawal puchhta hai, sona late ho jata hai

Ye sawal wala samay asal me uska aapke saath ka sabse shaant samay hota hai — use katna mat karo. Ek niyam rakho — bistar par 10 minute baat aur 2 sawal, phir 'baaki kal'. Kahani sunana is samay ke liye sabse achha hai — sunte-sunte neend aati hai. Din me uske saath baat ka samay badhao taaki raat ko bhari baatein na bachein. Ye charan kuch saal ka hota hai, phir bacche khud jaldi sone lagte hain.
Bacche ko neend me bahut samay lagta hai, bistar par karwatein badalta hai

Pehle din ki baatein dekho — shaam ko zyada daud-bhaag ya screen, dopahar ki lambi neend, ya sone se pehle bhaari khana. Sone se ek ghanta pehle ghar ki roshni aur awaaz kam karo. Garam doodh aur kahani wala kram rakho. Agar mann me koi dar ya chinta hai (andhera, sapne) to us par baat karo — raat ki roshni (halki) bhi rakho. Lagatar hafto aisa hai aur din me bhi asar hai to doctor ki salah lena theek rahega.
Baccha andhere se darta hai, akele kamre me nahi sota

Dar ko hasi me mat udao — bacche ke liye wo sach hota hai. Halki raat wali roshni rakho, darwaza thoda khula. Ek 'saathi' khilona bistar par rakho. Dheere-dheere saath ghatao — pehle paas baithna, phir darwaze tak, phir bahar. Dar wali kahani-TV din me bhi band rakho. Agar dar bahut zyada hai aur badh raha hai to salah lena sahi hai. Samay ke saath ye dar aksar khud jata hai — aapka shaant saath hi dawa hai.
School bus subah 6 baje aati hai, bacche ko 5 baje uthana padta hai, neend kaise puri ho?

Neend puri karne ka ek hi rasta hai — shaam ko jaldi sona. 5 baje uthne wale bacche ko 8-8:30 baje tak sona chahiye taaki 9 ghante mil jayein. Iske liye pure ghar ki shaam ki dincharya badalni padegi — khana jaldi, TV jaldi band. Dopahar me chhoti jhapki (30-45 minute) bhi madad karti hai. Raat ki taiyaari (bag-kapde) se subah ka samay bachta hai. Hafta bhar lagega par ye ghadi set ho jati hai.
Baccha ravivaar ko jaldi uth jata hai par school wale din nahi uthata, aisa kyun?

Kyunki ravivaar ko khel aur mazaa intezaar karta hai, school wale din bojh. Ye mann ki baat hai, shareer ki nahi. School wale din ki subah me bhi ek chhoti pasand wali cheez rakho — pasand ka nashta, raaste me dost se milna, school ki koi achhi baat. Aur asal wajah bhi dekho — school me kuch pareshan to nahi karta. Subah ko ladai ki jagah shaant dincharya banao — baccha din ko bojh nahi, aam din samjhega.
Beti ko subah uthate hi gussa aata hai, pura ghar pareshan ho jata hai

Kuch bacche subah ke samay chidchide hote hain — unhe jagane ke baad 10-15 minute ka samay do, turant sawal-jawab mat karo. Uthane ka tareeka badlo — zor ki awaaz ki jagah parde kholna, halki dhun, paas baithkar naam lena. Raat ki neend adhuri hai to gussa aur badhta hai — pehle neend pakki karo. Us samay seekh aur behes bilkul nahi. Jaise-jaise ghadi set hogi, subah ka gussa bhi kam hoga.
Bacche ko imaandaari ki seekh dene wali chhoti kahani sunao

Ek chhota ladka tha, Rohit. Ek din use raste me ek batua mila, usme 500 rupaye the. Uske dost ne kaha, 'kisi ko pata nahi chalega, rakh le'. Rohit ne batua thane me jama kar diya. Shaam ko ek buzurg pareshan hokar batua dhundhte aaye — wo unki dawa ke paise the. Unhone Rohit ko gale lagaya. Rohit ke paas paise to nahi aaye, par us din se pure mohalle me sab use 'sabse bharosemand ladka' kehne lage. Seekh — imaandaari ki keemat paison se badi hoti hai.
Bacche ko mehnat ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek chidiya thi jo barish se pehle apna ghonsla banana shuru kar deti thi, jabki dusri chidiya khel me lagi rehti. Sab haste — 'abhi to dhoop hai!' Jab baarish aayi, mehnati chidiya apne sukhe ghonsle me baithi thi aur khelne wali bheeg rahi thi. Phir mehnati chidiya ne use apne ghonsle me bula liya aur kaha — 'kaam samay par karne wala hi mushkil me hasta hai'. Seekh — aaj ki chhoti mehnat kal ki badi musibat se bachati hai.
Bacche ko dost ki madad wali seekh ki kahani sunao

Ek kachhua aur ek khargosh dost the. Ek din kachhua ek gadde me gir gaya aur bahar nahi nikal paya. Khargosh daudkar gaya aur ek lambi tehni kheench laya, jise pakadkar kachhua bahar aa gaya. Kachhue ne kaha, 'tum tez ho, main dheere — phir bhi tum mere kaam aaye'. Kuch din baad khargosh ka pair jhaadi me fansa, kachhua dheere-dheere tehni kaatkar use nikaal laya. Seekh — dost wahi jo mushkil me kaam aaye, aur madad ke liye tez hona zaroori nahi, dil hona zaroori hai.
Bacche ko jhooth na bolne ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek charwaha ladka roz pahad par chillata, 'bhediya aaya!' Gaon wale daudkar aate, wo hasta. Ek din sach me bhediya aa gaya. Ladka chillata raha, par kisi ne bharosa nahi kiya. Us din use samajh aaya — jhooth bolne wale ki sachhi baat bhi bekar ho jati hai. Seekh — bharosa banane me samay lagta hai, todne me ek jhooth kaafi hai.
Bacche ko sabr (dhairya) ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek ladki ne aam ki guthli boyi aur roz dekhti — 'paudha kyun nahi nikla?' Dadi ne kaha, 'beej ko samay lagta hai, roz khodkar dekhogi to wo marega'. Ladki ne paani dena jaari rakha par khodna band kar diya. Kuch hafto me chhota paudha nikla. Saalo baad wahi ped pure mohalle ko aam khilata tha. Seekh — achhi cheezein samay leti hain, sabr rakhne wala hi unka phal pata hai.
Bacche ko lalach ke nuksan wali kahani sunao

Ek kutta munh me roti lekar pul par ja raha tha. Paani me use apni parchhayi dikhi — use laga dusra kutta bhi roti liye hai. Usne socha, 'uski roti bhi le lu to do ho jayengi'. Jaise hi usne bhonkne ko munh khola, uski apni roti paani me gir gayi. Seekh — lalach me jo haath me hai wo bhi jata hai.
Bacche ko gussa control karne ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek rajkumar ko bahut gussa aata tha. Guru ne use ek keelo ka dabba diya aur kaha — 'jab gussa aaye, diwar me ek keel thok do'. Kuch mahino me diwar keelo se bhar gayi. Phir guru ne kaha — 'ab jab gussa roko, ek keel nikaal do'. Saal bhar me saari keelein nikal gayi, par diwar par chhed reh gaye. Guru ne kaha — 'gusse me kahi baat bhi aisi hi hai, maafi mil jati hai par nishan reh jata hai'. Seekh — gussa aana bura nahi, gusse me bolna bura hai.
Bacche ko baantkar khane ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Do bhaiyon ke paas ek bada aam tha. Dono akele khana chahte the, jhagda ho gaya. Maa ne aam ko beech me rakha aur kaha, 'jo pehle dusre ko khilayega, use bada hissa milega'. Dono ne ek saath dusre ki ore haath badhaya aur has pade. Aam aadha-aadha bant gaya par khushi dugni ho gayi. Seekh — baantne se cheez kam nahi hoti, khushi badh jati hai.
Bacche ko safai ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek mohalle me sab log kuda sadak par fenkte the. Ek chhoti ladki roz apne ghar ke saamne jhaadu lagati aur kuda dustbin me dalti. Log haste — 'ek ke karne se kya hoga?' Kuch mahino me uski gali sabse saaf dikhne lagi, dusre ghar bhi sharam se saaf rakhne lage. Saal ke aakhir me usi mohalle ko 'sabse saaf mohalla' ka inaam mila. Seekh — badlav hamesha ek se shuru hota hai.
Bacche ko ped-paani bachane ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek gaon me ek buzurg roz ek paudha lagata tha. Log kehte, 'tum iske phal to kha nahi paoge'. Buzurg haskar kehte, 'main un pedon ki chhaon me baitha hu jo mujhse pehle walo ne lagaye the. Ye ped mere baccho ke bacche ke liye hain'. Kuch saalo me gaon ke aas-paas hara-bhara bagh ban gaya. Seekh — kuch kaam apne liye nahi, aane walo ke liye hote hain, wahi sabse bade hote hain.
Bacche ko kisi ka mazak na udane ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Class me ek ladka haklata tha. Kuch bacche uski nakal karke haste. Ek din teacher ne sabko ek-ek karke ulta vaakya bolne ko kaha — sab atke, class has padi. Teacher ne kaha, 'dekha, jo kaam tumhe mushkil hai wahi use roz karna padta hai'. Us din ke baad kisi ne uska mazak nahi udaya, balki sab use pura bolne ka samay dene lage. Seekh — kisi ki kamzori par hasna nahi, uska saath dena chahiye.
Kahani ke dwara bacche ko seekh dena lecture se behtar kyun hai?

Kahani bacche ke mann me seedha utarti hai kyunki wo us samay seekh nahi, kahani sun raha hota hai. Lecture me baccha bachaav ki sthiti me hota hai — use lagta hai use dosh diya ja raha hai. Kahani ka paatra galti karta hai, parinaam bhugatta hai, aur baccha bina kahe samajh jata hai. Ek shart hai — kahani ke baad 'isiliye tumhe bhi...' wala updesh mat jodo, kahani ka asar wahi khatm ho jata hai. Seekh ko khud nikalne do.
Bacche ko haar jeet ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Daud me ek ladka hamesha dusre number par aata tha. Ek din usne haar mankar daudna chhodne ki sochi. Uske pita use kheto me le gaye aur ek chhota paudha dikhaya jo pathar ke neeche se nikal raha tha — 'ye haar isiliye nahi mana kyunki ise rukna nahi aata'. Ladke ne abhyas jaari rakha. Agle saal wo jeeta nahi, par uska samay pehle se bahut behtar tha — aur usi din use asal jeet samajh aayi. Seekh — apne kal se aage badhna hi asal jeet hai.
Bacche ko samay ki keemat wali kahani sunao

Ek ladke ko ek jaadugar ne ek jaadui ghadi di — 'ise ghumakar tum samay peeche le ja sakte ho, par sirf ek baar ek ghanta'. Ladke ne socha abhi nahi, bada hokar istemal karunga. Wo har mushkil me yehi sochta raha — 'ghadi hai na'. Saalo beet gaye, padhai, dost, maa-pita ka saath — sab peeche chhoot gaya intezaar me. Budhape me usne ghadi ghumayi, sirf ek ghanta mila. Seekh — samay kisi ke liye nahi rukta, jo pal haath me hai wahi asal hai.
Bacche ko apni galti manne ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Ek ladki se khidki ka kaanch toot gaya. Dar se usne billi ka naam le diya. Raat bhar use neend nahi aayi. Subah usne maa se sach keh diya — maa ne daantne ki jagah kaha, 'sach bolne ke liye himmat chahiye, mujhe tumpar garv hai'. Kaanch ka paisa uski bachat se kata, par us din se ladki ke mann ka bojh halka ho gaya. Seekh — galti chhupane se badi hoti hai, manne se chhoti.
Bacche ko bado ki seva wali seekh ki kahani sunao

Ek gaon me ek ladka roz apne dada ji ko akhbaar padhkar sunata tha kyunki dada ji ki aankhein kamzor thi. Dost haste — 'tumhara samay barbad hota hai'. Saalo baad dada ji nahi rahe, par ladke ke paas unki sunayi hazaaron kahaniyan aur seekhein thi jo kisi kitab me nahi thi. Ab wo apne baccho ko wahi kahaniyan sunata hai. Seekh — bado ke saath bitaya samay kabhi barbad nahi hota, wo khazana ban jata hai.
Bacche ko mehnat vs chaalaki ki seekh wali kahani sunao

Do khargosh the — ek roz abhyas karke tez daudna seekhta, dusra shortcut dhundhta rehta. Daud ke din shortcut wala jhaadi me fans gaya aur abhyas wala shaanti se jeet gaya. Judge bani buddhi lomdi ne kaha — 'chaalaki ek din kaam aati hai, mehnat har din'. Seekh — shortcut kabhi-kabhi kaam karta hai, par mehnat kabhi dhokha nahi deti.
Bacche ko dost ki galti par saath dene wali kahani sunao

Ek ladke ke dost se school ka paudha toot gaya. Teacher ne pucha to ladka khada hua aur bola — 'galti hum dono se hui, hum saath khel rahe the'. Dono ne milkar naya paudha lagaya aur roz paani diya. Teacher ne kaha — 'tumne dost ko bachaya nahi, uska saath diya — yehi asal dosti hai, kyunki tumne sach nahi chhupaya'. Seekh — dost ka saath matlab galti me bhi khada rehna, par galti ko sahi kehna nahi.
Bacche ko koshish karne ki seekh wali kahani sunao (haar ke baad)

Ek chhoti makdi baar-baar jaala bunti aur baarish use gira deti. Saat baar giri, aathvi baar usne jaala aisi jagah buna jahan chhat thi. Ek raja jo yuddh haar kar gufa me chhupa tha, ye dekh raha tha. Usne kaha — 'jo saat baar girkar aathvi baar uth sakti hai, main kyun nahi?' Wo wapas gaya aur apna rajya jeet liya. Seekh — girna haar nahi hai, uthna band kar dena haar hai.
Raat ko sone se pehle sunane ke liye seekh wali kahani batao

Ek chhota taara aasmaan me sabse peeche tha, sabse halka chamakta tha. Wo dukhi tha — 'meri roshni kisi kaam ki nahi'. Ek raat ek naav samundar me rasta bhatak gayi, chaand badlo me chhupa tha. Tabhi naavik ko wahi chhota taara dikha aur usi se disha mili, naav kinare pahunchi. Taare ko samajh aaya — chhoti roshni bhi kisi ke liye pura rasta hoti hai. Seekh — koi chhota nahi hota, har kisi ki apni jagah aur apna kaam hota hai. Shubh raatri!
Mera 5 saal ka beta har cheez me 'kyun' puchhta hai, thak jati hu, kya karu?

Ye 'kyun' wala charan uske dimaag ke liye sabse achha samay hai — isiliye thakan ke bawjood use todo mat. Har sawal ka jawab dena zaroori nahi — kabhi ulta puchho, 'tumhe kya lagta hai?' Uske andaze par haso mat. Din me 2-3 sawal chun kar achhe se jawab do, baaki ke liye 'ye hum kal saath me dhundhenge' kehkar ek copy me likh lo. Jigyasa hi padhai ki jad hai — aaj ke 'kyun' kal ke number banenge.
Baccha puchhta hai aasmaan neela kyun hai, use kaise samjhau?

Uske star par aasan shabdon me batao — 'Suraj ki roshni asal me kai rangon ki mili hui hai. Jab wo hawa se guzarti hai to neela rang sabse zyada bikharta hai, isiliye hume aasmaan neela dikhta hai'. Ek khel bhi karo — paani bhare gilaas me thoda doodh milakar torch ki roshni dikhao, rang badalna dikhega. Galat ya gol-mol jawab mat do — 'bhagwan ne banaya' kehkar baat band karne se jigyasa marti hai. Na aaye to saath me dhundho.
Beti puchhti hai log mar kyun jate hain, kya jawab du?

Is sawal se ghabrayein nahi, ye har bacche ke mann me aata hai. Uske star par shaant aur sachhi baat kaho — 'har jeev ka ek samay hota hai, shareer budha hokar kaam karna band kar deta hai, jaise bahut purani machine'. 'So jate hain' jaisi baat mat kaho, baccha sone se darne lagta hai. Agar ghar me kisi ki mrityu hui hai to uski baat pyar se karo, yaadein banao. Uske sawal aur rote ko jagah do — bhaav chhupana mat sikhao.
Baccha puchhta hai bacche kahan se aate hain, kya kahun?

Umr ke hisaab se sachha par aasan jawab do. 4-6 saal ke liye — 'baccha maa ke pet me ek khaas jagah par dheere-dheere banta hai, jaise beej se paudha'. Jhoothi kahani (pariya laati hain) mat banao — bada hokar use pata chalega to bharosa kam hoga. Zyada jankari ek saath mat do, jitna puchhe utna hi jawab. Baat ko aam lehje me rakho — aap shaant rahoge to wo bhi sawal ko aam samjhega.
Beta puchhta hai hum garib kyun hain, dost ke paas sab kuch hai

Dil ko chhune wala sawal hai, imaandaari se jawab do. Jhootha dilasa nahi — 'har ghar ki sthiti alag hoti hai, hum mehnat kar rahe hain aur dheere-dheere behtar ho raha hai'. Use ye bhi dikhao ki uske paas kya-kya hai — parivaar, sehat, dost. Paison ki asal baat umar ke hisaab se thodi bata sakte ho. Sabse zaroori — uske saamne dusro se apni tulna aur paiso ki shikayat mat karo, wo wohi seekhta hai.
Baccha puchhta hai padhna kyun zaroori hai, bina padhe bhi to log jeete hain

'Exam ke liye' wala jawab bacche ko nahi jodta. Uske sapne se jodo — 'tumhe driver banna hai? use bhi map aur hisaab padhna aana chahiye'. Roz ke udaharan do — dukaan wala hisaab na jane to thagega, form na padh paye to kaam atke. Padhna matlab sirf number nahi — duniya ko samajhne ki chaabi hai. Kisi bina padhe safal vyakti ki baat aaye to ye bhi kaho — 'usne zindagi se padha, seekhna usne bhi nahi chhoda'.
Beti puchhti hai bhagwan kahan rehte hain, kya jawab du?

Apne parivaar ke vishwas ke hisaab se shaant jawab do — is sawal ka koi ek jawab sabke liye nahi hota. Aam taur par bacche ko ye kehna aasan hota hai — 'bhagwan har jagah hain, hum unhe dekh nahi sakte par achhe kaam me mehsoos kar sakte hain'. Dusre dharmon ka mazak ya galat baat bilkul mat kaho. Uske aage ke sawalon ko rokho mat — vishwas ke sawal bhi jigyasa hi hai.
Baccha puchhta hai chaand mere saath-saath kyun chalta hai

Bahut pyaara aur aam sawal hai. Aasan jawab — 'chaand bahut-bahut door hai. Jaise door ka pahad chalte samay saath chalta lagta hai, waise hi chaand. Asal me hum chalte hain, chaand apni jagah se bahut dheere badalta hai'. Ek khel karo — paas ke ped aur door ke pahad ko dekhkar chalo, farak khud dikhega. Uske sawal ki tareef karo — 'ye sawal vaigyanik puchhte hain' — jigyasa ko protsahan milega.
Beta puchhta hai sapne kyun aate hain

Aasan shabdon me — 'jab hum sote hain to shareer aaram karta hai par dimaag aadha jaga rehta hai. Din me dekhi-suni baatein aur mann ki baatein milkar kahani ban jati hai, wahi sapna hai'. Darawane sapne ki baat aaye to batao sapna sach nahi hota, dimaag ka khel hai. Agar roz darawne sapne aate hain to sone se pehle ki baatein — darawani kahani/TV band karo, aur shaant dincharya rakho.
Baccha puchhta hai paani ka rang kya hai, samjhana hai

Achha sawal hai — use prayog se samjhao. Ek gilaas paani safed kagaz ke saamne rakho — koi rang nahi dikhega. Phir batao — 'paani ka apna koi rang nahi hota, wo jis cheez me hota hai waisa dikhta hai. Samundar neela isiliye dikhta hai kyunki wo aasmaan ka rang aur roshni pakadta hai'. Bacche ko khud alag-alag bartano me paani daalkar dekhne do. Prayog se samjhi baat kitab se zyada yaad rehti hai.
Beti puchhti hai aap mujhse sabse zyada pyar karte ho ya bhai se

Ye sawal pyar ki jaanch hai, number ki nahi. Jawab do — 'mera pyar koi naapne wali cheez nahi hai, tum dono ke liye pura-pura hai, kam zyada wala hisaab pyar me hota hi nahi'. Us samay use godi me lo. Asal me ye sawal tab aata hai jab use kam dhyan mil raha ho — apne samay ka hisaab dekho. 'Dono barabar' wali baat use kam wali lag sakti hai — 'tum mere liye apni jagah khaas ho' ye kehna zyada asar karta hai.
Baccha puchhta hai teacher ne jo kaha wo galat ho sakta hai kya

Shaant hokar haan kaho — 'har insaan se galti ho sakti hai, teacher se bhi. Par batane ka tareeka samman wala hota hai'. Use sikhao ki sawal puchhna aur asahmati jatana galat nahi, bas lehja sahi ho. Ghar par teacher ki burai mat karo, warna baccha class me samman nahi karega. Agar sach me teacher ne galat jankari di hai to bacche ko sahi baat pyar se bata do, bina teacher ko chhota kiye.
Beta puchhta hai agar mai fail ho gaya to aap kya karoge

Is sawal ke peeche dar hai, use pehle khatm karo. Saaf kaho — 'fail hona matlab wo vishay abhi nahi aaya, tum bure nahi ho. Hum saath me dekhenge kahan kami hai aur phir mehnat karenge. Mera pyar number par nahi hai'. Ye baat sirf kehna nahi, result wale din nibhana bhi hai — warna baccha kehna aur karna ka farak seekh jayega. Ye ek vaakya uski pure saal ki padhai ka dar aadha kar deta hai.
Baccha puchhta hai dharti gol hai to hum gir kyun nahi jate

Gurutvakarshan ko aasan shabdon me — 'dharti har cheez ko apni ore kheenchti hai, jaise bada chumbak. Isiliye hum jahan bhi khade hon, pair dharti ki ore hi रहते hain — upar-neeche wahan ke hisaab se hota hai'. Ek gend par chhoti gudiya chipkakar dikhao — neeche wali gudiya 'ulti' dikhegi par giri nahi. Aise sawal par uski tareef karo — yehi sawal bade vaigyaniko ne puche the.
Beti puchhti hai aap office kyun jate ho, ghar kyun nahi rehte

Uske star par sachhi baat — 'kaam karne se paise aate hain jinse hum khana, kapde, kitabein late hain. Aur mujhe apna kaam pasand bhi hai'. Ye bhi jodo — 'sham ko aakar tumhare saath samay mera sabse pasandida hota hai'. Kaam ko saza ki tarah mat dikhao ('majboori me jata hu') — baccha kaam ko bura samajhne lagta hai. Hafte me ek din uske saath pura samay rakho taaki use lage wo bhi aapki list me upar hai.
Baccha baar-baar wohi sawal puchhta hai jiska jawab de chuki hu

Baar-baar wahi sawal matlab jawab uske mann me baitha nahi, ya wo aapka dhyan chahta hai. Pehle baar me lehja badalkar, udaharan se samjhao. Kabhi ulta use hi jawab dene ko kaho — 'tum batao, maine kya kaha tha?' Agar ye dhyan ke liye hai to din me uske saath baithne ka samay badhao. Jhallahat dikhane se wo sawal puchhna hi band kar dega — aur sawal band matlab seekhna band.
Beta puchhta hai dost ke papa ke paas badi gaadi hai, humare paas kyun nahi

Tulna wala sawal hai, shaanti se lo. 'Har parivaar ki kamai aur kharcha alag hota hai. Gaadi badi hona khushi ki guarantee nahi hoti'. Apne ghar ki achhi baatein ginane ki jagah use mehsoos karane wali baatein karo — saath khana, kahani, khel. Agar gaadi asal me aapke sapno me bhi hai to imaandaari se kaho — 'hum bhi mehnat kar rahe hain, samay lagega'. Bacche tulna se zyada aapke lehje se seekhte hain — aap shaant to wo shaant.
Baccha puchhta hai mai bada hokar kya banunga, kaise batau?

Ye aapke batane ka nahi, uske dhundhne ka sawal hai. Usse puchho — 'tumhe kya karna sabse achha lagta hai?' Uske har jawab ko samman do, chahe wo roz badle — is umar me badalna aam hai. Alag-alag kaam ke baare me batao, logo se milwao, kitabein dilao. Ek kaam par dabav mat bano ('doctor hi banna hai') — sapna uska ho to mehnat bhi uski apni hogi. Aapka kaam rasta dikhana hai, manzil thopna nahi.
Beti puchhti hai jhooth bolna galat hai to aapne kal kyun bola tha

Bacche sab dekhte hain — is sawal par gussa ya taalna galat hoga. Imaandaari se mano — 'haan, mujhse galti hui, mujhe nahi bolna chahiye tha'. Ye maan lena aapko chhota nahi, uske liye bada bana deta hai — wo seekhegi ki galti manna sahi hai. Agar wo 'jhooth' asal me koi samajik shishtachar tha (jaise kisi ki buri cheez ko achha kehna) to umar ke hisaab se farak samjha sakte ho. Sabse badi seekh — aap apni baat par khud amal karo.
Bacche ke sawalon ka jawab na aaye to kya karna chahiye?

'Mujhe nahi pata' kehna bilkul sahi hai — ye bacche ko sabse badi seekh deta hai ki na janna sharam nahi hai. Phir saath me dhundho — kitab me, bado se puchhkar, ya phone par dekhkar. Ek 'sawal wali copy' banao jisme bina jawab wale sawal likhe jayein aur hafte me ek din unke jawab dhundho. Galat jawab dene se hamesha behtar hai saath me sahi dhundhna — baccha tareeka seekh jayega, sirf tathya nahi.
Bacche ke liye school chunna hai, kin baaton par dhyan du?

Naam aur fees se pehle ye dekho — ghar se doori (chhota baccha lambi yatra me thakta hai), class me baccho ki sankhya (kam ho to dhyan zyada), teacher ka baccho se vyavhaar (school jaakar dekho), safai aur suraksha, aur khel ki jagah. Bade school ka bada naam hamesha behtar padhai nahi hoti. Apne bacche ka swabhav dekho — sharmila baccha chhoti class me zyada khulta hai. Do-teen school jaakar dekho, sirf dusro ki baat par faisla mat lo.
Sarkari school me padhau ya private me, samajh nahi aata

Dono ke apne fayde hain — faisla apni sthiti aur school ki asal haalat par lo. Sarkari school me fees na ke barabar, par class me bacche zyada ho sakte hain — ghar ki dekh-rekh zyada chahiye. Private me suvidha aur dhyan zyada mil sakta hai par har private achha nahi hota. Asal me bacche ki safalta school se zyada ghar ke mahaul aur aadat par hoti hai. Apne ilaake ke dono school jaakar dekho, wahan ke mata-pita se puchho — wahi sachhi tasveer milegi.
Bacche ka school badalna chahiye ya nahi, dost chhoot jayenge isliye rota hai

School badalne ka kaaran pakka ho — padhai ki asal dikkat, doori, ya mahaul — tabhi badlo. Bacche ke rone ko halka mat lo, dost chhootna uske liye badi baat hai. Badalne se pehle use kaaran samjhao aur naye school ko pehle dikhane le jao. Purane doston se milne ka rasta rakho. Badalne ke baad pehle 2-3 mahine number ki ummeed mat rakho — ghulne ka samay do. Bina bade kaaran ke baar-baar school badalna bacche ki jad hila deta hai.
English medium me dalu ya hindi medium me, bacche ke liye kya sahi hai?

Shuruaat me jis bhasha me baccha sochta aur ghar me bolta hai, usi me samajh tez banti hai — isiliye chhoti class me maa-bhasha/hindi aasan padti hai. English aaj zaroori hai, par wo vishay ke roop me bhi achhi seekhi ja sakti hai. Agar english medium chuno to ghar par english ki kahani-baat ka mahaul banao, warna baccha dono me atak sakta hai. Asal baat — medium se zyada teacher aur ghar ki madad matter karti hai. Bacche par ek saath nayi bhasha aur nayi padhai ka dohra bojh mat dalo.
School ghar se bahut door hai, baccha yatra me thak jata hai, kya karu?

Lambi yatra chhote bacche ki neend, khana aur padhai — teeno khaati hai. Agar nazdeek achha school hai to badalna sahi kadam ho sakta hai. Nahi badal sakte to yatra ka samay kaam ka banao — kahani sunna, sawal-jawab ka khel (sona nahi). Subah ki taiyaari raat ko karke neend bachao. Teacher ko sthiti batao taaki class me susti par samjhe. Lambe samay me doori wala school bacche ko padhai se thaka deta hai — is baat ko halka mat lo.
Play school me bacche ko kab bhejna chahiye, umar kya sahi hai?

Aam taur par 2.5-3 saal ke aas-paas baccha dusre baccho ke saath rehne ke liye taiyaar hota hai — par har baccha alag hai. Sanket dekho — khud khana-peena thoda aata ho, apni baat ishare/shabd se keh pata ho, maa se kuch der alag reh pata ho. Play school padhai ke liye nahi, samajik seekh aur khel ke liye hota hai — wahan se akshar ki ummeed mat rakho. Ghar ke paas wala, khel par zor dene wala school chuno.
Bacche ke admission ke liye interview hota hai, kya taiyaari karau?

Chhote bacche ke interview me ratta nahi, aam vyavhaar dekha jata hai — apna naam, rang, aakaar, chhoti poem, shishtachar. Ghar par khel-khel me ye sab karwao, dabav bilkul nahi. Us din bacche ko bhukha ya neend me mat le jao. Agar baccha wahan chup ho jaye to pareshan mat ho — school wale ye samajhte hain. Mata-pita ke interview me imaandaari se apni baat rakho, badi-badi baatein nahi. Admission na ho to bacche ke saamne nirasha mat dikhao.
Ek hi school me bade bacche padhte hain, chhote ko bhi wahi dalu?

Agar bade baccho ka anubhav achha raha hai to wahi school aasan aur bharosemand rasta hai — bacche ko pehle se mahaul pata hota hai, aana-jaana bhi ek saath. Par har baccha alag hai — chhote ka swabhav aur uski zaroorat alag ho to dusra school dekhna galat nahi. Ek baat rakho — chhote ki tulna badon se school me bhi hogi ('tumhare bhai jaise bano'), is par teacher se pehle baat kar lo.
School me bacche ko koi tang karta hai, school badal du ya baat karu?

Pehle baat karo — school badalna aakhri rasta hai. Teacher aur principal ko saaf aur shaant shabdon me batao, tareekh aur baat ke saath. Bacche ko sikhao ki tang hone par turant teacher ko bataye aur aapko bhi — chhupana sabse khatarnak hai. School ki karyawahi par nazar rakho. Agar school baar-baar taal raha hai aur baccha school jane se dar raha hai, tab badalna sahi hai — bacche ki suraksha aur mann sabse pehle hai.
Fees bahut zyada hai us school ki jo pasand hai, karz lekar dalna sahi hai?

Nahi — padhai ke liye karz lena pure parivaar ko tanav me dalta hai aur uska asar bacche par padta hai. Yaad rakho — mehnga school safalta ki guarantee nahi hota; bacche ki aadat, ghar ka mahaul aur teacher ka dhyan zyada matter karta hai. Apni aamdani ke hisaab se school chuno taaki pure saal aaram se chal sake. Jo paisa bache use kitab, aur aage ki padhai ke liye rakho. Bacche ko bhi is faisle par kabhi bojh mehsoos mat karana.
Bacche ko hostel wale school me bhejna sahi rahega is umar me?

Chhoti umar (12 se kam) me hostel aam taur par sahi nahi maana jata — is umar me bacche ko parivaar ka saath sabse zyada chahiye. Agar paristhiti majboori hai (dono kaam par, gaon me school nahi) to achhi dekh-rekh wala chhota hostel dekho aur milne ka kram pakka rakho. Bade bacche (14+) ke liye hostel anushasan aur aatmanirbharta sikha sakta hai — par faisla bacche se baat karke lo, zabardasti bheja baccha mann se kat jata hai.
School chunne ke liye school jaakar kya-kya dekhna chahiye?

Jaakar ye dekho — class me kitne bacche, teacher baccho se kis lehje me baat karte hain, baccho ke chehre khush hain ya dare hue, shauchalay aur paani ki safai, khel ka maidan, aur chhutti ke samay ki vyavastha. Daftar me ye puchho — pariksha ka tareeka, kamzor bacche ke liye kya madad hai, mata-pita se baat kitni baar hoti hai. Gate par dusre mata-pita se 2 minute baat karo — sabse sachhi jankari wahi milegi.
Baccha jis school me hai wahan padhai ka star gir raha hai, kya karu?

Pehle apne bacche ki asal sthiti dekho — uske number aur samajh kaisi hai. School ka star girna agar sab mata-pita ko lag raha hai to samuh me principal se baat karo — akele se zyada samuh ki baat suni jati hai. Ghar par apni dekh-rekh badhao taaki bacche ka nuksan na ho. Ek saal dekhkar bhi na sudhre to badalna sahi hai — par beech session me badalne se bacche ka nuksan hota hai, saal ke aakhir ka samay chuno.
Ladkiyon ke liye alag school sahi hai ya ladke-ladkiyon wala?

Dono ke apne fayde hain — faisla school ki quality aur aapke ilaake par karo. Ladkiyon wale school me kai ladkiyan zyada khulkar bolti aur hissa leti hain. Mile-jule school me bacche samaj ke asal mahaul me seekhte hain. Asal baatein ye hain — suraksha, aana-jaana, teacher ka vyavhaar, aur school ka mahaul. Apni beti ke swabhav ko dekho aur school jaakar mahaul khud mehsoos karo — naam se zyada mahaul matter karta hai.
Bacche ko usi school me rakhu jahan uske dost hain ya behtar school me bheju?

Chhote bacche ke liye dost bahut bade hote hain — doston wala school use khush rakhta hai aur khush baccha achha seekhta hai. Agar dono school ki padhai me zyada farak nahi hai to doston wala hi chuno. Farak bada hai (padhai, mahaul) to badlo — par naye dost banane me madad karo, purano se milna rakho. Bacche ko kaaran umar ke hisaab se samjhao. Faisla sirf number par nahi, uske mann par bhi rakho.
Bacche ko tuition lagau ya ghar par hi padhau, kaise tay karu?

Pehele ye dekho — baccha class me samajh raha hai? Number theek aa rahe hain? Ghar par aapke paas samay aur us vishay ki samajh hai? Agar ye teenon haan hain to tuition ki zaroorat nahi. Tuition tab chahiye jab koi vishay sach me peeche ho, aapke paas samay bilkul na ho, ya baccha badi class me ho jahan vishay mushkil hain. Tuition aadat se nahi, zaroorat se lagao — bina zaroorat ka tuition bacche ka khel aur khud padhna dono khaata hai.
Teacher kehte hain tuition zaroori hai, par number to theek aa rahe hain

Agar number aur samajh dono theek hain to tuition ki asal zaroorat nahi hai — shaant hokar ye baat teacher se bhi keh sakte ho. Kabhi-kabhi 'sab bacche padhte hain' wala mahaul dabav banata hai. Apne bacche ko dekho, bheed ko nahi. Tuition ka samay aur paisa bacha hua use khel, kitab aur neend me lagana zyada fayda dega. Haan, agar koi ek vishay kamzor hai to sirf usi ki madad lena samajhdari hai.
Baccha tuition jata hai phir bhi number nahi badh rahe, kya karu?

Tuition badalna ya band karna — dono se pehle wajah dekho. Tuition me kitne bacche hain? Agar 20 baccho ke beech tumhara baccha baitha hai to wo dusra school hi hai. Padhaya gaya aur school me chal raha — dono ek hain ya alag? Ghar par dohrana hota hai ya nahi — bina dohrane ke tuition bekar hai. Tuition wale se saaf baat karo — kahan kamzori hai, kya yojana hai. 2-3 mahine me farak na dikhe to badlav karo, paisa aur samay dono bade hain.
Ghar par padhane ke liye mere paas samay nahi, dono kaam karte hain

Ye asal sthiti hai, dosh ki baat nahi. Aise me tuition ek sahara ho sakta hai — par sahi wala chuno: kam bacche, school ke hisaab se padhai, aur roz ka homework wahi niptaye. Hafte me ek din aap bacche ki copy zaroor dekho taaki pakad bani rahe. Bade bacche ke liye sirf mushkil vishay (ganit/vigyan) ki tuition kaafi hai. Aur ek baat — tuition ho ya na ho, roz 10 minute bacche se padhai ki baat karna uske liye sabse bada sahara hai.
Baccha tuition ke bina padhta hi nahi, aadat bigad gayi hai

Ye tuition ka sabse bada nuksan hai — khud padhne ki taakat mar jati hai. Dheere-dheere ghatao — pehle tuition ke baad ghar par 15 minute khud dohrana anivarya karo. Phir ek vishay ki tuition band karke dekho. Use samjhao — tuition madad hai, pair nahi; chalna khud padega. Pariksha ke samay ye aadat sabse zyada dhokha deti hai. Samay lagega par khud padhna hi asal punji hai.
Tuition wale sirf homework karwa dete hain, padhate nahi, sahi hai kya?

Homework karwana aur padhana alag baatein hain. Agar aapki zaroorat sirf dekh-rekh hai (aap kaam par hote hain) to ye vyavastha chal sakti hai, par ise 'padhai ki tuition' mat samjho. Agar number sudharna lakshya hai to aise tuition se kuch nahi hoga — baat karo ya badlo. Sahi tuition wala pehle samjhata hai, phir sawal karwata hai, aur kamzori aapko batata hai. Pehle mahine me hi ye farak dikh jata hai.
Kitne baccho wala tuition achha hota hai, bada group sasta padta hai

Samajh ke liye 5-8 baccho ka samooh sabse achha hota hai — teacher har bacche ko dekh pata hai. 15-20 wale samooh me aapka baccha sirf sunta hai, uski galti koi nahi pakadta. Sasta bada samooh aksar mehnga padta hai — paisa bhi gaya, samay bhi, seekha kuch nahi. Agar budget kam hai to bade samooh ki jagah sirf kamzor vishay ki chhoti tuition ya bade class ke achhe bacche se madad lena behtar hai.
Bacche ko sirf ganit ki tuition lagani hai, sahi rahega?

Haan, ye samajhdar rasta hai — jahan dikkat hai wahi madad. Pure vishayon ki tuition bacche ka pura din kha jati hai. Ganit ki tuition me ye dekho — wo peeche ki kamzori (pahade, hisaab) se shuru karta hai ya seedha class ke sawal? Neec wali kamzori bhare bina upar ki madad tikti nahi. 3 mahine ka lakshya rakho — is hisse me sudhar dikhe to jaari, warna tareeka badlo.
Tuition ke paise bahut zyada mang rahe hain, dena sahi hai?

Pehle apne budget ko dekho — padhai ke kharche se ghar ka tanav badhe to bacche par ulta asar padta hai. Mehnge tuition ka matlab achha tuition nahi hota. Dusre vikalp dekho — kam baccho wala chhota samooh, school ke teacher ke alawa koi aur, bade class ka mehnati baccha, ya online ke muft/aste sadhano se madad. Ek vishay se shuru karo. Aur ye pakka karo ki ghar ka dohrana chal raha hai — bina uske sabse mehnga tuition bhi bekar hai.
Baccha tuition jane se mana karta hai, kehta hai dost khelte hain us samay

Uska dukh samajh sakte ho — khel ka samay uske liye bhi zaroori hai. Tuition ka samay aisa rakho jo khel ko pura na kaate. Use kaaran samjhao — kis vishay me madad chahiye, kitne samay ke liye hai. Ek samay-seema rakho — '3 mahine dekhte hain, sudhar hua to band kar denge'. Uske khel ka samay pakka rakho aur nibhao. Jab bacche ko lage ki uski baat suni gayi hai to virodh aadha ho jata hai.
Online tuition sahi rahegi ya paas wala teacher?

Chhote baccho ke liye saamne baitha teacher behtar hota hai — dhyan aur aadat wahi banti hai. Bade bacche (12+) ke liye online bhi chal sakta hai agar wo khud zimmedaar hai — aana-jaana bachta hai, achha teacher door se bhi mil jata hai. Online me ye dekho — baccha asal me padh raha hai ya screen par kuch aur chal raha hai. Dono me ek hi niyam — 1 mahina dekhkar faisla karo, bina dekhe saal bhar ka paisa mat do.
School ke hi teacher ke paas tuition lagana sahi hai?

Isk fayeede bhi hain aur nuksan bhi. Fayda — teacher ko bacche ki kamzori aur pariksha ka tareeka pata hai. Nuksan — baccha class me puchhne se katrane lagta hai ('tuition me puchh lunga'), aur kabhi-kabhi class ki padhai halki ho jati hai. Kuch school iski anumati bhi nahi dete. Agar lagao to bacche ko samjhao ki class me sunna aur puchhna pehle hai. Aur number ka koi anuchit fayda mile — aisi ummeed bilkul mat rakho.
Garmiyon ki chhutti me tuition lagau taaki aage ki padhai ho jaye?

Chhutti ka matlab aaram aur khel bhi hai — puri chhutti tuition me dalna bacche ko saal bhar ke liye thaka deta hai. Agar peeche ki kamzori hai to chhutti uske liye achha samay hai — halke samay (subah 1 ghanta) se neev bharo. Aage ki padhai pehle kar lena koi fayda nahi deta — school me dobara bore hoga. Usse behtar hai — peeche pakka karo, kitab padhna, khel, aur koi naya kaushal. Chhutti ke aakhri 2 hafte halka dohrana kaafi hai.
Baccha tuition par nirbhar ho gaya hai, bina bataye ek sawal nahi karta

Ye nirbharata dheere-dheere todni hogi. Ghar par niyam rakho — tuition se aakar pehle khud 3 sawal bina dekhe karna. Tuition wale se baat karo ki wo jawab batane ki jagah sanket de aur bacche ko khud karne par majboor kare. Har hafte ek vishay ghar par khud padhna shuru karo. Jab khud kiya sawal sahi hoga to us khushi ko bada banao. Nirbharata ek din me nahi bani thi, jayegi bhi kadam-dar-kadam.
Do baccho me ek ko tuition hai dusre ko nahi, chhota bura manta hai

Baccho ko seedha kaaran samjhao — 'didi ko ganit me madad chahiye, tumhe nahi — jise zaroorat hoti hai use milti hai, jaise bimar ko dawa'. Barabari har cheez me nahi, zaroorat me hoti hai. Chhote ke liye bhi kuch khaas rakho — uske saath padhna ya uski pasand ki kitab. Agar chhote ko bhi kisi cheez me madad chahiye (khel, drawing) to wo bhi do. Baat samjhane se bacche zaroorat aur pakshpaat ka farak samajh jate hain.
Bacche ko protsahan dene ka sabse sahi tareeka kya hai?

Sabse sahi protsahan mehnat aur tareeke ki tareef hai, number ki nahi. 'Tum bahut tez ho' ki jagah 'tumne roz baithkar abhyas kiya, isiliye hua' — pehli baat bacche ko haar se darati hai, dusri mehnat se jodti hai. Tareef usi samay, sabke saamne kabhi-kabhi, aur sachhi ho — jhoothi tareef baccha turant pehchan leta hai. Galti par bhi koshish ko saraho. Yaad rakho — aapke shabd hi uski andar ki awaaz bante hain.
Baccha har kaam me pehle puchhta hai 'mujhe kya milega', inaam ki aadat pad gayi hai

Ye aadat hum bado ki di hui hai — har kaam par toffee/chocolate ke sauda se. Dheere-dheere badlo — kaam ke badle ki jagah kaam ke baad ki khushi par baat karo ('homework jaldi hua to khelne ka samay zyada mila'). Tareef aur saath wala samay inaam banao, cheezein nahi. Kabhi-kabhi bina kahe pasand ki cheez de do — wo uphaar hai, sauda nahi. Kuch hafto me 'kya milega' wala sawal kam ho jayega.
Beti ko number kam aane par protsahan kaise du, wo tut jati hai

Us samay seekh nahi, saath chahiye. Pehle uski bhaavna ko naam do — 'tum dukhi ho, hona bhi chahiye, tumne mehnat ki thi'. Phir 2-3 din baad shaanti se dekho kahan number kate. Ek chhota lakshya banao agle ke liye — pura parinaam nahi, ek vishay. Use apni pichhli safalta yaad dilao. Sabse zaroori — ghar ka vyavhaar number ke baad badle nahi; khana, baat, pyar ek sa rahe. Wahi suraksha use dobara koshish ki himmat deti hai.
Bacche ki tareef kab aur kaise karni chahiye ki asar ho?

Tareef turant, khaas baat par, aur dil se. 'Bahut achha' roz kehne se uski keemat gir jati hai. Khaas kaho — 'aaj tumne mushkil sawal par haar nahi mani, teen baar koshish ki'. Kabhi dusro ke saamne (dada-dadi ke aage) tareef karo — bacche ke liye wo dugni hoti hai. Sharirik pyar (gale lagana, peeth thapthapana) shabdon ke saath jodo. Aur galti wale din bhi din bhar me ek sachhi achhi baat dhundhkar kaho — baccha usi se judta hai.
Beta har kaam me haar man leta hai, 'mujhse nahi hoga' kehta hai

Ye vaakya uske andar ghar kar gaya hai — badalne me samay lagega. Chhote-chhote kaam do jinme jeet pakki ho, aur jeet ko bade shabdon me kaho. Apni kahani sunao — aap kahan haare the aur phir kya hua. 'Nahi hoga' sunte hi ulta mat todo, kaho — 'abhi nahi hua, koshish ke baad dekhte hain'. Khel me bhi use jeet ka anubhav do. Agar ye baat har cheez me aur gehri hai to salah lena theek rahega — aatm-vishwas ki jad bachpan me hi padti hai.
Bacche ko nayi cheez seekhne par protsahan dena hai, darta hai galti se

Galti ko aam banao — ghar me apni galtiyon par haso aur batao. Nayi cheez ko khel ka naam do, pariksha ka nahi. Pehli koshish par hi tareef — 'tumne haath to lagaya, aadhi jeet yahi hai'. Dusre baccho se tulna bilkul nahi is samay. Ek baat bar-bar kaho — 'galti matlab galat tareeka mila, agli baar dusra tareeka'. Jis ghar me galti par hasi nahi udti, wahan bacche nayi cheezein aazmate rehte hain.
Beti bahut sharmili hai, class me jawab jante hue bhi nahi bolti

Sharm ko dosh mat banao — ye swabhav hai, kamzori nahi. Ghar par mauke do — mehmaano ko paani dena, dukaan par saaman mangna, kahani sunana. Chhote samooh (2-3 dost) se shuru karo. Bolne par kabhi 'aur zor se' 'aur saaf' ki tok usi samay mat do — baad me pyaar se. Teacher ko batao taaki wo use chhote mauke de. Jabran stage par khada karna ulta asar karta hai. Samay ke saath, chhote mauko se, bharosa banta hai.
Bacche ko apne kaam par garv karna kaise sikhau?

Uske kaam ko jagah do — drawing ko diwar par, likhi kahani ko parivaar ko sunana, banayi cheez ko mez par. Jab wo kuch dikhaye to phone rakho aur dhyaan se dekho, 2 khaas baat kaho. 'Mera baccha' ki jagah 'tumhara kaam' par baat karo. Garv aur ghamand ka farak bhi sikhao — garv apni mehnat par, ghamand dusro ko chhota karke. Uske kaam ko sambhalkar rakhna bhi ek sandesh hai — ye keemti hai.
Baccha jeet par bahut uchhalta hai, haar par rota hai, santulan kaise lau?

Dono bhaav bade hain kyunki uske liye parinaam hi sab hai. Ghar me khel khelo aur haar-jeet ko aam lehje me lo — jeet par badhai, haar par 'achha khela'. Apni haar par haskar dikhao. Use samjhao — khel ka maza khelne me hai, jeet uska ek hissa. Jab wo haare to pehle bhaav ko jagah, phir baat. Dheere-dheere wo seekhega ki haar par duniya khatm nahi hoti — ye seekh pure jeevan kaam aati hai.
Beti ko stage par bolne ka mauka mila hai, darr rahi hai, protsahan kaise du?

Dar ko pehle aam batao — bade-bade log bhi stage se pehle ghabrate hain. Taiyaari hi dawa hai — ghar par khade hokar bolne ka abhyas, pehle akele, phir parivaar ke saamne, phir dost ke saamne. Pehli 2 line pakki kar lo — shuruaat chal jaye to baaki khud chalta hai. Us din kehna — 'galti ho jaye to rukna nahi, aage badhna — sunne wale bhul jate hain'. Uske baad parinaam jo bhi ho, koshish ka jashn manao.
Bacche ko roz protsahan dene ke liye kuch aasan aadat batao

Teen chhoti aadatein — subah uthate samay ek pyaari baat ('aaj ka din tumhara hai'), school se aane par pehle uski baat sunna (report card baad me), aur sone se pehle din ki ek achhi baat batana ('aaj tumne chhote bhai ki madad ki'). Ye teen samay bacche ke mann me ghar kar jate hain. Khaas baat — ye baatein mehnat, dayalu hona, koshish par hon, sirf number par nahi. Roz ka chhota protsahan bade inaam se zyada asar karta hai.
Beta apni kamzori par hi dhyan deta hai, taakat dekhta hi nahi

Mann ka niyam hai — buri baat badi dikhti hai. Ek khel banao — roz khane par har koi apni ek achhi baat bataye, aap bhi. Uski taakat ko naam do — 'tum logo ko hasane me tez ho', 'tumhara haath saaf hai drawing me'. Kamzori par kaam jaari rakho par baat taakat se shuru karo. Ek copy me uski safaltaein likhte jao — jab mann gire to wahi copy dikhao. Samay ke saath wo khud ko poora dekhna seekhega.
Bacche ko dusro ki tareef karna aur khushi manana kaise sikhau?

Ghar se shuru karo — aap dusro ki tareef uske saamne karo, rishtedar ki safalta par sachhi khushi dikhao. Jab dost jeete to use badhai dene ko kaho aur khud bhi us dost ko badhai do. Use samjhao — dusre ki jeet se tumhari jeet chhoti nahi hoti. Agar jalan mehsoos kare to use galat mat kaho — bhaav aam hai, par us par amal kya karna hai ye sikhao. Parivaar ka mahaul hi sabse badi pathshala hai.
Beti drawing me bahut achhi hai, kya use aage badhau ya padhai par zor du?

Dono — ye chunav hi galat hai. Drawing uski pehchan aur khushi hai, use samay aur samman do — achhi copy-rang, kabhi pradarshani/competition me bhejna. Padhai apne tay samay par chalti rahe. Kai bacche kala ke dwara hi padhai me bhi santulan pate hain. Haan, pariksha ke samay kala ka samay thoda kam ho sakta hai — ye samjhauta uske saath baithkar karo. Uski taakat ko daba kar padhai sudharti nahi, bigadti hai.
Baccha mehnat karta hai par parinaam nahi aata, protsahan kaise banaye rakhu?

Pehle asal baat — mehnat sahi disha me hai ya nahi, ye dekho. Galat tareeke ki mehnat parinaam nahi deti — tareeka badlo, mehnat ko dosh mat do. Usse ye kaho — 'tumhari mehnat mujhe dikhti hai, hum tareeka badalkar phir dekhenge'. Chhote lakshya rakho jinme pragati dikhe — is hafte spelling ki galti 10 se 6. Agar lagatar parinaam nahi aa raha to teacher se milkar asal kamzori pakdo — kabhi-kabhi seekhne ki dikkat hoti hai jisme khaas madad mil sakti hai.
Bacche ko khud par bharosa karna sikhana hai, har kaam me mujhse puchhta hai

Bharosa zimmedari se aata hai. Chhote faisle use karne do — kapde chunna, nashta chunna, apna kaam pehle kaun sa karega. Galat faisle par 'maine kaha tha' mat kaho — natija khud sikha dega. 'Tumhe kya lagta hai?' ye sawal baar-baar puchho. Jab wo khud kuch kare to peeche khade raho, haath mat lagao. Har chhoti safalta par usi ka naam lo — 'ye tumne khud kiya'. Bharosa ek din me nahi, so mauko se banta hai.
Beta khel me haar gaya, rota hua aaya, kya kahu?

Us samay seekh ka samay nahi hai — pehle godi, paani, shaanti. Rone ko 'ladkiyon jaisa' ya 'chhoti baat' mat kaho — uske liye wo badi hai. Shaant hone par bas itna — 'tumne pura zor lagaya, maine dekha'. Agle din baat karo ki kya sudhar sakta hai. Haar ko ghar me aam baat banao — apni haaro ki kahani bhi sunao. Jo baccha haar jhelna seekh jata hai, wo zindagi ki har ladai me tikta hai.
Bacche ko protsahan ke liye taali/sticker wala tareeka kitna sahi hai?

Chhote baccho (3-7 saal) ke liye sticker chart bahut kaam karta hai — pragati aankhon se dikhti hai. Par do baatein rakho — sticker aadat aur vyavhaar ke liye ho (roz baithna, khud bag pack karna), sirf number ke liye nahi. Aur umar badhne par ise shabdon ki tareef me badlo, warna baccha har kaam ki keemat mangne lagta hai. Chart pura hone par chhota jashn — pasand ka khana ya ghumna — cheez nahi, samay do.
Beti sab me 'perfect' karna chahti hai, thodi galti par ro deti hai

Ye bacche andar se bahut dabav me hote hain. Ghar ka mahaul dekho — kahin galti par sakhti to nahi hoti? Use dikhao ki aap apni galtiyon par kaise shaant rehte ho. 'Kaafi achha' ki tareef karo, 'sabse achha' ki kam. Use aisi cheezein do jahan galti chalti hai — drawing, mitti ke khel. Agar ye aadat gehri hai — pet dard, school se katna — to salah lena sahi hai. Use ye lagna chahiye ki aapka pyar uske perfect hone par nahi hai.
Bacche ko dusre ke saamne protsahan dun ya akele me, kya behtar hai?

Dono ka apna samay hai. Akele me di gayi tareef dil tak jati hai — sone se pehle ya saath chalte hue. Sabke saamne wali tareef garv deti hai — par har baccha isse khush nahi hota, kuch sharma jate hain. Apne bacche ko dekho — sharmila hai to akele me, khula hai to dono jagah. Ek niyam pakka — kamzori aur galti ki baat hamesha akele me, tareef dono jagah. Yehi aapke bharose ki neev hai.
Bacche ko bina daante samjhane ka tareeka kya hai?

Teen kadam — pehle shaant ho (gusse me boli baat seekh nahi deti), phir baat ko bacche se alag rakho ('tum bure nahi, ye kaam galat hua'), phir natija samjhao aur sahi rasta batao. Awaaz dheemi par baat saaf rakho. Usse bhi bolne do — uski baat sunne se aadhi baat wahi sulajh jati hai. Aakhir me ek samjhauta — 'agli baar kya karoge?' Jab baccha khud sahi rasta bolta hai to wo use yaad rehta hai.
Mujhe bacche par bahut gussa aa jata hai, chillane ke baad bura lagta hai

Ye maan lena aur badalne ki chaah hi sabse bada kadam hai. Gusse ke samay ek niyam rakho — pehle 10 ginati, paani piyo, phir bolo. Chillane ke baad bacche se maafi mango — 'mujhe chillana nahi chahiye tha' — isse baccha do cheezein seekhta hai: galti manna aur bhaav sambhalna. Apni thakan ka bhi dhyan rakho — thake hue maa-pita zyada chillate hain. Har baar perfect nahi hoga, par har koshish bacche ke mann me likhi jati hai.
Bacche ne jhooth bola, daantu ya samjhau? Kaise?

Pehle ye samjho jhooth ke peeche hamesha ek dar hota hai — saza ka, nirasha ka. Agar jhooth par badi saza milegi to agla jhooth aur pakka hoga. Shaant hokar kaho — 'mujhe sach pata hai, ab tum batao asal kya hua tha'. Sach bolne par saza nahi, galti ka sudhar rakho. Apne ghar ka mahaul dekho — kya sach bolne par hamesha daant padti hai? Sach bolna aasan hoga to jhooth ki zaroorat nahi padegi.
Baccha baar-baar wahi galti karta hai samjhane ke baad bhi

Baar-baar ki galti par pehle ye dekho — samjhaya gaya tareeka uski umar ke hisaab se sambhav hai? Kai baar hum 6 saal ke bacche se 10 saal wali samajh mangte hain. Galti ko chhote hisse me todo — ek samay ek sudhar. Niyam ko dikhne wali jagah likho. Sudhar par turant tareef, galti par shaant yaad-dilana. Agar galti jaanboojh kar aur badhti jaa rahi hai to natije wala tareeka rakho — jo hoga pehle se bata do aur nibhao. Samay lagta hai — aadat ek hafte me nahi badalti.
Bacche ko marna kabhi sahi hai? Mann me bahut aata hai

Imaandaari se suno — maar us samay asar dikhati hai, par lambi seekh nahi deti. Baccha kaam se nahi, maar se darna seekhta hai, aur chhupana seekhta hai. Aur sabse badi baat — wo yehi seekhta hai ki gussa aaye to haath uthana chalega. Jab haath uthne ko ho to kamre se bahar niklo, paani piyo — ye kamzori nahi, samajhdari hai. Agar maar pad gayi hai to baad me maafi mango aur baat karo. Madad chahiye to kisi bade ya salahkaar se baat karna sahi hai — isme sharm nahi.
Bacche ne dusre bacche ko mara, kaise samjhau?

Pehle chot wale bacche ki dekhbhal, phir apne bacche ki baat — dono usi samay. Usse puchho kya hua tha — aksar peeche koi baat hoti hai (tang karna, cheez chheenna). Samjhao — gussa aana galat nahi, haath uthana galat hai; gusse me kya karna hai ye bhi sikhao (door jana, bado ko batana, ginti ginna). Maafi sirf shabd nahi — us bacche ke liye kuch achha karna bhi rakho. Agar ye baar-baar ho raha hai to school ke saath milkar wajah dhundho.
Beti ne meri baat ka palat kar jawab diya, badtameezi lagti hai

Is umar me palat kar bolna aksar apni baat rakhne ki koshish hoti hai, badtameezi ka irada nahi. Us samay behes me mat pado — 'is lehje me baat nahi hogi, shaant hokar bolo, main sunungi' kaho. Shaant hone par uski baat sach me suno — ho sakta hai uski baat me sachhai ho. Lehja sudharo, baat ko mat dabao. Agar aap har asahmati ko badtameezi kahoge to wo bolna hi band kar degi — aur ye zyada khatarnak hai.
Baccha cheez tod deta hai laparwahi se, baar-baar hota hai

Laparwahi par chillane se dekhbhal nahi aati. Natije wala tareeka rakho — tooti cheez ki jagah uski pasand ki cheez kuch samay ke liye rokna, ya us kaam me uski hissa-madad. Use cheezon ki keemat samjhao — kitne me aati hai, kaise banti hai. Kaanch aur nazuk cheezein uski pahunch se door rakhna bhi aapki zimmedari hai. Galti aur laparwahi me farak karo — haath se chhootna galti hai, phenkna laparwahi.
Bacche ko saza deni hi pade to kaisi saza sahi hai?

Sahi saza ke teen niyam — galti se judi ho, pehle se pata ho, aur chhoti ho. Jaise — khilona phenka to khilona ek din ke liye gaya; padhai ka samay khel me khaya to khel ka samay kata. Khana band karna, andhere me band karna, sabke saamne beizzat karna, pyar rokna — ye saza nahi, chot hai. Saza ke baad baat khatm — pure din muh fulana nahi. Aur sudhar dikhe to saza ki baat kabhi mat uthao dobara.
Baccha galti karke chhupata hai, pakde jaane par aur jhooth bolta hai

Ye chakra dar se banta hai — galti ki saza itni badi lagti hai ki chhupana aasan lagta hai. Ghar ka niyam badlo — galti manne wale ko saza nahi, sudhar ka mauka. Apni galtiyan uske saamne mano. Jab wo sach bole to pehle usi baat ki tareef — 'tumne sach bola, ye badi baat hai' — phir galti par shaant baat. Kuch samay me chhupana kam hoga, kyunki sach bolna surakshit lagega.
Do baccho ke jhagde me kis ki galti, kaise tay karu bina pakshpaat ke?

Dono ko alag-alag suno — jo pehle bolta hai wo hamesha sahi nahi hota. 'Bade ko samajhna chahiye' aur 'chhota to chhota hai' — ye do vaakya pakshpaat ki jad hain. Jisne haath uthaya uski galti pehle, par wajah dono ki suno. Faisla sunakar khatm mat karo — dono se puchho 'ab kya karna chahiye tha?' Agli baar ke liye niyam dono ke saamne banao. Aapki nishpakshata hi dono ka bharosa hai.
Bacche ne school me kisi ki cheez utha li (chori), bahut pareshan hu

Ghabrayein nahi, ye umar me aam hai — bacche ke liye 'pasand aana' aur 'mera hona' ka farak abhi banta hai. Chillakar 'chor' ka naam bilkul mat do — ye shabd umar bhar chipakta hai. Shaant hokar cheez wapas karwao aur maafi dilwao — yehi asal seekh hai. Wajah dekho — wo cheez kyun chahiye thi, ghar se mil sakti thi kya. Agar ye baar-baar ho raha hai tab ye dhyaan dene ki baat hai — salah lena sahi rahega.
Baccha meri baat sunta hi nahi, ek kaan se sunkar dusre se nikal deta hai

Pehle apni baato ki ginati karo — din me kitni hidayatein deti ho? Zyada hidayaton me baccha sab band kar deta hai. Kam bolo, khaas bolo. Baat kehte samay uske paas jao, aankho me dekho, phir kaho — door se chillayi baat hawa hoti hai. Usse dohrane ko kaho — 'kya karna hai, batao'. Aur sabse bada — jo kaho wo nibhao. Khali dhamki ('ab main...') teen baar ke baad bekar ho jati hai.
Beti gusse me cheezein phenkti hai, kaise rokoon?

Us samay pakadne-chillane se aag badhti hai — surakshit raho, cheezon ko hatao, shaant lehje me ek hi baat — 'gussa aana theek hai, phenkna theek nahi'. Toofan guzarne ke baad baat karo. Gusse ke liye ek rasta sikhao — takiye par mukka, kagaz faadna, ginti, paani peena. Phenki cheez ko usi se saaf karwana bhi seekh hai. Agar gussa bahut zyada aur roz ka hai — neend, khana, school sab par asar — to salah lena sahi kadam hai.
Bacche ko apni galti ka ehsaas kaise dilau bina rulaaye?

Ehsaas dosh se nahi, natije dikhane se aata hai. Usse puchho — 'tumhare is kaam se dusre ko kaisa laga hoga?' Us sthiti me khud ko rakhna hi ehsaas hai. Koi sajawat nahi — saaf, shaant baat. Phir sudhar ka mauka do — maafi, tooti cheez jodna, dobara koshish. Jab wo khud 'mujhe aisa nahi karna chahiye tha' kahe, wahi asal ehsaas hai — rona uska saboot nahi hai.
Baccha dusro ke saamne zameen par let jata hai zid me, samjhau kaise?

Us samay bheed ke saamne samjhana bekar hai — zid aur badhti hai kyunki use darshak mil jate hain. Shaant raho, paas khade raho, zid ki cheez mat do. Ghar aakar, shaant samay me, baat karo — kya chahiye tha, kaise mangna chahiye tha. Mangne ka sahi tareeka sikhao aur jab wo sahi tareeke se mange to suno bhi. Ek-do baar zid par na milne se ye aadat jati hai — par beech me ek baar bhi de diya to aadat pakki ho jati hai.
Beta bina puche paise utha leta hai ghar se, kaise samjhau?

Pehle wajah — kis cheez ke liye paise chahiye the? Kabhi doston me dikhawa, kabhi koi khaas cheez, kabhi koi dabav bhi ho sakta hai (koi bada baccha mangta ho). Shaant hokar puchho. Samjhao — ghar ki cheez bhi bina puche lena sahi nahi, ye bharose ki baat hai. Use chhoti jeb-kharch (pocket money) ki vyavastha do taaki apni chhoti khwahish ke liye sahi rasta mile. Agar koi bahar wala dabav hai to wo gambheer hai — turant dhyan do.
Bacche ko daantne ke baad wo mujhse baat nahi karta, sulah kaise karu?

Pehle aap badappan dikhao — uske paas jao, paas baitho. 'Mujhe tum par chillana nahi chahiye tha, uske liye maafi. Par jo baat thi wo ab bhi hai — ...' Galti aur sambandh ko alag rakho. Chhote bacche ko godi aur khel se manao, bade ko samay aur baat se. Sulah me shart mat rakho ('pehle tum sorry bolo'). Jab baccha dekhega ki ladai ke baad sambandh judta hai, to wo bhi yehi seekhega.
Baccha teacher se jhooth bolta hai ki homework kho gaya, ghar par kya karu?

Teacher se sach batao — bacche ko bachane ke liye aapka jhooth uski aadat pakki karega. Ghar par shaant baat — homework kyun nahi hua, asal wajah kya thi. Use sikhao ki teacher se sach kehna ('nahi ho paya, kal pakka') jhooth se behtar hota hai — teacher bhi wahi samman karte hain. Agle din ka kaam pura karwakar bhejo. Agar ye baar-baar hai to wajah padhai ki dikkat ho sakti hai — wahan madad karo.
Beti har baat me 'nahi karungi' kehti hai, ziddi ho gayi hai

'Nahi' is umar me apni marzi jatane ka tareeka hai — ye poori tarah buri baat nahi. Har baat par takraav ki jagah chunav do — 'pehle homework ya pehle khana?' — chunav uska, kaam aapka. Jis baat par seema hai wahan shaant aur pakki raho, har baat ko seema mat banao. Uske 'nahi' ko kabhi suno bhi — jab uski baat mani jati hai to wo aapki bhi manne lagti hai. Zid aksar tab badhti hai jab bacche ko lage uski koi sunta hi nahi.
Bacche ke liye khel kitna zaroori hai, padhai ke samay se kaat kar khelu?

Khel bacche ke liye samay ki barbadi nahi, seekhne ka dusra school hai. Roz kam se kam 1 ghanta bahar ka khel chhote baccho ke liye zaroori maano — shareer, neend, dhyan sab isse judta hai. Asal me khel ke baad padhai me dhyan zyada lagta hai. Padhai ka samay khel kaat kar badhane se kul seekhna kam hota hai. Santulan rakho — pariksha ke samay khel thoda kam ho sakta hai, bilkul band nahi.
Beta pura din ghar me rehta hai, bahar khelne jata hi nahi

Pehle wajah — dost nahi hain, khelne ki jagah nahi, shareer me kamzori, ya phone-TV ki aadat. Aap shuruaat karo — shaam ko saath park/walk par jao, cycle chalao. Ek khel chuno jo use pasand aaye — cricket, football, badminton, daud — zabardasti sab nahi. Mohalle ke baccho ke khel ke samay use bhejo. Kuch bacche sharmile hote hain — unhe chhote samooh se shuru karo. Bahar ka khel badhega to neend, bhookh aur mann — teeno sudhrenge.
Bacche ko kisi khel me dalna hai, kaise chunu kaun sa khel?

Bacche ki pasand aur shareer ko dekho, apne adhure sapne ko nahi. 2-3 khel aazmane do — kuch hafte cricket, kuch badminton — jisme wo khud jane ko taiyaar ho wahi uska khel hai. Umra ke hisaab se — chhoto ke liye daud, cycle, tairaaki (suraksha ke saath) achhi shuruaat hai. Coaching se pehle sirf khel — dabav wala mahol khel ka maza khatm kar deta hai. Jeetne ke liye nahi, khelen ke liye bhejo — kaushal baad me aata hai.
Beti khel me hamesha haarti hai, ab khelne se mana karti hai

Haarne ka dukh asal hai — pehle use mano. Phir khel badlo jahan jeet-haar kam ho — cycle, tairaaki, nritya, ya aise khel jahan wo apne kal se aage badhe. Uski taakat wala khel dhundho — har baccha kisi na kisi cheez me achha hota hai. Ghar ke khel me kabhi use jeetne ka mauka bhi do (bina jataye). Samjhao — haar matlab us khel me abhi seekhna baki hai, tum kamzor ho ye nahi. Ek jeet ka anubhav mann badal deta hai.
Padhai aur khel ka santulan kaise banau, dono me samay kam padta hai

Din ka hisaab kagaz par karo — school 6-7 ghante, neend 9-10, khana-ghar 2-3 — bacha samay hi asal me kam hota hai. Usme padhai 1-1.5 ghanta aur khel 1 ghanta — dono aa sakte hain agar screen ka samay kata jaye. Asal chor screen hai, khel ya padhai nahi. Ravivaar ko bada khel rakho. Pariksha ke samay khel aadha, padhai thodi zyada — par dono zero kabhi nahi.
Baccha khel me bahut achha hai, kya use khel me hi aage badhau?

Pehle ye dekho — wo khel ko sach me jeeta hai ya sirf jeetta hai? Roz ka abhyas use pasand hai to aage badhana sahi hai. Achha coach dhundho jo bacche ko pehle insan samjhe. Padhai ka ek star banaye rakho — khel ka safar lamba aur anishchit hota hai, padhai saath wali suraksha hai. Ghar ka kharcha aur samay dekhkar kadam badhao. Sabse zaroori — faisla uski khushi par ho, parivaar ke sapne par nahi.
Bacche ko cycle chalana sikhana hai, girne se darta hai

Dar ko pehle mano, haso mat. Suraksha pehle — helmet, ghutne ke pad, aur naram zameen (ghaas wala maidan). Pehle santulan wala khel — bina pedal ke pair se dhakka dekar chalana (balance bike wala tareeka). Aap peeche pakadkar saath daudo, achanak chhodne ki chaal mat karo — bharosa tootta hai. Girne par chillao mat, shaanti se uthao. Chhoti doori ke lakshya rakho. Ek din wo khud kahega 'ab mat pakdo' — wahi din asal jeet hai.
Baccha team wale khel me kisi ke saath milkar nahi khel pata

Team khel samajik seekh hai — samay lagta hai. Pehle chhote samooh ke khel (2-3 dost) se shuru karo. Use team ke chhote kaam do — ball lana, score ginna — shamil hone ka ehsaas wahi se aata hai. Ghar par parivaar ke saath khel khelo jahan saath jeetna-haarna hota hai. Agar wo har jagah akela rehta hai — school me bhi, park me bhi — to ye sirf khel ki baat nahi, uske mann ki baat hai; teacher se baat karo. Zabardasti bade samooh me dhakelna ulta karega.
Barish ke mausam me bacche ko ghar me kaise khelau, bahar ja nahi sakta?

Ghar ke khel ki list bana lo — carrom, ludo, taash, block, mitti ke khel, nritya (gaana lagakar), chhupam-chhupai, gaddo ka kila. Ek 'barish wala dabba' banao jisme khaas khel hon jo sirf tab niklein — navita bani rehti hai. Khana banane me chhoti madad bhi khel hai is umar me. Screen ko aakhri vikalp rakho, pehla nahi. Barish ke din baccho ke liye yaadgar bante hain agar parivaar saath khele.
Bacche ko tairaaki (swimming) sikhana hai, umar aur savdhani batao

Aam taur par 5-6 saal ke baad baccha seekhne ke liye taiyaar hota hai, par asal baat uske dar aur paani se lagav ki hai. Sirf wahi bhejo jahan prashikshit coach aur saaf paani ho, aur shuru me aap aas-paas raho. Bina coach ke talab/nadi me bilkul nahi — paani ke saath koi samjhota nahi. Dar lag raha ho to zabardasti mat karo — pehle paani me khel, phir seekhna. Tairaaki ek jeevan bhar ka kaushal hai, jaldi ki koi daud nahi.
Beta khel ke baad itna thak jata hai ki padhai nahi hoti, samay kaise rakhu?

Khel aur padhai ke beech 30-45 minute ka antar rakho — khana, nahana, aaram. Padhai khel ke turant baad rakhna hi galti hai. Ya to padhai pehle (shaam ke khel se pehle halka homework), ya khel ke baad aaram karke. Bhaari khel wale din padhai halki rakho. Neend ka samay aage badhao un dinon. Shareer ki thakan asal hoti hai — use aals mat samjho. Samay-sarini bacche ke saath baithkar banao to wo bhi nibhayega.
Bacche ko chess/dimaagi khel me ruchi hai, kya ye bhi khel mana jayega?
