Ctrl+S dabao. Pehli baar file ka naam aur jagah puchhega — naam do (jaise 'Dukaan Hisab') aur Save dabao. Excel file .xlsx naam se banti hai. Kaam karte hue beech-beech me Ctrl+S dabate raho, bijli jaye to bhi kaam bachega.
Excel me do number ka jod kaise kare bina formula ke?
Ek cell me = likho, phir pehla number, + ka nishan, dusra number — jaise =50+30 — aur Enter dabao. Jawab 80 aa jayega. Isi tarah ghatav ke liye -, guna ke liye *, bhaag ke liye / use hota hai.
SUM formula kya hota hai Excel me?

SUM matlab jod. Kai number ek saath jodne ke liye: =SUM(A1:A5) likho — A1 se A5 tak ke saare number jud jayenge. Colon (:) ka matlab hai 'se lekar tak'. Ye Excel ka sabse zyada use hone wala formula hai.
Excel me average (ausat) kaise nikale?
AVERAGE formula use karo: =AVERAGE(A1:A5) — un cells ke numbero ka ausat aa jayega. Jaise marks ka average nikalne me ye bahut kaam aata hai. Ausat matlab kul jod ko ginati se bhaag.
Excel me percentage kaise nikale?
Percentage ke liye formula: =(mile number / kul number)*100. Misal: = (B2/500)*100 — agar B2 me 400 hai to jawab 80 aayega, matlab 80%. Cell me seedha =(B2/500)*100 likho aur Enter dabao.
Excel me sabse bada aur sabse chhota number kaise dhundhe?
Sabse bade ke liye =MAX(A1:A10) aur sabse chhote ke liye =MIN(A1:A10) likho. Jaise class me sabse zyada marks ya sabse kam kharcha dhundhna ho to ye formula ek second me bata dega.
Excel me number ginne (count) kaise kare?
Sirf number wale cell ginne ke liye =COUNT(A1:A20) aur koi bhi bhara hua cell (naam bhi) ginne ke liye =COUNTA(A1:A20) use karo. List me kul kitni entry hai, ye janne me kaam aata hai.
Excel me table kaise banaye?

Pehle data likho — pehli line me heading (Naam, Pata, Number), neeche ek-ek entry. Phir poora data select karo, upar 'Insert' me jaakar 'Table' dabao. Sundar table ban jayegi jisme har column par chhota teer hoga — usse sort aur filter kar sakte ho.
Excel me data sort (kram me lagana) kaise kare?

Data select karo, upar 'Data' me jaakar 'Sort' dabao. Jis column ke hisaab se lagana hai wo chuno — A se Z (chhota se bada) ya Z se A. Naam alphabetic kram me ya number bade-chhote kram me lag jayenge. Dhyaan do — sort se pehle poora data select karo warna aadhi list bigad jayegi.
Excel me filter kya hota hai?

Filter se badi list me sirf wahi dikhta hai jo chahiye. Data select karke Data → Filter dabao. Har heading par teer aa jayega — use dabakar sirf ek cheez chuno, jaise sirf 'Patna' wale naam. Baaki chhup jayenge, delete nahi honge.
Excel me budget sheet kaise banaye?

Ek column me kharche ke naam likho (Kiraya, Khana, Safar...), dusre me rakam. Aakhir me =SUM se kul kharcha nikalo. Upar aamdani likho aur =Aamdani-Kul Kharcha wala formula lagao — bachat apne aap dikhegi. Har mahine nayi sheet ya nayi line jodo.
Excel me row aur column kya hote hain?

Row leti hui (horizontal) line hoti hai — 1, 2, 3 number wali. Column khada (vertical) hota hai — A, B, C akshar wala. Cell inhi dono ke milne ki jagah hai, isliye pata 'B3' jaisa hota hai — column B, row 3.
Excel me nayi row ya column beech me kaise jode?

Jahan jodna hai us row ke number par right click karke 'Insert' chuno — upar ek khaali row ban jayegi. Column ke liye akshar (A/B/C) par right click karke Insert karo. Neeche ki cheezein apne aap khisak jayengi, data nahi mitega.
Excel me ek line delete kaise kare?

Us row ke number par right click karo aur 'Delete' chuno. Poori line mit jayegi aur neeche wali upar aa jayegi. Sirf likha hua mitana hai to cell select karke Delete (Del) dabao — sirf andar ka saaf hoga.
Excel formula me galti aayi #DIV/0! kya matlab hai?

Iska matlab hai formula kisi number ko 0 se bhaag de raha hai, jo mumkin nahi. Ya jisse bhaag de rahe ho wo cell khaali hai. Us cell me sahi number dalo, error hat jayega. #VALUE! aaye to matlab formula me number ki jagah galat cheez (jaise naam) aa gayi.
Excel me cell ka rang ya border kaise lagaye?

Cell select karo, upar 'Home' me rang bharne wala dibba (Fill Color) aur border wala vikalp hota hai. Heading wale cell me halka rang bhar do aur border laga do — sheet saaf aur sundar dikhegi, padhne me aasan hogi.
Excel sheet ka naam kaise badle?

Neeche sheet ke naam (Sheet1) par double click karo, naya naam likho (jaise 'January') aur Enter dabao. Ek file me kai sheet ho sakti hain — neeche '+' dabakar nayi sheet banti hai. Har mahine ki alag sheet banana achhi aadat hai.
Excel me ek cell ka formula dusre cell me kaise lagaye (copy kare)?

Formula wale cell ko select karo, uske neeche-daaine kone par chhota sa kala bindu (fill handle) hota hai. Use pakad kar neeche kheecho — formula har line par apne aap lag jayega aur cell ke pate bhi khud badal jayenge. Sau line ka hisaab ek second me ho jayega.
Excel me number ko paisa (₹) ke roop me kaise dikhaye?

Number wale cell select karo, Home me number format wale dabbe me 'Currency' chuno. Number ke aage ₹ ka nishan aur hazaar par comma lag jayega, jaise ₹1,500. Hisaab-kitab wali sheet me ye bahut saaf dikhta hai.
Excel me date (tareekh) kaise dale?

Cell me tareekh is roop me likho: 15/08/2026 ya 15-Aug-2026. Excel khud pehchan lega ki ye tareekh hai. Phir do tareekho ka antar bhi nikal sakta hai — badi tareekh me se chhoti ghatao, din ki ginati aa jayegi.
Excel me poori sheet print karni hai to pehle kya dekhe?

File → Print me jaakar preview dekho. Sheet zyada chaudi ho to 'Orientation' ko Landscape karo aur 'Fit Sheet on One Page' wala vikalp chuno — poori sheet ek page par aa jayegi. Bina preview dekhe print karne se aadhi sheet kat sakti hai.
Excel me marks ki merit list kaise banaye?

Naam aur marks likho, phir marks wale column ko select karke Data → Sort me 'Largest to Smallest' chuno. Sabse zyada marks wala upar aa jayega. Dhyaan do — sort karte samay 'Expand the selection' wala vikalp chuno, warna naam aur marks ka jod bigad jayega.
Excel me IF formula kya hota hai, aasan bhasha me batao?

IF matlab 'agar-to'. Jaise pass/fail ke liye: =IF(B2>=33, "Pass", "Fail") — B2 ke number 33 ya zyada ho to Pass likhega, kam ho to Fail. Shart, phir sahi hone par kya, phir galat hone par kya — bas yahi IF hai.
Excel me gunakar (multiply) kaise kare?
Guna ke liye * ka nishan use hota hai. Jaise ek cell me daam aur dusre me ginati ho to =A2*B2 likho — kul rakam aa jayegi. Dukaan ke bill aur stock hisaab me ye roz kaam aata hai.
Excel me cell ki chaudaai kaise badhaye, likha hua pura nahi dikh raha?
Upar column ke aksharo ke beech wali line par double click karo — column apne aap likhe hue ke hisaab se chauda ho jayega. Ya line ko pakad kar kheench kar bhi chauda kar sakte ho.
Excel me galti se kuch mit gaya, wapas kaise laye?

Turant Ctrl+Z dabao — pichla kaam ulta ho jayega aur mita hua wapas aa jayega. Ctrl+Z kai baar dabakar kai kadam peeche ja sakte ho. Galti sudharne ka ye sabse aasan tareeka har program me chalta hai.
Excel aur calculator me kya farak hai hisaab ke liye?

Calculator ek baar ka hisaab karta hai, number badlo to phir se karo. Excel me formula ek baar lagao — number badalte hi saare jawab khud badal jate hain. Isiliye bada hisaab, list aur budget Excel me hi banta hai.
A1 se A5 tak dukaan ki 5 din ki bikri likhi hai: 120, 250, 80, 400, 150. Kul bikri kaise nikalu?
Formula likho: =SUM(A1:A5) aur Enter dabao. Jawab aayega: 1000. SUM ka kaam hi hai diye gaye saare number jodna — colon (:) ka matlab 'A1 se A5 tak'.
A1:A5 me 5 logo ke kharche hain: 45, 60, 75, 90, 30. Jod ka formula batao?
Formula likho: =SUM(A1:A5) aur Enter dabao. Jawab aayega: 300. SUM ka kaam hi hai diye gaye saare number jodna — colon (:) ka matlab 'A1 se A5 tak'.
A1 se A4 me rakam hai: 500, 300, 200, 1000. SUM kaise lagau?
Formula likho: =SUM(A1:A4) aur Enter dabao. Jawab aayega: 2000. SUM ka kaam hi hai diye gaye saare number jodna — colon (:) ka matlab 'A1 se A4 tak'.
A1:A6 me 6 din ke graahak hain: 12, 18, 25, 40, 55, 60. Kul kitne hue?
Formula likho: =SUM(A1:A6) aur Enter dabao. Jawab aayega: 210. SUM ka kaam hi hai diye gaye saare number jodna — colon (:) ka matlab 'A1 se A6 tak'.
5 vishayo ke number A1:A5 me hain: 60, 70, 80, 90, 100. Average kaise nikale?
Formula: =AVERAGE(A1:A5) likho. Jawab: 80 aayega. AVERAGE pehle sab ko jodta hai (400), phir ginati (5) se bhaag deta hai.
Teen test ke number 40, 50, 60 A1:A3 me hain. Ausat nikalna hai.
Formula: =AVERAGE(A1:A3) likho. Jawab: 50 aayega. AVERAGE pehle sab ko jodta hai (150), phir ginati (3) se bhaag deta hai.
4 hafto ki kamai A1:A4 me hai: 200, 300, 400, 500. Hafte ka ausat kitna?
Formula: =AVERAGE(A1:A4) likho. Jawab: 350 aayega. AVERAGE pehle sab ko jodta hai (1400), phir ginati (4) se bhaag deta hai.
Excel me 500 me se 425 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(425/500)*100 ya cell se =(B2/500)*100. Hisab: 425 ÷ 500 = 0.85, × 100 = 85%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 85% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 400 me se 360 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(360/400)*100 ya cell se =(B2/400)*100. Hisab: 360 ÷ 400 = 0.9, × 100 = 90%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 90% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 300 me se 270 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(270/300)*100 ya cell se =(B2/300)*100. Hisab: 270 ÷ 300 = 0.9, × 100 = 90%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 90% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 800 me se 640 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(640/800)*100 ya cell se =(B2/800)*100. Hisab: 640 ÷ 800 = 0.8, × 100 = 80%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 80% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 200 me se 150 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(150/200)*100 ya cell se =(B2/200)*100. Hisab: 150 ÷ 200 = 0.75, × 100 = 75%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 75% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 100 me se 88 number aaye, percentage ka formula aur jawab batao?
Formula: =(88/100)*100 ya cell se =(B2/100)*100. Hisab: 88 ÷ 100 = 0.88, × 100 = 88%. Excel me ye formula likhte hi 88% jawab aa jayega.
Excel me 1000 rupaye ki cheez par 10% chhoot (discount) ke baad daam kaise nikale?
Do kadam: pehle chhoot = 1000 × 10/100 = ₹100. Phir daam = 1000 − 100 = ₹900. Excel me ek saath: =1000-(1000*10/100) likho, jawab ₹900 aayega.
Excel me 500 rupaye ki cheez par 20% chhoot (discount) ke baad daam kaise nikale?
Do kadam: pehle chhoot = 500 × 20/100 = ₹100. Phir daam = 500 − 100 = ₹400. Excel me ek saath: =500-(500*20/100) likho, jawab ₹400 aayega.
Excel me 2000 rupaye ki cheez par 15% chhoot (discount) ke baad daam kaise nikale?
Do kadam: pehle chhoot = 2000 × 15/100 = ₹300. Phir daam = 2000 − 300 = ₹1700. Excel me ek saath: =2000-(2000*15/100) likho, jawab ₹1700 aayega.
Excel me 800 rupaye ki cheez par 25% chhoot (discount) ke baad daam kaise nikale?
Do kadam: pehle chhoot = 800 × 25/100 = ₹200. Phir daam = 800 − 200 = ₹600. Excel me ek saath: =800-(800*25/100) likho, jawab ₹600 aayega.
Excel me 1500 rupaye ki cheez par 5% chhoot (discount) ke baad daam kaise nikale?
Do kadam: pehle chhoot = 1500 × 5/100 = ₹75. Phir daam = 1500 − 75 = ₹1425. Excel me ek saath: =1500-(1500*5/100) likho, jawab ₹1425 aayega.
Word kya hota hai aur kis kaam aata hai?

Word likhne wala program hai — patra, aavedan, resume, nibandh, report sab isme banta hai. Isme likha saaf dikhta hai, galti sudharna aasan hai, aur print ya PDF banana bhi. File .docx naam se banti hai.
Word me naya page (document) kaise khole?
Word kholo, 'Blank document' par click karo — khaali safed page aa jayega. Ab type karna shuru karo. Pehle se khula hai to Ctrl+N dabane se bhi naya khaali page khul jata hai.
Word me likha hua save kaise kare?

Ctrl+S dabao. Pehli baar naam aur jagah puchhega — saaf naam do, jaise 'Mera Resume' ya 'Chhutti Aavedan'. Likhne ke dauran beech-beech me Ctrl+S dabate raho — bijli jane par bhi kaam surakshit rahega.
Word me akshar bade (bold) kaise kare?

Jin aksharo ko bada (mota) karna hai unhe pehle select karo — mouse ghaseet kar ya double click se. Phir Ctrl+B dabao ya upar 'B' wala button dabao. Heading ke liye bold use hota hai taaki wo alag dikhe.
Word me heading kaise banaye jo badi aur saaf dikhe?

Heading wali line select karo, upar 'Home' me 'Styles' me se 'Heading 1' chuno — akshar bade aur rangin ho jayenge. Ya khud font size badha kar (jaise 18) bold kar do. Poore document me ek jaisi heading rakho, saaf dikhega.
Word me aksharo ka size aur rang kaise badle?

Text select karo. Upar Home me number wala dabba font size hai (aam likhai 12-14, heading 16-18). Uske paas 'A' ke neeche rang wali patti se font ka rang badal sakte ho. Pehle select karna sabse zaroori hai — bina select kiye kuch nahi badlega.
Word me table kaise banaye?

Upar 'Insert' → 'Table' me jao. Chhote khaano par mouse ghumakar jitni row-column chahiye select karo — table page par ban jayegi. Phir har khaane me click karke likho. Samay-sarini, number ki list, bill — sabke liye table behtareen hai.
Word me resume kaise banaye?

Upar naam aur mobile/email badi heading me likho. Phir chhote heading banao: 'Shiksha', 'Anubhav', 'Kaushal (Skills)' — har ke neeche apni jaankari line-dar-line. Saaf font (Calibri/Arial), size 11-12 rakho. Ek-do page se zyada lamba mat karo. Taiyaar hone par PDF banakar bhejo — wo har jagah ek jaisa dikhega.
Word me photo kaise lagaye?

'Insert' → 'Pictures' → 'This Device' chuno, apni photo select karo. Photo page par aa jayegi. Konon ko pakad kar chhota-bada karo — kone se kheenchne se photo ki chaudaai-lambaai ka anupaat nahi bigdega.
Word me page ke upar naam/date (header) kaise lagaye?

Page ke sabse upari hisse par double click karo — header khul jayega. Wahan apna naam, school ka naam ya tareekh likho. Ye har page par apne aap dikhega. Kaam ho jane par page ke beech me double click karke bahar aao.
Word me spelling ki galti kaise theek kare?

Jis shabd ke neeche laal lehar wali line hai, usme spelling galat ho sakti hai. Us shabd par right click karo — sahi shabd ke sujhav aayenge, sahi wala chun lo. Dhyaan do — Hindi naam ya jagah ke naam par bhi laal line aa sakti hai, wo galat nahi hote.
Word me likha hua print karne se pehle kaisa dikhega, kaise dekhe?
File → Print kholo. Dayein taraf poora page dikhega jaisa print hoga. Page ka size A4 hai ya nahi, kinare (margin) theek hain ya nahi — yahi se dekho. Theek lage tab Print dabao.
Word me margin (kinare ki jagah) kaise set kare?
Upar 'Layout' → 'Margins' me jao. 'Normal' aam kaam ke liye sahi hai. Zyada likhna ek page me lana hai to 'Narrow' chuno — kinare chhote ho jayenge aur jagah badh jayegi.
Word me line ke beech ki doori kaise badhaye?
Text select karo, Home me 'Line Spacing' wale button (upar-neeche teer wali line) par click karke 1.5 ya 2.0 chuno. School ke nibandh aur aavedan me 1.5 ki doori saaf aur sundar dikhti hai.
Word me bullet points (bindu wali list) kaise banaye?

Lines select karo, Home me teer ke saath bindu wale button (Bullets) par click karo. Har line ke aage bindu aa jayega. Number wali list chahiye to uske paas wala 'Numbering' button dabao — 1, 2, 3 apne aap lagega.
Word me ek shabd pure page me jagah-jagah kaise badle?

Ctrl+H dabao. 'Find' me purana shabd, 'Replace' me naya shabd likho, 'Replace All' dabao. Poore document me wo shabd ek saath badal jayega. Naam ki spelling sab jagah ek saath theek karne me ye jadui kaam karta hai.
Word me page number kaise lagaye?
'Insert' → 'Page Number' → neeche (Bottom of Page) chuno aur style chun lo. Har page par apne aap 1, 2, 3... lagega. Lambi report aur project me page number zaroor lagana chahiye.
Word me likhte samay page khatm ho to naya page kaise jode?
Page bharne par Word khud naya page bana deta hai — bas likhte raho. Agar page aadha bhara hai aur zabardasti naya page chahiye to Ctrl+Enter dabao — usi samay naya page shuru ho jayega.
Word file ko PDF me kaise badle bhejne ke liye?
File → 'Save As' → file type me 'PDF' chuno → Save. Ya File → 'Export' → 'Create PDF' dabao. Resume aur aavedan hamesha PDF me bhejo — saamne wale ke computer me design bilkul nahi bigdega.
Word me copy kiya hua text bina design ke (saada) kaise chipkaye?

Ctrl+V se paste karne par purana rang-size saath aa jata hai. Saada paste ke liye Ctrl+Shift+V dabao ya paste karne ke baad chhote dabbe me 'Keep Text Only' chuno. Isse text tumhare page ke design me ghul jayega.
PowerPoint kya hota hai?

PowerPoint presentation banane ka program hai. Isme ek-ek page (slide) banta hai — badi heading, bindu me baatein, photo. School project, office ki report ya koi baat samjhane ke liye slide dikha-dikha kar bolna aasan hota hai.
PowerPoint me nayi slide kaise jode?
PowerPoint kholo, bayein taraf slide wale hisse me right click karke 'New Slide' chuno, ya Ctrl+M dabao. Har nayi baat ke liye nayi slide banao — ek slide par zyada mat bharo.
Slide par kya-kya likhna chahiye?

Ek slide par ek hi baat rakho. Upar badi heading, neeche 4-5 chhoti line bindu me. Pura paragraph mat likho — slide dekhne ke liye hai, tum bolkar samjhaoge. Ek sambandhit photo lagao to aur saaf hoga.
PowerPoint me slide ka design (theme) kaise badle?
Upar 'Design' me jao — kai tayyar design dikhenge. Ek par click karo, saari slide ka rang-roop ek saath badal jayega. Poore presentation me ek hi theme rakho, har slide alag-alag mat karo.
Presentation chalakar (slideshow) kaise dikhaye?
Upar 'Slide Show' → 'From Beginning' dabao, ya seedha F5 dabao. Poori screen par slide aayegi. Aage badhne ke liye click ya → teer dabao, peeche ke liye ←. Khatam karne ke liye Esc dabao.
Slide me photo ya chart kaise lagaye?

Slide par 'Insert' → 'Pictures' se photo lagao. Hisaab dikhana hai to Insert → Chart se graph bhi lag sakta hai — number likhte hi chart ban jayega. Photo itni badi rakho ki peeche ki seat se bhi dikhe.
PowerPoint file ko video ya PDF me badal sakte hain?
Haan. File → Export me 'Create a Video' se poora presentation video ban jata hai — WhatsApp par bhejne ke liye behtareen. PDF ke liye Save As me PDF chuno — slide kagaz ki tarah save ho jayengi.
Slide par likha chhota dikh raha hai, kya dhyaan de?
Heading ka size kam se kam 32 aur aam text 24 se chhota mat rakho. Peeche baithne walo ko bhi padhna aana chahiye. Ek slide par 6 line se zyada mat likho — zyada hai to do slide banao.
Presentation banate samay sabse aam galti kya hoti hai?

Poora nibandh slide par likh dena. Slide par sirf mukhya bindu hone chahiye, tafseel tum bolkar doge. Dusri galti — har slide par alag rang aur ghumne wale asar (animation) — isse dhyaan bhatakta hai. Saada aur saaf hi sabse acha.
Slide me animation (hilta hua asar) kaise lagaye?

Jis text ya photo par asar chahiye use select karo, upar 'Animations' me jaakar ek asar chuno, jaise 'Fade' ya 'Appear'. Halka asar acha lagta hai. Har cheez par nachta-ghoomta asar mat lagao — presentation bhadkila lagta hai.
Mobile se photo computer me kaise bheje?

Sabse aasan: data cable (USB) mobile se computer me lagao. Mobile par 'File Transfer' wala vikalp chuno. Computer me File Explorer me mobile ka naam dikhega — DCIM/Camera folder se photo copy karke computer me paste kar do.
Bina cable ke mobile se computer me file kaise bheje?

Teen tareeke: (1) Apne aap ko WhatsApp par file bhejo aur computer par WhatsApp Web kholkar download karo. (2) Email me file lagakar apne aap ko bhejo. (3) Google Drive par mobile se file dalo, computer par wahi kholo. Chhoti file ke liye WhatsApp sabse tez hai.
Computer se gana mobile me kaise dale?

Cable lagao, mobile par File Transfer chuno. Computer se gana copy karke mobile ke 'Music' folder me paste karo. Cable nahi hai to WhatsApp/Drive se bhi bhej sakte ho, phir mobile me download karke Music folder me rakho.
Mobile computer se jud nahi raha, sirf charge ho raha hai, kya karu?

Cable lagane ke baad mobile ki screen par ek sandesh aata hai — wahan 'Charging only' ki jagah 'File Transfer / MTP' chuno. Tab computer me mobile dikhega. Phir bhi na dikhe to dusri cable lagao — kuch cable sirf charge ke liye hoti hain, data wali nahi.
Badi video mobile se computer me bhejni hai, WhatsApp par quality gir jati hai?

Video ke liye cable sabse acha hai — quality bhi poori, tez bhi. Cable na ho to Google Drive par dalo (15 GB tak muft jagah milti hai) aur computer se download karo. WhatsApp par bhejna hai to video ki jagah 'Document' ke roop me bhejo — quality nahi giregi.
Computer ki file pen drive ke bina mobile me kaise le jaye?

File ko apne email par bhej do ya Google Drive me daal do, phir mobile me wahi email/Drive kholkar download karo. Aas-paas ke mobile se lena hai to Bluetooth ya 'nearby share' type vikalp bhi kaam karte hain, par badi file me samay lagega.
Computer me screenshot kaise le?

Poori screen ka screenshot: keyboard par 'PrtSc' (Print Screen) dabao, phir Paint ya Word me Ctrl+V dabakar chipkao. Windows me sabse aasan: Windows key + Shift + S dabao — screen par jitna hissa chahiye utna ghaseet kar chuno, screenshot pakda jayega.
Screenshot lene ke baad file kahan milti hai?

Windows+Shift+S wala screenshot pehle chipkaane (paste) ke liye taiyaar hota hai. File ke roop me save karna hai to Windows key + PrtSc ek saath dabao — screenshot Pictures folder ke 'Screenshots' hisse me apne aap save ho jayega.
Sirf ek khidki (window) ka screenshot kaise le?
Jis khidki ka chahiye use pehle click karke aage lao, phir Alt + PrtSc dabao. Sirf wahi khidki pakdi jayegi, poori screen nahi. Phir Paint/Word me Ctrl+V karke dekho aur save karo.
Laptop me screenshot ka button nahi mil raha?
Kuch laptop me PrtSc, Fn ke saath hota hai — Fn + PrtSc dabao. Ya Windows + Shift + S wala tareeka har laptop me chalta hai, wahi use karo. Screenshot pakadne ke baad Paint kholkar Ctrl+V se dekho.
Screenshot ko photo file (JPG) kaise banaye?
Screenshot lene ke baad Paint kholo, Ctrl+V dabao, phir File → Save As → JPEG chuno, naam dekar save karo. Ab ye aam photo file hai — WhatsApp ya email se kahin bhi bhej sakte ho.
Mobile me screenshot kaise lete hain?

Aam taur par Power button aur Volume Down button ek saath dabao — screen chamkegi aur screenshot gallery me save ho jayega. Kuch phone me teen ungli neeche ghaseetne se bhi hota hai. Company ke hisaab se tareeka thoda alag ho sakta hai.
Zip file kya hoti hai?

Zip ek dabbe (archive) jaisi file hai jisme kai files dabakar ek saath rakhi jati hain aur unka size bhi chhota ho jata hai. Bhejne aur rakhne me aasan hoti hai. Zip file ke naam ke aakhir me .zip hota hai.
Files ko zip kaise kare?

Files select karo (Ctrl dabakar kai file), kisi ek par right click karo → 'Send to' → 'Compressed (zipped) folder'. Usi jagah ek zip file ban jayegi. Naye Windows me right click ke menu me 'Compress to ZIP file' seedha bhi aata hai.
Zip file kaise khole (nikale)?

Zip file par right click karke 'Extract All' dabao, jagah chuno, 'Extract' karo. Andar ki saari files ek folder me bahar aa jayengi. Bina nikale andar jhank sakte ho, par kaam karne ke liye pehle nikalna (extract) hi sahi hai.
Zip karne se file ka size kitna chhota hota hai?

Ye file par nirbhar hai. Document aur text file bahut dab jati hain (aadhi se bhi kam). Photo (JPG) aur video pehle se dabi hoti hain, isliye zip karne se unka size zyada nahi ghatta. Kai file ek saath bhejni ho to zip har haal me suvidha hai.
Zip file khul nahi rahi, password mang rahi hai?

Kuch zip file bhejne wale password se band karte hain (suraksha ke liye). Password bhejne wale se pucho. Bina password ke wo nahi khulegi. Apna zip banate samay password lagaya ho to use kahin likh kar rakho — bhool gaye to file hamesha ke liye band.
Email me badi file bhejni hai, zip kaise kaam aayega?

Pehle saari files ek folder me rakho, folder ko zip karo — ek hi file ban jayegi aur size bhi kuch ghatega. Phir email me wahi zip lagakar bhejo. Gmail ki seema 25 MB hai — usse badi ho to Google Drive par dal kar link bhejo.
Computer virus kya hota hai?

Virus ek kharab chhota program hota hai jo bina bataye computer me ghus jata hai. Ye files kharab karta hai, computer dheema karta hai, ya tumhari jaankari chura sakta hai. Ye aam taur par galat website, farzi email ki file ya dusro ki pen drive se aata hai.
Computer ko virus se kaise bachaye?

Paanch niyam: (1) Antivirus on rakho — Windows ka Windows Security muft me aata hai. (2) Anjaan email ki file aur link mat kholo. (3) Program sirf asli website se download karo. (4) Dusro ki pen drive pehle scan karo. (5) Windows aur program samay par update karo.
Windows Security (antivirus) se scan kaise kare?

Start me 'Windows Security' likhkar kholo → 'Virus & threat protection' → 'Quick scan' dabao. Virus hoga to pakda jayega. Mahine me ek baar 'Full scan' wala gehra wala scan bhi karo — samay zyada lagega par poora computer dekhega.
Computer me virus aa gaya lagta hai, nishani kya hai?

Nishaniyan: computer ekdum dheema ho jaye, apne aap ajeeb khidkiya khule, files gayab ya naam badle hue dikhe, browser me baar-baar vigyapan aaye, pen drive me shortcut ban jaye. Aisa ho to turant full scan karo aur us samay net banking jaisa kaam mat karo.
Free wala software download karte samay kya dhyaan de?

Sirf company ki asli website ya Microsoft Store se download karo. 'Download' ke bade-bade rangin button wali anjaan site se bacho — galat button dabane se virus wala program aa jata hai. Install karte samay har kadam padho, saath me ghusne wale faltu program (toolbar vagera) ka tick hata do.
Pen drive lagate hi virus aa sakta hai kya?

Haan, aa sakta hai agar pen drive kisi sankramit computer me lagi ho. Isliye dusro ki pen drive lagate hi koi file mat kholo — pehle Windows Security se pen drive scan karo. Apni pen drive cyber cafe jaisi jagah lagane ke baad bhi ghar par scan kar lo.
Ransomware kya hota hai?

Ye sabse khatarnak virus hai — saari files ko band (lock) karke kholne ke badle paisa mangta hai. Isse bachne ka ek hi pakka tareeka hai: zaroori files ka backup alag pen drive ya Drive me rakho. Paisa dene par bhi file milegi, iski koi guarantee nahi hoti.
Browser me baar-baar ajeeb website khulti hai, kya karu?

Ye ek kharab program (adware) ki nishani hai. Pehle Windows Security se full scan karo. Phir browser ki setting me jaakar anjaan 'extensions' hata do. Aur Control Panel me jaakar jo program tumne install nahi kiya, use uninstall karo.
Mazboot password kaisa hona chahiye?

Kam se kam 10-12 akshar ka, jisme bade akshar (A-Z), chhote (a-z), number (0-9) aur nishan (@, #, !) mile hon. Naam, janm tithi, mobile number password me kabhi mat rakho — ye sabse pehle aazmaye jate hain. Misal: 'Chai@2026#Masti' jaisa — yaad rahe par andaza mushkil.
Har jagah ek hi password rakhna sahi hai kya?

Bilkul nahi. Ek website se password leak ho to chor saari jagah wahi aazmayega — email, bank sab khul sakta hai. Har zaroori khaate ka password alag rakho. Yaad rakhne ke liye ek surakshit diary ghar par rakho, phone ke note me saade roop me mat rakho.
Password kahin likhna sahi hai ya nahi?

Mobile ya computer me khule note me likhna galat hai. Ghar me ek diary me likhkar surakshit jagah rakhna aam taur par theek hai — chor aam taur par internet se aata hai, tumhare ghar ki almari se nahi. Diary par 'password' bada-bada mat likho.
OTP kya hota hai? Kisi ko bata sakte hain?

OTP phone par aane wala kuch anko ka code hai jo pehchan pakki karta hai. OTP bilkul waisa hi hai jaisi tumhari sign — kisi ko mat batao. Bank, police, company — koi asli aadmi phone karke OTP nahi mangta. Mangne wala pakka thug hai, phone kaat do.
Two-step verification (2-step) kya hota hai?

Ye dusri taala hai. Password dalne ke baad phone par aaya code bhi dalna padta hai. Chor ko password mil bhi jaye to bina tumhare phone ke khaata nahi khulega. Gmail aur WhatsApp me setting se ye on kar lo — 2 minute ka kaam, suraksha dugni.
Password bhool jata hoon baar-baar, koi aasan tareeka?

Ek aasan jumla (sentence) banao aur use password banao, jaise 'MeraGaon@Subah6Baje' — lamba bhi hai, yaad bhi rahega. Har site ke liye aakhir me site ka chhota nishan jod do. Aur 'Forgot password' se naya banana bhi aasan hota hai — ghabrane ki baat nahi.
Public jagah (cyber cafe) ke computer par email kholna surakshit hai?

Majboori ho tabhi kholo. Kaam khatm hote hi 'Sign out' zaroor karo, sirf khidki band karna kaafi nahi. Password 'save' karne ka puche to hamesha 'No' karo. Net banking jaisa kaam cafe ke computer par bilkul mat karo.
Backup kya hota hai?

Backup matlab apni zaroori files ki dusri copy alag jagah rakhna. Asli file mit jaye, computer kharab ho jaye ya virus aa jaye to copy se kaam chal jata hai. Copy usi computer me ho to wo asal backup nahi — alag pen drive, dusri disk ya internet (Drive) par honi chahiye.
Files ka backup lene ka sabse aasan tareeka kya hai?

Ek pen drive ya bahari hard disk rakho sirf backup ke liye. Har hafte ya mahine zaroori folder (Documents, Photo) usme copy kar do. Copy karte samay purani par nayi chadhane (replace) ka vikalp aaye to haan karo — taaza copy rahegi.
Google Drive par backup kaise le?

Browser me drive.google.com kholo, 'New' → 'File upload' ya folder seedha ghaseet kar dalo. 15 GB jagah muft milti hai — kagazaat aur photo ke liye kaafi. Drive ki file internet par hoti hai, isliye computer kharab ho jaye to bhi file kahin se bhi mil jayegi.
Kin files ka backup sabse zaroori hai?

Jo dobara nahi ban sakti: parivaar ki photo-video, zaroori kagazaat ke scan, apna kaam (resume, project, hisaab ki file). Film aur gana dobara mil jayenge, parivaar ki purani photo nahi milegi — pehle unka backup lo.
Backup kitne dino me lena chahiye?

Jo kaam roz badalta hai (dukaan ka hisaab) — hafte me ek baar. Photo aur kagaz — jab bhi naye judo, tab hi copy kar do. Ek aasan niyam: mahine ki pehli tareekh ko backup wala din bana lo, bhoologe nahi.
Backup wali pen drive ko kahan rakhe?

Usi kamre me computer ke paas rakhna theek hai aam kaam ke liye, par aag-paani-chori se bachana hai to dusri jagah (dusra kamra ya rishtedar ka ghar) aur bhi acha. Aur ek copy Drive par bhi ho to sabse pakka — teen jagah wali file kabhi nahi khoti.
Computer me naya program (software) kaise install kare?

Pehle program ki asli website se uski setup file download karo (.exe wali). File par double click karo — setup khulega. 'Next' dabate jao, shartein padhkar 'I Agree' karo, aakhir me 'Install' phir 'Finish'. Program Start menu me aa jayega.
Program kahan se download karna surakshit hai?

Sirf teen jagah: (1) company ki asli website, (2) Microsoft Store, (3) program ki pehchan wali aadhikarik site. Google par pehla link hi asli ho, zaroori nahi — naam dhyaan se padho. 'Free download' ke bhadkile button wali site se bacho.
Jo program kaam ka nahi, use kaise hataye (uninstall)?

Settings kholo → 'Apps' → list me program dhundho → uspar click karke 'Uninstall' dabao. Ya Control Panel → 'Programs and Features' se bhi hota hai. Desktop se sirf icon delete karne se program nahi hatta — wo sirf shortcut hai.
Install karte samay saath me faltu program ghus aaya, kya karu?

Ye aam hota hai — install ke kadam me chhote tick wale dabbe hote hain. Agli baar har kadam padhkar faltu ka tick hata do. Ghus aaya hai to Settings → Apps me jaakar use uninstall kar do. Naam anjaan ho aur tareekh wahi ho jis din program dala tha — wahi hoga.
Program install nahi ho raha, error aa raha hai?

Pehle dekho: disk me jagah hai? Program tumhare Windows (32/64 bit) ke hisaab ka hai? Phir computer restart karke dubara try karo. Setup file par right click karke 'Run as administrator' se bhi kai baar ho jata hai. Phir bhi na ho to error ka naam Google par khojo — hal mil jayega.
Windows update karna chahiye ya nahi?

Zaroor karna chahiye. Update me suraksha ke sudhar aate hain jinse virus aur chor se bachav hota hai. Settings → Windows Update me 'Check for updates' dabao. Update ke samay computer band mat karo — bijli lagi rehne do.
Mobile wala app computer par chal sakta hai kya?

Seedha nahi chalta. Kuch app ke computer wale version hote hain (jaise WhatsApp ka computer version) — wo install karo. Baaki mobile app ke liye 'emulator' naam ke program lagte hain, par wo computer ko dheema karte hain — bina zaroorat ke mat lagao.
Computer bahut dheema ho gaya hai, pehle kya kare?

Pehla ilaaj: computer ko Restart karo. Bahut din se chala aa raha computer restart se tarotaaza ho jata hai. Phir dekho — disk (C drive) me jagah khaali hai? Lal bhari disk bhi dheema karti hai. Ye do kaam aadhi dikkat wahi khatm kar dete hain.
C drive bhar gaya hai, jagah kaise khaali kare?

Downloads folder saaf karo — purani setup file aur video yahi bhare hote hain. Recycle Bin khaali karo. Phir Settings → System → Storage me 'Temporary files' saaf karo. Kam se kam 15-20 GB jagah hamesha khaali rakho, computer saans lega.
Computer on hote hi bahut samay lagta hai, kya wajah hai?

On hote hi khud chalu hone wale program (startup apps) badi wajah hain. Ctrl+Shift+Esc dabakar Task Manager kholo → 'Startup' hisse me jao → jo program shuru me nahi chahiye (jaise game, updater) use 'Disable' karo. On hona tez ho jayega.
Ek saath program kholne par computer atak jata hai?

Ye RAM kam hone ki nishani hai. Kaam ke samay faltu program aur browser ke zyada tab band rakho. Task Manager me 'Memory' dekhkar pata chalega kaun sa program zyada kha raha hai. Sthayi hal: RAM badhwana (8 GB se 16 GB) sasta aur asardar upaay hai.
Browser (Chrome) bahut dheema chalta hai, kya kare?

Ek saath 20-30 tab mat kholo — har tab RAM khata hai. Faltu extensions hata do (browser ki setting me Extensions). Mahine me ek baar history/cache saaf karo. Aur browser ko update rakho — purana version dheema aur asurakshit hota hai.
Computer dheema hai, virus hai ya purana ho gaya — kaise pehchane?

Pehle full antivirus scan karo. Phir Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) me dekho — koi anjaan program CPU/RAM 90% kha raha hai to wahi dushman hai. Sab saaf hai phir bhi dheema hai to umar ki baat hai — SSD lagwana purane computer ko nayi jaan deta hai.
Purane computer ko tez karne ka sabse sasta upaay kya hai?

Agar computer me purani hard disk (HDD) hai to SSD lagwao — yahi ek badlav sabse bada farak deta hai, on hona aur program khulna 4-5 guna tez. Saath me RAM 8 GB tak ho to aam kaam ke liye purana computer bhi kai saal aur chalega.
Desktop par bahut saari file rakhi hain, usse dheema hota hai kya?

Desktop par dhair lagi file se computer thoda dheema to padta hai, par sabse badi baat — dhundhna mushkil hota hai. Files ko unke folder (Documents/Pictures) me rakho, Desktop par sirf 4-5 shortcut rakho. Saaf desktop, saaf dimag.
Computer garam hokar band ho jata hai, kya karu?

Ye zyada garmi ki nishani hai. Cabinet ke hawa wale jaale (vent) par dhool jami hoti hai — band karke naram brush se saaf karo. Laptop ko bistar par rakhkar mat chalao, neeche hawa nahi jaati — mez par rakho. Phir bhi band ho to mistri ko dikhao, andar ka fan ya paste ka kaam ho sakta hai.
Game khelte samay computer dheema padta hai?

Game bhaari kaam hai. Khelne se pehle baaki program band karo. Game ki setting me graphics 'Low' ya 'Medium' rakho. Laptop hai to charger lagakar khelo — battery par laptop taakat bachata hai, isliye dheema chalta hai.
Copy paste ka shortcut kya hai?

Copy: Ctrl+C, Paste: Ctrl+V, Cut: Ctrl+X. Pehle cheez select karo, Ctrl+C dabao, jahan chahiye wahan jaakar Ctrl+V. Ye teen shortcut har program me chalte hain — Word, Excel, browser, sab me. Inhe yaad kar lo, mouse se aadha samay bachega.
Galti ho jaye to ulta (undo) kaise kare?

Ctrl+Z dabao — jo aakhri kaam kiya tha wo ulta ho jayega. Galat delete, galat likhai — zyadatar galtiyan Ctrl+Z se sudhar jati hain. Wapas aage jana ho to Ctrl+Y. Ye jodi har program me sabse kaam ki hai.
Poora text ya saari file ek saath select karne ka shortcut?
Ctrl+A — 'All' wala. Page ka poora text ya folder ki saari file ek saath select ho jati hain. Phir ek saath copy, delete ya rang badalna — jo karna ho karo.
Likhne ka kaam save karne ka shortcut kya hai?
Ctrl+S — Save. Jo bhi program ho, kaam karte hue har 5-10 minute me Ctrl+S dabane ki aadat banao. Bijli jaye ya program band ho jaye, kaam surakshit rahega.
Khuli hui khidkiyo me badalne (switch) ka shortcut?
Alt+Tab dabaye rakho aur Tab dabate jao — khule programo ki list aayegi, jo chahiye uspar chhodo. Ek saath kai program me kaam karne walo ke liye ye sabse tez tareeka hai.
Computer turant lock karna hai, kaise kare?
Windows key + L dabao — computer turant lock ho jayega aur password mangega. Daftar ya dukaan me seat se uthte samay hamesha lock karo, taaki koi tumhare kaam me haath na mare.
Mouse ka right click aur left click me kya farak hai?

Left click se cheez chunte aur kholte hain (double click se file khulti hai). Right click se us cheez ke vikalpo ki list (menu) khulti hai — copy, delete, rename sab wahi milta hai. Kuch samajh na aaye to right click karke dekho, vikalp wahi hote hain.
Mouse ki speed tez/dheemi kaise kare?

Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Mouse me 'Pointer speed' wali line ko aage-peeche karo. Jo aadat hai uske hisaab se set karo. Naye user ke liye thodi dheemi speed sahi rehti hai — click sahi jagah padta hai.
Desktop ka wallpaper (peeche wali photo) kaise badle?

Desktop ki khaali jagah par right click → 'Personalize' → 'Background' me apni pasand ki photo chuno. Apni photo lagani hai to 'Browse' karke photo select karo. Screen tumhari pasand ki ho to kaam me man lagta hai.
Screen ki roshni (brightness) kaise kam-zyada kare?

Laptop me keyboard par suraj wale nishan wali key (aam taur par F2/F3 ya F5/F6, Fn ke saath) hoti hai. Ya neeche-daaine ghadi ke paas click karke brightness wali patti ghaseeto. Raat me roshni kam rakho — aankho ko aaram milega.
Computer ki awaaz (volume) kaise badhaye-ghataye?

Neeche-daaine speaker wale nishan par click karo aur patti ko aage-peeche karo. Laptop me keyboard par speaker wali key bhi hoti hai. Awaaz bilkul nahi aa rahi to dekho — speaker/headphone sahi se laga hai? Volume mute to nahi?
WiFi se computer kaise jode?

Neeche-daaine WiFi wale nishan par click karo — aas-paas ke network dikhenge. Apne ghar/dukaan ke WiFi ka naam chuno, password dalo, Connect dabao. Ek baar jud jaye to agli baar apne aap jud jayega. Password galat ho to 'incorrect' aayega — dhyaan se dobara dalo.
Internet nahi chal raha, pehle kya check kare?

Kram se dekho: (1) WiFi on hai? Laptop me airplane mode to nahi? (2) Modem/router ki batti jal rahi hai? Router band karke 10 second baad on karo. (3) Mobile par wahi WiFi chal raha hai? Mobile par chale aur computer par nahi to dikkat computer ki hai. Zyadatar dikkat router restart se theek ho jati hai.
Download aur upload me kya farak hai?

Download matlab internet se apne computer me lana — jaise film, photo, program lana. Upload matlab apne computer se internet par bhejna — jaise Drive par file dalna, email me file lagana. Download aam taur par tez hota hai, upload dheema.
Browser kya hota hai? Chrome aur Edge me farak?

Browser wo program hai jisse internet ki website khulti hai — Chrome, Edge, Firefox sab browser hain. Edge Windows ke saath aata hai, Chrome Google ka hai. Kaam dono ek jaisa — website kholna. Jo aadat pad jaye wahi use karo.
Website ka address (URL) kahan likhte hain?

Browser ke sabse upar wale lambe dabbe (address bar) me. Wahan pura address likho, jaise www.google.com, aur Enter dabao. Usi dabbe me seedha sawal likhkar search bhi kar sakte ho — Google khud dhundh dega.
Browser me naya tab kaise khole?

Upar tab ke paas '+' wale nishan par click karo, ya Ctrl+T dabao. Har website alag tab me khulti hai — ek band kiye bina dusri dekh sakte ho. Galti se tab band ho jaye to Ctrl+Shift+T dabao — wahi tab wapas khul jayega.
Kisi website ko bookmark (pasandeeda) kaise kare?

Website kholo, address bar ke paas taare (star) wale nishan par click karo, ya Ctrl+D dabao. Website save ho jayegi. Agli baar bookmark list se ek click me khulegi — roz khulne wali site (email, bank, sarkari portal) bookmark kar lo.
Computer ki tareekh aur samay galat hai, kaise theek kare?

Neeche-daaine ghadi par right click → 'Adjust date and time' → 'Set time automatically' on kar do — internet se sahi samay aa jayega. Samay galat ho to kai website (khaas karke bank wali) khulne me dikkat karti hain, isliye ye sahi rakho.
Hindi me type karna hai computer par, kaise kare?

Do tareeke: (1) Google Input Tools ya Windows ki Hindi keyboard jodo — Devanagari akshar type honge. (2) Internet par 'Hinglish to Hindi' wali site — Roman me likho, Hindi me badal jayega. Settings → Language me Hindi jodne se keyboard badal sakte ho (Windows key + Space se).
Excel me kalam ka daam 12 rupaye hai aur ginati 5 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (12) aur dusre me ginati (5) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 12 × 5 = ₹60. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me copy ka daam 40 rupaye hai aur ginati 8 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (40) aur dusre me ginati (8) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 40 × 8 = ₹320. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me pencil ka daam 5 rupaye hai aur ginati 20 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (5) aur dusre me ginati (20) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 5 × 20 = ₹100. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me kitab ka daam 150 rupaye hai aur ginati 3 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (150) aur dusre me ginati (3) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 150 × 3 = ₹450. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me kursi ka daam 700 rupaye hai aur ginati 4 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (700) aur dusre me ginati (4) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 700 × 4 = ₹2800. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me basta ka daam 450 rupaye hai aur ginati 2 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (450) aur dusre me ginati (2) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 450 × 2 = ₹900. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me dabba ka daam 60 rupaye hai aur ginati 10 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (60) aur dusre me ginati (10) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 60 × 10 = ₹600. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me botal ka daam 90 rupaye hai aur ginati 6 hai, kul rakam ka formula batao?
Ek cell me daam (90) aur dusre me ginati (6) likho, teesre me formula =A2*B2 lagao. Hisab: 90 × 6 = ₹540. Guna ke liye Excel me * ka nishan use hota hai.
Excel me mahine ki tankhwah 15000 hai, 12 mahine ki kul tankhwah kaise nikale?
Formula: =15000*12 ya cell se =A2*B2. Hisab: 15000 × 12 = ₹180000. Aise hi koi bhi mahine ka hisaab saal bhar ka ban jata hai.
Excel me mahine ki tankhwah 8000 hai, 6 mahine ki kul tankhwah kaise nikale?
Formula: =8000*6 ya cell se =A2*B2. Hisab: 8000 × 6 = ₹48000. Aise hi koi bhi mahine ka hisaab saal bhar ka ban jata hai.
Excel me mahine ki tankhwah 25000 hai, 3 mahine ki kul tankhwah kaise nikale?
Formula: =25000*3 ya cell se =A2*B2. Hisab: 25000 × 3 = ₹75000. Aise hi koi bhi mahine ka hisaab saal bhar ka ban jata hai.
Excel me mahine ki tankhwah 12000 hai, 9 mahine ki kul tankhwah kaise nikale?
Formula: =12000*9 ya cell se =A2*B2. Hisab: 12000 × 9 = ₹108000. Aise hi koi bhi mahine ka hisaab saal bhar ka ban jata hai.
Excel me A1:A4 me kiraya, khana, safar aur bill likhe hain: 2000, 1500, 800, 700. Kul kharcha nikalna hai, formula aur jawab?
Formula: =SUM(A1:A4) — jawab ₹5000 aayega. Aur ausat chahiye to =AVERAGE(A1:A4) se ₹1250 aayega. Dono formula hisaab-kitab ki jaan hain.
Excel me A1:A3 me teen dino ke kharche likhe hain: 500, 300, 200. Kul kharcha nikalna hai, formula aur jawab?
Formula: =SUM(A1:A3) — jawab ₹1000 aayega. Aur ausat chahiye to =AVERAGE(A1:A3) se ₹333.3 aayega. Dono formula hisaab-kitab ki jaan hain.
Excel me A1:A5 me hafte bhar ke kharche likhe hain: 1200, 900, 450, 350, 600. Kul kharcha nikalna hai, formula aur jawab?
Formula: =SUM(A1:A5) — jawab ₹3500 aayega. Aur ausat chahiye to =AVERAGE(A1:A5) se ₹700 aayega. Dono formula hisaab-kitab ki jaan hain.
Ramesh ke 5 vishayo ke number hain: 78, 85, 92, 67, 88. Excel me kul, average aur percentage kaise nikale?
Teen formula: Kul = =SUM(A1:A5) → 410. Average = =AVERAGE(A1:A5) → 82. Percentage = =(kul/500)*100 → 82%. Teeno ek saath lagao to poori report card Excel khud bana dega.
Sita ke 5 vishayo ke number hain: 45, 52, 60, 38, 55. Excel me kul, average aur percentage kaise nikale?
Teen formula: Kul = =SUM(A1:A5) → 250. Average = =AVERAGE(A1:A5) → 50. Percentage = =(kul/500)*100 → 50%. Teeno ek saath lagao to poori report card Excel khud bana dega.
Amit ke 5 vishayo ke number hain: 90, 95, 88, 92, 85. Excel me kul, average aur percentage kaise nikale?
Teen formula: Kul = =SUM(A1:A5) → 450. Average = =AVERAGE(A1:A5) → 90. Percentage = =(kul/500)*100 → 90%. Teeno ek saath lagao to poori report card Excel khud bana dega.
Pooja ke 5 vishayo ke number hain: 33, 40, 35, 50, 42. Excel me kul, average aur percentage kaise nikale?
Teen formula: Kul = =SUM(A1:A5) → 200. Average = =AVERAGE(A1:A5) → 40. Percentage = =(kul/500)*100 → 40%. Teeno ek saath lagao to poori report card Excel khud bana dega.
File Explorer kya hota hai?

File Explorer wo khidki hai jisme computer ki saari file aur folder dikhte hain. Neeche taskbar par peele folder wale nishan par click karo ya Windows key + E dabao. Yahi se har file tak pahunchte hain — copy, delete, dhundhna sab yahi se.
Taskbar kya hota hai?

Screen ke sabse neeche wali patti ko taskbar kehte hain. Isme Start button, khule hue program aur daaine kone me ghadi hoti hai. Roz use hone wale program ko yahan chipka (pin) sakte ho — right click karke 'Pin to taskbar'.
Start menu kya hota hai aur kaise khole?

Neeche-bayein kone par Windows wale nishan (Start) par click karo — saare program ki list khul jayegi. Yahi se program kholte hain, computer band (Shut down) karte hain aur setting me jate hain. Keyboard par Windows key dabane se bhi khulta hai.
Computer sahi tareeke se band (shut down) kaise kare?

Pehle khule program band karo aur kaam save karo. Phir Start → Power (bijli wala nishan) → 'Shut Down' dabao. Seedha bijli ka button ya switch band karna galat hai — file kharab ho sakti hai aur computer me dikkat aa sakti hai.
Restart aur Shut down me kya farak hai?

Shut down se computer pura band hota hai. Restart me band hokar khud phir chalu ho jata hai. Computer atak jaye ya naya program install ho to restart karna chahiye — bahut si chhoti dikkat restart se hi theek ho jati hai.
Scanner kya hota hai, kagaz ko computer me kaise dale?

Scanner kagaz ki photo karke use computer me file bana deta hai. Kagaz scanner me ulta rakho, computer me scan wala program kholo, 'Scan' dabao — kagaz ki saaf file (PDF/JPG) ban jayegi. Aajkal zyadatar printer me scanner saath me hota hai.
Photocopy (Xerox) aur scan me kya farak hai?

Photocopy me kagaz ki copy kagaz par hi nikalti hai. Scan me kagaz ki file computer me banti hai — use email/WhatsApp se kahin bhi bhej sakte ho aur hamesha ke liye save rakh sakte ho. Kagaz bhejna ho to scan, kagaz chahiye to photocopy.
Computer me Bluetooth se mobile se photo kaise le?

Dono ka Bluetooth on karo. Computer me Settings → Bluetooth me mobile ka naam dhundhkar jodo (pair karo). Phir mobile se photo share karke Bluetooth se computer chuno. Chhoti file ke liye theek hai, badi video me cable tez padega.
Ek file galti se galat folder me chali gayi, sahi jagah kaise laye?

File ko dhundho (search se), use select karke Ctrl+X (cut) karo, sahi folder kholo aur Ctrl+V dabao. Ya mouse se pakad kar (drag) folder par le jaakar chhod do — file wahan chali jayegi. Drag karte samay galat folder par na chhute, dhyaan do.
File ka poora path (pata) kya hota hai?

Path file ka poora pata hai — jaise C:\Users\Documents\Resume.docx. Matlab: C drive → Users → Documents folder → Resume file. File par right click → Properties me ya File Explorer ke upar wale dabbe me ye pata dikhta hai.
Notepad kya hota hai? Kis kaam aata hai?

Notepad sabse saada likhne wala program hai — bina rang-size ke saadi likhai. Jaldi note karna, number likhna, koi code ya list banana — iske liye behtareen. File .txt naam se banti hai aur har computer me khul jati hai.
Paint kya hota hai?

Paint tasveer banane-sudharne ka saada program hai. Isme screenshot chipkana, photo ka size badalna, photo par nishan ya teer lagana, ghumana — ye chhote kaam aaram se hote hain. Naye seekhne walo ke liye sabse aasan photo wala program hai.
Photo ka size (MB) chhota kaise kare bina app ke?

Photo ko Paint me kholo → 'Resize' dabao → percentage 50% kar do → nayi file ke roop me save karo. Photo aadhi ho jayegi aur file bhi chhoti. Email ya form me photo dalne ke liye aksar chhoti file hi mangte hain.
Form bharte samay photo ki file 200 KB se chhoti mangi hai, kya karu?

Pehle photo ka size Properties me dekho. Zyada badi hai to Paint me Resize karke 50% karo aur JPG me save karo, phir size check karo. Online form ke liye ye roz ki dikkat hai — ek baar tareeka seekh lo to 1 minute ka kaam hai.
Computer me ek program atak (hang) gaya, band kaise kare?

Ctrl+Shift+Esc dabakar Task Manager kholo. Atke hue program ke naam par click karke 'End Task' dabao — program zabardasti band ho jayega. Dhyaan do — bina save kiya kaam us program me gayab ho jayega.
Recycle Bin kya hota hai?

Recycle Bin computer ka kooda-daan hai. Delete ki hui file seedha nahi mitti, pehle yahan jati hai. Galti se delete hui file yahan se 'Restore' karke wapas mil jati hai. Bin bhar jaye to use khaali (Empty) kar do — tab file asal me mitti hai aur jagah khaali hoti hai.
Desktop par bahut icon bhar gaye, tarteeb kaise kare?

Desktop ki khaali jagah par right click → 'Sort by' → 'Name' chuno — icon naam ke kram me lag jayenge. Files ko folder me dalo aur Desktop par sirf roz wale program ke shortcut rakho. Saaf desktop par kaam tez aur aasan hota hai.
Keyboard par kuch key kaam nahi kar rahi, kya check kare?

Pehle dekho koi cheez key ke neeche fasi to nahi — ulta karke halke se jhatko. Phir dusre program me type karke dekho. Ek hi key kharab hai to keyboard badalna pad sakta hai; saari band hain to cable/port check karo ya restart karo.
Caps Lock on hai, pata kaise chalta hai?

Keyboard par Caps Lock wali chhoti batti jalti hai jab wo on hota hai. Iske on hone par saare akshar bade (CAPITAL) likhte hain. Password dalte samay khaas dhyaan do — Caps Lock on ho to sahi password bhi galat mana jata hai.
Number wala hissa (numpad) kaam nahi kar raha keyboard ke side wala?

Keyboard ke upar 'Num Lock' wali key dabao — uski batti jalni chahiye. Num Lock band ho to side wale number ki jagah teer (arrow) ka kaam karte hain. Hisab-kitab walo ke liye numpad sabse tez number dalne ka tareeka hai.
Folder ke andar bahut file hain, ek jhalak me sabki list kaise dekhe?

File Explorer me upar 'View' me 'Details' ya 'List' chuno — har file ek line me naam, tareekh aur size ke saath dikhegi. Photo dekhni ho to 'Large icons' chuno — photo ki chhoti tasveer dikhegi bina khole.
Kisi file ko pen drive me bhejne ki jagah seedha WhatsApp Web se kaise bheje?

Computer par web.whatsapp.com kholo, mobile se QR code scan karke login karo. Chat kholo, clip wale nishan se 'Document' chuno aur file bhej do. Computer ki file seedha mobile walo tak pahunchane ka ye tez tareeka hai.
Google Drive kya hai, aasan bhasha me?

Google Drive internet par mili tumhari apni almari hai — 15 GB muft. File wahan dalo to wo Google ke computer me save hoti hai, tum kahin se bhi (mobile/computer) apne Gmail se khol sakte ho. Computer kharab ho jaye to bhi file surakshit.
OneDrive aur Google Drive me kya farak hai?

Dono internet par file rakhne ki jagah hain. OneDrive Microsoft ka hai, Windows ke saath aata hai, 5 GB muft. Google Drive Google ka hai, 15 GB muft aur Gmail se juda hai. Kaam dono ka ek hi hai — jo aadat ho wahi use karo.
Computer me samay ke saath tareekh bhi dikhe, kaise kare?

Taskbar ki ghadi par waise hi tareekh dikhti hai jab mouse uspar le jao. Hamesha dikhana hai to Settings → Personalization → Taskbar me samay wali setting dekho. Ghadi sahi rakhna zaroori hai — galat samay par kai website khulne se mana kar deti hain.
File ko email se bhejne layak chhota kaise kare agar 30 MB ki hai?

Gmail ki seema 25 MB hai. File ko zip karo — document ho to size ghat jayega. Phir bhi badi hai to Google Drive par dalo aur email me sirf Drive ka link bhejo. Video ke liye hamesha Drive wala tareeka hi sahi hai.
Excel me do sheet ke beech data kaise le jaye?

Jis cell ka data chahiye us sheet me jao, cell select karke Ctrl+C, dusri sheet (neeche naam par click) me jaakar Ctrl+V. Formula se jodna hai to =Sheet1!A1 jaisa likhte hain — pehli sheet ke A1 ka data yahan aa jayega aur wahan badle to yahan bhi badlega.
Word me do page ka document ek page me kaise laye?

Pehle font size thoda kam karo (12 se 11), phir Layout → Margins → Narrow karo, aur line spacing 1.5 se 1.0 karo. Zyadatar do page wale kagaz isse ek page me aa jate hain. Print preview me dekhte jao ki kata to nahi.
Excel me naam ki list ko roll number ke kram me kaise lagaye?

Poora data select karo, Data → Sort me pehle 'Roll Number' wala column chuno, kram 'Smallest to Largest'. 'Expand selection' wala vikalp zaroor chuno taaki naam apne roll number ke saath hi khisken — warna list ka jod bigad jayega.
PowerPoint ki slide ka size A4 kagaz jaisa kaise kare?
Design → Slide Size → 'Custom Slide Size' me A4 chuno. Print karne wale presentation ke liye ye sahi hai. Aam screen prastuti ke liye 16:9 (chaudi screen) wala size behtar dikhta hai.
Print karte samay kagaz ka size A4 kaise set kare?

Print dabbe me 'Paper size' me A4 chuno — Bharat me aam kagaz A4 hi hota hai. Letter size galti se chuna ho to print ka kinara kat sakta hai. Ek baar A4 set karke 'default' bana do to baar-baar nahi karna padega.
Computer me hindi font (Devanagari) dikh nahi raha, dabbe-dabbe dikh rahe hain?

Ye font ki dikkat hai — file jis font me bani hai wo computer me nahi hai. Mangal font Windows me aata hi hai, usme Hindi dikhta hai. Purani Kruti Dev wali file ke liye wahi font install karna padega. Font badalne ke liye text select karke font list se chuno.
Excel me ghatav (minus) kaise kare?
Ghatav ke liye - ka nishan: =500-200 likho, jawab 300. Cell se karna hai to =A1-B1 — A1 me se B1 ghatega. Bachi hui rakam, bacha hua stock — roz ke hisaab me ye sabse zyada chalta hai.
Excel me bhaag (divide) kaise kare?
Bhaag ke liye / ka nishan: =100/4 likho, jawab 25. Jaise kul kharcha 4 logo me baantna ho to =kul/4. Dhyaan do — 0 se bhaag doge to #DIV/0! error aayega, kyunki 0 se bhaag mumkin nahi.
Excel me bill kaise banaye dukaan ke liye?

Column banao: Saman, Daam, Ginati, Kul. Har line me Kul ke liye =Daam*Ginati wala formula. Aakhir me =SUM(Kul wala column) — poora bill jud jayega. Upar dukaan ka naam badi heading me likho, print karke graahak ko de sakte ho.
Excel me saal bhar ke kharche ka graph (chart) kaise banaye?

Mahine aur kharche ka data likho, use select karo, Insert → Chart me 'Column' wala chuno. Kharcha salakho (bar) ke roop me dikhega — kis mahine zyada hua, ek nazar me pata chalega. Report aur prastuti me chart bahut asar dalta hai.
Excel me cell me lambi line likhi hai, dusri line me kaise jaye ek hi cell me?
Cell me likhte samay Alt+Enter dabao — usi cell me nayi line shuru ho jayegi. Pata ya pura naam-pata ek cell me line-dar-line likhne ke liye ye kaam aata hai. Cell ki unchaai apne aap badh jayegi.
Excel me do tareekho ke beech kitne din hue, kaise nikale?
Do cell me tareekhe likho (jaise A1 me 01/01/2026, B1 me 31/01/2026). Teesre cell me =B1-A1 likho — jawab 30 (din) aayega. Udhari ke din, kiraye ke din ginne me ye bahut kaam aata hai.
Word me apne naam ka bada poster jaisa page banana hai?

Word me naam type karo, select karke font size 72 ya usse bada karo, bold karo, beech me (center) karo. Rang bhi badal sakte ho. Print karke diwar par lagane layak bada naam taiyaar. School ke karyakram me ye khoob kaam aata hai.
Word me aavedan (application) kaise likhe chhutti ke liye?

Upar bayein 'Sewa me, Pradhanacharya mahoday' likho, phir school ka naam. Neeche 'Vishay: Chhutti hetu aavedan'. Phir izzat ke saath apni baat 4-5 line me. Aakhir me 'Aapka aagyakari shishya', naam, class, roll number. Har hisse ke beech ek khaali line rakho — saaf dikhega.
Word me do document ki spelling ek jaise check karni hai, jaldi kaise?

Word me upar 'Review' → 'Spelling & Grammar' dabao (ya F7). Word ek-ek galti dikhayega aur sudhar ka sujhav dega — sahi wale par 'Change' dabate jao. Poora kagaz bhej/print karne se pehle ye jaanch zaroor karo.
Word me page par border (chaukhat) kaise lagaye?
Design → 'Page Borders' me jao. Line wali chaukhat chuno ya 'Art' me phool-patti wali design chuno. Praman patra, nimantran aur school project ke page par border bahut sundar lagta hai.
PowerPoint me apne school ka parichay dena hai, kitni slide banau?

5-7 slide kaafi hain: (1) Naam aur photo, (2) Itihaas/sthapna, (3) Suvidhaye, (4) Shikshak aur padhai, (5) Khel aur karyakram, (6) Safalta, (7) Dhanyavaad. Har slide par ek photo aur 3-4 bindu. Zyada slide se sunne wale thak jate hain.
Internet par online form bharte samay kya-kya dhyaan de?

Pehle poora form padho, phir bharna shuru karo. Naam aur tareekh kagaz ke hisaab se bilkul waisi hi likho. Photo/signature ki file pehle se tayyar rakho sahi size me. Submit se pehle ek baar poora padhkar check karo — galti ho to sudhar ka mauka har form me nahi milta.
Internet se file download karte samay kahan jati hai?

Aam taur par Downloads folder me. Browser me neeche ya upar download ki patti dikhti hai — uspar click karke file khol sakte ho ya 'Show in folder' se jagah dekh sakte ho. Download pura hone se pehle file mat kholo.
Internet ki speed dheemi hai, video ruk raha hai, kya kare?

Pehle dusre program aur download band karo. WiFi router ke paas jaakar dekho — doori aur deewar se signal kam hota hai. Video ki quality 480p ya 360p kar do — kam data me aaram se chalega. Router restart karna bhi aksar kaam karta hai.
Memory card (SD card) kya hota hai? Computer me kaise padhe?

Memory card mobile/camera me lagne wali chhoti chip hai jisme photo-video hota hai. Computer me padhne ke liye card reader lagta hai — kuch laptop me card lagane ki jagah (slot) in-built hoti hai. Lagate hi File Explorer me nayi drive dikhegi, aam pen drive ki tarah kholo.
External hard disk kya hoti hai?

Ye jeb me aane wali badi storage hai — 1 TB, 2 TB tak. USB se lagti hai. Badi file, film, photo ka sangrah aur backup ke liye use hoti hai. Pen drive se zyada jagah aur aam taur par zyada bharosemand hoti hai, sambhal kar rakho — girne se kharab ho sakti hai.
Computer ki physical safai kaise kare?

Pehle computer band karke taar nikalo. Screen ko naram sukhe kapde (microfiber) se halke haath poncho — paani ya spray seedha screen par mat maro. Keyboard ulta karke halke se jhatko. Cabinet ke jaalo ki dhool brush se saaf karo. Mahine me ek baar itna kaafi hai.
Screen par kuch dikh hi nahi raha, monitor band hai kya check kare?

Kram se: (1) Monitor ka power button on hai? Uski batti jal rahi hai? (2) Monitor ki taar cabinet se sahi lagi hai? (3) Cabinet chalu hai — uski batti aur pankhe ki awaaz? Ek-ek karke check karo, dikkat wahi milegi.
Computer chalu hai par keyboard-mouse kaam nahi kar rahe?

Taar wala hai to plug nikal kar dubara lagao, dusre USB port me try karo. Wireless hai to battery check karo aur chhota sa USB dongle sahi laga hai ya nahi dekho. Phir bhi na ho to restart karo — driver ki atak aksar restart se khulti hai.
File ka naam bahut lamba hai, chhota karne se koi dikkat?

Naam chhota karna bilkul theek hai — bas naam aisa rakho jisse samajh aaye andar kya hai. 'Document1' ki jagah 'Fees Rasid 2026' behtar hai. Naam me tareekh jodna achhi aadat hai — purani-nayi file turant pehchani jati hai.
Ek folder me 1000 file ho gayi, dhundhna mushkil hai, kya karu?

Andar saal ya vishay ke hisaab se chhote folder banao — jaise '2025', '2026' ya 'Bill', 'Photo'. Phir files unme baanto (cut-paste). File Explorer ke search me naam ka hissa likhkar bhi turant dhundh sakte ho.
Excel me number likhte hi tareekh ban jata hai (jaise 1-2 se)?

Excel 1-2 ko tareekh (1-Feb) samajh leta hai. Isse bachne ke liye cell ko pehle 'Text' format karo: cell select → Home me format wale dabbe me 'Text' chuno, phir likho. Ya number se pehle chhota sa ' (apostrophe) lagao — Excel use jaisa hai waisa rakhega.
Excel me mobile number likhne par aage ka 0 gayab ho jata hai?

Excel number ke aage ka 0 bekar samajh kar hata deta hai. Hal: cell ka format pehle 'Text' karo, phir number likho. Ya number se pehle ' lagao. Mobile number, PIN code — jahan 0 aage aata hai wahan ye niyam yaad rakho.
Word me likhte samay poora shabd apne aap badal jata hai (autocorrect)?

Word galat spelling ko khud theek karta hai — kabhi-kabhi naam bhi badal deta hai. Badla hua pasand na ho to turant Ctrl+Z karo. Hamesha ke liye band karna hai to File → Options → Proofing → AutoCorrect me jaakar band kar sakte ho.
PDF file me se ek page ki photo (image) kaise nikale?

PDF me wo page kholo, page ko bada karo, screenshot lo (Windows+Shift+S) aur Paint me paste karke save karo. Aasan aur bina kisi program ke ho jata hai. Saaf photo chahiye to page ko 150-200% bada karke screenshot lo.
Email me badi saari purani email saaf kaise kare?

Gmail me search me bhejne wale ka naam likho, upar wale tick dabbe se saare chuno aur Delete dabao. Delete hue email 30 din 'Trash' me rehte hain, phir khud mit jate hain. Jagah (storage) zyada badi file wale email se bharti hai — 'larger:10M' likhkar search karne se bade email milenge.
Google par mausam, sona-chaandi ka daam jaise taaza haal kaise dekhe?
Search me seedha likho 'aaj ka mausam [shehar]' ya 'aaj sone ka daam'. Google upar hi taaza jaankari dikha deta hai. Daam jaisi cheez me tareekh zaroor dekho — purani khabar ka daam aaj ka nahi hota.
Internet par padhai ke liye achhi website kaise pehchane?

Sarkari aur bharosemand: NCERT (ncert.nic.in) ki kitab muft milti hai, SWAYAM par muft course hain, Khan Academy par video se padhai hoti hai. Jis site par har kadam par paisa ya OTP mange, wahan se bacho. Kitab hamesha aadhikarik site se lo.
Computer par bacho ke liye suraksha kaise rakhe?

Apna alag khaata (user account) bacho ke liye banao, jisme program install na ho sake. Browser me anjaan site se download rokna sikhayo. Aur sabse zaroori — bacho ko batao ki internet par kisi ko naam-pata-photo nahi dena. Samay ki seema bhi tay karo.
Typing ki speed badhani hai, kya tareeka hai?

Pehle sahi ungliyo ki jagah seekho — beech wali line (ASDF...) par ungliya rakho. Bina keyboard dekhe type karne ka abhyaas roz 15 minute karo. Internet par muft typing seekhane wali site hain. Pehle sahi, phir tez — ye kram rakho, speed khud badhegi.
File share karte samay 'link' bhejna kya hota hai?

Google Drive par file dalo, file par right click karke 'Share' → 'Copy link' karo. Wo link jise bhejoge, wo file dekh/download kar sakta hai. Badi file bhejne ka ye sabse aasan tareeka hai. Niji file ka link sirf use do jise dena hai — link jiske paas gaya, file uske paas gayi.
Computer me do monitor lag sakte hain kya?

Haan, zyadatar computer me lag sakte hain — dusra monitor HDMI/VGA taar se jodo, Settings → Display me 'Extend' chuno. Ek par Excel, dusre par Word — kaam bahut aasan ho jata hai. Laptop me bhi bahari monitor lagakar badi screen par kaam kar sakte ho.
Laptop ki battery zyada der chale, kya kare?

Screen ki roshni kam rakho — battery sabse zyada wahi khati hai. Kaam na ho to WiFi/Bluetooth band rakho. Battery saver mode on karo (battery wale nishan par click karke). Ek saath bhaari program mat kholo. Purani battery phul gayi ho to turant badalwao — khatra hai.
Computer me CD/DVD chalani hai par drive nahi hai?

Bahari (external) DVD drive USB se lagti hai — wahi hal hai. CD ki file pehle kisi dusre computer se pen drive me nikal lena aur bhi aasan hai. Aajkal CD ka zamana gaya, zyadatar cheez internet par mil jati hai.
Print nikalte samay 'printer offline' dikh raha hai?

Printer on hai aur sahi se juda hai, pehle ye dekho. Phir printer aur computer dono restart karo. Settings → Printers me jaakar apne printer ko 'Set as default' karo. WiFi printer hai to dekho dono ek hi WiFi par hain ya nahi.
Excel me percentage badhne-ghatne ka hisaab kaise kare (jaise daam 200 se 250 hua)?
Formula: =(naya-purana)/purana*100. 200 se 250 par: =(250-200)/200*100 = 25% badha. Jawab minus me aaye to matlab ghata. Dukaan ke daam aur kamai ke badlav me ye roz kaam aata hai.
Sadharann byaj (simple interest) Excel me kaise nikale?

Formula: =mul*saal*daar/100. Misal: 10,000 rupaye, 2 saal, 8% — =10000*2*8/100 = 1,600 rupaye byaj. Kul rakam chahiye to =10000+1600 = 11,600. Teen cell me mul, saal, dar likhkar formula lagao to har baar ke liye taiyaar.
Word me table me ek aur line (row) kaise jode beech me?

Jis line ke neeche nayi line chahiye, usme click karo, right click → 'Insert' → 'Insert Rows Below'. Upar chahiye to 'Insert Rows Above'. Aakhir me nayi line ke liye aakhri khaane me Tab dabana hi kaafi hai.
PowerPoint slide par video kaise lagaye?

Insert → Video → 'This Device' se apni video file chuno. Video slide par aa jayegi — slideshow me chalegi. Video file bhaari ho to presentation ki file bhi bhaari ho jayegi, bhejne me samay lagega — chhoti clip hi lagao.
Screenshot ko seedha WhatsApp par bhejna hai computer se?

Windows+Shift+S se screenshot lo (wo chipkane ke liye taiyaar hai). Phir WhatsApp Web ki chat kholo aur Ctrl+V dabao — screenshot chat me aa jayega, Enter dabakar bhej do. File save karne ki zaroorat hi nahi.
Zip aur RAR me kya farak hai?

Dono file dabane wale dabbe (archive) hain. ZIP Windows me bina kisi program ke khul jata hai — isliye aam kaam ke liye ZIP hi behtar. RAR kholne ke liye alag program lagta hai. Khud bhejna hai to hamesha ZIP banao, saamne wale ko dikkat nahi hogi.
Computer me jagah (storage) kitni bachi hai, kaise dekhe?

File Explorer me 'This PC' kholo — har drive ke neeche neeli patti ke saath dikhega kitni bhari, kitni khaali. C drive par right click → Properties me gol graph bhi dikhta hai. 90% se zyada bhari disk computer ko dheema kar deti hai.
Download ki hui file kholne par 'Windows ne roka' wala sandesh aaya?

Ye Windows ki suraksha chetaavni hai — file internet se aayi hai aur pehchani nahi gayi. File bharosemand jagah (asli website) se aayi hai to 'More info' → 'Run anyway' se chala sakte ho. Anjaan site ki file ho to bilkul mat chalao — yahi virus ka sabse aam rasta hai.
Email ka 'inbox zero' matlab kya, email saaf rakhne ka tareeka?

Matlab inbox me bewajah ke email ka dhair na ho. Roz 2 minute: farzi/vigyapan wale delete karo, kaam ke email ko label/folder me rakho, jis company ke email nahi chahiye uski 'Unsubscribe' dabao. Saaf inbox me zaroori email kabhi nahi khoyega.
Google search me sirf khabar (news) dekhni hai to?

Search karne ke baad upar 'News' par click karo — sirf khabro wali website ke result aayenge, taaza pehle. Tareekh dekhkar padho — kabhi-kabhi purani khabar nayi bankar ghoomti hai, tareekh hi pehchan hai.
Kisi ka email address galat likh diya to email ka kya hota hai?

10000 rupaye par 2 saal ka 8% ki dar se sadharann byaj kitna hoga, hisaab samjhao?
Formula: Byaj = (Mul × Saal × Dar) / 100. Hisab: (10000 × 2 × 8) / 100 = 160000 / 100 = ₹1600. Kul rakam wapas milegi: 10000 + 1600 = ₹11600.

Formula: Byaj = (Mul × Saal × Dar) / 100. Hisab: (5000 × 3 × 10) / 100 = 150000 / 100 = ₹1500. Kul rakam wapas milegi: 5000 + 1500 = ₹6500.
20000 rupaye par 1 saal ka 6% ki dar se sadharann byaj kitna hoga, hisaab samjhao?
Formula: Byaj = (Mul × Saal × Dar) / 100. Hisab: (20000 × 1 × 6) / 100 = 120000 / 100 = ₹1200. Kul rakam wapas milegi: 20000 + 1200 = ₹21200.
15000 rupaye par 4 saal ka 5% ki dar se sadharann byaj kitna hoga, hisaab samjhao?
Formula: Byaj = (Mul × Saal × Dar) / 100. Hisab: (15000 × 4 × 5) / 100 = 300000 / 100 = ₹3000. Kul rakam wapas milegi: 15000 + 3000 = ₹18000.

Percentage = (mile / kul) × 100 = (315/450) × 100 = 70%. Excel me kisi cell me =(315/450)*100 likho, 70 jawab aayega. Yahi tareeka marks, chhoot aur hisse — har jagah chalta hai.

Excel me apne naam ki hajiri (attendance) sheet kaise banaye?

Pehle column me taareekh, dusre me naam, teesre me Hajir/Gair-hajir. Mahine ke aakhir me =COUNTIF(C:C,"Hajir") se hajiri ke din gin sakte ho. COUNTIF shart ke hisaab se ginti karta hai — di gayi shabd wale cell gin leta hai.

Upar beech me '|| Shree Ganeshaya Namah ||' ya apne dharm ke hisaab se shuruaat, phir naam badi heading me. Neeche table bana kar Janm tareekh, Gotra, Shiksha, Kaam, Parivaar ki jaankari line-dar-line. Table se biodata sabse saaf dikhta hai. Aakhir me PDF banakar bhejo.
Word me do column (akhbaar jaisa) kaise banaye?
Text select karo, Layout → 'Columns' → 'Two' chuno. Likhai do hisso me bat jayegi — akhbaar aur patrika ki tarah. School patrika aur biodata me ye bahut sundar lagta hai.
Print me kagaz ulta nikal raha hai (ulta print ho gaya)?

PDF ka ek page print karna hai, poori PDF nahi?
PDF kholo, us page par jao, Ctrl+P dabao. Print dabbe me 'Current page' ya page number likho. Sirf wahi page print hoga. Form ke sirf bhare hue page ka print nikalne me ye roz kaam aata hai.
