kisi dost ke dost se pehli baar English me parichay

"Hi, I am Varun, Rohit's friend. I work with him in the same office. I have heard a lot about you. Nice to meet you!"

'I have heard a lot about you' matlab 'aapke baare me bahut suna hai' — samne wale ko khushi hoti hai.
Interview me 'Tell me about yourself' ka jawab English me kaise dun?

"My name is Rohit Sharma. I am from Jaipur. I have completed my B.Com. I have two years of experience as an accountant. I am good at Excel and Tally. I am a quick learner and I want to grow with your company."

Ye sawal har interview ka pehla sawal hota hai. Jawab 30-40 second ka rakho — naam, padhai, tajurba, skill, aur aakhir me company ke liye ek achhi baat.
'Why should we hire you?' ka jawab English me

"You should hire me because I have the skills this job needs. I am hardworking, I learn fast, and I always complete my work on time. I will give my best to your company."

Is sawal me apni skill aur bharosa dikhana hai. Ghabrana nahi — shaanti se, muskurakar jawab do.
'What is your weakness?' interview me English me kya bolu?

"My weakness is that I speak less in front of new people. But now I am improving my communication skills by practising daily."

Kamzori aisi chuno jo kaam par zyada asar na kare, aur saath me 'sudhaar raha hoon' wali baat jaroor bolo.
'What is your strength?' ka English me jawab

"My biggest strength is my honesty and hard work. I never leave any work incomplete. My seniors always trust me for important tasks."

Taakat ke saath ek chhota sa saboot (seniors trust karte hain) jawab ko mazboot banata hai.
Interview me salary kitni chahiye, English me kaise bolu?

"As per my skills and experience, I expect a salary of twenty thousand rupees per month. However, I am open to discussion."

'I am open to discussion' matlab 'baat-cheet ho sakti hai' — ye line sakhti khatm karti hai aur baat aage badhti hai. Pehle hi din bahut zyada rakam mat mango.
'Where do you see yourself in 5 years?' ka jawab English me

"In five years, I see myself in a senior position in this company, with more skills and more responsibilities."

Ye jawab dikhata hai ki tum lambe samay ke liye aaye ho, bhaagne ke liye nahi. Company yahi sunna chahti hai.
Interview me pichli naukri chodne ki wajah English me kaise batau?

"I left my previous job for better growth opportunities. I learned a lot there, but now I want new challenges and better learning."

Purani company ki burai kabhi mat karo — interviewer sochega kal hamari bhi burai karega. Hamesha 'growth' aur 'learning' ki baat karo.
'Can you work under pressure?' ka jawab English me

"Yes, I can work under pressure. In my previous job, I completed a full month's billing work in just three days during the financial year ending."

Sirf 'yes' mat bolo — ek chhota sa asal example do, baat pakki ho jayegi.
Interview ke aakhir me 'Do you have any questions?' par kya puchu English me?

Ek-do sawal puchna achha lagta hai:

- "What will be my main responsibilities in this job?"
- "Is there any training provided by the company?"
- "When can I expect the result of this interview?"

Kabhi seedha salary ki baat aakhir me mat chedo agar pehle na hui ho. Sawal puchna dikhata hai ki tum naukri ko lekar serious ho.
Interview me late ho jau to English me kya bolu?

"I am extremely sorry for being late. There was heavy traffic on the way. I will make sure this does not happen again. Thank you for waiting for me."

'Extremely sorry' matlab 'bahut zyada maafi'. Bahana chhota rakho, maafi badi rakho.
Fresher hoon, experience nahi hai — interview me English me kya bolu?

"I am a fresher, but I have good practical knowledge. During my training, I worked on real projects. I am a fast learner and I am ready to work hard to prove myself."

Fresher hona kamzori nahi hai — seekhne ki bhookh aur mehnat ki taiyari hi tumhara experience hai.
'Why do you want this job?' ka jawab English me

"I want this job because it matches my skills and interests. Your company has a good name in the market, and I believe I can grow here while contributing to the company's success."

'Contributing' matlab 'yogdaan dena'. Dono taraf ki baat karo — mujhe kya milega aur company ko kya milega.
Interview me 'Are you ready to relocate?' (doosre sheher jana) par jawab

"Yes, I am ready to relocate. I understand that growth sometimes needs change, and I am comfortable living in a new city."

Agar sach me taiyaar ho tabhi haan bolo. Nahi ho to izzat se bolo — 'Sir, due to family responsibilities, I prefer this city at present.'
Night shift ke baare me puche to English me jawab

"Yes, I am comfortable with night shifts. My family knows about my job requirements and they support me fully."

'Comfortable with' matlab 'koi dikkat nahi hai'. Family support wali baat maalik ko tasalli deti hai.
Interview me apni padhai (qualification) English me kaise batau?

"I have completed my graduation in Arts from Lucknow University in 2023. Before that, I passed my intermediate with 68 percent marks."

Padhai ulta kram me batao — sabse nayi padhai pehle, phir purani. Saal aur percent zaroor bolo.
'Tell me about your family' ka jawab English me

"We are five members in my family. My father is a farmer, my mother is a homemaker. I have one elder brother and one younger sister. We live together in our village."

' Homemaker' grihini ke liye sahi shabd hai. Parivaar ki baat chhoti aur saaf rakho.
Interview me computer knowledge English me kaise batau?

"I have good computer knowledge. I can work on MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. My typing speed is 30 words per minute in English. I can also use email and the internet for official work."

Jo sach me aata hai wahi bolo — practical test me jhooth pakda jata hai.
Overtime karne ko puche to English me kya bolu?

"Yes, I can do overtime when the work demands it. I believe completing important work on time is my responsibility."

'When the work demands' matlab 'jab kaam ki zaroorat ho'. Ye jawab zimmedari dikhata hai.
Interview shuru hote hi greeting English me kaise karu?

"Good morning sir. Thank you for giving me this opportunity. I am very happy to be here."

Andar aate hi muskura kar greeting karo. 'Thank you for this opportunity' wali line pehla asar (first impression) achha banati hai. Baithne ko kaha jaye tabhi baitho.
Interview khatm hone par English me kya bolu?

"Thank you for your time, sir. It was a pleasure meeting you. I hope to hear good news from you soon. Have a nice day!"

'I hope to hear good news' matlab 'achhi khabar ki ummeed hai'. Izzat se alvida lena aakhri asar chhodta hai.
'What are your hobbies?' interview me jawab English me

"My hobbies are reading newspapers and playing cricket. Reading keeps me updated with current affairs, and cricket has taught me teamwork."

Hobby ko kaam se jod do — jaise cricket se teamwork. Interviewer yahi sunna chahta hai.
Group discussion (GD) me bolna shuru kaise karu English me?

"Good morning everyone. Today's topic is very interesting. In my opinion, technology has changed our lives in a positive way. I would like to give an example..."

'In my opinion' matlab 'mere vichar me' — GD ki sabse kaam ki shuruaat. Chillana nahi, saaf aur dheere bolo.
Interview me 'join kab kar sakte ho' puche to English me jawab

"I can join immediately, sir. If you give me this opportunity, I can start from tomorrow itself."

'Tomorrow itself' matlab 'kal se hi'. Taiyari dikhane wali line hai — par jhootha vaada mat karo, join sach me karna padega.
Typing test ke baare me interview me English me kya bolu?

"My typing speed is 35 words per minute in English with good accuracy. I practise daily to improve it further."

'Accuracy' matlab shुद्धता — speed ke saath accuracy bolna professional lagta hai.
Sales ki naukri ke interview me apne baare me English me kya bolu?

"I am a confident and friendly person. I like meeting new people and convincing them with honest information. In my last job, I achieved my sales target for six months continuously."

'Continuously' matlab 'lagatar'. Sales me numbers bolna sabse badi baat hai — 6 mahine lagatar target pura.
Interview me nervous ho jau to English me kya bolu?

"I am sorry, I am a little nervous today because this job is very important for me. Please give me a moment."

Sach bol dena kamzori nahi hai. 'Please give me a moment' bolkar gehri saans lo — interviewer bhi insaan hai, samjhega.
Data entry job ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have fast and accurate typing skills. I know MS Excel well, including formulas and data formatting. I can work for long hours with full concentration."

'Concentration' matlab dhyaan. Data entry me speed + dhyaan = yahi do cheezein sabse badi skill hain.
'Why did you leave studies?' (padhai kyun chhodi) ka jawab English me

"Due to family financial problems, I had to leave my studies and start working. But I am still learning through online courses in my free time."

Sach izzat se bolo. 'Still learning' wali baat dikhati hai ki haalaat ne roka, aalsi ne nahi.
Interview me do saal ka gap hai, English me kaise samjhau?

"After my graduation, I was preparing for government exams for two years. Though I could not clear them, that preparation improved my general knowledge and discipline. Now I am fully focused on building my career in the private sector."

Gap ko chhupao mat — usme seekhi hui baat nikalo. 'Fully focused' matlab 'poora dhyaan ab isi par'.
Peon/chaupdar ki naukri ke liye interview me English me kya bolu?

"My name is Ramlal. I am from this district only. I am honest and hardworking. I can do all office work like serving tea, carrying files and keeping the office clean. I will never be late."

Chhoti naukri me imandari aur samay ki pabandi hi sabse badi qualification hai.
Cook (bawarchi) ki naukri ke liye interview me English me

"I have eight years of experience in cooking. I can cook North Indian, Chinese and tandoor items. I keep my kitchen clean and I always use fresh ingredients."

'Ingredients' matlab samagri (masale, sabzi waghairah). Safai ki baat cook ke liye sona hai.
Security guard ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have worked as a security guard for five years. I am physically fit and alert during duty. I have a clean record and I can work in both day and night shifts."

'Alert' matlab chaukanna. Guard ke liye fitness aur saaf record hi sab kuch hai.
Helper ki naukri ke liye interview English me simple jawab

"I am ready to do any work given to me. I am strong, honest and I learn work quickly by watching. I will not give any chance for complaint."

'I will not give any chance for complaint' matlab 'shikayat ka mauka nahi dunga' — ye line har maalik ko pasand aati hai.
'Do you know driving?' ka jawab English me

"Yes, I know driving. I have a valid driving licence for two-wheelers and four-wheelers. I have been driving for six years without any accident."

'Valid licence' matlab 'chaalu (vaidh) licence'. Accident-free wali baat bharosa badhati hai.
Accountant interview me English me apne kaam kaise batau?

"In my previous job, I handled daily billing, GST filing and bank reconciliation. I work on Tally and Excel daily. I always complete monthly closing on time."

'Bank reconciliation' matlab bank hisaab milana. Apne asal kaam ke naam lo — wahi asli jawab hai.
Interview me 'team work' par English me kya bolu?

"I believe teamwork gives better results. In my last job, our team completed a big order in ten days by dividing the work properly and helping each other."

Teamwork ka jawab example ke saath do — khaali 'I am a team player' purani baat hai.
Telecaller ki naukri ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have a clear and polite voice. I can talk to customers patiently and explain products in simple words. I can speak Hindi and basic English, and I am comfortable making 100 calls a day."

Telecaller ke liye awaaz ki safai aur dhairya (patiently) sabse badi baat hai. Call ki sankhya bolna plus point hai.
Interview me 'kab se kaam dhoondh rahe ho' ka jawab English me

"I have been looking for a suitable job for the last two months. I want a job where I can stay for a long time and grow, that is why I am choosing carefully."

'Choosing carefully' matlab 'soch-samajh kar chun raha hoon' — ye jawab bekaar baithne wali baat ko izzat wali baat bana deta hai.
Receptionist ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have good communication skills and a pleasant personality. I can handle visitors politely, attend phone calls and manage basic computer work. I always keep a smile while talking."

'Pleasant personality' matlab 'khush-mizaj vyaktitva'. Receptionist ki muskurahat hi uski qualification hai.
Interview me English kamzor ho to sach kaise bolu?

"Sir, honestly, my English is basic right now, but I am learning it daily. I can understand and manage routine work in English, and I will improve quickly."

'Honestly' matlab 'sach kahu to'. Kamzori chhupane se bada jhooth koi nahi — sach + sudhaar ki koshish = interviewer ka dil jeetne wala jawab.
'What salary do you expect?' fresher ke liye English me jawab

"As a fresher, my main aim is to learn and prove my work. I am comfortable with the salary structure of your company for this post."

Fresher ke liye ye sabse samajhdari wala jawab hai — seekhna pehle, paisa apne aap badhega.
Interview me 'overtime/weekend' par mana karna ho to English me izzat se kaise bolu?

"Sir, I am ready to work extra hours on weekdays. On Sundays, I have some family responsibilities, but in urgent situations, I will definitely come."

Seedha 'no' mat bolo — 'urgent me aaunga' wali baat beech ka rasta hai aur sach bhi.
Supervisor ki post ke liye interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have experience of handling a team of ten workers. I plan the day's work in the morning, distribute tasks according to skill, and check the work in the evening. My team has never missed a deadline under me."

'Deadline' matlab 'tai samay tak kaam pura karna'. Supervisor ka jawab number aur tareeke ke saath hona chahiye.
Interview me marks kam hain, is par kya bolu English me?

"My marks are average because I was also supporting my family by working part-time during studies. But my practical knowledge is good, and my work will prove it."

Bahana nahi, wajah do — aur aakhir me kaam se saabit karne ki baat. Ye jawab kam number ko bhi izzat bana deta hai.
Store keeper ki naukri ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have three years of experience in store management. I maintain stock registers daily, check material on arrival, and keep the store neat and organised. I am good at counting and record keeping."

'Organised' matlab 'vyavasthit'. Store keeper ke liye hisaab aur safai-suthra rakhna hi kaam hai.
Interview me 'computer chalana aata hai?' ka simple English jawab

"Yes sir, I can operate a computer. I know typing, MS Word, Excel, email and printing work. I have also done a one-year computer diploma."

Jo-jo aata hai ginna do — typing, Word, Excel, email, print. Diploma ho to zaroor bolo.
Apne gaon se sheher kaam ke liye aaya hoon, interview me English me kya bolu?

"I have come from my village to the city for work. I am ready to do hard work and stay here permanently. I will not leave the job suddenly, you can trust me."

'You can trust me' — maalik gaon wale ladke se yahi sunna chahta hai ki kaam chhodkar bhaagega nahi.
Interview me 'hamein jhooth bolne walo se dikkat hai' jaisi baat par English me jawab

"I completely agree, sir. Honesty is the base of any job. In my life, I have never cheated anyone, and I will always be truthful in my work."

'I completely agree' matlab 'main poori tarah sehmat hoon'. Interviewer ki baat se sehmati dikhana samajhdari hai.
Electrician ki naukri ke interview me English me kya bolu?

"I am a trained electrician with ITI certificate. I have five years of experience in house wiring, motor repair and fault finding. I always follow safety rules while working."

'Safety rules' matlab 'suraksha ke niyam'. Bijli ke kaam me safety sabse pehle boli jati hai.
Plumber ki naukri ke liye English me parichay aur jawab

"I am a plumber with seven years of experience. I do fitting, repair and new pipeline work. I reach on time and I charge reasonably for my work."

'Charge reasonably' matlab 'munasib paisa leta hoon'. Samay par pahunchna aur sahi daam — yahi do baatein mistri ko kaam dilati hain.
Maine English me likha: 'I am agree with you' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "I am agree with you"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I agree with you.**

'Agree' khud ek verb (kriya) hai, uske saath 'am' nahi lagta. Jaise 'I am happy' hota hai par 'I agree' seedha banta hai.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'He don't know English'?

Tumne likha: "He don't know English"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He doesn't know English.**

He/She/It ke saath 'don't' nahi, 'doesn't' lagta hai. I/You/We/They ke saath 'don't'.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'She is more smarter than me'

Tumne likha: "She is more smarter than me"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **She is smarter than me.**

'Smarter' me hi 'more' chhupa hai — do baar zyada wala shabd nahi lagta. Galti: more + smarter dono ek saath galat.
'I have saw this film' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "I have saw this film"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I have seen this film.**

'Have' ke baad verb ki teesri form (seen) lagti hai, dusri (saw) nahi. Go-went-gone, see-saw-seen — teesri form yaad karo.
Maine English me likha: 'Please return back my book' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "Please return back my book"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **Please return my book.**

'Return' ka matlab hi hai 'wapas karna' — uske saath 'back' jodna dohri baat hai.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'My father is a honest man'?

Tumne likha: "My father is a honest man"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **My father is an honest man.**

'Honest' ka pehla akshar H khamosh (silent) hai, awaaz 'o' se shuru hoti hai — isliye 'a' nahi 'an' lagega.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'I am living here since 2015'

Tumne likha: "I am living here since 2015"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I have been living here since 2015.**

Purane samay se chalta kaam 'since' ke saath 'have been + ing' me banta hai.
'She told that she will come' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "She told that she will come"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **She told me that she would come.**

Do galti: 'told' ke baad sunne wala (me/us) zaroor aata hai, aur peeche ki baat me 'will' ka 'would' ban jata hai.
Maine English me likha: 'I did not went there' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "I did not went there"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I did not go there.**

'Did' aane par verb apni pehli form (go) me aa jati hai — 'went' nahi. Did ne pehle hi past dikha diya.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'What is your good name?'?

Tumne likha: "What is your good name?"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **What is your name?**

Ye sabse aam Indian galti hai. 'Good name' Hindi ke 'shubh naam' ka seedha anuvaad hai, English me sirf 'What is your name?' bolte hain.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'He is my cousin brother'

Tumne likha: "He is my cousin brother"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He is my cousin.**

English me 'cousin' se hi ladka-ladka... matlab cousin se hi rishta samajh jata hai, 'brother/sister' jodna galat hai.
'I am having a car' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "I am having a car"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I have a car.**

Apni cheez (maliki) batane ke liye 'have' seedha lagta hai, 'having' nahi. 'I am having lunch' (khana kha raha hoon) sahi hai, par cheez ke liye nahi.
Maine English me likha: 'Yesterday I have gone to market' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "Yesterday I have gone to market"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **Yesterday I went to market.**

'Yesterday' ke saath 'have gone' nahi lagta — beeta hua pakka samay ho to seedha past tense (went).
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'She is married with a doctor'?

Tumne likha: "She is married with a doctor"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **She is married to a doctor.**

Shaadi 'with' se nahi 'to' se hoti hai English me — married to.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'Discuss about the problem'

Tumne likha: "Discuss about the problem"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **Discuss the problem.**

'Discuss' ka matlab hi hai 'ke baare me baat karna' — iske baad 'about' nahi lagta.
'I am very much happy' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "I am very much happy"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I am very happy.**

'Very much' khushi ke saath nahi judta. 'Very happy', 'very good' — sirf 'very'. 'Thank you very much' me hi 'very much' chalta hai.
Maine English me likha: 'He speaks English very good' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "He speaks English very good"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He speaks English very well.**

Kaam kaise hota hai batane ke liye 'well' lagta hai, 'good' cheez ke liye hota hai. Speak well, drive well, sing well.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'Myself Ramesh Kumar'?

Tumne likha: "Myself Ramesh Kumar"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I am Ramesh Kumar. / My name is Ramesh Kumar.**

Parichay 'myself' se shuru karna galat hai. 'Myself' tab aata hai jab 'I' pehle aa chuka ho — 'I did it myself'.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'I and my friend went there'

Tumne likha: "I and my friend went there"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **My friend and I went there.**

English ki tehzeeb: dusre ko pehle, khud ko baad me — 'My friend and I'. Pehle 'main' bolna badtameezi lagti hai.
'Open the TV' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "Open the TV"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **Switch on the TV. / Turn on the TV.**

Machine 'open' nahi hoti — TV, pankha, light ke liye 'switch on / turn on', band ke liye 'switch off'. Darwaza 'open' hota hai.
Maine English me likha: 'He is a best student' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "He is a best student"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He is the best student.**

'Sabse' wale shabdon (best, first, biggest) ke saath 'a' nahi 'the' lagta hai.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'I am boring in this class'?

Tumne likha: "I am boring in this class"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I am bored in this class.**

Bahut badi galti! 'I am boring' matlab 'main bore karne wala hoon'. Bore mehsoos ho raha hai to 'I am bored' bolo.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'She is having long hairs'

Tumne likha: "She is having long hairs"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **She has long hair.**

Baal ginne wali cheez nahi — 'hair' ek hi rehta hai, 'hairs' nahi. Aur maliki ke liye 'has', 'is having' nahi.
'I will call you when I will reach home' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "I will call you when I will reach home"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I will call you when I reach home.**

'When' ke baad wale hisse me 'will' nahi lagta — 'when I reach', 'when he comes'.
Maine English me likha: 'He did a mistake' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "He did a mistake"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He made a mistake.**

Galti 'do' nahi 'make' hoti hai — make a mistake. Waise hi 'make a noise', 'make tea'.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'Please explain me this'?

Tumne likha: "Please explain me this"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **Please explain this to me.**

'Explain' ke baad pehle cheez aati hai, phir 'to me'. Samjhaya kya gaya wo pehle bolo.
English teacher ki tarah meri galti sudharo: 'I am not knowing this'

Tumne likha: "I am not knowing this"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I do not know this.**

'Know' (jaanna) chalne wala kaam nahi hai — iske saath 'ing' wala roop nahi banta. 'I don't know' seedha bolo.
'She has a baby of two months' — isme galti hai kya? Samjhao.

Tumne likha: "She has a baby of two months"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **She has a two-month-old baby.**

Umar batane ka sahi tareeka: 'two-month-old baby'. Mahine ke saath 's' nahi lagega is roop me.
Maine English me likha: 'I lost my one thousand rupees' — kya ye sahi hai?

Tumne likha: "I lost my one thousand rupees"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **I lost one thousand rupees.**

'My' aur 'one' dono ek saath nahi — ya 'my money' bolo ya ginati ke saath sirf number.
Ye sentence sahi hai kya: 'He is more better than his brother'?

Tumne likha: "He is more better than his brother"

❌ Ye galat hai.
✅ Sahi: **He is better than his brother.**

'Better' me hi 'more' chhupa hai — good → better → best. Do zyada wale shabd ek saath galat.

**sweet** ka matlab hai — meetha.

Sentence: "This mango is very sweet."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: mithaas. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Vocabulary badhani hai. 'bitter' samjhao example ke saath

**bitter** ka matlab hai — kadwa.

Sentence: "Karela is bitter but healthy."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: kadwaahat. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
English shabd sikhao: 'true' ka matlab aur ek sentence batao

**true** ka matlab hai — sach.

Sentence: "Always speak the true thing — sahi roop: Always speak the truth."

Dhyaan do: 'true' ka noun roop hai 'truth' (sachhai). 'Speak the truth' sahi hai, 'speak the true' galat.
'false' ka matlab Hindi me kya hota hai? Sentence bhi banao

**false** ka matlab hai — jhootha.

Sentence: "He gave a false statement."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: jhooth. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Aaj ka English shabd: right — matlab aur istemal sikhao

**right** ka matlab hai — sahi.

Sentence: "Your answer is right."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: sahi hona. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Vocabulary badhani hai. 'wrong' samjhao example ke saath

**wrong** ka matlab hai — galat.

Sentence: "This is the wrong way to the station."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: galti. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
English shabd sikhao: 'early' ka matlab aur ek sentence batao

**early** ka matlab hai — jaldi (samay se pehle).

Sentence: "We reached the station early."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: jaldi pahunchna. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
'late' ka matlab Hindi me kya hota hai? Sentence bhi banao

**late** ka matlab hai — der se.

Sentence: "The train is late by one hour."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: deri. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Aaj ka English shabd: near — matlab aur istemal sikhao

**near** ka matlab hai — paas.

Sentence: "My school is near my house."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: nazdiki. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Vocabulary badhani hai. 'far' samjhao example ke saath

**far** ka matlab hai — door.

Sentence: "The hospital is far from our village."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: doori. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
English shabd sikhao: 'full' ka matlab aur ek sentence batao

**full** ka matlab hai — bhara hua.

Sentence: "The bus is full today."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: bhara hona. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
'empty' ka matlab Hindi me kya hota hai? Sentence bhi banao

**empty** ka matlab hai — khaali.

Sentence: "The bottle is empty."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: khaalipan. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Aaj ka English shabd: new — matlab aur istemal sikhao

**new** ka matlab hai — naya.

Sentence: "I bought a new cycle."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: nayaapan. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Vocabulary badhani hai. 'old' samjhao example ke saath

**old** ka matlab hai — purana / boodha.

Sentence: "This is a very old temple."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: puranaapan. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
English shabd sikhao: 'young' ka matlab aur ek sentence batao

**young** ka matlab hai — jawaan.

Sentence: "Young people should respect elders."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: jawaani. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
'careful' ka matlab Hindi me kya hota hai? Sentence bhi banao

**careful** ka matlab hai — dhyaan se / savdhaan.

Sentence: "Be careful while crossing the road."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: savdhaani. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Aaj ka English shabd: ready — matlab aur istemal sikhao

**ready** ka matlab hai — taiyaar.

Sentence: "I am ready to go to school."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: taiyaari. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
Vocabulary badhani hai. 'free' samjhao example ke saath

**free** ka matlab hai — muft / khaali (samay).

Sentence: "This book is free with the course."

Isi se bana dusra shabd: muft. Roz ek shabd seekhkar use apni baat-cheet me istemal karo — shabd tabhi yaad rehta hai jab munh se nikle.
'school' ka uchcharan kaise karu?

**School** ko 'is-kool' nahi, 'skool' bolo. Shuru ki 's' ke baad seedha 'k' ki awaaz aati hai. Aise hi: station = 'stay-shun', student = 'styoo-dent'. English me kai shabdon ki shuruaat Hindi jaisi nahi hoti — sunne ki practice sabse kaam ki hai.
'Wednesday' bolna mushkil hai, aasan tareeka batao
**Wednesday** ko 'Wed-nes-day' alag-alag mat bolo. Asal uchcharan hai: **'Wenz-day'**. Beech wala 'd' aur 'ne' khamosh rehte hain. Yaad karne ka nuskha: 'wenz-day' do hisso me ratta maro.
'comfortable' ka sahi uchcharan kya hai?
**Comfortable** = 'KUMF-ta-bul' (4 hisse nahi, 3). Aksar log 'com-for-table' bolte hain jo galat hai. Aise hi vegetable = 'VEJ-ta-bul'. English me beech ke hisse aksar ghul jate hain.
'hotel' aur 'hostel' me uchcharan ka farak batao
**Hotel** = 'ho-TEL' (zor dusre hisse par), **hostel** = 'HOS-tel' (zor pehle hisse par). Galti se ulta bolne par matlab badal jata hai. Hostel me 's' ki awaaz saaf aayegi, hotel me nahi.
'said' ka uchcharan 'sed' jaisa kyun hota hai?

**Said** likha 's-a-i-d' jata hai par bola 'sed' jata hai. English me likhna aur bolna aksar alag hota hai — ye uski purani aadat hai. Nuskha: mushkil shabdon ko likhkar nahi, sunkar yaad karo. Said, again (a-gen), friend (frend) — ye teen aise hi hain.
'knife' me K kyun nahi bolte?
**Knife** = 'naif'. Shabd ke shuru ka 'k' khamosh (silent) hai. Aise hi: know = 'no', knee = 'nee', knock = 'nok'. Niyam: 'kn' se shuru shabd me k kabhi nahi bolta.
'hour' me H silent hai kya?
Haan, **hour** = 'aawar', H nahi bolta. Isi liye 'an hour' kehte hain, 'a hour' nahi. Aise hi honest = 'onest', honour = 'onor'. Par 'hotel' aur 'house' me H bolta hai — wahan 'a hotel', 'a house'.
'island' ka uchcharan batao
**Island** = 'aai-land', beech wala 's' khamosh hai. Likhne me s hai, bolne me nahi. Aise hi: listen = 'lis-un' (t silent), castle = 'kaa-sul' (t silent).
'debt' aur 'doubt' me b bolte hain kya?
Nahi. **Debt** = 'det', **doubt** = 'dout' — dono me 'b' khamosh hai. Ye shabd Latin se aaye, wahan b likha jata tha par bola nahi jata. Subtle = 'sa-tul' bhi aisa hi hai.
'v' aur 'w' ki awaaz me farak kaise karu?

Ye Hindi bolne walo ki sabse aam galti hai.

**W** ke liye honth gol karo jaise seeti bajane wale ho: water, we, window.
**V** ke liye upar ke daant neeche wale honth par halka rakho: very, village, voice.

Practice: 'Very well' — pehle daant-honth (v), phir gol honth (w).
'th' ki awaaz (think/this) kaise nikalu?

**Th** ke do roop hain:
- Think, three, thank — jeebh daanton ke beech halki si bahar, hawa nikalo.
- This, that, mother — jeebh wahi, par awaaz me kampan (gala gungunaye).

Hindi ke 'थ' se ye alag hai — jeebh daant ko chhuti hai, taalu ko nahi.
'sheep' aur 'ship' me farak kaise bolu?

**Sheep** (bhed) me 'ee' lambi awaaz: 'sheeep'.
**Ship** (jahaz) me 'i' chhoti awaaz: 'ship'.
Galti se sheep ko chhota bol diya to bhed jahaz ban jayegi! Aise hi: seat/sit, feel/fill, leave/live — lambi-chhoti 'ee' ka khel hai.
'full' aur 'fool' ka uchcharan farak

**Full** (bhara) = 'ful' — chhoti 'u' awaaz.
**Fool** (bewakoof) = 'fooool' — lambi 'oo'.
Pool/pull bhi aise hi hain. Lambi awaaz ko kheench kar bolo, chhoti ko jhatke se.
'heart' aur 'hurt' me farak batao

**Heart** (dil) = 'haart' — beech me lambi 'aa'.
**Hurt** (chot) = 'hurt' — chhoti 'ar' awaaz.
Sunne me kareeb hain par matlab zameen-aasmaan ka farak hai. Practice jodi: heart/hurt, part/pert nahi — sirf pehli jodi yaad rakho.
English me zor (stress) kahan lagta hai? Ek aasan nuskha do

Nuskha: **do hisse wale shabdon me aksar pehle hisse par zor** lagta hai — TAble, DOCtor, TEAcher, STUdent.
Par kuch shabdon me dusre par: hoTEL, beGIN, aLONE.
Jis shabd me shak ho, use mobile ke dictionary me sunkar check karo. Galat jagah zor lagane se samne wala atak jata hai, shabd sahi hone par bhi.
'photograph' aur 'photography' me zor kahan badalta hai?

Bahut badhiya sawal!
- **PHOtograph** — zor pehle hisse par.
- phoTOgraphy — zor dusre hisse par.
Shabd bada hua to zor aage sarak gaya. Yahi khel: ECOnomy → ecoNOMic. Isi liye English bolte time lay (rhythm) par dhyaan do.
'receipt' ka uchcharan kya hai?
**Receipt** (raseed) = 'ri-SEET', beech wala 'p' khamosh hai. Likhne me p hai, bolne me nahi. Aise hi: cupboard = 'kab-ard' (p silent), psychology = 'sai-KO-lo-ji' (p silent shuru me).
'salmon' (machli) me L bolte hain kya?
Nahi, **salmon** = 'sa-mun', 'l' khamosh hai. Aise hi: calm = 'kaam' (l silent), half = 'haaf', walk = 'wauk', talk = 'tauk'. 'Lk' aur 'lm' wale kai shabdon me l ghul jata hai.
'women' ka uchcharan 'wimin' kyun hai?

**Women** (mahilayein) = 'WI-min' — pehla hissa 'wo' nahi 'wi' bolta hai. Aur ek mahila ke liye **woman** = 'WU-mun'. Ye English ke sabse ajeeb shabdon me se hai — ratta hi upaay hai: woman (ek) = wu-mun, women (kai) = wi-min.
'busy' ko 'bizi' kyun bolte hain?
**Busy** = 'BI-zi'. 'U' ki awaaz yahan 'i' jaisi hai. Aise hi: business = 'BIZ-nes'. English me akshar ki awaaz jagah-jagah badal jati hai — isiliye sunkar seekhna, padhkar seekhne se tez hota hai.
'sugar' aur 'sure' me S ki awaaz 'sh' kyun hai?

**Sugar** = 'SHU-gar', **sure** = 'shor'. Kuch shabdon me 's' ke baad 'u' aaye to awaaz 'sh' ban jati hai. Aise hi: pressure = 'PRE-shar'. Ye chhoti baatein sunne ki practice se apne aap aa jati hain.
'tomb' aur 'comb' ka uchcharan batao

**Comb** (kanghi) = 'koom', **tomb** (makbara) = 'toom' — dono me 'b' khamosh. Par 'bomb' = 'bom' me bhi b silent hai, jabki 'climb' = 'klaim' me bhi. Niyam: shabd ke aakhir me 'mb' aaye to b aksar khamosh.
'genre' jaise mushkil shabd kaise bolu?

**Genre** (prakar/kisam) = 'ZHAAN-ra' — 'j' jaisi naram awaaz se shuru. Aise shabd French se aaye hain. Fikr mat karo, aise shabd roz ki baat me kam aate hain. Asli kaam ke shabd pehle pakke karo — mushkil shabd baad me apne aap aayenge.
English tez bolne walo ko samajh nahi aata, koi nuskha?

Tez English samajhne ka nuskha: shabd-shabd pakadne ki koshish mat karo, **poori baat ka matlab** pakdo. Aur bolne walo se kehne me sharmao mat: 'Please speak slowly, I am learning English.' Roz 10 minute English sunkar wahi dohrana (shadowing) sabse tez tareeka hai samajh badhane ka.
'ed' wale shabdon (walked, played) ka uchcharan nuskha do

'Ed' ke teen roop:
- **Walked** = 'waukt' (t awaaz) — jab shabd k/p/s jaisi sakht awaaz par khatm ho.
- **Played** = 'playd' (d awaaz) — naram awaaz ke baad.
- **Wanted** = 'want-id' (id awaaz) — jab shabd t/d par hi khatm ho.
Ye nuskha seekh lo, aadhi pronunciation ki dikkat khatm.
Apna naam English walo ko sahi kaise sunau?

Naam ka uchcharan badlo mat — bas **dheere aur saaf** bolo, hisso me todkar: 'Ra-MESH', 'Su-NI-ta'. Naam tumhari pehchan hai, use English banane ki zaroorat nahi. Agar samne wala atak jaye to muskura kar dobara bolo. Apne naam par garv rakho, sharm nahi.
English me baat-cheet ki practice karni hai. Tum kuch pucho, main jawab dunga.

Bahut badhiya! Main tumhara practice saathi hoon. Shuru karte hain aasan sawal se:

**What is your name and where are you from?**

Jawab English me do, jitna aata hai utna. Galti hogi to main pyaar se sudhar dunga. Chalo, bolo!
Practice: koi mujhse puche 'How was your day?' to kya jawab dun?

Is sawal ke teen aasan jawab:

- "It was good. I finished all my work." (achha tha)
- "It was a busy day." (vyast din tha)
- "It was a little tiring, but fine." (thoda thakane wala, par thik)

Ab tum meri baat ka jawab do: **How was your day?** Apne aaj ke din par ek line bolo.
Dost se English me haal-chaal kaise shuru karu? Practice karni hai

Dostana shuruaat aise hoti hai:

A: "Hi! How are you?"
B: "I am good. What about you?"
A: "I am also fine. Long time no see! Where were you?"

'Long time no see' matlab 'bahut din baad dikhe'. Ab practice: main puchta hoon — **Hi! How are you?** Tum jawab do.
English me kisi se pehli baar baat karne ki practice karwao

Pehli mulaqat ki baat-cheet aisi hoti hai:

- "Hello, my name is Amit. What is your name?"
- "I am Rahul. Nice to meet you."
- "Nice to meet you too. What do you do?"
- "I am a student. And you?"

'What do you do?' matlab 'aap kya kaam karte hain?' — ye naukri puchne ka tehzeeb wala tareeka hai. Ab tum pehli line bolo, main Rahul bankar jawab dunga.
Bazaar me dukaan-daar se English me baat-cheet ki practice

Chalo, main dukaan-daar banta hoon:

**Shopkeeper:** "Good morning! What do you want, sir?"
**You:** "Good morning. I want one kilo of rice and half kilo of sugar."
**Shopkeeper:** "Anything else?"
**You:** "No, that's all. How much is the total?"

'Anything else?' matlab 'aur kuch?' aur 'That's all' matlab 'bas itna hi'. Ab tum customer bankar pehli line bolo.
Rikshaw wale se English me baat karne ki practice karwao

Safar ki baat-cheet:

**You:** "Will you go to the railway station?"
**Driver:** "Yes, sit down."
**You:** "How much will you charge?"
**Driver:** "Fifty rupees."
**You:** "Okay, let's go. Please drive slowly."

Daam pehle pakka karna English me bhi waisa hi zaroori hai! 'Will you go...?' se sawal tehzeeb se banta hai.
Phone par dost se English me baat-cheet practice

Phone wali English thodi alag hoti hai:

**You:** "Hello Rohit, this is Sandeep."
**Rohit:** "Hi Sandeep! How are you?"
**You:** "I am fine. Are you free this Sunday?"
**Rohit:** "Yes, why?"
**You:** "Let's go for a movie."

Phone par naam pehle batana padta hai — 'this is Sandeep' bolo, 'I am Sandeep' bhi chalega par 'this is' zyada sahi lagta hai.
Doctor ke paas English me apni takleef batane ki practice

Doctor se baat aise hoti hai:

**You:** "Good morning, doctor. I have fever since yesterday."
**Doctor:** "Do you have any other problem?"
**You:** "Yes, I have a headache and body pain too."

'Since yesterday' matlab 'kal se'. Takleef ginne ke liye: fever (bukhaar), headache (sir-dard), body pain (badan dard), cough (khansi). Ab tum apni koi takleef ek line me bolo.
Teacher se English me baat-cheet ki practice, homework ke baare me

Class ki baat-cheet:

**You:** "Good morning, sir. I have not completed my homework."
**Teacher:** "Why?"
**You:** "I was ill yesterday. I will complete it by tomorrow."

Sach bolna + vaada karna — ye jodi har teacher ko pasand aati hai. 'By tomorrow' matlab 'kal tak'.
Padosi se English me chhoti baat-cheet (small talk) practice

Padosi se halki baat-cheet ko 'small talk' kehte hain:

- "Good morning, uncle. Going for a walk?"
- "Yes, the weather is nice today."
- "Yes, it rained last night. The air is fresh now."

Mausam ki baat small talk ki sabse surakshit shuruaat hai — duniya bhar me yahi hota hai.
Bus conductor se English me baat karne ki practice

**You:** "One ticket to Aligarh, please."
**Conductor:** "Twenty rupees."
**You:** "Please inform me when Aligarh comes."

'Inform me' matlab 'mujhe bata dena'. Neend aa jaye to ye line kaam ki hai! Ek ticket ke liye 'One ticket to...' kaafi hai, pura sentence banane ki zaroorat nahi.
Hotel me kamra book karne ki English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Good evening. I need a room for two nights."
**Receptionist:** "Single or double, sir?"
**You:** "Double room. What is the rent per day?"
**Receptionist:** "Two thousand rupees."
**You:** "Okay, please book it. My name is Arvind Kumar."

'Rent per day' matlab 'ek din ka kiraya'. Naam aakhir me dena hota hai booking ke liye.
Interview se pehle reception par English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Good morning. I am here for an interview. My name is Kunal."
**Receptionist:** "Please take a seat. Sir will call you."
**You:** "Thank you. May I wait here?"

'May I...?' izazat mangne ka sabse tehzeeb wala tareeka hai — may I come in, may I sit, may I wait.
Kisi anjaan aadmi se rasta puchne ki English practice

**You:** "Excuse me, how can I reach the bus stand?"
**Man:** "Go straight and turn left at the crossing."
**You:** "How far is it from here?"
**Man:** "Just five minutes on foot."

'Excuse me' se shuru karna tehzeeb hai. 'On foot' matlab 'paidal'. Rasta puchna English practice ka sabse aasan mauka hai — roz milega.
Sabzi wale se English me mol-bhaav ki practice karwao

**You:** "What is the rate of tomatoes?"
**Vendor:** "Forty rupees per kilo."
**You:** "That's too much. Give me at a reasonable price."
**Vendor:** "Okay, take it for thirty-five."

'Too much' matlab 'bahut zyada'. Mol-bhaav me gussa nahi, muskurahat chalti hai — English me bhi, Hindi me bhi.
Bank me manager se English baat-cheet ki practice

**You:** "Good morning, sir. I want to take a loan for my small business."
**Manager:** "What is your business?"
**You:** "I run a general store. I need two lakh rupees to expand it."

'Expand' matlab 'badhana'. Loan ki baat me kaam, rakam aur wajah — teen cheezein saaf rakho.
Train me saathi yatri se English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Excuse me, is this seat taken?"
**Passenger:** "No, it's free. Please sit."
**You:** "Thank you. Are you also going to Delhi?"
**Passenger:** "Yes. It will take four more hours."

'Is this seat taken?' matlab 'kya ye seat kisi ki hai?' Safar me baat-cheet aise hi shuru hoti hai.
Dost ko janamdin ki badhai English me phone par — practice

**You:** "Hello Neha! Wish you a very happy birthday!"
**Neha:** "Thank you so much!"
**You:** "May God bless you with good health and success."

'Wish you a very happy birthday' sabse common badhai hai. 'May God bless you' matlab 'Bhagwan tumhe aashirwad de'.
Kisi ko English me dhanyavaad kehne ke alag-alag tareeke practice karwao

Dhanyavaad ke roop:

- "Thank you." (aam)
- "Thank you so much." (zyada dil se)
- "Thanks a lot for your help." (madad ke liye)
- "I am really grateful to you." (bahut zyada ehsaanmand — grateful = aabhaari)

Jawab me sunne ko milega: 'You are welcome' ya 'No problem'. Ab tum mujhe apne teacher ke liye dhanyavaad ek line me bolo.
Maafi mangne ki English practice — galti ho gayi ho to

Maafi ke roop:

- "I am sorry." (aam galti)
- "I am really sorry, it was my mistake." (galti manna)
- "Please forgive me, I will not repeat it." (dobara nahi hoga)

'It was my mistake' bolne wala aadmi chhota nahi hota, bada hota hai. Ab practice: tum late aaye ho, teacher se maafi ek line me mango.
English me kisi ko khaane par bulane ki baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Please come to my home for dinner this Sunday."
**Guest:** "Thank you for the invitation. What time should I come?"
**You:** "Please come by 8 in the evening."

'Invitation' matlab 'nimantran/nyota'. 'By 8' matlab '8 baje tak'. Ghar bulana ho to din, samay — dono saaf bolo.
Mobile recharge ki dukaan par English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Please recharge my number with the 239 rupees plan."
**Shopkeeper:** "Number, please?"
**You:** "It's nine-eight-seven... (apna number angrezi ankon me)"

Number English me bolna practice karo: 0=zero, 9=nine. Apna number English me bolna aana sabse pehli practice honi chahiye.
English me apne dost ka haal-chaal lambi baat-cheet me practice karwao

Lambi dostana baat aise badhti hai:

**A:** "How is your job going?"
**B:** "It's going well. I got a small promotion last month."
**A:** "Wow, congratulations! We should celebrate."
**B:** "Sure! Let's meet this weekend."

'Promotion' matlab 'tarraki'. Badhai ke liye 'Congratulations!' — ye shabd har khushi me chalta hai.
Bacche ko school ke baare me English me puchne ki practice

Bacche se pyaar se:

**You:** "How was school today?"
**Child:** "It was good, papa."
**You:** "What did you learn today?"
**Child:** "We learned a new poem."

Roz ek sawal English me puchne se baccha bina dare English bolne lagega. Galti par toko mat, protsahit karo.
Customer care ko English me call karne ki practice

**You:** "Hello, my internet is not working since morning."
**Executive:** "Please tell me your registered mobile number."
**You:** "It is 98XXX XXXXX. Please register my complaint."

'Complaint' matlab 'shikayat'. 'Since morning' matlab 'subah se'. Customer care par shaanti se baat karo — kaam jaldi hota hai.
English me samay (time) puchne aur batane ki practice

**You:** "Excuse me, what is the time?"
**Man:** "It's half past three." (saadhe teen)

Time ke roop yaad karo:
- 3:00 = three o'clock
- 3:15 = quarter past three (sava teen)
- 3:30 = half past three (saadhe teen)
- 3:45 = quarter to four (paune chaar)

Ab tum bolo: 5:30 ko English me kya kahenge?
Barber (nai) ki dukaan par English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "I want a haircut and shaving."
**Barber:** "Please sit. How short do you want the hair?"
**You:** "Medium from the sides, and keep it a little long on top."

'Haircut' matlab baal katwana. 'Medium', 'short', 'long' — ye teen shabd nai ki dukaan ke liye kaafi hain.
Phal wale se English me baat-cheet practice karwao

**You:** "Are these mangoes sweet?"
**Vendor:** "Yes sir, fully ripe and sweet."
**You:** "Give me two kilos. And a dozen bananas also."

'Ripe' matlab 'paka hua'. Darjan ke liye 'a dozen' — 12 kele = one dozen bananas.
Office me sah-karmi (colleague) se English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Good morning! Have you completed the report?"
**Colleague:** "Almost done. I need ten more minutes."
**You:** "No hurry. Tell me if you need any help."

'Almost done' matlab 'lagbhag ho gaya'. 'No hurry' matlab 'koi jaldi nahi'. Daftar ki chhoti English yahi hoti hai.
English me mausam ki baat-cheet practice (weather talk)

**A:** "It's very hot today, isn't it?"
**B:** "Yes, and there is no wind at all."
**A:** "I think it will rain in the evening."
**B:** "Let's hope so. We need rain badly."

'Let's hope so' matlab 'ummeed karte hain aisa hi ho'. Mausam ki baat-cheet English seekhne ka sabse surakshit maidan hai.
Kisi ko English me salah (advice) dene ki practice

Salah dene ke roop:

- "You should take rest." (tumhe aaram karna chahiye)
- "In my opinion, you should save money." (mere vichar me)
- "If I were you, I would join the course." (main tumhari jagah hota to)

'Should' salah ka sabse kaam ka shabd hai. Ab tum mujhe ek salah do: main English kaise sudharu?
English me mana karne (no kehne) ke tehzeeb wale tareeke practice

Seedha 'no' rude lag sakta hai. Tehzeeb wale roop:

- "Sorry, I can't. I am busy today." 
- "I wish I could, but I have some work." (kaash kar pata)
- "Not today, maybe next time." (aaj nahi, agli baar)

'I wish I could' matlab 'kaash main kar sakta'. Mana karna bhi ek kala hai.
Train ticket window par English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "One ticket to Lucknow for tomorrow morning, please."
**Clerk:** "Which train?"
**You:** "The 6 o'clock express. Is a seat available?"
**Clerk:** "Yes, window seat is available."

'Is a seat available?' matlab 'seat khali hai kya?' Ticket window par chhote-chhote sentence hi chalte hain.
Apne purane teacher se English me baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Good morning, sir. I am Rakesh, your old student."
**Teacher:** "Rakesh! So nice to see you. What are you doing these days?"
**You:** "Sir, I am working in a bank now. All this is because of your blessings."

'Because of your blessings' matlab 'aapke aashirwad se'. Guru ke saamne ye line dil chhoo leti hai.
English me taareef (compliment) karne ki practice karwao

Taareef ke roop:

- "Your English is very good!" 
- "You are looking smart today." (aaj smart lag rahe ho)
- "This food is delicious. Who cooked it?" (khana swadisht hai)

Taareef ke jawab me: 'Thank you, that's very kind of you.' Ab tum mere liye ek taareef English me bolo — practice ho jayegi.
Gaon me aaye videshi mehman se English baat-cheet practice

**You:** "Welcome to our village. Please have some tea."
**Guest:** "Thank you. Your village is very beautiful."
**You:** "This is our farm. We grow wheat and mustard here."

Mehmaan-nawazi hamari pehchan hai — 'Welcome to our village' aur chai ka prastav, bas itne se dil jeet loge. Sarson = mustard, gehun = wheat.
English me phone number aur pata batane ki practice

Apna parichay wala data English me bolna seekho:

- Mobile: "My number is nine-six, four-two, double five, three-one-seven." (ank jodiyon me bolo)
- Pata: "I live in House Number 24, Gandhi Nagar, near the bus stand."

'Near' matlab 'ke paas'. Number ko 2-2 ankon me todkar bolna sabse aasan aur saaf tareeka hai.
Dost ke saath cricket par English baat-cheet practice

**A:** "Did you watch yesterday's match?"
**B:** "Yes! India won by five wickets."
**A:** "The last over was very exciting."
**B:** "True. Our captain played a great innings."

'Innings' matlab paari. Khel ki baat-cheet English practice ka sabse mazedaar rasta hai — doston ke saath shuru karo.
English me apni pasand-naapasand batane ki practice

Pasand batane ke roop:

- "I like tea, but I love coffee." (pasand vs bahut pasand)
- "I don't like spicy food." (mujhe tikha nahi pasand)
- "My favourite colour is blue."
- "I enjoy travelling." (mujhe ghumna pasand hai)

'Enjoy' pasand ka mazboot roop hai. Ab tum apni teen pasand English me bolo.
Subah ki sair par mile aadmi se English small talk practice

**A:** "Good morning! You come here daily?"
**B:** "Good morning. Yes, I walk for one hour every day."
**A:** "That's a good habit. Walking keeps us fit."
**B:** "Absolutely. Health is wealth."

'Health is wealth' matlab 'sehat hi daulat hai' — English me ye kahawat bilkul chalti hai. Small talk me kahawatein baat ko rang deti hain.
School me chhutti ke liye English me application likho

Chhutti ki application ka format:

To,
The Principal,
ABC School, Kanpur

Respected Sir,
I am a student of class 8-B. I have fever since yesterday. The doctor has advised me to take rest. Kindly grant me leave for two days, from 12 May to 13 May.

Thanking you.
Yours obediently,
Ravi Kumar
Class 8-B, Roll No. 15

Dhyaan do: 'Yours obediently' school me chalta hai. Date aur class-roll number kabhi mat bhoolo.
Office me chhutti ke liye English me email likho

Dear Sir,
I request you to grant me one day's leave on 15 May due to some urgent work at home. I will complete my pending work before leaving.

Thank you.
Regards,
Amit Sharma
Accounts Department

Email me 'Regards' izzat wala aakhri shabd hai. Kaam pehle pura karne ki baat likhna manager ko khush karta hai.
Bank ko English me letter — address badalne ke liye

To,
The Branch Manager,
State Bank of India, Agra

Subject: Request to change address in my account

Sir,
My savings account number is 31245678901. I have shifted to a new house. Kindly update my new address in your records: House No. 45, Kamla Nagar, Agra. I have attached my Aadhaar card copy as proof.

Thanking you.
Yours faithfully,
Sunil Verma

'Yours faithfully' daftar ke patro ka aakhri shabd hai. Account number aur proof — dono zaroori.
English me dhanyavaad ka letter (thank you letter) likho

Dear Uncle,
I received the bicycle you sent for my birthday. I am very happy. It is beautiful and exactly the colour I wanted. Thank you so much for this lovely gift. I will take good care of it.
Your loving nephew,
Chotu

Dhanyavaad ke patra me tohfe ki ek khaasiyat (rang) zaroor likho — dene wale ko lagta hai tohfa sach me pasand aaya.
Nagar palika ko English me shikayat patra — gali ki light kharab hai

To,
The Chairman,
Municipal Board, Rampur

Subject: Complaint about broken street light

Sir,
The street light in front of House No. 22, Main Market Road, has not been working for the last ten days. The road remains dark at night and accidents may happen. Kindly get it repaired at the earliest.

Yours faithfully,
Residents of Main Market Road

Shikayat me din ginakar likho (ten days) — samasya ki gambhirta saaf hoti hai. 'At the earliest' matlab 'jald se jald'.
Dost ko English me patra — gaon bulane ke liye

Dear Vikash,
How are you? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing to invite you to my village during the summer holidays. We will eat mangoes, swim in the canal and enjoy the fair. Please come, we will have great fun.
Your friend,
Deepak

Dost ke patra me 'How are you?' se shuru karna aur mazedaar yojna batana — yahi do cheezein patra ko zinda karti hain.
English me naukri ke liye application letter ka format

The Manager,
XYZ Company, Delhi

Yours faithfully,
Rahul Kumar
Mobile: 98XXXXXXXX

'Vacancy' matlab 'khaali post'. Mobile number zaroor likho — bina number ke bulawa nahi aayega.
Bijli vibhaag ko English me letter — meter kharab hai

The Junior Engineer,
Electricity Department, Sitapur

Subject: Complaint about defective meter

House No. 9, Civil Lines

Consumer number bina patra aage nahi badhta — bijli ke har patra me ye pehla kaam hai.
Principal ko English me application — fees maafi ke liye

Fees maafi me apne number (82 percent) zaroor likho — mehnati bacche ki madad har principal karna chahta hai.
Email English me — dost ko apni nayi naukri ki khabar

Subject: Good news — I got the job!

Dear Rohit,
I am very happy to share that I have got a job in a bank as a clerk. I will join from next Monday. All this became possible because of your support and blessings. Let us meet soon and celebrate.
Your friend,
Sandeep

Khushi ki khabar wale email me subject hi aadhi khabar hoti hai — 'Good news' likhna mat bhoolo.
English me letter — bahan ki shaadi ka nimantran dost ko

Dear Friend,
You will be happy to know that my sister's marriage has been fixed for 20 December. The ceremony will be held at our home in the village. You are invited with your family. Please reach one day before and stay with us.
With love,

'Has been fixed' matlab 'tai ho gayi hai'. Ek din pehle aane ko kehna gaon ki mehmaan-nawazi hai.
Post office ko English me letter — letter nahi mila

To,
The Postmaster,
Head Post Office, Moradabad

Mohalla Kot, Moradabad

Dak ke patra me bhejne ki tareekh aur 'registered' shabd zaroori hai — bina iske khoj nahi hoti.

B.A. Part 2

Maafi ke email me wajah chhoti rakho aur kaam jod do (attached) — sirf maafi se kaam nahi chalta, kaam saath bhejo.
Gaon ke sarpanch ko English me letter — saaf paani ke liye

To,
The Sarpanch,
Gram Panchayat Rampur

The only hand pump of our ward has been out of order for two months. People are forced to bring water from far away. Kindly arrange for its repair or a new hand pump at the earliest.

Yours faithfully,
Villagers of Ward No. 4

Kai logo ki samasya ho to aakhir me ek aadmi nahi, 'Villagers of...' likho — patra ka wazan badh jata hai.
English me letter — pita ji ko paiso ke liye (hostel se)

Dear Father,
I am well here and I hope you are also fine. My studies are going well. I need one thousand rupees for buying books and paying the exam fee. Please send the money when possible. Give my regards to Mother.
Your loving son,

Pita ji ke patra me pehle haal-chaal, phir padhai, phir paisa — ye kram izzat dikhata hai. Seedha paisa mangna acha nahi lagta.

I purchased a mixer grinder from your shop on 2 May (Bill No. 118). It stopped working within one week. The product is under warranty. Kindly repair or replace it at the earliest.

'Under warranty' matlab 'guaranti ke andar hai'. Bill number bina shikayat adhoori rehti hai.
Makan malik ko English me letter — kiraya badhane par jawab

I received your letter about increasing the rent. I have been living in your house for three years and have always paid the rent on time. A sudden increase of two thousand rupees is difficult for me. Kindly consider a smaller increase. I shall be thankful.
Yours sincerely,
Gopal Das

'Yours sincerely' thoda naram aakhri shabd hai. Apni achhai (samay par kiraya) yaad dilana baat-cheet ka sahi tareeka hai.
English me chhutti ki application — behan ki shaadi ke liye (office)

Subject: Leave application from 18 to 22 December

Chhutti ke email me apni jagah kaam sambhalne wale ka naam dena — manager ka dil yahi jeetta hai.
Dost ko English me letter — English seekhne ki salah

Dear Raju,
You asked me how to learn English. My advice is simple: speak a little English every day, even if you make mistakes. Watch English news for ten minutes and repeat the sentences. Do not feel shy. In three months, you will see a big change.
Your friend,
Manoj

Salah wale patra me bade vaade nahi, chhote roz ke kaam batao — wahi asal salah hoti hai.
English me letter — dada ji ko unke janamdin par

Dear Grandfather,
Wish you a very happy birthday! May you live a long and healthy life. I miss the stories you used to tell me in my childhood. This year I will surely come to the village in December and meet you.
Your loving grandson,
Rohit

'Used to tell' matlab 'sunaya karte the' — purani aadat ke liye ye roop dil ko chhuta hai.
School transfer certificate (TC) ke liye English me application

Class 9-C, Roll No. 8

TC ki application me wajah (pita ka transfer) saaf likhna zaroori hai — bina wajah ke TC me deri hoti hai.
English me email — interview ka dhanyavaad (thank you email)

Subject: Thank you for the interview opportunity

Dear Sir,

Interview ke baad ye chhota sa email tumhe baaki ummeedwaron se alag khada kar deta hai — bahut kam log bhejte hain.
Bus stand adhikari ko English me letter — bus samay par nahi chalti

To,
The Depot Manager,
Roadways Bus Depot, Mathura

Subject: Complaint about irregular bus service on Route 12

Sir,
The bus on Route 12 does not run on time. Passengers, especially students and office workers, suffer daily. Sometimes the bus does not come at all. Kindly look into the matter.

Yours faithfully,
Daily Passengers of Route 12

'Irregular' matlab 'aniyamit'. Roz ke yatriyon ki taraf se likha patra akhbar tak pahunch jata hai — wazan rakho.
'About myself' par 10 line English me likho, student ke liye

1. My name is Rahul Kumar.
2. I am 16 years old.
3. I study in class 11.
4. I live in a small town with my family.
5. My favourite subject is Mathematics.
6. I like playing cricket in the evening.
7. My aim in life is to become an engineer.
8. I respect my teachers and parents.
9. I am a hardworking and honest boy.
10. I always help my friends in studies.

Har line ek baat — naam, umar, padhai, pasand, lakshya. Yahi 'about myself' ki jaan hai.
'My family' par English me paragraph likho

"I have a small and happy family. There are six members in my family — my grandfather, grandmother, father, mother, my younger sister and I. My father is a shopkeeper and my mother is a homemaker. My sister studies in class 7. We eat dinner together every night and share our whole day's talks. I love my family very much."

Parivaar ke paragraph me: kul sadasya, kaun kya karta hai, aur ek pyaari aadat (saath khana) — ye teen cheezein kaafi hain.
'My village' par English me 10 line likho

1. My village is Rampur.
2. It is situated near a small river.
3. About two thousand people live in my village.
4. Most of the people are farmers.
5. We grow wheat, rice and sugarcane.
6. There is a primary school and a small hospital in my village.
7. The air of my village is clean and fresh.
8. People know each other and help in need.
9. We celebrate all festivals together.
10. I am proud of my village.

Gaon ki khaasiyat — saaf hawa aur apnapan — ye do baatein zaroor rakho.
'My city' par English me paragraph likho

"I live in Kanpur, a big city of Uttar Pradesh. It is famous for leather goods and the holy river Ganga. The city is always busy with markets, factories and students. There are good schools, hospitals and a railway station. Life in the city is fast, but I like its energy. Kanpur is my home and I am proud of it."

Sheher ke paragraph me: kis cheez ke liye mashhoor, kya-kya suvidha, aur sheher ki raftaar — teen baatein.
'My mother' par English me kuch line likho

"My mother is the most important person in my life. She wakes up early and works for the family the whole day. She cooks delicious food and takes care of everyone. When I am sad, she understands me without words. She is my first teacher. I want to make her proud one day."

'Without words' matlab 'bina kahe'. Maa par likhne me bade shabd nahi, sachhi baatein chahiye.
'My father' par English me paragraph likho

"My father is a hardworking man. He runs a small shop in the market. He works from morning to night so that we can study and live well. He is strict about studies but very kind at heart. He always teaches me to be honest. My father is my hero."

'At heart' matlab 'dil se'. 'My father is my hero' — ye aakhri line paragraph ko dil bana deti hai.
'My best friend' par English me likho

"My best friend is Aman. We study in the same class and sit together. He is good in studies and always helps me in Mathematics. We play cricket together in the evening. He never leaves me alone in difficult times. A true friend is a gift of God, and Aman is that gift for me."

Dost par likhne me: saath kya karte ho, mushkil me saath — ye do baatein sabse badi hain.
'My school' par English me 8 line likho

1. My school is Government Inter College.
2. It is a big school with a large playground.
3. There are about fifty teachers in my school.
4. My school has a library and a science lab.
5. We have a morning assembly every day.
6. My teachers are very kind and helpful.
7. I have many good friends in my school.
8. I love my school very much.

School par likhne me building nahi, teacher aur dost — wahi school ki asal pehchan hai.
'My favourite festival' Diwali par English me likho

"My favourite festival is Diwali, the festival of lights. On this day, we clean our house and decorate it with lamps and candles. In the evening, we worship Goddess Lakshmi and burst crackers. We eat sweets and visit our relatives. Diwali teaches us that light always wins over darkness."

'Wins over' matlab 'par jeet'. Tyohar ka matlab (roshni ki jeet) aakhir me likhna paragraph ko pura karta hai.
'My aim in life' — teacher banna hai, English me likho

"My aim in life is to become a teacher. Teachers build the future of the country by teaching children. In my village, many children cannot study properly. I want to teach them and change their lives. I am working hard to achieve my aim."

'Achieve' matlab 'hasil karna'. Lakshya ke saath wajah (gaon ke bacche) likho — bina wajah ka lakshya khokhla lagta hai.
'My aim in life' — doctor banna hai, English me paragraph

"My aim in life is to become a doctor. I want to serve the poor people of my village, where there is no good hospital. I have seen people suffering due to lack of treatment. I will study hard, become a doctor and open a small hospital in my village."

'Due to lack of' matlab 'ki kami ke kaaran'. Apna dekha hua dukh hi sabse sachha lakshya hota hai.
'My daily routine' par English me likho

"I get up at 5 o'clock in the morning. After taking a bath, I study for two hours. I go to school at 8 and come back at 2. After lunch, I take rest for some time. In the evening, I play with my friends and complete my homework. I go to bed at 10 after dinner."

Roz ke kaam beete nahi, aam samay (present) me likhe jate hain — get up, go, come. Samay ghadi ke saath jodo, paragraph jeeta-jagta lagega.
'My hobby' — baghbani (gardening) par English me likho

"My hobby is gardening. I have a small garden in front of my house. I grow roses, marigolds and vegetables like tomatoes and chillies. I water the plants every morning. Gardening keeps me close to nature and gives me fresh vegetables. It is a healthy and peaceful hobby."

'Close to nature' matlab 'prakriti ke kareeb'. Hobby me fayda (taazi sabzi, shaanti) zaroor likho.
'My favourite game' cricket par English me paragraph

"My favourite game is cricket. It is the most popular game in India. I play cricket with my friends every Sunday in the village ground. I am an all-rounder — I can bat and bowl both. Cricket teaches us teamwork and patience. My favourite player is Virat Kohli because of his hard work and passion."

'Passion' matlab 'junoon'. Pasandeeda khiladi ki wajah (mehnat) likhna paragraph ko upar uthata hai.
Apne baare me English me likho — naukri dhoondhne wala ladka

"I am Sandeep Kumar, a 22-year-old graduate from a small town. I belong to a farmer family. I have completed a computer diploma and I am looking for a job. I am ready to work hard and learn new things. My dream is to support my family and build a better future."

Ye chhota sa parichay application ke saath jodne ke kaam ka hai — umar, parivaar, skill, taiyari, sapna.
'My house' par English me kuch line likho

"I live in a small but beautiful house. It has three rooms, a kitchen and a courtyard. There is a neem tree in our courtyard which gives shade in summer. My grandmother sits under the tree and tells us stories. My house is small, but it is full of love and happiness."

'Aangan' ko English me 'courtyard' kehte hain. Ghar ki sabse pyaari jagah (neem ka ped) likhna paragraph ko apna banata hai.
'My pet dog' par English me likho

"I have a pet dog named Sheru. He is brown in colour and very playful. He waits for me at the door when I come from school. He guards our house at night. Sheru is not just a dog, he is a member of our family."

'Guards' matlab 'rakhwali karta hai'. 'Not just a dog' wali line paltu ke liye pyaar dikhati hai.
'My favourite teacher' par English me paragraph

"My favourite teacher is Mr. Sharma, who teaches us Mathematics. He explains difficult sums in a very simple way. He never gets angry and always encourages weak students. Because of him, Mathematics has become my favourite subject. I respect him a lot."

'Encourages' matlab 'haunsla badhata hai'. Teacher ki khaasiyat example ke saath — 'mushkil hisaab aasan tareeke se' — yahi asal taareef hai.
Apne gaon ke baare me English me batao — koi sheher wala puche to

"Our village is small but self-dependent. We grow our own food and vegetables. The people are simple and helpful. There is no pollution and no noise like the city. In the evening, elders sit together under the banyan tree and talk. You must visit once — you will love the peace."

'Self-dependent' matlab 'aatma-nirbhar'. Bargad = banyan tree. Gaon ki shaanti hi uski sabse badi daulat hai.
'My dream' par English me chhota paragraph — apni dukaan kholni hai

"My dream is to open my own shop one day. I am working in another person's shop to learn the business. I am saving money little by little. When my shop opens, I will keep good quality goods and treat customers with respect. A dream with hard work always comes true."

'Little by little' matlab 'thoda-thoda karke'. Sapne ke saath aaj ki taiyari likho — sapna tabhi sachha lagta hai.
'My brother' par English me likho

"My elder brother is my guide and my best friend. He works in a factory in the city. He sends money home every month and supports my studies. Whenever I face any problem, I call him first. I want to become like him — responsible and caring."

'Responsible' matlab 'zimmedaar', 'caring' matlab 'parwah karne wala'. Bhai par likhne me sahara aur seekh — do baatein.
'My grandmother' par English me paragraph likho

"My grandmother is 75 years old. She is the oldest member of our family. She tells us stories of old times and teaches us good values. Her hands make the most delicious food in the world. Everyone in the village respects her. May God give her a long life."

'Good values' matlab 'achhe sanskar'. Dadi ki kahaniyan aur khana — ye do baatein har dil ko chhuti hain.
Apne baare me English me 5 line — ladki ke liye, school ke liye

1. My name is Anjali Kumari.
2. I am 13 years old.
3. I study in class 8.
4. I live in Patna with my parents.
5. I want to become a doctor.

Naam, umar, class, jagah, sapna — 5 line me pura parichay. Pehle ye ratta nahi, bol-bol kar practice karo.
'My favourite season' — sardi (winter) par English me likho

"My favourite season is winter. The weather becomes cool and pleasant. We sit around the fire in the evening and eat hot food. In winter, we get many fresh vegetables and fruits like oranges and guavas. I like winter because I can play in the sun the whole day without getting tired."

'Pleasant' matlab 'suhavna'. Mausam par likhne me khana aur khel — dono ka zikr paragraph ko rang deta hai.
'About my state' — apne rajya par English me chhota paragraph (UP ke liye)

"I belong to Uttar Pradesh, the largest state of India by population. Lucknow is its capital. The Taj Mahal in Agra and the ghats of Varanasi are famous all over the world. The rivers Ganga and Yamuna flow through my state. I am proud of my state's rich culture and history."

'Rich culture' matlab 'samriddh sanskriti'. Rajya par likhne me: rajdhani, mashhoor jagah, nadiyan — teen baatein kaafi.
Apne baare me English me batao jab koi puche 'Introduce yourself' dostana mahaul me

"I am Imran. I am from Hyderabad. I work as a tailor in a garment shop. I love Hyderabadi biryani and old songs. On Sundays, I spend time with my family. That's all about me — now tell me about yourself!"

Dostana parichay me aakhir me sawal palat do — 'now tell me about yourself' — baat-cheet aise hi aage badhti hai.
Pehla Vishwa Yuddh kab aur kaise shuru hua tha?

Pehla Vishwa Yuddh 1914 me shuru hua. Austria-Hungary ke yuvraj Archduke Franz Ferdinand ki Sarajevo me hatya (28 June 1914) ke baad Austria-Hungary ne Serbia par yuddh ghoshit kar diya, aur sandhiyon ke jaal se bade desh ek-ek karke yuddh me ghus gaye. Yuddh 1918 tak chala.
Pehle Vishwa Yuddh me kaun-kaun se paksh the?

Ek taraf Mitra Rashtra (Allies) the - Britain, France, Russia aur baad me America. Dusri taraf Kendriya Shaktiyan (Central Powers) thi - Germany, Austria-Hungary aur Ottoman samrajya. Isiliye ise duniya bhar me lada gaya pehla bada yuddh mana jata hai.
Pehle Vishwa Yuddh ka parinaam kya hua?

Germany, Austria-Hungary aur Ottoman samrajya khatm ho gaye, Europe ka naksha badal gaya aur 1919 me Versailles ki sandhi hui. Shanti banaye rakhne ke liye League of Nations bana, lekin wo kamzor raha aur dusra vishwa yuddh rok nahi paya.
Dusra Vishwa Yuddh kab aur kaise shuru hua?

Dusra Vishwa Yuddh 1 September 1939 ko shuru hua, jab Hitler ke Nazi Germany ne Poland par hamla kiya. Jawab me Britain aur France ne Germany ke khilaf yuddh ghoshit kar diya. Ye yuddh 1945 tak chala aur duniya ke lagbhag har hisse tak phaila.
Dusra Vishwa Yuddh ka ant kaise hua?

1945 me Germany ki haar ke saath Europe me yuddh khatm hua. Japan par August 1945 me Hiroshima (6 August) aur Nagasaki (9 August) par atom bomb gire, jiske baad Japan ne bhi aatmasamarpan kar diya. Isi ke baad Sanyukt Rashtra (UN) ki sthapna hui taaki aisa yuddh dobara na ho.
Adolf Hitler kaun tha?

Hitler Germany ka Nazi tanashah tha. Uski vistarwadi neetiyon aur yahudiyon par atyachar (Holocaust) ke kaaran dusra vishwa yuddh hua, jisme karodon log mare gaye. 1945 me Germany ki haar ke samay usne aatmahatya kar li.
League of Nations kya tha?

League of Nations pehle vishwa yuddh ke baad 1920 me bana duniya ka pehla antarrashtriya sangathan tha, jiska kaam deshon ke jhagde baatchit se suljhana tha. Uske paas apni sena nahi thi aur America uska sadasya bhi nahi bana, isliye wo dusra vishwa yuddh rokne me asafal raha.
Sanyukt Rashtra (UN) kab aur kyun bana?

Sanyukt Rashtra ki sthapna 24 October 1945 ko dusre vishwa yuddh ke baad hui, taaki duniya me shanti bane rahe aur desh apne jhagde baatchit se suljhayein. Iska mukhyalaya New York (America) me hai aur aaj iske 193 sadasya desh hain. 24 October ko UN Diwas manaya jata hai.
UN ki Suraksha Parishad ke baare me batao.

Suraksha Parishad UN ka sabse shaktishali ang hai, jo duniya ki shanti aur suraksha ke faisle leta hai. Iske kul 15 sadasya hote hain, jisme 5 sthaayi sadasya hain - America, Russia, China, Britain aur France. In paancho ke paas veto shakti hai, matlab inme se koi ek bhi kisi prastav ko rok sakta hai.
UNICEF aur WHO kya karte hain?

UNICEF (1946) duniya bhar ke bachcho ke swasthya, shiksha aur suraksha ke liye kaam karta hai. WHO (Vishwa Swasthya Sangathan, 1948) duniya ke swasthya ke liye kaam karta hai - iska mukhyalaya Geneva me hai. Dono UN ki vishesh agencies hain.
MISR (Egypt) ki prachin sabhyata kaisi thi?

Misr ki sabhyata Nile nadi ke kinare vikasit hui, isliye ise 'Nile ka upahaar' kaha jata hai. Wahan ke raja Pharaoh kahlaye. Misr walo ne vishal pyramid, mandir aur mummy banane ki kala vikasit ki. Unki lekhan paddhati ko hieroglyph (chitra-lipi) kehte hain.
Giza ka sabse bada pyramid kisne banwaya tha?

Giza ka sabse bada pyramid Pharaoh Khufu ke liye lagbhag 4,500 saal pehle (lagbhag 2560 BCE) banaya gaya tha. Ye lagbhag 4,500 saalon tak duniya ki sabse unchi manav-nirmit rachna raha. Us samay ke hisab se ye vastukala ka adbhut chamatkar tha.
Pharaoh kaun hote the?

Pharaoh prachin Misr ke raja hote the. Praja unhe keval raja nahi, devta ka swaroop bhi manti thi. Unke paas shasan, sena aur dharm teeno ki shakti hoti thi. Tutankhamun aur Ramesses sabse prasiddh pharaon me se hain.
Sindhu Ghati sabhyata ki khaas baatein batao.

Sindhu Ghati sabhyata lagbhag 5,000 saal purani hai aur duniya ki sabse prachin sabhyataon me se ek hai. Mohenjo-daro aur Harappa iske bade shahar the. Wahan pakki eenton ke ghar, chaudi sadkein, dhaki hui naaliyan aur Mohenjo-daro ka vishal snan-ghar (Great Bath) mila hai - ye us samay ke shandar nagar-niyojan ko dikhata hai.
Rome ki sabhyata ki khaas baat kya thi?

Rome ke log shandar sadkein, pul, jal-marg (aqueduct) aur badi imaratein banane me mahir the. Unke kanoon (Roman Law) ne aaj ke kai deshon ke kanoon ko prabhavit kiya. Rome ka Colosseum aaj bhi usi garima ki gawahi deta hai. Latin bhasha wahi se phaili.
Julius Caesar kaun tha?

Julius Caesar Rome ka prasiddh senapati aur shasak tha, jisne Gaul (aaj ka France) jeeta aur Rome ki shakti bahut badha di. Baad me wo Rome ka tanashah ban gaya. 44 BCE me uski hatya uske hi saathiyon, jinme Brutus bhi tha, ne kar di. 'Et tu, Brute?' usse judi prasiddh katha hai.
Loktantra (democracy) ki shuruaat kahan hui thi?

Loktantra ki neev prachin Greece (Yunan) ke shahar Athens me padi, lagbhag 2,500 saal pehle. Wahan nagrik seedha sabha me ikatthe hokar faisle lete the. 'Democracy' shabd bhi Greek bhasha ke 'demos' (log) aur 'kratos' (shakti) se bana hai - matlab logo ki shakti.
Prachin Olympic khel kahan se shuru hue?

Prachin Olympic khel Greece ke Olympia shahar me 776 BCE se shuru hue the aur har chaar saal par hote the. Ye devta Zeus ke samman me aayojit hote the. Aadhunik Olympics ki prerna bhi yahi se mili, aur chaar saal ka antaral aaj bhi wahi parampara hai.
Sikandar (Alexander the Great) kaun tha?

Sikandar Makedonia (Macedon) ka raja tha, jisne keval 10-12 saalon me Greece se lekar Misr, Persia (Iran) aur Bharat tak ka vishal samrajya jeet liya. 326 BCE me wo Bharat aaya aur Jhelum (Hydaspes) ki ladai me Raja Porus se lada. Uske sainiko ke aage badhne se inkaar par wo wapas laut gaya.
Mesopotamia sabhyata kahan thi?

Mesopotamia aaj ke Iraq me Tigris aur Euphrates nadiyon ke beech ka kshetra tha. Wahan Sumer ke logo ne duniya ki sabse pehli lekhan paddhati (cuneiform) aur pahiya vikasit kiya. Babylon yahi ka prasiddh shahar tha.
Hammurabi kaun tha?

Hammurabi Babylon ka prasiddh raja tha (lagbhag 3,800 saal pehle). Wo apni kanoon-sanghita ke liye jana jata hai, jo duniya ke sabse purane likhit kanoono me se ek hai. Isme 'aankh ke badle aankh' jaise sakht niyam the.
China ne duniya ko kaun-kaun se aavishkar diye?

Prachin China ne kagaz, disha-suchak (compass), barood (gunpowder) aur chhapai (printing) jaise mahan aavishkar duniya ko diye. Inhe China ke 'chaar bade aavishkar' kaha jata hai. Inhone duniya ka itihaas badal diya - kagaz se gyaan phaila, compass se samudri yatrayein aasan hui.
Qin Shi Huang kaun tha?

Qin Shi Huang China ka pehla samrat tha, jisne 221 BCE me China ko ek kiya. Usi ne alag-alag deewaron ko jodkar Mahan Deewar ki neev rakhi. Uski kabr ke paas mitti ke bane hazaron sainiko ki murtiyan (Terracotta Army) mili hain, jo aaj duniya bhar me prasiddh hain.
Genghis Khan (Changez Khan) kaun tha?

Genghis Khan ne 13vi sadi me Mongol janjatiyon ko ek karke itihaas ka sabse bada lagatar bhoomi samrajya banaya, jo China se Europe tak phaila tha. Uski sena ghud-sawari aur teer-andazi me behad tez thi. Uske poton ne baad me China aur Persia par shasan kiya.
1453 me Constantinople vijay kyun mahatvapurna thi?

1453 me Ottoman sultan Mehmed II ne Constantinople (aaj ka Istanbul) jeet liya, jisse purvi Roman (Byzantine) samrajya ka ant ho gaya. Ise aam taur par Madhya Yug ke ant aur naye yug ki shuruaat ka chinh mana jata hai. Iske baad Europe ke logo ne Bharat ke naye samudri raaste khojne par aur zor diya.
Renaissance (Punarjagaran) kya tha?

Renaissance 14vi se 16vi sadi ke beech Europe me aaya kala, sahitya aur vigyaan ka punarjanm tha. Isme logo ne purani Greek-Roman paramparaon ko dobara apnaya aur naye sawal puchne shuru kiye. Leonardo da Vinci is kaal ke sabse bade pratibha the. Isi daur ne aadhunik vigyaan ki neev rakhi.
Leonardo da Vinci kaun the?

Leonardo da Vinci Italy ke mahaan chitrakar, vaigyanik aur aavishkarak the. Unki sabse prasiddh painting 'Mona Lisa' hai, aur 'The Last Supper' bhi unhi ki rachna hai. Unhone udne wali machineon aur shareer rachna ke bare me apne samay se bahut aage ki khoj ki thi.
French Kranti kab hui aur uska naara kya tha?

French Kranti 1789 me hui, jab France ki janta ne raja ke atyachar aur asamanata ke khilaf awaaz uthayi. Iska naara tha - 'Swatantrata, Samanta, Bandhuta' (Liberty, Equality, Fraternity). Is kranti ne duniya bhar ke loktantra andolanon ko prerna di.
America ko swatantrata kab mili aur pehle rashtrapati kaun bane?

America ko Britain se swatantrata 4 July 1776 ko ghoshit hui, isliye wahan 4 July ko Swatantrata Diwas manaya jata hai. George Washington swatantra America ke pehle rashtrapati bane aur unhe wahan ke 'rashtrapita' mana jata hai.
Abraham Lincoln kyun prasiddh hain?

Abraham Lincoln America ke 16ve rashtrapati the. Unhone 1861-65 ke grih yuddh ke dauraan desh ko ek rakha aur das pratha (gulami) ka ant kiya. Unka Gettysburg bhashan duniya ke sabse prasiddh bhashano me gina jata hai. 1865 me unki hatya kar di gayi.
Audyaugik Kranti (Industrial Revolution) kahan se shuru hui?

Audyaugik Kranti 18vi sadi me England se shuru hui. Bhaap engine aur machineon ke aane se karkhane bane, utpadan tezi se badha aur log gaon se shaharo ki ore aane lage. Isi ne aadhunik udyog aur shahari jeevan ki neev rakhi.
Christopher Columbus kaun tha?

Columbus Italy ka navik tha jo Bharat ka samudri raasta dhundhne nikla tha, lekin 1492 me wo America ke paas ke dweepo par pahunch gaya. Use galti se laga ki wo Bharat pahunch gaya hai, isliye wahan ke mool niwasiyon ko 'Indian' kaha gaya. Uski yatra ke baad Europe aur America ke beech sampark shuru hua.
Vasco da Gama ka Bharat se kya sambandh hai?

Vasco da Gama Portugal ka navik tha, jo 1498 me samudra ke raaste Bharat ke Calicut (Kozhikode) bandargah par pahuncha. Wo Bharat pahunchne wala pehla European navik tha. Isi ke baad European companiyon ka Bharat aana aur vyapaar shuru hua.
Magellan ke abhiyan ki khaas baat kya thi?

Ferdinand Magellan ke abhiyan (1519-1522) ne pehli baar prithvi ka chakkar samudra se lagaya. Magellan ki beech yatra me mrityu ho gayi thi, lekin uska ek jahaz Juan Sebastian Elcano ke netritva me Spain wapas pahunch gaya. Isse prithvi ke gol hone ka vyavharik saboot mila.
