Gutenberg ka aavishkar kaun sa tha?

Johannes Gutenberg ne lagbhag 1440 me Germany me chal-typ (movable type) wali chhapai machine (printing press) ko safal banaya. Isse kitabein sasti aur tez chhapne lagi, gyaan aam logo tak pahuncha aur Europe me shiksha aur vigyaan ko bahut badhava mila. Unki chhapi Bible prasiddh hai.
Russian Kranti kab hui thi?

Russian Kranti 1917 me hui. Pehle Raja (Tsar) ka shasan khatm hua, phir Vladimir Lenin ke netritva me Bolshevikon ne satta li aur duniya ka pehla samyavadi (communist) desh - Soviet Sangh - bana. Is ghatna ne 20vi sadi ki duniya ki rajneeti ko gehra prabhavit kiya.
Sheet Yuddh (Cold War) kya tha?

Dusre vishwa yuddh ke baad America aur Soviet Sangh ke beech chali lambe samay ki takraar ko Sheet Yuddh kehte hain (lagbhag 1947-1991). Dono ke beech seedha yuddh kabhi nahi hua, lekin hathiyaron ki daud, jasusi aur dusre deshon ke yuddhon me ulta-paksh lena chalta raha. 1991 me Soviet Sangh ke vighatan ke saath ye khatm hua.
Berlin Deewar kyun bani aur kab giri?

Dusre vishwa yuddh ke baad Germany do hisso me bant gaya tha - Paschimi aur Purvi Germany. 1961 me Berlin shahar ke beech deewar khadi kar di gayi taaki log Purvi hisse se bhaag na sakein. 9 November 1989 ko ye deewar gir gayi aur 1990 me Germany dobara ek ho gaya.
Soviet Sangh ka vighatan kab hua?

1991 me Soviet Sangh tootkar 15 alag deshon me bant gaya, jinme Russia sabse bada hai. Iske saath sheet yuddh ka ant hua aur America duniya ki ekmatra mahashakti reh gaya. Mikhail Gorbachev us samay Soviet neta the, jinki 'glasnost' aur 'perestroika' neetiyon ne badlav ki neev rakhi thi.
Nelson Mandela kaun the?

Nelson Mandela Dakshin Africa me rang-bhed (apartheid) ke khilaf ladne wale neta the. Unhone 27 saal jail me bitaye, phir bhi ahinsa aur sulah ka raasta nahi chhoda. 1994 me wo Dakshin Africa ke pehle kaale (Black) rashtrapati bane. Unhe 1993 me Nobel Shanti Puraskar mila tha.
Martin Luther King Jr. kaun the?

Martin Luther King Jr. America me kaale logo ke nagrik adhikaron ke neta the. Unhone ahinsak andolan chalaya aur 1963 me unka 'I Have a Dream' bhashan duniya bhar me prasiddh hua. Unhe 1964 me Nobel Shanti Puraskar mila. 1968 me unki hatya kar di gayi.
Napoleon Bonaparte kaun tha?

Napoleon France ka prasiddh senapati aur samrat tha. Usne Europe ke bade hisse par vijay payi aur kanoon (Napoleonic Code) jaise sudhar kiye. Aakhir me 1815 me Waterloo ki ladai me haar ke baad uska patan hua aur use door ke dweep Saint Helena bhej diya gaya, jahan uski mrityu hui.
Atom bomb pehli baar kab aur kahan istemal hua?

Yuddh me atom bomb ka pehla istemal 6 August 1945 ko Japan ke Hiroshima shahar par hua, aur dusra 9 August ko Nagasaki par. Dono shahar lagbhag tabah ho gaye aur lakhon log mare gaye. Iske turant baad Japan ne aatmasamarpan kiya aur dusra vishwa yuddh khatm hua.
Pearl Harbor hamla kya tha?

7 December 1941 ko Japan ne Hawaii ke Pearl Harbor sthit America ke nausena adde par achanak hawai hamla kiya. Isi ke baad America aadhikarik roop se dusre vishwa yuddh me shamil ho gaya. Ye ghatna yuddh ka mod sabit hui.
Pehle Vishwa Yuddh me Bharatiya sainiko ki kya bhoomika thi?

Pehle vishwa yuddh me 10 lakh se zyada Bharatiya sainiko ne Britain ki taraf se hissa liya aur Europe, Africa aur Madhya Poorv ke morcho par lade. Hazaron sainik shahid hue. Yuddh ke baad Bharat me swatantrata ki mang aur tez ho gayi, kyunki Bharatiyaon ko badle me sudhar ki ummeed thi.
Hannibal kaun tha?

Hannibal prachin Carthage (aaj ka Tunisia) ka mahaan senapati tha. Dusre Punic Yuddh me wo apni sena aur ladaku haathiyon ke saath barfile Alps pahaad paar karke Italy pahuncha aur Rome ko kai ladaiyon me haraya. Cannae ki ladai me uski chaal aaj bhi sena-shiksha me padhai jati hai.
Cleopatra kaun thi?

Cleopatra prachin Misr ki antim prasiddh shasika thi (lagbhag 2,000 saal pehle). Wo buddhiman aur kai bhashayein jaanne wali mani jati hai. Uske samay ke baad Misr Rome ke adheen ho gaya. Uske jeevan par duniya bhar me kai kahaniyan aur filmen bani hain.
Ottoman samrajya ka ant kab hua aur Turkey kaise bana?

Pehle vishwa yuddh me haar ke baad Ottoman samrajya kamzor pad gaya aur 1922 me sultanat khatm ho gayi. 1923 me Mustafa Kemal Ataturk ke netritva me Turkey ganatantra bana. Ataturk ne Turkey ko aadhunik roop diya, isliye unhe 'Turkey ke pita' kaha jata hai.
Charles Darwin ka siddhant kya hai?

Charles Darwin ne vikasvaad (Theory of Evolution) ka siddhant diya. Unke anusar prakriti me wahi jeev aage badhte hain jo paryavaran ke anukool hote hain (natural selection). Unki kitab 'On the Origin of Species' 1859 me aayi aur jeev-vigyaan ki samajh badal gayi.
Isaac Newton kis liye prasiddh hain?

Isaac Newton ne gurutvakarshan (gravity) ka siddhant aur gati ke teen niyam diye. Kaha jata hai ki ped se seb girte dekhkar unhe gravity ka vichar aaya. Unki kitab 'Principia' (1687) vigyaan ki sabse prabhavshali kitabon me gini jati hai. Calculus ganit ke vikas me bhi unka bada yogdan hai.
Albert Einstein ka sabse prasiddh sutra kaun sa hai?

Einstein ka sutra hai E = mc square, matlab urja aur dravyaman (mass) ek dusre me badal sakte hain. Unhone sapekshata ka siddhant (Theory of Relativity) diya. Unhe 1921 ka Nobel Puraskar photoelectric prabhav ki vyakhya ke liye mila tha. Unhe aadhunik bhautiki ke sabse bade vaigyanik mana jata hai.
Marie Curie ki khaas baat kya thi?

Marie Curie pehli mahila thi jise Nobel Puraskar mila, aur wo do alag-alag vigyanon (Bhautiki 1903 aur Rasayan 1911) me Nobel pane wali pehli vyakti thi. Unhone radioactivity par khoj ki aur do naye tatva - polonium aur radium - khoje. Radioactive padarthon ke lambi sampark se hi unki mrityu hui.
Copernicus ne kya siddhant diya tha?

Nicolaus Copernicus ne 16vi sadi me bataya ki prithvi nahi, surya kendra me hai aur prithvi sahit saare grah surya ke chakkar lagate hain. Us samay ye baat bahut krantikari thi, kyunki log prithvi ko kendra mante the. Isi se aadhunik khagol vigyaan ki neev padi.
Galileo ko saza kyun mili thi?

Galileo ne durbeen (telescope) ko sudharkar Jupiter ke chand aur anya khojein ki. Unhone Copernicus ke is siddhant ka samarthan kiya ki prithvi surya ke chakkar lagati hai. Us samay ke dharmik adhikariyon ko ye baat pasand nahi aayi aur unhe gharelu nazarbandi (house arrest) ki saza mili.
Nobel Puraskar kab se diye jane lage?

Nobel Puraskar 1901 se diye jane lage. Ye dynamite ke aavishkarak Alfred Nobel ki vasiyat se shuru hue. Ye puraskar bhautiki, rasayan, chikitsa, sahitya, shanti aur (baad me joda gaya) arthashastra me diye jate hain. Shanti puraskar Norway ke Oslo me aur baaki Sweden ke Stockholm me diye jate hain.
Babur ne Mughal samrajya ki neev kaise rakhi?

Babur ne 1526 me Panipat ki pehli ladai me Delhi ke sultan Ibrahim Lodi ko harakar Mughal samrajya ki neev rakhi. Usne ladai me topon aur bandookon ka istemal kiya, jo Bharat me us samay naya tha. Babur Chingiz Khan aur Timur ke vansh se juda tha aur usne apni jeevani 'Baburnama' bhi likhi.
Panipat ki pehli ladai me Babur ki jeet ki khaas wajah kya thi?

1526 ki is ladai me Babur ki sena chhoti thi, lekin usne top-khana aur ghud-sawaron ki 'tulughma' chaal ka behtareen istemal kiya. Ibrahim Lodi ki badi sena is nayi ran-neeti ke saamne tik nahi payi. Isi jeet se Bharat me Mughal shasan ki shuruaat hui.
Baburnama kiski rachna hai?

Baburnama Babur ki aatmakatha hai, jo usne apni matribhasha Chagatai Turki me likhi thi. Isme usne apni ladaiyon, Bharat ki prakriti, phalon aur mausam ka varnan kiya hai. Ye kitab us samay ke itihaas ko samajhne ka mahatvapurna sadhan hai.
Humayun ko kisne haraya tha?

Humayun ko Sher Shah Suri ne Chausa (1539) aur Kannauj (1540) ki ladaiyon me haraya tha. Humayun ko Bharat chhodkar Persia (Iran) bhaagna pada. Sher Shah ki mrityu ke baad kamzor uttaradhikariyon ka fayda uthakar Humayun 1555 me dobara Delhi jeetne me safal hua.
Sher Shah Suri ke kaam batao.

Sher Shah ne keval paanch saal (1540-1545) shasan kiya, lekin bade sudhar kiye. Usne Peshawar se Kolkata tak Sadak-e-Azam (baad me GT Road) banwayi, dak vyavastha sudhari, bhoomi ki nap-jokh karayi aur 'Rupiya' naam ka sikka chalaya - aaj ki Bharatiya mudra ka naam wahi se aaya hai. Sasaram (Bihar) me uska prasiddh maqbara hai.
Akbar kab shasak bana aur dusri Panipat ladai kiske saath hui?

Akbar 1556 me keval 13 saal ki umar me shasak bana. Usi saal Panipat ki dusri ladai me Akbar ki sena (Bairam Khan ke netritva me) ne Hemu ko haraya. Is jeet se Mughal shasan Bharat me mazboot ho gaya.
Akbar ke Navratna kaun-kaun the?

Akbar ke darbar ke nau vishesh pratibhao ko Navratna kaha jata hai. Inme Birbal (buddhi), Tansen (sangeet), Todar Mal (rajjasva), Abul Fazl (vidwan), Raja Man Singh (senapati), Abdur Rahim Khan-e-Khana (kavi), Faizi, Mulla Do-Piyaza aur Fakir Aziao-Din shamil mane jate hain.
Birbal kaun the?

Birbal Akbar ke sabse priya darbarai aur salahkar the. Unka asli naam Mahesh Das tha. Wo apni haazir-jawabi aur buddhimani ke liye prasiddh hue - Akbar-Birbal ki kathaayein aaj bhi bachcho ko sunayi jati hain. Ve ek kavi bhi the aur 'Brahm Kavi' ki upadhi se jane jate the.
Tansen kaun the?

Miyan Tansen Akbar ke darbar ke mahaan sangeetkar the. Unhe Hindustani shastriya sangeet ke sabse bade ustado me mana jata hai. Kaha jata hai ki unke gaane se deepak jal uthte the (Raag Deepak) aur baarish ho jati thi (Raag Malhar) - ye kathaayein unki kala ki mahima dikhati hain.
Todar Mal kis liye prasiddh the?

Raja Todar Mal Akbar ke vitt mantri the. Unhone bhoomi ki sahi nap (zabti paddhati) aur upaj ke aadhar par lagaan tay karne ki vyavastha banayi, jise 'Todar Mal bandobast' kehte hain. Isse kisano aur sarkar dono ke liye hisaab saaf ho gaya.
Abul Fazl ne kaun si kitabein likhi?

Abul Fazl Akbar ke vidwan mitra the. Unhone 'Akbarnama' (Akbar ke shasan ka itihaas) aur uska bhag 'Ain-i-Akbari' likha, jisme us samay ke shasan, samaaj aur arthavyavastha ki vistrit jaankari hai. Ve Akbar ke Navratno me sabse vidwan mane jate hain.
Fatehpur Sikri kyun prasiddh hai?

Fatehpur Sikri ko Akbar ne apni rajdhani banaya tha (Agra ke paas). Wahan ka Buland Darwaza duniya ke sabse bade darwazon me se hai, jo Akbar ne Gujarat vijay ki khushi me banwaya tha. Paani ki kami ke kaaran baad me rajdhani wapas Agra shift karni padi.
Akbar ki dharmik neeti kaisi thi?

Akbar sab dharmo ka samman karta tha. Usne Hinduon par laga jizya kar khatm kiya, Ibadat Khana me sab dharmo ke vidwanon se charcha karayi aur sab dharmo ki achhi baaton ko jodkar 'Din-i-Ilahi' ka vichar rakha. Uski 'sulh-i-kul' (sabke saath shanti) neeti ke kaaran samrajya mazboot hua.
Jahangir ke samay ki do khaas baatein batao.

Jahangir nyay ke liye prasiddh tha - usne Agra ke kile me 'nyay ki zanjeer' lagwayi thi, jise bajakar koi bhi fariyadi us tak pahunch sakta tha. Uski patni Nur Jahan shasan me bahut prabhavshali thi. Jahangir ke samay hi angrez dut Sir Thomas Roe Bharat aaya tha, jisse angrezon ko vyapaar ki chhoot mili.
Shah Jahan ke kaal ko vastukala ka sunhara yug kyun kehte hain?

Shah Jahan ne sangmarmar ki shandar imaratein banwayi - Agra ka Taj Mahal, Delhi ka Lal Qila aur Jama Masjid, aur Agra kile ki Moti Masjid. Safed sangmarmar aur bareek nakash ka kaam uske kaal me charam par tha, isliye uske samay ko Mughal vastukala ka sunhara yug kaha jata hai.
Nadir Shah ka hamla kyun prasiddh hai?

1739 me Persia (Iran) ke shasak Nadir Shah ne Delhi par hamla kiya. Usne Karnal ki ladai me Mughalon ko haraya, Delhi me bhayankar loot machayi aur Mayur Singhasan (Peacock Throne) aur Kohinoor heera lootkar le gaya. Is hamle ne Mughal samrajya ki kamzori duniya ke saamne khol di.
Aurangzeb ke samay samrajya ki sthiti kaisi thi?

Aurangzeb ke samay Mughal samrajya apne sabse bade aakar par pahuncha - lagbhag poora Bharat uske adheen tha. Lekin Deccan ki lambi ladaiyon, Maratho ke virodh aur sakht neetiyon se khazana khaali hota gaya. 1707 me uski mrityu ke baad samrajya tezi se kamzor padne laga.
Khalsa Panth ki sthapna kisne aur kab ki?

Khalsa Panth ki sthapna Sikhon ke dasve Guru, Guru Gobind Singh ji ne 1699 me Anandpur Sahib me Baisakhi ke din ki thi. Unhone Panj Pyare sajaye aur Sikhon ko 'Singh' aur 'Kaur' naam apnane ko kaha. Isse pehle 1675 me Guru Tegh Bahadur ji ne dharmik swatantrata ke liye Delhi me shahadat di thi.
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ka rajyabhishek kab hua?

Shivaji Maharaj ka rajyabhishek 1674 me Raigad kile par hua, jahan unhe 'Chhatrapati' ki upadhi mili. Unhone Maratha samrajya ki neev rakhi, mazboot nausena banayi aur praja ke hit me shasan kiya. Unke paas lagbhag 300 kile the, isliye unhe 'kilon ke raja' bhi kehte hain.
Shivaji Maharaj ki yuddh-neeti kaisi thi?

Shivaji Maharaj 'ganimi kava' (guerrilla yuddh) ke mahir the - chhoti tez tukdiyan, pahaadi kshetron ka fayda, achanak hamla aur turant peeche hatna. Isi neeti se unhone apne se kahin badi Mughal aur Adilshahi senaon ko baar-baar maat di. Unka prasiddh mukabla Afzal Khan se hua tha.
Tanaji Malusare kaun the?

Tanaji Malusare Shivaji Maharaj ke bahadur senapati the. 1670 me unhone Sinhagad (Kondhana) ka kila jeetne ke liye jaan ki baazi lagayi aur veergati payi. Tab Shivaji Maharaj ne kaha tha - 'Gad ala, pan Sinha gela' (kila aa gaya, par sher chala gaya). Kile ka naam unhi ke samman me Sinhagad pada.
Ahilyabai Holkar kaun thi?

Ahilyabai Holkar Indore ki Holkar vansh ki prasiddh rani thi (18vi sadi). Ve apne nyay, dan aur praja-hito ke liye desh bhar me sammanit hain. Unhone Kashi Vishwanath mandir sahit desh ke kai prasiddh mandiron ka jirnoddhar karwaya aur sadkein, dharmshalayein banwayi.
Haldighati ki ladai kab aur kiske beech hui?

Haldighati ki ladai 1576 me Maharana Pratap aur Akbar ki sena (Man Singh ke netritva me) ke beech Rajasthan me hui. Isme Maharana ke priya ghode Chetak ki bahaduri ki katha prasiddh hai. Pratap ne kabhi Akbar ki adheenata sweekar nahi ki aur jangalon se sangharsh jaari rakha.
Khanwa ki ladai me kya hua tha?

Khanwa ki ladai 1527 me Babur aur Rana Sanga ke beech hui. Rana Sanga Rajput rajao ke sangh ke saath lade, lekin Babur ki top-khane wali ran-neeti ke saamne unhe haar mili. Is jeet se Babur ki sthiti Bharat me aur mazboot ho gayi.
Tipu Sultan ko 'Mysore ka Sher' kyun kehte hain?

Tipu Sultan Mysore ke shasak the aur angrezon ke sabse kadve dushman. Unhone angrezon se chaar yuddh lade aur yuddh me rocket (loha-khol wale rocket) ka istemal kiya, jo us samay ki nayi takneek thi. 1799 me Srirangapatna ki raksha karte hue ve veergati ko praapt hue. Unki bahaduri ke kaaran unhe 'Mysore ka Sher' kaha jata hai.
Maharaja Ranjit Singh kaun the?

Maharaja Ranjit Singh ne 19vi sadi ki shuruaat me Punjab me shaktishali Sikh samrajya banaya, jiski rajdhani Lahore thi. Unki sena aadhunik tareeke se prashikshit thi aur unke darbar me sab dharmo ke log the. Prasiddh Kohinoor heera bhi kuch samay unke paas raha.
Panipat ki teesri ladai kab aur kiske beech hui?

Panipat ki teesri ladai 1761 me Maratho aur Ahmad Shah Abdali (Afghan shasak) ke beech hui. Isme Maratho ki bhari haar hui aur hazaron sainik mare gaye. Is haar ne Maratha shakti ko gehra dhakka diya aur Bharat me angrezon ke badhne ka raasta aasan ho gaya.
Tarain ki ladaiyon me kya hua tha?

1191 ki Tarain ki pehli ladai me Prithviraj Chauhan ne Muhammad Ghori ko haraya tha. Lekin 1192 ki dusri ladai me Ghori ne Prithviraj ko hara diya. Is jeet ke baad uttar Bharat me Turk shasan ki neev padi - ye Bharat ke itihaas ka ek bada mod mana jata hai.
Rani Chennamma kaun thi?

Rani Chennamma Karnataka ke Kittur ki rani thi. Unhone 1824 me angrezon ke khilaf hathiyaar uthaye - ye 1857 ke sangram se lagbhag 33 saal pehle ki baat hai. Isliye unhe angrezon se ladne wali pehli Bharatiya veeranganaon me gina jata hai. Unka sangharsh aaj bhi Karnataka me garv se yaad kiya jata hai.
Samrat Ashok ke jeevan ka mod kaun si ghatna thi?

Kalinga ka yuddh (lagbhag 261 BCE) Ashok ke jeevan ka mod tha. Yuddh me hue bhayankar raktpaat ko dekhkar unka hriday badal gaya aur unhone hinsa chhodkar Buddha ke updeshon ko apnaya. Iske baad unhone poore samrajya me 'dhamma' (daya, ahinsa, seva) ka prachar kiya aur jagah-jagah shilalekh lagwaye.
Sarnath ka Sinh Stambh Bharat ke liye kyun khaas hai?

Ashok dwara Sarnath me lagwaya gaya Sinh Stambh (Lion Capital) aaj Bharat ka rashtriya chinh (National Emblem) hai. Isme chaar sinh bane hain, jinme se teen dikhai dete hain. Iske neeche 'Satyameva Jayate' likha hai, jo Bharat ka rashtriya aadarsh vakya hai. Ye chinh 26 January 1950 ko apnaya gaya tha.
Chanakya kaun the?

Chanakya (Kautilya/Vishnugupta) Chandragupta Maurya ke guru aur pradhan mantri the. Unhone 'Arthashastra' naam ki prasiddh kitab likhi, jisme raajneeti, arthavyavastha aur shasan chalane ke siddhant diye gaye hain. Unki buddhimani ke kaaran unhe Bharat ka sabse bada raajneeti-visharad mana jata hai.
Gupta kaal ko 'Swarna Yug' kyun kehte hain?

Gupta kaal (4vi-6vi sadi) me Bharat me vigyaan, ganit, sahitya aur kala ka bahut vikas hua. Aryabhata jaise vaigyanik aur Kalidas jaise kavi isi kaal me hue. Nalanda vishwavidyalaya bhi isi daur me phala-phoola. Isi samriddhi ke kaaran ise Bharat ka 'Swarna Yug' kaha jata hai.
Kalidas kaun the?

Kalidas Sanskrit ke sabse mahaan kavi aur natakkar mane jate hain. Unki prasiddh rachnaayein hain - natak 'Abhijnana Shakuntalam' aur kavya 'Meghaduta' (badal ko doot banakar sandesh bhejna). Unhe 'Kavi Kulaguru' kaha jata hai aur unki tulna aksar Shakespeare se ki jati hai.
Brihadeeswara mandir kisne banwaya tha?

Thanjavur (Tanjore) ka vishal Brihadeeswara mandir Chola samrat Rajaraja Chola I ne lagbhag 1010 CE me banwaya tha. Iska shikhar lagbhag 66 meter uncha hai aur ye Dravid vastukala ka adbhut udaharan hai. Ye mandir aaj UNESCO vishwa dharohar me shamil hai.
Krishnadevaraya kaun the?

Krishnadevaraya Vijayanagara samrajya ke sabse prasiddh raja the (16vi sadi). Unki rajdhani Hampi us samay duniya ke sabse samriddh shaharo me thi. Ve khud Telugu ke kavi the aur unke darbar me 'Ashtadiggaja' (aath mahaan kavi) the. Tenali Raman unhi ke darbar se jude the.
Bhakti andolan ke pramukh sant kaun-kaun the?

Bhakti andolan ne pure Bharat me bhakti aur samanta ka sandesh phailaya. Iske pramukh sant the - Kabir (dohe), Guru Nanak Dev (Sikh dharm ke sansthapak, 1469 me janm), Mirabai (Krishna bhakt), Tulsidas (Ramcharitmanas), Surdas aur Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Inhone jaat-paat se upar uthkar prem aur bhakti ki baat kahi.
Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti kaun the?

Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Ajmer ke prasiddh Sufi sant the, jinhe 'Garib Nawaz' kaha jata hai. Unhone prem, seva aur insaniyat ka sandesh diya. Ajmer Sharif ki dargah par aaj bhi sab dharmo ke log shraddha se aate hain. Delhi ke Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya bhi Chishti parampara ke hi prasiddh sant the.
Ashok ke shilalekh kaise padhe gaye?

Ashok ke shilalekh Brahmi lipi me the, jo samay ke saath bhool jayi gayi thi. 1837 me angrez vidwan James Prinsep ne Brahmi lipi ko padhne me safalta payi. Isse Ashok ke baare me duniya ko pehli baar vistrit jaankari mili aur prachin Bharat ka itihaas samajhna aasan hua.
East India Company kab bani aur Plassey ki ladai kya thi?

East India Company 1600 me England me vyapaar ke liye bani thi. 1757 me Plassey ki ladai me Robert Clive ne Bengal ke nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah ko haraya - is jeet me nawab ke senapati Mir Jafar ki gaddari ka bhi bada haath tha. Isi ladai se Bharat me angrezi shasan ki neev padi.
Buxar ki ladai aur Diwani adhikar kya tha?

1764 me Buxar ki ladai me Company ne Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula aur Mughal badshah Shah Alam II ki sanyukt sena ko haraya. 1765 me badshah ne Company ko Bengal, Bihar aur Orissa ki 'Diwani' (lagaan vasoolne ka adhikar) de di. Isse Company keval vyapaari nahi rahi, shasak ban gayi.
Bharat me pehli rail kab chali?

Bharat me pehli rail 16 April 1853 ko Mumbai se Thane ke beech chali, jisne 34 kilometer ki doori tay ki. Usme lagbhag 400 yatri sawaar the. Aaj Bharatiya rail duniya ke sabse bade rail jaalon me se ek hai.
Lord Dalhousie ki 'haddap neeti' (Doctrine of Lapse) kya thi?

Dalhousie ki is neeti ke tahat jis rajya ke raja ka koi swabhavik uttaradhikari nahi hota tha, us rajya ko angrez apne me mila lete the - god liye hue bete ko manyata nahi milti thi. Isi neeti se Satara, Nagpur aur Jhansi jaise rajya angrezon ke paas chale gaye. Rani Lakshmibai ka sangharsh bhi isi neeti se juda tha.
Raja Ram Mohan Roy ke sudhar kaun se the?

Raja Ram Mohan Roy ko 'aadhunik Bharat ka pita' kaha jata hai. Unhone sati pratha ke khilaf awaaz uthayi, jiske phalswaroop 1829 me Governor-General Lord William Bentinck ne sati par pratibandh lagaya. 1828 me unhone Brahmo Samaj ki sthapna ki aur mahila shiksha aur press ki swatantrata ka samarthan kiya.
Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar kis liye prasiddh hain?

Vidyasagar Bengal ke mahaan samaj sudharak aur vidwan the. Unhi ke prayason se 1856 me vidhwa punarvivah (Hindu Widows' Remarriage) ka kanoon bana. Unhone ladkiyon ki shiksha ke liye kai school khole aur Bangla varnmala ko saral banaya. Unki daya ke kaaran unhe 'Dayasagar' bhi kaha gaya.
Savitribai Phule ka yogdaan batao.

Savitribai Phule Bharat ki pehli mahila shikshika mani jati hain. Unhone apne pati Jyotiba Phule ke saath 1848 me Pune me ladkiyon ke liye pehla school khola, jab ladkiyon ki padhai ka sakht virodh hota tha. Unhone jaat-bhed aur mahilaon ke adhikaron ke liye jeevan bhar sangharsh kiya.
Arya Samaj ki sthapna kisne ki thi?

Arya Samaj ki sthapna Swami Dayananda Saraswati ne 1875 me Mumbai me ki thi. Unhone 'Vedon ki ore lauto' ka naara diya aur murti-pooja, jaat-paat aur baal-vivah ka virodh kiya. Arya Samaj ne shiksha ke kshetra me DAV schoolo ki shringkhala shuru ki.
Sir Syed Ahmad Khan kaun the?

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ne musalmano me aadhunik shiksha phailane ke liye Aligarh Andolan chalaya. Unhone 1875 me Aligarh me Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental (MAO) College ki sthapna ki, jo baad me Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) bana. Ve vigyaan aur angrezi shiksha ke samarthak the.
Dadabhai Naoroji ko 'Grand Old Man of India' kyun kehte hain?

Dadabhai Naoroji Bharat ke sabse varishth netaon me se the. Unhone 'Drain of Wealth' siddhant diya - ki angrez Bharat ki sampatti lootkar England le ja rahe hain. Ve 1892 me British sansad ke sadasya banne wale pehle Bharatiya bhi the. Unhi ke samman me unhe 'Grand Old Man of India' kaha gaya.
1857 ke sangram ki shuruaat kaise hui?

1857 ke sangram ki chingari sipahi Mangal Pandey se judi hai, jinhone March 1857 me Barrackpore me angrez adhikariyon par hamla kiya tha. Asli shuruaat 10 May 1857 ko Meerut ke sipahiyon ke vidroh se hui, jo Delhi pahunchkar Bahadur Shah Zafar ko neta ghoshit karke bada sangram ban gaya. Charbi wale kartoos iski tatkaal wajah the, lekin kaaran saalon ke shoshan me chupe the.
1857 ke pramukh nayak kaun-kaun the?

1857 ke sangram ke nayako me Jhansi ki Rani Lakshmibai, Tatya Tope, Nana Saheb, Bihar ke Kunwar Singh, Lucknow ki Begum Hazrat Mahal aur Delhi ke Bahadur Shah Zafar pramukh the. Rani Lakshmibai ki veerta dekhkar angrez senapati ne bhi unhe 'sabse khatarnak aur sabse yogya' kaha tha.
1857 ke baad Bharat ke shasan me kya badlav aaya?

1857 ke sangram ke baad East India Company ka shasan khatm kar diya gaya aur 1858 se Bharat seedha Britain ki Maharani Victoria ke adheen aa gaya. Maharani ne ghoshna ki ki Bharatiyaon ke dharm me hastakshep nahi hoga aur god lene ka adhikar mana jayega. Bharat ke liye London me 'Secretary of State' ka pad bana.
Bharatiya Rashtriya Congress (INC) ki sthapna kab hui?

Congress ki sthapna 1885 me hui. Iske pehle adhiveshan me Bombay me 72 pratinidhi shamil hue aur adhyaksh Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee bane. Iske sansthapak me retired angrez adhikari A.O. Hume ka naam liya jata hai. Aage chalkar Congress hi swatantrata andolan ki mukhya sangathan bani.
Bengal ka bantwara kab hua aur kyun radd hua?

1905 me Lord Curzon ne prashasan ki suvidha ka bahana karke Bengal ko do hisso me baant diya. Asliyat me ye Hindu-Muslim ekta todne ki chaal thi. Iske khilaf pure desh me Swadeshi andolan chala - videshi samaan ka bahishkar aur swadeshi apnane ka sankalp. Janata ke dabav se 1911 me bantwara radd karna pada.
Muslim League ki sthapna kab aur kahan hui?

Muslim League ki sthapna 1906 me Dhaka me hui. Iska uddeshya musalmano ke rajnaitik hiton ki raksha bataya gaya tha. Aage chalkar Muhammad Ali Jinnah ke netritva me yahi sangathan alag desh Pakistan ki mang ka kendra bana.
Lokmanya Tilak ka prasiddh naara kya tha?

Bal Gangadhar Tilak ne kaha tha - 'Swaraj mera janmasiddh adhikar hai aur main ise lekar rahunga.' Ve 'Lokmanya' ke naam se prasiddh hue aur 'Kesari' akhbaar chalate the. Unhone Ganpati utsav aur Shivaji utsav ko sarvajanik roop dekar logo ko ekjut kiya.
Gopal Krishna Gokhale kaun the?

Gokhale Congress ke naram-panthi neta aur mahaan vidwan the. Mahatma Gandhi unhe apna rajnaitik guru mante the. Unhone 'Servants of India Society' ki sthapna ki, jiske sadasya desh-seva ka vrat lekar kaam karte the. Unki salah par hi Gandhi ji ne pehle saal pure Bharat ka bhraman karke desh ko samjha tha.
Swami Vivekananda ka Chicago bhashan kab hua?

Swami Vivekananda ne 1893 me America ke Chicago shahar me Vishwa Dharm Sansad me prasiddh bhashan diya. 'Sisters and Brothers of America' se shuru hue is bhashan ne pure paschim ko Bharatiya sanskriti aur Vedant se parichit karaya. Unhone 1897 me Ramakrishna Mission ki sthapna ki, jo aaj bhi shiksha aur seva ka kaam karta hai.
Gandhi ji Bharat kab laute aur unka pehla satyagrah kahan hua?

Gandhi ji 1915 me Dakshin Africa se Bharat laute, jahan unhone rang-bhed ke khilaf safal satyagrah kiya tha. Bharat me unka pehla satyagrah 1917 me Bihar ke Champaran me hua, jahan unhone neel ki kheti karne wale kisano par hone wale atyachar ke khilaf awaaz uthayi. Iske baad Kheda aur Ahmedabad ke andolan hue.
Jallianwala Bagh hatyakand kab hua tha?

13 April 1919 ko Baisakhi ke din Amritsar ke Jallianwala Bagh me shantipurn sabha par General Dyer ne bina chetaavni ke goliyan chalwayi. Bagh chaaron ore se band tha, isliye sainkadon log mare gaye. Is ghatna ne pure desh ko jhakjhor diya aur Gandhi ji ke asahyog andolan ki neev rakhi. Rabindranath Tagore ne virodh me apni 'Sir' (Knighthood) upadhi lauta di thi.
Asahyog Andolan kab chala aur kyun roka gaya?

Asahyog Andolan 1920 me Gandhi ji ne shuru kiya - videshi samaan, sarkari schoolo, adalaton aur upadhi ka bahishkar iska karyakram tha. February 1922 me Chauri Chaura (UP) me bheed ne thane me aag laga di, jisme kai sipahi mare gaye. Hinsa se dukhi hokar Gandhi ji ne andolan wapas le liya.
Simon Commission ka virodh kyun hua?

1928 me Bharat ke samvidhanik sudharon ke liye Simon Commission aaya, jisme ek bhi Bharatiya sadasya nahi tha. Isiliye 'Simon Go Back' ke naaro ke saath uska desh bhar me virodh hua. Lahore me virodh ka netritva karte hue Lala Lajpat Rai lathi-charge me gambhir roop se ghayal hue aur kuch din baad unka nidhan ho gaya.
Purna Swaraj ki ghoshna kab hui?

December 1929 me Lahore adhiveshan me (Jawaharlal Nehru ki adhyakshata me) Congress ne 'Purna Swaraj' - matlab puri swatantrata - ka prastav pass kiya. 26 January 1930 ko pehla Swatantrata Diwas manaya gaya. Isi yaad me baad me 26 January ko hi samvidhan lagu karne ki tareekh chuni gayi.
Dandi March (Namak Satyagrah) kya tha?

1930 me Gandhi ji ne namak par lage anyaypurn kar ke khilaf Sabarmati Ashram se Dandi tak lagbhag 385 kilometer ki paidal yatra ki (12 March - 6 April 1930). Dandi pahunchkar unhone samudra ke paani se namak banakar kanoon toda. Isse pure desh me Namak Satyagrah phail gaya aur duniya bhar ka dhyaan Bharat ki ore gaya.
Poona Pact 1932 kya tha?

1932 me angrezon ne dalito ke liye alag nirvachan (separate electorate) ki ghoshna ki, jise Gandhi ji ne Hindu samaj ko todne wala mana aur jail me aamaran anshan shuru kiya. Phir Gandhi ji aur Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ke beech Poona Pact hua - alag nirvachan ki jagah aarakshit seeton par sammati bani aur Gandhi ji ne anshan toda.
Bhagat Singh ko faansi kab hui thi?

Bhagat Singh, Rajguru aur Sukhdev ko 23 March 1931 ko Lahore jail me faansi di gayi. Unhone Assembly me dhuaan bomb phenka tha (jaan lene ke liye nahi, awaaz uthane ke liye) aur Saunders ki hatya ka aarop un par tha. 'Inquilab Zindabad' unka prasiddh naara tha. 23 March ko Shaheed Diwas manaya jata hai.
Khudiram Bose kaun the?

Khudiram Bose Bharat ke sabse kam umar ke krantikariyon me se ek the. 1908 me Muzaffarpur me angrez magistrate Kingsford par hamle ke prayas ke aarop me unhe faansi di gayi, tab unki umar keval 18 saal thi. Faansi ke samay unki nirbhayata ki kathaayein aaj bhi sunayi jati hain.
Udham Singh ne kise mara tha aur kyun?

Sardar Udham Singh ne 1940 me London me Michael O'Dwyer ko goli mari. O'Dwyer Jallianwala Bagh hatyakand ke samay Punjab ka Lieutenant Governor tha. Udham Singh ne 21 saal tak us hatyakand ka badla lene ki kasam nibhayi. Unhe London me hi faansi di gayi.
Madam Bhikaji Cama kaun thi?

Madam Bhikaji Cama videsh me rahkar Bharat ki swatantrata ke liye kaam karne wali agrani neta thi. 1907 me Germany ke Stuttgart shahar me unhone antarrashtriya sammelan me Bharat ka jhanda fehraya - videshi dharti par Bharatiya jhanda fehrane ka ye pehla prasiddh avsar mana jata hai.
Bharat Chhodo Andolan (Quit India) kab hua?

8 August 1942 ko Bombay adhiveshan me Gandhi ji ne 'Bharat Chhodo' ka naara aur 'Karo ya Maro' ka mantra diya. Agle hi din saare bade neta giraftaar kar liye gaye, lekin andolan pure desh me phail gaya. Isi daur me Aruna Asaf Ali ne bhoomigat rahkar andolan sambhala aur Gowalia Tank maidan me jhanda fehraya.
Subhas Chandra Bose aur Azad Hind Fauj ke baare me batao.

Subhas Chandra Bose ne angrezon se ladne ke liye videsh me Azad Hind Fauj (INA) ka gathan kiya. Unke prasiddh naare the - 'Delhi Chalo', 'Jai Hind' aur 'Tum mujhe khoon do, main tumhe azadi dunga.' INA ne Bharat ki purvi seema tak pahunchkar ladai ladi. Yuddh ke baad INA adhikariyon par chale Lal Qila mukadme ne pure desh me angrezon ke khilaf mahol bana diya.
INA mukadma (Lal Qila trial) kya tha?

1945 me angrezon ne Azad Hind Fauj ke teen adhikariyon - Shah Nawaz Khan, Prem Sahgal aur Gurbaksh Dhillon - par Delhi ke Lal Qile me deshdroh ka mukadma chalaya. Ek Hindu, ek Muslim aur ek Sikh adhikari ke is mukadme ne pure desh ko ek kar diya. Janata ke dabav me angrezon ko unhe riha karna pada.
Bharat ko swatantrata kab mili aur pehle Pradhan Mantri kaun bane?

Bharat 15 August 1947 ko swatantra hua. Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru desh ke pehle Pradhan Mantri bane. 14-15 August ki madhyaratri ko unhone sansad me prasiddh 'Tryst with Destiny' (niyati se vaada) bhashan diya tha. Lord Mountbatten swatantra Bharat ke pehle Governor-General bane.
1947 ke vibhajan me kya hua tha?

Swatantrata ke saath desh do hisso me bant gaya - Bharat aur Pakistan (Pakistan 14 August 1947 ko bana). Muhammad Ali Jinnah Pakistan ke pehle Governor-General bane. Vibhajan ke dauran ek crore se zyada logon ko apna ghar chhodna pada aur bhayankar hinsa hui - ye duniya ke sabse bade visthapanon me se ek tha.
Sardar Patel ko 'Lauh Purush' kyun kehte hain?

Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel swatantra Bharat ke pehle Griha Mantri aur Up-Pradhan Mantri the. Unhone 500 se zyada desi riyaston ko samjha-bujhakar aur dridhta se Bharat me milaya - isi loh-dridh sankalp ke kaaran unhe 'Lauh Purush' (Iron Man) kaha jata hai. Junagadh aur Hyderabad ka vilay unki sabse badi safaltayein thi.
Kashmir aur Hyderabad ka Bharat me vilay kaise hua?

October 1947 me Kashmir ke Maharaja Hari Singh ne Bharat me vilay ke dastavej (Instrument of Accession) par hastakshar kiye. Hyderabad ke Nizam Bharat me milne ko taiyar nahi the, isliye September 1948 me 'Police Action' (Operation Polo) ke dwara Hyderabad ka vilay hua. Dono kaam Sardar Patel ke netritva me grih mantralaya ne sambhala.
Samvidhan Sabha ki pehli baithak kab hui?

Samvidhan Sabha ki pehli baithak 9 December 1946 ko Delhi me hui. Dr. Rajendra Prasad iske sthaayi adhyaksh chune gaye. Vibhajan ke baad iske sadasyon ki sankhya 299 reh gayi, jinme 15 mahila sadasya bhi thi - jaise Sarojini Naidu, Hansa Mehta aur Durgabai Deshmukh.
Samvidhan ki Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh kaun the?

Drafting Committee (praroop samiti) ke adhyaksh Dr. B.R. Ambedkar the. Unhi ke netritva me samvidhan ka masvida taiyar hua, isliye unhe 'Samvidhan ke shilpkar' aur 'Samvidhan ke pita' kaha jata hai. Samvidhan Sabha ke samvaidhanik salahkar B.N. Rau the, jinhone kai deshon ke samvidhanon ka adhyayan karke prarambhik masvida banaya tha.
Bharat ka samvidhan kab apnaya gaya aur kab lagu hua?

Samvidhan 26 November 1949 ko apnaya gaya - is din ko ab Samvidhan Diwas manate hain. Ye poori tarah se 26 January 1950 ko lagu hua, jiske saath Bharat ek ganatantra (Republic) bana aur Dr. Rajendra Prasad pehle Rashtrapati bane. Samvidhan banne me kul 2 saal, 11 mahine aur 18 din lage.
26 January hi kyun chuni gayi samvidhan lagu karne ke liye?

1930 me Congress ne 26 January ko pehla Swatantrata Diwas (Purna Swaraj Diwas) manaya tha. Usi aitihasik din ke samman me samvidhan ko 26 January 1950 ko lagu kiya gaya. Tab se har saal 26 January ko Gantantra Diwas manaya jata hai aur Delhi me bhavya parade hoti hai.
Bharat ke samvidhan ki khaas baatein batao.

Bharat ka samvidhan duniya ka sabse bada (sabse lamba) likhit samvidhan hai. Mool roop me isme 395 anuchhed (articles), 22 bhaag aur 8 anusuchiyan thi. Isme kai deshon ke samvidhanon ki achhi baatein li gayi hain - jaise America se maulik adhikar, Britain se sansadiya paddhati aur Ireland se niti-nirdeshak tatva.
Mool samvidhan ki prati ki khaas baat kya thi?

Bharat ke mool samvidhan ki prati chhapi hui nahi thi - ye haath se sundar aksharon me likhi gayi thi. Ise prasiddh sulekhak (calligrapher) Prem Behari Narain Raizada ne likha tha, aur iske prishthon ko Nandalal Bose aur Shantiniketan ke kalakaron ne Bharatiya kala se sajaya tha. Ye prati aaj bhi sansad ke granthalaya me surakshit hai.
Samvidhan ki Prastavna (Preamble) kya kehti hai?

Prastavna 'Hum, Bharat ke log' (We, the People of India) se shuru hoti hai. Isme Bharat ko samprabhu, samajvadi, dharmnirpeksh aur loktantrik ganatantra banane ka sankalp hai aur sab nagrikon ko nyay, swatantrata, samanta aur bandhuta dilane ki baat hai. 'Samajvadi' aur 'dharmnirpeksh' shabd 1976 me 42ve sanshodhan se jude the. Iski neev Nehru ke 'Uddeshya Prastav' (1946) me thi.
Maulik adhikaron me badlav ki khaas baat batao.

Mool samvidhan me 7 maulik adhikar the. 1978 me 44ve sanshodhan dwara 'sampatti ke adhikar' ko maulik adhikaron se hata kar keval kanooni adhikar bana diya gaya, isliye ab 6 maulik adhikar hain - samanta, swatantrata, shoshan ke viruddh, dharm, sanskriti-shiksha aur samvaidhanik upchar ka adhikar. Dr. Ambedkar ne samvaidhanik upchar (Article 32) ko samvidhan ka 'hriday aur aatma' kaha tha.
Bharat me matdaan ki umar 18 saal kab hui?

Pehle matdaan ki umar 21 saal thi. 1989 me 61ve samvidhan sanshodhan dwara ise ghata kar 18 saal kar diya gaya, taaki yuvaon ko bhi desh ke faislon me hissa mile. Bharat me har nagrik ko bina bhedbhav ke ek vote ka adhikar hai - ye duniya ke sabse bade loktantra ki pehchan hai.
Cricket me 100 antarrashtriya shatak lagane wala ekmatra khiladi kaun hai?

Sachin Tendulkar duniya ke ekmatra khiladi hain jinhone 100 antarrashtriya shatak (Test me 51 aur ODI me 49) lagaye hain. Unhe 'Cricket ka Bhagwan' kaha jata hai. 2014 me unhe Bharat Ratna mila - ye samman pane wale ve pehle khiladi aur sabse kam umar ke vyakti the.
Sachin Tendulkar ke runo ke record batao.

Sachin ke naam Test me 15,921 run aur ODI me 18,426 run hain - dono hi vishwa record hain. Ve 200 Test khelne wale duniya ke ekmatra khiladi hain. ODI me 200 run (double century) banane wale ve duniya ke pehle khiladi the - 2010 me Gwalior me Dakshin Africa ke khilaf.
ODI cricket me sabse bada vyaktigat score kisne banaya hai?

Rohit Sharma ne 2014 me Kolkata ke Eden Gardens me Sri Lanka ke khilaf 264 run banaye the - ye ODI itihaas ka sabse bada vyaktigat score hai. Rohit ke naam ODI me teen double century hain, jo duniya me kisi aur ke paas nahi. Isiliye unhe 'Hitman' kaha jata hai.
Virat Kohli ne 2023 World Cup me kaun sa record toda tha?

2023 World Cup ke semifinal me Virat Kohli ne apna 50va ODI shatak lagakar Sachin Tendulkar ke 49 shatakon ka vishwa record tod diya. Kohli ODI shatakon me ab duniya me sabse aage hain. Usi World Cup me unhone sabse zyada run bhi banaye the.
Test cricket me sabse zyada wicket kisne liye hain?

Sri Lanka ke Muttiah Muralitharan ke naam Test me 800 wicket hain - duniya me sabse zyada. Dusre sthan par Australia ke Shane Warne (708) hain. Bharat ke Anil Kumble 619 wicket ke saath teesre bade Bharatiya naam hain aur ve Test me sabse zyada wicket lene wale Bharatiya hain.
Test cricket ki sabse badi paari kisne kheli hai?

West Indies ke Brian Lara ne 2004 me England ke khilaf 400 not out ki paari kheli thi - ye Test cricket ki sabse badi vyaktigat paari hai. Lara ke naam first-class cricket me 501 not out ka record bhi hai. Ve 'Prince of Trinidad' kahlaye.
Don Bradman ka batting average kyun duniya bhar me prasiddh hai?

Australia ke Sir Don Bradman ka Test batting average 99.94 hai - unhe shatakiya average (100) ke liye aakhiri paari me keval 4 run chahiye the, lekin ve 0 par out ho gaye. Unka ye average aaj tak duniya me sabse uncha hai aur koi khiladi iske paas bhi nahi pahuncha. Unhe cricket itihaas ka sabse mahaan batsman mana jata hai.
Bharat ne apna pehla Cricket World Cup kab jeeta tha?

Bharat ne pehla World Cup 25 June 1983 ko Kapil Dev ki kaptani me jeeta tha. Lord's ke final me Bharat ne keval 183 run banaye the, lekin do baar ki champion West Indies ko 140 par rok kar itihaas rach diya. Isi tournament me Zimbabwe ke khilaf Kapil Dev ne 175 not out ki prasiddh paari kheli thi, jab team 17 run par 5 wicket kho chuki thi.
2011 World Cup final ki khaas baat kya thi?

2011 ka final Mumbai ke Wankhede Stadium me hua, jahan Bharat ne Sri Lanka ko haraya. Captain MS Dhoni ne 91 not out ki paari kheli aur jeet ke liye lagaya gaya unka chhakka Bharatiya cricket ki sabse yaadgar tasveeron me se hai. Bharat 28 saal baad World Cup jeeta aur gharelu zameen par jeetne wala pehla desh bana.
MS Dhoni ki sabse badi upalabdhi kya hai?

MS Dhoni duniya ke ekmatra captain hain jinhone teeno badi ICC trophiyan jeeti hain - 2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 ODI World Cup aur 2013 Champions Trophy. Ve apne shaant swabhav ke kaaran 'Captain Cool' kahlaye. Ranchi se aakar ve duniya ke sabse safal captainon me gine jate hain.
Bharat ne T20 World Cup kab-kab jeeta hai?

Bharat ne pehla T20 World Cup 2007 me jeeta tha - final me Pakistan ko romanchak mukable me haraya, aur Joginder Sharma ke aakhiri over ki katha prasiddh hai. Dusra T20 World Cup Bharat ne 2024 me Barbados me jeeta, jahan final me Dakshin Africa ko 7 run se haraya - ye 17 saal ka intezaar khatm hua. 2024 me Rohit Sharma captain the.
Yuvraj Singh ke 6 chhakko ki katha batao.

2007 ke pehle T20 World Cup me Yuvraj Singh ne England ke Stuart Broad ke ek over me lagatar 6 chhakke lagaye the - T20 antarrashtriya cricket me ye pehli baar hua. Usi tournament me unhone 12 gendon me 50 run ka record bhi banaya tha. 2011 World Cup me ve 'Player of the Tournament' bane, aur baad me cancer ko hara kar maidan par laute - ye unki sabse badi jeet mani jati hai.
Test ki ek paari me 10 wicket lene wale Bharatiya kaun hain?

Anil Kumble ne 1999 me Delhi ke Feroz Shah Kotla maidan par Pakistan ke khilaf ek paari me saare 10 wicket liye the. Duniya me ye karnama unse pehle keval England ke Jim Laker (1956) ne kiya tha. Isiliye Kumble ko 'Jumbo' kaha jata hai aur ye din Bharatiya cricket me amar hai.
Sunil Gavaskar ka kaun sa record prasiddh hai?

Sunil Gavaskar Test cricket me 10,000 run pure karne wale duniya ke pehle khiladi the. Unhone 34 Test shatak lagaye, jo us samay ka vishwa record tha. Bina helmet ke tez gendbaazon ko khelne ke liye ve 'Little Master' kahlaye.
Virender Sehwag ko 'Multan ka Sultan' kyun kehte hain?

2004 me Multan (Pakistan) me Sehwag ne 309 run banaye - ve Test me triple century lagane wale pehle Bharatiya bane. Unhone chhakka lagakar apna triple century pura kiya tha. Baad me unhone ek aur triple century (319) lagayi - do triple century lagane wale ve ekmatra Bharatiya hain.
Rahul Dravid ko 'The Wall' kyun kaha jata hai?

Rahul Dravid apni mazboot raksha (defence) aur lambe samay tak crease par tike rehne ke liye 'The Wall' kahlaye. Unhone Test me 13,000 se zyada run banaye aur slip me sabse zyada catch lene ka record bhi unke naam raha. Ve Bharat ke sabse bharosemand batsmanon me gine jate hain aur baad me team ke coach bhi bane.
Bharat ka pehla Test match kab hua tha?

Bharat ne apna pehla Test match 1932 me England ke Lord's maidan par khela tha. Us team ke captain C.K. Nayudu the, jinhe Bharatiya cricket ka agradoot mana jata hai. Usse pehle 1928 me BCCI (Bharatiya Cricket Board) ki sthapna ho chuki thi.
Ranji Trophy kya hai?

Ranji Trophy Bharat ki sabse badi gharelu first-class cricket pratiyogita hai, jo 1934 se kheli ja rahi hai. Ye Nawanagar ke prasiddh khiladi Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji ke naam par hai, jo England ke liye khele the. Mumbai ne ye trophy sabse zyada baar jeeti hai.
IPL kab shuru hua aur pehli vijeta kaun thi?

Indian Premier League (IPL) 2008 me shuru hua aur duniya ki sabse badi T20 league ban gaya. Pehle IPL ki vijeta Rajasthan Royals thi, Shane Warne ki kaptani me. Mumbai Indians aur Chennai Super Kings ne 5-5 baar khitab jeeta hai - sabse zyada. 2025 me Royal Challengers Bengaluru ne pehli baar IPL jeeta.
WPL (Women's Premier League) kab shuru hui?
Mahilaon ki WPL 2023 me shuru hui. Pehli vijeta Mumbai Indians bani, Harmanpreet Kaur ki kaptani me. Is league ne Bharat me mahila cricket ko nayi pehchan aur yuva khiladiyon ko bada manch diya.
Bharat ki mahila cricket team ne World Cup kab jeeta?

2025 me Bharat ki mahila team ne pehli baar ODI World Cup jeeta - final me Dakshin Africa ko haraya. Harmanpreet Kaur ki kaptani me mili ye jeet Bharatiya mahila cricket ke itihaas ka sabse bada pal hai. Isse pehle team 2005 aur 2017 me final tak pahunchi thi.
Mithali Raj kaun hain?

Mithali Raj Bharat ki sabse mahaan mahila cricketer mani jati hain. Ve mahila ODI cricket me duniya me sabse zyada run banane wali khiladi hain (7,800 se zyada). Unhone lagbhag 23 saal tak Bharat ke liye khela aur do World Cup final me team ki kaptani ki.
Jhulan Goswami ka record kya hai?
Jhulan Goswami ke naam mahila ODI cricket me duniya me sabse zyada wicket (255) hain. Ve apni unchai aur tez gendbaazi ke liye 'Chakda Express' kahlayi. Unka career 20 saalon se zyada lamba raha.
Harmanpreet Kaur ki 171 wali paari kahan prasiddh hai?

2017 ke Mahila World Cup semifinal me Harmanpreet Kaur ne Australia ke khilaf 171 not out (keval 115 gendon me) ki toofani paari kheli thi. Is paari ki badaulat Bharat final me pahuncha. Ise mahila cricket ki sabse mahaan paariyon me gina jata hai.
Duniya ka pehla Cricket World Cup kab hua tha?

Pehla Cricket World Cup 1975 me England me hua tha aur West Indies ne jeeta tha (final me Australia ko haraya). Us samay match 60-60 over ke hote the aur khiladi safed kapdo me khelte the. Pehla ek-divasiya (ODI) match bhi 1971 me Australia aur England ke beech hua tha.
Test cricket kab shuru hua tha?

Duniya ka pehla aadhikarik Test match 1877 me Australia aur England ke beech Melbourne me khela gaya tha. England aur Australia ke beech ki prasiddh shrinkhala ko 'The Ashes' kehte hain, jo 1882 se chali aa rahi hai aur cricket ki sabse purani takkar hai.
Hockey me Bharat ke kitne Olympic swarna padak hain?

Bharat ke paas hockey me kul 8 Olympic swarna padak hain - 1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964 aur 1980 me. Ye kisi bhi desh ke liye lambe samay tak record raha. Isi daur ko Bharatiya hockey ka sunhara yug kehte hain.
Major Dhyan Chand ko 'Hockey ka Jadugar' kyun kehte hain?

Dhyan Chand ki stick se gend is tarah chipki rehti thi ki darshak aur virodhi hairan reh jate the - isiliye unhe 'Hockey ka Jadugar' kaha gaya. Unhone 1928, 1932 aur 1936 ke Olympics me Bharat ko swarna dilaya. Unka janmdin 29 August har saal Rashtriya Khel Diwas ke roop me manaya jata hai.
1928 ke Olympic hockey ki khaas baat kya thi?

1928 ke Amsterdam Olympics me Bharat ne pehli baar hockey me hissa liya aur swarna padak jeeta. Khaas baat ye ki poore tournament me Bharat ke khilaf ek bhi goal nahi hua. Final me Bharat ne Netherlands ko 3-0 se haraya tha.
Balbir Singh Sr. ka kaun sa record hai?

Balbir Singh Sr. ne 1952 ke Helsinki Olympic hockey final me Netherlands ke khilaf 5 goal kiye the - Olympic hockey final me kisi ek khiladi ke sabse zyada goal ka ye record aaj bhi kayam hai. Ve 1948, 1952 aur 1956 ke swarna vijeta teamon ke sadasya the.
Bharat ne Hockey World Cup kab jeeta tha?

Bharat ne apna ekmatra Hockey World Cup 1975 me Malaysia ke Kuala Lumpur me jeeta tha. Final me Bharat ne Pakistan ko 2-1 se haraya tha aur Ashok Kumar ne jeet wala goal kiya tha. Us team ke captain Ajit Pal Singh the.
Tokyo Olympics 2020 me Bharatiya hockey ke liye kya khaas raha?

Tokyo 2020 me Bharat ki purush hockey team ne kansya (bronze) padak jeeta - ye 41 saalon ke baad hockey me Bharat ka pehla Olympic padak tha. Mahila team bhi pehli baar semifinal tak pahunchi aur chauthe sthan par rahi. Paris 2024 me purush team ne dobara kansya padak jeeta.
Olympics me Bharat ka sabse pehla padak kisne jeeta tha?

Norman Pritchard ne 1900 ke Paris Olympics me athletics me do rajat (silver) padak jeete the - ye Olympics me Bharat ke sabse pehle padak mane jate hain. Us samay Bharat British shasan ke adheen tha. Swatantrata ke baad pehla vyaktigat padak 1952 me pehelwan K.D. Jadhav ne jeeta.
K.D. Jadhav kaun the?

K.D. Jadhav ne 1952 ke Helsinki Olympics me kushti (wrestling) me kansya padak jeeta tha. Ye swatantra Bharat ka pehla vyaktigat Olympic padak tha. Ve Maharashtra ke ek chhote se gaon se aaye the aur unki safalta ne kai pehelwanon ko prerna di.
Olympic padak jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila kaun thi?

Karnam Malleswari ne 2000 ke Sydney Olympics me bharottolan (weightlifting) me kansya padak jeeta tha. Ve Olympic padak jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila bani. Andhra Pradesh ki Malleswari ko isse pehle 'iron girl' kaha jata tha.
Abhinav Bindra ki upalabdhi kya hai?

Abhinav Bindra ne 2008 ke Beijing Olympics me 10 meter air rifle shooting me swarna padak jeeta. Ve vyaktigat spardha me Olympic swarna jeetne wale pehle Bharatiya bane. Unki kitab 'A Shot at History' bhi prasiddh hai.
Sushil Kumar ke Olympic padak batao.

Pehelwan Sushil Kumar ne 2008 Beijing me kansya aur 2012 London me rajat padak jeeta. Ve do Olympic padak jeetne wale pehle Bharatiya purush khiladi (swatantrata ke baad) bane. Unki safalta se Bharat me kushti ko nayi pehchan mili.
M.C. Mary Kom kaun hain?

Mary Kom Manipur ki prasiddh mahila mukkebaaz (boxer) hain, jinhe 'Magnificent Mary' kaha jata hai. Ve 6 baar mahila vishwa boxing champion bani hain - duniya me ekmatra mahila boxer jinhone ye karnama kiya. 2012 ke London Olympics me unhone kansya padak jeeta tha.
P.V. Sindhu ke Olympic record kya hain?

P.V. Sindhu ne 2016 Rio me rajat aur 2020 Tokyo me kansya padak jeeta. Ve do Olympic padak jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila khiladi hain. 2019 me ve badminton ki vishwa champion bhi bani - ye khitab jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya hain.
Neeraj Chopra ki safalta batao.

Neeraj Chopra ne Tokyo 2020 Olympics me bhala phenk (javelin throw) me 87.58 meter ke saath swarna padak jeeta - athletics me Bharat ka pehla Olympic swarna. Paris 2024 me unhone rajat padak jeeta. Haryana ke Neeraj ko Bharatiya athletics ka sabse bada sitara mana jata hai.
Mirabai Chanu kaun hain?

Mirabai Chanu Manipur ki bharottolak (weightlifter) hain. Unhone Tokyo 2020 Olympics me 49 kg varg me rajat padak jeeta - ye us Olympics me Bharat ka pehla padak tha. Ve Commonwealth Games me bhi swarna jeet chuki hain.
Manu Bhaker ne Paris 2024 me kya itihaas racha?

Shooter Manu Bhaker ne Paris 2024 Olympics me do kansya padak jeete - ek hi Olympics me do padak jeetne wali ve swatantrata ke baad ki pehli Bharatiya khiladi bani. Unke padakon se Bharat ki shuruaat us Olympics me mazboot hui. Paris 2024 me Bharat ne kul 6 padak (1 rajat, 5 kansya) jeete.
Milkha Singh ko 'Flying Sikh' kyun kehte hain?

Milkha Singh Bharat ke sabse prasiddh daudak (sprinter) the. 1960 ke Rome Olympics me ve 400 meter me chauthe sthan par rahe - padak se keval kuch pal ke antar se chooke. Pakistan me ek daud jeetne par unhe 'The Flying Sikh' ki upadhi mili thi. Unke jeevan par film 'Bhaag Milkha Bhaag' bani hai.
P.T. Usha kaun hain?

P.T. Usha ko 'Payyoli Express' kaha jata hai. 1984 ke Los Angeles Olympics me ve 400 meter badha daud (hurdles) me keval 1/100 second (0.01 second) se kansya padak se chook gayi - ye Bharatiya athletics ki sabse prasiddh 'karibi haar' hai. Baad me ve yuva khiladiyon ko prashikshan dene lagi.
Saina Nehwal ki upalabdhiyan kya hain?

Saina Nehwal ne 2012 ke London Olympics me badminton me kansya padak jeeta - Bharat ke liye badminton ka ye pehla Olympic padak tha. 2015 me ve vishwa number 1 ranking pane wali pehli Bharatiya mahila badminton khiladi bani. Prakash Padukone 1980 me All England Championship jeetne wale pehle Bharatiya the.
Bharat ne Thomas Cup kab jeeta tha?

2022 me Bharat ki purush badminton team ne pehli baar Thomas Cup jeeta - final me 14 baar ke champion Indonesia ko 3-0 se haraya. Thomas Cup ko badminton ki vishwa team championship mana jata hai. Ye jeet Bharatiya badminton ke itihaas ki sabse badi jeeton me se hai.
Leander Paes ka Olympic record kya hai?

Tennis khiladi Leander Paes ne 1996 ke Atlanta Olympics me ekal (singles) me kansya padak jeeta tha - tennis me Bharat ka ye ekmatra Olympic padak hai. Ve lagatar 7 Olympics me khelen aur doubles-mixed doubles milakar 18 Grand Slam khitab jeet chuke hain.
Dipa Karmakar kaun hain?

Dipa Karmakar Tripura ki gymnast hain. Ve Olympics me hissa lene wali pehli Bharatiya mahila gymnast bani (Rio 2016) aur wahan chauthe sthan par rahi. Ve khatarnak 'Produnova vault' safaltapurvak karne wali duniya ki gini-chuni gymnasts me se hain.
Avani Lekhara kaun hain?

Avani Lekhara Rajasthan ki para-shooter hain. Unhone Tokyo 2020 Paralympics me swarna padak jeetkar itihaas racha aur Paris 2024 me dobara swarna jeeta. Ve Paralympics me do swarna jeetne wali pramukh Bharatiya khiladiyon me hain. Murlikant Petkar Bharat ke pehle Paralympic swarna vijeta the (1972, tairna/swimming me).
Pehla Football World Cup kab hua aur kisne jeeta?

Pehla FIFA Football World Cup 1930 me Uruguay me hua aur mejbaan Uruguay ne hi jeeta (final me Argentina ko haraya). Tab keval 13 teamon ne hissa liya tha, kyunki samudri yatra lambi hoti thi. Aaj World Cup duniya ka sabse bada khel aayojan hai.
Sabse zyada Football World Cup kis desh ne jeete hain?

Brazil ne sabse zyada 5 baar Football World Cup jeeta hai - 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994 aur 2002 me. Brazil ekmatra desh hai jo har World Cup me khela hai. Uske baad Germany aur Italy ke paas 4-4 khitab hain.
Pele kaun the aur unka record kya hai?

Pele Brazil ke mahaan footballer the, jinhe 'Football ka Raja' kaha jata hai. Ve duniya ke ekmatra khiladi hain jinhone 3 World Cup (1958, 1962, 1970) jeete hain. 1958 me ve keval 17 saal ki umar me World Cup khele aur final me do goal kiye the.
2022 Football World Cup kahan hua aur kisne jeeta?

2022 ka World Cup Qatar me hua - ye Madhya Poorv me aayojit pehla World Cup tha aur sardiyon me khela gaya. Final me Argentina ne France ko penalty shootout me haraya aur Lionel Messi ne apna pehla World Cup jeeta. Is final ko itihaas ke sabse romanchak finalon me gina jata hai.
Bharatiya football ka sabse bada purana pal kaun sa hai?

1956 ke Melbourne Olympics me Bharatiya football team semifinal tak pahunchi aur chauthe sthan par rahi - ye Bharatiya football ki sabse badi upalabdhi mani jati hai. Usse pehle 1950 me Bharat World Cup ke liye qualify bhi hua tha, lekin team tournament me khelne nahi gayi. Us daur ko Bharatiya football ka sunhara kaal kehte hain.
Sunil Chhetri kaun hain?

Sunil Chhetri Bharatiya football team ke sabse prasiddh khiladi aur lambe samay tak captain rahe. Unhone Bharat ke liye 90 se zyada antarrashtriya goal kiye hain - duniya ke sabse zyada international goal karne wale sakriya khiladiyon me unka naam upar raha hai. Ve Bengaluru FC ke liye club football khelte hain.
Mohun Bagan ki 1911 wali jeet kyun itihaas me darj hai?

1911 me Kolkata ke Mohun Bagan club ne IFA Shield ke final me angrezon ki East Yorkshire Regiment team ko 2-1 se haraya. Khaas baat ye thi ki Bharatiya khiladi nange paon (bina juto ke) khele the. Swatantrata se pehle ki ye jeet pure desh ke liye garv aur prerna ka prateek ban gayi.
Durand Cup ki khaas baat kya hai?

Durand Cup 1888 me shuru hua tha aur ye Asia ka sabse purana football tournament hai (duniya ke sabse purane tournamenton me teesra). Iski shuruaat Shimla me hui thi aur iska naam us samay ke videsh sachiv Sir Mortimer Durand par rakha gaya. Aaj bhi ye Bharat ki sena ke dwara aayojit hota hai.
Kabaddi World Cup me Bharat ka record kaisa hai?

Purush Kabaddi World Cup ab tak teen baar hua hai (2004, 2007, 2016) aur teeno baar Bharat hi vijeta bana hai. Kabaddi ki jadon ko prachin Bharat se joda jata hai aur ye Bangladesh ka rashtriya khel hai. Bharat me ye gaon-gaon me khela jane wala sabse lokpriya paramparik khelon me se hai.
Pro Kabaddi League kab shuru hui?

Pro Kabaddi League 2014 me shuru hui. Isne kabaddi ko TV aur shaharo tak pahunchakar dobara lokpriya bana diya - pehle season ke baad ye Bharat ki dusri sabse zyada dekhi jane wali sports league ban gayi thi. Isse kabaddi khiladiyon ko naam aur rozgar dono mile.
Asian Games me kabaddi me Bharat ka pradarshan kaisa raha hai?

Asian Games me kabaddi 1990 me shamil hua aur Bharat ne isme sabse zyada swarna padak jeete hain. Purush team ne 1990 se 2014 tak lagatar saato baar swarna jeeta tha. 2022 ke Asian Games (2023 me hue) me bhi Bharat ki purush aur mahila dono teamon ne swarna jeeta.
Kabaddi khel ka mool tareeka kya hota hai?

Kabaddi me ek 'raider' saans roke hue 'kabaddi-kabaddi' bolte hue virodhi hisse me jata hai, wahan ke khiladiyon ko chhookar surakshit wapas aana hota hai. Virodhi team use pakadkar rokne ki koshish karti hai. Is khel me taakat, furti aur saans ka niyantran - teeno ki pariksha hoti hai.
Viswanathan Anand kaun hain?

Viswanathan Anand Bharat ke sabse mahaan shatranj (chess) khiladi hain. Ve 5 baar vishwa chess champion bane aur duniya ke sabse tez khiladiyon me gine jane ke kaaran 'Lightning Kid' kahlaye. Chennai ke Anand ko 1991-92 me pehla Khel Ratna (us samay Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna) mila tha.
Bharat ke pehle Chess Grandmaster kaun the?

Viswanathan Anand 1988 me Bharat ke pehle Grandmaster bane. Grandmaster shatranj ki sabse unchi upadhi hoti hai, jo FIDE (vishwa shatranj sangh) deta hai. Anand ke baad Bharat me shatranj tezi se badha aur aaj Bharat ke paas 80 se zyada Grandmaster hain.
D. Gukesh ne kya itihaas racha?

D. Gukesh ne 2024 me keval 18 saal ki umar me vishwa chess championship jeeti - ve itihaas ke sabse kam umar ke vishwa chess champion bane. Unhone Singapore me hue final me China ke Ding Liren ko haraya. Chennai ke Gukesh Bharatiya shatranj ki nayi peedhi ke sabse bade sitare hain.
R. Praggnanandhaa kaun hain?

R. Praggnanandhaa Bharat ke yuva shatranj Grandmaster hain. 2023 ke Chess World Cup me ve final tak pahunche - Vishwanathan Anand ke baad ye karnama karne wale ve dusre Bharatiya bane (final me unhe Magnus Carlsen se haar mili). Bachpan me hi ve duniya ke sabse kam umar ke International Master ban gaye the.
Shatranj (chess) ki shuruaat kahan se mani jati hai?

Shatranj ki jad prachin Bharat ke khel 'chaturanga' se mani jati hai, jo lagbhag 1,500 saal pehle Bharat me khela jata tha. 'Chaturanga' matlab sena ke chaar ang - paidal, ghoda, haathi aur rath, jo aaj ke pyaade, ghode, unth/rook jaise mohron me badle. Ye khel Persia hote hue Europe gaya aur 'chess' bana.
Koneru Humpy kaun hain?

Koneru Humpy Andhra Pradesh ki prasiddh mahila shatranj khiladi hain. Ve Bharat ki sabse majboot mahila Grandmasteron me se hain aur mahilaon ki rapid vishwa chess championship jeet chuki hain. Unhone bahut kam umar me Grandmaster ka norm pura karke naam kamaya tha.
Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore kaun hain?

Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore ne 2004 ke Athens Olympics me double trap shooting me rajat padak jeeta tha - ye shooting me Bharat ka pehla Olympic padak tha. Ve sena ke adhikari the aur baad me rajneeti me aakar khel mantri bhi bane.
Anju Bobby George ki upalabdhi kya hai?

Anju Bobby George ne 2003 ki Vishwa Athletics Championship (Paris) me lambi kood (long jump) me kansya padak jeeta - ve vishwa championship me padak jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya athlete bani. Unke pati Bobby George unke coach bhi the.
Hima Das ko 'Dhing Express' kyun kehte hain?

Hima Das Assam ke Dhing kasbe se hain, isliye unhe 'Dhing Express' kaha jata hai. 2018 me unhone World Under-20 Championship me 400 meter me swarna jeeta - kisi vishwa track spardha me swarna jeetne wali ve pehli Bharatiya mahila bani.
Vijender Singh kaun hain?

Vijender Singh Haryana ke prasiddh mukkebaaz (boxer) hain. Unhone 2008 ke Beijing Olympics me kansya padak jeeta - ve Olympic padak jeetne wale pehle Bharatiya boxer bane. Baad me ve peshewar (professional) boxing me bhi utare.
Sakshi Malik ka Olympic record kya hai?

Sakshi Malik ne Rio 2016 Olympics me kushti me kansya padak jeeta - ve Olympic padak jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila pehelwan bani. Unki jeet ke baad Haryana aur pure desh me ladkiyon ke kushti seekhne ka rujhan bahut badha.
Tokyo 2020 me Bharat ke kushti padak kaun se the?

Tokyo 2020 me Ravi Kumar Dahiya ne kushti me rajat aur Bajrang Punia ne kansya padak jeeta. Isi Olympics me Lovlina Borgohain ne mukkebaazi me kansya jeeta tha. Bharat ne Tokyo me kul 7 padak jeete, jo us samay tak ka uska sarvashreshth Olympic pradarshan tha.
Pehle Asian Games kahan hue the?

Pehle Asian Games 1951 me Bharat ki rajdhani New Delhi me hue the. Bharat iske sansthapak deshon me se hai. Asian Games har chaar saal par hote hain aur inhe 'Asiad' bhi kehte hain. 1982 me bhi Delhi ne Asian Games ki mejbani ki thi, jiske liye bade stadium bane.
Commonwealth Games 2010 kahan hue the?

2010 ke Commonwealth Games New Delhi me hue the - ye Bharat me aayojit sabse bade antarrashtriya khel aayojano me se ek tha. Bharat ne usme 101 padak jeetkar dusra sthan paya tha, jo uska sarvashreshth pradarshan raha. Isi daur me Delhi ka Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium dobara banaya gaya tha.
Bijli ke bulb ka aavishkar kisne kiya tha?

Vyavharik bijli ke bulb ka shrey Thomas Edison ko jata hai, jinhone 1879 me aisa bulb banaya jo ghanton tak jal sakta tha. England ke Joseph Swan ne bhi usi daur me bulb par kaam kiya tha. Edison ne keval bulb nahi, bijli baantne ki poori vyavastha (generator, taar, switch) bhi banayi - isliye unka naam sabse aage hai.
Telephone ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Telephone ka patent 1876 me Alexander Graham Bell ko mila, isliye aavishkar ka shrey unhe jata hai. Kehte hain ki usi din Elisha Gray ne bhi aisi hi yojana ke kagaz jama kiye the. Bell ki pehli prasiddh baat thi apne sahayak ko kehna - 'Mr. Watson, yahan aao, mujhe tumhari zaroorat hai.'
Radio ka aavishkar kisne kiya tha?

Radio ka shrey aam taur par Guglielmo Marconi ko jata hai, jinhone 1890s me bina taar ke sanket (wireless telegraph) bhejna safal kiya aur 1901 me Atlantic mahasagar ke paar sanket bheja. Bharat ke Jagadish Chandra Bose ne bhi usi samay radio tarangon par mahatvapurna prayog kiye the aur ve is kshetra ke agradoot mane jate hain.
Television ka aavishkar kaise hua?

Television kai vaigyanikon ke kaam se bana. Scotland ke John Logie Baird ne 1926 me pehla mechanical TV pradarshan diya, aur America ke Philo Farnsworth ne 1927 me electronic TV ka safal pradarshan kiya. Aaj ke TV ki neev Farnsworth ke electronic tareeke par hi hai.
Mobile phone ki pehli call kisne ki thi?

Duniya ki pehli mobile phone call 3 April 1973 ko Motorola ke engineer Martin Cooper ne ki thi. Unhone apni pratidwandi company ke vyakti ko phone karke bataya ki ve ek haath me pakde jane wale phone se baat kar rahe hain. Pehla vyavsayik mobile (DynaTAC) lagbhag 1 kilo wazan ka tha aur 1983 me bazaar me aaya.
Hawai jahaz ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Hawai jahaz ka shrey America ke Wright bandhuon - Orville aur Wilbur Wright - ko jata hai. 17 December 1903 ko unhone Kitty Hawk me pehli safal engine-chaalit udaan bhari, jo keval 12 second chali. Keval kuch saalon me ye takneek duniya bhar me phail gayi.
Bhaap engine (steam engine) ka vikas kisne kiya?

Bhaap engine ke kai roop pehle se the, lekin James Watt ne 18vi sadi me usme bade sudhar karke use karkhano aur rail ke kaabil banaya. George Stephenson ne safal railway locomotive 'Rocket' banaya. Bhaap engine ne hi Audyaugik Kranti ko gati di.
Duniya ki pehli yatri railway kab chali?

Duniya ki pehli sarvajanik yatri railway 1825 me England me Stockton se Darlington ke beech chali, jisme George Stephenson ka engine istemal hua. Iske baad rail yatra pure Europe aur duniya me tezi se phaili. Bharat me pehli rail iske 28 saal baad, 1853 me chali.
Motor car ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Aadhunik motor car ka shrey Germany ke Karl Benz ko jata hai, jinhone 1885 me petrol engine wali teen-pahiya 'Benz Patent-Motorwagen' banayi - ye pehli asal car mani jati hai. Baad me America ke Henry Ford ne assembly line se car banana sasta kiya aur car aam aadmi tak pahunchi.
Computer ke pita kise kaha jata hai?

Charles Babbage ko 'Computer ke Pita' kaha jata hai. 19vi sadi me unhone 'Analytical Engine' naam ki machine ki yojana banayi thi, jisme aaj ke computer jaise hisse (input, memory, processing) ka vichar tha. Wo machine us samay ban nahi payi, lekin uski soch aaj ke computer ki neev hai. Ada Lovelace ko duniya ki pehli programmer mana jata hai, kyunki unhone usi machine ke liye nirdesh likhe the.
Pehla electronic computer kaun sa tha?

ENIAC (1945) ko pehle bade electronic general-purpose computeron me gina jata hai. Ye America me bana tha, ek bade kamre ke barabar tha aur usme lagbhag 18,000 vacuum tube lage the. Isi daur se computer yug ki shuruaat mani jati hai.
Alan Turing kaun the?

Alan Turing Britain ke ganitagya the, jinhe computer vigyaan ka pita mana jata hai. Dusre vishwa yuddh me unhone Germany ke gupt code (Enigma) ko todne me kendriya bhoomika nibhayi, jisse yuddh jaldi khatm hone me madad mili. 'Turing Test' aaj bhi machine ki buddhi napne ka prasiddh vichar hai.
Internet ki shuruaat kaise hui?

Internet ki neev 1969 me America ke raksha vibhag ke network ARPANET se padi, jo kuch vishwavidyalayon aur sansthanon ko jodta tha. Baad me Vint Cerf aur Bob Kahn ne TCP/IP niyam banaye, jinse alag-alag network aapas me jud sake. Isi liye Vint Cerf ko 'Internet ke Pita' me se ek kaha jata hai.
Internet aur World Wide Web me kya antar hai?

Internet duniya bhar ke computeron ko jodne wala jaal (network) hai, jabki World Wide Web (www) us jaal par chalne wali ek seva hai, jisme web page bane hote hain. Web ka aavishkar Tim Berners-Lee ne 1989 me CERN (Switzerland) me kiya tha. Email aur chat bhi internet ki hi sevayein hain, lekin ve web se alag hain.
Email me '@' ka chinh kisne chuna tha?

Email ki neev rakhne wale Ray Tomlinson ne 1971 me pehla network email bheja. Unhone hi user ke naam aur computer ke naam ko alag karne ke liye '@' (at) chinh chuna, kyunki ye chinh naam me aam taur par nahi hota tha. Aaj ye chinh har email pate ki pehchan hai.
Printing press ne duniya kaise badli?

Johannes Gutenberg ki chhapai machine (lagbhag 1440) se pehle kitabein haath se likhi jati thi aur bahut mehngi hoti thi. Machine se kitabein sasti aur badi sankhya me chhapne lagi. Isse shiksha, vigyaan aur naye vichar aam logo tak pahunche - isliye ise itihaas ke sabse bade aavishkaro me gina jata hai.
Penicillin ki khoj kaise hui?

1928 me Alexander Fleming ne dekha ki unki prayogshala ki ek plate me lagi fungus (Penicillium) ke aas-paas ke kitanu mar gaye hain. Isi se duniya ki pehli antibiotic dawa - Penicillin - bani. Is khoj ne lakhon logo ki jaan bachayi aur chikitsa jagat badal diya. Ye khoj ek 'durghatna' se hui, lekin Fleming ne use pehchana - yahi vaigyanik ki pehchan hai.
Sabse pehla teeka (vaccine) kisne banaya tha?

Edward Jenner ne 1796 me chechak (smallpox) ka pehla teeka banaya. Unhone dekha ki cowpox (gaiyon ki halki bimari) hue logo ko chechak nahi hota. Unhi ke kaam se aage chalkar chechak duniya se khatm hone wali pehli bimari bani (1980 me WHO ne iski ghoshna ki).
X-ray ki khoj kisne ki thi?

X-ray ki khoj 1895 me Germany ke Wilhelm Röntgen ne ki thi. Unhone apni patni ke haath ki pehli X-ray tasveer li, jisme haddiyan aur anguthi saaf dikhi. Is khoj ne chikitsa me kranti la di - bina shareer kaate andar dekhna sambhav ho gaya. Iske liye unhe 1901 me pehla bhautiki ka Nobel bhi mila.
Battery ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Pehli bijli ki battery 1800 me Italy ke Alessandro Volta ne banayi thi, jise 'Voltaic Pile' kehte hain. Unhone alag-alag dhatuon aur namak ke paani se lagatar bijli banana dikhaya. Bijli ki ikai 'Volt' unhi ke naam par hai.
Bijli ke generator ki neev kisne rakhi?

Michael Faraday ne 1831 me vidyut-chumbakiya preran (electromagnetic induction) ka siddhant khoja - chumbak aur taar ki gati se bijli banana. Yahi siddhant aaj ke generator aur motor ki neev hai. Faraday garib parivar se the aur khud padh-likh kar duniya ke bade vaigyanik bane.
Benjamin Franklin ka bijli se kya sambandh hai?

Benjamin Franklin ne 1752 me apne prasiddh patang prayog se ye samjhaya ki aakash ki bijli (lightning) aur aam bijli ek hi cheez hai. Unhone bijli se bachaav ke liye 'lightning rod' (tadit-chaalak) ka vichar bhi diya, jo aaj bhi unchi imaraton par lagaya jata hai. Ve America ke sansthapakon me se ek the.
Telegraph aur Morse code kya tha?

Telegraph taar ke dwara bijli ke sanket bhejkar door tak sandesh pahunchane ka pehla sadhan tha. Samuel Morse ne iske liye 'Morse Code' banaya - bindu (dot) aur dash se akshar bane. 1844 me pehli telegraph line par sandesh bheja gaya. Telephone aur internet ki neev yahi se mani jati hai.
Phonograph (gramophone ka purvaj) kisne banaya?

Thomas Edison ne 1877 me phonograph banaya, jo awaaz record karke dobara sunane wali pehli machine thi. Us par pehli recording khud Edison ne 'Mary Had a Little Lamb' gaakar ki thi. Isi se aage chalkar gramophone aur sangeet udyog ki shuruaat hui.
Camera se pehli tasveer kab li gayi?

Duniya ki sabse purani bachi hui tasveer 1826-27 ke aas-paas France ke Joseph Nicéphore Niépce ne li thi - ye unke ghar ki khidki se dikhne wala drishya tha. Us samay tasveer banne me kai ghante lagte the. Baad me Daguerre aur Fox Talbot ne is takneek ko aasan banaya.
Cinema ki shuruaat kisne ki?

France ke Lumière bandhuon (Auguste aur Louis) ne 1895 me pehla sarvajanik film pradarshan Paris me kiya. Unki chhoti filmo me train ka station par aana itna asal laga ki darshak ghabra gaye - aisi katha prasiddh hai. Bharat me iske 18 saal baad, 1913 me, pehli Bharatiya film bani.
Kagaz ka aavishkar kahan hua tha?

Kagaz ka aavishkar China me hua. 105 CE me Cai Lun ne ped ki chhaal, purane kapdo aur jaal se kagaz banane ki vidhi ko sudhara aur lokpriya banaya. Isi liye unhe kagaz ka aavishkarak mana jata hai. Kagaz ke aane se likhna-padna sasta aur aasan ho gaya.
Compass aur barood kahan ke aavishkar hain?

Disha-suchak compass aur barood (gunpowder) dono prachin China ke aavishkar hain. Compass se naviko ko samudra me disha mili aur lambi yatrayein sambhav hui. Barood pehle aatishbaazi me istemal hota tha, baad me ye yuddh me istemal hone laga aur duniya ka itihaas badal gaya.
Shunya (zero) ka aavishkar kahan hua tha?

Shunya ko ek ank ke roop me istemal karne ka shrey Bharat ko jata hai. 7vi sadi me Brahmagupta ne shunya se hisaab ke niyam apni kitab me diye. Bharat ki dashamlav (decimal) paddhati Arab vyapaariyon ke dwara Europe pahunchi, isliye pashchim me in anko ko 'Arabic numerals' kaha gaya, halanki inki jad Bharat me hai.
Telescope ko khagol ke liye pehle kisne istemal kiya?

Durbeen (telescope) ka aavishkar Netherlands se joda jata hai, lekin 1609 me Galileo ne use sudhar kar aakash ki ore ghumaya. Unhone Jupiter ke chaar bade chand, Chand par pahaad aur Shukra ki kalayein dekhi. In khojon ne prithvi-kendrit soch ko badal diya.
Jeevanuon (bacteria) ko pehle kisne dekha tha?

Netherlands ke Antonie van Leeuwenhoek ne 17vi sadi me apne banaye sukshm-darshi (microscope) se paani ki boond me chalte hue chhote jeev dekhe - ye bacteria ki pehli jhalak thi. Unhone laal rakt koshikayein bhi dekhi. Unhe 'sukshm jeev vigyaan ka pita' mana jata hai.
Stethoscope ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Stethoscope ka aavishkar 1816 me France ke René Laennec ne kiya. Kaha jata hai ki unhone kagaz ko modkar nalika banayi aur mareez ke dil ki dhadkan saaf suni - yahi se ye upkaran bana. Aaj ye har doctor ki pehchan hai.
Air conditioner (AC) ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Aadhunik AC ka aavishkar 1902 me America ke Willis Carrier ne kiya tha. Dilchasp baat ye hai ki unhone ye machine kamra thanda karne ke liye nahi, ek chhapakhane (printing press) me nami (humidity) kam karne ke liye banayi thi, taaki kagaz aur syahi kharab na ho. Thandak uska sukhad side-effect thi.
Helicopter ka safal roop kisne banaya?

Igor Sikorsky ne 1939 me pehla vyavharik ek-rotor wala helicopter (VS-300) udaya, jiska design aaj ke helicopteron ki neev hai. Sikorsky Russia se America aaye the aur unki company aaj bhi helicopter banati hai. Helicopter ki khaas baat hai ki ye ek hi jagah se udaan bhar aur utar sakta hai.
Jet engine ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Jet engine ka shrey Britain ke Frank Whittle ko jata hai, jinhone 1930 me iska patent liya aur 1941 me unke engine se pehli udaan hui. Germany ke Hans von Ohain ne bhi swatantra roop se jet engine banaya tha, jisse 1939 me pehli jet udaan hui thi. Jet engine ne hawai yatra ko tez aur sasta bana diya.
Dynamite ka aavishkar kisne kiya tha?

Dynamite ka aavishkar 1867 me Alfred Nobel ne kiya tha. Unhone khatarnak nitroglycerin ko surakshit roop me istemal yogya banaya. Yahi Nobel baad me apni sampatti se Nobel Puraskar ki neev rakh gaye - kaha jata hai ki ve chahte the ki unhe keval visfotak ke liye yaad na kiya jaye.
Plastic (Bakelite) ka aavishkar kab hua?

Pehla poori tarah kritrim plastic 'Bakelite' 1907 me Leo Baekeland ne banaya tha. Ye bijli ka kuchaalak tha, isliye switch, radio aur phone ke kholo me iska khoob istemal hua. Yahi se plastic yug ki shuruaat mani jati hai.
ATM machine kab aayi thi?

Duniya ki pehli ATM machine 1967 me London me lagi thi. Iska shrey John Shepherd-Barron ko jata hai - kehte hain ki unhe nahate samay ye vichar aaya ki bank band hone par bhi paise milne chahiye. Unhone hi 4 ankon wale PIN ka sujhaya roop diya, kyunki unki patni ko 4 ank hi aasani se yaad rehte the.
Calculator ki shuruaat kisne ki thi?

Blaise Pascal ne 1642 me keval 19 saal ki umar me 'Pascaline' naam ki pehli mechanical calculator machine banayi, jo jod-ghata kar sakti thi. Ye unhone apne pita ke kar (tax) ke hisaab me madad ke liye banayi thi. Computer ki programming bhasha 'Pascal' unhi ke naam par hai.
Pendulum wali ghadi kisne banayi?

Pendulum wali pehli safal ghadi 1656 me Netherlands ke vaigyanik Christiaan Huygens ne banayi. Galileo ne pendulum ke niyamit dolan ka vichar diya tha. Pendulum ghadiyon se samay napna pehle se kahin zyada sahi ho gaya.
Silai machine ka patent kisne liya tha?

Aadhunik silai machine ka mahatvapurna patent 1846 me Elias Howe ko mila tha. Baad me Isaac Singer ne usme sudhar karke use ghar-ghar pahunchaya. Silai machine ne kapda udyog aur gharelu silai dono me kranti la di.
Microwave oven ki khoj kaise hui?

Microwave oven ki khoj ek ittefaq se hui. 1945 me America ke engineer Percy Spencer radar par kaam kar rahe the, tab unki jeb me rakhi chocolate pighal gayi. Unhone samjha ki microwave tarange khana garam kar sakti hain. Pehle microwave oven almari jitne bade aur mehange the.
Laser ka aavishkar kab hua?

Pehla kaam karta laser 1960 me Theodore Maiman ne banaya tha, jisme unhone rubi (ruby) ke kristal ka istemal kiya. Aaj laser ka istemal operation, barcode scanner, fiber-optic internet aur udyog - har jagah hota hai. 'Laser' ka matlab hai Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation.
Transistor kyun itna mahatvapurna aavishkar hai?

Transistor 1947 me Bell Labs ke vaigyanikon - John Bardeen, Walter Brattain aur William Shockley - ne banaya. Is chhote se upkaran ne bade vacuum tube ki jagah li, jisse computer aur radio chhote, saste aur bharosemand bane. Aaj ke har phone aur computer ki chip me karodon-arbon transistor hote hain.
Computer chip (integrated circuit) kisne banayi?

1958 me Jack Kilby ne pehla integrated circuit (IC) banaya, jisme kai electronic hisse ek chhoti si plate par jod diye gaye. Robert Noyce ne bhi usi daur me is par kaam kiya. Isi chip takneek se computer jeb ke phone tak pahuncha. Kilby ko iske liye 2000 me Nobel Puraskar mila.
Bharat me pehli mobile call kab hui thi?

Bharat me pehli mobile phone call 1995 me Kolkata me hui thi - us samay ke Paschim Bengal ke mukhyamantri Jyoti Basu ne kendriya sanchar mantri Sukh Ram ko call kiya tha. Us samay mobile call bahut mehngi hoti thi - sunne par bhi paise lagte the. Aaj Bharat duniya ke sabse bade mobile bazaron me se hai.
Bharat me internet kab shuru hua?

Bharat me aam janta ke liye internet 15 August 1995 ko VSNL dwara shuru hua. Us samay dial-up connection se dheemi speed milti thi aur ghante ke hisab se kharcha hota tha. Aaj Bharat me duniya ka sabse sasta mobile data milta hai - ye safar keval teen dashakon ka hai.
Bharat me TV prasaran kab shuru hua?

Bharat me TV prasaran ki shuruaat 1959 me Delhi me ek chhote se prayogik kendra se hui - yahi Doordarshan bana. 1982 ke Asian Games ke samay rangin TV (color TV) Bharat me vyapak roop se aaya. Lambe samay tak Doordarshan hi ekmatra channel raha.
Bharat ki pehli film kaun si thi?

Bharat ki pehli film 'Raja Harishchandra' (1913) thi, jise Dadasaheb Phalke ne banaya tha - isliye unhe 'Bharatiya cinema ke pita' kaha jata hai. Pehli bolti film 'Alam Ara' 1931 me aayi. Phalke ke samman me cinema ka sabse bada rashtriya puraskar unhi ke naam par diya jata hai.
Google ki sthapna kab aur kisne ki?

Google ki sthapna 1998 me Larry Page aur Sergey Brin ne ki thi, jab ve Stanford University ke chhatra the. Unhone search ko behtar banane ke liye PageRank tareeka nikala. Ek chhote garage se shuru hui ye company aaj duniya ki sabse badi takneeki companiyon me hai. YouTube (2005) aur WhatsApp (2009) bhi baad me bade takneeki aavishkaro ke roop me ubhre.
Dak ticket (postage stamp) ki shuruaat kahan hui?

Duniya ka pehla dak ticket 'Penny Black' 1840 me Britain me aaya, jis par Maharani Victoria ki tasveer thi. Isse pehle patra pane wala vyakti dak kharcha deta tha - ticket ke baad bhejne wala pehle se bhugtan karne laga. Bharat me pehle ticket 1850s me aaye (Scinde Dawk, 1852).
Bharat ka pehla computer kaun sa tha?

Bharat ka pehla computer TIFRAC tha, jo 1960 me Mumbai ke Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) me bana aur chalu hua. Ise Bharatiya vaigyanikon ne swayam design kiya tha. Us samay ke computer aaj ke ek chhote phone se bhi kam shaktishali the, lekin ye Bharat ki takneeki yatra ki neev tha.
Diesel engine ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Diesel engine ka aavishkar Germany ke Rudolf Diesel ne 1890 ke dashak me kiya tha. Ye engine petrol engine se zyada kargar (efficient) hota hai, isliye truck, bus, train aur jahazon me iska khoob istemal hota hai. Petrol engine ke vikas me Nikolaus Otto ka naam pramukh hai, jinke naam par 'Otto cycle' hai.
Thermometer ka vikas kaise hua?

Galileo ne 16vi sadi ke ant me 'thermoscope' naam ka prarambhik upkaran banaya tha, jo taapman badalna dikhata tha. 1714 me Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit ne paare (mercury) wala sahi thermometer banaya aur Fahrenheit paimana diya. Anders Celsius ne 1742 me Celsius paimana diya, jo aaj duniya me sabse zyada istemal hota hai.
Microscope (sukshm-darshi) ka aavishkar kisne kiya?

Microscope ka shrey aam taur par Netherlands ke chashma banane wale Zacharias Janssen aur unke pita ko jata hai (lagbhag 1590). Baad me Leeuwenhoek ne ek-lens wale shaktishali sukshm-darshi banakar sukshm jeevon ki duniya kholi. Aaj ke electronic microscope to parmanuo tak dekh sakte hain.
Ramayana ke rachayita kaun hain?

Ramayana ke rachayita Maharshi Valmiki hain, jinhe 'Adi Kavi' (sabse pehle kavi) kaha jata hai. Ramayana me lagbhag 24,000 shlok hain aur ye saat kandon me banti hai. Kaha jata hai ki Valmiki pehle Ratnakar naam ke daku the, lekin jeevan ki ek ghatna ne unhe badal diya.
Mahabharat ke baare me khaas baatein batao.

Mahabharat ke sankalankarta Maharshi Ved Vyas mane jate hain. Ye duniya ka sabse bada mahakavya hai, jisme lagbhag ek lakh shlok hain. Ye 18 parvon me banta hai aur Bhagavad Gita iska hi ek bhag hai (Bhishma Parva se). Kurukshetra yuddh iski kendriya katha hai.
Bhagavad Gita kahan se li gayi hai?

Bhagavad Gita Mahabharat ka ek bhag hai. Ye Kurukshetra ke maidan me Shri Krishna aur Arjun ke beech hue samvad ka sangrah hai, jisme lagbhag 700 shlok hain. Isme karm, dharm aur jeevan ke gehare siddhant samjhaye gaye hain. Ise duniya ki sabse zyada padhi jane wali kitabon me gina jata hai.
Ramcharitmanas kisne likhi hai?

Ramcharitmanas Sant Tulsidas ji ki rachna hai, jo unhone Awadhi bhasha me likhi. Isiliye ye aam logo tak Ram-katha ko unki apni bhasha me le gayi. Tulsidas ne Varanasi me iski rachna ki thi. 'Hanuman Chalisa' bhi unhi ki prasiddh rachna hai.
Panchatantra ke lekhak kaun hain?

Panchatantra ke lekhak Pandit Vishnu Sharma mane jate hain. Isme janwaron ki kahaniyon ke dwara raajneeti aur jeevan-vyavhar ki seekh di gayi hai. Ye kitab duniya ki sabse zyada anuvaad hone wali kitabon me se hai - iski kahaniyan 200 se zyada bhashaon aur sanskaranon me milti hain.
Arthashastra kiski kitab hai?

Arthashastra Chanakya (Kautilya) ki prasiddh rachna hai. Isme shasan, arthavyavastha, kanoon, yuddh-neeti aur prashasan ke vistrit siddhant hain. Ye kitab saikdon saalon tak gum rahi thi aur 20vi sadi ki shuruaat me ek hastlikhit prati milne par dobara duniya ke saamne aayi.
Abhijnana Shakuntalam aur Meghaduta kiski rachna hain?

Dono hi Mahakavi Kalidas ki prasiddh rachnaayein hain. 'Abhijnana Shakuntalam' Raja Dushyant aur Shakuntala ki prem-katha par aadharit natak hai, aur 'Meghaduta' me ek virahi yaksh badal ko doot banakar apni priya tak sandesh bhejta hai. Kalidas ki rachnaon ka anuvaad duniya ki kai bhashaon me hua hai.
Gitanjali kisne likhi aur usse kya samman mila?

Gitanjali Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore ki kavitaon ka sangrah hai. Iske angrezi anuvaad par unhe 1913 me Sahitya ka Nobel Puraskar mila - ve sahitya me Nobel pane wale pehle gair-European (aur pehle Bharatiya) the. Tagore ne Gitanjali ka angrezi anuvaad swayam kiya tha.
Do deshon ke rashtragaan likhne wale kavi kaun hain?

Rabindranath Tagore duniya ke ekmatra kavi hain jinki rachnaayein do deshon ke rashtragaan hain - Bharat ka 'Jana Gana Mana' aur Bangladesh ka 'Amar Shonar Bangla'. 'Jana Gana Mana' pehli baar 1911 me Kolkata ke Congress adhiveshan me gaya gaya tha aur 24 January 1950 ko rashtragaan ke roop me apnaya gaya.
Vande Mataram kahan se liya gaya hai?

'Vande Mataram' Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay ke upanyas 'Anandamath' (1882) se liya gaya hai. Ye geet swatantrata andolan me Bharatiyaon ka sabse bada prerna-naara bana. 24 January 1950 ko ise rashtragaan ke barabar ka darja diya gaya. 'Sare Jahan Se Achha' Muhammad Iqbal ki rachna hai.
Godaan ke lekhak kaun hain?

Godaan Munshi Premchand ka sabse prasiddh upanyas hai, jo ek garib kisan Hori ke jeevan ki katha hai. Premchand ko 'Upanyas Samrat' kaha jata hai aur unka asli naam Dhanpat Rai tha. Unki anya prasiddh rachnaayein hain - Nirmala, Gaban, Sevasadan aur kahani 'Kafan' aur 'Eidgah'.
Madhushala kiski rachna hai?

Madhushala Harivansh Rai Bachchan ki sabse prasiddh kavita-kriti hai (1935). Isme unhone madiralay (sharab-khane) ko prateek banakar jeevan ke gehare satya samjhaye hain. Bachchan ji ki aatmakatha bhi Hindi sahitya me bahut sammanit hai. Ve abhineta Amitabh Bachchan ke pita the.
Kamayani ke kavi kaun hain?
