Kamayani Jaishankar Prasad ki mahaan rachna hai, jo Chhayavaad ki sabse badi kriti mani jati hai. Isme Manu aur Shraddha ki katha ke dwara manav ke bhavnaatmak vikas ko dikhaya gaya hai. Prasad ki anya prasiddh rachnaon me 'Aansu' aur natak 'Chandragupta' shamil hain.
Maithilisharan Gupt ki prasiddh rachna kaun si hai?

Maithilisharan Gupt ki prasiddh rachnaon me 'Saket' (Urmila ke tyag par) aur 'Bharat-Bharati' pramukh hain. Unhe aadhunik Hindi ke sabse lokpriya kaviyon me gina jata hai aur Gandhi ji ne unhe 'Rashtrakavi' ki upadhi di thi. Unki bhasha saral Khadi Boli thi, jo aam pathak tak pahunchti thi.
'Jhansi wali Rani' kavita kisne likhi hai?

'Khoob ladi mardani, wo to Jhansi wali Rani thi' - ye prasiddh kavita Subhadra Kumari Chauhan ki hai. Unhone veer-ras ki kai kavitaayein likhi aur swayam swatantrata andolan me bhaag lekar jail bhi gayi. Unki kavitaayein aaj bhi schoolon me padhai jati hain.
Mahadevi Varma ko 'Aadhunik Meera' kyun kehte hain?

Mahadevi Varma Chhayavaad ki pramukh kavi thi. Unki kavitaon me virah aur bhavna ki gehraai Meera jaisi thi, isliye unhe 'Aadhunik Meera' kaha gaya. Unke sangrah 'Yama' ko Jnanpith Puraskar mila. Ve mahila shiksha ki bhi badi samarthak thi aur Prayag Mahila Vidyapith se judi rahi.
Discovery of India kisne likhi hai?

'The Discovery of India' Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru ki prasiddh kitab hai, jo unhone 1944-46 me Ahmednagar kile ki jail me rehte hue likhi thi. Isme Bharat ke itihaas aur sanskriti ki khoj hai. Nehru ne apni beti Indira ko likhe patron ka sangrah 'Glimpses of World History' bhi likha tha.
Gandhi ji ki aatmakatha ka naam kya hai?

Gandhi ji ki aatmakatha ka naam hai 'Satya ke Saath Mere Prayog' (The Story of My Experiments with Truth). Ye mool roop se Gujarati me likhi gayi thi. Isme unhone apne jeevan ki safaltaon ke saath-saath galtiyon ko bhi imaandaari se likha hai. Unki dusri mahatvapurna kitab 'Hind Swaraj' (1909) hai.
R.K. Narayan ki prasiddh kritiyan kaun si hain?

R.K. Narayan angrezi me likhne wale prasiddh Bharatiya lekhak hain. Unhone kalpanik kasbe 'Malgudi' ko kendra banakar kai upanyas likhe - 'Swami and Friends', 'The Guide' aur kahani-sangrah 'Malgudi Days' sabse prasiddh hain. 'Malgudi Days' par bana TV serial bhi bahut lokpriya hua. 'The Guide' ko Sahitya Akademi Puraskar mila tha.
The God of Small Things kiski kitab hai?

'The God of Small Things' Arundhati Roy ka pehla upanyas hai, jise 1997 me Booker Puraskar mila. Ye Kerala ki prishthbhoomi par do judwa bachcho ki katha hai. Arundhati Roy ye samman pane wali pramukh Bharatiya lekhikaon me se hain.
Midnight's Children kisne likhi hai?

'Midnight's Children' Salman Rushdie ka prasiddh upanyas hai, jise 1981 me Booker Puraskar mila aur baad me ise 'Booker of Bookers' (sarvashreshth Booker vijetaon me) bhi chuna gaya. Iska nayak Saleem Sinai 15 August 1947 ki madhyaratri me paida hota hai aur uski katha Bharat ke itihaas ke saath chalti hai.
Train to Pakistan kiski rachna hai?

'Train to Pakistan' Khushwant Singh ka prasiddh upanyas hai, jo 1947 ke vibhajan ki prishthbhoomi par hai. Isme ek seema-varti gaon ke dwara vibhajan ki trasadi ko dikhaya gaya hai. Khushwant Singh prasiddh patrakar aur 'Illustrated Weekly' ke sampadak bhi rahe.
Wings of Fire kiski aatmakatha hai?

'Wings of Fire' Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam ki aatmakatha hai. Isme ek sadharan parivar ke ladke ke vaigyanik aur phir Rashtrapati banne tak ka safar hai. Ye kitab yuvaon me bahut lokpriya hai. Kalam sahab ko 'Missile Man' aur 'Janata ke Rashtrapati' kaha jata hai.
Long Walk to Freedom kiski aatmakatha hai?

'Long Walk to Freedom' Nelson Mandela ki aatmakatha hai. Isme unke sangharsh, 27 saalon ki jail aur Dakshin Africa me rang-bhed ke ant ki katha hai. Ye duniya ki sabse prernadayak aatmakathaon me gini jati hai.
Anne Frank ki Diary kyun duniya bhar me prasiddh hai?

Anne Frank ek yahudi ladki thi, jo dusre vishwa yuddh me Nazi atyachar se bachne ke liye Amsterdam me do saal tak ek gupt kamre me chhupi rahi. Wahan likhi uski diary yuddh ke baad 'The Diary of a Young Girl' ke naam se chhapi aur duniya ki sabse zyada padhi jane wali kitabon me se ek ban gayi. Anne ka nidhan keval 15 saal ki umar me nazarbandi shivir (concentration camp) me hua.
Alice in Wonderland ke lekhak kaun hain?

'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland' Lewis Carroll ki prasiddh rachna hai (1865). Carroll ka asli naam Charles Dodgson tha aur ve ganit ke adhyapak the. Alice ki ye kalpanik duniya ki katha bachcho ke saath-saath badon me bhi utni hi lokpriya hai.
Harry Potter shringkhala kisne likhi hai?

Harry Potter ki kitabein J.K. Rowling ne likhi hain. Pehli kitab 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone' 1997 me aayi. Ek samay aarthik tangi se joojh rahi Rowling ki ye shringkhala duniya ki sabse zyada bikne wali kitabon me se ek ban gayi aur un par bani filmen bhi vishwa prasiddh hui.
Sherlock Holmes ke rachayita kaun hain?

Sherlock Holmes ke rachayita Sir Arthur Conan Doyle hain. Holmes aur unke saathi Dr. Watson ki jasusi kahaniyan itni lokpriya hui ki pathak Holmes ko asal vyakti manne lage. Holmes ka kalpanik pata - 221B Baker Street, London - aaj sangrahalaya ban gaya hai.
The Jungle Book kisne likhi hai?

'The Jungle Book' Rudyard Kipling ki rachna hai, jisme Mowgli aur jungle ke janwaron ki kahaniyan hain. Kipling ka janm Mumbai me hua tha aur Bharat unki rachnaon me baar-baar aata hai. Unhe 1907 me Sahitya ka Nobel mila tha. Unki kavita 'If' bhi duniya bhar me prasiddh hai.
Akbarnama kisne likha tha?

Akbarnama Abul Fazl ne likha tha. Isme Akbar ke shasan ka vistrit itihaas hai. Iska teesra bhag 'Ain-i-Akbari' hai, jisme us samay ke prashasan, sena, aamdani aur samaj ki jaankari milti hai. Ye Mughal-kaal ko samajhne ka sabse bharosemand sadhan mana jata hai.
Baburnama kis bhasha me likha gaya tha?

Baburnama (Tuzuk-i-Baburi) Babur ne apni matribhasha Chagatai Turki me likha tha. Baad me Akbar ke samay iska Farsi me anuvaad hua. Isme Babur ne apne anubhav, Bharat ki garmi, phal (khaas taur par aam aur tarbooz par tippani) aur ladaiyon ka varnan imaandaari se kiya hai.
Rajatarangini kiski rachna hai?

Rajatarangini Kalhana ki rachna hai (12vi sadi), jisme Kashmir ke rajaon ka itihaas kavya roop me likha gaya hai. Ise Bharat ki sabse prachin vyavasthit itihaas-kitabon me gina jata hai, kyunki Kalhana ne tathyon ko parakh kar likhne ka prayas kiya tha. 'Rajatarangini' ka arth hai - rajaon ki nadi.
Ashtadhyayi kiski rachna hai?

Ashtadhyayi Maharshi Panini ki rachna hai, jo Sanskrit vyakaran ki sabse mahaan kitab mani jati hai. Isme lagbhag 4,000 sutron me Sanskrit ke niyam diye gaye hain. Iske niyam itne vyavasthit hain ki aadhunik bhasha-vaigyanik aur computer vigyaan ke log bhi iski prashansa karte hain.
Charak Samhita aur Sushrut Samhita kya hain?

Charak Samhita Ayurved ka mool granth hai, jisme bimariyon ke kaaran aur ilaaj ka varnan hai - Maharshi Charak isse jude hain. Sushrut Samhita shalya chikitsa (surgery) ka prachin granth hai, isliye Sushrut ko 'shalya chikitsa ke pita' kaha jata hai. Dono granth Bharatiya chikitsa parampara ki neev hain.
Iliad aur Odyssey kiski rachnaayein hain?

Iliad aur Odyssey prachin Greek kavi Homer ke mahakavya hain. Iliad me Troy ke yuddh ki katha hai aur Odyssey me yoddha Odysseus ki yuddh ke baad ghar lautne ki lambi yatra hai. Ye dono kritiyan paschimi sahitya ki sabse purani aur prabhavshali rachnaon me gini jati hain.
Shakespeare kaun the aur unki prasiddh rachnaayein kaun si hain?

William Shakespeare ko angrezi sahitya ka sabse bada natakkar mana jata hai. Unke prasiddh natak hain - Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear aur Romeo and Juliet. Unhone lagbhag 37 natak aur 150 se zyada sonnet (kavitaayein) likhe. Unki rachnaon ka anuvaad duniya ki lagbhag har badi bhasha me hua hai.
Toba Tek Singh kahani kiski hai?

'Toba Tek Singh' Saadat Hasan Manto ki sabse prasiddh kahani hai, jo vibhajan ke samay pagal-khane ke kaidiyon ke adla-badli ki prishthbhoomi par vibhajan ke pagalpan ko dikhati hai. Manto Urdu ke sabse bade kahanikaron me gine jate hain. Unki anya prasiddh kahaniyan hain - 'Thanda Gosht' aur 'Khol Do'.
Panini ke alawa prachin Bharat ke aur kaun se granth prasiddh hain?

Prachin Bharat ke prasiddh grantho me Patanjali ka 'Yoga Sutra' (yoga ke siddhant), Vishnu Sharma ka 'Panchatantra', Narayana ka 'Hitopadesh' (neeti kathayein), Jayadev ka 'Geet Govind' (Radha-Krishna ki kavya rachna) aur Banabhatta ka 'Harshacharita' (Samrat Harsh ka jeevan charit) pramukh hain. Vishakhadatta ka natak 'Mudrarakshasa' Chanakya-Chandragupta ki katha par hai.
Lilavati granth kisne likha hai?

Lilavati 12vi sadi ke mahaan ganitagya Bhaskaracharya (Bhaskara II) ka prasiddh ganit granth hai. Isme ankganit ke sawal kavita aur katha ke roop me diye gaye hain. Kaha jata hai ki Bhaskaracharya ne ye apni beti Lilavati ke naam par likha tha. Unka dusra granth 'Siddhanta Shiromani' khagol aur ganit ka vishal sangrah hai.
Surdas ki prasiddh rachna kaun si hai?

Sant-kavi Surdas ki prasiddh rachna 'Sur Sagar' hai, jisme Shri Krishna ki baal-leelayon ka varnan hai. Ve Braj bhasha ke sabse bade kaviyon me mane jate hain. Unki rachnaon me 'Bhramar Geet' bhi bahut prasiddh hai. Surdas ko parampara me netraheen (andha) kavi mana jata hai.
Bharat Ratna ke baare me batao - ye kab shuru hua?

Bharat Ratna Bharat ka sarvochch nagrik samman hai, jo 1954 me shuru hua. Ye kala, sahitya, vigyaan, samaj seva aur khel jaise kshetron me asadharan yogdaan ke liye diya jata hai. Iske saath koi dhana-rashi nahi milti - keval ek praman patra aur peepal ke patte ke aakar ka padak milta hai.
Bharat Ratna pane wale sabse pehle vyakti kaun the?

1954 me pehle saal teen mahaan vyaktiyon ko Bharat Ratna mila - C. Rajagopalachari (swatantrata senani aur antim Governor-General), Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan (darshanik aur baad me Rashtrapati) aur Dr. C.V. Raman (Nobel vijeta vaigyanik). Teenon apne-apne kshetra ke shikhar the.
Bharat Ratna pane wali pehli mahila kaun thi?

Indira Gandhi Bharat Ratna (1971) pane wali pehli mahila thi. Unhone Pradhan Mantri rehte hue 1971 ke yuddh me Bharat ki jeet ka netritva kiya tha. Usse pehle unke pita Jawaharlal Nehru ko bhi 1955 me Bharat Ratna mila tha.
Khel jagat se Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle khiladi kaun hain?

Sachin Tendulkar khel jagat se Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle aur ekmatra khiladi hain. Unhe ye samman 2014 me mila, jab ve 40 saal ke the - us samay ve sabse kam umar ke Bharat Ratna praptakarta bhi bane. Unse pehle kisi khiladi ko ye samman nahi mila tha.
Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle videshi kaun the?

Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, jinhe 'Seemant Gandhi' (Frontier Gandhi) kaha jata hai, Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle videshi the (1987). Dusre videshi Nelson Mandela the, jinhe 1990 me ye samman mila. Ye dono hi ahinsa aur swatantrata ke sangharsh ke prateek the.
2024 me Bharat Ratna kinhe diya gaya tha?

2024 me ek saath paanch vyaktiyon ko Bharat Ratna ghoshit hua - Karpoori Thakur, Lal Krishna Advani, P.V. Narasimha Rao, Chaudhary Charan Singh aur M.S. Swaminathan. Swaminathan ko 'Harit Kranti ke pita' mana jata hai. Inme se chaar ko ye samman marankopar (posthumous) mila.
Marankopar Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle vyakti kaun the?

Lal Bahadur Shastri marankopar (mrityu ke baad) Bharat Ratna pane wale pehle vyakti the - unhe 1966 me, Tashkent me hue unke nidhan ke baad ye samman mila. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ko bhi 1990 me marankopar Bharat Ratna diya gaya tha.
Padma puraskaron ki teen shreniyan kaun si hain?

Padma puraskar teen shreniyon me diye jate hain, mahatva ke kram me - Padma Vibhushan (dusra sarvochch nagrik samman), Padma Bhushan (teesra) aur Padma Shri (chautha). Ye 1954 me Bharat Ratna ke saath hi shuru hue the. Inki ghoshna har saal 25 January ki purv-sandhya par hoti hai aur Rashtrapati inhhe pradan karte hain.
Padma puraskaron ko 'Peoples Padma' kyun kaha jane laga hai?

Aaj kal aam nagrik bhi Padma puraskaron ke liye kisi yogya vyakti ka naam online sujha sakte hain. Isi liye inhhe 'Peoples Padma' kaha jane laga hai. Har saal inme kai aise gumnaam nayak hote hain jo gaon-kasbon me chupchaap samaj seva, kala ya paryavaran ka kaam kar rahe hote hain.
Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna puraskar ke baare me batao.

Ye Bharat ka khel ka sarvochch samman hai. Ye 1991-92 me 'Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna' ke naam se shuru hua tha aur iske pehle praptakarta shatranj khiladi Viswanathan Anand the. 2021 me iska naam badalkar hockey ke jadugar Major Dhyan Chand ke naam par 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna' kar diya gaya.
Arjuna Puraskar aur Dronacharya Puraskar me kya antar hai?

Arjuna Puraskar utkrisht khiladiyon ko diya jata hai - ye 1961 se diya ja raha hai. Dronacharya Puraskar unke prashikshakon (coaches) ke liye hai, jo 1985 se diya jata hai. Mahabharat ke Arjun aur unke guru Dronacharya ke naam par ye dono puraskar rakhe gaye hain.
Dadasaheb Phalke Puraskar kya hai?

Dadasaheb Phalke Puraskar Bharatiya cinema ka sarvochch samman hai, jo 1969 se diya jata hai. Ye Bharatiya cinema ke pita Dadasaheb Phalke ke samman me shuru hua. Iski pehli praptakarta abhinetri Devika Rani thi, jinhe 'Bharatiya cinema ki pratham mahila' kaha jata hai.
Jnanpith Puraskar kya hai?

Jnanpith Puraskar Bharat ka sahitya ka sarvochch samman hai, jo 1965 se diya jata hai. Iske pehle praptakarta Malayalam kavi G. Sankara Kurup the. Ise pane wali pehli mahila Bangla lekhika Ashapurna Devi thi (1976). Ye puraskar Bharat ki 22 aadhikarik bhashaon ke lekhakon ko mil sakta hai.
Nobel Puraskar pane wale pehle Bharatiya kaun the?

Rabindranath Tagore Nobel Puraskar pane wale pehle Bharatiya the - unhe 1913 me sahitya ke liye ye puraskar 'Gitanjali' par mila. Ve sahitya me Nobel pane wale pehle gair-European bhi the. Is samman se Bharatiya sahitya ko duniya bhar me pehchan mili.
Dr. C.V. Raman ko Nobel kis khoj ke liye mila tha?

Dr. Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman ko 1930 me bhautiki ka Nobel 'Raman Prabhav' (Raman Effect) ki khoj ke liye mila. Unhone 28 February 1928 ko ye khoj ki thi - isiliye 28 February ko har saal Bharat me Rashtriya Vigyan Diwas manaya jata hai. Ve vigyaan me Nobel pane wale pehle Bharatiya the.
Amartya Sen ko Nobel kis kshetra me mila?

Amartya Sen ko 1998 me arthashastra ka Nobel Puraskar mila. Unhone kalyan arthashastra aur akaal (famine) ke kaaranon par mahatvapurna kaam kiya - unhone dikhaya ki akaal keval khadya ki kami se nahi, baant (distribution) ki khami se bhi padta hai. Unhe 1999 me Bharat Ratna bhi mila.
Kailash Satyarthi ko Nobel Shanti Puraskar kyun mila?

Kailash Satyarthi ko 2014 me Nobel Shanti Puraskar mila. Unhone 'Bachpan Bachao Andolan' chalakar hazaron bachcho ko baal majdoori aur taskari se mukti dilayi. Ye puraskar unhe Pakistan ki Malala Yousafzai ke saath sanyukt roop se mila tha - ye Bharat-Pakistan ke sajhe samman ka durlabh pal tha.
Bharat se jude anya Nobel vijeta kaun-kaun hain?

Bharatiya mool ke kai vaigyanikon ko Nobel mila hai - Har Gobind Khorana (1968, chikitsa - genetic code par kaam), Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar (1983, bhautiki - sitaaron ki sanrachna, 'Chandrasekhar seema'), Venkatraman Ramakrishnan (2009, rasayan - ribosome ki sanrachna) aur Abhijit Banerjee (2019, arthashastra - garibi par prayogik adhyayan).
Mother Teresa ko kaun se bade samman mile the?

Mother Teresa ko 1979 me Nobel Shanti Puraskar aur 1980 me Bharat Ratna mila. Unhone Kolkata me 'Missionaries of Charity' sanstha banakar garibon, beemar aur marte hue logo ki seva ki. Unhone apna poora jeevan manav seva me laga diya, isliye unhe baad me sant (Saint Teresa) ghoshit kiya gaya.
Dr. Kalam ko Bharat Ratna kab mila tha?

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam ko Bharat Ratna 1997 me mila tha - ye Rashtrapati banne (2002) se paanch saal pehle ki baat hai. Ye samman unhe Bharat ke missile aur antariksh karyakramon me yogdaan ke liye mila tha. Ek vaigyanik ke roop me Bharat Ratna pane wale ve pramukh naamon me se hain.
Sangeet kshetra se Bharat Ratna pane wale kaun-kaun hain?

Sangeet se kai diggajon ko Bharat Ratna mila hai - M.S. Subbulakshmi (1998, Carnatic gayika), Bismillah Khan (2001, shehnai vadak), Lata Mangeshkar (2001, paarshv gayika) aur Pandit Bhimsen Joshi (2008, Hindustani gayak). Bismillah Khan ki shehnai Kashi aur Ganga se judi aastha ka prateek mani jati hai.
Oscar pane wali pehli Bharatiya kaun thi?

Bhanu Athaiya Oscar jeetne wali pehli Bharatiya thi - unhe 1982 ki film 'Gandhi' ke liye sarvashreshth costume design ka Oscar mila (1983 ke samaroh me). Isi film ke dwara Bharat ka naam Oscar manch tak pahuncha. Baad me Satyajit Ray ko 1992 me manad (Honorary) Oscar diya gaya.
A.R. Rahman ke Oscar ke baare me batao.

A.R. Rahman ne 2009 me film 'Slumdog Millionaire' ke liye ek saath do Oscar jeete - sarvashreshth mool sangeet (score) aur sarvashreshth geet ('Jai Ho', jiske geetkaar Gulzar the aur unhe bhi sanyukt Oscar mila). Ek hi samaroh me do Oscar jeetne wale ve pehle Bharatiya bane.
Naatu Naatu geet ko kaun sa bada samman mila?

Film RRR ke geet 'Naatu Naatu' ne 2023 me sarvashreshth mool geet (Best Original Song) ka Oscar jeeta. Iske sangeetkar M.M. Keeravani aur geetkaar Chandrabose hain. Usi saal Bharat ki 'The Elephant Whisperers' ne sarvashreshth documentary short film ka Oscar bhi jeeta - ye Bharat ke liye dohra garv ka pal tha.
Pt. Ravi Shankar ko Grammy se kaise joda jata hai?

Sitar vadak Pandit Ravi Shankar ko Grammy puraskar kai baar mile, jisme marankopar Grammy Lifetime Achievement samman bhi shamil hai. Unhone Bharatiya shastriya sangeet ko paschim me lokpriya banaya. Unke shishyon me Beatles ke George Harrison bhi the - isse sitar duniya bhar ke yuvaon tak pahuncha.
Ustad Zakir Hussain ne 2024 me kya karnama kiya?

Tabla vadak Ustad Zakir Hussain ne 2024 ke Grammy samaroh me ek saath teen Grammy puraskar jeete - ye kisi Bharatiya ke liye ek saal me abhutpurv safalta thi. Ve duniya ke sabse prasiddh tabla vadako me gine jate hain aur 'Shakti' band ke sansthapak sadasyon me se hain. Unke pita Ustad Allah Rakha bhi mahaan tabla vadak the.
Sardar Patel aur Dr. Ambedkar ko Bharat Ratna kab mila?

Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ko Bharat Ratna 1991 me marankopar diya gaya - swatantrata ke 44 saal baad. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ko bhi 1990 me marankopar Bharat Ratna mila. Dono hi aadhunik Bharat ke nirmata the, isliye in sammano ko 'der se mila nyay' bhi kaha gaya.
Param Vir Chakra kya hai aur iske pehle praptakarta kaun the?

Param Vir Chakra Bharat ka sarvochch sainya samman hai, jo yuddh me asadharan veerta ke liye diya jata hai. Ye 26 January 1950 se lagu hua. Iske pehle praptakarta Major Somnath Sharma the, jinhe 1947 ke yuddh me Badgam ki raksha me veergati par ye samman marankopar mila. Aaj tak ye samman keval 21 veeron ko mila hai - isse iski durlabhata ka pata chalta hai.
Ashok Chakra kise diya jata hai?

Ashok Chakra shanti-kaal me veerta ka sarvochch sainya samman hai - ye un veeron ko milta hai jo yuddh ke maidan se bahar asadharan sahas dikhate hain. Ise pane wali pehli mahila Neerja Bhanot thi, jinhone 1986 me apaharan hue jahaz me yatriyon ki jaan bachate hue apni jaan di thi (marankopar, 1987).
Sahitya Akademi Puraskar ke baare me batao.

Sahitya Akademi Puraskar 1955 se diya ja raha hai. Ye Bharat ki 22 aadhikarik bhashaon ke alawa Angrezi aur Rajasthani sahit kul 24 bhashaon ke sarvashreshth lekhakon ko har saal milta hai. Sahitya Akademi Bharat ki rashtriya sahitya sanstha hai, jiski sthapna 1954 me hui thi.
Antariksh me jaane wala pehla insaan kaun tha?

Antariksh me jaane wale pehle insaan Soviet Sangh ke Yuri Gagarin the. 12 April 1961 ko unhone 'Vostok 1' yan se prithvi ka ek chakkar lagbhag 108 minute me lagaya. Unke prasiddh shabd the - prithvi bahut sundar hai. Is din ko duniya bhar me manav antariksh udaan diwas ke roop me manaya jata hai.
Antariksh me jaane wali pehli mahila kaun thi?

Antariksh me jaane wali pehli mahila Valentina Tereshkova thi (Soviet Sangh), jo 1963 me 'Vostok 6' se gayi thi. Ve aaj bhi antariksh me akele (solo) udaan bharne wali ekmatra mahila hain. Unse lagbhag 19 saal baad dusri mahila antariksh me gayi.
Kul kitne log chand par chale hain?

1969 se 1972 ke beech Apollo missions me kul 12 antariksh yatri chand ki satah par chale hain - sabhi America ke the. Uske baad koi manav chand par nahi gaya, lekin ab kai desh dobara manav ko chand par bhejne ki taiyari kar rahe hain - Bharat ka Gaganyaan karyakram bhi isi disha ka ek kadam hai.
Antariksh me jaane wale pehle Bharatiya kaun the?

Squadron Leader Rakesh Sharma antariksh me jaane wale pehle Bharatiya the. Ve 1984 me Soviet yan Soyuz T-11 se gaye aur ek hafta antariksh me rahe. Jab tatkalin Pradhan Mantri Indira Gandhi ne unse pucha ki antariksh se Bharat kaisa dikhta hai, to unka jawab tha - 'Saare Jahan Se Achha.'
Kalpana Chawla kaun thi?

Kalpana Chawla Bharatiya mool ki pehli mahila antariksh yatri thi, jo 1997 me pehli baar antariksh me gayi. Haryana ke Karnal me janmi Kalpana NASA ki antariksh yatri thi. 1 February 2003 ko unka yan Columbia prithvi par lautte samay durghatnagrast ho gaya aur un sahit saato yatri shahid ho gaye. Unki smriti me kai sansthanon aur ek khagoliya pind ka naam rakha gaya hai.
Sunita Williams kaun hain?

Sunita Williams Bharatiya mool ki NASA antariksh yatri hain. Unhone antariksh me lambe samay tak rehne aur sabse zyada spacewalk karne wali mahilaon me naam kamaya hai. 2024 me gayi unki yatra takneeki kaaran se lambi ho gayi aur ve kai mahino tak Antarrashtriya Antariksh Station (ISS) par rukin - unki surakshit wapsi poori duniya ke liye khabar bani.
Shubhanshu Shukla kaun hain?

Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla Bharatiya Vayu Sena ke pilot aur Gaganyaan ke liye chune gaye antariksh yatri hain. 2025 me ve Axiom-4 mission se Antarrashtriya Antariksh Station (ISS) gaye - ISS jaane wale ve pehle Bharatiya bane, aur Rakesh Sharma ke 41 saal baad antariksh me jaane wale dusre Bharatiya bhi.
ISRO ki sthapna kab hui aur iske pita kaun mane jate hain?

ISRO (Bharatiya Antariksh Anusandhan Sangathan) ki sthapna 15 August 1969 ko hui. Dr. Vikram Sarabhai ko Bharatiya antariksh karyakram ka pita mana jata hai. Unhone hi kaha tha ki Bharat jaise desh ke liye antariksh takneek aam aadmi ki samasyaon ke hal ke liye honi chahiye - mausam, sanchar aur shiksha me.
Bharat ka pehla upagrah kaun sa tha?

Bharat ka pehla upagrah 'Aryabhata' tha, jo 19 April 1975 ko Soviet Sangh (Russia) ke rocket se chhoda gaya tha. Iska naam mahaan Bharatiya khagolshastri Aryabhata ke naam par rakha gaya tha. Isi ke saath Bharat upagrah chhodne wale deshon ki shreni me shamil ho gaya.
Bharat ne apna pehla upagrah apne rocket se kab chhoda?

1980 me Bharat ne SLV-3 rocket se 'Rohini' upagrah ko kaksha me sthapit kiya. Is pariyojana ke nideshak Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam the. Iske saath Bharat apne swadeshi rocket se upagrah chhodne wala duniya ka chhatha desh ban gaya.
Duniya ka pehla kritrim upagrah kaun sa tha?

Duniya ka pehla kritrim upagrah Sputnik 1 tha, jo Soviet Sangh ne 4 October 1957 ko chhoda tha. Ye ek chhota sa gola tha jo radio sanket bhejta tha. Isi ke saath antariksh yug ki shuruaat hui aur America-Soviet ke beech antariksh ki daud shuru hui.
Antariksh me jaane wala pehla jeev kaun tha?

Antariksh ki kaksha me jaane wala pehla jeev Laika naam ki kutti (dog) thi, jise Soviet Sangh ne 1957 me Sputnik 2 se bheja tha. Us samay yan ko wapas lane ki takneek nahi thi, isliye Laika wapas nahi aa saki. Uske balidan ne manav ki antariksh yatra ka raasta khola.
NASA kya hai aur kab bana?

NASA America ki antariksh agency hai, jiski sthapna 1958 me hui thi. NASA ne hi Apollo karyakram se manav ko chand par pahunchaya. Aaj NASA ke alawa Europe ki ESA, Bharat ki ISRO, China ki CNSA aur Japan ki JAXA duniya ki pramukh antariksh agencies hain.
Chandrayaan-1 mission ki khaas baat kya thi?

Chandrayaan-1 Bharat ka pehla chand mission tha, jo 2008 me PSLV rocket se gaya. Isne chand ki satah par paani ke anuo ke sanket khoje - ye us samay ki duniya bhar ki badi khoj thi, jisme NASA ke upkaran ne bhi madad ki. Is mission ne Bharat ko chand tak pahunchne wale chune hue deshon me shamil kar diya.
Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) kyun duniya bhar me charcha me raha?

Mangalyaan 5 November 2013 ko chhoda gaya aur 24 September 2014 ko Mangal ki kaksha me pahunch gaya. Bharat Mangal par pehle hi prayas me safal hone wala duniya ka pehla desh bana aur Asia ka bhi pehla desh. Is mission ki lagat lagbhag 450 crore rupaye thi - itni kam lagat dekhkar duniya hairan reh gayi thi.
Chandrayaan-2 me kya hua tha?

Chandrayaan-2 (2019) ka orbiter safaltapurvak chand ki kaksha me pahuncha aur aaj bhi kaam karke jaankari bhej raha hai. Lekin lander 'Vikram' utarte samay aakhiri palon me sampark se bahar ho gaya aur naram landing nahi ho payi. Isi anubhav se seekh lekar Chandrayaan-3 ko sudhara gaya.
Chandrayaan-3 ne kya itihaas racha?

23 August 2023 ko Chandrayaan-3 ka lander 'Vikram' chand ke dakshin dhruv ke paas safaltapurvak utara. Bharat chand par naram landing karne wala chautha desh bana aur dakshin dhruv kshetra me utarne wala duniya ka pehla desh. Lander se 'Pragyan' rover bahar aakar chand ki satah par chala aur mitti ka adhyayan kiya - sulfur jaise tatvon ke sanket mile. Is din ko Bharat me Rashtriya Antariksh Diwas manaya jata hai.
Chandrayaan-3 ke landing sthal ka naam kya rakha gaya?

Chandrayaan-3 ke utarane ke sthan ko 'Shiv Shakti Point' naam diya gaya. Isi tarah Chandrayaan-2 ke lander ke girne ke sthan ko 'Tiranga Point' kaha gaya. Naam dene ki ye parampara Bharat ke antariksh itihaas ko yaadgar banati hai.
Aditya-L1 mission kya hai?

Aditya-L1 Bharat ka pehla surya adhyayan mission hai. Ye 2023 me chhoda gaya aur prithvi se lagbhag 15 lakh kilometer door L1 bindu ke aas-paas sthit hai, jahan se ye bina ruke surya ko dekhta hai. Isse surya ke toofano (solar storms) ki jaankari milegi, jo hamare upagrahon aur bijli vyavastha ko prabhavit karte hain.
PSLV ko ISRO ka 'workhorse' kyun kehte hain?

PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) ISRO ka sabse bharosemand rocket hai, isliye ise 'workhorse' kehte hain. 2017 me PSLV ne ek saath 104 upagrah chhodkar us samay ka vishwa record banaya tha. Chandrayaan-1 aur Mangalyaan jaise mission bhi PSLV se hi gaye the. Bharat ka sabse bhaari rocket LVM3 hai, jisse Chandrayaan-3 gaya tha.
Gaganyaan mission kya hai?

Gaganyaan Bharat ka pehla swadeshi manav antariksh mission hai, jisme Bharatiya antariksh yatri Bharatiya rocket (LVM3) se prithvi ki kaksha me jayenge. Iske liye Vayu Sena ke chaar test piloton ko chuna gaya hai. Manav mission se pehle 'Vyommitra' naam ki mahila robot (humanoid) ko parikshan udaan me bhejne ki yojna hai.
Sriharikota kyun prasiddh hai?

Sriharikota Andhra Pradesh ke tat par sthit ek dweep hai, jahan ISRO ka Satish Dhawan Antariksh Kendra hai - Bharat ke lagbhag saare bade rocket yahi se chhode jate hain. Ye sthan bhoomadhya rekha ke paas aur samudra ke kinare hone ke kaaran rocket prakshepan ke liye surakshit aur upyukt hai. Isko pehle SHAR kaha jata tha.
Hubble Telescope kya hai?

Hubble Space Telescope 1990 me antariksh me sthapit ki gayi ek vishal durbeen hai. Prithvi ke vatavaran se upar hone ke kaaran ye bina dhundhlapan ke brahmand ki saaf tasveerein leti hai. Iski tasveeron ne aakashgangaon, sitaaron ke janm aur brahmand ke vistar ko samajhne me bahut madad ki hai.
Voyager 1 kya hai?

Voyager 1 NASA ka ek yan hai jo 1977 me chhoda gaya tha. Ye aaj manav dwara banayi gayi sabse door ki vastu hai - hamare saur mandal ki seema paar karke taaron ke beech ke kshetra (interstellar space) me pahunch chuka hai. Isme ek 'Golden Record' rakha hai, jisme prithvi ki awaazein, sangeet aur tasveerein hain - kisi anya sabhyata ke liye sandesh ke roop me.
Black hole ki pehli tasveer kab aayi?

Black hole ki pehli asal tasveer 2019 me aayi thi, jo Event Horizon Telescope naam ke vishwa-vyapi durbeen jaal ne li thi. Ye tasveer M87 aakashganga ke kendra ke vishal black hole ki thi - ek chamakti hui anguthi ke beech kaala gola. Isse Einstein ke siddhanton ko ek aur saboot mila.
Surya ka prakash prithvi tak pahunchne me kitna samay leta hai?

Surya ka prakash lagbhag 15 crore kilometer ki doori tay karke prithvi tak pahunchne me lagbhag 8 minute 20 second leta hai. Prakash ki gati lagbhag 3 lakh kilometer prati second hoti hai - brahmand me isse tez kuch nahi ja sakta. Isi liye jab hum surya ko dekhte hain, to asal me hum uska 8 minute purana roop dekhte hain.
Chand prithvi se kitni door hai?

Chand prithvi se ausatan lagbhag 3.84 lakh kilometer door hai. Prakash ko ye doori tay karne me lagbhag 1.3 second lagta hai. Chand prithvi ke chaaron ore lagbhag 27 din me ek chakkar pura karta hai - isiliye mahine me ek baar purnima aur ek baar amavasya hoti hai.
Antararrashtriya Antariksh Station (ISS) kya hai?

ISS duniya ki sabse badi manav-nirmit antariksh prayogshala hai, jo prithvi se lagbhag 400 kilometer upar chakkar lagati hai. Ise 1998 se tukdo me jodkar banaya gaya aur isme America, Russia, Europe, Japan aur Canada saajhedar hain. Isme antariksh yatri mahino rehkar shunya gurutva me prayog karte hain.
Mangal ko 'Laal Grah' kyun kehte hain?

Mangal ki mitti aur chattaanon me lohe ke oxide (jang) ki matra zyada hai, isliye ye laal-narangi dikhai deta hai aur ise 'Laal Grah' kehte hain. Mangal par saur mandal ka sabse uncha jwalamukhi Olympus Mons hai. Bharat ka Mangalyaan yahi gaya tha.
Sabse bada grah aur sabse garam grah kaun se hain?

Brihaspati (Jupiter) hamare saur mandal ka sabse bada grah hai - usme 1,300 se zyada prithvi samaj jayein, itna vishal hai. Sabse garam grah Shukra (Venus) hai, surya ke sabse paas wale Budh (Mercury) se bhi zyada garam - kyunki Shukra ke ghane baadal garmi ko andar band kar lete hain (greenhouse prabhav). Shani apne sundar chaudi chakron (rings) ke liye prasiddh hai.
Khagolshastri Aryabhata ka yogdaan kya tha?

Aryabhata 5vi sadi ke mahaan Bharatiya ganitagya aur khagolshastri the. Unhone apni kitab 'Aryabhatiya' (499 CE) me bataya ki prithvi apni dhuri par ghoomti hai aur chand-surya grahan ka asal kaaran chhaya hai, Rahu-Ketu nahi. Unhone pi (π) ka sahi ke aas-paas man bhi diya. Bharat ke pehle upagrah ka naam unhi ke samman me rakha gaya.
INSAT upagrahon ne Bharat me kya badlav laya?

1980 ke dashak me shuru hui INSAT upagrah shrinkhala ne Bharat me TV prasaran, telephone aur mausam ki jaankari me kranti la di. Inhi upagrahon se Doordarshan gaon-gaon pahuncha aur chakrawat (cyclone) ki samay par chetaavni se lakhon jaanein bachne lagi. Aaj Bharat ke upagrah sanchar, mausam, nausena-margdarshan (NavIC) aur door-sanvedan (remote sensing) - har kaam me lage hain.
Swadeshi cryogenic engine kyun khaas hai?

Cryogenic engine bahut thande indhan (taral hydrogen aur oxygen) se chalta hai aur bhaari upagrahon ko unchi kaksha me pahunchane ke liye zaroori hota hai. Ye takneek bahut mushkil hai - duniya ke gine-chune desho ke paas hi hai. Bharat ne varshon ki mehnat se apna swadeshi cryogenic engine banaya, jiski pehli badi safalta 2014 me GSLV-D5 ki udaan se mili.
Chandrayaan-3 ka rover Pragyan kitne din kaam ke liye bana tha?

Pragyan rover ek chand-diwasi (lunar day) - matlab prithvi ke lagbhag 14 din - tak kaam karne ke liye banaya gaya tha, kyunki uske baad chand par 14 din lambi thandi raat aati hai jisme taapman bahut gir jata hai. Rover surya ki urja se chalta tha. Apne karyakaal me usne chand ki mitti me sulfur, aluminium, calcium aur lohe jaise tatvon ki pushti ki.
Duniya ke naveen saat ajube kaun se hain?

2007 me duniya bhar ke vote se chune gaye naveen saat ajube hain - Bharat ka Taj Mahal, China ki Mahan Deewar, Jordan ka Petra, Italy ka Colosseum, Mexico ka Chichen Itza, Peru ka Machu Picchu aur Brazil ki Christ the Redeemer murti. Taj Mahal ka inme shamil hona har Bharatiya ke liye garv ki baat hai.
Prachin duniya ke saat ajubo me se aaj kya bacha hai?

Prachin saat ajubo me Misr ka Giza ka Mahaan Pyramid hi aaj bacha hai. Baaki - Babylon ke latkate bagh, Olympia ki Zeus murti, Alexandria ka prakash-stambh (lighthouse), Rhodes ki vishal murti, Halicarnassus ka maqbara aur Artemis ka mandir - samay ke saath nasht ho gaye. Pyramid ki mazbooti ka ye sabse bada saboot hai.
China ki Mahan Deewar kitni lambi hai?

China ki Mahan Deewar ki kul lambai saari shakhaon sahit lagbhag 21,000 kilometer se zyada hai. Ye ek din me nahi bani - kai vanshon ne sainkadon saalon me ise uttar ke hamlo se raksha ke liye banaya. Ye duniya ki sabse lambi manav-nirmit rachna hai.
Kya China ki Mahan Deewar chand se dikhai deti hai?

Nahi, ye ek prasiddh bhram (mithak) hai. Mahan Deewar bahut lambi zaroor hai, lekin bahut patli hai - antariksh se nangi aankh se ye nahi dikhti. Antariksh yatriyon ne bhi iski pushti ki hai. Isi tarah ke bhramon ko hamesha tathyon se parakhna chahiye.
Taj Mahal ke baare me khaas baatein batao.

Taj Mahal Agra me Yamuna nadi ke kinare safed sangmarmar se bana hai. Shah Jahan ne ise apni patni Mumtaz Mahal ki yaad me 1632 se 1653 ke beech banwaya tha. Subah, shaam aur chaandni raat me iska rang badalta sa lagta hai. Ye 1983 se UNESCO vishwa dharohar hai aur iske mukhya vastukar ko Ustad Ahmad Lahori mana jata hai.
Qutub Minar ki khaas baat kya hai?

Delhi ki Qutub Minar lagbhag 73 meter unchi hai - ye eent se bani duniya ki sabse unchi minaron me se hai. Iski neev Qutubuddin Aibak ne rakhi thi aur Iltutmish ne ise pura kiya. Isi parisar me sthit Lohe ka Stambh lagbhag 1,600 saal purana hai aur us par aaj tak jang (rust) nahi laga - ye prachin Bharat ki dhatu kala ka chamatkar hai.
Statue of Unity kahan hai aur kitni unchi hai?

Statue of Unity Gujarat ke Kevadia me Narmada nadi ke kinare sthit Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ki murti hai. Ye 182 meter unchi hai - duniya ki sabse unchi murti. Iska anavaran 2018 me hua tha. Iske shilpkar Ram V. Sutar hain. Murti ke liye desh bhar ke kisano se lohe ke auzaar ikatthe kiye gaye the.
Duniya ki sabse unchi imarat kaun si hai?

Duniya ki sabse unchi imarat Dubai ki Burj Khalifa hai, jiski unchai 828 meter hai (160 se zyada manzila). Ye 2010 me khuli thi. Iski unchai ka andaza isse lagao ki ye Qutub Minar se 11 guna se bhi zyada unchi hai.
Eiffel Tower ke baare me batao.

Eiffel Tower Paris (France) me sthit lohe ki prasiddh minar hai, jo 1889 me ek vishwa mele ke liye banayi gayi thi. Iske nirmata Gustave Eiffel the. Lagbhag 330 meter unchi ye minar shuru me asthaayi banayi gayi thi, lekin itni lokpriya hui ki aaj ye Paris aur France ki pehchan hai.
Statue of Liberty kahan hai aur iska itihaas kya hai?

Statue of Liberty New York (America) ke bandargah ke paas ek dweep par sthit hai. Ye murti France ne 1886 me America ko swatantrata ki shatabdi par upahaar me di thi. Iske shilpkar Bartholdi the aur andar ka lohe ka dhancha Gustave Eiffel ne banaya tha. Ye aaj swatantrata ka vishwa-prateek hai.
Giza ka Sphinx kya hai?

Sphinx Misr ke Giza me sthit ek vishal murti hai, jiska shareer sher ka aur sir insaan ka hai. Ye ek hi vishal chattan ko kaatkar banayi gayi mani jati hai aur pyramidon ki raksha ke liye banayi gayi thi. Iski naak tooti hui hai, jiske kaaran par kai kathaayein prasiddh hain.
Hawa Mahal kahan hai aur isme kitne jharokhe hain?

Hawa Mahal Jaipur (Rajasthan) me hai, jo 1799 me Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh ne banwaya tha. Isme 953 chhote jharokhe (khidkiyan) hain, jinse thandi hawa andar aati thi aur raj-parivar ki mahilayein bina dikhai diye bahar ka drishya dekh sakti thi. Iska aakar mukut jaisa hai.
Charminar kahan aur kab bana tha?

Charminar Hyderabad me hai, jo 1591 me Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah ne banwaya tha. Iske chaar unche minar iski pehchan hain. Kaha jata hai ki ye naye shahar Hyderabad ke kendra ke roop me aur plauge ke ant ki khushi me banaya gaya tha. Aas-paas ka Laad Bazaar choodiyon ke liye prasiddh hai.
Gateway of India kahan hai?

Gateway of India Mumbai me samudra kinare sthit ek vishal pravesh-dwar jaisi imarat hai. Iski neev 1911 me England ke Raja George V ke Bharat aagman par rakhi gayi thi aur ye 1924 me bankar taiyar hua. Dilchasp baat - 1948 me Bharat chhodne wale aakhiri angrez sainik bhi yahi se jahaaz par sawaar hue the.
India Gate ke baare me batao.

India Gate Delhi me sthit 42 meter uncha vijay-stambh jaisa smarak hai, jo pehle vishwa yuddh me shahid hue Bharatiya sainiko ki yaad me banaya gaya tha. Iske vastukar Edwin Lutyens the. Iske neeche lambe samay tak 'Amar Jawan Jyoti' jalti rahi, jo baad me Rashtriya Yuddh Smarak ki jyoti me vilin kar di gayi.
Lal Qila (Red Fort) ki khaas baat kya hai?

Delhi ka Lal Qila Shah Jahan ne 1648 me banwaya tha - ye lagbhag 200 saalon tak Mughal badshahon ka nivas raha. Ye laal balua patthar se bana hai, isliye iska naam Lal Qila pada. Har saal 15 August ko Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri yahi se jhanda fehrate hain aur desh ko sambodhit karte hain.
Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib) ki khaas baat kya hai?

Amritsar ka Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib) Sikhon ka sabse pavitra sthal hai. Ye ek pavitra sarovar ke beech bana hai aur is par sone ki parat chadhi hai. Yahan ka langar duniya ke sabse bade muft bhojanalayon me se hai - roz hazaron log bina kisi bhedbhav ke ek saath baithkar bhojan karte hain. Gurudware ke chaar darwaze sab dishaon se aane walon ke swagat ka prateek hain.
Ajanta aur Ellora ki gufayein kyun prasiddh hain?

Maharashtra ki Ajanta gufayein apni prachin Buddhist chitrakala ke liye duniya bhar me prasiddh hain - ye rang aur rekhaein 2,000 saal baad bhi jeevant hain. Ellora ka Kailasa mandir ek hi vishal chattan ko upar se kaat-kaat kar banaya gaya hai - ye Rashtrakuta kaal ki adbhut kala hai. Dono UNESCO vishwa dharohar hain.
Konark ka Surya Mandir kaisa hai?

Odisha ka Konark Surya Mandir (13vi sadi) ek vishal rath ke aakar me bana hai, jisme 24 nakashdaar pahiye aur 7 ghode bane hain - mano Surya dev ka rath ho. Ye Kalinga vastukala ka shandar udaharan hai aur UNESCO vishwa dharohar hai. Ise 'Black Pagoda' bhi kaha gaya tha, kyunki samudra kinare se ye kaala dikhai deta tha.
Sanchi Stupa kisne banwaya tha?

Madhya Pradesh ka Sanchi Stupa samrat Ashok ke samay (3ri sadi BCE) banana shuru hua tha. Ye Buddha ke avasheshon par bana ek vishal ghumavdar stupa hai. Iske chaar nakashdaar pravesh dwar (torana) Buddha ke jeevan ki kathayein bina unki murti dikhaye - prateekon se - samjhate hain. Ye bhi UNESCO vishwa dharohar hai.
Mount Everest ki unchai kitni hai aur is par pehle kaun chadha?

Mount Everest duniya ki sabse unchi choti hai - iski unchai 8,848.86 meter hai. Nepal me ise Sagarmatha aur Tibet me Chomolungma kehte hain. Is par pehli safal chadhai 29 May 1953 ko Edmund Hillary (New Zealand) aur Tenzing Norgay (Bharat/Nepal ke Sherpa) ne ki thi.
Everest chadhne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila kaun thi?

Bachendri Pal Everest chadhne wali pehli Bharatiya mahila hain - unhone ye karnama 23 May 1984 ko kiya tha. Unse pehle 1965 me Captain Avtar Singh Cheema Everest chadhne wale pehle Bharatiya bane the. Bachendri Pal ko Padma Shri aur Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya gaya hai.
Duniya ki sabse lambi nadi kaun si hai?

Aam taur par Nile (Neel) nadi ko duniya ki sabse lambi nadi mana jata hai - lagbhag 6,650 kilometer. Ye Africa me behti hai aur Misr ki sabhyata iske kinare hi phali-phooli. Paani ki matra (behav) ke hisab se sabse badi nadi Dakshin America ki Amazon hai, jiske aas-paas duniya ka sabse bada varsha-van hai.
Duniya ka sabse uncha jharna aur sabse gehra samudri sthan kaun sa hai?

Duniya ka sabse uncha jharna Venezuela ka Angel Falls hai, jiski unchai lagbhag 979 meter hai. Samudra ka sabse gehra sthan Prashant Mahasagar ki Mariana Trench hai, jiski gehraai lagbhag 11 kilometer hai - wahan Mount Everest ko dubo diya jaye to bhi uski choti paani se 2 kilometer neeche rahegi.
Petra aur Machu Picchu kya hain?

Petra Jordan ka prachin shahar hai, jo gulabi-laal chattanon ko kaatkar banaya gaya tha - isliye ise 'Rose City' kehte hain. Machu Picchu Peru me pahaado ki unchai par sthit Inca sabhyata ka prachin shahar hai, jo 15vi sadi me bana aur saikdon saal tak duniya se chhupa raha. Dono aaj naveen saat ajubo me shamil hain.

Java program chalane ke steps kya hai, pehle compile hota hai kya?

Haan, Java me 2 steps hote hain:

1. **Compile:** `javac Hello.java` — ye code ko bytecode me badalta hai aur `Hello.class` file ban ti hai
2. **Run:** `java Hello` — JVM us bytecode ko chalata hai

Isi liye Java ko "compile bhi hota hai aur interpret bhi" kaha jata hai. Bytecode ki wajah se wahi program Windows, Linux, Mac — har jagah chal jata hai.
JVM, JRE aur JDK me kya farak hai simple bhasha me batao

Teeno ko ek line me samjho:

- **JVM (Java Virtual Machine):** Java program ko chalane wali machine (software). Bytecode ko padh kar run karti hai.
- **JRE (Java Runtime Environment):** JVM + ready-made libraries. Sirf program *chalana* ho to JRE kaafi hai.
- **JDK (Java Development Kit):** JRE + compiler (javac) aur tools. Program *banana* hai to JDK chahiye.

Yaad rakho: JDK ⊃ JRE ⊃ JVM — programmer hamesha JDK install karta hai.
Java seekhna kyun faydemand hai, kahan use hoti hai ye language?

Java seekhne ki badi wajahen:

1. **Android apps** ki mukhya bhashaon me se ek hai
2. Badi companies ke **backend/server** systems zyada tar Java me bante hain
3. **Naukriyan** bahut milti hain — bank, IT companies sab Java use karte hain
4. Ek baar seekh lo to dusri languages (C#, Kotlin) aasan lagti hain

Java thodi lambi (verbose) hai par discipline sikhati hai, isiliye colleges me bhi padhai jati hai.

main method ki line public static void main samjhake batao, har shabd ka matlab

Line hai: `public static void main(String[] args)` — har shabd ka kaam:

- **public:** JVM bahar se is method ko bula sakta hai
- **static:** Bina object banaye hi chal sakta hai (program ki shuruaat me object kahan se aayega!)
- **void:** Ye method kuch return nahi karta
- **main:** Naam fix hai, JVM isi ko dhundhta hai
- **String[] args:** Bahar se diye gaye shabdon (command line arguments) ki list

Ek bhi shabd badla to JVM main ko pehchanega nahi aur program shuru hi nahi hoga.

```java

```

Chhote se bade me apne aap ho jata hai. Bade se chhote me `(type)` likhna padta hai aur dashamlav wala hissa **kaat** diya jata hai, round nahi hota.

Java me do string barabar hai ya nahi == se kyun nahi check karte?

Java ki sabse mashhoor chaal yahi hai:

```java
String a = "Ram";
String b = new String("Ram");
System.out.println(a == b);        // false! (jagah alag hai)
System.out.println(a.equals(b));   // true (shabd ek hai)
```

`==` string ke **shabdon** ko nahi, unki **memory ki jagah** ko milata hai. String hamesha `.equals()` se milao — ye andar ke akshar check karta hai. Capital-chhota ignore karna ho to `equalsIgnoreCase()` hai.

Java Python se tez kyun hoti hai, compile hone ka fayda kya hai?

Wajah mashin-bhasha se doori ki hai:

- **Java** pehle compile hokar bytecode banta hai, phir JVM use chalate samay mashin code me badal deta hai (JIT). Program chalne se pehle hi bahut kaam ho chuka hota hai, isiliye tez.
- **Python** har line ko chalate samay padhta hai (interpreter), isiliye dheema.

Fayda Java ka: bade aur lambe chalne wale program tez. Keemat: likhne me zyada samay aur har badlav par dobara compile. Python ulta hai — likhna jaldi, chalna dheema.
Java me semicolon bhool jane par kya hota hai, har line ke aakhir me kyun lagta hai?

Java me semicolon `;` line ka **purna viram** hai — compiler ko batata hai ki statement yahan khatm hua:

```java
System.out.println("Hello")   // ; gayab
System.out.println("World");
```

Compiler error dega: `';' expected`. Kyunki bina semicolon ke use samajh nahi aata pehli baat kahan khatm hui. Ye shuru me sabse zyada aane wali galti hai — ghabrana mat, error me line number bhi likha aata hai, wahi jaakar dekho.
Java me class ka naam aur file ka naam alag rakhne par kya error aata hai?

Public class ka naam aur file ka naam ek hona Java ka sakht niyam hai:

```java
// File ka naam: Test.java
public class Demo {   // galti: naam Demo, file Test
}
```

Error aayega: `class Demo is public, should be declared in a file named Demo.java`

Ilaaj 2 hai: ya file ka naam Demo.java kar do, ya class ka naam Test kar do. Shuruaat me har dusra learner is error se takrata hai.
NullPointerException kya hota hai Java me, sabse aam error samjhao

Ye Java ka sabse mashhoor error hai. Matlab: tumne ek khali (null) cheez par kaam karne ki koshish ki:

```java
String naam = null;
System.out.println(naam.length());  // NullPointerException!
```

`naam` me asal string hai hi nahi (null = kuch nahi), to length kahan se milegi. Jaise khali pate par khana dhundhna. Bachne ka tareeka: use karne se pehle check karo `if (naam != null)`, aur variable ko shuru me hi sahi value do.
Java me cannot find symbol error ka matlab kya hota hai?

`cannot find symbol` matlab compiler ko wo naam mila hi nahi jo tumne likha. Aam wajahen:

1. **Spelling galti:** `System.out.prinln` likh diya (println ki jagah)
2. **Variable pehle banaya hi nahi** — bina banaye use kar diya
3. **Capital-chhota uljhan:** Java case-sensitive hai, `string` nahi `String` hota hai
4. **Import bhoolna:** Scanner use kiya par `import java.util.Scanner;` nahi likha

Java ke hisaab wale (arithmetic) operators:

```java
int a = 17, b = 5;
System.out.println(a + b);  // 22 jod
System.out.println(a - b);  // 12 ghatav
System.out.println(a * b);  // 85 guna

```

Comparison ka jawab hamesha boolean (true/false) hota hai:

```java
int a = 10, b = 20;
System.out.println(a == b);  // false (barabar?)
System.out.println(a != b);  // true  (alag?)
System.out.println(a < b);   // true
System.out.println(a >= 10); // true
```

Sabse aam galti: `==` ki jagah `=` likh dena. `=` matlab value rakhna (assignment), `==` matlab milana (comparison). Ek nishan ka farak, ghanto ki pareshaani.
Java me Math class ke useful methods batao sqrt, pow, max, random

`Math` class me tayyar hisaab ke dabbe hain:

```java
System.out.println(Math.sqrt(25));       // 5.0 (vargmool)
System.out.println(Math.pow(2, 10));     // 1024.0 (power)
System.out.println(Math.max(10, 20));    // 20
System.out.println(Math.min(10, 20));    // 10
System.out.println(Math.abs(-15));       // 15 (negative ko positive)
System.out.println(Math.random());       // 0.0 se 1.0 ke beech koi bhi number
```

Dhyan do: sqrt aur pow ka jawab double me aata hai. `Math.random()` game aur OTP type ke kaamo me bahut use hota hai — 1 se 100 tak ka number chahiye to `(int)(Math.random() * 100) + 1`.

Wajah bytecode hai:

1. Tum code likhte ho (.java)
2. Compiler use **bytecode** (.class) me badalta hai — ye kisi ek mashin ki bhasha nahi hai
3. Har system (Windows, Linux, Mac) ka apna JVM hota hai jo usi bytecode ko padh leta hai

Matlab ek baar likha program har jagah chal jata hai — bas wahan JVM hona chahiye. C/C++ me har system ke liye alag compile karna padta tha, Java ne wahi jhanjhat khatm ki.
Java me garbage collection kya hota hai, memory saaf kaun karta hai?

Garbage collection matlab: jo object ab kisi kaam ka nahi raha, uski memory Java khud khali kar deta hai.

```java
Student s = new Student("Ram");
// ... baad me
s = null;   // ab wo object bekaar, GC use hata dega
```

C/C++ me programmer ko khud memory khali karni padti thi — bhool jaye to memory leak. Java me ye kaam JVM ka Garbage Collector sambhalta hai, isiliye Java program zyada surakshit aur aasan bante hain.
Java me package kya hota hai, java.util.Scanner me util kya hai?

Package matlab classon ka folder (dabba) — milti-julti classen ek saath:

```java
import java.util.Scanner;   // java -> util -> Scanner
```

- `java.lang` — sabse basic classen (String, Math) — ye apne aap import hoti hain
- `java.util` — kaam ki classen (Scanner, ArrayList, Random)
- `java.io` — file padhna-likhna

Apna package banane ke liye file ki pehli line me `package merapacket;` likhte hain. Package se naam takrane ka dar khatm hota hai — do alag packet me ek naam ki class reh sakti hai.

`public, private, class, static, void, int, if, else, for, while, return, new, this, extends, try, catch, final, switch, case, break, continue, boolean, double, char, long, import, package` — kul lagbhag 50 keyword hain.

Java me access modifier public private protected ka matlab kya hai?

Ye tay karte hain ki class ki cheez ko kaun haath laga sakta hai:

- **public:** sab ke liye khula (main method isiliye public hai)
- **private:** sirf usi class ke andar (data ki suraksha ke liye)
- **protected:** class aur uske bachche (inheritance wale) ke liye
- **kuch na likho (default):** sirf usi package ke andar

Niyam saral hai: data ko private rakho, method ko zaroorat ke hisaab se public. Yahi encapsulation ki neev hai.

1. **JDK (Java Development Kit):** Oracle ya OpenJDK ki site se free milta hai. Isme compiler (javac) aur JVM dono aate hain. Install ke baad terminal me `java -version` likh kar check kar sakte ho.
2. **IDE (likhne wala software):** Shuruaat me **IntelliJ IDEA** ya **Eclipse** ya **VS Code** — ye galtiyan rang se dikhate hain aur code pura karne me madad (auto-complete) karte hain.

Pehle din ke liye online compiler bhi chalta hai, par asal seekhna apne computer par JDK laga kar hi hota hai.

Bechne/share karne par aksar .class (ya uski jar) di jati hai taaki asal code na dikhe. Aur chalane ke liye hamesha .class hi chahiye hoti hai — `java Hello` likhne par JVM Hello.class hi uthata hai.

Java me program compile hota hai par chalta nahi, dono error me farak batao

Do tarah ki galti hoti hai:

1. **Compile error:** Code ke niyam toote — semicolon gayab, bracket band nahi, naam galat. Program **chalu hi nahi** hota. Error me file aur line number milta hai.
2. **Runtime error:** Niyam sahi, par chalate samay hadsa — zero se bhag (ArithmeticException), khali par kaam (NullPointerException), array ke bahar (ArrayIndexOutOfBounds). Program **beech me ruk** jata hai.

Aur ek teesri chhupi hui: **logic error** — program chalta hai, error nahi, par jawab galat. Ye sabse mushkil hai kyunki dhundhna khud padta hai, chhote hisaab haath se karke milao.

Hisaab me 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004 kyun aata hai JavaScript me

Ye JavaScript ki nahi, har computer ki baat hai — dashamlav number andar do ke hisaab (binary) me rakhe jate hain aur kuch number pure nahi bante:

```javascript
console.log(0.1 + 0.2);                    // 0.30000000000000004
console.log((0.1 + 0.2).toFixed(2));       // '0.30' — dikhane ke liye thik
console.log(Math.round((0.1 + 0.2) * 100) / 100);  // 0.3 — hisaab ke liye
```

Paise ke hisaab me ye galti mehngi pad sakti hai — isliye bade apps paise ko rupaye me nahi, **paise (sabse chhoti ikai)** me rakhte hain: 10.50 rupaye = 1050 paise, pura number, koi dashamlav nahi.

Daamo ki list me saare daamo ka kul jod chahiye — kaunsa function lagega map filter ya reduce

Pehchan ka niyam pehle, phir code:

- Har item **badalna** hai, ginati utni hi → **map**
- Kuch item **chhatne** hain → **filter**
- Puri list ka **ek jawab** chahiye → **reduce**

```javascript
let daam = [100, 600, 250, 900];
daam.map(function(d) { return d * 2; });            // dugne
daam.filter(function(d) { return d > 500; });       // bade wale
daam.reduce(function(j, d) { return j + d; }, 0);   // kul jod
```

Teeno me asal list nahi badalti (reduce to ek number deta hai). Jawab naye variable me rakho — yahi woh teen hathiyaar hain jinse list ka 90% kaam ho jata hai.

Element ko beech me ya kisi khaas jagah par jodne ke tareeke — append prepend before after me farak

Char tareeke, chaar jagah:

```javascript
let dabba = document.getElementById('dabba');
let naya = document.createElement('p');
naya.textContent = 'Naya';
dabba.append(naya);   // dabbe ke ANDAR, aakhir me
dabba.prepend(naya);  // dabbe ke ANDAR, shuru me
dabba.before(naya);   // dabbe ke BAHAR, pehle
dabba.after(naya);    // dabbe ke BAHAR, baad me
```

Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: append/prepend andar ki baat hai (child banta hai), before/after bahar ki (bhai-behen banta hai). Ek hi element ko do jagah nahi jod sakte — dusri jagah jodne par wo pehli jagah se hat jayega.

Function se kuch return karna bhool jaye to undefined kyun milta hai

Return nahi to jawab hamesha undefined:

```javascript
function jodoGalat(a, b) { let j = a + b; }
console.log(jodoGalat(2, 3));   // undefined
function jodoSahi(a, b) { return a + b; }
console.log(jodoSahi(2, 3));    // 5
```

Andar hisaab kar lena kaafi nahi — jawab bahar bhejna `return` ka kaam hai. `console.log` dikhata hai, `return` deta hai; dono alag kaam hain, yehi bhool sabse zyada hoti hai.

Daamo ki list me saare daam dugne karne hain — kaunsa function lagega map filter ya reduce

Pehchan ka niyam pehle, phir code:

- Har item **badalna** hai, ginati utni hi → **map**
- Kuch item **chhatne** hain → **filter**
- Puri list ka **ek jawab** chahiye → **reduce**

```javascript
let daam = [100, 600, 250, 900];
daam.map(function(d) { return d * 2; });            // dugne
daam.filter(function(d) { return d > 500; });       // bade wale
daam.reduce(function(j, d) { return j + d; }, 0);   // kul jod
```

Teeno me asal list nahi badalti (reduce to ek number deta hai). Jawab naye variable me rakho — yahi woh teen hathiyaar hain jinse list ka 90% kaam ho jata hai.

Ek = matlab rakhna, do == matlab tulna:

```javascript
let x = 5;

```

Ye galti error bhi nahi deti — code chalta hai par galat chalta hai, isliye sabse khatarnak hai. Hamesha `===` use karo; ek wala = sirf value rakhne ke liye hai.

Dikhne me ek jaise, kaam alag:

```javascript
let naam = ['Ravi', 'Seema'];
naam.forEach(function(n) { console.log('Namaste ' + n); });  // sirf kaam kiya, kuch wapas nahi
```

Niyam yaad rakho: **jawab chahiye to map, sirf kaam karna hai to forEach.** forEach ka jawab pakadne ki koshish karna aam galti hai — wo `undefined` deta hai.

setTimeout aur setInterval me farak aur dono ke sahi istemal batao

Ek baar vs baar-baar:

```javascript
setTimeout(function() { alert('3 second baad ek baar'); }, 3000);
let t = setInterval(function() { console.log('har 1 second'); }, 1000);
```

Samay hamesha millisecond me hota hai (3000 = 3 second). Interval ko band karna bhoolna sabse aam galti hai — ghadiyaan dugni tez bhagne lagti hain kyunki do interval chal padte hain.

Math ke kaam ke function — round floor ceil abs ek saath samjhao

```javascript
console.log(Math.round(4.6));   // 5 — paas wala pura number
console.log(Math.floor(4.9));   // 4 — hamesha neeche
console.log(Math.ceil(4.1));    // 5 — hamesha upar
console.log(Math.abs(-7));      // 7 — minus hatakar
```

Yaad rakho: round aadhe par upar jata hai (4.5 → 5). Paise me round, umar me floor, dibbo ki ginati (5.1 dibbe chahiye to 6) me ceil — har ek ki jagah alag hai.

```javascript

let wapas = JSON.parse(text);      // phir se object

```

Yaad karne ka tareeka: `stringify` = string (text) banana, `parse` = padh kar object banana. localStorage aur server — dono jagah data text bankar jata hai, isliye ye jodi har jagah lagegi.

Kisi zamane me ek gaon me ek gareeb par mehnati parivaar rehta tha.
Is katha ka kendra tha ek nek dil lakadhaara.

Waqt mushkil tha, par ummeed abhi baaki thi.
Sadhu ne use ek nayi mazboot kulhaadi aur kuch anaaj diya, ye kehkar ki imaandaar ki madad karna unka niyam hai..
Lakadhaara ne mehnat se apni haalat sudhaari aur har saal sadhu ke naam par gareebon ko anaaj baantne laga..
Katha sikhati hai: Imaandaari ka phal der se mile, par milta zaroor hai..

Pita ne ek-ek lakdi sabko todne ko di — sabne aasani se tod di. Phir lakdiyon ka gatthar diya — koi na tod saka..
Pehle to sabko laga ki ye samasya kabhi suljhegi hi nahi.
Pita bole, 'Tum sab in lakdiyon jaise ho. Alag rahe to har koi tod dega, saath rahe to koi nahi.'.
Us din se saaton bhai milkar rehne lage aur unka parivaar gaon ka sabse mazboot parivaar ban gaya..
Lok-katha sikhati hai: Ekta hi parivaar ki asal taakat hai..
Gaon ke buddhe aaj bhi chaupal par ye katha sunate hain.
Mujhe ek dadi-nani wali kahani sunao

Bahut purani baat hai, ek rajya me ek raja rehta tha jo apni praja ka bahut khayal rakhta tha.

Bahu ne kaha, 'Killi dono ki hai. Subah ek parivaar, shaam ko dusra — aur beech ka samay khet ke liye.' Dono taraf ke log pehle chaunke..
Waqt mushkil tha, par ummeed abhi baaki thi.
Usne ye bhi kaha, 'Jo pehle ladna band karega, uske ghar aaj mere haath ki kheer jayegi.' Hasne ke saath jhagda wahin khatm ho gaya..
Us din ke baad gaon me har jhagde me log kehte, 'Pehle bahu ki salah lo, phir ladna.'.
Lok-katha ka saar: Ladai se bada koi nahi banta, samjhota karne wala sabse bada hota hai..
Us samay ke log is katha ko apne baccho ko sone se pehle sunaya karte the.
Ek achhi si hasya kahani sunao

Diwali ka tyohar aane wala tha. Poora mohalla diyon ki roshni se saj raha tha aur hawa me mithaas aur naye kapde ki khushboo thi.
Kabir, ek samajhdaar ladka, is baar tyohar ko kuch khaas tareeke se manana chahta tha.

aam ke pedon wala gaon me ek chhoti si ladki rehti thi. Uska naam tha Pihu. Pihu ko nayi-nayi cheezein khojna bahut pasand tha.

Pehla graahak khaate hi 'ye jalebi to nachti hai!' kehkar paani ki taraf bhaaga.
Aas-paas khade log pehle chaunke, phir unke chehre par muskaan phail gayi.

Dusre din vah machhli 'haathi jitni' ho gayi aur teesre din 'poora pahad jitni'.

Buddhe Ramu kaka bole, 'Gappu, machhli ko roko, warna agle hafte woh poora gaon nigal jayegi'.
Bacche to bacche, buddhe bhi pet pakadkar hasne lage.
