Neend puri karna kyun zaroori hai?

Puri neend se dimaag taaza rehta hai, yaaddasht aur dhyaan behtar hota hai, shareer din bhar ki thakaan se ubarta hai aur bimaariyon se ladne ki taakat bani rehti hai. Neend kam ho to chidchidapan, dhyaan bhatakna aur thakaan rehti hai — ye aam sehat jaankari hai.
Roz kitne ghante sona chahiye?

Aam taur par bade logo ke liye 7-9 ghante, school ke bachon ke liye 9-11 ghante aur chhote bachon ke liye isse bhi zyada neend sahi mani jati hai. Ginati se zyada zaroori hai ki neend gehri ho aur uthne par taazgi lage.
Achhi neend ke liye kya aadatein banaye?

Roz ek hi samay par sone-jaagne ki koshish karo, sone se 1 ghanta pehle mobile/TV band karo, kamra andhera aur thanda rakho, raat ko bhaari khana aur chai-coffee der se mat lo, aur din me thodi dhoop aur chalna bhi neend ko behtar karta hai.
Paani peena sehat ke liye kyun achha hai?

Shareer ka bada hissa paani hai — paani khana pachane, shareer ka taapman theek rakhne, aur gandagi bahar nikalne me madad karta hai. Paani kam peene se thakaan, sir dard aur kabz jaisi aam shikayatein ho sakti hain.
Ek din me kitna paani peena chahiye?

Aam salah hai ki bada aadmi din me lagbhag 2.5-3 litre (8-12 glass) paani piye; garmi, kaam aur pasine ke hisaab se zyada bhi lag sakta hai. Pyaas lagna shareer ka sanket hai — use nazarandaaz mat karo. Rang halka peela peshaab sahi matra ka aasan sanket hai.
Paani peene ki aadat kaise dale, bhool jata hoon?

Paas me bottle rakho aur use khatam karne ka lakshya banao, subah uthte hi ek glass paani piyo, har khane ke saath paani rakho, aur mobile me yaad-dihani (reminder) laga lo. Ek saath zyada peene ki jagah din bhar thoda-thoda peena behtar hai.
Roz chalna (walk) sehat ke liye kyun faydemand hai?

Chalna sabse aasan kasrat hai — isse dil aur khoon ka daura behtar rehta hai, wazan santulan me madad milti hai, khana pachne me asaani hoti hai aur mann bhi halka rehta hai. Iske liye koi samaan ya khaas jagah nahi chahiye.
Roz kitna chalna chahiye?
Aam salah hai din me kam se kam 30 minute tez chalna, ya lagbhag 8,000-10,000 kadam. Shuruaat me jitna ho sake utne se shuru karo — 10 minute bhi roz ka fayda deta hai, dheere-dheere badhao.
Chalne ki aadat kaise banaye agar time nahi milta?

Chhoti doori par paidal jao, seedhi (stairs) ka istemal karo, phone par baat karte hue chalo, khane ke baad 10 minute ki sair aadat banao. Time ko tukdon me baantna bhi chalega — subah 10, dopahar 10, shaam 10 minute.
Roz exercise karne ke kya fayde hain?

Niyamit exercise se manspeshiyan aur haddiyan majboot rehti hain, dil sehatmand rehta hai, neend aur mood behtar hota hai, aur lambe samay tak shareer sakriya (active) bana rehta hai. Ye aam sehat jaankari hai, kisi bimari ka ilaaj nahi.
Shuruaat karne wale ke liye kaunsi exercise sahi hai?
Shuruaat halki se karo — chalna, halki stretching, aasan yoga aasan, saikil chalana. Pehle hafte me hi zyada zor mat do; shareer ko aadat padne do. Koi purani takleef ho to pehle doctor ki salah lo.
Exercise roz kitni der karni chahiye?
Aam salah hai hafte me kam se kam 150 minute madhyam kasrat (jaise tez chalna) — matlab roz lagbhag 30 minute, 5 din. Roj thoda-thoda karna, kabhi-kabhi bahut zyada karne se behtar hai.
Mobile zyada dekhne se aankhon ko kya nuksan hota hai?

Der tak screen dekhne se aankhen thakti hain, sukhapan aur jalan mehsoos ho sakti hai, aur palak jhapakna kam ho jata hai. Ye aam jaankari hai — lagatar takleef ho to aankh ke doctor ko dikhana chahiye.
Aankhon ko screen se bachane ke kya tareeke hain?
20-20-20 niyam apnao: har 20 minute me 20 second ke liye door (lagbhag 20 feet) dekho. Screen aankh se ek haath ki doori par rakho, kamre me roshni theek rakho, aur baar-baar palak jhapkao.
Bachon ko mobile kitna dena chahiye?

Chhote bachon ko screen bahut kam dena chahiye aur bade bachon ke liye bhi samay tay karke do — padhai, khel aur neend ka samay screen se pehle aata hai. Khana khate samay aur sone se pehle mobile door rakhna achhi aadat hai.
Subah jaldi uthne ke kya fayde hain?

Subah jaldi uthne se din ki shuruaat shaanti se hoti hai, padhai-kaam ke liye extra samay milta hai, aur neend ka chakra (cycle) theek rehta hai. Subah ki taazi hawa aur dhoop bhi mann ko taaza karti hai.
Jaldi uthne ki aadat kaise dale?
Ek din me hi 2 ghante pehle uthne ki koshish mat karo — roz 15 minute pehle ka alarm lagao. Raat ko samay par sona iski pehli shart hai. Alarm ghadi ko bistar se door rakho taaki uthna hi pade.
Subah uth kar sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
Ek glass paani piyo, thoda khuli hawa/dhoop lo, halki stretching ya sair karo. Uthte hi mobile dekhne se bacho — din ki shuruaat apne kaam se karo, duniya ki khabron se nahi.
Haath dhona kyun zaroori hai?

Haathon par din bhar me bahut keetanu (germs) lag jate hain — wahi haath munh, aankh aur khane tak jate hain. Sabun se haath dhona aam bimaariyon se bachne ka sabse aasan aur sasta tareeka mana jata hai.
Haath kab-kab dhone chahiye?
Khana khane aur banane se pehle, shauch ke baad, bahar se ghar aane par, khaansne-chheekne ke baad, aur kisi bimar ki dekhbhal ke baad haath zarur dho. Bachon ko ye aadat khaas taur par sikhao.
Haath sahi tareeke se kaise dhoye?

Paani se geela karke sabun lagao, kam se kam 20 second tak hatheli, peeche, ungliyon ke beech aur naakhunon ke neeche ragdo, phir saaf paani se dho kar sukhe kapde se pochho. Sabun na ho to paani se achhi tarah dhona bhi kuch had tak kaam karta hai.
Daant saaf rakhna kyun zaroori hai?
Daanton me fase khane ke hisse sadne se munh ki badboo, masudon ki takleef aur daant kharab hote hain. Saaf daant khana chabane aur bolne me bhi madad karte hain — aur muskurahat bhi achhi lagti hai.
Daant din me kitni baar brush karne chahiye?
Roz do baar — subah uthkar aur raat ko sone se pehle — naram brush se lagbhag 2 minute brush karo. Raat wala brush sabse zaroori hai kyunki raat bhar munh sukha rehta hai.
Daanton ki dekhbhal ke aur kya tareeke hain?

Meetha aur chipchipa khana kam karo, khane ke baad kulli karo, brush ko 3-4 mahine me badlo, aur saal me ek baar dentist ko dikhana achhi aadat hai. Daant me dard ya khoon aaye to doctor ko dikhao, ghar par ilaaj mat karo.
Roz nahana aur safai kyun zaroori hai?
Din bhar shareer par pasina, dhool aur keetanu jamte hain. Roz nahane se twacha saaf rehti hai, badboo nahi aati aur mann bhi taaza rehta hai — safai aadhi sehat kahi jati hai.
Sardi me roz nahana chahiye kya?

Sardi me garam paani se nahana theek hai, par bahut garam paani twacha ko sukha deta hai. Zyada thand ho to ek din chhod kar nahana ya shareer ko geele kapde se pochhna bhi chal sakta hai — safai bani rehni chahiye.
Personal safai me aur kya-kya aata hai?
Naakhun samay par kaatna, baal saaf rakhna, saaf kapde pehenna, apna tauliya aur kanghi alag rakhna, aur pairon ko dho kar sukhana — ye sab roz ki safai ka hissa hai.
Khana dheere chaba kar khana kyun chahiye?

Achhi tarah chabane se khana chhota tukdon me toot jata hai aur laar (saliva) mil jati hai, jisse pet ko pachane me asaani hoti hai. Jaldi-jaldi khane se aksar zyada khaya jata hai kyunki pet ke bhare hone ka sanket dimaag tak der se pahunchta hai.
Ek niwala kitni baar chabana chahiye?
Koi pakki ginati nahi hai, par aam salah hai ki niwala tab niglo jab wo naram aur laar mila ho jaye — lagbhag 20-30 baar chabana aam hisaab hai. Asli niyam: khana munh me ghul jaisa jaye tab niglo.
Dheere khane ki aadat kaise padegi?

Khate samay mobile/TV band karo, chhota niwala lo, chammach-kaanta beech me neeche rakho, aur khane ke liye kam se kam 20 minute ka samay do. Parivaar ke saath baith kar khane se bhi gati dheere ho jati hai.
Subah ka nashta kyun zaroori mana jata hai?

Raat bhar ke upvaas ke baad shareer ko urja chahiye hoti hai. Sahi nashta karne se din ki shuruaat me dhyaan aur taakat bani rehti hai, aur dopahar me ek saath bahut zyada khane ki naubat kam aati hai.
Sehatmand nashta kaisa hona chahiye?
Nashta me kuch pet bharne wala aur kuch poshak — jaise poha, upma, idli, daliya, ande, doodh/dahi, phal. Sirf chai-biscuit ko nashta nahi kehte; meetha aur tala hua roz ke nashte me kam rakho.
Nashta chhodne se kya hota hai?
Nashta chhodne se subah thakaan, chidchidapan aur dhyaan kam ho sakta hai, aur baad me zyada khaya jata hai. Ye aam jaankari hai — agar koi khaas wajah (vrat/upvaas) ho to baat alag hai.
Roz phal khane ke kya fayde hain?

Phalon me vitamin, khanij (minerals) aur resha (fibre) hota hai jo shareer ke roz ke kaamon ke liye chahiye. Phal meetha khane ki sahi jagah le sakte hain kyunki inme prakratik mithaas ke saath poshan bhi milta hai.
Roz kitna phal khana chahiye?
Aam salah hai din me 1-2 phal (ek seb, ek kela, ya ek katora kate phal jaisa). Mausam ke taaze phal sabse achhe aur saste hote hain — aam ke mausam me aam, sardi me amrood-santra.
Phal kab khana sabse achha hota hai?
Phal khane ke turant baad ki jagah khali pet ya khano ke beech me khana aam taur par behtar mana jata hai. Raat ko der se bhaari phal khane se kuch logo ko asuvidha hoti hai — apne shareer ki suno.
Rang-birangi sabziyan kyun khani chahiye?

Alag-alag rang ki sabziyon me alag-alag poshak tatva hote hain — hari sabzi me iron aur folate, peeli-narangi me vitamin A se jude tatva, laal me lycopene jaise tatva. Thali me rang zyada matlab poshan zyada tarah ka.
Roz ki thali me kitni sabzi honi chahiye?
Aam salah hai ki thali ka lagbhag aadha hissa sabzi-salad se bhara ho aur din me 3-4 katora alag-alag sabziyan khayi jayen. Ek hi sabzi roz ki jagah badal-badal kar khao.
Bache sabzi nahi khate, kya kare?
Sabzi ko chhupa kar do — paratha me bhar kar, dal-khichdi me mila kar, soup bana kar. Zabardasti ki jagah khud kha kar dikhao, aur bachon ko sabzi kharidne-banane me shamil karo to ruchi badhti hai.
Doodh aur dahi sehat ke liye kyun achhe hain?
Doodh aur dahi me calcium aur protein hota hai jo haddiyon, daanton aur manspeshiyon ke liye chahiye. Dahi me achhe keetanu (good bacteria) bhi hote hain jo pet ke liye faydemand mane jate hain.
Roz kitna doodh ya dahi lena chahiye?
Aam taur par bade ke liye din me 1-2 glass doodh ya uske barabar dahi-paneer sahi mana jata hai; bachon ko isse zyada ki salah di jati hai. Ye aam jaankari hai, khaas sthiti me doctor ki salah lo.
Jise doodh nahi pachta, wo kya kare?
Kuch logo ko doodh pachne me takleef hoti hai — unke liye dahi, chhaas ya paneer aksar asaani se pachta hai. Ye aam jaankari hai; lagatar takleef ho to doctor ko dikhao, khud ilaaj tay mat karo.
Seedha baithna (posture) kyun zaroori hai?

Galat tareeke se der tak baithne se gardan, kandhe aur kamar par zor padta hai aur aam dard ki shikayat ho sakti hai. Seedhi peeth ke saath baithne se saans bhi achhi aati hai aur thakaan kam hoti hai.
Mobile dekhte samay posture kaise theek rakhe?
Mobile ko neeche jhuk kar dekhne ki jagah aankh ki seedh me uthao, peeth ko sahara do, aur har aadhe ghante me khade hokar halka ghumo. Jhuki gardan par sir ka bojh kai guna badh jata hai.
Kaam ki kursi par kaise baithe?
Pair zameen par pure rakho, peeth kursi se lagi ho, screen aankh ki seedh me aur ek haath ki doori par ho. Har 30-45 minute me 2 minute ka break lena aadat banao.
Gehri saans aur khuli hawa ke kya fayde hain?
Gehri saans lene se shareer ko achhi tarah oxygen milti hai aur mann shaant hota hai. Subah ki khuli, saaf hawa me kuch samay bitana taazgi deta hai — ye aam sehat jaankari hai.
Gehri saans ka aasan abhyaas kaise kare?
Shaant jagah baith kar naak se 4 ginati me saans andar lo, 2 ginati roko, 6 ginati me munh se dheere chhodo. 5-10 baar aisa karna din me kabhi bhi kiya ja sakta hai — khaas karke jab mann bechain ho.
Ghar ki hawa saaf rakhne ke liye kya kare?
Roz kuch der khidkiyan kholo taaki taazi hawa aaye, ghar me dhuaan (sigdi, agarbatti ka zyada dhuaan) kam karo, aur geeli jagah par fungus na jamne do. Ped-paudhe bhi mahaul ko behtar banate hain.
Thodi der dhoop me rehna kyun faydemand hai?
Dhoop shareer ko vitamin D banane me madad karti hai, jo haddiyon ke liye zaroori mana jata hai. Subah ki halki dhoop me kuch samay bitana din bhar ki taazgi ke liye bhi achha hota hai.
Kitni der dhoop me rehna chahiye?
Aam salah hai subah ki halki dhoop me 15-20 minute — tez dopahar ki dhoop se bachna chahiye. Zyada der tez dhoop me rehne se twacha ko nuksan ho sakta hai, isliye santulan rakho.
Dhoop me jaate samay kya dhyaan rakhe?
Paani saath rakho, sir ko topi ya gamchhe se dhako tez dhoop me, aur dopahar 12-3 ki tez dhoop me lambe samay bahar rehne se bacho — khaas karke garmiyon me.
Chai coffee zyada peene se kya hota hai?
Chai-coffee me caffeine hota hai — zyada matra me neend kharab, bechaini aur pet me jalan jaisi aam shikayatein ho sakti hain. Santulan me peene se aam taur par koi dikkat nahi hoti.
Din me kitni chai ya coffee theek hai?
Aam salah hai din me 2-3 cup chai ya 1-2 cup coffee tak seemit rakhna, aur shaam ke baad caffeine na lena taaki neend kharab na ho. Cheeni bhi kam rakho — asal bojh aksar cheeni ka hota hai.
Chai ki aadat kam kaise kare?
Ek cup kam karke shuru karo, ek chai ki jagah garam paani, nimbu paani ya chhaas lo, aur chai ko khane ke turant baad ki jagah thodi der baad piyo. Dheere-dheere kam karna zyada tikta hai.
Meetha kam khana kyun chahiye?
Zyada cheeni se khali calorie milti hai — poshan nahi. Zyada meetha khane ki aadat se wazan badhna aur daant kharab hona aam baatein hain; isliye meetha tyohar-khaas rakho, roz ki aadat nahi.
Roz kitni cheeni chalegi?
Aam salah hai ki bade aadmi ke liye din bhar ki cheeni lagbhag 6-9 chhote chammach se zyada na ho — isme khane-peene me chhupi cheeni (mithaas, cold drink, biscuit) bhi ginni hai.
Meetha khane ki ichha kaise kam kare?

Meethi cheezein ghar me kam rakho, cold drink ki jagah paani/nimbu paani lo, phal se mithaas ki aadat dalo, aur kharidari ke samay label par cheeni ki matra dekho. Ek saath band karne ki jagah dheere-dheere kam karo.
Namak kam khana kyun zaroori hai?

Khane me zyada namak ki aadat lambe samay me sehat ke liye achhi nahi mani jati. Bharatiya khane me namak aksar upar se aur achaar-papad-chips jaisi cheezon se zyada ho jata hai — santulan zaroori hai.
Ek din me kitna namak theek hai?
Aam salah hai din bhar me lagbhag 1 chhota chammach (5 gram) se zyada namak na ho — isme khane me pada aur upar se liya, dono shamil hain. Ye aam jaankari hai, khaas salah doctor se lo.
Namak kam karne ke aasan tareeke kya hain?
Upar se namak daalna band karo, achaar-papad aur packet wale namkeen kam karo, khane me nimbu, amchur, hari mirch aur masalon se swaad badhao taaki namak ki kami mehsoos na ho.
Raat ko sone se pehle mobile kyun nahi dekhna chahiye?
Screen ki roshni aur lagatar khabrein-content dimaag ko sakriya rakhti hain, jisse neend der se aati hai aur gehri bhi nahi hoti. Sone se pehle ka samay shaanti wala hona chahiye.
Sone se kitni der pehle screen band kare?
Aam salah hai sone se kam se kam 30-60 minute pehle mobile/TV band kar do. Us samay me nahana, kal ki taiyari, halki kitab padhna ya parivaar se baat karna behtar hai.
Mobile ki jagah raat ko kya kare?
Halki kitab padho, din bhar ki achhi baatein yaad karo, gehri saans ka abhyaas karo, ya kal ke kaam ki chhoti list banao. Phone ko dusre kamre me charge par rakhna sabse kaargar tareeka hai.
Khana samay par khana kyun zaroori hai?

Samay par khane se shareer ki pachan ghadi (routine) bani rehti hai, bhookh aur urja ka santulan rehta hai. Der tak bhooka rehne se phir zyada khaya jata hai aur pet me jalan jaisi aam shikayat hoti hai.
Din me khane ka sahi samay kya rakhe?
Koi ek pakka samay sabke liye nahi, par aam tareeka hai: subah 8-9 nashta, 1-2 dopahar ka khana, shaam halka naashta, raat 8-9 tak halka khana — aur roz lagbhag yahi samay rakho.
Raat ka khana der se khane se kya hota hai?
Der raat bhaari khana kha kar turant sone se pachan me asuvidha aur neend kharab ho sakti hai. Aam salah hai sone se 2-3 ghante pehle khana kha lo aur raat ka khana din ka sabse halka rakho.
Raat ko halka khana kyun khana chahiye?
Raat me shareer ki gatividhi kam hoti hai, isliye bhaari khana pachne me der lagti hai aur neend me khalal padta hai. Halka khana khaane se subah pet saaf aur shareer halka mehsoos hota hai.
Raat ke halke khane me kya-kya chalega?
Dal-chawal, khichdi, roti-sabzi, soup, daliya — ye sab halke vikalp hain. Tala hua aur bahut masaledar khana raat ko kam rakho.
Bhookh lage raat ko to kya kare?
Sone se pehle tez bhookh lage to halka kuch lo — ek glass garam doodh ya ek phal. Bhaari khana raat ko kha kar turant letna theek aadat nahi hai.
Naakhun aur pairon ki safai kyun zaroori hai?
Lambe naakhunon ke neeche gandagi aur keetanu jamte hain jo khane ke saath pet me ja sakte hain. Pairon ko saaf-sukha rakhne se badboo aur twacha ki aam takleefon se bachav hota hai.
Naakhun kitne din me kaatne chahiye?
Aam taur par hafte me ek baar naakhun kaatna sahi rehta hai — itne lambe hone hi mat do ki unme mail dikhe. Bachon ke naakhun khaas taur par samay par kaato.
Pairon ki dekhbhal kaise kare?
Roz pair dho kar ungliyon ke beech tak achhi tarah sukhao, saaf moje pehno, aur geele jute der tak mat pehno. Pair me lagatar khujli ya takleef ho to doctor ko dikhao.
Headphone tez awaaz me sunne se kya hota hai?
Der tak tez awaaz sunne se kaano ko nuksan ho sakta hai aur sunne ki taakat par asar pad sakta hai — ye dheere-dheere hota hai aur aksar pata der se chalta hai. Kaano ki suraksha aadat se banti hai.
Headphone ki awaaz kitni rakhni chahiye?
Aam niyam hai 60-60: awaaz kul ki 60% se zyada nahi, aur ek baar me 60 minute se zyada lagatar nahi — beech me break lo. Paas baitha aadmi gaana sun sake to awaaz zyada tez hai.
Kaanon ki suraksha ke aur tareeke kya hain?

Shor wali jagah (DJ, machine) me der tak rehna ho to kaan me rui/ear plug lagao, tez awaaz ke baad kaano ko aaram do, aur kaan me koi cheez daal kar saaf mat karo — takleef ho to kaan ke doctor ko dikhao.
Padhai ya kaam ke beech break kyun lena chahiye?
Lagatar kaam karne se dhyaan aur taakat dono kam hote hain. Chhote break se dimaag taaza hota hai, aankhen aur shareer ko aaram milta hai, aur wapas kaam par dhyaan zyada lagta hai.
Kitni der kaam ke baad break le?
Aam tareeka hai 25-50 minute kaam ke baad 5-10 minute ka break — khade ho, paani piyo, khidki se door dekho, halka chalo. Break me mobile chalana asal aaram nahi deta.
Break ka sahi upyog kaise kare?
Break me shareer hilaao — stretching, sair, paani. Lambe break (dopahar ke khane ke baad) me 15-20 minute ki jhapki bhi taazgi de sakti hai.
Garmi me shareer ko thanda aur surakshit kaise rakhe?

Garmi me shareer se pasine ke saath paani nikalta hai — paani ki kami se thakaan, chakkar jaisi shikayatein ho sakti hain. Sahi kapde, paani aur dhoop se bachav hi garmi ka ilaaj-jaisa bachav hai (ye aam jaankari hai).
Garmi me kya peena sabse achha hai?

Sada paani sabse achha hai; iske alawa nimbu paani (halka namak-cheeni wala), chhaas, nariyal paani aur bel ka sharbat garmi ke desi vikalp hain. Cold drink aur bahut meetha sharbat paani ki jagah nahi lete.
Loo se bachne ke kya upaay hain?
Dopahar ki tez dhoop me bahar kam niklo, niklo to sir dhako, halke sooti kapde pehno, paani saath rakho aur baar-baar peete raho. Chakkar ya ulti jaisi halat ho to turant doctor ko dikhao.
Din me chhoti jhapki (nap) lena sahi hai kya?
Dopahar ki chhoti jhapki (15-20 minute) taazgi aur dhyaan ke liye faydemand ho sakti hai — bahut se logo ki ye purani aadat hai. Lekin lambi dopahar ki neend raat ki neend kharab kar sakti hai.
Jhapki kitni lambi honi chahiye?
15-20 minute aadarsh mani jati hai; 1 ghante se zyada ki dopahar neend se uthne par susti rehti hai aur raat ko neend der se aati hai. Alarm laga kar soona achha tareeka hai.
Jhapki kab nahi leni chahiye?

Shaam ko 4 baje ke baad jhapki lene se raat ki neend par asar padta hai. Jinhe raat ko neend na aane ki shikayat hai, unhe dopahar ki neend kam ya band karke dekhna chahiye — lagatar samasya ho to doctor ki salah lo.
Doston aur parivaar se baat karna sehat ke liye kyun achha hai?

Apne logo se baat-cheet se mann halka rehta hai, akelapan kam hota hai aur mushkil samay me sahara milta hai. Khushi aur pareshaani baantne se mann par bojh kam hota hai — ye mansik sehat ki aam jaankari hai.
Mann udaas ho to kya karna chahiye?

Kisi bharosemand dost ya parivaar wale se baat karo, bahar sair karo, apni pasand ka kaam karo. Agar udaasi lambe samay tak bani rahe aur roz ke kaam par asar pade to doctor ya salahkaar (counsellor) se milna sahi kadam hai — isme koi sharm nahi.
Rishton ko samay kaise de agar kaam zyada hai?
Roz ke chhote pal hi kaafi hain — khane par saath baithna, phone par 5 minute ki baat, hafte me ek baar saath sair. Samay ki matra se zyada niyamitapan (regularity) zaroori hai.
Kitaab padhna aur dimaagi khel kyun faydemand hain?
Padhne aur sochne wale khelon se dimaag sakriya rehta hai, yaaddasht aur shabd-bhandar behtar hota hai. Jaise shareer ko kasrat chahiye, dimaag ko bhi chunauti chahiye hoti hai.
Roz kitna padhna chahiye?
Roz 20-30 minute padhna achhi shuruaat hai — kahani, akhbaar, ya apni ruchi ka vishay. Bachon ko roz padhne ki aadat chhoti umar se dalna sabse faydemand hota hai.
Dimaag tez rakhne ke aur kya tareeke hain?
Paheliyan, shatranj, sudoku, nayi cheez seekhna (bhasha, vaadya, kaushal), aur haathon se kuch banana — ye sab dimaag ko sakriya rakhte hain. Mobile par ghanton scroll karna dimaagi kasrat nahi hai.
Dhumrapaan aur sharab se door rehna kyun kaha jata hai?

Tambaku aur sharab shareer ke lagbhag har hisse ko dheere-dheere nuksan pahunchate hain aur inki latt (addiction) pad jati hai. Inse door rehna lambe aur sehatmand jeevan ki sabse badi aadat mani jati hai — ye aam sehat jaankari hai.
Jo peeta hai wo chhodna chahe to kaise shuru kare?

Pehle man me pakka iraada, phir dheere-dheere kam karna ya ek tareekh tay karke chhodna — dono tareeke chalte hain. Parivaar ko batao, saathi badlo jo peene par majboor na kare, aur mushkil ho to doctor ki madad lo — iske liye dawai aur salah dono milti hai, doctor hi batayega.
Doston ke dabav me mana kaise kare?
Saaf aur shaant shabdon me mana karo — 'main nahi peeta, mere liye chai/juice le aao.' Asli dost dabav nahi dalte. Apni sehat ka faisla apna hai, isme kisi ki narazgi se darna nahi chahiye.
Wazan santulit rakhna kyun zaroori hai?

Bahut zyada ya bahut kam wazan dono hi shareer par bojh dalte hain. Santulit wazan se chalna-phirna, kaam karna aasan rehta hai aur lambe samay ki sehat behtar rehti hai — ye aam jaankari hai, ilaaj nahi.
Wazan santulan ke aasan niyam kya hain?
Samay par santulit khana, roz 30 minute chalna-kasrat, meetha aur tala hua seemit, puri neend, aur paani paryapt. Koi jaadui totka nahi — dheere-dheere bani aadatein hi tikti hain.
Kya roz wazan tolna chahiye?

Roz tolna zaruri nahi; hafte me ek baar, subah khali pet, ek hi samay par tolna sahi rehta hai. Ek-do din ke upar-neeche par pareshan mat ho — maheene ka rujhaan (trend) dekho. Khaas salah ke liye doctor se milein.
Safar me sehat ka dhyaan kaise rakhe?
Lambe safar me baithna, khana-peena aur neend bigad jati hai. Thodi taiyari se safar aaramdayak aur surakshit banta hai — paani, halka khana aur beech-beech me hilna-dulna sabse zaroori hai.
Lambi bus/train yatra me kya kare?
Apna paani saath rakho, station ka khula khana soch kar khao (taaza aur garam ho), har kuch ghante me uth kar chalo, aur pairon ko seat par baith kar bhi hilate raho.
Safar me saath kya rakhna chahiye?

Paani ki bottle, halka nashta (phal, bhuna chana), tissue/sanitizer, aur apni roz ki zaruri cheezein. Koi niyamit dawa lete ho to wo doctor ki salah se saath rakho — main dawa ke baare me salah nahi de sakta.
Ghar ki safai ka sehat se kya sambandh hai?
Ghar me jama dhool, gandagi aur khada paani keetanu aur machcharon ko bulawa dete hain. Saaf ghar matlab kam bimaari aur taaza mahaul — safai ka seedha asar parivaar ki sehat par padta hai.
Ghar me khaas taur par kya saaf rakhna chahiye?
Rasoi aur bathroom sabse zyada dhyaan maangte hain. Kooda roz bahar, paani ki tanki aur bartan saaf, geele farsh par phisalne ka dhyaan, aur machchar wale sthan (khada paani) bilkul nahi.
Machcharon se bachav ke tareeke kya hain?
Aas-paas paani jama na hone do, khidkiyon me jaali lagao, sote samay machhardani ka istemal karo, aur poori baah ke kapde pehno shaam ko. Bukhar aaye to andaza lagane ki jagah doctor ko dikhao.
Chhoti doori ke liye paidal ya cycle kyun jana chahiye?
Gaadi ki jagah paidal/cycle se chhoti doori tay karne se roz ki kasrat apne aap ho jati hai, paisa aur petrol bachta hai, aur mann bhi taaza rehta hai — ye dohra fayda hai.
Ek din me kitna paidal chalna ho jata hai aise?
Dukaan, school, office ke chhote kaam paidal karne se aaram se 2,000-4,000 extra kadam ho jate hain — ye roz ke 8,000-10,000 kadam ke lakshya ka bada hissa hai.
Cycle chalane ke kya fayde hain?
Cycle se pairon ki kasrat hoti hai, ghatno par chalane se kam zor padta hai, aur gati paidal se tez milti hai. Chalate samay sadak ke niyam aur suraksha (helmet) ka dhyaan rakho.
Bachon ko bahar khelna kyun chahiye?
Bahar khelne se bachon ka shareer majboot hota hai, dhoop aur taazi hawa milti hai, dost bante hain aur padhai me dhyaan bhi behtar hota hai. Khel bachon ke vikas ka khana hai, samay ki barbadi nahi.
Bachon ko roz kitna khelna chahiye?
Aam salah hai school jane wale bachon ke liye din me kam se kam 1 ghanta bahar ka khel. Chhote bachon ko isse zyada sakriya samay chahiye hota hai.
Mobile ki jagah khel ki aadat kaise dale?
Khel ka samay tay karo aur khud bhi kabhi saath khelo, aas-paas ke bachon se dostी karwao, aur ghar me mobile ka samay seema rakho. Zabardasti ki jagah khel ko mazedaar banana kaam karta hai.
Mujhe bukhar hai, kaunsi dawa loon?

Main doctor nahi hoon aur dawa ke baare me salah nahi de sakta — galat dawa nuksan kar sakti hai. Bukhar ho to aaram karo, paani peete raho aur doctor ko dikhao. Tez bukhar ho, 2 din se zyada rahe, ya saans me takleef ho to turant doctor/emergency me jao.
Pet me bahut dard hai, kya karu?

Pet dard ki bahut si wajahen ho sakti hain, main ilaaj ya dawa nahi bata sakta. Halka garam paani aur aaram karke dekho, par dard tez ho, badh raha ho, ulti ho ya khoon jaisi koi baat ho to turant doctor ko dikhao — andaza lagana khatarnak ho sakta hai.
Sir me dard rehta hai, koi goli batao

Goli ka naam main nahi bata sakta — ye doctor ka kaam hai, aur sir dard ki wajah jaanne bina dawa lena theek nahi. Aaram karo, paani piyo, tez roshni-shor se bacho. Agar dard baar-baar hota hai ya bahut tez hai to doctor ko zarur dikhao.
Khansi bahut ho rahi hai, koi syrup batao

Khansi ke syrup ka naam main nahi bata sakta — khansi ki wajah ke hisaab se ilaaj alag hota hai aur ye doctor tay karta hai. Garam paani peete raho, dhuaan-dhool se bacho. Khansi 2 hafte se zyada rahe, khoon aaye ya saans phoole to turant doctor ko dikhao.
Ulti aur dast ho rahe hain, kya karu?

Main ilaaj nahi bata sakta. Ulti-dast me shareer se paani nikalta hai, isliye thoda-thoda paani peete rehna zaroori hai, aur aaram karo. Agar ruk na raha ho, chakkar aaye, bachha ya bujurg ho, to turant doctor ko dikhao — der karna theek nahi.
Chakkar aa rahe hain, wajah kya hai?

Chakkar ki wajah main nahi bata sakta — kamzori, paani ki kami, kaan ki takleef ya kuch aur bhi ho sakta hai, jaanch doctor hi karega. Baith ya let jao taaki giro nahi, paani piyo, aur chakkar baar-baar aaye ya behoshi jaisa lage to turant doctor ko dikhao.
Kamar dard ka ilaaj batao

Kamar dard ka ilaaj main nahi bata sakta aur koi dawa ya tel ka naam bhi nahi dunga — galat ilaaj takleef badha sakta hai. Bhaari samaan uthane se bacho, aaram karo. Dard pair tak jaye, sunn pade ya lambe samay rahe to doctor ko dikhao.
Daant me bahut dard hai, kya loon?

Daant dard ke liye dawa main nahi bata sakta — dentist ko dikhana hi sahi hai, kyunki dard ki wajah (sadan, infection) jaanch se hi pata chalti hai. Tab tak garam khana aur us taraf chabana kam karo. Sujan ho ya bukhar aaye to turant dentist ko dikhao.
Gale me kharash aur dard hai, ilaaj batao
Main ilaaj ya dawa nahi bata sakta. Garam paani peete raho, thandi cheezon se bacho aur awaaz ko aaram do. Agar saans lene me takleef ho, tez bukhar ho ya 3-4 din me theek na ho to doctor ko dikhao.
Aankh me jalan aur laal ho gayi hai, drop batao

Aankh ke drop ka naam main nahi bata sakta — aankh nazuk hoti hai, galat drop nuksan kar sakta hai. Aankh ko ragdo mat, saaf paani ke chhinte maar sakte ho. Dard, roshni me takleef ya dhundla dikhe to turant aankh ke doctor ko dikhao.
Shareer par daane nikal aaye hain, kya lagau?

Daane par lagane ki koi cheez ya dawa main nahi bata sakta — daane ki wajah jaanne ke liye doctor ko dikhana padega. Khujli par khujlao mat, saaf kapde pehno. Daane badh rahe hon, bukhar ho ya chehre par sujan ho to turant doctor ko dikhao.
Pair me moch aa gayi hai, ilaaj batao

Moch ka ilaaj main nahi bata sakta. Pair ko aaram do, us par bojh mat daalo aur sujan zyada ho to doctor ko dikhao — haddi ki chot bhi ho sakti hai jiski jaanch X-ray se hoti hai. Chal na pao ya sujan badhti jaye to turant doctor ke paas jao.

52 patto ki taash ki gaddi se ek patta yaadrichhik (random) roop se nikala jata hai. Uske laal baadshah hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Nadi ke kinare khade vyakti ko dusre kinare wale ped ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 30° dikhta hai. Ped usse 60 m door hai to ped ki unchai nikalo.

tan 30° = unchai/doori = unchai/60, aur tan 30° = 1/√3.
unchai = 60/√3 = 60√3/3 m ≈ 34.64 m.

tan 45° + tan 60° ÷ tan 60° ka maan gyat karo.

Niyam: Sangath kon barabar hote hain.
Isliye kon = 80°.
Jawab: 80°.
Do binduon (2, 2) aur (10, 17) ke beech ki doori gyat karo.

Doori sutra: d = √((x₂-x₁)² + (y₂-y₁)²).
d = √((8)² + (15)²) = √(64 + 225) = √289 = 17.
Jawab: doori 17 ikaai hai.
Agar sin A = 12/20 hai (A nyoon kon hai), to cos A aur tan A ke maan nikalo.

sin A = lamb/karn = 12/20, isliye lamb = 12 aur karn = 20 mano.
Pythagoras se aadhar = √(20² - 12²) = √256 = 16.
cos A = aadhar/karn = 16/20 = 4/5, tan A = lamb/aadhar = 12/16 = 3/4.
Jawab: cos A = 4/5, tan A = 3/4.
4x² - 64 ka gunankhand karo.

Ye a² - b² ke roop me hai: (2x)² - (8)².
a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b) lagane par: (2x + 8)(2x - 8).
Jawab: (2x + 8)(2x - 8).
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar 2 ka gunaaj (multiple) aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). 2 ka gunaaj (multiple) wale anukool parinaam 3 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 3/6 = 1/2.
Jawab: 1/2.
Ek AP ka pehla pad 16 aur saarv antar 4 hai. Kaunsa pad 40 hoga?

Maan lo nvaan pad 40 hai: a + (n-1)d = 40.
16 + (n-1) × 4 = 40 → (n-1) × 4 = 24 → n - 1 = 6 → n = 7.
Jawab: 40, 7vaan pad hoga.
Ek thele me 4 laal aur 3 neeli genden hain (kul 7). Ek gend bina dekhe nikali jati hai. Uske laal hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Kul genden = 7. laal genden = 4.
Sambhaavyata = 4/7 = 4/7.
Jawab: 4/7.
Ek sikka ek baar uchhala jata hai. Pat (Tail) aane ki sambhaavyata nikalo.

Kul parinaam 2 hain: Chit, Pat. Anukool parinaam 1 (Pat).
Sambhaavyata = 1/2.
Jawab: 1/2.
Do anko ki ek sankhya ke anko ka jod 6 hai. Anko ko ulta karne par bani sankhya, mool sankhya se 18 kam hoti hai. Sankhya nikalo.

Ikai ka ank y aur dahai ka ank x mano. x + y = 6.
Ank ulta karne par sankhya 9(x - y) kam hoti hai, isliye x - y = 18 ÷ 9 = 2.
Dono jodne par 2x = 6 + 2 = 8 → x = 4, y = 2.
Jawab: sankhya 42 hai.
Tribhuj ke shirsh (7, 7), (7, 5) aur (7, 3) hain. Uska kendraak (centroid) gyat karo.

Kendraak = ((x₁+x₂+x₃)/3, (y₁+y₂+y₃)/3).
= (21/3, 15/3) = (7, 5).
Jawab: kendraak (7, 5) hai.
Do rassiyon ki lambai 40 m aur 56 m hai. Dono ko bina kaate barabar ke sabse bade tukdo me kaatna hai. Har tukda kitna lamba hoga?

Sabse bada barabar tukda = dono lambaiyon ka HCF.
40 aur 56 ka HCF = 8.
Jawab: har tukda 8 m lamba hoga, aur kul 12 tukde banege.
(3x - 2)² ka vistaar sarvsamika se karo.

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² lagane par:
(3x - 2)² = (3x)² - 2×3x×2 + 2² = 9x² - 12x + 4.
Jawab: 9x² - 12x + 4.
Ek tribhuj ke kon 3 : 4 : 5 ke anupaat me hain. Sabse bada kon kitne degree ka hai?

Tribhuj ke teen kono ka jod 180° hota hai. Anupaat ka jod = 12.
Ek hissa = 180 ÷ 12 = 15°. Kon hain: 45°, 60°, 75°.
Jawab: sabse bada kon 75° hai.
36x² - 16 ka gunankhand karo.

Ye a² - b² ke roop me hai: (6x)² - (4)².
a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b) lagane par: (6x + 4)(6x - 4).
Jawab: (6x + 4)(6x - 4).
Agar sin A = √3/2 ho to kon A kitne degree ka hoga? (A nyoon kon hai)

Maanak kono ki talika se sin A = √3/2 tab hota hai jab A = 60°.
Jawab: A = 60°.
Do pase ek saath fenke jate hain. Dono par aayi sankhyaon ka yog 7 hone ki sambhaavyata nikalo.

Do paso ke kul parinaam 36 hote hain. Yog 7 banane wale jode 6 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 6/36 = 1/6.
Jawab: 1/6.
Ek tribhuj ke do antar kon 53° aur 51° hain. Teesre kon ka bahya kon (exterior angle) kitna hoga?

Bahya kon ka siddhant: bahya kon = saamne wale do antar kono ka jod.
Bahya kon = 53° + 51° = 104°.
Jawab: 104°.
Ek seedhi diwar ke sahare lagi hai. Seedhi ka neeche wala sira diwar se 10 m door hai aur upar wala sira zameen se 24 m unchai par diwar ko chhoota hai. Seedhi ki lambai nikalo.

Diwar, zameen aur seedhi samkon tribhuj banate hain.
Pythagoras se: lambai² = 10² + 24² = 100 + 576 = 676, isliye lambai = 26 m.
Jawab: seedhi 26 m lambi hai.
₹4000 par 20% vaarshik dar se 2 saal ka chakravriddhi byaj (compound interest) nikalo.

Saal 1: byaj = 4000 × 20/100 = 800, rakam = 4800
Saal 2: byaj = 4800 × 20/100 = 960, rakam = 5760
2 saal baad kul rakam = ₹5760.
Chakravriddhi byaj = 5760 - 4000 = ₹1760.
Jawab: ₹1760.
Samikaran jodi hal karo: 2x + 2y = 16 aur 5x + 2y = 25.

Viloapan (elimination) vidhi: pehle samikaran ko 5 se aur dusre ko 2 se guna karke ghataane par x kat jata hai.
Hisab karne par y = 5 milta hai.
y ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 2x + 2×5 = 16, yani 2x = 6, isliye x = 3.
Jawab: x = 3, y = 5.
(4x + 2)² ka vistaar sarvsamika se karo.

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² lagane par:
(4x + 2)² = (4x)² + 2×4x×2 + 2² = 16x² + 16x + 4.
Jawab: 16x² + 16x + 4.
tan 30° × tan 60° ka maan gyat karo.

Maan rakhne par: tan 30° = 1/√3 aur tan 60° = √3, guna karne par 1.
Isliye kul maan = 1.
Jawab: 1.
Ek dibbe (ghanabh) ki map 4 cm × 7 cm × 3 cm hai. Uska sampurn prishth kshetrafal nikalo.

Sampurn prishth kshetrafal = 2(lb + bh + hl).
= 2 × (4×7 + 7×3 + 3×4) = 2 × (28 + 21 + 12) = 122 cm².
Jawab: 122 cm².
Quadratic equation x² + 9x + 20 = 0 ko hal karo, mool batao.

Beach wala pad 9x todne ke liye aisi do sankhyaen chahiye jinka jod 9 aur guna 20 ho: 4 aur 5 (kyunki 4 + 5 = 9 aur 4 × 5 = 20).
Samikaran: x² + 4x + 5x + 20 = 0
Samuh banakar: x(x + 4) + 5(x + 4) = 0, yani (x + 4)(x + 5) = 0
Isliye x + 4 = 0 ya x + 5 = 0.
Jawab: mool x = -4 aur x = -5 hain.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar 3 se chhoti sankhya aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). 3 se chhoti sankhya wale anukool parinaam 2 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 2/6 = 1/3.
Jawab: 1/3.
Ek samkon tribhuj me kon A ke saamne wali bhuja (lamb) 8 cm, aadhar 15 cm aur karn 17 cm hai. tan A ka maan nikalo.

tan A = lamb/aadhar hota hai.
Isliye tan A = 8/15 = 8/15.
Jawab: tan A = 8/15.
Ek samdwibahu tribhuj ka shirsh kon 100° hai. Aadhar ke dono kon kitne-kitne degree ke honge?

Samdwibahu tribhuj me aadhar ke kon barabar hote hain.
Bache hue kono ka jod = 180 - 100 = 80°, har kon = 80 ÷ 2 = 40°.
Jawab: dono kon 40° ke honge.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar 6 ka gunankhand (factor) aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). 6 ka gunankhand (factor) wale anukool parinaam 4 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 4/6 = 2/3.
Jawab: 2/3.
5 cm vyaas (diameter) wali goliyon ko ek 1 m lambi kataar me rakha jaye to kitni goliyan lagengi? (1 m = 100 cm)

Har goli 5 cm jagah leti hai.
Goliyon ki sankhya = 100 ÷ 5 = 20.
Jawab: 20 goliyan lagengi.
Do samanantar rekhaon ko ek tirachhi rekha (transversal) kaat ti hai. Ek kon 75° ka hai to uska ek hi taraf ka antar kon (co-interior) kitne degree ka hoga?

Niyam: Ek hi taraf ke antar kono ka jod 180° hota hai.
Isliye kon = 105°.
Jawab: 105°.
x² - 9x + 14 = 0 — is samikaran ke mool kya honge?

Beach wala pad -9x todne ke liye aisi do sankhyaen chahiye jinka jod -9 aur guna 14 ho: -7 aur -2 (kyunki -7 + -2 = -9 aur -7 × -2 = 14).
Samikaran: x² - 7x - 2x + 14 = 0
Samuh banakar: x(x - 7) - 2(x - 7) = 0, yani (x - 7)(x - 2) = 0
Isliye x - 7 = 0 ya x - 2 = 0.
Jawab: mool x = 7 aur x = 2 hain.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar sam (even) sankhya aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). sam (even) sankhya wale anukool parinaam 3 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 3/6 = 1/2.
Jawab: 1/2.
Ek samkon tribhuj me kon A ke saamne wali bhuja (lamb) 9 cm, aadhar 12 cm aur karn 15 cm hai. cos A ka maan nikalo.

cos A = aadhar/karn hota hai.
Isliye cos A = 12/15 = 4/5.
Jawab: cos A = 4/5.
Do binduon (4, 2) aur (13, 14) ke beech ki doori gyat karo.

Doori sutra: d = √((x₂-x₁)² + (y₂-y₁)²).
d = √((9)² + (12)²) = √(81 + 144) = √225 = 15.
Jawab: doori 15 ikaai hai.
Ek belanakar bartan ki trijya 7/2 cm aur unchai 20 cm hai. Uska aayatan (volume) gyat karo. (π = 22/7)

Belan ka aayatan = πr²h.
= 22/7 × 7/2 × 7/2 × 20 = 770 cm³.
Jawab: aayatan 770 cm³ hai.
Do samikaran hal karo: x + y = 14 aur x - y = 4. x aur y ke maan batao.

Dono samikaran jodne par y kat jata hai: 2x = 14 + 4 = 18, isliye x = 9.
x ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 9 + y = 14, isliye y = 14 - 9 = 5.
Jawab: x = 9, y = 5.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar sanyukt (composite) sankhya aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). sanyukt (composite) sankhya wale anukool parinaam 2 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 2/6 = 1/3.
Jawab: 1/3.
(2x - 5)² ka vistaar sarvsamika se karo.

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² lagane par:
(2x - 5)² = (2x)² - 2×2x×5 + 5² = 4x² - 20x + 25.
Jawab: 4x² - 20x + 25.
Ek ardhgole (hemisphere) ki trijya 14 cm hai. Uska sampurn prishth kshetrafal nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Ardhgole ka sampurn prishth = vakr hissa 2πr² + aadhar ka vritt πr² = 3πr².
= 3 × 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 1848 cm².
Jawab: 1848 cm².
₹1000 par 10% dar se 2 saal ke chakravriddhi byaj aur saadhaaran byaj ka antar nikalo.

2 saal ke liye antar ka chhota sutra: antar = P × (R/100)².
= 1000 × (10/100)² = 1000 × 1/100 = ₹10.
Jawab: antar ₹10 hai.
Do samanantar rekhaon ko ek tirachhi rekha (transversal) kaat ti hai. Ek kon 50° ka hai to uska sangath kon (corresponding angle) kitne degree ka hoga?

Niyam: Sangath kon barabar hote hain.
Isliye kon = 50°.
Jawab: 50°.
126 ke abhaajya gunankhand (prime factorisation) nikalo.

126 ko chhoti abhaajya sankhyaon se baantte jao:
126 = 2 × 3 × 3 × 7.
Jawab: 126 = 2 × 3^2 × 7.
Do samanantar rekhaon ko ek tirachhi rekha (transversal) kaat ti hai. Ek kon 80° ka hai to uska ekantar kon (alternate angle) kitne degree ka hoga?

Niyam: Ekantar kon barabar hote hain.
Isliye kon = 80°.
Jawab: 80°.
Ek seedhi diwar ke sahare lagi hai. Seedhi ka neeche wala sira diwar se 6 m door hai aur upar wala sira zameen se 8 m unchai par diwar ko chhoota hai. Seedhi ki lambai nikalo.

Diwar, zameen aur seedhi samkon tribhuj banate hain.
Pythagoras se: lambai² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100, isliye lambai = 10 m.
Jawab: seedhi 10 m lambi hai.
Nadi ke kinare khade vyakti ko dusre kinare wale ped ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 30° dikhta hai. Ped usse 30 m door hai to ped ki unchai nikalo.

tan 30° = unchai/doori = unchai/30, aur tan 30° = 1/√3.
unchai = 30/√3 = 30√3/3 m ≈ 17.32 m.
Jawab: ped ki unchai lagbhag 17.32 m hai.
Do sankhyao ka HCF 12 aur LCM 72 hai. Agar ek sankhya 24 hai to dusri sankhya nikalo.

Niyam: HCF × LCM = pehli sankhya × dusri sankhya.
12 × 72 = 24 × dusri, yani 864 = 24 × dusri.
Dusri sankhya = 864 ÷ 24 = 36.
Jawab: dusri sankhya 36 hai.
GP: 5, 10, 20, ... ka 4vaan pad nikalo.

GP me pehla pad a = 5, saarv anupaat r = 2. nvaan pad = a × r^(n-1).
4vaan pad = 5 × 2^3 = 5 × 8 = 40.
Jawab: 40.
Vritt ke kendra se 25 cm door ek bahari bindu se vritt par sparsh rekha kheenchhi gayi. Vritt ki trijya 15 cm hai to sparsh rekha ki lambai nikalo.

Sparsh bindu par trijya, sparsh rekha par lamb hoti hai, isliye samkon tribhuj banta hai.
Sparsh lambai² = 25² - 15² = 625 - 225 = 400, isliye lambai = 20 cm.
Jawab: sparsh rekha 20 cm lambi hai.
Dvighat samikaran x² - 6x + 8 = 0 ke mool gyat karo.

Beach wala pad -6x todne ke liye aisi do sankhyaen chahiye jinka jod -6 aur guna 8 ho: -2 aur -4 (kyunki -2 + -4 = -6 aur -2 × -4 = 8).
Samikaran: x² - 2x - 4x + 8 = 0
Samuh banakar: x(x - 2) - 4(x - 2) = 0, yani (x - 2)(x - 4) = 0
Isliye x - 2 = 0 ya x - 4 = 0.
Jawab: mool x = 2 aur x = 4 hain.
sin² 45° + cos² 45° ka maan gyat karo.

Maan rakhne par: kisi bhi kon ke liye sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 hota hai.
Isliye kul maan = 1.
Jawab: 1.
Ek belan (cylinder) ki trijya 14 cm aur unchai 15 cm hai. Uska vakr prishth kshetrafal (curved surface area) nikalo. (π = 22/7 lo)

Belan ka vakr prishth kshetrafal = 2πrh.
= 2 × 22/7 × 14 × 15 = 1320 cm².
Jawab: 1320 cm².
Ek thele me 3 laal aur 4 neeli aur 3 hari genden hain (kul 10). Ek gend bina dekhe nikali jati hai. Uske hari hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Kul genden = 10. hari genden = 3.
Sambhaavyata = 3/10 = 3/10.
Jawab: 3/10.
Zameen par ek bindu se ped ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 60° hai. Bindu ped se 25 m door hai to ped ki unchai kitni hogi?

tan 60° = unchai/doori aur tan 60° = √3.
unchai = 25 × √3 = 25√3 m ≈ 43.30 m.
Jawab: unchai 25√3 m (lagbhag 43.30 m) hai.
Ek kamra 7 m lamba, 3 m chauda aur 5 m uncha hai. Uski chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal nikalo (chhat aur farsh nahi gina jayega).

Chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal = 2 × unchai × (lambai + chaudai).
= 2 × 5 × (7 + 3) = 2 × 5 × 10 = 100 m².
Jawab: chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal 100 m² hai.
Kya sankhya 3847, 4 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

4 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: aakhri do ank = 47.
Shart poori nahi hoti, isliye 3847, 4 se poori vibhaajit nahi hogi (bhaag dene par shesh 3 bachega).
Jawab: Nahi, vibhaajit nahi hogi.
Do anko ki ek sankhya ke anko ka jod 3 hai. Anko ko ulta karne par bani sankhya, mool sankhya se 9 kam hoti hai. Sankhya nikalo.

Ikai ka ank y aur dahai ka ank x mano. x + y = 3.
Ank ulta karne par sankhya 9(x - y) kam hoti hai, isliye x - y = 9 ÷ 9 = 1.
Dono jodne par 2x = 3 + 1 = 4 → x = 2, y = 1.
Jawab: sankhya 21 hai.
Do pase ek saath fenke jate hain. Dono par aayi sankhyaon ka yog 8 hone ki sambhaavyata nikalo.

Do paso ke kul parinaam 36 hote hain. Yog 8 banane wale jode 5 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 5/36 = 5/36.
Jawab: 5/36.
sin 60° × cos 30° + cos 60° × sin 30° ka maan gyat karo.

Maan rakhne par: √3/2 × √3/2 + 1/2 × 1/2 = 3/4 + 1/4.
Isliye kul maan = 1.
Jawab: 1.
Ek khamba 30 m uncha hai. Uske shikhar ka unnaayan kon zameen ke ek bindu se 30° hai. Bindu khambe se kitni door hai?

tan 30° = unchai/doori, aur tan 30° = 1/√3.
1/√3 = 30/doori, isliye doori = 30 × √3 = 30√3 m ≈ 51.96 m.
Jawab: bindu lagbhag 51.96 m door hai.
Ek gole ki trijya 7 cm hai. Uska prishth kshetrafal (surface area) gyat karo. (π = 22/7)

Gole ka prishth kshetrafal = 4πr².
= 4 × 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 616 cm².
Jawab: 616 cm².
Ram ne ₹48000 ka loan 12% vaarshik saadhaaran byaj par 1 saal ke liye liya. Pure paise 12 barabar maasik kishto (EMI) me chukana hai to har kisht kitne ki hogi? (saral hisaab)

Saadhaaran byaj = 48000 × 12 × 1 / 100 = ₹5760.
Kul chukana = 48000 + 5760 = ₹53760.
Har kisht = 53760 ÷ 12 = ₹4480.
Jawab: har maasik kisht ₹4480 ki hogi.
x² + 8x + 16 ka gunankhand karo.

16 ke gunankhand 4 aur 4 hain jinka jod 8 hai (4 + 4 = 8, 4 × 4 = 16).
Isliye x² + 8x + 16 = (x + 4)(x + 4).
Jawab: (x + 4)(x + 4).
995 ka varg (a - b)² wali sarvsamika se gyat karo.
Agar tan A = 1 ho to kon A kitne degree ka hoga? (A nyoon kon hai)

Maanak kono ki talika se tan A = 1 tab hota hai jab A = 45°.
Jawab: A = 45°.
60 ke abhaajya gunankhand (prime factorisation) nikalo.

60 ko chhoti abhaajya sankhyaon se baantte jao:
60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5.
Jawab: 60 = 2^2 × 3 × 5.
Ek aayat (rectangle) ki lambai 5 cm aur chaudai 12 cm hai. Uske vikarn (diagonal) ki lambai gyat karo.

Vikarn aayat ko do samkon tribhujon me baantta hai.
Vikarn² = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169, isliye vikarn = 13 cm.
Jawab: vikarn 13 cm hai.
₹8000 par 5% vaarshik dar se 2 saal ka chakravriddhi byaj (compound interest) nikalo.

Saal 1: byaj = 8000 × 5/100 = 400, rakam = 8400
Saal 2: byaj = 8400 × 5/100 = 420, rakam = 8820
2 saal baad kul rakam = ₹8820.
Chakravriddhi byaj = 8820 - 8000 = ₹820.
Jawab: ₹820.
Ek minaar ke pate (neeche) se 15 m door khade hokar uske shikhar ko dekhne par unnaayan kon (angle of elevation) 45° banta hai. minaar ki unchai nikalo.

tan 45° = unchai/doori hota hai aur tan 45° = 1.
Isliye unchai = 15 × 1 = 15 m.
Jawab: minaar ki unchai 15 m hai.
₹5000 par 10% vaarshik dar se 3 saal ka chakravriddhi byaj (compound interest) nikalo.

Saal 1: byaj = 5000 × 10/100 = 500, rakam = 5500
Saal 2: byaj = 5500 × 10/100 = 550, rakam = 6050
Saal 3: byaj = 6050 × 10/100 = 605, rakam = 6655
3 saal baad kul rakam = ₹6655.
Chakravriddhi byaj = 6655 - 5000 = ₹1655.
Jawab: ₹1655.
Do sikke ek saath uchhale jate hain. Dono par Chit aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Kul parinaam 4 hain: (Chit,Chit), (Chit,Pat), (Pat,Chit), (Pat,Pat). Anukool sirf 1: (Chit,Chit).
Sambhaavyata = 1/4.
Jawab: 1/4.
Kya 61 aur 63 judwa abhaajya (twin primes) hain? Batao kyun.

61 abhaajya hai, lekin 63 abhaajya nahi hai (ye 63 = 3 × 21 hota hai).
Isliye ye jodi judwa abhaajya nahi hai.
Jawab: Nahi, judwa abhaajya nahi hain.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar visam (odd) sankhya aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). visam (odd) sankhya wale anukool parinaam 3 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 3/6 = 1/2.
Jawab: 1/2.
Do rassiyon ki lambai 28 m aur 42 m hai. Dono ko bina kaate barabar ke sabse bade tukdo me kaatna hai. Har tukda kitna lamba hoga?

Sabse bada barabar tukda = dono lambaiyon ka HCF.
28 aur 42 ka HCF = 14.
Jawab: har tukda 14 m lamba hoga, aur kul 5 tukde banege.
Kya 71 aur 73 judwa abhaajya (twin primes) hain? Batao kyun.

Dono sankhyaen abhaajya hain aur inka antar 73 - 71 = 2 hai.
Jin do abhaajya sankhyaon ka antar 2 ho, ve judwa abhaajya kehlati hain.
Jawab: Haan, 71 aur 73 judwa abhaajya hain.
Ek aayatakar baag 30 m × 14 m ka hai. Uske andar charon taraf 1 m chauda raasta bana hai. Raaste ka kshetrafal nikalo.

Pure baag ka kshetrafal = 30 × 14 = 420 m².
Raasta chhodkar andar wala hissa = (30 - 2) × (14 - 2) = 28 × 12 = 336 m².
Raaste ka kshetrafal = 420 - 336 = 84 m².
Jawab: 84 m².
A ek kaam 15 din me aur B 20 din me karta hai. A ne 3 din kaam karke chhod diya. Bacha hua kaam B akele kitne din me pura karega?

x² + 14x + 48 ka gunankhand karo.

48 ke gunankhand 6 aur 8 hain jinka jod 14 hai (6 + 8 = 14, 6 × 8 = 48).
Isliye x² + 14x + 48 = (x + 6)(x + 8).
Jawab: (x + 6)(x + 8).
25x² - 49 ka gunankhand karo.

Ye a² - b² ke roop me hai: (5x)² - (7)².
a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b) lagane par: (5x + 7)(5x - 7).
Jawab: (5x + 7)(5x - 7).
Ek shanku (cone) ki trijya 5 cm aur unchai 12 cm hai. Uska aayatan nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Shanku ka aayatan = (1/3)πr²h.
= (1/3) × 22/7 × 5 × 5 × 12 = 2200/7 cm³.
Jawab: aayatan 2200/7 cm³ hai.
A ek kaam ko 5 din me aur B usi kaam ko 10 din me pura karta hai. Dono milkar kaam kitne din me pura karenge?

Kul kaam ko 10 ikaai mano (5 aur 10 ka LCM).
A ki roz ki kshamta = 10 ÷ 5 = 2 ikaai, B ki = 10 ÷ 10 = 1 ikaai.
Dono ki milkar = 3 ikaai roz. Samay = 10 ÷ 3 = 10/3 din.
Jawab: dono milkar 10/3 din me kaam pura karenge.
56 × 44 ka maan a² - b² wali sarvsamika se nikalo.

Dono sankhyaen 50 ke aas-paas hain: 56 = 50 + 6 aur 44 = 50 - 6.
(a + b)(a - b) = a² - b² lagane par: 50² - 6² = 2500 - 36 = 2464.
Jawab: 56 × 44 = 2464.
Kya sankhya 9615, 8 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

8 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: aakhri teen ank = 615.
Shart poori nahi hoti, isliye 9615, 8 se poori vibhaajit nahi hogi (bhaag dene par shesh 7 bachega).
Jawab: Nahi, vibhaajit nahi hogi.
Ek shanku ki trijya 3 cm hai aur uski tirchhi unchai (slant height) 5 cm hai. Vakr prishth kshetrafal nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Shanku ka vakr prishth kshetrafal = πrl, jahan l tirchhi unchai hai.
= 22/7 × 3 × 5 = 330/7 cm².
Jawab: 330/7 cm².
Kya sankhya 6883, 9 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

9 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: anko ka jod = 25.
Shart poori nahi hoti, isliye 6883, 9 se poori vibhaajit nahi hogi (bhaag dene par shesh 7 bachega).
Jawab: Nahi, vibhaajit nahi hogi.
Ek seedhi diwar ke sahare lagi hai. Seedhi ka neeche wala sira diwar se 3 m door hai aur upar wala sira zameen se 4 m unchai par diwar ko chhoota hai. Seedhi ki lambai nikalo.

Diwar, zameen aur seedhi samkon tribhuj banate hain.
Pythagoras se: lambai² = 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25, isliye lambai = 5 m.
Jawab: seedhi 5 m lambi hai.
Samikaran jodi hal karo: 4x + 2y = 68 aur 3x + 3y = 69.

Viloapan (elimination) vidhi: pehle samikaran ko 3 se aur dusre ko 4 se guna karke ghataane par x kat jata hai.
Hisab karne par y = 12 milta hai.
y ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 4x + 2×12 = 68, yani 4x = 44, isliye x = 11.
Jawab: x = 11, y = 12.
GP: 5, 15, 45, ... ka 4vaan pad nikalo.

GP me pehla pad a = 5, saarv anupaat r = 3. nvaan pad = a × r^(n-1).
4vaan pad = 5 × 3^3 = 5 × 27 = 135.
Jawab: 135.
Ek samkon tribhuj me kon A ke saamne wali bhuja (lamb) 12 cm, aadhar 16 cm aur karn 20 cm hai. tan A ka maan nikalo.

tan A = lamb/aadhar hota hai.
Isliye tan A = 12/16 = 3/4.
Jawab: tan A = 3/4.
(4x - 6)² ka vistaar sarvsamika se karo.

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² lagane par:
(4x - 6)² = (4x)² - 2×4x×6 + 6² = 16x² - 48x + 36.
Jawab: 16x² - 48x + 36.
Ek shanku (cone) ki trijya 7 cm aur unchai 24 cm hai. Uska aayatan nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Shanku ka aayatan = (1/3)πr²h.
= (1/3) × 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 24 = 1232 cm³.
Jawab: aayatan 1232 cm³ hai.
Kya 23 aur 25 judwa abhaajya (twin primes) hain? Batao kyun.

23 abhaajya hai, lekin 25 abhaajya nahi hai (ye 25 = 5 × 5 hota hai).
Isliye ye jodi judwa abhaajya nahi hai.
Jawab: Nahi, judwa abhaajya nahi hain.
Ek shanku ki trijya 5 cm aur unchai 12 cm hai. Uski tirchhi unchai (slant height) gyat karo.

Tirchhi unchai l ke liye: l² = r² + h² = 25 + 144 = 169.
Isliye l = 13 cm.
Jawab: tirchhi unchai 13 cm hai.
Ek shanku ki trijya 6 cm aur unchai 8 cm hai. Uski tirchhi unchai (slant height) gyat karo.

Tirchhi unchai l ke liye: l² = r² + h² = 36 + 64 = 100.
Isliye l = 10 cm.
Jawab: tirchhi unchai 10 cm hai.
Binduon (-1, -3) aur (-1, -5) ko jodne wale rekha-khand ka madhy bindu (midpoint) nikalo.
Ek shanku ki trijya 6 cm hai aur uski tirchhi unchai (slant height) 10 cm hai. Vakr prishth kshetrafal nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Shanku ka vakr prishth kshetrafal = πrl, jahan l tirchhi unchai hai.
= 22/7 × 6 × 10 = 1320/7 cm².
Jawab: 1320/7 cm².
Kya 43 aur 45 judwa abhaajya (twin primes) hain? Batao kyun.

43 abhaajya hai, lekin 45 abhaajya nahi hai (ye 45 = 3 × 15 hota hai).
Isliye ye jodi judwa abhaajya nahi hai.
Jawab: Nahi, judwa abhaajya nahi hain.
Kya sankhya 4625, 6 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

6 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: anko ka jod = 17, sankhya visam (odd) hai.
Shart poori nahi hoti, isliye 4625, 6 se poori vibhaajit nahi hogi (bhaag dene par shesh 5 bachega).
Jawab: Nahi, vibhaajit nahi hogi.
Ek samdwibahu tribhuj ka shirsh kon 40° hai. Aadhar ke dono kon kitne-kitne degree ke honge?

Samdwibahu tribhuj me aadhar ke kon barabar hote hain.
Bache hue kono ka jod = 180 - 40 = 140°, har kon = 140 ÷ 2 = 70°.
Jawab: dono kon 70° ke honge.
13 cm trijya wale vritt ki ek jeeva (chord) 10 cm lambi hai. Jeeva ki vritt ke kendra se doori nikalo.

Kendra se jeeva par lamba usey aadha karta hai, isliye aadhi jeeva = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm.
Samkon tribhuj me Pythagoras se: doori² = 13² - 5² = 169 - 25 = 144, isliye doori = 12 cm.
Jawab: jeeva kendra se 12 cm door hai.
Ek belan (cylinder) ki trijya 7/2 cm aur unchai 5 cm hai. Uska vakr prishth kshetrafal (curved surface area) nikalo. (π = 22/7 lo)

Belan ka vakr prishth kshetrafal = 2πrh.
= 2 × 22/7 × 7/2 × 5 = 110 cm².
Jawab: 110 cm².
Sabse chhoti sankhya nikalo jise 6 se bhaag dene par aur 8 se bhaag dene par, dono baar shesh 3 bache.

Pehle 6 aur 8 ka LCM = 24. Aisi sankhya LCM se 3 zyada hogi taaki har baar shesh 3 bache.
Sankhya = 24 + 3 = 27.
Jawab: sabse chhoti sankhya 27 hai.
Zameen par ek bindu se khambe ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 60° hai. Bindu khambe se 20 m door hai to khambe ki unchai kitni hogi?

tan 60° = unchai/doori aur tan 60° = √3.
unchai = 20 × √3 = 20√3 m ≈ 34.64 m.
Jawab: unchai 20√3 m (lagbhag 34.64 m) hai.
Ek belan (cylinder) ki trijya 7/2 cm aur unchai 20 cm hai. Uska vakr prishth kshetrafal (curved surface area) nikalo. (π = 22/7 lo)

Belan ka vakr prishth kshetrafal = 2πrh.
= 2 × 22/7 × 7/2 × 20 = 440 cm².
Jawab: 440 cm².
Agar cos A = 1/2 ho to kon A kitne degree ka hoga? (A nyoon kon hai)

Maanak kono ki talika se cos A = 1/2 tab hota hai jab A = 60°.
Jawab: A = 60°.
Ek samkon tribhuj ki do bhujaen (lamb aur aadhar) 7 m aur 24 m hain. Karn (hypotenuse) ki lambai kitni hogi?

Pythagoras siddhant: karn² = 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625.
Isliye karn = 25 m.
Jawab: karn 25 m hoga.
Ek tribhuj ke do antar kon 54° aur 32° hain. Teesre kon ka bahya kon (exterior angle) kitna hoga?

Bahya kon ka siddhant: bahya kon = saamne wale do antar kono ka jod.
Bahya kon = 54° + 32° = 86°.
Jawab: 86°.
Kya sankhya 3368, 4 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

4 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: aakhri do ank = 68.
Shart poori hoti hai, isliye haan — 3368, 4 se poori vibhaajit hogi (3368 ÷ 4 = 842).
Jawab: Haan, vibhaajit hogi.
Ek ghan (cube) ki har kinari (edge) 9 cm hai. Uska aayatan aur sampurn prishth kshetrafal dono nikalo.

Ghan ka aayatan = kinari³ = 9³ = 729 cm³.
Sampurn prishth kshetrafal = 6 × kinari² = 6 × 81 = 486 cm².
Jawab: aayatan 729 cm³, prishth kshetrafal 486 cm².
Do binduon (1, 5) aur (9, 20) ke beech ki doori gyat karo.

Doori sutra: d = √((x₂-x₁)² + (y₂-y₁)²).
d = √((8)² + (15)²) = √(64 + 225) = √289 = 17.
Jawab: doori 17 ikaai hai.
x² - 2x - 3 = 0 — is samikaran ke mool kya honge?

Beach wala pad -2x todne ke liye aisi do sankhyaen chahiye jinka jod -2 aur guna -3 ho: -3 aur 1 (kyunki -3 + 1 = -2 aur -3 × 1 = -3).
Samikaran: x² - 3x + 1x - 3 = 0
Samuh banakar: x(x - 3) + 1(x - 3) = 0, yani (x - 3)(x + 1) = 0
Isliye x - 3 = 0 ya x + 1 = 0.
Jawab: mool x = 3 aur x = -1 hain.
(2x + 7)² ka vistaar sarvsamika se karo.

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² lagane par:
(2x + 7)² = (2x)² + 2×2x×7 + 7² = 4x² + 28x + 49.
Jawab: 4x² + 28x + 49.
Ek aayat (rectangle) ki lambai 10 cm aur chaudai 24 cm hai. Uske vikarn (diagonal) ki lambai gyat karo.

Vikarn aayat ko do samkon tribhujon me baantta hai.
Vikarn² = 10² + 24² = 100 + 576 = 676, isliye vikarn = 26 cm.
Jawab: vikarn 26 cm hai.
Ek thele me 6 laal aur 4 neeli genden hain (kul 10). Ek gend bina dekhe nikali jati hai. Uske neeli hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Kul genden = 10. neeli genden = 4.
Sambhaavyata = 4/10 = 2/5.
Jawab: 2/5.
Kya sankhya 5100, 11 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

11 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: ekantar anko ke jod ka antar = 4.
Shart poori nahi hoti, isliye 5100, 11 se poori vibhaajit nahi hogi (bhaag dene par shesh 7 bachega).
Jawab: Nahi, vibhaajit nahi hogi.
₹5000 par 20% vaarshik dar se 2 saal ka chakravriddhi byaj (compound interest) nikalo.

Saal 1: byaj = 5000 × 20/100 = 1000, rakam = 6000
Saal 2: byaj = 6000 × 20/100 = 1200, rakam = 7200
2 saal baad kul rakam = ₹7200.
Chakravriddhi byaj = 7200 - 5000 = ₹2200.
Jawab: ₹2200.
Ek pasa (dice) ek baar fenka jata hai. Upar abhaajya sankhya aane ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Pase par kul parinaam 6 hain (1 se 6). abhaajya sankhya wale anukool parinaam 3 hain.
Sambhaavyata = 3/6 = 1/2.
Jawab: 1/2.
Sabse chhoti sankhya nikalo jise 6 se bhaag dene par aur 8 se bhaag dene par, dono baar shesh 2 bache.

Pehle 6 aur 8 ka LCM = 24. Aisi sankhya LCM se 2 zyada hogi taaki har baar shesh 2 bache.
Sankhya = 24 + 2 = 26.
Jawab: sabse chhoti sankhya 26 hai.
Do bhaiyon ki umr ka anupaat 5 : 8 hai aur dono ki umr ka jod 26 saal hai. Dono ki umr nikalo.

Umr ko 5x aur 8x mano. Jod: 5x + 8x = 26 → 13x = 26 → x = 2.
Jawab: pehle ki umr 5 × 2 = 10 saal, dusre ki 8 × 2 = 16 saal.
Teen sikke uchhalne par teenon par Pat aane ki sambhaavyata nikalo.

Kul parinaam 8 hain. Teenon Pat wala sirf 1 parinaam hai.
Sambhaavyata = 1/8.
Jawab: 1/8.
Ek kamra 4 m lamba, 6 m chauda aur 5 m uncha hai. Uski chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal nikalo (chhat aur farsh nahi gina jayega).

Chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal = 2 × unchai × (lambai + chaudai).
= 2 × 5 × (4 + 6) = 2 × 5 × 10 = 100 m².
Jawab: chaar diwaron ka kshetrafal 100 m² hai.
Zameen par ek bindu se minaar ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 60° hai. Bindu minaar se 25 m door hai to minaar ki unchai kitni hogi?

tan 60° = unchai/doori aur tan 60° = √3.
unchai = 25 × √3 = 25√3 m ≈ 43.30 m.
Jawab: unchai 25√3 m (lagbhag 43.30 m) hai.
Vritt ke kendra se 10 cm door ek bahari bindu se vritt par sparsh rekha kheenchhi gayi. Vritt ki trijya 6 cm hai to sparsh rekha ki lambai nikalo.

Sparsh bindu par trijya, sparsh rekha par lamb hoti hai, isliye samkon tribhuj banta hai.
Sparsh lambai² = 10² - 6² = 100 - 36 = 64, isliye lambai = 8 cm.
Jawab: sparsh rekha 8 cm lambi hai.
Ek band belan ki trijya 7/2 cm aur unchai 12 cm hai. Uska sampurn prishth kshetrafal (total surface area) nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Sampurn prishth kshetrafal = 2πr(r + h).
= 2 × 22/7 × 7/2 × (7/2 + 12) = 2 × 22/7 × 7/2 × 31/2 = 341 cm².
Jawab: 341 cm².
Do samanantar rekhaon ko ek tirachhi rekha (transversal) kaat ti hai. Ek kon 65° ka hai to uska aasann poorak kon (linear pair) kitne degree ka hoga?

Niyam: Seedhi rekha par bane aasann kono ka jod 180° hota hai.
Isliye kon = 115°.
Jawab: 115°.
52 patto ki taash ki gaddi se ek patta yaadrichhik (random) roop se nikala jata hai. Uske baadshah (king) hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Kul 4 baadshah hote hain.
Sambhaavyata = 4/52 = 1/13.
Jawab: 1/13.
AP 6, 15, 24, ... ke pehle 12 pado ka yog nikalo.
Do bhaiyon ki umr ka anupaat 8 : 2 hai aur dono ki umr ka jod 30 saal hai. Dono ki umr nikalo.

Umr ko 8x aur 2x mano. Jod: 8x + 2x = 30 → 10x = 30 → x = 3.
Jawab: pehle ki umr 8 × 3 = 24 saal, dusre ki 2 × 3 = 6 saal.
Ek nal ek tanki ko 6 ghante me bharta hai, dusra nal 12 ghante me. Dono nal ek saath khol diye jayein to tanki kitne ghante me bharegi?

Tanki ki kshamta 12 ikaai mano (6 aur 12 ka LCM).
Pehla nal 1 ghante me 2 ikaai, dusra 1 ikaai bharta hai. Dono milkar = 3 ikaai prati ghanta.
Samay = 12 ÷ 3 = 4 ghante.
Jawab: tanki 4 ghante me bhar jayegi.
AP: 9, 14, 19, ... ka 8vaan pad (term) nikalo.

AP me a = 9, saarv antar d = 5. nvaan pad = a + (n-1)d.
8vaan pad = 9 + 7 × 5 = 9 + 35 = 44.
Jawab: 44.
Ek pita ki umr apne bete ki umr ki 2 guna hai. 5 saal baad dono ki umr ka jod 34 saal hoga. Dono ki vartamaan umr nikalo.

Bete ki umr x mano, to pita ki umr 2x.
5 saal baad: (x + 5) + (2x + 5) = 34 → 3x + 10 = 34 → 3x = 24 → x = 8.
Jawab: bete ki umr 8 saal, pita ki umr 2 × 8 = 16 saal.
Ek nal ek tanki ko 3 ghante me bharta hai, dusra nal 6 ghante me. Dono nal ek saath khol diye jayein to tanki kitne ghante me bharegi?

Tanki ki kshamta 6 ikaai mano (3 aur 6 ka LCM).
Pehla nal 1 ghante me 2 ikaai, dusra 1 ikaai bharta hai. Dono milkar = 3 ikaai prati ghanta.
Samay = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 ghante.
Jawab: tanki 2 ghante me bhar jayegi.
Ek AP ka pehla pad 10 aur saarv antar 3 hai. Kaunsa pad 55 hoga?

Maan lo nvaan pad 55 hai: a + (n-1)d = 55.
10 + (n-1) × 3 = 55 → (n-1) × 3 = 45 → n - 1 = 15 → n = 16.
Jawab: 55, 16vaan pad hoga.
Ek aayat (rectangle) ki lambai 20 cm aur chaudai 21 cm hai. Uske vikarn (diagonal) ki lambai gyat karo.

Vikarn aayat ko do samkon tribhujon me baantta hai.
Vikarn² = 20² + 21² = 400 + 441 = 841, isliye vikarn = 29 cm.
Jawab: vikarn 29 cm hai.
Ek seedhi diwar ke sahare lagi hai. Seedhi ka neeche wala sira diwar se 8 m door hai aur upar wala sira zameen se 15 m unchai par diwar ko chhoota hai. Seedhi ki lambai nikalo.

Diwar, zameen aur seedhi samkon tribhuj banate hain.
Pythagoras se: lambai² = 8² + 15² = 64 + 225 = 289, isliye lambai = 17 m.
Jawab: seedhi 17 m lambi hai.
Ek tribhuj ke do antar kon 65° aur 53° hain. Teesre kon ka bahya kon (exterior angle) kitna hoga?

Bahya kon ka siddhant: bahya kon = saamne wale do antar kono ka jod.
Bahya kon = 65° + 53° = 118°.
Jawab: 118°.
₹5000 par 10% dar se 2 saal ke chakravriddhi byaj aur saadhaaran byaj ka antar nikalo.

2 saal ke liye antar ka chhota sutra: antar = P × (R/100)².
= 5000 × (10/100)² = 5000 × 1/100 = ₹50.
Jawab: antar ₹50 hai.
Do anko ki ek sankhya ke anko ka jod 10 hai. Anko ko ulta karne par bani sankhya, mool sankhya se 36 kam hoti hai. Sankhya nikalo.

Ikai ka ank y aur dahai ka ank x mano. x + y = 10.
Ank ulta karne par sankhya 9(x - y) kam hoti hai, isliye x - y = 36 ÷ 9 = 4.
Dono jodne par 2x = 10 + 4 = 14 → x = 7, y = 3.
Jawab: sankhya 73 hai.
Ek shanku (cone) ki trijya 6 cm aur unchai 8 cm hai. Uska aayatan nikalo. (π = 22/7)

Shanku ka aayatan = (1/3)πr²h.
= (1/3) × 22/7 × 6 × 6 × 8 = 2112/7 cm³.
Jawab: aayatan 2112/7 cm³ hai.
Samikaran jodi hal karo: 2x + 2y = 30 aur 5x + 2y = 36.

Viloapan (elimination) vidhi: pehle samikaran ko 5 se aur dusre ko 2 se guna karke ghataane par x kat jata hai.
Hisab karne par y = 13 milta hai.
y ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 2x + 2×13 = 30, yani 2x = 4, isliye x = 2.
Jawab: x = 2, y = 13.
A ek kaam 8 din me aur B 12 din me karta hai. A ne 2 din kaam karke chhod diya. Bacha hua kaam B akele kitne din me pura karega?

A ka 2 din ka kaam = 2/8 = 1/4 hissa.
Bacha kaam = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4 hissa.
B pura kaam 12 din me karta hai, isliye bacha hissa = 12 × 3/4 = 9 din.
Jawab: B 9 din me bacha kaam pura karega.
Samikaran jodi hal karo: 2x + 5y = 43 aur 2x + 2y = 28.

Viloapan (elimination) vidhi: pehle samikaran ko 2 se aur dusre ko 2 se guna karke ghataane par x kat jata hai.
Hisab karne par y = 5 milta hai.
y ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 2x + 5×5 = 43, yani 2x = 18, isliye x = 9.
Jawab: x = 9, y = 5.
52 patto ki taash ki gaddi se ek patta yaadrichhik (random) roop se nikala jata hai. Uske ekka (ace) hone ki sambhaavyata kya hai?

Har rang ke hisse me 1 ekka, kul 4 ekke.
Sambhaavyata = 4/52 = 1/13.
Jawab: 1/13.
60 aur 80 ke beech kitni abhaajya sankhyaen (prime numbers) hain? Ginati batao.

60 se 80 ke beech ki abhaajya sankhyaen: 61, 67, 71, 73, 79.
Kul ginati = 5.
Jawab: 5 abhaajya sankhyaen hain.
2 cm vyaas (diameter) wali goliyon ko ek 1 m lambi kataar me rakha jaye to kitni goliyan lagengi? (1 m = 100 cm)

Har goli 2 cm jagah leti hai.
Goliyon ki sankhya = 100 ÷ 2 = 50.
Jawab: 50 goliyan lagengi.
Ek belanakar paani ki tanki ki trijya 14 cm aur unchai 20 cm hai. Tanki me kitne litre paani ayega? (π = 22/7, 1000 cm³ = 1 litre)

Tanki ka aayatan = πr²h = 22/7 × 14 × 14 × 20 = 12320 cm³.
Litre me badalne par: 12320 ÷ 1000 = 308/25 litre.
Jawab: tanki me 308/25 litre paani ayega.
Kya sankhya 9747, 3 se poori tarah vibhaajit (divisible) hogi? Kaaran ke saath batao.

3 ki vibhaajyata ka niyam lagane par: anko ka jod = 27.
Shart poori hoti hai, isliye haan — 9747, 3 se poori vibhaajit hogi (9747 ÷ 3 = 3249).
Jawab: Haan, vibhaajit hogi.
Samikaran jodi hal karo: 2x + 3y = 22 aur 3x + 4y = 31.

Viloapan (elimination) vidhi: pehle samikaran ko 3 se aur dusre ko 2 se guna karke ghataane par x kat jata hai.
Hisab karne par y = 4 milta hai.
y ka maan pehle samikaran me rakhne par: 2x + 3×4 = 22, yani 2x = 10, isliye x = 5.
Jawab: x = 5, y = 4.
Agar sin A = 3/5 hai (A nyoon kon hai), to cos A aur tan A ke maan nikalo.

sin A = lamb/karn = 3/5, isliye lamb = 3 aur karn = 5 mano.
Pythagoras se aadhar = √(5² - 3²) = √16 = 4.
cos A = aadhar/karn = 4/5 = 4/5, tan A = lamb/aadhar = 3/4 = 3/4.
Jawab: cos A = 4/5, tan A = 3/4.
Teen sikke uchhalne par kam se kam ek Pat aane ki sambhaavyata nikalo.

Nadi ke kinare khade vyakti ko dusre kinare wale ped ke shikhar ka unnaayan kon 30° dikhta hai. Ped usse 90 m door hai to ped ki unchai nikalo.

tan 30° = unchai/doori = unchai/90, aur tan 30° = 1/√3.

tan 30° = unchai/doori, aur tan 30° = 1/√3.

Python se kaise pata karu ki ek folder me kaunsi files 90 din se purani hain?

File ki aakhri badlav wali tareekh `os.path.getmtime` se milti hai, use aaj ke samay se ghata kar umar nikalti hai:

```python
import os, time

folder = "Downloads"
abhi = time.time()
din = 90
seema = din * 24 * 60 * 60

for file in os.listdir(folder):
    path = os.path.join(folder, file)
    if os.path.isfile(path):
        umar = abhi - os.path.getmtime(path)
        if umar > seema:
            print(file, "- lagbhag", int(umar // 86400), "din purani")
```

`getmtime` file ke badlav ka samay seconds me deta hai. Aaj ke samay (`time.time`) se ghata kar jo farak aaya, use dinon se tulna karke purani files chun li jati hain. Chaaho to inhe alag folder me move ya delete bhi kar sakte ho.

Subah 5:45 baje ka alarm lagane ki simple Python script banao jo samay aane par beep kare

Ye script tab tak chalti rehni chahiye jab tak samay na aaye, isliye loop lagaya hai. `\a` se computer ki beep bajti hai — phone wala asli alarm nahi hai, par computer par kaam karte samay kaam kar jata hai.

Photo ke naam ke aage uski tareekh (date) jodkar rename karne ki script do, taaki photos samay ke kram me lag jayein

File ke badlav wale samay se tareekh nikaal kar naam ke aage lagani hai:

```python
import os, time

folder = "Photos"

for file in os.listdir(folder):
    path = os.path.join(folder, file)
    if os.path.isfile(path) and file.lower().endswith(".jpg"):
        samay = os.path.getmtime(path)
        tareekh = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(samay))
        naya_naam = tareekh + "_" + file
        os.rename(path, os.path.join(folder, naya_naam))
```

Ek folder ki saari files ke naam ke aage 'File_' lagakar number ke saath rename karne ki script banao, ginati 101 se shuru ho

Naam badalne ke liye `os.rename` use hota hai, aur `splitext` se purana extension bacha rehta hai:

```python
import os

folder = "MeraFolder"
files = sorted(os.listdir(folder))
num = 101

for file in files:
    purana = os.path.join(folder, file)
    if os.path.isfile(purana):
        ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1]
        naya_naam = "File_" + str(num) + ext
        os.rename(purana, os.path.join(folder, naya_naam))
        print(file, "->", naya_naam)
        num += 1
```

Pehle files ko sort karke ek kram me liya, phir har file ke aage prefix aur badhta hua number lagaya. Dhyan do — jo file pehle rename ho gayi, usi naam se dobara takraav na ho isliye ginati alag number se shuru ki hai.

Do alag folders me ek hi naam ki duplicate files hain ya nahi, Python se kaise check karu?

Dono folders ke naamon ko set bana kar unka aam hissa (intersection) nikaalna hai:

```python
import os

folder1 = set(os.listdir("FolderA"))
folder2 = set(os.listdir("FolderB"))

aam = folder1 & folder2

if aam:
    print("Dono me maujud files:")
    for file in sorted(aam):
        print("-", file)
else:
    print("Koi duplicate naam nahi mila")
```

Set ka `&` sirf wahi naam deta hai jo dono jagah hain. Ye sirf naam ki tulna hai — do files ka content bhi ek hai ya nahi, uske liye size ya hash milana padega.

```python
    reader = csv.reader(f)
```

```python
import os
```

```python
import os
```

```python
        num += 1
```

Pehle files ko sort karke ek kram me liya, phir har file ke aage prefix aur badhta hua number lagaya. Dhyan do — jo file pehle rename ho gayi, usi naam se dobara takraav na ho isliye ginati alag number se shuru ki hai.

`localtime` bade number wale samay ko saal-mahina-din me tod deta hai, phir tareekh ki tulna aasan ho jati hai. Ye kaam roz ki files alag karne me bahut kaam aata hai.
Password banane ke saath uski jaanch bhi ho — lambai, ank aur nishan hai ya nahi, sab ek saath bataye

Password banakar turant usi par jaanch chalana — dono kaam ek script me:

```python
import random, string

sab = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "!@#$%"
password = "".join(random.choice(sab) for i in range(12))

print("Password:", password)
print("Lambai:", len(password))
print("Ank hai:", any(c.isdigit() for c in password))
print("Nishan hai:", any(c in "!@#$%" for c in password))
```

`any` wali jaanch har shart ko haan/na me bata deti hai. Agar koi shart puri na ho to dobara banane wala loop jod sakte ho.
Python se computer ki disk me kul kitni jagah hai aur kitni khali hai, ye janne ka code do

`shutil.disk_usage` kisi drive ki poori jaankari de deta hai:

```python
import shutil

kul, bhari, khali = shutil.disk_usage("/")

gb = 1024 ** 3
print("Kul jagah:", round(kul / gb, 1), "GB")
print("Khali jagah:", round(khali / gb, 1), "GB")
print("Bhari hui:", round(bhari / gb, 1), "GB")
```

Size bytes me aata hai, isliye GB ke liye 1024 ke ghata teen se bhaag diya. Windows par drive ka akshar (jaise "C:") dena hoga, Linux par "/" chalega.
Python se mere Desktop folder me padi saari .mp4 files ko ek alag 'Videos' folder me kaise daalu?

video files ko alag folder me daalne ke liye `os` se list aur `shutil.move` ka use hota hai:

```python
import os, shutil

folder = "Desktop"
naya_folder = os.path.join(folder, "Videos")
os.makedirs(naya_folder, exist_ok=True)

for file in os.listdir(folder):
    if file.lower().endswith(".mp4"):
        shutil.move(os.path.join(folder, file), os.path.join(naya_folder, file))
        print("Move hua:", file)

print("Kaam ho gaya!")
```

`os.listdir` folder ki saari files deta hai, `endswith` se sirf .mp4 wali chuni jati hain aur `shutil.move` unhe naye folder me bhej deta hai. Folder pehle se na ho to `makedirs` bana deta hai.

Maafi mangna haar nahi, rishte ki jeet hoti hai. Sahi maafi ke teen hisse hote hain: ek, apni galti saaf shabdon me maano — 'galti ho gayi' ki jagah 'bina wajah chilla diya' ye karke maine galat kiya. Do, bina 'lekin' ke — 'sorry, lekin tumne bhi...' wali maafi maafi nahi hoti. Teen, sudhaar ka waada jo tum sach me nibha sako. Samay bhi dekho: jab maa shaant ho tab jao, garam pal me maafi bhi behes ban jati hai. Agar saamne kehna mushkil ho to pehle ek saaf sa message likho, par ho sake to milkar kehna zyada asar karta hai. Maafi ke baad turant sab theek hone ki ummeed mat rakho — bharosa samay se wapas aata hai, tum apna sudhaar dikhate raho.

Buzurgon ki dekhbhal me sabse badi cheez hai: niyamitata aur izzat. Roz ke kaam me ye dhyaan rakho — dawa ka samay pakka aur ek jagah par rakha hua dibba, khana halka aur samay par, ghar me fisalne wali jagahen (bathroom, seedhi) par pakad ka sahara, aur raat ko raaste me halki roshni. Dadaji ki baat ko beech me kaatna band karo; budhape me sabse bada dukh hota hai 'meri koi sunta nahi'. Hafte me kuch samay sirf unke paas baitho — purani baatein sunna unke liye dawa jaisa kaam karta hai. Aur apni seema bhi rakho: dekhbhal karne wale ko bhi araam chahiye, kaam parivaar me baant lo.

Aur sabse bada saboot: apni ab tak ki padhai ki mehnat dikhao; number aur lagan hi maa-pita ko sabse zyada manate hain.

Rishtedaaro ki tulna wali baatein sunna kisi ko achha nahi lagta, par unka jawab behes se dena apni hi shaanti kharab karta hai. Do tareeke rakho: halki baat ko hasi me taal do — 'Chacha, aapki baat sahi hai, koshish jaari hai' kehkar vishay badal do. Diwali kyun manaya jata hai?

Diwali ke peeche sabse prasiddh katha hai ki Bhagwan Ram 14 saal ke vanvaas ke baad Ayodhya laute the, to nagar-wasiyon ne khushi me ghee ke diye jalaye the. Isi liye ise prakash ka tyohar kehte hain — andhere par roshni ki jeet. Isi din Maa Lakshmi aur Bhagwan Ganesh ki puja hoti hai, aur kai jagah samudra-manthan se Maa Lakshmi ke prakat hone ki katha bhi judi hai.
Diwali ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Diwali par ghar ki safai karke diye aur roshni se sajaya jata hai. Shaam ko Lakshmi-Ganesh puja hoti hai, mithaas baanti jati hai, bacche phuljhari-phatake chalate hain aur log ek dusre ke ghar milne jate hain. Dhanteras se Bhai Dooj tak paanch din ka tyohar mana jata hai.
Diwali par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Diwali par gujiya, mathri, namakpare, chakli, laddu, barfi aur kaju katli banti hai. Mehmanon ke liye namkeen aur mithaas ki thali sajti hai.
Diwali par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Ghar ki gehri safai, rangoli, toran (aam ya ashok ke patto ka), mitti ke diye, LED ladiyan aur phoolon ki mala se sajawat hoti hai. Aangan me rangoli banana shubh mana jata hai.
Diwali ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Diwali ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Maa Lakshmi aapke ghar me sukh, samriddhi aur sehat ka vaas karein. Diye ki tarah aapka jeevan hamesha roshan rahe. Shubh Deepavali!
Baccho ko Diwali ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Diwali par hum diye isliye jalate hain kyunki bahut pehle Ram ji vanvaas khatm karke ghar laute the aur sabne khushi me roshni ki thi. Iska matlab hai — achhai ki hamesha jeet hoti hai.
Diwali kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Diwali ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Diwali Bharat ka sabse bada tyohar mana jata hai. Jain dharm me is din Mahavir Swami ko nirvan mila tha aur Sikh parampara me Bandi Chhor Divas bhi isi aas-paas manaya jata hai.

Holi kyun manaya jata hai?

Holi se judi sabse prasiddh katha bhakt Prahlad aur Holika ki hai — Holika aag me jalkar bhasm hui aur bhakt Prahlad surakshit raha, isiliye burai par achhai ki jeet ka tyohar hai. Dusri katha Radha-Krishna ke prem aur rangon se judi hai, isiliye Vrindavan ki Holi duniya bhar me mashhoor hai.
Holi ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Holi se ek raat pehle Holika Dahan hota hai — mohalle me aag jalakar burai ko jalane ka sankalp liya jata hai. Agle din sab ek dusre ko gulal aur rang lagate hain, paani ki pichkari chalti hai, dhol-majeere bajte hain aur gale milkar bhed-bhav bhulaya jata hai.
Holi par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Holi par gujiya sabse khaas hai, saath me thandai, dahi-bade, malpua, mathri aur papad bante hain. Kai jagah thandai me bhang milane ki bhi parampara hai, jo sirf bade log lete hain.
Holi par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?

Holi ke liye khaas sajawat nahi hoti, par ghar par purane safed kapde pehenne, rang-gulal ki thali sajane aur mithaas ki taiyari ki parampara hai. Holika Dahan ke liye mohalle me lakdiyan ikatthi ki jati hain.
Holi ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Holi ki rang-bhari shubhkamnaye! Aapka jeevan khushiyon ke rangon se bhara rahe, saare gile-shikwe is Holi me dhul jayein. Happy Holi!

Holi kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Eid-ul-Fitr kyun manaya jata hai?

Eid-ul-Fitr Ramzan ke ek maheene ke rozon ke sampann hone ki khushi me manayi jati hai. Maana jata hai ki ye Allah ki taraf se rozedaron ko diya gaya inaam ka din hai. Is din gareebon ko fitra (daan) dena wajib mana jata hai taaki wo bhi Eid ki khushi me shamil ho sakein.
Eid-ul-Fitr ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Eid par subah naye kapde pehenkar Eidgah ya masjid me khaas namaz padhi jati hai. Phir log gale milkar 'Eid Mubarak' kehte hain, bacchon ko Eidi (paisa ya tohfa) milti hai aur ghar-ghar mithaas baanti jati hai.
Eid-ul-Fitr par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Eid par sevaiyan (sheer khurma) sabse khaas hai, saath me biryani, kebab, phirni aur tarah-tarah ki mithaas banti hai.
Eid-ul-Fitr par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Eid par ghar ki safai, naye kapde, itr (khushboo) lagana aur mehmaan-nawazi ki khaas taiyari hoti hai. Chaand Raat ko bazaar me raunak hoti hai aur mehndi lagayi jati hai.

Janmashtami kyun manaya jata hai?

Janmashtami Bhagwan Shri Krishna ke janm ka tyohar hai. Katha hai ki Krishna ka janm Mathura ki jail me aadhi raat ko hua tha, jab unke mama Kansa ka atyachaar charam par tha. Vasudev ji unhe tokri me rakhkar Yamuna paar Gokul le gaye the.
Janmashtami ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Is din log vrat rakhte hain, mandiron me Krishna ki jhankiyan sajti hain. Aadhi raat ko Krishna janm ke samay aarti hoti hai aur panjiri-makhan ka bhog lagta hai. Agle din kai jagah Dahi-Handi ka karyakram hota hai jisme yuvaon ki toli unchai par tangi handi phodti hai.

Janmashtami par panjiri, makhan-mishri, panchamrit, kheer aur dhaniya ki panjiri ka bhog khaas hota hai. Vrat walo ke liye kuttu-singhare ke aate ki cheezein banti hain.
Janmashtami par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?

Ganesh Chaturthi kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Pongal kyun manaya jata hai?

Pongal Tamil Nadu ka fasal tyohar hai. Ye Sooraj devta (Surya) ko dhanyavaad dene ka tyohar hai jinki roshni se faslein pakti hain. 'Pongal' ka matlab hai ubalna — naye chawal ko doodh me ubalkar tyohar ki shuruaat hoti hai.
Pongal ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Pongal chaar din manaya jata hai — Bhogi, Surya Pongal, Maattu Pongal (pashuon ki puja) aur Kaanum Pongal. Naye mitti ke bartan me doodh-chawal ubalte hain aur 'Pongalo Pongal' bolkar khushi manate hain. Gai-bail ko sajakar unki puja hoti hai.
Pongal par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Sarkarai Pongal (gud aur doodh wala meetha chawal) sabse khaas hai, saath me ven pongal, vadai aur ganna khaya jata hai.
Pongal par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Ghar ke bahar kolam (rangoli) banti hai, aangan me haldi-kumkum aur ganna sajaya jata hai. Naye bartan aur naye kapde tyohar ki pehchan hain.
Pongal ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Pongal ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Sooraj ki kirno ki tarah aapke jeevan me roshni aur fasal ki tarah samriddhi aaye. Happy Pongal!

Pongal kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Pongal January ke beech me, jab sooraj Makar rashi me pravesh karta hai (Thai maas ka pehla din) aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.

Makar Sankranti kyun manaya jata hai?

Makar Sankranti sooraj ke uttarayan hone ka tyohar hai — is din se din bade hone lagte hain. Ye fasal katne ki khushi aur sooraj devta ke prati kritagyata ka tyohar hai. Kathaon me is din Bhishma Pitamah ne apni ichha se shareer tyaga tha.
Makar Sankranti ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Is din subah snaan karke til-gud ka daan aur sevan hota hai — 'tilgul khao, meetha bolo' kaha jata hai. Aakash me rang-birangi patangein udti hain. Alag rajyon me ye Lohri, Pongal, Bihu aur Uttarayani ke naam se bhi manaya jata hai.
Makar Sankranti par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Til ke laddu, gud, rewari, gajak, khichdi aur dahi-chura khaas hain. Bihar-Jharkhand me dahi-chura aur tilkut prasiddh hai.
Makar Sankranti par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Chhaton par patangbaazi ki taiyari, ghar me til-gud ki mithaas aur mandiron me daan-punya ki parampara hai. Gujarat me aakash patangon se bhar jata hai.
Makar Sankranti ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Makar Sankranti ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Til ki mithaas aur gud ki tarah aapke rishte meethay rahein, patang ki tarah aapki ummeedein unchi udein. Shubh Sankranti!
Baccho ko Makar Sankranti ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Sankranti par hum patang udate hain aur til-gud ke laddu khate hain. Is din se din bade hone lagte hain aur sardi kam hone lagti hai.
Makar Sankranti kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Makar Sankranti Har saal lagbhag 14-15 January ko, jab sooraj Makar rashi me aata hai aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Makar Sankranti ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Prayagraj me Sankranti par Magh Mele aur Kumbh ke snaan ki badi parampara hai. Gujarat ka Uttarayan patang mahotsav duniya bhar me mashhoor hai.
Dost ko Makar Sankranti ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Makar Sankranti ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Shubh Sankranti!
