Onam kyun manaya jata hai?

Onam se judi katha Raja Mahabali ki hai — maana jata hai ki ve har saal Onam par apni praja se milne dharti par aate hain. Mahabali apni daan-veerta aur nyay-priyata ke liye prasiddh the, isiliye Kerala ke log unke swagat me ye tyohar manate hain.
Onam ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Das din tak gharo ke bahar phoolon ki rangoli (Pookalam) banti hai. Vallam Kali (naav daud), Pulikali (bagh nritya) aur kai sanskritik karyakram hote hain. Sabse khaas hai Onam Sadhya — kele ke patte par parosa gaya bada bhoj.
Onam par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Onam Sadhya me 20 se zyada vyanjan kele ke patte par parose jate hain — sambar, avial, thoran, olan, pachadi aur payasam khaas hain. Ye poora bhoj shakahari hota hai.
Onam par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Pookalam ke liye roz taze phool chune jate hain aur design roz bada hota jata hai. Mahilayein kasavu saree (safed-sunehri kinari wali) aur purush mundu pehente hain.
Onam ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Onam ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Raja Mahabali ki tarah aapke ghar me bhi sukh, samriddhi aur ekta ka vaas ho. Happy Onam!
Baccho ko Onam ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Onam Kerala ka tyohar hai. Ek bahut achhe raja Mahabali har saal apne logon se milne aate hain, isiliye sab phoolon ki sundar rangoli banate hain aur kele ke patte par bada khana khate hain.
Onam kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Onam Kerala ke Chingam maas me, aam taur par August-September me, das din tak aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Onam ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Thiruvananthapuram aur Aranmula ki naav daud (Vallam Kali) Onam ki sabse badi pehchan hai, jisme lambi saamp-naav par sau se zyada naavik ek saath chalte hain.
Dost ko Onam ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Onam ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Happy Onam!

Namaskar! Aap sabko onam ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Raja Mahabali ki tarah aapke ghar me bhi sukh, samriddhi aur ekta ka vaas ho. Happy Onam! — Aapka parivaarik bandhan aur prem yun hi bana rahe.
Baisakhi kyun manaya jata hai?
Baisakhi Punjab ka fasal tyohar hai aur Sikh dharm me iska khaas mahatva hai — 1699 me isi din Guru Gobind Singh ji ne Khalsa Panth ki sthapna ki thi aur Panj Pyaron ko amrit chhakaya tha.
Baisakhi ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Kisaan pakki fasal ki khushi me Bhangra-Giddha karte hain. Gurudwaron me kirtan hota hai, Nagar Kirtan (shobha yatra) nikalti hai aur langar lagta hai. Anandpur Sahib me ye tyohar sabse bade star par manaya jata hai.
Baisakhi par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Baisakhi par sarso ka saag-makke ki roti, kheer, kesari chawal aur lassi khaas hai. Gurudware ke langar me sab ek saath baithkar khana khate hain.
Baisakhi par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Gurudwaron ko sajaya jata hai, Nishan Sahib (kesari jhanda) ko naha-dhula kar naya chola pehnaya jata hai. Melon me dhol aur bhangra ki raunak hoti hai.
Baisakhi ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Baisakhi di lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Nayi fasal ki tarah aapke jeevan me bhi samriddhi aur khushhali aaye. Waheguru ji ka Khalsa, Waheguru ji ki Fateh!
Baccho ko Baisakhi ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Baisakhi par kisaan khush hote hain kyunki unki gehun ki fasal pak gayi hoti hai. Sab naachte-gaate hain aur gurudware me sabko free khana (langar) milta hai.
Baisakhi kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Baisakhi Har saal 13 ya 14 April ko, rabi ki fasal pakne ke samay aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Baisakhi ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Assam me lagbhag isi samay Bihu, Bengal me Poila Boishakh aur Tamil Nadu me Puthandu (naya saal) manaya jata hai — April Bharat me nayi shuruaat ka maheena hai.
Dost ko Baisakhi ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Baisakhi di lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Waheguru ji ka Khalsa, Waheguru ji ki Fateh!
Baisakhi par rishtedaaron ko bhejne ke liye shubhkamna sandesh chahiye

Namaskar! Aap sabko baisakhi di lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Nayi fasal ki tarah aapke jeevan me bhi samriddhi aur khushhali aaye. Waheguru ji ka Khalsa, Waheguru ji ki Fateh! — Aapka parivaarik bandhan aur prem yun hi bana rahe.
Christmas ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Girjaghar me aadhi raat ki prarthana (Midnight Mass) hoti hai, carol gaaye jate hain. Ghar me Christmas tree sajta hai, bacche Santa Claus se tohfe ki ummeed karte hain aur parivaar ek saath bhoj karta hai.
Christmas par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Christmas par plum cake, fruit cake, cookies, roast khana aur garam chocolate khaas hai. Bharat me kai jagah biryani aur mithaas bhi banti hai.
Christmas par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Christmas tree par taare, ghantiyan, gubbare aur roshni sajti hai. Ghar ke bahar taara (star) latkana aur jhanki (crib) banana parampara hai — Kerala me ye khaas lokpriya hai.
Christmas ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Christmas ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Aapke ghar me shanti, prem aur khushi ka vaas ho. Santa aapki saari manokamnayein puri kare. Merry Christmas!
Baccho ko Christmas ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Christmas Santa Claus wala tyohar hai! Isa Masih ke janamdin par hum tree sajate hain, cake khate hain aur ek dusre ko tohfe dete hain. Achhe bacchon ko Santa tohfa deta hai.
Christmas kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Christmas Har saal 25 December ko aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Christmas ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Goa ke Christmas aur wahan ke purane girjaghar duniya bhar me prasiddh hain. Shillong aur Kerala me bhi ye tyohar bahut dhoom se manaya jata hai.
Dost ko Christmas ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Christmas ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Merry Christmas!

Guru Nanak Jayanti kyun manaya jata hai?

Guru Nanak Jayanti Sikh dharm ke pehle Guru, Guru Nanak Dev ji ke janm ka tyohar hai. Guru Nanak ji ne 'Ik Onkar' — ek Ishwar, aur 'Naam Japo, Kirat Karo, Vand Chhako' (imaandari ki kamai aur baantkar khana) ka sandesh diya tha.
Guru Nanak Jayanti ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Gurpurab se do din pehle Akhand Path (Guru Granth Sahib ka lagatar path) shuru hota hai. Subah Prabhat Pheri nikalti hai, din me kirtan hota hai aur bada langar lagta hai jisme sab bina bhed ke khana khate hain. Raat ko gurudware roshni se jagmagate hain.
Guru Nanak Jayanti par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Gurpurab par langar me dal, roti, sabzi aur kheer banti hai, saath me karah prasad (aate ka halwa) sabko milta hai.
Guru Nanak Jayanti par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Gurudware ki safai-sewa, phoolon ki sajawat aur roshni hoti hai. Nagar Kirtan me Panj Pyare aage chalte hain aur gatka (paramparik kala) ka pradarshan hota hai.
Guru Nanak Jayanti ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Guru Nanak Jayanti ki lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Guru Nanak Dev ji ke updesh aapke jeevan ko sachchai aur seva ke raaste par le jayein. Waheguru ji ka Khalsa, Waheguru ji ki Fateh!
Baccho ko Guru Nanak Jayanti ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao

Baccho, Guru Nanak ji ek bahut bade sant the. Unhone sikhaya ki sab insaan barabar hain aur humein imaandari se kama kar dusron ke saath baantna chahiye. Gurudware me sabko free khana milta hai — ise langar kehte hain.
Guru Nanak Jayanti kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Guru Nanak Jayanti Kartik Purnima ko, aam taur par November me (Gurpurab) aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Guru Nanak Jayanti ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Amritsar ke Swarn Mandir me Gurpurab ki raunak dekhne layak hoti hai — sarovar me sajawat aur aatishbazi hoti hai. Nankana Sahib (Pakistan) Guru Nanak ji ka janm-sthan hai.
Dost ko Guru Nanak Jayanti ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Guru Nanak Jayanti ki lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Waheguru ji ka Khalsa, Waheguru ji ki Fateh!
Guru Nanak Jayanti par rishtedaaron ko bhejne ke liye shubhkamna sandesh chahiye

Ramzan kyun manaya jata hai?

Ramzan Islam ka sabse pavitra maheena hai. Maana jata hai ki isi maheene me Quran Sharif ka pehla sandesh Hazrat Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ko mila tha. Is maheene me roze rakhkar aatm-sanyam, sabr aur gareebon ke dard ko samajhne ka abhyaas hota hai.
Ramzan ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Rozedhar subah sehri karke roza shuru karte hain aur suraj doobne par iftar se roza kholte hain — aam taur par khajoor aur paani se. Raat ko Tarawih ki khaas namaz hoti hai. Mahine bhar zakat (daan) dene ka khaas mahatva hai.
Ramzan par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Iftar me khajoor, phal, pakode, samose, dahi-bade aur sharbat khaas hain. Sehri me halka aur poshṭik khana khaya jata hai. Iftar ki daawat me rishtedaar aur padosi bhi bulaye jate hain.
Ramzan par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Ramzan me masjidon me roshni aur sajawat hoti hai, gharo me iftar ki dastarkhwan sajti hai. Bazaar me sehri-iftar ke samay khaas raunak hoti hai.
Ramzan ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Ramzan Mubarak! Allah aapke roze, namaz aur duaayein kubool kare. Ye pavitra maheena aapke liye barkat, sehat aur sukh lekar aaye. Ramzan ki dher saari shubhkamnaye!
Baccho ko Ramzan ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao

Baccho, Ramzan ke maheene me bade log subah se shaam tak bina khaye-piye roza rakhte hain. Isse unhe gareebon ki bhookh samajh aati hai aur mann mazboot hota hai. Shaam ko sab milkar iftar khate hain.
Ramzan kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Ramzan Islami calendar ke nauvein maheene me, chaand dikhne se shuru hokar agle chaand tak aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.
Ramzan ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Ramzan ka maheena chaand ke hisaab se chalta hai, isiliye ye har saal lagbhag 10-11 din peeche khisakta hai aur alag-alag mausam me aata hai.
Dost ko Ramzan ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Ramzan Mubarak! Ramzan ki dher saari shubhkamnaye!
Ramzan par rishtedaaron ko bhejne ke liye shubhkamna sandesh chahiye

Chhath kyun manaya jata hai?

Chhath Sooraj devta aur Chhathi Maiya ki upasna ka tyohar hai. Kathaen Mahabharat kaal se judi hain — Draupadi aur Karna dwara surya upasna ki baatein kahi jati hain. Ye tyohar sehat, santan aur parivaar ki samriddhi ke liye manaya jata hai, khaas taur par Bihar, Jharkhand aur purvi UP me.
Chhath ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Vrat rakhne wale chaar din ka kathin vrat rakhte hain — Nahay-Khay, Kharna, phir doobte suraj ko arghya aur agle din ugte suraj ko arghya. Nadi ya talab ke kinare baans ki tokri (soop) me phal aur thekua sajakar puja hoti hai.
Chhath par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Chhath par thekua sabse khaas prasad hai — aate, gud aur ghee se banta hai. Saath me kaddoo-bhaat (Kharna par), phal aur ganna prasad me chadhte hain.
Chhath par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Ghaaton ki safai aur sajawat samudaay milkar karta hai. Mitti ke diye aur kele ke patte se ghaat sajta hai. Ghar me vrat ki pavitrata ka khaas dhyaan rakha jata hai.
Chhath ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Chhath ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Surya dev aur Chhathi Maiya aapke parivaar ko sehat, sukh aur samriddhi dein. Jai Chhathi Maiya!
Baccho ko Chhath ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Chhath par hum nadi kinare jaakar Sooraj ko namaskar karte hain — shaam ko doobte hue aur subah ugte hue. Sooraj humein roshni aur taakat deta hai, isiliye hum use thank you bolte hain.
Chhath kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Chhath ke baare me koi khaas baat batao
Chhath ko sabse kathin vraton me se ek mana jata hai — vrat rakhne wale lagbhag 36 ghante bina paani ke rehte hain. Ye tyohar prakriti puja ka sabse sundar udaharan hai.
Dost ko Chhath ki shubhkamna WhatsApp par bhejni hai, chhota sandesh do
Chhath ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Jai Chhathi Maiya!
Chhath par rishtedaaron ko bhejne ke liye shubhkamna sandesh chahiye

Karwa Chauth kyun manaya jata hai?

Karwa Chauth par vivahit mahilayein apne pati ki lambi umar ke liye vrat rakhti hain. Kathaon me Veeravati ki katha prasiddh hai jiske vrat ke pratap se uske pati ko jeevan mila. 'Karwa' ka matlab hai mitti ka ghada jisse chaand ko arghya diya jata hai.
Karwa Chauth ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Subah suryoday se pehle sargi (saas dwara di gayi thaali) khayi jati hai, phir din bhar nirjala vrat rehta hai. Shaam ko katha suni jati hai aur raat ko chaand dikhne par chhalni se chaand aur phir pati ko dekhkar vrat toda jata hai.
Karwa Chauth par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Sargi me mithaas, phal, parathe aur doodh hota hai. Vrat kholne par poori-sabzi, mithaas aur khaas taur par karwa me bhara paani pehla ghoont hota hai.
Karwa Chauth par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Mahilayein dulhan ki tarah solah shringar karti hain — mehndi, laal saree ya lehnga, choodiyan aur sindoor. Puja ke liye karwa ko rangoli aur aate se sajaya jata hai.
Karwa Chauth ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Karwa Chauth ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Aapka dampatya jeevan prem aur vishwaas se bhara rahe, chaand ki tarah aapka rishta roshan rahe. Happy Karwa Chauth!

Karwa Chauth Kartik maas ke Krishna Paksh ki Chaturthi ko, aam taur par October-November me aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.

Aaj kal kai pati bhi patni ke saath vrat rakhte hain — ye badalti hui ek pyaari parampara hai. Punjab, Delhi, Haryana aur UP me ye tyohar khaas dhoom se manaya jata hai.

Teej kyun manaya jata hai?

Teej Maa Parvati ke vrat ka tyohar hai — katha hai ki Maa Parvati ne Bhagwan Shiv ko pati ke roop me pane ke liye kathin tapasya aur vrat kiya tha. Isiliye ye tyohar dampatya sukh aur achhe var ke liye manaya jata hai.
Teej ka tyohar kaise manate hain?

Mahilayein hari saree pehenti hain, mehndi lagati hain, pedon par jhoole padte hain aur saheliyon ke saath kajli geet gaayi jati hain. Hariyali Teej, Kajari Teej aur Hartalika Teej iske prasiddh roop hain. Kai jagah nirjala vrat rakha jata hai.
Teej par kaun se khaas khane bante hain?
Teej par ghevar sabse khaas mithaas hai, saath me sattu (khaas taur par Rajasthan me), kheer aur maalpua bante hain.
Teej par ghar ki sajawat aur taiyari kaise hoti hai?
Pedon par resham ki dor ke jhoole, mehndi ki sajawat aur hare rang ke kapde-chooliyan Teej ki pehchan hain. Rajasthan me Jaipur ki Teej ki sawari prasiddh hai.
Teej ki badhai ka sandesh likh do
Teej ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Saawan ki phuhar ki tarah aapke jeevan me khushiyan barsein, Maa Parvati aapki manokamnayein puri karein. Happy Teej!
Baccho ko Teej ke baare me aasan bhasha me samjhao
Baccho, Teej barsaat ke mausam ka tyohar hai. Is din didi-aunty hari saree pehenti hain, haathon me mehndi lagati hain aur pedon ke jhoole par jhoolti hain.
Teej kab aata hai, kis maheene me padta hai?

Teej Shravan aur Bhadrapad maas me, aam taur par July-September ki barsaat ke mausam me aata hai. Tyoharon ki tareekh aam taur par chaand-taaron par aadharit panchang se tay hoti hai, isiliye har saal angrezi calendar ki tareekh thodi aage-peeche ho sakti hai.

Jaipur me Teej par Maa Parvati ki bhavya sawari (shobha yatra) nikalti hai jo dekhne ke liye duniya bhar se log aate hain.

Dussehra kyun manaya jata hai?

Dussehra do jeeton ka tyohar hai — Ram ne Ravan ko haraya aur Maa Durga ne Mahishasur ka vadh kiya. Isiliye ise Vijayadashami kehte hain — burai par achhai ki vijay. Navratri ke dasve din ye manaya jata hai.
Dussehra kaise manate hain?

Dussehra par jagah-jagah Ravan, Kumbhkaran aur Meghnad ke bade putle jalaye jate hain. Usse pehle Ramlila me Ram katha ka manchan hota hai. Maharashtra me is din 'sona' (apti ke patte) baantkar ek dusre ko shubhkamnaye di jati hain. Mysore ka Dussehra aur uski haathi sawari duniya bhar me prasiddh hai.
Dussehra ki badhai sandesh likho
Dussehra ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Burai par achhai ki jeet ki tarah aapke jeevan ki har mushkil door ho aur safalta mile. Jai Shri Ram! Shubh Vijayadashami!
Ram Navami kyun manayi jati hai?

Ram Navami Bhagwan Ram ke janm ka tyohar hai, Chaitra maas ki Navami ko manaya jata hai. Ram ko Maryada Purushottam kaha jata hai — unka jeevan sachchai, kartavya aur maryada ki misaal hai. Ayodhya me is din bhavya utsav hota hai.
Ram Navami par kya hota hai?

Mandiron me Ram janm ki jhanki sajti hai, dopeher me Ram ji ka janm manakar aarti hoti hai. Ramayana ka path, bhajan-kirtan hota hai aur panjiri-charanamrit ka prasad bantta hai. Kai jagah shobha yatra bhi nikalti hai.
Mahashivratri kyun manayi jati hai?

Mahashivratri Bhagwan Shiv ki upasna ki sabse badi raat hai. Katha hai ki isi raat Shiv-Parvati ka vivah hua tha, aur ye bhi mana jata hai ki isi din Shiv ne samudra-manthan ka vish piya tha. Bhakt raat bhar jaagkar Shiv ki puja karte hain.
Mahashivratri par vrat aur puja kaise hoti hai?

Bhakt din bhar vrat rakhte hain, Shivling par jal, doodh, belpatra, dhatura aur bhasm chadhate hain. 'Om Namah Shivaya' ka jaap hota hai aur raat ko char pahar ki puja ki parampara hai. Kashi, Ujjain jaise jyotirlingon par badi bheed hoti hai.
Lohri kyun manayi jati hai?

Lohri Punjab ka tyohar hai jo Makar Sankranti se ek raat pehle manaya jata hai. Ye sardi ke khatm hone aur rabi ki fasal ki khushi ka tyohar hai. Aag ko samarpit karke agni dev ka dhanyavaad kiya jata hai aur nayi fasal ki samriddhi ki kamna hoti hai.
Lohri kaise manate hain?

Shaam ko mohalle me badi aag (bonfire) jalayi jati hai, usme til, rewari, moongphali aur gajak daali jati hai. Sab aag ke chaaron or ghoomkar 'Sundar mundariye' gaate hain, Bhangra-Giddha hota hai aur rewari-moongphali baanti jati hai. Naye jode aur navjaat bacche ki pehli Lohri khaas dhoom se manayi jati hai.
Basant Panchami kyun manayi jati hai?

Basant Panchami Maa Saraswati — vidya aur kala ki devi — ke janm ka din mana jata hai. Ye basant ritu ke aagman ka tyohar bhi hai. Is din peela rang khaas hota hai — peeli saree, peela khana aur sarso ke peele phool iski pehchan hain.
Basant Panchami par kya karte hain?

Schoolon aur gharo me Saraswati puja hoti hai, bacche apni kitabein Maa ke saamne rakhte hain. Bengal me ye tyohar bahut bade star par hota hai. Peele chawal aur kesariya mithaas banti hai, aur kai jagah patangbaazi bhi hoti hai.
Akshaya Tritiya ka mahatva kya hai?

Akshaya Tritiya ko sabse shubh dino me se ek mana jata hai — 'akshaya' matlab jo kabhi khatm na ho. Is din bina muhurat dekhe shaadi, griha pravesh aur naye kaam shuru kiye jate hain. Sona kharidna is din shubh mana jata hai aur daan-punya ka khaas mahatva hai.
Hanuman Jayanti kyun manayi jati hai?

Hanuman Jayanti Pawan-putra Hanuman ji ke janm ka tyohar hai. Hanuman ji ko shakti, bhakti aur seva ka prateek mana jata hai. Is din mandiron me Hanuman Chalisa aur Sunderkand ka path hota hai aur bhandaare lagte hain.
Gudi Padwa kya hota hai?

Gudi Padwa Maharashtra ka naya saal hai, Chaitra maas ke pehle din manaya jata hai. Ghar ke bahar baans par kalash, aam ke patte aur gud ki 'gudi' (dhwaj) lagayi jati hai jo vijay ka prateek hai. Neem-gud ka prasad khaya jata hai — jeevan me kadwe-meethe dono anubhavon ka sandesh.
Ugadi kya hota hai?

Ugadi Andhra Pradesh, Telangana aur Karnataka ka naya saal hai. Is din 'Ugadi pachadi' banti hai — neem, gud, imli, mirch, namak aur aam se bani chatni jo jeevan ke chhah swaadon (khushi, dukh, gussa, kadwahat, hairani, dar) ko darshati hai. Panchang ki bhavishyavani sunne ki bhi parampara hai.
Vishu kya hota hai?

Vishu Kerala ka naya saal hai. Subah uthkar sabse pehle 'Vishukkani' dekhi jati hai — chawal, phal, sunehri vastuein aur diya sajakar rakha jata hai, maana jata hai ki saal bhar samriddhi rehti hai. Bade chhoton ko 'Vishukkaineetam' (paisa) dete hain.
Poila Boishakh kya hai?

Poila Boishakh Bengal ka naya saal hai, April ke beech me manaya jata hai. Vyapari naye khate (Haal Khata) shuru karte hain, log naye kapde pehente hain aur Rabindra Sangeet ke karyakram hote hain. Mishti doi aur bengali mithaas is din ki pehchan hai.
Cheti Chand kya hota hai?
Cheti Chand Sindhi samudaay ka naya saal aur Jhulelal ji ka janmotsav hai. Jhulelal ko jal ke devta mana jata hai. Is din shobha yatra nikalti hai aur 'Ayo Lal, Jhoole Lal' ke jaikare lagte hain.

Haldi ki rasam me dulha-dulhan ko haldi, chandan aur tel ka ubtan lagaya jata hai. Maana jata hai ki haldi se rang nikharata hai, buri nazar utarti hai aur shaadi ki chamak aati hai. Ye rasam khushi-mazak se bhari hoti hai — sab parivaar wale ek dusre ko bhi haldi lagate hain.
Haldi ki rasam kyun karte hain, iska matlab kya hai?

Mehndi ki rasam me dulhan aur mahilaon ke haathon-pairon me mehndi ke sundar design banaye jate hain. Kehte hain mehndi ka rang jitna gehra, sasural me utna pyaar milta hai. Is dauraan dholki par geet gaaye jate hain aur nach-gaana hota hai.

Baraat dulhe ki shobha yatra hoti hai — dulha ghodi ya sajawati gaadi par sawaar hokar nachte-gaate dulhan ke ghar ya venue tak jata hai. Band-baaja aur doston ka nach baraat ki jaan hota hai. Dulhan ke parivaar dwara baraat ka swagat hota hai.

Dulha dulhan ki maang me sindoor bharta hai aur maangalsutra pehnata hai. Ye vivahit mahila ki pehchan aur pati ki lambi umar ki kaamna ka prateek mana jata hai. Ye pal shaadi ki sabse bhavuk rasmon me se ek hota hai.

Vidaai me dulhan apne maike se vida hoti hai. Wo peeche ki or chawal phenkti hai — maana jata hai ki isse maike me samriddhi bani rehti hai. Ye sabse bhavuk pal hota hai, phir dulhan apne naye ghar ki or ravana hoti hai.

Aaj bhi ye rasam isiliye nibhayi jati hai kyunki ye sirf ek rivaaz nahi, parivaar ke pyaar aur aashirvaad ka tareeka hai.

Naye ghar me dulhan ka swagat aarti se hota hai. Dulhan kalash ko pair se gira kar (chawal bhara kalash) aur alta lage pairo se andar aati hai — ye Lakshmi ke aagman ka prateek hai.

Sagai (ring ceremony) me dulha-dulhan ek dusre ko angoothi pehnate hain. Ye shaadi ke pakke hone ki ghoshna hoti hai. Dono parivaar mithaas khilakar rishta pakka karte hain.

Tilak ki rasam me dulhan ke parivaar wale dulhe ke ghar jaakar use tilak lagate hain aur tohfe dete hain. Ye rishta svikaar karne aur dulhe ke samman ka prateek hai. Kai jagah ise godh bharai se pehle ki badi rasam mana jata hai.

Bharatiya shaadi kitne din chalti hai?

Bharatiya shaadi aam taur par 2 se 5 din tak chalti hai — haldi, mehndi, sangeet, shaadi aur reception. Kuch samudaayon me rasmein ek hafte tak bhi chalti hain. Har din ka apna rang aur mahatva hota hai.
Shaadi me saat phere hi kyun lete hain?

Saat ki sankhya Bharatiya parampara me pavitra mani jati hai — saat janm, saat vachan. Pheron ke saat vachan dampatya jeevan ki neev hote hain: khana-poshan, shakti, samriddhi, sukh, santan, sehat aur jeevan bhar ki dosti.
Dulhan laal rang kyun pehenti hai?

Laal rang prem, samriddhi aur shakti ka prateek mana jata hai, isiliye dulhan aam taur par laal lehenga ya saree pehenti hai. Halanki aaj kal gulabi, maroon aur pastel rang bhi bahut chalan me hain — samay ke saath pasand badalti rehti hai.
Shaadi me mehndi wale din kya hota hai?

Mehndi wale din dulhan ke ghar khushi ka mahol hota hai — mehndi lagayi jati hai, dholki bajti hai, purani mahilayein paramparik geet gaati hain aur mithaas baanti jati hai. Rishtedaar aur saheliyaan bhi mehndi lagwati hain.
Naamkaran sanskar kya hota hai?

Naamkaran bacche ko naam dene ka sanskar hai, aam taur par janm ke 11ve ya 12ve din hota hai. Havan-puja ke baad bade-buzurg bacche ke kaan me uska naam kehte hain. Naam aksar janm ki rashi ke akshar par rakha jata hai. Is din rishtedaar bacche ko aashirvaad aur tohfe dete hain.
Chhathi ki puja kya hoti hai?

Chhathi janm ke chhathe din manayi jati hai. Maana jata hai ki is raat Vidhata (Bhagwan) bacche ka bhaagya likhte hain, isiliye maa-bacche ke paas kagaz-kalam aur diya rakha jata hai. Maa ki sehat ke liye khaas khana banta hai aur geet gaaye jate hain.
Mundan sanskar kyun karte hain?

Mundan me bacche ke janm ke baal pehli baar kaate jate hain, aam taur par pehle ya teesre saal me. Maana jata hai ki isse bacche ki sehat aur buddhi achhi hoti hai aur pichle janm ke sanskar door hote hain. Kai parivaar ye kisi prasiddh mandir me karte hain, jaise Tirupati ya Vindhyachal.
Annaprashan kya hota hai?

Annaprashan me bacche ko pehli baar ann (khaana) khilaya jata hai, aam taur par 6 maheene ki umar me. Kheer ya meethe chawal se shuruaat hoti hai. Kuch paramparaon me bacche ke saamne kitaab, paisa, mitti jaise saaman rakhkar dekhte hain ki wo kya uthata hai — ye ek mazedaar rasm hoti hai.
Navjaat bacche ko nazar se bachane ke liye kya karte hain?

Bharat me bacche ke maathe ya gaal par kaala teeka lagane, kaala dhaga bandhne aur nazar utaarne (rai-namak ya laal mirch se) ki parampara hai. Ye bade-buzurgon ka pyaar aur suraksha ki bhawna hai — bacche ko buri nazar se bachane ka vishwaas iske peeche hai.
Godh bharai kya hoti hai?

Godh bharai garbhavati mahila ke liye manayi jane wali rasam hai, aam taur par saatvein maheene me. Uske godh me phal, mithaas aur tohfe bhare jate hain aur badi mahilayein hone wale bacche aur maa ko aashirvaad deti hain. Ise Bengal me Shaad aur Tamil Nadu me Valaikappu kehte hain.
Bacche ke janm par kaun se geet gaaye jate hain?

Bacche ke janm par 'sohar' geet gaaye jate hain — khaas taur par UP aur Bihar me. In geeton me Ram-Krishna ke janm se tulna karke bacche ke aagman ki khushi bayaan hoti hai. Mahilayein dholak par ye geet kai dino tak gaati hain.
Janamdin par Bharatiya parampara me kya karte hain?

Paramparik tareeke se janamdin par mandir jaakar aashirvaad liya jata hai, bado ke pair chhoo kar namaskar karte hain aur gareebon ko khana khilaya jata hai. Cake kaatna aadhunik chalan hai, par diya jalana aur tilak lagana aaj bhi kai gharo me hota hai.
Griha pravesh kya hota hai?

Griha pravesh naye ghar me pehli baar pravesh karne ki puja hai. Vastu ke hisaab se shubh muhurat nikala jata hai, havan hota hai aur Ganesh-Lakshmi ki puja ki jati hai. Maana jata hai ki isse ghar me sukh, shanti aur samriddhi rehti hai.
Griha pravesh me kalash kyun le jaate hain?

Kalash ko samriddhi aur devtaon ka nivas mana jata hai. Naye ghar me sabse pehle kalash lekar pravesh karna shubh hota hai. Kalash me paani, aam ke patte aur nariyal rakha jata hai — ye paanch tatvon ka prateek hai.
Naye ghar me pehle din doodh ubalna kyun mana jata hai?
Naye ghar ki rasoi me pehle din doodh ubalkar girana aur kheer banana parampara hai. Doodh shuddhta aur samriddhi ka prateek hai — ubalta doodh bhadti hui barkat ka sanket mana jata hai.
Griha pravesh ki badhai ka sandesh likho
Naye ghar ki hardik badhai! Aapka ye aashiyana hamesha hasi, pyaar aur samriddhi se bhara rahe. Griha pravesh ki dher saari shubhkamnaye!
Griha pravesh me kaun si cheezein shubh mani jati hain?

Pehle din ghar me Ganesh murti, paani bhara kalash, chaandi ka sikka, haldi-kumkum aur deepak shubh mane jate hain. Dwaaar par toran aur rangoli banayi jati hai aur pehla khana meetha banana shubh mana jata hai.
Bharatiya thali kya hoti hai?

Bharatiya thali ek badi thaali me sajaye gaye kai chhote vyanjanon ka sangrah hai — roti, chawal, dal, 2-3 sabziyan, raita, salad, papad, achaar aur mithaas. Iska vichaar hai ki ek bhojan me chhah swaad (meetha, namkeen, kadwa, khatta, teekha, kasaila) milein — ye poshan aur swaad dono ka santulan hai.
Gujarati thali me kya khaas hota hai?
Gujarati thali me khakhra, thepla, dal (thodi meethi), shaak (sabzi), rotli, bhaat, kadhi, farsan aur shrikhand ya aamras hota hai. Gujarati khana halka meetha hone ke liye jana jata hai.
Punjabi khane me kya prasiddh hai?

Punjabi khana makkhan aur desi ghee se bharpur hota hai — dal makhani, sarso ka saag-makke ki roti, butter chicken, amritsari kulcha, rajma-chawal aur lassi duniya bhar me prasiddh hain. Tandoor ki roti-naan Punjabi dhabe ki pehchan hai.
South Indian khana kaisa hota hai?

South Indian khane me chawal mukhya hai — dosa, idli, uttapam, vada, sambar aur rasam prasiddh hain. Nariyal, rai, kadi patta aur imli ka istemal khaas hai. Khana aam taur par kele ke patte par parosa jata hai.
Bengali khane me kya khaas hai?

Bengali khane me machhli (khaas taur par hilsa) aur chawal mukhya hain — 'machh-bhaat' Bengal ki pehchan hai. Sarso ke tel aur paanch phoron ka tadka khaas hai. Mithaas me rasgulla, sandesh aur mishti doi duniya bhar me mashhoor hain.
Rajasthani khana kaisa hota hai?

Rajasthani khana registaan ki jalvayu ke hisaab se bana hai — dal-baati-choorma, gatte ki sabzi, ker-sangri aur bajre ki roti prasiddh hain. Paani ki kami ke kaaran yahan ke khane me tel-ghee zyada aur taaze phal-sabzi kam istemal hoti thi. Mirchi ka teekhapan khaas pehchan hai.
Langar kya hota hai?

Langar Gurudware me lagne wala muft saamoohik bhoj hai, Guru Nanak Dev ji ne shuru kiya tha. Isme raja ho ya rank, sab zameen par ek pankti me baithkar ek jaisa khana khate hain — ye barabari aur seva ka sabse bada prateek hai. Amritsar ke Swarn Mandir me roz lagbhag 50 hazaar log langar khate hain.
Prasad kya hota hai aur kaun kaun se prasiddh prasad hain?

Prasad wo bhog hai jo devta ko chadhakar bhakton me baanta jata hai — maana jata hai ki usme aashirvaad hota hai. Prasiddh prasad: Tirupati ke laddu, Vaishno Devi ka halwa-chana, Jagannath Puri ka Mahaprasad, Vrindavan ki peda aur gurudware ka karah prasad.
Kele ke patte par khana kyun khate hain?

South India aur kai paramparaon me kele ke patte par khana parosa jata hai. Kele ka patta saaf, bada aur prakritik hota hai — uspar garam khana rakhne se halki khushboo aur poshak tatva bhi milte maane jate hain. Ye paryavaran ke liye bhi achha hai kyunki patta mitti me mil jata hai.
Vrat me khana kaisa hota hai?

Vrat me aam taur par anaaj (gehun-chawal) nahi khaya jata. Kuttu, singhara, sabudana, samak ke chawal, phal, doodh-dahi aur sendha namak ka istemal hota hai. Aise khane ko 'phalahar' kehte hain — halka aur saatvik.
Saatvik khana kya hota hai?

Saatvik khana wo hai jo bina lahsun-pyaaz, halka aur taaza bana ho. Maana jata hai ki aisa khana mann ko shaant aur shareer ko halka rakhta hai. Puja-path aur vrat me aam taur par saatvik bhojan hi banta hai.
Bharat me mehmaan-nawazi ki parampara kya hai?

Bharat me 'Atithi Devo Bhava' — mehmaan ko devta ke barabar mana jata hai. Ghar aaye mehmaan ko bina khilaye nahi bhejte, chahe apne hisse ka khana hi kyun na dena pade. Ye parampara Bharat ki sabse purani aur pyaari paramparaon me se ek hai.
Puri ke Mahaprasad ki khaas baat kya hai?

Jagannath Puri ka Mahaprasad mitti ke bartano me, lakdi ki aag par banta hai. Khaas baat ye hai ki bartano ko ek ke upar ek rakhkar pakaya jata hai aur sabse upar wala bartan sabse pehle pakta hai. Ye prasad Anand Bazaar me bhakton ko milta hai.
Hindu parampara me nariyal kyun foda jata hai?

Puja me nariyal fodna ahamkaar ko todne ka prateek mana jata hai — upar ki sakht khol hamari kathorta aur andar ka safed hissa shuddh mann ka prateek hai. Nariyal ko 'shriphal' kaha jata hai aur ye har puja me chadhaya jata hai.
Ghar me tulsi ka paudha kyun lagate hain?

Tulsi ko pavitra mana jata hai aur use 'maa' ka darja diya gaya hai. Vaigyanik roop se tulsi hawa ko shuddh karti hai aur usme aushadhiya gun hote hain. Aangan me tulsi chaura banakar roz diya jalane aur jal chadhane ki parampara hai.
Diya kyun jalate hain puja me?

Diya agyaan ke andhere ko door karke gyaan ki roshni ka prateek hai. Maana jata hai ki deepak ki jyoti nakaratmakta ko door karti hai. Isiliye har puja, aarti aur tyohar me diya jalana sabse pehla kaam hota hai.
Tilak kyun lagate hain maathe par?

Tilak aadar aur shubh ka prateek hai. Mehmaan ke swagat me, puja ke baad aur tyoharon par maathe par tilak lagaya jata hai. Chandan ka tilak thandak deta hai, kumkum shakti ka prateek hai. Alag samudaayon ke tilak ki aakriti bhi alag hoti hai.
Aarti kya hoti hai aur thaali kyun ghumate hain?

Aarti me deepak, dhoop aur phool ki thaali devta ke saamne gol ghumayi jati hai. Maana jata hai ki deepak ki roshni devta ki shakti se bhar jati hai, phir wahi roshni haath se lekar maathe par lagane se aashirvaad milta hai. Aarti ke saath ghanti aur shankh bhi bajaye jate hain.
Pair chhoo kar namaskar kyun karte hain?

Bado ke pair chhoona unke anubhav aur aashirvaad ke prati samman dikhata hai. Maana jata hai ki jhukne se ahamkaar khatm hota hai aur bade khushi se aashirvaad dete hain. Tyohar, janamdin aur kisi bade kaam ki shuruaat par ye parampara aam hai.
Namaste ka matlab kya hai?

Namaste ka arth hai 'main aapke andar ke divya tatva ko naman karta hoon'. Dono haath jodkar namaste karna samman ka sabse saral aur sundar tareeka hai. Ye Bharat ki pehchan hai aur duniya bhar me apnaya gaya hai.
Bharatanatyam nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Ye Bharat ke sabse prachin shastriya nrityon me se ek hai, jo mandiron se shuru hua. Isme katha ko bhaav-bhangi aur hasta-mudraon se dikhaya jata hai. Nritya karne wali ki poshak resham ki saree aur gahne hote hain.
Bharatanatyam ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Ye Bharat ke sabse prachin shastriya nrityon me se ek hai, jo mandiron se shuru hua. Isme katha ko bhaav-bhangi aur hasta-mudraon se dikhaya jata hai. Nritya karne wali ki poshak resham ki saree aur gahne hote hain. Ye Tamil Nadu ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Kathak nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Kathak ka matlab hi hai 'katha sunane wala'. Ye nritya seedhi khadi mudra, tez gol ghumav (chakkar) aur pairon ki lay (ghungroo) ke liye jana jata hai. Mughal darbar aur mandir dono me iska vikas hua.
Kathak ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Kathak ka matlab hi hai 'katha sunane wala'. Ye nritya seedhi khadi mudra, tez gol ghumav (chakkar) aur pairon ki lay (ghungroo) ke liye jana jata hai. Mughal darbar aur mandir dono me iska vikas hua. Ye Uttar Pradesh ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Kathakali nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Kathakali Kerala ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Kathakali me nritya-naatika hoti hai — kalakar bade rang-birange mukhaute (hare rang ka make-up), bade ghaghra-numa poshak pehenkar Ramayan-Mahabharat ki kathayein dikhate hain. Sirf aankhon aur ungliyon ke bhaav se puri katha samajh aa jati hai.
Kathakali ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Kathakali me nritya-naatika hoti hai — kalakar bade rang-birange mukhaute (hare rang ka make-up), bade ghaghra-numa poshak pehenkar Ramayan-Mahabharat ki kathayein dikhate hain. Sirf aankhon aur ungliyon ke bhaav se puri katha samajh aa jati hai. Ye Kerala ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Odissi nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Odissi Odisha ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Odissi Bhagwan Jagannath ki bhakti se juda nritya hai. Isme shareer ki 'tribhangi' mudra (teen jagah se muda shareer) aur mulayam gati khaas hai. Chandi ke gahne aur resham ki saree iski pehchan hai.
Odissi ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Odissi Bhagwan Jagannath ki bhakti se juda nritya hai. Isme shareer ki 'tribhangi' mudra (teen jagah se muda shareer) aur mulayam gati khaas hai. Chandi ke gahne aur resham ki saree iski pehchan hai. Ye Odisha ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Kuchipudi nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Kuchipudi nritya-naatak ki shaili hai jo Andhra ke ek gaon ke naam par hai. Isme kalakar thaali par pair rakhkar aur sir par ghada lekar bhi nritya karte hain — Tarangam iski sabse prasiddh prastuti hai.
Kuchipudi ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Kuchipudi nritya-naatak ki shaili hai jo Andhra ke ek gaon ke naam par hai. Isme kalakar thaali par pair rakhkar aur sir par ghada lekar bhi nritya karte hain — Tarangam iski sabse prasiddh prastuti hai. Ye Andhra Pradesh ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Manipuri nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Manipuri Manipur ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Manipuri nritya Radha-Krishna ki raas-leela par aadharit hai. Mahila kalakar ghanti-aakar ki lambi poshak (potloi) pehenti hain aur nritya bahut hi komal aur dhimi gati ka hota hai — bina tez awaaz ke.
Manipuri ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Manipuri nritya Radha-Krishna ki raas-leela par aadharit hai. Mahila kalakar ghanti-aakar ki lambi poshak (potloi) pehenti hain aur nritya bahut hi komal aur dhimi gati ka hota hai — bina tez awaaz ke. Ye Manipur ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Mohiniyattam nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Mohiniyattam Kerala ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Mohiniyattam ka matlab hai 'mohini ka nritya' — ye Kerala ka komal mahila nritya hai. Safed-sunehri kinari wali saree pehenkar kiya jane wala ye nritya apni dheemi, lachakti gati ke liye jana jata hai.
Mohiniyattam ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Mohiniyattam ka matlab hai 'mohini ka nritya' — ye Kerala ka komal mahila nritya hai. Safed-sunehri kinari wali saree pehenkar kiya jane wala ye nritya apni dheemi, lachakti gati ke liye jana jata hai. Ye Kerala ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Sattriya nritya kahan ka hai aur kaisa hota hai?

Sattriya Assam ka prasiddh shastriya nritya hai. Sattriya Assam ke Vaishnav mathon (sattra) se aaya nritya hai, sant Srimanta Sankardev ne ise shuru kiya tha. Isme Krishna kathaon ka manchan hota hai. Ye Bharat ke aath pramukh shastriya nrityon me sabse baad me shamil hua.
Sattriya ki khaas pehchan kya hai?

Sattriya Assam ke Vaishnav mathon (sattra) se aaya nritya hai, sant Srimanta Sankardev ne ise shuru kiya tha. Isme Krishna kathaon ka manchan hota hai. Ye Bharat ke aath pramukh shastriya nrityon me sabse baad me shamil hua. Ye Assam ki sanskritik pehchan hai.
Garba kahan ka lok nritya hai?

Garba Gujarat ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Navratri me Maa Durga ke chaaron or gol ghoomkar kiya jane wala nritya. Beech me rakhe deepak ya garba (chhedo wala ghada) ke chaaron or mahilayein aur purush rang-birange kapdo me nritya karte hain.
Bhangra kahan ka lok nritya hai?
Bhangra Punjab ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Fasal katne ki khushi ka nritya, dhol ki thaap par unchi chhalang aur zor bhari gati iski pehchan hai. Baisakhi par iska khaas mahatva hai.
Giddha kahan ka lok nritya hai?
Giddha Punjab ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Mahilaon ka nritya jisme boliyan (chhote geet) gaakar taali aur bhaav se kahaniyan sunayi jati hain.
Bihu kahan ka lok nritya hai?
Bihu Assam ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Bihu tyohar par kiya jane wala nritya, jo naye saal aur fasal ka jashn hai. Dhol, pepa aur gagana ki dhun par tez aur lachakti gati hoti hai.
Ghoomar kahan ka lok nritya hai?

Ghoomar Rajasthan ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Mahilayein bade gheredar ghagre me gol ghoomti hain — ghaghra ghumne se phool ki tarah khilta hai. Rajput parampara se juda ye nritya shaan ka prateek hai.
Lavani kahan ka lok nritya hai?

Lavani Maharashtra ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Dholki ki tez lay par kiya jane wala urja-bhara nritya, nauvari saree pehenkar mahilayein karti hain. Ye nritya apni tez gati aur theth bhaav ke liye jana jata hai.
Yakshagana kahan ka lok nritya hai?

Yakshagana Karnataka-Kerala ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Nritya-naatak ki parampara jisme bade mukut, bhaari make-up aur unchi awaaz me samvaad hote hain. Ramayan-Mahabharat ki kathayein raat bhar chalne wale is khel me dikhayi jati hain.
Dandiya kahan ka lok nritya hai?
Dandiya Gujarat ka prasiddh lok nritya hai. Navratri me do lakdiyon (dandiya) ko ek dusre se bajakar kiya jane wala nritya. Jodiyan gol ghumte hue lay me lakdiyan takrati hain.
Bharat ke pramukh vadya yantra kaun se hain?

Bharat ke prasiddh vadya hain — sitar, tabla, veena, bansuri (flute), harmonium, dholak, sarangi, santoor, mridangam, pakhawaj, shehnai aur nagada. Inme se kuch shastriya sangeet me aur kuch lok sangeet me bajaye jate hain.
Hindustani aur Carnatic sangeet me kya farak hai?

Hindustani sangeet Uttar Bharat me aur Carnatic sangeet Dakshin Bharat me prachlit hai. Dono ki neev raag aur taal hai, par Carnatic me raag ki sanrachna zyada niyamit hoti hai aur usme veena-mridangam ka bolbala hai, jabki Hindustani me khayal aur tabla-sitar zyada prasiddh hain.
Shehnai kiska vadya hai aur kahan bajti hai?

Shehnai ek shubh vadya mana jata hai — shaadiyon aur mandiron me iski awaaz sunayi deti hai. Ustad Bismillah Khan ne shehnai ko duniya bhar me prasiddh kiya; unki shehnai Kashi ke Vishwanath mandir se judi thi.
Tabla kya hai aur kaun bajata hai?

Tabla do chhote dholon ka joda hai jo haathon se bajaya jata hai — ek lakdi ka (dayan) aur ek dhatu ka (bayan). Ye Hindustani sangeet ki lay ki jaan hai. Ustad Zakir Hussain duniya ke sabse prasiddh tabla vadako me se hain.
Lok geet kya hote hain?

Lok geet aam janta ke geet hain jo pidhi-dar-pidhi chale aate hain — shaadi ke geet, sohar, kajri, phag, bidaai geet, fasal ke geet. Har kshetra ki apni boli aur dhun hoti hai. Ye geet jeevan ki khushi-dukh ka sabse saccha darpan hain.
Bhajan aur kirtan me kya farak hai?

Bhajan akele ya chhote samooh me gaya jane wala bhakti geet hai, jabki kirtan me ek mukhya gayak gayaata hai aur samooh dohrata hai — taaliyon aur manjire ke saath. Dono ka maksad bhakti hai, kirtan me samooh ki bhagidari zyada hoti hai.
Qawwali kya hoti hai?

Qawwali Sufi parampara ka bhakti sangeet hai jo dargahon me gaya jata hai. Isme taaliyon ke saath unchi urja me Allah aur Sufi santon ki shaan me kalaam pesh hota hai. Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan ko 'Shahenshah-e-Qawwali' kaha jata hai.
Saree Bharat me itni khaas kyun hai?

Saree Bharat ki sabse purani aur priya poshak hai — 5-9 gaj ka kapda bina silayi ke lapeta jata hai. Har rajya ki apni saree hai aur use pehenne ka tareeka bhi alag hai. Saree har mauke — roz se lekar shaadi tak — ke liye upyukt hai.
Banarasi saree kahan ki hai?
Banarasi saree Varanasi (Banaras), Uttar Pradesh ki hai. Ye resham par sunehri-chaandi ke zari ke kaam ke liye duniya bhar me prasiddh hai aur dulhan ki pehli pasand hoti hai.
Kanjivaram saree kahan ki hai?

Kanjivaram (Kanchipuram) saree Tamil Nadu ke Kanchipuram shahar ki hai. Ye shuddh resham, gehri sunehri kinari aur mandir-design ke liye jani jati hai. Dakshin Bharat ki shaadiyon me iska khaas sthan hai.
Bandhej (Bandhani) kahan ki hai?

Bandhej ya Bandhani Gujarat aur Rajasthan ki prasiddh bandh-rangai kala hai — kapde ko chhoti gaanth bandhkar rangte hain jisse bindu-design banta hai. Bandhej ki chunri aur saree tyoharon me khoob pehni jati hai.
Paithani saree kahan ki hai?
Paithani Maharashtra ke Paithan shahar ki resham saree hai. Mor aur kamal ke design wala iska pallu iski pehchan hai. Ise Maharashtra ki shaan kaha jata hai.
Purushon ki paramparik poshak kya hai Bharat me?

Purushon ki paramparik poshakon me kurta-pajama, dhoti-kurta, sherwani, bandhgala (Jodhpuri), pagdi/saafa aur dakshin me mundu-veshti shamil hain. Tyoharon aur shaadiyon me kurta aur Nehru jacket bahut lokpriya hai.
Pagdi kyun pehente hain, iska kya mahatva hai?

Pagdi (saafa) samman aur pehchan ka prateek hai. Rajasthan me pagdi ka rang mauke ke hisaab se hota hai — kesariya tyohar par, safed shok par. Sikh dharm me dastar (pagdi) dharmik mahatva rakhti hai — ye Kesh ki raksha aur pehchan hai. Mehmaan ko pagdi pehnana samman dena mana jata hai.
Dhoti kya hoti hai?
Dhoti kamar par lapeti jane wali safed ya halki kinari wali poshak hai, khaas taur par puja-path aur tyoharon me pehni jati hai. Bengal me dhoti-panjabi aur dakshin me mundu iske kshetriya roop hain.
Shaadi me dulha kya pehenta hai?

Dulha aam taur par sherwani, kurta-pajama ya bandhgala pehenta hai, saath me saafa (pagdi), sehra aur jutti. Kuch paramparaon me dulha talwar ya kataar bhi rakhta hai. Aaj kal Indo-western bhi chalan me hai.
Chaniya choli kya hai?
Chaniya choli Gujarat ki mahila poshak hai — gheredar ghaghra (chaniya), choli aur odhni. Navratri ke Garba me rang-birangi kaanch-jadi chaniya choli pehni jati hai.
Phulkari kahan ki kala hai?

Phulkari Punjab ki kadhai kala hai — 'phul' matlab phool. Isme resham ke dhaago se kapde par phoolon ke design bante hain. Phulkari dupatta Punjabi poshak ki shaan hai aur shubh avsaron par odha jata hai.
Lehenga aur ghaghra me kya farak hai?

Dono hi lambe gheredar skirt hain. Ghaghra aam taur par roz aur lok nrityo me pehna jane wala halka roop hai, jabki lehenga shaadi-tyoharon ke liye bhaari kadhai-zari wala shandaar roop hai. Sath me choli aur dupatta dono ke saath hota hai.
Mekhela chador kahan ki poshak hai?
Mekhela chador Assam ki mahilaon ki paramparik poshak hai — do hisson me pehni jati hai, safed par laal kinari iski pehchan hai. Bihu par ye khoob pehni jati hai.
Tyoharon par naye kapde kyun pehente hain?

Tyohar nayi shuruaat ka prateek hai — naye kapde pehenna khushi aur pavitrata ko darshata hai. Baccho ke liye to tyohar ka matlab hi naye kapde aur mithaas hota hai. Ye parampara har dharm aur kshetra me milti hai.
Kumbh Mela kya hota hai?

Kumbh Mela duniya ka sabse bada dharmik mela hai. Katha hai ki samudra-manthan se nikle amrit ke ghade (kumbh) se amrit ki boondein chaar jagah giri thi — Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain aur Nashik. Wahi chaar sthanon par baari-baari se Kumbh lagta hai jahan karodon log pavitra nadi me snaan karte hain.
Kumbh Mela kitne saal me lagta hai?

Har sthan par Kumbh 12 saal me ek baar lagta hai, aur 6 saal par Ardh-Kumbh hota hai. Prayagraj me 144 saal me ek baar Maha Kumbh ki parampara mani jati hai. Kumbh ko UNESCO ne manavta ki sanskritik virasat ki soochi me shamil kiya hai.
Kumbh me Shahi Snaan kya hota hai?

Shahi Snaan Kumbh ke sabse pavitra din hote hain jab akhaadon ke sadhu-sant — Naga sadhu sabse aage — shobha yatra ke saath nadi me snaan karte hain. Maana jata hai ki in dino snaan karne se paap dhul jate hain.
Pushkar Mela kahan lagta hai?

Pushkar Mela Rajasthan ke Pushkar shahar me Kartik Purnima ke aas-paas lagta hai. Ye duniya ke sabse bade unt (camel) melon me se ek hai — saath me Pushkar jheel me snaan aur Brahma mandir ke darshan ka mahatva hai. Pushkar me Bhagwan Brahma ka ekmaatra prasiddh mandir hai.
Sonepur Mela kya hai?

Sonepur Mela Bihar ke Sonepur me Ganga-Gandak ke sangam par lagta hai. Ye Asia ke sabse bade pashu melon me se ek hai jahan haathi, ghode aur gai-bail ki kharid-bikri hoti thi. Kartik Purnima par yahan snaan ka khaas mahatva hai.
Surajkund Mela kahan hota hai?

Surajkund Mela Haryana ke Faridabad me har saal February me lagta hai. Ye hast-shilp (handicraft) ka antarrashtriya mela hai jisme Bharat ke har rajya ke karigar apni kala, poshak aur khana pesh karte hain.
Hornbill Mahotsav kya hai?

Hornbill Mahotsav Nagaland ka sabse bada tyohar hai, December ke pehle hafte Kohima ke paas Naga Heritage Village me hota hai. Isme Naga janajatiyon ke nritya, geet, poshak aur khana ek saath dekhne ko milta hai. Hornbill Nagaland ki rajkya pakshi hai.
Rath Yatra kya hoti hai?

Rath Yatra Odisha ke Puri me hoti hai jisme Bhagwan Jagannath, Balabhadra aur Subhadra bade lakdi ke rathon par sawaar hokar Gundicha mandir jate hain. Lakhs log rath ki rassi kheenchna punya ka kaam mante hain. Isi se angrezi shabd 'juggernaut' bana hai.
Durga Puja Kolkata ki kyun khaas hai?

Kolkata ki Durga Puja duniya bhar me prasiddh hai — har mohalle me theme-based bhavya pandal, kala se bhari murtiyan aur roshni ki sajawat hoti hai. UNESCO ne ise manavta ki sanskritik virasat me shamil kiya hai. Dhunuchi nritya aur sindoor khela iski khaas pehchan hain.
Sindoor Khela kya hota hai?

Durga Puja ke antim din (Vijayadashami) Bengal ki vivahit mahilayein Maa Durga ko sindoor chadhakar ek dusre ko sindoor lagati hain. Ye sukh-samriddhi aur dampatya sukh ki kamna ki parampara hai. Safed-laal kinari wali saree is din ki pehchan hai.
Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam ka matlab kya hai?
Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam ka arth hai 'puri duniya ek parivaar hai'. Ye Bharat ke sabse purane vichaaron me se ek hai — isiliye Bharat me har dharm aur sanskriti ko apnane ki parampara rahi hai.
Yoga Divas kab aur kyun manaya jata hai?

Antarrashtriya Yoga Divas har saal 21 June ko manaya jata hai. Bharat ke prastav par sanyukt rashtra ne ise 2015 se shuru kiya. Yoga Bharat ki prachin den hai jo shareer aur mann dono ko swasth rakhti hai.
Bakrid (Eid-ul-Adha) kya hoti hai?

Eid-ul-Adha, jise Bakrid bhi kehte hain, kurbani ka tyohar hai. Maana jata hai ki Hazrat Ibrahim ne Allah ke hukm par apni sabse priya cheez ki kurbani ki taiyaari dikhayi thi — unki is nishtha ki yaad me ye tyohar manaya jata hai. Is din kurbani ke maans ka ek hissa gareebon me baanta jata hai — baantna is tyohar ki jaan hai.
Muharram kya hota hai?

Muharram Islami saal ka pehla maheena hai. Iske dasve din (Ashura) Hazrat Imam Hussain ki Karbala me di gayi shahadat ki yaad manayi jati hai. Shia samudaay is din majlis aur maatam karta hai aur kai jagah sabeel (sharbat-paani) baanti jati hai. Sunni samudaay ke log bhi is din roza rakhte hain. Ye tyohar balidaan aur sachchai ke liye khade hone ki seekh deta hai.
Buddha Purnima kya hai?

Buddha Purnima Bhagwan Buddha ke janm, gyaan-prapti aur nirvan — teeno ka din mana jata hai, teeno Vaishakh Purnima ko hue maane jate hain. Is din Bodh Gaya aur Sarnath me badi shraddha se puja hoti hai. Buddha ka sandesh hai — ahimsa, karuna aur madhya marg.
Mahavir Jayanti kya hoti hai?

Mahavir Jayanti Jain dharm ke 24ve Tirthankar Bhagwan Mahavir ke janm ka tyohar hai. Is din Jain mandiron me abhishek hota hai aur shobha yatra nikalti hai. Mahavir ke paanch siddhant hain — ahimsa, satya, asteya (chori na karna), brahmacharya aur aparigrah (zyada sangrah na karna).
Good Friday aur Easter kya hote hain?

Good Friday ke din Isa Masih ke balidaan (crucifixion) ki yaad me girjagharo me prarthana aur upvaas hota hai. Uske baad wale Ravivaar ko Easter manaya jata hai — maana jata hai ki is din Isa Masih punarjeevit hue the. Easter khushi ka tyohar hai, isme Easter eggs sajane ki parampara bhi hai.
Fasal wale tyohar kaun kaun se hain Bharat me?

Bharat ke mukhya fasal tyohar hain — Punjab me Baisakhi aur Lohri, Tamil Nadu me Pongal, Kerala me Onam, Assam me Bihu, Maharashtra me Pola (bailon ki puja), Chhattisgarh-Odisha me Nuakhai (naya chawal) aur poore Bharat me Makar Sankranti. Sabka mool ek hai — kisan aur prakriti ka dhanyavaad.
Bharat me chaand dekhkar kaun se tyohar tay hote hain?

Hindu panchang chaand par aadharit hai, isiliye Diwali, Holi, Rakhi jaise tyohar chaand ki tithi se tay hote hain. Islami calendar bhi chaand par aadharit hai — Ramzan aur Eid chaand dikhne se hi tay hote hain. Isiliye in tyoharon ki angrezi tareekh har saal badalti hai.
Har tyohar par mithaas kyun baanti jati hai?

Mithaas khushi aur shubh ka prateek hai. Bharatiya parampara me koi bhi achhi khabar ya tyohar bina munh meetha kiye adhura mana jata hai — mithaas baantne ka matlab hai apni khushi me sabko shamil karna.
Ganga Aarti kahan kahan hoti hai?

Ganga Aarti Varanasi ke Dashashwamedh Ghaat, Haridwar ki Har Ki Paudi aur Rishikesh ke Triveni Ghaat par prasiddh hai. Shaam ko pandit bade deepakon se maa Ganga ki aarti karte hain — hazaron diye nadi me baha diye jate hain, ye drishya duniya bhar ke paryatakon ko kheenchta hai.
Nariyal aur phool puja me kyun chadhate hain?

Phool prakriti ki sabse shuddh aur sundar bhet mane jate hain — ve pavitrata aur komalta ka prateek hain. Nariyal ko shriphal kaha jata hai. Puja me ye cheezein chadhana matlab apni sabse achhi cheez Ishwar ko samarpit karna.
Pandit ji panchang dekhkar muhurat kyun nikaalte hain?

Muhurat grah-nakshatron ke hisaab se chuna gaya shubh samay hota hai. Shaadi, griha pravesh jaise bade kaamon ke liye muhurat nikalne ki parampara hai taaki kaam shubh ghadi me shuru ho. Ye vishwaas aur parampara ka hissa hai.
Bharat ko tyoharon ka desh kyun kehte hain?

Bharat me saal ke lagbhag har maheene koi na koi bada tyohar hota hai — alag dharm, alag kshetra, alag fasal aur alag mausam ke. Yahan tyohar sirf dharmik nahi, samajik bhi hain — log ek dusre ke tyoharon me shamil hote hain, isiliye Bharat ko tyoharon ka desh kehte hain.
Dost ke janamdin par Bharatiya andaz me badhai sandesh likho
Janamdin ki hardik badhai, mere dost! Aaj ke din bado ka aashirvaad lo aur cake ke saath mithaas bhi baato. Naya saal tumhare liye sehat, safalta aur dher saari khushiyan lekar aaye. Party pakki!
Kisi ki shaadi par shubhkamna sandesh likho
Vivah ki hardik badhai! Aap dono ka saath saat pheron ke vachano ki tarah hamesha mazboot rahe, jeevan khushiyon se bhara rahe. Nav-dampati ko dher saara pyaar aur aashirvaad!
Naye saal ki shubhkamna Bharatiya andaz me likho
Naye saal ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Pichhle saal ki seekh saath rakho aur naye saal me nayi ummeedon ke saath aage badho. Aapke ghar me sukh, shanti aur samriddhi bani rahe. Happy New Year!
Nayi naukri milne par badhai sandesh likho
Nayi naukri ki bahut bahut badhai! Tumhari mehnat rang laayi. Aise hi imaandari aur lagan se aage badhte raho — pehli tankhwah ki mithaas hamari taraf se pakki!
Pariksha me safalta par badhai sandesh likho
Pariksha me safalta ki hardik badhai! Ye tumhari mehnat ka phal hai. Aage bhi aise hi badhte raho, maa-baap ka naam roshan karo. Mithaas khilana mat bhoolna!
Safar par jaane wale ko shubhkamna sandesh likho
Aapki yatra mangalmay ho! Surakshit jao, surakshit aao. Ghar wale aapka intezaar karenge — wapas aakar yatra ki kahaniyan zaroor sunana. Shubh yatra!
Bimaar rishtedaar ke liye shubhkamna sandesh likho
Aapke jald swasth hone ki kamna karte hain. Aaram karo aur dawa samay par lo — hum sab ki duaayein aapke saath hain. Jaldi theek hokar ghar ki raunak phir badhao.
Teacher ko Guru Purnima par sandesh likho
Guru Purnima ki hardik shubhkamnaye, Guruji! Aapne sirf kitaabi gyaan nahi, jeevan jeena sikhaya hai. Aapke aashirvaad aur margdarshan ke liye hamesha aabhari rahunga. Charan sparsh!
Guru Purnima kya hoti hai?

Guru Purnima Ashadh maas ki Purnima ko manayi jati hai — ye guruon ke prati aabhar vyakt karne ka din hai. Maana jata hai ki is din Maharshi Ved Vyas ka janm hua tha jinhone Mahabharat likhi aur Vedo ka sangrah kiya. Shishya is din guru ke pair chhookar aashirvaad lete hain.
Buddhist aur Jain dharm me Guru Purnima ka mahatva kya hai?

Buddha ne apna pehla updesh (Dharmachakra) Guru Purnima ke din hi Sarnath me diya tha, isiliye Buddha anuyayion ke liye ye din khaas hai. Jain parampara me bhi guru-vandana ka is din mahatva hai. Ye din dikhata hai ki guru ka samman har Bharatiya parampara me ek jaisa hai.
Makar Sankranti par dost ko sandesh bhejo
Tilgul khao, meetha bolo! Makar Sankranti ki badhai dost — patang ki tarah tumhari har ummeed aasman chhooe, aur hamari dosti gud ki tarah meethi bani rahe!
Pongal par sahkarmi ko sandesh bhejna hai
Pongal ki shubhkamnaye! Nayi fasal ki khushboo ki tarah aapke kaam me bhi nayi safalta aaye. Parivaar ke saath tyohar ka aanand lein. Happy Pongal!
Onam par dost ko Malayalam mila sandesh do
Onam Ashamsakal! (Onam ki shubhkamnaye — Malayalam me). Sadhya ka swaad aur Pookalam ke rang tumhare jeevan me khushiyan bharein. Happy Onam, dost!
Baisakhi par Punjabi me badhai sandesh do
Baisakhi diyan lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Rab tuhanu hamesha chardi kala vich rakhe (Bhagwan aapko hamesha unchi bhaavna aur khushi me rakhein). Fasal wangu tuhada jeevan vi hara bhara rahe!
Eid par dost ko sandesh bhejo
Chaand Mubarak aur Eid Mubarak, dost! Sevaiyon ki mithaas tumhare ghar aaye aur tumhari saari duaayein kubool hon. Eidi me mithaas pakki, samjhe!
Christmas par dost ko sandesh bhejo
Merry Christmas, dost! Santa tumhe wo sab de jo tumne saal bhar manga hai — aur cake ka sabse bada hissa mera, ye pehle se tay hai!
Diwali par boss ko formal shubhkamna sandesh likho
Namaskar Sir/Ma'am, aapko aur aapke parivaar ko Diwali ki hardik shubhkamnaye. Maa Lakshmi aapke jeevan me sukh aur samriddhi dein. Aapke margdarshan ke liye dhanyavaad. Shubh Deepavali!
Diwali par teacher ko sandesh likho
Namaskar Guruji, Diwali ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Aapke diye gyaan ka diya mere jeevan ko hamesha roshan karta rahega. Aapke charno me pranam. Shubh Deepavali!
Rakhi par door rehne wale bhai ko sandesh likho
Happy Rakhi, bhaiya! Door ho par dil ke sabse paas ho. Rakhi courier se bhej di hai — pehenkar photo bhejna aur mera tohfa mat bhoolna! Tumhari lambi umar ki dua hamesha karti hoon.
Chhath par parivaar ko sandesh bhejo
Chhath ki hardik shubhkamnaye! Chhathi Maiya hum sabke parivaar ko sehat aur samriddhi dein. Ghaat par milte hain — thekua khana mat bhoolna! Jai Chhathi Maiya!
Navratri par Garba khelne bulane ka sandesh likho
Navratri ki shubhkamnaye! Aaj raat Garba me zaroor aana — dandiya taiyaar rakhna, is baar trophy hamari team ki hogi! Jai Mata Di, milte hain maidan me!
Sagai ki badhai ka sandesh likho
Sagai ki bahut bahut badhai! Do dilon ke saath do parivaar bhi jud gaye. Aap dono ka rishta angoothi ki tarah hamesha chamakta rahe. Shaadi ka intezaar rahega!
Dulhan ke griha pravesh par sandesh likho
Naye ghar me swagat hai, bhabhi! Aapke kadam is ghar ke liye Lakshmi ka aagman hon. Ye ghar aapki hasi se hamesha gunjta rahe. Dher saari shubhkamnaye!
Yatra se pehle bado se aashirvaad lene ki parampara kya hai?

Bharat me kisi bade kaam ya lambi yatra se pehle bado ke pair chhookar aashirvaad lene ki parampara hai. Maana jata hai ki bado ki duaayein raksha kavach ka kaam karti hain. Dahi-cheeni khilakar vida karna bhi shubh mana jata hai.
Dhanteras kya hota hai?

Dhanteras Diwali se do din pehle manaya jata hai. Maana jata hai ki is din samudra-manthan se Dhanvantari (aayurved ke devta) aur Maa Lakshmi prakat hui thi. Is din sona-chaandi ya naye bartan kharidna shubh mana jata hai aur shaam ko Yam ke liye diya jalaya jata hai.
Choti Diwali (Narak Chaturdashi) kya hai?

Choti Diwali Diwali se ek din pehle hoti hai. Katha hai ki is din Krishna ne Narakasur ka vadh kiya tha. Is din subah jaldi tel-ubtan se snaan (abhyang snaan) karne aur shaam ko diye jalane ki parampara hai.
Govardhan Puja kya hoti hai?

Govardhan Puja Diwali ke agle din hoti hai. Katha hai ki Krishna ne Indra ke ahankar ko todkar Govardhan parvat ko ungli par uthaya tha taaki gaon wale barsaat se bach sakein. Is din gobar se Govardhan banakar puja hoti hai aur Annakoot (chhappan bhog) ka prasad banta hai.
Bhai Dooj kya hota hai?

Bhai Dooj Diwali ke do din baad manaya jata hai — ye Raksha Bandhan jaisa hi bhai-behen ka tyohar hai. Behen bhai ke maathe par tilak karke uski lambi umar ki dua karti hai. Katha Yam aur Yamuna se judi hai.
Maa Durga ke nau roop kaun se hain?

Navratri me pujit Maa Durga ke nau roop hain — Shailputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandmata, Katyayani, Kaalratri, Mahagauri aur Siddhidatri. Har din ek roop ki puja hoti hai aur har roop ki apni katha aur shakti hai.
Dahi Handi kya hoti hai?

Dahi Handi Janmashtami ke aas-paas Maharashtra me hone wala karyakram hai. Krishna ko makhan chor kaha jata hai — unki is shararat ki yaad me unchai par dahi-makhan ki handi tangi jati hai aur yuvaon ki toli (Govinda pathak) insaani pyramid banakar use phodti hai.
Ramlila kya hoti hai?

Ramlila Ramayan ki katha ka manch par pradarshan hai, jo Navratri-Dussehra ke dino me jagah-jagah hota hai. Gaon-mohalle ke kalakar Ram, Sita, Lakshman aur Ravan bante hain. Varanasi ki Ramnagar Ramlila ek maheene chalne ke liye duniya bhar me prasiddh hai.
Kullu Dussehra kaisa hota hai?

Kullu (Himachal Pradesh) ka Dussehra baaki Bharat se alag hai — yahan Ravan dahan nahi hota. Aas-paas ke gaon ke devta palkion me aakar Bhagwan Raghunath ke darbar me haziri lagate hain. Ye saptah bhar chalne wala dev parampara ka mela hai.
Pola tyohar kya hota hai?

Pola Maharashtra aur Chhattisgarh me bailon ke samman ka tyohar hai. Kisaan apne bailon ko nehla-dhula kar, singon ko rangkar aur sajakar unki puja karte hain — saal bhar kheton me saath dene ke liye dhanyavaad. Bacche mitti ke bailon se khelte hain.
Nuakhai kya hota hai?

Nuakhai Odisha aur Chhattisgarh ka fasal tyohar hai — 'nua' matlab naya, 'khai' matlab khana. Nayi fasal ke pehle chawal ko pehle devta (Maa Samaleswari) ko chadhaya jata hai, phir parivaar milkar khata hai. Bade chhoton se aashirvaad lete hain — 'Nuakhai Juhar' kehkar.
Holi ke alag-alag roop kaun se hain?

Holi ke kai roop hain — Barsana ki Lathmar Holi (mahilayein lathi se khelti hain), Vrindavan ki Phoolon wali Holi, Shantiniketan ka Basanta Utsav aur Maharashtra me Rang Panchami. Har jagah rang ek hai, andaz alag hai.
Makar Sankranti ko alag rajyon me kya kehte hain?

Ek hi tyohar ke kai naam hain — Punjab me Maghi (usse pehle raat Lohri), Tamil Nadu me Pongal, Assam me Magh Bihu, Gujarat me Uttarayan, Bengal me Poush Sankranti, Karnataka me Suggi aur UP-Bihar me Khichdi. Naam alag, bhaav ek — suraj aur fasal ka dhanyavaad.
Diwali par bacche kya karte hain?

Baccho ke liye Diwali sabse mazedaar tyohar hai — naye kapde, phuljhari-phatake (bado ki nigrani me), mithaas aur rishtedaaron se milna. Kai bacche diye rangna aur rangoli me madad karna bhi seekhte hain. Suraksha ka dhyaan rakhna sabse zaroori hai.
Eid par Eidi kya hoti hai?

Eidi Eid par bado ki taraf se bacchon ko diya jane wala paisa ya tohfa hai. Bacche subah se hi Eidi ikattha karne ki yojna banate hain — ye Eid ki sabse pyaari paramparaon me se ek hai. Isse bacche baantna aur bachat dono seekhte hain.
Diwali par Lakshmi puja kaise hoti hai, saral shabdon me batao

Shaam ko shubh muhurat me ek chauki par Maa Lakshmi aur Ganesh ji ki murti rakhi jati hai. Kalash sthapna, phool-mithaas chadhana, dhoop-diya jalana aur aarti hoti hai. Puja ke baad prasad baantkar parivaar ke saath mithaas khayi jati hai aur diye poore ghar me rakhe jate hain.
Karwa Chauth par mehndi kyun lagate hain?

Mehndi shubh aur suhaag ka prateek mani jati hai. Karwa Chauth aur Teej par mehndi lagana shringar ka hissa hai — maana jata hai ki mehndi ka gehra rang prem ka prateek hota hai. Ye mahilaon ke ikatthe hone aur khushi ka bahana bhi hai.
Shaadiyon me haldi wale din peela kyun pehente hain?

Peela rang khushi, pavitrata aur haldi ka rang hai. Haldi ki rasam me peele kapde pehenna parampara hai — peela shubh mana jata hai aur basant jaise taazgi ka prateek hai. Aaj kal haldi ceremony ek rang-biranga photo-wala function ban gaya hai.
Janmashtami par jhoola kyun jhulate hain?

Krishna ke janm ke baad unhe paalne me jhulaya gaya tha — usi yaad me mandiron aur gharo me phoolon se saja jhoola rakha jata hai jisme Bal Krishna ko bithakar sab jhoola jhulata hain. Ye prem aur vatsalya ki parampara hai.
Navratri me kanya pujan kya hota hai?

Ashtami ya Navami ke din chhoti kanyaon ko Devi ka roop mankar unki puja hoti hai — pair dhoye jate hain, tilak lagta hai aur halwa-puri-chana khilakar tohfe diye jate hain. Ye nari shakti ke samman ki parampara hai.
Chhath me soop aur tokri me kya rakha jata hai?

Chhath ke soop me thekua, phal (kela, seb, singhara, ganna), nariyal, supaari aur diya rakha jata hai. Ye sab prakriti ki den hai — suraj ko wahi chadhaya jata hai jo dharti se mila hai. Tokri baans ki bani hoti hai.
Onam me Vallam Kali kya hai?

Vallam Kali Kerala ki prasiddh naav daud hai jo Onam ke samay hoti hai. Lambi saamp-naav (chundan vallam) par 100 se zyada naavik ek lay me chappu chalate hain. Aranmula aur Alappuzha (Nehru Trophy) ki daud sabse prasiddh hai.
Gurpurab par Nagar Kirtan kya hota hai?

Nagar Kirtan Sikh parampara ki shobha yatra hai jo Gurpurab par nikalti hai. Guru Granth Sahib ki sawari aage hoti hai, Panj Pyare chalte hain, kirtan hota hai, gatka ka pradarshan hota hai aur raaste me jagah-jagah sharbat-khana baanta jata hai.
Christmas par carol kya hota hai?

Carol Christmas ke khushi bhare geet hain jo samooh me ghar-ghar jaakar gaaye jate hain. Carol gaane wali toli gharo me jaakar Isa Masih ke janm ke geet sunati hai aur badle me mithaas milti hai. 'Jingle Bells' aur 'Silent Night' sabse jaane-maane carol hain.
Ramzan me Tarawih kya hoti hai?

Tarawih Ramzan ki raaton me Isha ki namaz ke baad padhi jane wali khaas lambi namaz hai, jisme Quran ka bada hissa sunaya jata hai. Kai masjidon me poora Quran Ramzan bhar me Tarawih me sampann kiya jata hai.
Teej par jhoole kyun padte hain?
Saawan ki hariyali me pedon par jhoole daalna Teej ki pehchan hai. Maana jata hai ki Maa Parvati bhi jhoola jhoolti thi. Jhoole, kajli geet aur mehndi — ye teeno milkar Teej ka mahol banate hain.
Bharat me baans aur lakdi ke khilone ki parampara kahan ki hai?

Lakdi ke khilone ki kala kai jagah prasiddh hai — UP ka Varanasi aur Chitrakoot, Karnataka ka Channapatna (rang-birange lakdi ke khilone, GI tag mila hai), Andhra ka Kondapalli aur Rajasthan ke कठपुतली (kathputli) khilone. Kathputli ka naach Rajasthan ki vishwa-prasiddh lok kala hai.
Kathputli kala kahan ki hai?

Kathputli (dor wali gudiya) ka naach Rajasthan ki prasiddh lok kala hai. Kalakar lakdi ki gudiyon ko ungliyon se bandhi dor se nacha kar katha sunata hai, saath me dholak aur gaana hota hai. Ye kala hazaron saal purani mani jati hai.
Madhubani painting kahan ki hai?

Madhubani (Mithila) painting Bihar ke Mithila kshetra ki hai — mahilayein gharon ki deewaron aur kagaz par prakriti, devta aur tyoharon ke drishya banati hain. Isme khaali jagah nahi chhodi jati — poori satah design se bhari hoti hai. Ise GI tag mila hai.
Warli kala kahan ki hai?

Warli Maharashtra ke Thane-Palghar kshetra ki janajatiya kala hai. Safed rang se laal-geru deewar par insaan ki aakritiyan (gol sir aur trikon shareer) banayi jati hain — nritya, fasal aur roz ke jeevan ke drishya iski pehchan hain.
Pattachitra kahan ki kala hai?
Pattachitra Odisha aur Bengal ki prachin chitra kala hai — kapde (patta) par Jagannath aur Krishna kathaon ke vistrit chitra bante hain. Odisha ke Raghurajpur gaon ko kala-gaon kaha jata hai.
Tyohar par ghar me rangoli kyun banate hain?

Rangoli shubh aur swagat ka prateek hai — maana jata hai ki rangoli dekhkar devta aur mehmaan khush hote hain. Rangoli ke rang prakriti se liye jate the — haldi, kumkum, chawal ka aata. Chawal ke aate ki rangoli cheentiyon aur pakshiyon ka khana bhi banti hai — ye chhoti si seva hai.
Alpana aur kolam kya hain?

Rangoli ke hi kshetriya roop hain — Bengal me chawal ke ghole se bani 'Alpana', Tamil Nadu me chawal ke aate se bani 'Kolam' aur Kerala me phoolon ki 'Pookalam'. Har subah dwar par kolam banana wahan ki mahilaon ki dincharya hai.
Mandir me ghanta kyun bajate hain?

Mandir me pravesh par ghanta bajane se maana jata hai ki mann ekagra hota hai aur nakaratmak urja door hoti hai. Ghante ki awaaz ko Om ki dhvani se jodkar dekha jata hai. Ye devta ke darshan se pehle dhyaan kendrit karne ka tareeka hai.
Shankh kyun bajaya jata hai?

Shankhnaad ko pavitra aur shubh ghosh mana jata hai — puja ki shuruaat aur aarti me shankh bajta hai. Kathaon me shankh samudra-manthan se nikla tha aur Vishnu ke paas rehta hai. Iski awaaz ko vatavaran shuddh karne wali mana jata hai.
Har ghar me subah shaam diya jalane ki parampara kyun hai?

Subah-shaam tulsi ke paas aur mandir me diya jalana din ki shuruaat aur ant ko pavitra banata hai. Sandhya ka diya andhere ko door karne aur ghar me sakaratmakta ka prateek hai. Kai gharo me ye niyam aaj bhi nibhaya jata hai.
Tyohar ke din gareebon ko khana kyun khilate hain?

Bharatiya parampara me anna-daan ko sabse bada daan mana gaya hai — 'annadaanam mahadanam'. Maana jata hai ki tyohar ki khushi tabhi puri hoti hai jab koi bhookha na rahe. Isiliye tyoharon par bhandaare, langar aur sadavrat ki parampara hai.
Bhandara kya hota hai?

Bhandara mandiron aur tyoharon par lagne wala muft bhoj hai jisme koi bhi aakar kha sakta hai. Ye seva-bhaav se hota hai — log paisa, saaman ya shram daan karte hain. Kumbh aur bade tyoharon me vishaal bhandaare lagte hain.
Eid par masjid me kya hota hai?

Eid ki subah masjid aur Eidgah me khaas namaz (Salat-ul-Eid) hoti hai jisme badi tadaad me log ikatthe hote hain. Namaz se pehle takbeer padhi jati hai, baad me sab gale milte hain. Gareebon ko fitra dena namaz se pehle zaroori mana jata hai.
Diwali par patakhe kyun chalaye jate hain?

Phatake Ram ke Ayodhya aagman ki khushi aur burai ko darane ke prateek ke roop me chalaye jane lage. Aaj ke samay me vaayu pradushan ke kaaran phuljhari aur kam awaaz wale 'green cracker' ka chalan badha hai aur kai log sirf diye se tyohar manate hain — roshni wahi hai, tareeka badla hai.
Holi par thandai kyun peete hain?

Holi garmi ki shuruaat me aati hai — thandai (doodh, badam, saunf, ilaichi, gulab) shareer ko thandak deti hai. Rang khelne ke baad ki thakan me ye taazgi deti hai. Mathura-Vrindavan ki thandai khaas prasiddh hai.
Sankranti par khichdi kyun banti hai?

Makar Sankranti ko UP me 'Khichdi' ka tyohar hi kehte hain. Nayi fasal ke chawal aur dal se bani khichdi saral, poshṭik aur thand ke mausam me garam rehti hai. Is din khichdi ka daan bhi kiya jata hai.
Tyoharon me upadhi — dost ko Diwali par kaju katli kyun bhejte hain?

Kaju katli Diwali ki sabse lokpriya mithaas hai — iska sunehra varq (chaandi ka patla parat) use tyohar ke laayak shandaar banata hai. Mithaas ka dabba bhejna prem aur shubhkamna bhejne ka tareeka hai — isiliye Diwali par mithaas ke dabbe sabse zyada bikhte hain.
Lohri par aag me til kyun dalte hain?

Lohri ki aag me til, rewari aur moongphali daalkar agni dev ko nayi fasal ka pehla hissa arpan kiya jata hai. Til sardi me shareer ko garmi deta hai, isiliye sardiyon ke tyoharon me til ki mithaas har jagah milti hai.
Vishu par Vishukkani kya hoti hai, phir se saral me batao

Vishukkani ka matlab hai 'pehli nazar'. Vishu (Kerala ke naye saal) ki subah uthkar aankhein band karke puja ke kamre me jaate hain aur sabse pehle sajayi gayi thaali dekhte hain — usme chawal, phal, sona, sikke, diya aur Bhagwan ki murti hoti hai. Maana jata hai ki saal ki pehli nazar shubh cheezon par pade to saal achha jata hai.
Bharat me sabse zyada manaya jane wala tyohar kaun sa hai?

Jansankhya ke hisaab se Diwali Bharat ka sabse bada tyohar mana jata hai — use Hindu, Jain, Sikh aur kuch Buddhist samudaay bhi apne-apne kaaranon se manate hain. Iske baad Holi, Eid, Dussehra aur Christmas bade paimane par manaye jate hain.
Char Dham yatra kya hoti hai?

Char Dham Bharat ke chaar pavitra teerth hain — Badrinath (Uttarakhand), Dwarka (Gujarat), Puri (Odisha) aur Rameshwaram (Tamil Nadu). Maana jata hai ki Adi Shankaracharya ne chaaron dishaon me ye dham sthapit kiye the. Chhota Char Dham (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath) ki yatra bhi bahut prasiddh hai.
Vaishno Devi ki yatra kaisi hoti hai?

Mata Vaishno Devi ka mandir Jammu ke Katra ke paas Trikuta pahadi par hai. Bhakt lagbhag 13 km paidal chadhkar gufa mandir me Maa ke pindi roop ke darshan karte hain. Raaste bhar 'Jai Mata Di' ke jaikare goonjte hain.
Tirupati Balaji mandir kyon prasiddh hai?

Andhra Pradesh ke Tirupati me Bhagwan Venkateswara (Balaji) ka mandir duniya ke sabse adhik darshanarthi pane wale mandiron me se hai. Yahan ke laddu prasad ko GI tag mila hai. Kesh-daan (mundan) yahan ki khaas parampara hai.
Amarnath yatra kya hai?

Amarnath Kashmir ki unchai par sthit gufa hai jahan har saal barf se prakritik Shivling banta hai. Shravan maas me hazaron bhakt kathin pahadi raaste se yatra karte hain. Ye yatra prakriti aur shraddha ka sangam hai.
Kumbh me akhaade kya hote hain?

Akhaade sadhu-santon ke prachin sangathan hain — Shaiv aur Vaishnav parampara ke kul 13 akhaade mane jate hain. Kumbh me inhi akhaadon ka Shahi Snaan hota hai. Naga sadhu Shaiv akhaadon se jute hote hain.
Chhath ke chaar din kaun se hote hain?

Chhath chaar din ka tyohar hai — pehla din Nahay-Khay (snaan ke baad saatvik khana), dusra Kharna (gur ki kheer aur roti khakar vrat ki shuruaat), teesra din doobte suraj ko arghya aur chauthe din ugte suraj ko arghya dekar vrat ka paaran hota hai.
Pongal ke chaar din kaun se hain?

Pongal chaar din hota hai — pehla din Bhogi (purani cheezein jalakar nayi shuruaat), dusra Surya Pongal (sooraj ki puja aur meetha pongal), teesra Maattu Pongal (gai-bail ki puja) aur chauthe din Kaanum Pongal (rishtedaaron se milna aur ghoomna).
Karwa Chauth par sargi kya hoti hai?

Sargi woh thaali hai jo saas apni bahu ko Karwa Chauth ki subah suryoday se pehle deti hai — usme mithaas, phal, parathe aur shringar ka saaman hota hai. Sargi khaakar hi vrat shuru hota hai. Ye saas-bahu ke pyaar ka prateek hai.
Rakhi par bhai ko tohfa kya dein, paramparik roop se?

Paramparik roop se bhai behen ko kapde, mithaas ya paisa (shagun) deta hai. Aaj kal kitaabein, ghadi ya behen ki pasand ki cheez bhi dete hain. Asli tohfa raksha ka vachan mana jata hai — tohfa uska prateek hai.
Mahashivratri par belpatra kyun chadhate hain?

Belpatra (teen patti wala patta) Shiv ko atyant priya mana jata hai — uski teen pattiyan tri-dev aur Shiv ke trinetra ka prateek mani jati hain. Katha hai ki belpatra ki thandak Shiv ke vish-paan ki jalan ko shaant karti hai.
Basant Panchami par peela khana kyun banta hai?

Basant ka rang peela hai — sarso ke phool, aam ke baur aur pakki fasal ka rang. Isiliye Basant Panchami par peele chawal (kesariya bhaat), peeli mithaas banti hai aur peele kapde pehne jate hain. Peela gyaan aur samriddhi ka bhi prateek hai.
Eid aur Ramzan me kya farak hai?

Ramzan ek maheene ka naam hai jisme roze rakhe jate hain. Us maheene ke khatm hone par jo tyohar hota hai use Eid-ul-Fitr kehte hain. Matlab Ramzan upvaas aur ibadat ka maheena hai, Eid uske sampann hone ki khushi ka din.
Janmashtami par jhanki kya hoti hai?

Jhanki me Krishna ke jeevan ke drishya sajaye jate hain — unka janm, makhan churana, Kaliya naag par nritya, Govardhan uthana. Mandiron aur mohallo me jhanki sajane ki parampara hai, bacche Krishna-Radha bankar taiyaar hote hain.
praman patra ke liye pita ke kagaz nahi hain (nidhhan ho gaya), kya hoga

Aisi sthiti aam hai — karyalay me apni paristhiti likhit me do. Maa ke kagaz, parivaar ke purane record, school ke kagaz aur sthaniya jaanch ke aadhar par praman banta hai. CSC/karyalay ke karmchari se apni sthiti ke hisaab se kagaz-soochi pehle pakki kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
apne paas ka CSC kendra kaise dhundhe

1. CSC ki sarkari website par 'Find CSC' / locator wala vikalp hota hai — rajya, jila aur kshetra dal kar paas ke kendra mil jate hain.
2. Aas-paas ki dukaanon par 'CSC' ya 'Jan Seva Kendra' ke board bhi lage hote hain.
3. Jaane se pehle pooch lo ki jo kaam tumhe karwana hai wo us kendra par hota hai ya nahi — har seva har kendra par nahi hoti.
4. Kendra ka VLE (chalak) ka naam aur kendra ka code parchi par hota hai — shikayat ke samay yehi kaam aata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
cheque bounce ho jaye to kya hota hai

Khate me paisa kam hone par cheque bounce hota hai — bank is par shulk lagata hai aur baar-baar hone par kanooni kaarravaai bhi ho sakti hai. Cheque dene se pehle khate me rakam pakki kar lo; cheque mila ho aur bounce ho to dene wale se likhit me baat karo aur bank ki parchi sambhalo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
khatauni aur registry me kya farak hai

Registry zameen ki kharid-beekri ka dastavej hai jo sub-registrar karyalay me banta hai; khatauni us zameen ke malik aur kabze ka sarkari record hai jo tehsil rakhta hai. Dono ke kaam alag hain — kharid ke baad naam khatauni me chadhana (mutation/dakhil kharij) alag se karwana padta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ghar me shaadi hai, ration card me bahu ka naam kab jode

Vivah ke baad pehle uske maike wale card se naam katwane ka praman lo, phir vivah praman patra aur Aadhaar ke saath apne card me naam jodne ka aavedan karo. Dono kaam ek saath shuru karne se samay bachta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar ki copy par 'sirf is kaam ke liye' likhna kyun kehte hain

Isse copy ka dusra istemal mushkil ho jata hai — koi use dusri jagah lagaye to turant pata chalta hai ki ye nakal hai. Tareekh ke saath ye ek line likhna do minute ka kaam hai, par suraksha bahut badh jati hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar me bachche ka naam galat hai, school me dikkat aa rahi hai

1. Baal Aadhaar me naam sudhaar ke liye Aadhaar kendra jao — janm praman patra saath rakho.
2. Naam bilkul janm praman patra jaisa karwao — school ke record se bhi wahi milna chahiye.
3. Sudhaar ke baad school me bhi nayi copy jama kar do taaki aage ke kagaz ek jaise bane.
4. 5 aur 15 saal par biometric update ke samay jaankari dobara jaanch lena.
Aadhaar banwane ke liye koi fees lagti hai kya

Pehli baar Aadhaar banwana muft hota hai. Kuch update (jaise kagaz dobara dena) par chhoti si nishchit fees lagti hai — kendra par fees ki soochi lagi hoti hai, usse zyada mat do aur har bhugtan ki parchi lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
do mahine ka bill ek saath aa gaya, galti hai kya

Kabhi meter reader ke na aane par ek mahina anumaanit bill banta hai aur agle mahine asal reading se samaayojan ho jata hai — bill par 'average/provisional' likha hota hai. Hisab samajh na aaye to dono bill lekar karyalay me mila lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
karyalay wala kagaz ki 'attested copy' mang raha hai, iska matlab kya hai

1. Attested copy ka matlab hai photocopy par kisi adhikrit vyakti (gazetted officer, notary, ya sanstha ke pramukh) ke sign aur mohar ke saath pramanit copy.
2. Aaj kal zyadaatar jagah 'self-attested' chalti hai — photocopy par khud apne sign karke tareekh likh do.
3. Form ke nirdesh me jo likha hai wahi karo — galat prakar ki copy par form wapas ho sakta hai.
4. Asli kagaz hamesha apne paas rakho — jaanch ke samay dikha kar wapas le lo.
Aadhaar kendra wala galat jaankari bhar de to kya kare

Kendra par kaam pura hone se pehle screen par dikhai gayi jaankari khud padh kar pakki karo. Galti baad me pata chale to usi parchi (EID) ke saath dobara kendra jao — galti sudhaar ka aavedan wahi se hoga, aur UIDAI helpline 1947 par bhi soochna de sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
gaadi ka beema (insurance) renew online kaise kare

Beema company ki website/app par gaadi number dal kar policy renew hoti hai — purani policy ki copy taiyaar rakho. Third-party beema kanoonan anivarya hai; bina beema gaadi chalana jurmana aur jail tak ka kaaran ban sakta hai. Anjaan agent se sasti policy ke naam par nakli kagaz mat lo — policy number company ki site par jaanch lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Learner Licence ka test kaisa hota hai, taiyari kaise kare

1. Test me aam taur par 10-15 sawal aate hain — sadak ke nishan (signs), yatayat ke niyam, aur suraksha se jude.
2. Taiyari ke liye Parivahan portal par hi muft mock test aur sawal-jawab ki soochi milti hai — use padh kar jao.
3. Kai rajyo me test online hota hai — camera wale computer/phone se dena hota hai, koi aur vyakti paas nahi hona chahiye.
4. Paas hone ke number rajya ke hisaab se hote hain; fail ho jao to kuch din baad dobara test de sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
driving licence par orgaan daan (organ donation) wala vikalp kya hai
