Licence ke aavedan/renewal me ichha se ang-daan ke liye sahmati dene ka vikalp hota hai — ye poori tarah tumhari marzi hai, licence banne par isse koi farak nahi padta. Parivaar ko apni ichha pehle se bata kar rakhna hi iska asal matlab hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
tehsil aur jila karyalay me kya farak hai, kaunsa kaam kahan hoga

Tehsil taluka star ka karyalay hai — praman patra, bhoomi record jaise roz ke kaam wahi hote hain. Jila karyalay (Collectorate) bade aur apeel wale kaam dekhta hai. Aam taur par pehla kadam hamesha tehsil/CSC se shuru karo — wahi se sahi disha mil jati hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar me pata dusri baar badalna hai, pehli baar galat ho gaya tha

1. myAadhaar portal par dobara Address Update ka aavedan karo — sahi kagaz ke saath.
2. Pehle wale aavedan ka status pehle band/poora hone do, warna dusra atak sakta hai.
3. Is baar pata bilkul waisa likho jaisa kagaz par hai — ghar number, gali, PIN code.
4. Manzoori ke baad nayi copy jaanch kar hi aage istemal karo.
bike se car ka licence add karna hai (dusri category judwani hai)

1. Parivahan portal par 'Additional Endorsement to DL' (nayi shreni jodna) wala vikalp chuno.
2. Jis shreni (jaise LMV — car) ko jodna hai, pehle uska Learner Licence bane ga — agar usi samooh ki shreni pehle se hai to seedha test bhi ho sakta hai, portal par saaf dikhta hai.
3. Driving test RTO me usi gaadi se dena hoga jo shreni chahiye.
4. Test paas hone par wahi purana licence dono shreniyon ke saath naya ban jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train me senior citizen ke liye lower berth kaise pakki kare

1. Booking ke samay 'berth preference' me lower chuno aur yatra akele ho to kuch trainon me buzurgo ke liye vishesh quota (lower berth quota) hota hai.
2. Quota wali ticket ke liye booking ke samay sambandhit vikalp chuno — umar pehchan patra ke hisaab se bharo.
3. Seat chart par milti hai — PNR status me berth number dikh jata hai.
4. Galat umar bhar kar riyayat lena niyam ke khilaf hai — TTE jaanch par antar vasulta hai.
Tatkal ticket kya hoti hai, kab aur kaise book hoti hai

Tatkal aakhri samay par yatra ke liye rakhi gayi vishesh quota ticket hai — iski booking train chalne se ek din pehle khulti hai.
1. AC class ke liye booking subah 10 baje aur Sleeper ke liye 11 baje khulti hai — pehle se login karke taiyaar raho.
2. Yatriyon ki jaankari pehle se 'Master List' me save kar lo taaki samay bache.
3. Tatkal ka kiraya aam se zyada hota hai aur isme riyayat (concession) nahi milti.
4. Ticket milna pakka nahi hota — maang bahut zyada hoti hai; kisi agent ko apna IRCTC password kabhi mat do.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ka status kaise track kare

1. Passport Seva portal par 'Track Application Status' wala vikalp kholo.
2. Application ka prakar chuno aur file number (kendra se mili parchi par hota hai) aur janm tithi bharo.
3. Wahan har charan dikhta hai — kendra prakriya, police verification, printing aur dispatch.
4. Dispatch ke baad post ki tracking jaankari bhi wahi se mil jati hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Driving test ke din kya-kya kagaz le jaye

1. Learner Licence (asli aur copy).
2. Permanent licence ke aavedan ki parchi/fees ki receipt.
3. Pehchan patra (Aadhaar) aur photo.
4. Gaadi ke kagaz — RC, beema, PUC; aur medical certificate jahan laagu ho.
aay praman patra me galat aay likh gayi, sudhaar hoga kya

1. Haan — jis portal/karyalay se bana tha wahi sudhaar ya naye praman ke liye aavedan karo.
2. Sahi aay ke kagaz (vetan parchi, bank byora, swa-ghoshna) saath lagao.
3. Galat praman ka istemal aage mat karo — jaanch me pakde jaane par labh ruk sakta hai.
4. Aay har saal badalti hai, isliye praman patra aam taur par taaza hi manga jata hai.
pariksha kendra dusre sheher me pada hai, badal sakte hai kya

Aam taur par kendra badalna nahi hota — form bharte samay kendra ke vikalp dhyaan se chuno. Vishesh paristhiti (bimari aadi) me vibhaag ke niyam hote hain, helpline par samay rehte puch lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
nivas praman patra (domicile) banwana hai

1. Rajya seva portal ya CSC/tehsil se 'Nivas Praman Patra' ka aavedan karo.
2. Kagaz — us rajya me nishchit samay se rehne ka praman: bijli bill, kirayanama, Voter ID, school ke kagaz aadi.
3. Jaankari ki jaanch lekhpal/tehsil se hoti hai — kitne saal se reh rahe ho ye kagazon se saaf hona chahiye.
4. Praman patra milne ke baad use naukri aur padhai ke aavedano me lagaya ja sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar update ka status kaise check kare

Status dekhna bahut aasan hai, bas tumhare paas wo number hona chahiye jo update ke samay mila tha.
1. Online update kiya tha to SRN number aur kendra se kiya tha to Enrollment ID (EID) parchi par likhi hoti hai.
2. myAadhaar portal par 'Check Update Status' me ye number dalo.
3. Wahan dikh jayega ki update manzoor hua, chal raha hai ya kisi wajah se ruka hai.
4. Rukne ki wajah aam taur par kagaz saaf na hona hota hai — sahi kagaz ke saath dobara aavedan karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
naya ration card banana hai, process batao

Ration card rajya sarkar banati hai, isliye portal aur karyalay rajya ke hisaab se hota hai — prakriya lagbhag har jagah ek jaisi hai.
1. Apne rajya ke khadya aapoorti (Food & Supply) vibhaag ke portal par online aavedan karo, ya CSC kendra/tehsil karyalay se form lo.
2. Parivaar ke mukhiya ke naam par form bhara jata hai; parivaar ke sabhi sadasyon ke Aadhaar aur jaankari lagti hai.
3. Kagaz — pate ka praman, parivaar ke sadasyo ke Aadhaar, photo, aur aay se sambandhit kagaz jaisa manga jaye.
4. Aavedan ke baad jaanch hoti hai; manzoori milne par ration card banta hai aur tumhara naam usi uchit dar dukaan (ration dukaan) se jud jata hai.
5. Kai rajyo me digital ration card/e-Ration card portal se download bhi ho jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ek hi ghar ke sabke Voter ID alag-alag booth par hai, ek jagah ho sakte hai kya

Haan — Form 8 me pate ke hisaab se sudhaar/shifting karne par sabka booth ek hi pate ke hisaab se ho jata hai. Har sadasya ka aavedan alag-alag hoga, par prakriya ek hi hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar me pata (address) badalna hai, process batao

Pata badalna sabse aasan update hai aur ye online bhi ho jata hai.
1. myAadhaar portal par apne Aadhaar number aur OTP se login karo.
2. 'Address Update' chuno aur naya pata dhyaan se bharo — jaisa kagaz par likha hai waisa hi.
3. Naye pate ka praman (bijli bill, paani bill, bank statement, kirayanama aadi) upload karo.
4. Fees bhugtan karke submit karo; kuch din me pata badal jayega aur status SRN se dikhega.
5. Kagaz na ho to 'Head of Family' ke Aadhaar se bhi pata update ka vikalp portal par milta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN ke bina bank me bada len-den kyun nahi hota

1. Ek nishchit rakam se bade len-den par PAN anivarya hai — ye niyam kaale dhan ko rokne ke liye hai.
2. PAN na ho to Form 60 chal sakta hai, par seema aur shartein hoti hain.
3. Roz ke kaam ke liye PAN banwana hi sabse aasan hal hai — online kuch hi samay lagta hai.
4. Kisi aur ka PAN istemal karna kanooni apradh hai — kabhi mat karo.
Voter ID par sign/photo mismatch ki shikayat booth par hui, aage kya kare

Booth par pehchan dusre kagaz se bhi ho jati hai. Ghar aakar Form 8 se photo/jaankari sudharwa lo taaki agle chunav me dikkat na ho. Purani photo 10-15 saal me badal jana aam hai — ye sudhaar isiliye hota hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
pension ke kagaz (jeevan praman patra) kaise jama kare buzurgo ke liye

1. Har saal jeevan praman (life certificate) jama hota hai — ye bank, post office ya CSC par ungli ke nishan se ban jata hai.
2. Jeevan Pramaan app se ghar baithe chehre se bhi ye praman ban sakta hai — kisi ki madad le lo.
3. Praman banne ke baad uski digital copy pension dene wale karyalay tak apne aap jati hai.
4. Samay par jama na ho to pension ruk sakti hai — isliye mahina yaad rakho aur parchi sambhalo.
train me saamaan (luggage) kitna le ja sakte hain

1. Har class ke hisaab se muft saaman ki seema hoti hai — usse zyada par alag shulk lagta hai.
2. Bhaari saaman (bike, bada samaan) ke liye station ke parcel/luggage karyalay se booking hoti hai.
3. Apne saath wale saaman ki suraksha tumhari zimmedari hai — keemti cheezein apne paas rakho.
4. Train me jwalanasheel cheezein le jana sakht mana hai — ye kanooni apradh hai.
ration dukaan par ungli ke nishan match nahi ho rahe (buzurg), ration kaise milega

1. Pehle dusri ungli ya saaf haath se dobara koshish karo — machine par aksar ho jata hai.
2. Kai rajyo me OTP (mobile par) ya parivaar ke dusre sadasya ke nishan se ration ka vikalp hota hai.
3. Baar-baar dikkat ho to vibhaag ke karyalay me apni sthiti darj karwao — iske liye prakriya hoti hai.
4. Dukaandaar bina pushti ke ration rok nahi sakta — shikayat ka number apne paas rakho.
ration card me mukhiya badalna hai (mukhiya ka nidhan ho gaya)

Mukhiya ke mrityu praman patra ke saath parivaar ke naye mukhiya ke naam transfer ka aavedan portal/karyalay me do. Jaankari jaanch ke baad card naye mukhiya ke naam ho jata hai — baaki sadasya waise hi rehte hain.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Tatkaal Passport kya hota hai, kab lena chahiye

Tatkaal yojana me Passport jaldi banta hai, par iski fees zyada hoti hai aur kagazon ki shartein sakht hoti hain.
1. Portal par form bharte samay 'Tatkaal' yojana chuno.
2. Tatkaal ke liye maange jane wale kagazon ki soochi aam yojana se lambi hoti hai — portal par apni shreni ke hisaab se soochi pehle padh lo.
3. Appointment bhi jaldi milta hai aur prakriya tez charno me hoti hai; kuch maamlon me police verification Passport milne ke baad hota hai.
4. Jaldi asal me ho tabhi Tatkaal lo — aam yojana me bhi samay par ban jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
18 saal hone wala hu, Voter ID pehle se banwa sakta hu kya

Haan — ab saal me kai tithiyon par panjikaran hota hai aur 17 saal ke baad aage ke liye pehle se aavedan (advance application) bhi diya ja sakta hai.
1. Portal par Form 6 bharo aur janm tithi ka praman lagao.
2. Tumhara naam usi soochi me judega jis tithi tak tum 18 ke ho jaoge.
3. 18 pure hone ke baad hi vote dalne ka adhikar milega.
4. School/college me lagne wale panjikaran shiviron se bhi ye kaam ho sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train ticket par khana aur seat dono ki shikayat ek saath kahan kare

RailMadad par shikayat ki shreni chun kar ek hi PNR par alag-alag shikayatein darj ho sakti hain. Yatra ke dauran 139 helpline sabse tez rasta hai — coach number aur seat number batane par madad jaldi milti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration card me sadasya ki janm tithi galat hai

1. Portal/CSC par sudhaar form me sahi janm tithi bharo.
2. Praman ke liye us sadasya ka Aadhaar ya janm praman patra lagao.
3. Sudhaar ke baad card ki jaankari Aadhaar se mil jayegi — aage ke kaamo me dikkat nahi hogi.
4. Sabhi sadasyon ki jaankari ek baar milakar dekh lo, baar-baar chakkar nahi lagega.
bank khate ke liye PAN nahi hai to kya hoga

1. PAN na ho to khata kholte samay Form 60 bharna padta hai — ye ek ghoshna hai ki tumhare paas PAN nahi hai.
2. Lekin bade len-den ke liye PAN zaroori ho jata hai, isliye PAN banwana hi behtar hai — online aavedan aasan hai.
3. PAN ke liye aavedan kar diya hai to uski parchi (acknowledgment) bhi kai jagah kaam aa jati hai.
4. Bank me jhooti jaankari mat do — baad me khata band ho sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
passbook par mohar wala statement loan ke liye kyun manga jata hai

Mohar wala statement bank ki or se pramanit hota hai — isse samne wali sanstha ko bharosa hota hai ki byora asal hai. Shakha se samay-avadhi bata kar aavedan do, aam taur par usi din mil jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form me hastakshar (signature) upload ka size bada ho raha hai

Signature ko chhote kagaz par karke scan karo aur aas-paas ki khaali jagah kaat do — file apne aap chhoti ho jayegi. Phir bhi badi ho to image compressor se halka karo, par itna nahi ki sign dhundhla ho jaye.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
bijli connection dusre ke naam hai aur bill mere paas aata hai, bharu ya nahi

1. Bill usi ghar ka hai jahan tum rehte ho to bhugtan samay par karo — kata connection tumhe hi pareshan karega.
2. Parchi apne paas rakho — kiraye ke hisaab me ye saboot hai.
3. Lambe samay ke liye rehna hai to naam transfer ki baat makan malik se karo.
4. Bakaaya purana hai to malik se likhit me tay karo ki kaun bharega.
PAN card par photo blur hai, naya card kaise bane

Correction/reprint ke aavedan me nayi saaf photo lagao — Aadhaar e-KYC wala rasta chunne par Aadhaar ki photo aa jati hai. Naya e-PAN email par aur card post se aa jayega.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank se SMS alert band ho gaya hai, chalu kaise kare

SMS alert ke liye mobile number khate se juda aur seva sakriya honi chahiye. Shakha/app se 'SMS alert' sakriya karo — kuch bank is par chhota shulk lete hain. Alert band rehne par galat len-den ka pata der se chalta hai, isliye ise hamesha chalu rakho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Voter ID me naam galat hai, sudhaar kaise hoga

1. Matdata seva portal par login karke 'Shifting/Correction of Entries' (Form 8) chuno.
2. Apna EPIC number dalo aur jis hisse me sudhaar hai use chuno.
3. Sahi jaankari bharo aur usse milta kagaz upload karo.
4. Submit karne ke baad reference number se status dekho.
5. Sudhaar manzoor hone par nayi jaankari soochi me dikhne lagti hai aur chaho to naya card bhi mangwa sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN aavedan ke liye Aadhaar me naam aur form me naam alag dala, kya hoga

1. e-KYC wale aavedan me naam Aadhaar se hi aata hai — alag likhne ka vikalp hi nahi hota.
2. Physical form me antar ho to aavedan 'discrepancy' me ruk jata hai.
3. Pehle tay karo sahi naam kya hai, phir dono jagah wahi rakho.
4. Ruka hua aavedan acknowledgment number se track karo aur manga gaya sudhaar bhejo.
Passport ki delivery koi aur le sakta hai kya (main ghar par nahi hu)

Passport post se aata hai aur aam taur par aavedak ko hi diya jata hai. Ghar par na ho to postman soochna chhodta hai — uske saath post office jaakar pehchan dikhakar le sakte ho. Isiliye vartaman pata aur mobile form me bilkul sahi bharo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PNR status kaise check kare, WL ka matlab kya hai

1. IRCTC website/app, ya rail sevaon par 'PNR Status' me 10 ank ka PNR dalo.
2. CNF ka matlab seat pakki, RAC ka matlab seat aadhi pakki (baithne ki jagah pakki, berth chart par mil sakti hai), WL matlab waiting list — number jitna chhota, chance utna zyada.
3. Chart banne (aam taur par train chalne se kuch ghante pehle) ke baad antim sthiti dikhti hai.
4. E-ticket agar chart ke baad bhi poori WL rahe to wo apne aap radd ho jati hai aur paisa usi khate me wapas aata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli bill par naam ke saath 'care of' galat hai, dikkat hogi kya

1. Chhoti jaankari ki galti par bill bhugtan me dikkat nahi aati — consumer number hi asal pehchan hai.
2. Lekin kagaz ke kaamo (pata praman) me bill istemal karna ho to naam sahi hona chahiye — karyalay se sudhaar karwa lo.
3. Sudhaar ke liye pehchan patra aur purana bill saath rakho.
4. Ek baar me saari galtiyan (naam, pata, mobile) theek karwa lo.
DL par mobile number update kyun zaroori hai

Challan, renewal ki soochna aur OTP sab mobile par aata hai. Purana band number rehne par soochnaein nahi milti aur online sevaein atak jati hain. Parivahan portal par login karke number update kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
CSC par Aadhaar se paisa nikalna (AePS) kya hota hai, surakshit hai kya

1. AePS me CSC/Bank Mitra ke paas ungli ke nishan se tumhare Aadhaar-jude bank khate se paisa nikal/jama ho sakta hai.
2. Har len-den ke baad parchi zaroor lo aur khate ka SMS jaancho.
3. Apni ungli kisi ke kahne par baar-baar mat lagao — ek len-den ke liye ek baar hi lagti hai.
4. Paisa kam mile ya parchi na de to turant apne bank ko soochit karo.
ATM/debit card band (block) karna hai, turant kya kare

Card kho jaye ya galat len-den dikhe to ek minute bhi der mat karo.
1. Bank ke mobile app ya internet banking me 'Block Card' ka turant vikalp hota hai — wahi se band karo.
2. App na ho to bank ke customer care number (passbook/card par likha hota hai) par call karke band karwao.
3. Nazdeeki shakha jaakar bhi band kar sakte ho aur naya card wahi se mangwa sakte ho.
4. Card band karne ke baad khate ke pichhle len-den jaancho; galat len-den dikhe to turant bank ko likhit shikayat do.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ek hi mobile se kitne logo ke form bhar sakte hai

Form to bhar sakte ho, lekin har portal ka khata usi vyakti ke number se banna chahiye jiska form hai — warna uski soochnaein aur OTP tumhare paas aayenge aur uske kaam rukenge. Parivaar ke form me bhi har ek ka apna number rakho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
DL ka driving test me kya hota hai, fail ho jau to kya

1. Test me RTO ke adhikari ke saamne track par gaadi chalani hoti hai — aam taur par '8' ya 'H' aakar ke track par bina ruke chalana, reverse aur nishano ka palan dekha jata hai.
2. Apni hi gaadi le jani hoti hai jo shreni ke hisaab se sahi ho; kagaz (LL, aavedan parchi) saath rakho.
3. Fail hone par ghabrana mat — nishchit samay (aam taur par 7 din) ke baad dobara test ki tareekh mil jati hai.
4. Dobara jaane se pehle kisi anubhavi chalak ke saath track jaisi practice kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
sarkari yojana ka paisa nahi aa raha, pehle kya jaanche

Sabse pehle yahi jaancho — khata Aadhaar se mapped hai ya nahi, khata chalu hai ya band/dormant, aur KYC pura hai ya nahi. Adhiktar maamlon me rukawat inhi teen me se ek hoti hai. Yojana ke fayde ki jaankari ke liye sambandhit vibhaag se pucho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
gaadi ka challan kata hai ya nahi, online kaise jaanche

Parivahan/e-Challan portal par gaadi number ya DL number dal kar pending challan dikh jata hai. Wahi se online bhugtan bhi ho jata hai — bhugtan ki parchi sambhal kar rakho. Anjaan link se challan kabhi mat bharo, hamesha sarkari portal khud type karke kholo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
do jagah se janm praman ban gaya hai, kya dikkat hai

Ek vyakti ka ek hi janm panjikaran hona chahiye. Galti se do ban gaye hon to karyalay me likhit aavedan dekar ek ko radd karwao — do record aage Passport jaise kaamo me rukawat bante hain.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
jati praman patra (caste certificate) banwana hai, process batao

Jati praman patra rajya sarkar deti hai aur prakriya rajya ke hisaab se thodi badal sakti hai.
1. Apne rajya ke seva portal (e-District aadi) par 'Jati Praman Patra' ke liye online aavedan karo, ya CSC/tehsil karyalay se form lo.
2. Kagaz — aavedak aur pita ke kagaz: Aadhaar, purana jati praman (parivaar me kisi ka ho to), school ka kagaz (TC/marksheet), pate ka praman.
3. Aavedan ke baad sthaniya jaanch (lekhpal/tehsil star par) hoti hai.
4. Manzoori ke baad praman patra portal se download ho jata hai — us par digital sign/QR hota hai jo har jagah chalta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
chashma lagakar gaadi chalata hu, licence par likha hona chahiye kya

Haan — test me chashme ke saath paas hue ho to licence par 'with spectacles' jaisi tippani hoti hai. Bina chashme ke chalana us sthiti me niyam ke khilaf mana jata hai. Number badle to naye chashme ke saath jaankari update karwa lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
pati-patni dono ke naam ek hi form se jud sakte hai kya

Har vyakti ka aavedan alag hota hai — Form 6 har ek ke liye alag bharna hoga. Haan, ek hi baithak me pure parivaar ke form ek saath bhar sakte ho, isse BLO ki jaanch bhi ek saath ho jati hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form submit ho gaya, uski parchi/print kaise nikale aur kyun rakhe

1. Submit ke turant baad screen par application number dikhta hai — usi page ka print ya screenshot pehle le lo.
2. Portal par 'Print Application' ya email par aayi copy se PDF save karo.
3. Is parchi par hi aage ke saare kaam hote hain — admit card, status, sudhaar sab isi number se hoga.
4. Ek copy phone me aur ek kagaz wali copy kagazon wali file me rakho.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
sarkari bharati ke form me photo par tareekh wala niyam kya hota hai

1. Kuch formon me photo par naam aur tareekh chhapi honi chahiye, kuch me bilkul nahi — ye har vigyapan me alag hota hai.
2. Vigyapan ke 'photo nirdesh' wala hissa dhyaan se padho.
3. Studio par photo khichwate samay niyam bata do — ve usi hisaab se bana dete hain.
4. Galat photo wala form jaanch me radd ho sakta hai — is chhoti baat ko halke me mat lo.
PAN form bharte samay photo aur signature kaise lagaye

1. Safed background wali hal ki passport size photo rakho — online aavedan me nirdhaarit size (aam taur par 3.5 x 2.5 cm ke aas-paas) ki scan copy mangi jati hai.
2. Signature safed kagaz par kaale ya neele pen se karke scan karo — wahi signature rakho jo bank me dete ho.
3. Dhyaan rahe file ka size aur format (JPG aadi) portal par likhe niyam ke hisaab se ho, warna upload nahi hogi.
4. Aadhaar e-KYC wala rasta chunne par photo Aadhaar se aa jati hai aur ye jhanjhat khatm ho jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration dusri dukaan ya dusre jile se lena hai (portability)

Ration card ki portability suvidha se kai rajyo me tum apne hisse ka ration kisi bhi uchit dar dukaan se le sakte ho — iske liye Aadhaar se joda hona zaroori hota hai.
1. Pakka karo ki ration card sabhi sadasyo ke Aadhaar se juda (seeded) hai — ye kaam portal ya ration dukaan/CSC se hota hai.
2. Jis dukaan se ration lena hai wahan card aur Aadhaar lekar jao — e-POS machine par ungli ke nishan se pushti hoti hai.
3. Agar parivaar do jagah rehta hai, to kuch sadasya ek jagah aur kuch dusri jagah bhi hisse ka ration le sakte hain — vibhaag ke niyam rajya se jaancho.
4. Machine par mile parchi (receipt) ko hamesha lo aur matra jaanch kar hi sign/thumb lagao.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ek hi PNR par kuch yatri CNF aur kuch WL hain, kya kare

Aisi sthiti aam hai — jinki seat pakki hai wo yatra kar sakte hain. E-ticket par WL wale yatri train me nahi chadh sakte; chart banne tak intezaar karo, sthiti badalti rehti hai. Counter ticket par niyam thode alag hain — station par pakka karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
mera naam matdata soochi me hai ya nahi, kaise check kare

1. Matdata seva portal par 'Search in Electoral Roll' wala vikalp kholo.
2. Apna EPIC number, ya naam + janm tithi + rajya bhar kar khojo.
3. Naam mil jaye to booth (matdan kendra) ki jaankari bhi wahi dikh jati hai.
4. Naam na mile to Form 6 se naya panjikaran karo; galti dikhe to Form 8 se sudhaar karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form bharne ke liye umar ka praman kaunsa kagaz chalega

Aam taur par janm praman patra ya 10vi ki marksheet/Board praman patra chalta hai — Aadhaar har jagah umar ka praman nahi mana jata. Vigyapan me di gayi kagaz-soochi hi antim hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN number bhool gaya hu, kaise pata kare

1. Agar PAN kabhi bank ya naukri me diya tha, to purane kagaz — bank passbook ki copy, vetan parchi (salary slip) ya Form 16 — me PAN number mil jayega.
2. Income Tax portal par 'Know Your PAN' jaisi suvidha samay-samay par milti hai — naam, janm tithi aur mobile OTP se PAN pata chal sakta hai.
3. Na mile to apne bank shakha se pucho — khate me darj PAN wahi dikh jata hai.
4. PAN milte hi use surakshit jagah note kar lo — PAN number kisi anjaan ko mat do.
PAN card ke liye apply kiya tha, 1 mahina ho gaya nahi aaya — kya kare

1. Pehle acknowledgment number se status jaancho — NSDL/UTIITSL portal par 'Track Status' hota hai.
2. Status me 'under process' dikhe to thoda aur intezaar karo; kagaz me kami dikhe to manga gaya kagaz dobara bhejo/upload karo.
3. Card dispatch ho gaya ho to post vibhaag ki tracking se pata lagao — kai baar card post office me pada rehta hai.
4. e-PAN email par pehle hi aa jata hai — usi se bank ke kaam ho jate hain, plastic card ka intezaar mat karo.
kisi ne mere Aadhaar ki galat copy istemal kar li, kaise pata chalega

myAadhaar portal par 'Aadhaar Authentication History' me pichhle kuch mahino me tumhare Aadhaar ka istemal kahan-kahan hua, ye dikh jata hai. Anjaan istemal dikhe to turant UIDAI ke helpline 1947 par soochna do aur Aadhaar lock kar do.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
praman patra Hindi me hai, dusre rajya me English wala chahiye — kya kare

Kai portal par praman patra do bhashao me banta hai — download ke samay bhasha ka vikalp dekho. Na mile to notary se pramanit anuvaad (translation) karwana ek rasta hai — pehle mangne wali sanstha se puch lo ki unhe kya chahiye.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN card par janm tithi sirf saal chhapa hai, poori kaise hogi

Purane PAN me kabhi sirf saal hota tha. Correction form se poori janm tithi bharo aur praman (Aadhaar/marksheet) lagao — naye card par poori tithi aa jayegi. Bank KYC me ye antar aksar rukawat banta hai, isliye theek karwa lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar kendra par appointment online kaise book kare

Bheed se bachne ke liye pehle se appointment le sakte ho.
1. myAadhaar portal par 'Book an Appointment' wala vikalp kholo.
2. Apna rajya aur nazdeeki Aadhaar Seva Kendra chuno.
3. Jo kaam karwana hai (naya Aadhaar, update aadi) wo chuno aur khaali samay (slot) me se apne hisaab ka samay rakho.
4. Mobile number par OTP aayega, use dalte hi appointment pakki ho jayegi — us samay par kendra pahunch jao.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank se statement kaise nikale (khate ka byora chahiye)

1. Sabse aasan — bank ke mobile app ya internet banking se chahiye wale samay ka statement PDF me download karo.
2. App na ho to shakha jaakar statement ka aavedan do — samay-avadhi (jaise pichhle 6 mahine) bata do.
3. Kuch kaamo (visa, loan) ke liye mohar (stamp) wala statement chahiye hota hai — wo shakha se hi milega.
4. Statement me apni jaankari (khata number) hoti hai — use anjaan logo ko mat bhejo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
kisi aur ke khate me paisa bhejna hai, kya jaankari chahiye

Sirf teen cheezein — pane wale ka naam (bank record wala), khata number aur shakha ka IFSC. Iske alawa OTP ya PIN kabhi nahi chahiye hota. Agar koi paisa 'paane' ke liye tumse PIN/OTP mange to wo fraud hai — paisa lene ke liye PIN kabhi nahi lagta.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
online form ke liye OTP wala number band ho gaya hai beech me, kya kare

1. Pehle wahi number dobara chalu karwao — telecom company band number ko kuch samay tak usi graahak ko wapas deti hai.
2. Number hi na mile to sambandhit seva me pehle number update karwao (Aadhaar kendra, bank shakha aadi).
3. Form aadha bhara hai to wo save rehta hai — number theek karke aage badho.
4. Isiliye sarkari kaamo wala number kabhi band mat karo — wo tumhari digital chaabi hai.
CSC par apna kaam dusre se karwana hai (main nahi ja sakta)

Aam form wale kaam parivaar ka sadasya kagaz lekar karwa sakta hai, lekin jahan ungli ke nishan (biometric) ya OTP lage wahan tumhara khud hona zaroori hai. Apna OTP phone par kisi ko aage bhejkar mat do — ye sabse badi galti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank passbook kho gayi ya bhar gayi, nayi kaise milegi

1. Apni shakha jaakar duplicate passbook ka aavedan do — pehchan ke liye Aadhaar saath rakho.
2. Passbook bhar gayi ho to nayi passbook muft/niyam anusaar turant mil jati hai.
3. Kho gayi ho to bank chhoti si prakriya (kabhi-kabhi ghoshna patra) ke baad nayi passbook deta hai.
4. Aaj kal mobile banking/app par bhi pura statement dikh jata hai — passbook ke saath use bhi sakriya rakho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration card se naam katwaye bina dusre rajya me ration milega kya

Portability suvidha se dusre rajya ki dukaan se bhi ration mil sakta hai, basharte card Aadhaar se juda ho. Lekin lambe samay ke liye shift ho gaye ho to naye rajya me naam judwana aur purani jagah se katwana hi sahi aur surakshit tareeka hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
signature scan karke upload kaise kare, niyam kya hai

1. Safed kagaz par kaale ya neele pen se apna aam wala signature karo — wahi jo bank me dete ho.
2. Use phone se seedha photo lo ya scan karo; aas-paas ki khaali jagah kaat (crop) do.
3. File ko manga gaya size/format (aam taur par JPG, kuch KB) me rakho.
4. Dhyaan rahe — kisi aur ke signature ki nakal ya alag har baar signature karna aage jaanch me dikkat deta hai.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
do bank khate hain, sarkari paisa kis khate me aayega

1. Sarkari labh (DBT) us khate me aata hai jo Aadhaar se NPCI par 'mapped' hota hai — aam taur par aakhri baar joda gaya khata.
2. Kaunsa khata mapped hai ye UIDAI/bank se jaanch sakte ho.
3. Galat khate me paisa ja raha ho to jis bank me chahiye wahan Aadhaar seeding ki request do.
4. Ek hi khata rakho jis par tum nazar rakhte ho — paisa aane ka SMS wahi milega.
Aadhaar number yaad nahi aur mobile bhi badal gaya, number kaise pata kare

Aadhaar kendra jao — wahan tumhare fingerprint se pehchan karke Aadhaar number ki jaankari aur naya mobile number jodne ka kaam ek saath ho sakta hai. Saath me koi pehchan patra (PAN/Voter ID) le jana madad karta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
baccha 15 saal ka ho gaya, biometric update nahi karaya — card band hoga kya

Samay par biometric update na ho to Aadhaar ke istemal me rukawat aa sakti hai. Der ho gayi ho to bhi kendra jaakar update karwa lo — prakriya wahi hai, sirf der hui hai. School/bank ke kaamo se pehle ye nipta lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ghar me bijli ka load badhwana hai (AC lagana hai), prakriya kya hai

Bijli company ke portal/karyalay me 'Load Enhancement' ka aavedan hota hai — vartaman connection number aur chahiye wala load bharo. Jaanch ke baad antar ki security/fees bharne par load badh jata hai. Bina badhwaye zyada load chalana niyam ke khilaf hai aur taar/meter ko nuksan pahuncha sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
UTS app se general ticket kaise le

1. UTS app ko sarkari store se download karo aur mobile number se panjikaran karo.
2. Station ke paas hone par hi (GPS se jaanch hoti hai) general ticket book hoti hai — ghar se bahut door se nahi.
3. Apna route aur ticket prakar chuno, wallet/UPI se bhugtan karo.
4. Ticket app me dikhti hai — yatra ke dauran wahi TTE ko dikhani hoti hai; screenshot kabhi-kabhi nahi chalta, app wali asal ticket rakho.
ration dukaan par kam ration milta hai ya dukaan band rehti hai, shikayat kahan kare

1. Pehle parchi (receipt) zaroor lo — bina parchi ke shikayat kamzor padti hai; matra aur daam parchi par likhe hote hain.
2. Shikayat apne rajya ke khadya vibhaag ke helpline number ya portal par darj karo — card number aur dukaan ka naam batao.
3. Jile ke aapoorti adhikari (DSO) karyalay me likhit shikayat bhi de sakte ho.
4. Shikayat ka number/parchi sambhal kar rakho aur kuch din me uska status bhi usi number se puch sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli bill bahut zyada aa gaya, galti lagti hai — kya kare

1. Pehle meter ki vartaman reading bill par likhi reading se milao — photo le lo meter ki, tareekh ke saath.
2. Purane 2-3 bill se tulna karo — kya ye anumaanit (average) bill hai ya asal reading wala, ye bill par likha hota hai.
3. Galti lage to bijli karyalay me likhit shikayat do ya company ke portal/app par 'Bill Complaint' darj karo — meter photo saath lagao.
4. Shikayat ka number sambhal kar rakho; jaanch me galti nikle to sudhra bill (revised bill) banta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport seva kendra dusre jile me hai, apne jile se aavedan ho sakta hai kya

Tum apne vartaman pate ke kshetra wale kendra se aavedan karte ho — portal par pata dalte hi sahi kendra apne aap sujhaya jata hai. Kuch chhote kendra (Post Office PSK) ab lagbhag har jile me hain, isliye door jaana kam padta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Driving Licence banana hai, poora process shuru se batao

Licence do charno me banta hai — pehle Learner Licence, phir kuch samay baad Permanent (Driving) Licence.
1. Parivahan Sewa portal (parivahan.gov.in) par 'Learner Licence' ke liye aavedan karo — umar: gear wali gaadi ke liye 18 saal, bina gear (50cc tak) ke liye 16 saal (mata-pita ki sahmati se).
2. Kagaz lagao — umar ka praman (Aadhaar, janm praman patra, 10vi marksheet), pate ka praman, photo aur signature.
3. Fees bharo aur online test (LL test) ki tareekh lo — test me yatayat ke niyam aur nishano ke sawal aate hain; kai rajyo me ye test online ghar se bhi hota hai.
4. Test paas karne par Learner Licence mil jata hai — iske saath tum 'L' lagakar seekh sakte ho.
5. Learner banne ke 30 din baad aur 6 mahine ke andar Permanent Licence ke liye aavedan karo; RTO me gaadi chalakar dikhane ka driving test hoga.
6. Test paas hote hi licence banta hai aur post se ghar aa jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
janm praman patra me naam jodna hai (pehle bina naam ka bana tha)

1. Jis karyalay se praman patra bana tha, wahi naam jodne ka aavedan hota hai — kai rajyo me online bhi hota hai.
2. Maa-pita ke pehchan patra aur purana praman patra saath rakho.
3. Naam wahi likhwao jo school me chalega — teeno jagah (janm praman, Aadhaar, school) ek naam rakho.
4. Samay seema ke baad naam jodne par karyalay ke nirdeshanusar ghoshna patra lag sakta hai.
Voter ID ke form me galti se dusra jila bhar diya, kya hoga

1. Submit se pehle dikhe to wahi theek kar lo — preview hamesha padho.
2. Submit ho gaya ho to reference number se status dekho; jaanch me galti pakdi jaane par form wapas ho sakta hai.
3. Correction ke liye Form 8 se sahi jaankari ka aavedan karo.
4. Do jagah aavedan kabhi mat karo — naam do soochiyon me aana niyam ke khilaf hai.
company/naukri badli, PAN me kuch badalna padta hai kya

Nahi — PAN vyakti ka hota hai, naukri se nahi badalta. Sirf niyokta (company) ko apna PAN number dena hota hai. Pata badla ho to wo bhi PAN me badalna zaroori nahi, par bank record me naya pata update karwa lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Voter ID ka EPIC number kya hota hai

EPIC number Voter ID card par chhapa 10 akshar-ank wala vishesh number hai — yahi tumhari matdata pehchan hai. Naam khojne, sudhaar aur e-EPIC download — sabme yehi number kaam aata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
praman patra kitne din me ban jata hai

Samay rajya aur praman ke prakar par nirbhar karta hai — aam taur par kuch dino se 2-3 hafto tak. Aavedan parchi par anumanit samay likha hota hai aur portal par status bhi dikhta hai. Samay par na bane to parchi lekar karyalay me pucho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
zameen ka naam transfer (dakhil kharij/mutation) kaise hota hai

Registry ke baad tehsil me dakhil kharij ka aavedan do — registry ki copy aur pehchan patra lagta hai. Jaankari ki jaanch ke baad naam revenue record me chadh jata hai. Iske bina khatauni me purane malik ka naam dikhta rehta hai, isliye ye kadam kabhi mat chhodo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
CSC kendra kya hota hai, wahan kya-kya kaam hota hai

CSC (Common Service Centre) gaon/sheher me chalne wala sarkari-seva kendra hai jahan ek hi jagah par bahut se online sarkari kaam hote hain.
1. Wahan hone wale aam kaam — Aadhaar se jude kaam, PAN aavedan, praman patra, form bharna, bijli bill, train ticket, bank (Bank Mitra) ki chhoti sevaein.
2. Har kaam ke liye nishchit seva-fees hoti hai — kendra par fees ki soochi lagi honi chahiye, usse zyada mat do.
3. Har kaam ki parchi (receipt) zaroor lo — usi par aavedan number hota hai.
4. Apna OTP aur password kendra wale ko bhi mat batao — OTP khud apne phone par dekh kar khud dalo ya bolkar dalne ke baad sandesh jaanch lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
online form me galti ho gayi hai, sudhaar (correction) kaise hoga

1. Kai formon me submit ke baad kuch din ke liye 'Correction Window' khulta hai — portal par apne login se form kholkar galti theek karo.
2. Naam, janm tithi jaisi badi galtiyan kabhi-kabhi correction me nahi badalti — aise me vibhaag ke helpline/karyalay se sampark karo.
3. Correction window band ho chuki ho to bhi ghabrao mat — kagaz jaanch (document verification) ke samay sahi kagaz dikhakar kai galtiyan wahi sudhar jati hain.
4. Aage se form bharte samay submit se pehle 'Preview' wala page poora padhne ki aadat dalo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
paani ke bill me purana bakaaya dikh raha hai jo bhar chuka hu

Purani bhugtan parchi lekar nagar nigam/jal karyalay jao — record me bhugtan chadhana (posting) reh gaya hota hai. Parchi dikhate hi sudhaar ho jata hai. Isiliye har bill ki parchi kam se kam ek saal sambhal kar rakho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
mobile kho gaya jisme saare sarkari app the, kya kare

Sabse pehle SIM band karwao (telecom company se) aur naya SIM usi number ka lo — number wahi rehne par saare khate OTP se wapas khul jate hain. Bank ko soochit karo, aur naye phone me app lagakar sabke password badal lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
jati praman patra dusre rajya me chalega kya

Jati praman patra jari karne wale rajya ke andar poori tarah chalta hai. Kendriya kaamo me bhi rajya ka bana praman aam taur par maanya hota hai, lekin kuch maamlon me kendriya soochi se milan dekha jata hai. Dusre rajya me bas jane par wahan ki sevaon ke liye naya praman wahan ke niyam se banta hai — apna purana praman hamesha sambhal kar rakho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
station par ticket lena hai (counter ticket), process kya hai

1. Station ke reservation counter par form bharo — train number/naam, tareekh, station aur yatriyon ke naam-umr saaf likho.
2. Aarakshit (reserved) ticket ke liye form jama karke fees do; bina aarakshan (general) ticket alag khidki se turant milti hai.
3. Counter ticket kho jaye to duplicate ke liye station par prakriya hoti hai — PNR aur pehchan patra saath rakho.
4. Counter wali ticket ko online (IRCTC se) cancel nahi kar sakte — uske liye counter par hi jana hota hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank locker kaise milta hai

Locker shakha me uplabdhata ke hisaab se milta hai — aavedan ke saath khata aur KYC zaroori hota hai. Locker ka saal ka kiraya aur shartein bank pehle hi bata deta hai. Qeemti kagaz (property ke kagaz, zevar) ke liye locker sabse surakshit jagah hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
licence renewal me medical certificate kab lagta hai

1. Nishchit umar (aam taur par 40/50 saal ke baad, rajya ke niyam se) ke baad renewal par doctor ka medical certificate lagta hai.
2. Commercial (transport) licence ke renewal par medical har baar lag sakta hai.
3. Certificate panjikrit doctor se banta hai — form portal par milta hai.
4. Aankhon ki jaanch khaas taur par dekhi jati hai — chashma lagta hai to wo licence par darj ho jata hai.
notary kya hota hai, shapath patra (affidavit) kahan banta hai

Notary sarkar dwara niyukt vyakti hota hai jo shapath patra aur kagazon ko pramanit karta hai — ye aam taur par court/tehsil ke aas-paas milte hain. Shapath patra stamp paper par banta hai; rakam aur prakar kaam ke hisaab se hota hai — pehle mangne wale vibhaag se pakka karo ki unhe kaisa chahiye.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar se juda bank khata kaise pata kare (konsa bank mapped hai)

1. UIDAI ki website par 'Check Aadhaar/Bank Linking Status' wala vikalp hota hai.
2. Aadhaar number aur OTP dalne par dikh jata hai ki kaunsa bank khata mapped hai (bank ka naam dikhta hai, khata number nahi).
3. Galat bank dikhe to jis bank me labh chahiye wahan jaakar Aadhaar seeding ki request do.
4. Seeding ke baad 2-3 din me status badal jata hai — dobara jaanch kar pakka karo.
EPF/PF ka balance kaise jaanche naukri karne wale ke liye

UMANG app ya EPFO portal par UAN number se PF balance dikh jata hai. UAN pehli naukri par banta hai — purani company se mila UAN hi aage chalta hai, naya mat banwao. Mobile number UAN se juda rakho taaki OTP aa sake.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
5 saal ke bacche ka Aadhaar (Baal Aadhaar) kaise banta hai

Chhote baccho ke liye Baal Aadhaar banta hai — isme bacche ke fingerprint nahi liye jate.
1. Bacche ka janm praman patra aur maa ya pita me se kisi ek ka Aadhaar lekar Aadhaar kendra jao.
2. Wahan bacche ki sirf photo li jayegi; form mata-pita ke Aadhaar se joda jayega.
3. Baccha 5 saal ka ho jaye to pehli baar aur 15 saal par dusri baar biometric (ungli ke nishan, photo) update karwana zaroori hota hai.
4. Ye biometric update samay par karwa lena, warna card aage chal kar band ho sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank me FD (fixed deposit) kaise khulti hai, prakriya batao

1. Apni shakha ya mobile app/internet banking se FD khol sakte ho — rakam aur samay (avadhi) tum chunte ho.
2. Khate se rakam apne aap kat kar FD me chali jati hai; FD ki parchi/receipt sambhal kar rakho.
3. Nominee ka naam FD par bhi zaroor do.
4. Samay se pehle todne par byaj kam milta hai aur kabhi-kabhi katauti hoti hai — shartein kholne se pehle padh lo.
bina gear wali scooty ke liye licence kab ban sakta hai

1. 16 saal ki umar par bina gear (engine seema ke andar) wali gaadi ka Learner Licence ban sakta hai.
2. Mata-pita/abhibhavak ki likhit sahmati saath lagti hai.
3. Prakriya wahi hai — Parivahan portal par aavedan, kagaz, fees aur LL test.
4. 18 saal hone par gear wali gaadi aur car ki shreni judwani hogi.
mahine wala pass (season ticket) kaise banta hai

Roz ek hi route par jaane walo ke liye station counter ya UTS app se season pass banta hai — pehchan patra aur photo lagta hai. Pass par route aur avadhi likhi hoti hai; usi route par maanya hota hai. Student pass ke liye school/college ka praman lag sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
kagaz ka lamination karwana sahi hai kya

Kuch praman patro par lamination ke baad mohar/sign ki jaanch mushkil ho jati hai aur kuch karyalay use lene se mana kar sakte hain. Asli kagaz ko saaf file/plastic cover me rakho, lamination se bacho — khaas taur par marksheet aur praman patro par.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli bill par mobile number galat hai kisi aur ka, badle kaise

1. Bijli company ke portal/app par 'update mobile' ka vikalp hota hai — consumer number aur bill ki jaankari se badal jata hai.
2. Online na ho to karyalay me aavedan do.
3. Galat number par tumhare bill ki jaankari ja rahi hai — ye sirf asuvidha nahi, suraksha ka sawal bhi hai, turant badlo.
4. Badalne ke baad ek SMS aakar pushti hoti hai — use jaanch lo.
train ticket par khana (food) pehle se book ho sakta hai kya

Kuch trainon me ticket ke saath khana judta hai (Rajdhani/Shatabdi jaise me kiraya me shamil hota hai). Dusri trainon me IRCTC ke e-catering se station par khana mangwaya ja sakta hai — PNR number se order hota hai. Pantry car wali train me yatra ke dauran bhi khana milta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
CSC se form bharwaya, galti ho gayi — jimmedari kiski aur sudhaar kaise

1. Form submit karne se pehle preview khud padhna tumhari jimmedari hai — CSC par bhi screen dekh kar hi haan bolo.
2. Galti ho gayi ho to usi CSC par jaakar correction ki prakriya pucho — aavedan number usi ke paas hoga.
3. Correction window khuli ho to wahi se sudhar jayegi.
4. Aage se form bharne ke baad mili parchi par naam/janm tithi usi samay mila lene ki aadat dalo.
Voter ID ke liye kya kagaz chahiye, list batao

1. Umar ka praman — janm praman patra, 10vi ki marksheet, Aadhaar ya Passport me se ek.
2. Pate ka praman — Aadhaar (usi pate wala), bijli/paani bill, kirayanama, ya bank passbook.
3. Ek passport size photo.
4. Pehle se kahi naam hai to wahan se hatane ki jaankari bhi saath do.
train ki ticket online book karni hai, poora process batao

1. IRCTC ki website ya Rail Connect app par apna khata (account) banao — naam, mobile aur email chahiye; mobile OTP se pakka hota hai.
2. Login karke 'From' aur 'To' station, tareekh aur class (Sleeper/AC aadi) chuno aur train khojo.
3. Apni train aur seat ki sthiti (Available/WL aadi) dekh kar 'Book Now' karo.
4. Yatriyon ke naam, umar aur pehchan patra ki jaankari sahi bharo — naam ID card jaisa hi likho.
5. UPI/card/net-banking se bhugtan karo — safal hote hi PNR number milta hai, ticket email/SMS par bhi aa jati hai.
6. Yatra ke din chart banne ke baad seat number pakka hota hai — PNR status dekh kar hi ghar se niklo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
dusre sheher shift ho gaya hu, Aadhaar me pata wahi purana hai — kya karna chahiye

Pata purana rehne se bank, SIM aur sarkari kaamo me dikkat aati hai, isliye naye sheher ka pata update karwa lena chahiye.
1. Naye pate ka koi praman rakho — kirayanama (rent agreement), naye pate ka bijli bill, ya bank passbook par naya pata.
2. myAadhaar portal par login karke Address Update se naya pata bharo aur kagaz upload karo.
3. Agar tumhare paas koi kagaz nahi hai, to makan malik ya parivaar ke mukhiya ke Aadhaar dwara pata update ka vikalp bhi portal par hai.
4. Update ke baad nayi e-Aadhaar copy download karke rakh lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
mere paas pate ka koi kagaz nahi hai, Aadhaar kaise bane

Aisi sthiti ke liye 'Introducer' aur 'Head of Family' jaise vikalp hote hain — parivaar ke mukhiya ke kagaz ke aadhar par tumhara Aadhaar/update ho sakta hai. Aadhaar kendra par apni sthiti batao, wahan ke karmchari sahi vikalp batayenge.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train me seat par koi aur baitha hai, kya kare

Pehle apni ticket par seat number mila lo — kai baar galat dabba/coach hota hai. Sahi seat par koi aur ho to pehle shanti se apni ticket dikhao; baat na bane to TTE se milo — wahi antim faisla karta hai. Ladai-jhagda kabhi mat karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration card me naye sadasya ka naam jodna hai (baccha/bahu)

1. Rajya ke portal par 'sadasya jode' wala form chuno ya CSC/tehsil karyalay se form lo.
2. Naye sadasya ka Aadhaar aur sambandh ka praman lagao — bacche ke liye janm praman patra, vivah ke baad judne par vivah praman patra jaisa kagaz.
3. Agar naam dusri jagah ke ration card me tha, to pehle wahan se naam katwana (surrender/deletion certificate) zaroori hota hai — ek vyakti do jagah nahi reh sakta.
4. Jaankari jaanch ke baad naam jud jata hai aur agle mahine se us hisaab se ration milne lagta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration ki dukaan par machine kharab batakar ration nahi de raha, kya kare

1. Pehle dusre din jaakar dekho — asal kharabi ek-do din me theek ho jati hai.
2. Baar-baar yahi bahana ho to vibhaag ke helpline par dukaan ke number ke saath shikayat darj karo.
3. Apne hisse ka ration mahine ke andar hi milta hai — aakhri din tak mat ruko.
4. Mohalle ke aur logo ke saath milkar likhit shikayat dena zyada asar-daar hota hai.
e-Aadhaar download karne ke baad PDF ka password kya hota hai

e-Aadhaar ki PDF password se surakshit hoti hai, taaki koi aur use khol na sake.
1. Password tumhare naam ke pehle 4 akshar (bade/CAPITAL me) aur janm ke saal ko jodkar banta hai.
2. Example: naam 'Ramesh Kumar' aur janm saal 1998 hai to password hoga RAME1998.
3. PDF kholne par ye password dalo — dhyaan rahe naam wahi likho jo Aadhaar par hai.
4. Ye password kisi anjaan vyakti ko mat batao, e-Aadhaar bilkul asli card jitna hi maanya hai.
Aadhaar par janm saal hi likha hai poori tareekh nahi, Passport me dikkat hogi kya

1. Purane kuch Aadhaar me sirf janm saal chhapa hota tha — Passport ke liye poori janm tithi ka praman chahiye.
2. Janm praman patra ya 10vi ki marksheet ko praman banao — wahi Passport me lagegi.
3. Aadhaar me bhi poori janm tithi kendra se judwa lo — aage sab jagah kaam aayegi.
4. Sab kagazon me janm tithi ek karna lambe samay ki sabse achhi taiyaari hai.
ration card ko Aadhaar se link (seed) kaise kare

Rajya portal par 'Aadhaar seeding' ka vikalp hota hai, ya ration dukaan/CSC par sabhi sadasyon ke Aadhaar ke saath ye kaam hota hai. Ek-ek sadasya ka Aadhaar alag se judta hai — kisi ka chhoot jaye to uske hisse ka ration atak sakta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
sarkari karyalay me kaam nahi ho raha, shikayat kahan aur kaise kare

1. Pehle usi karyalay ke bade adhikari (senior officer) ko likhit aavedan do — ek copy par 'prapt' ki mohar/parchi zaroor lo.
2. Kaam na bane to jile ke adhikari (DM/Collector karyalay) me shikayat darj karo — kai rajyo me iske liye jan sunvai aur online portal bhi hote hain.
3. Kendriya kaamo ke liye CPGRAMS portal par online shikayat darj hoti hai aur uska number milta hai.
4. Shikayat me hamesha tathya likho — aavedan ki tareekh, parchi number, kisne kya kaha; gussa aur bhasha par kabu rakho, kagaz hi sabse badi taakat hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye photo kaisi chahiye

Passport photo ka nap aur niyam sakht hote hain — safed background, chehra saaf aur aage ki ore, bina chashme ke (aam taur par). PSK me photo wahi li jati hai, isliye bahar ki photo ki chinta mat karo — bas saaf-suthre kapdo me samay par pahuncho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train ki general ticket aur reserved ticket me kya farak hai

1. General (unreserved) ticket par koi seat pakki nahi hoti — general dabbe me jagah milne par baithte hain; ye turant station se milti hai.
2. Reserved ticket par seat/berth number pakka hota hai aur naam se booking hoti hai.
3. Lambi yatra me hamesha reserved ticket lo — general me bheed bahut hoti hai.
4. General ticket ki maanyata samay seemit hoti hai — ticket lene ke baad nishchit samay me yatra shuru karni hoti hai.
kagazon ki suraksha ke liye kya aadat rakhe (fraud se bachna)

1. Apne asal kagaz (Aadhaar, PAN) ki photocopy dete samay us par tareekh aur jis kaam ke liye di hai wo likh do — isse dusra istemal mushkil hota hai.
2. OTP, PIN, password kisi ko mat batao — bank, police ya sarkari vibhaag phone par ye kabhi nahi mangte.
3. Kagazon ki digital copy DigiLocker jaise sarkari app me rakho; WhatsApp par anjaan ko Aadhaar ki photo mat bhejo.
4. 'Aapka khata band ho jayega, turant ye link kholo' jaise sandesh hamesha fraud hote hain — seedha bank/karyalay jaakar pata karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN card me naam ki spelling galat hai, sudhaar kaise kare

1. NSDL ya UTIITSL portal par 'Changes/Correction in PAN' wala form chuno.
2. Apna PAN number dalo aur jis hisse me galti hai (naam, janm tithi, pita ka naam) use tick karo.
3. Sahi jaankari bharo aur uska praman (Aadhaar, janm praman patra aadi) upload karo.
4. Fees bhugtan karke form submit karo — ek acknowledgment number milega, usse status dekho.
5. Sudhaar ke baad naya e-PAN email par aa jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form bharne ke baad admit card kaise aur kab aata hai

1. Admit card aam taur par pariksha se 1-2 hafte pehle usi portal par aata hai jahan form bhara tha.
2. Apne login (aavedan number/janm tithi) se download karo.
3. Us par naam, photo, kendra aur samay jaancho — galti dikhe to turant vibhaag ke helpline par batao.
4. Admit card ke saath ek photo pehchan patra le jana hota hai — nirdesh wala page poora padho.
Aadhaar aur bank khate ka naam alag-alag hai, paisa atakta hai — kya kare

1. Pehle tay karo ki sahi naam kaunsa hai — school ke kagaz aur janm praman ke hisaab se.
2. Galat wale kagaz me sudhaar karo — Aadhaar me galat hai to Aadhaar sudhaar, bank me galat hai to bank shakha me naam sudhaar ka form.
3. Bank me naam badalne ke liye Aadhaar/PAN aur aavedan patra lagta hai.
4. Dono jagah naam ek ho jane ke baad KYC dobara update karwa lo.
aay praman patra kitne samay ke liye maanya hota hai

1. Aam taur par praman patra ek vittiya varsh/ek saal ke liye maanya mana jata hai — sahi avadhi rajya ke niyam se hoti hai.
2. Jis kaam ke liye jama karna hai, wahan ki shartein padh lo — kai jagah 6 mahine se purana nahi chalta.
3. Purana pada hai aur kaam abhi hai to naya banwana hi surakshit hai.
4. Praman par jari hone ki tareekh saaf likhi hoti hai — wahi se hisaab karo.
bank se ghar ka pata par koi kagaz aana hai par pata purana hai

Turant shakha/app se pata update karo — bank ke kagaz (card, cheque book) purane pate par jaakar kho sakte hain. Tab tak purane pate par rehne walo se sampark rakho taaki koi dak mile to tum tak pahunche.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
cheque book ke liye aavedan kaise kare

1. Shakha me cheque book ka form bharo ya internet banking/app se 'Request Cheque Book' karo.
2. Cheque book tumhare darj pate par post se aati hai — pata purana ho to pehle pata update karwao.
3. Cheque par sign wahi karo jo bank me darj hai — alag sign par cheque ruk (bounce) sakta hai.
4. Khaali cheque par pehle se sign karke kabhi mat rakho aur cheque kisi anjaan ko mat do.
Voter ID me booth dusre gaon ka aa gaya hai, pata sahi hai

1. Portal par apne record ki jaankari jaancho — kabhi-kabhi booth ka punargathan (badlav) hota hai aur naya booth banta hai.
2. Pata sahi par booth galat lage to BLO se milo — soochi ki galti wahi theek karwata hai.
3. Form 8 se pate ka sudhaar bhi ek rasta hai.
4. Chunav se pehle voter slip par booth zaroor mila lo — purani aadat par mat jao.
bijli chori ki shikayat (padosi katiya dal raha hai) kahan kare

Bijli company ke helpline/portal par iski shikayat gopniya roop se darj hoti hai. Katiya (seedha taar) jaan ke liye bhi khatarnak hai — khud haath lagakar hatane ki koshish kabhi mat karo. Shikayat me pata saaf likho, naam dena zaroori nahi hota.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank khata kitne din me band ho jata hai

Aam taur par aavedan ke din ya 1-2 kaam ke dino me khata band ho jata hai. Agar khate par koi ruka hua len-den ya shulk baki hai to pehle wo saaf karna padta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train me bacche ka ticket alag seat ke saath kaise book kare

1. Booking ke samay bacche ko yatri soochi me jodo aur 'berth chahiye' wala vikalp chuno.
2. Berth lene par poora kiraya lagta hai; bina berth ke aadha — screen par saaf dikhta hai.
3. Bacche ki umar sahi bharo — yatra ke din ki umar gin-ti hai.
4. 5 saal se chhota baccha bina ticket ke ja sakta hai, par uske liye seat nahi milti.
sarkari website asli hai ya nakli, kaise pehchane

1. Address bar me website ka naam dhyaan se padho — sarkari website aam taur par .gov.in ya .nic.in par khatm hoti hai.
2. Naam me chhoti galti (jaise akshar idhar-udhar) nakli site ki nishani hai — search ke pehle link par andha bharosa mat karo.
3. Website khud type karke kholo, WhatsApp/SMS ke link se kabhi nahi.
4. Paisa bharne se pehle page par vibhaag ka naam aur logo jaancho — shak ho to CSC jaakar karwa lo.
Voter ID ke liye umar 18 se 2 mahine kam hai, form abhi bhar du kya

1. Advance application ki suvidha hai — form abhi de sakte ho, naam tab judega jab patrata ki tithi tak 18 pure ho jaoge.
2. Form me janm tithi bilkul sahi bharo — wahi se hisaab hota hai.
3. Umar ka praman (marksheet/janm praman) zaroor lagao.
4. Naam jud jane ki jaankari portal par reference number se milti rahegi.
DL gum ho gaya aur number bhi yaad nahi, duplicate kaise bane

Parivahan portal par Aadhaar se juda record khojne ki suvidha hoti hai, ya apne RTO jaakar naam-janm tithi se record nikalwao. DigiLocker me pehle se DL joda tha to wahan number dikh jayega. Number milte hi duplicate ki prakriya aam hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli ka bill online bharna hai, kaise bhare

1. Apne rajya/bijli company ki sarkari website ya app kholo — bill par company ka naam aur website likha hota hai; Bharat BillPay (BBPS) wale app (jaise bank ke app) se bhi bill bhara jata hai.
2. Apna consumer number (bill par likha CA/K number) dalo — bill ki rakam aur aakhri tareekh dikh jayegi.
3. Rakm jaanch kar UPI/card se bhugtan karo.
4. Safal bhugtan ki parchi/PDF save kar lo — bhugtan number (transaction id) hi saboot hai.
5. Paisa kat jaye par bill 'unpaid' dikhe to 2-3 din intezaar karo, aam taur par update ho jata hai; na ho to transaction id ke saath company ke helpline par shikayat karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
school ke kagaz aur Aadhaar ka naam alag ho to kaunsa sahi mana jayega

Har vibhaag apne record ko dekhta hai — isliye sab kagaz ek jaise karna hi asli hal hai. Sabse purana aur mool kagaz (janm praman patra) ko aadhar banao aur baaki sab usi ke hisaab se sudharwa lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bachche (nabalig) ka PAN card ban sakta hai kya, process kya hai

Haan, nabalig ka bhi PAN ban sakta hai — aavedan mata-pita ya abhibhavak karte hain.
1. Form 49A bharo, usme nabalig ki jaankari aur pratinidhi (mata/pita) ka hissa bhi hota hai.
2. Bacche ka janm praman patra ya school ka praman, aur mata/pita ka pehchan patra lagta hai.
3. Nabalig ke PAN par photo nahi chapti; 18 saal ka hone par photo wala PAN dobara banwana (update) padta hai.
4. Bank khata ya nivesh ke kaamo ke liye ye PAN kaam aata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye sasural ke pate par rehti hu, pata praman kya lagega

1. Pati ke pate ke kagaz aur vivah praman patra aam taur par kaam aate hain.
2. Apne naam ka koi bill na ho to pati ke Aadhaar/bill ke saath rishta praman lagta hai.
3. Kendra jaane se pehle portal ki soochi me 'spouse ke pate' wala hissa padh lo.
4. Dono pate (maika aur sasural) form me sahi-sahi bharo — verification dono jagah ja sakta hai.
Aadhaar seva kendra aur bank wale kendra me kya farak hai

Dono jagah Aadhaar ke kaam hote hain — bank/post office ke kendra chhote hote hain aur unme sevaein seemit ho sakti hain, jabki Aadhaar Seva Kendra par saari sevaein milti hain. Bade/samasya wale kaam ke liye Seva Kendra hi jao.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli ka naya connection lena hai, process kya hai

1. Bijli company ke portal par 'New Connection' ka online aavedan karo ya kshetra karyalay jao.
2. Kagaz — pehchan patra, pate ka praman, ghar ke kagaz/kirayanama, photo; kitna load (KW) chahiye ye bhi bharna hota hai.
3. Aavedan ke baad vibhaag ka karmchari jagah ki jaanch karta hai aur meter lagane ki tareekh milti hai.
4. Security jama aur connection shulk ka bhugtan parchi ke hisaab se karo — har bhugtan ki sarkari parchi lo, kisi ko nakad bina parchi ke mat do.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
licence par lagi photo bahut purani hai, renewal par badlegi kya

Haan — renewal ke samay nayi photo li/maangi jati hai aur naye card par wahi aati hai. Beech me bhi photo update ki seva portal par mil sakti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form bharne ke liye email id banana aur sambhalna kyun zaroori hai

1. Lagbhag har sarkari portal par khata email aur mobile se banta hai — admit card aur soochnaein wahi aati hain.
2. Apni khud ki email banao aur uska password yaad rakho/note karke surakshit jagah rakho — CSC wale ki email par form mat bharwao.
3. Ek hi email-mobile sabhi formon me rakho taaki jaankari ek jagah mile.
4. Email ka password kisi ke saath share mat karo aur samay-samay par badalte raho.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
DigiLocker ka kagaz police/adhikari maanta hai kya

Haan — IT niyamo ke tahat DigiLocker ke issued documents kagazi asli ke barabar maanya hain. Yatayat police ke liye to sarkar ne spasht kaha hai ki DigiLocker/mParivahan wala DL-RC dikhana kaafi hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank khata band karna hai, process kya hai

1. Apni shakha me khata band karne ka aavedan do — passbook, ATM card aur bachi cheque book saath le jao.
2. Khate me bachi rakam tumhe nakad ya dusre khate me transfer karke di jati hai.
3. Khate se jude auto-payment (bijli bill aadi) pehle band kar lo, warna aage dikkat hogi.
4. Band hone ki parchi zaroor lo — bhavishya me saboot kaam aata hai.
bank khate me pata badalna hai (dusre sheher aa gaya hu)

1. Shakha me pata badalne ka form bharo ya internet banking se karo — kai bank online dete hain.
2. Naye pate ka praman — Aadhaar (naye pate wala), kirayanama, bijli bill.
3. Pata badalne ke baad nayi passbook/cheque book naye pate par hi aayegi.
4. Aadhaar ka pata bhi saath me update karwa lo taaki sab jagah ek pata rahe.
naya Passport banana hai, poora process batao

1. Passport Seva portal (passportindia.gov.in) par khata (register) banao aur login karo.
2. 'Apply for Fresh Passport' wala form bharo — naam, janm tithi, pata bilkul kagazon jaisa likho.
3. Form submit karke fees online bharo aur apne nazdeeki Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) ya Post Office PSK ka appointment lo.
4. Appointment wale din saare asli kagaz lekar jao — wahan photo, fingerprint aur kagazon ki jaanch hogi.
5. Uske baad police verification hota hai — tumhare vartaman (aur kai baar purane) pate par police jaanch ke liye aati hai.
6. Sab saaf hone par Passport post se ghar aa jata hai; status portal par application number se dikhta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bijli bill me naam ya pata galat hai, sudhaar kaise kare

1. Apne kshetra ke bijli karyalay (sub-division office) me sudhaar ka aavedan do.
2. Kagaz — purana bill, pehchan patra aur pate/sampatti ke kagaz (jaise registry ya kirayanama) ki copy.
3. Naam badalna asal me connection ka malik badalna (name transfer) hota hai — iske liye vibhaag ka form aur kabhi-kabhi purane malik ki sahmati lagti hai.
4. Sudhaar ke baad aane wala bill naye naam se aayega — pehla bill jaanch kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank khate ka paisa dusre ke khate me galti se bhej diya, kya kare

Turant apne bank ko likhit soochna do — transaction number aur samay ke saath. Galti pakde jaane par bank dusre paksh se sampark karke paisa wapas karne ki prakriya karta hai. Jitni jaldi bataoge utni sambhavna zyada. Aage se number do baar jaanch kar hi paisa bhejo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
bank khate me nominee (varis) kaise jode ya badle

1. Shakha se nominee wala form (DA-1) lo ya internet banking me nominee wala hissa kholo.
2. Nominee ka naam, umar, aur tumse rishta bharo.
3. Form jama karte hi passbook/record me nominee darj ho jata hai — iski parchi le lo.
4. Nominee jodna bahut zaroori hai — khatedhar ke na rehne par parivaar ko paisa milne me aasani hoti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ek se zyada bank me khata rakhna sahi hai kya

Haan, rakh sakte ho — koi pabandi nahi. Bas har khate ka minimum balance aur KYC sambhalo, aur jis khate me sarkari paisa aana hai use Aadhaar se mapped rakho. Band pade khaato ko samay par band karna behtar hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport form me vartaman aur sthayi pata alag hai, dono ka verification hoga kya

Haan — jitne pate tum pichhle samay me rahe ho, un par verification ja sakta hai. Dono paton ke kagaz taiyaar rakho aur form me samay-avadhi sahi likho. Chhupane se report rukti hai, sach likhne se kaam aasan hota hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ki fees kitni hoti hai

Fees Passport ke prakar (aam/Tatkaal, page ki sankhya, umar) ke hisaab se badalti hai — portal par form bharte samay sahi rakam apne aap dikh jati hai. Kisi agent ko sarkari fees se zyada mat do; bhugtan hamesha portal par khud karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN status me 'discrepancy' dikh raha hai, matlab kya hai

Discrepancy matlab form ki jaankari aur kagaz me antar hai. Portal par kaaran saaf likha hota hai — wahi kagaz sahi karke dobara bhejo/upload karo. Kaaran padhe bina dobara wahi bhejne se phir wahi hoga.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye 10 saal purane pate par verification aayega kya

1. Form me pichhle 1 saal ke pate khaas taur par maange jate hain — usi avadhi ke paton par verification aam hai.
2. Usse purane pate form me likhne ki zaroorat aam taur par nahi hoti.
3. Vartaman pata 1 saal se kam purana ho to usse pehle wala pata bhi dena padta hai.
4. Jo bhi pata do, us samay ke kagaz (bill/kirayanama) ki copy taiyaar rakho.
bhaari gaadi (truck/bus) ka licence kaise banta hai

Pehle LMV licence par nishchit anubhav (aam taur par 1 saal) chahiye, phir HMV shreni ke liye aavedan, medical certificate aur RTO ka driving test hota hai. Commercial gaadi ke liye umar aur prashikshan ki shartein rajya ke hisaab se hoti hain — RTO se taaza jaankari lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
sarkari anaaj (ration) ki matra aur daam kahan jaanche

Rajya ke khadya vibhaag ke portal par aur dukaan par lagi soochi me matra-daam likhe hote hain. Parchi par bhi wahi chhapa hota hai — har baar mila kar dekho. Daam samay ke saath badalte hain, isliye taaza soochi hi sach hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN ke liye photo wala niyam kya hai (chashma, topi)

1. Photo me chehra saaf aur seedha dikhna chahiye — safed background rakho.
2. Aankhon par kaala chashma na ho; dharmik pehnaava pehchan chhupaye bina chal sakta hai.
3. Photo hal ki ho — bahut purani photo me chehra badal jane par jaanch me rukawat aati hai.
4. e-KYC wale aavedan me Aadhaar ki photo hi aa jati hai.
Jan Dhan khata kya hota hai, aam khate se kya farak hai

Jan Dhan (PMJDY) khata un logo ke liye hai jinka pehle koi bank khata nahi hai — iska mukhya farak ye hai ki isme nyuntam rakam (minimum balance) rakhne ki shart nahi hoti.
1. Khata kisi bhi bank shakha ya Bank Mitra (CSC/bank saathi) ke paas khulta hai.
2. Kagaz — Aadhaar aur photo; Aadhaar na ho to nirdhaarit kagazon se bhi chhota khata khul sakta hai, bank se jaankari lo.
3. Khate ke saath RuPay debit card milta hai aur sarkari yojanaon ka paisa seedha khate me aane ka rasta khulta hai.
4. Samanya bachat khate me bank ke hisaab se minimum balance rakhna pad sakta hai, Jan Dhan me ye shart nahi hai.
Dhyaan rahe — yojanaon ke fayde samay ke saath badalte hain, taaza jaankari bank se lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN card dusre ke naam par istemal ho raha hai aisa lage to kya kare

Income Tax portal par apne PAN se jude len-den (AIS/TIS jaankari) samay-samay par jaancho. Galat len-den dikhe to turant Income Tax ke helpline aur apne bank ko soochna do — samay par shikayat hi sabse badi suraksha hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form me galat file upload ho gayi, submit se pehle badal sakte hai kya

Haan — submit se pehle 'preview/remove' se file hata kar sahi file dobara lagayi ja sakti hai. Submit ke baad badlav correction window me hi hota hai, isliye submit wala button dabane se pehle har file ka preview dekhna sabse achhi aadat hai.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
online form ke liye photo ka size kaise theek kare (KB me badalna)

1. Pehle form ke nirdesh padho — wahan photo ka size (jaise 20-50 KB) aur nap (dimension) likha hota hai.
2. Photo ko phone ke photo editor ya kisi muft 'image compressor' upkaran se chhota karo — chehra saaf dikhna chahiye, zyada dabaane se photo dhundhli ho jati hai.
3. File ka naam aasan rakho (photo.jpg) aur format JPG hi rakho jaisa manga ho.
4. Upload ke baad preview me apni photo saaf dikhe tabhi aage badho — galat photo par form radd ho sakta hai.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
Aadhaar PVC card online order kaise kare

PVC card wahi Aadhaar hai, bas plastic card ke roop me post se ghar aata hai.
1. myAadhaar portal par 'Order Aadhaar PVC Card' wala vikalp kholo.
2. Apna Aadhaar number aur captcha bharo, mobile par aaya OTP dalo.
3. Naam, pata jaancho aur online fees ka bhugtan karo.
4. Ek SRN number milega — usse order ka status dekh sakte ho; card kuch din me post se aa jata hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
videsh jana hai, PAN ki zaroorat padegi kya
