4. Train me TTE se vinamrata se kahne par khaali berth ka badlav kabhi-kabhi ho jata hai — ye uski marzi hai, haq nahi.
do desho ki yatra ke liye Passport par khaali page kyun dekhe jate hai

Har desh entry/exit par mohar lagata hai aur visa ke liye khaali page chahiye hota hai. Page bhar jane par naya Passport (re-issue, 'pages exhausted') banwana padta hai — yatra se pehle khaali page gin lene ki aadat dalo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport banne me kitna samay lagta hai

1. Aam yojana me appointment ke baad kuch hafto me Passport aa jata hai — samay police verification ki gati par nirbhar karta hai.
2. Tatkaal me prakriya tez hoti hai, par kagazon ki shartein zyada hoti hain.
3. Har charan ka status portal par file number se dikhta hai — wahi jaanchte raho.
4. Der ho rahi ho to portal ke helpline/PSK me file number ke saath pucho.
Aadhaar sudhaar me kitna samay lagta hai

Aam taur par update 7-10 din me ho jata hai, kabhi-kabhi zyada samay bhi lag sakta hai. SRN/EID number se myAadhaar portal par status dekhte raho — wahi sabse pakki jaankari hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN card banne ka status kaise check kare

1. Jis portal (NSDL ya UTIITSL) se aavedan kiya tha, usi par 'Track PAN Status' wala vikalp kholo.
2. Aavedan ke samay mila 15 ank ka acknowledgment number dalo.
3. Wahan dikhega ki aavedan kis charan me hai — jaanch me hai, ban gaya hai ya post se bheja gaya hai.
4. Card dispatch ho jaye to post ki tracking jaankari bhi wahi mil jati hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Voter ID me photo bahut purani hai, badal sakte hain kya

Haan, photo bhi Form 8 se badli ja sakti hai.
1. Portal par Form 8 me photo badalne ka vikalp chuno.
2. Hal ki safed background wali passport size photo upload karo.
3. Aavedan jaanch ke baad manzoor hota hai aur nayi photo soochi me dikhne lagti hai.
4. Nayi photo wala card chahiye to replacement EPIC ka aavedan bhi saath me kar sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
train ticket cancel karni hai, refund kaise milega

1. IRCTC par login karke 'Booked Tickets' me apni ticket chuno aur 'Cancel' karo.
2. Radd karne ka shulk (cancellation charges) samay ke hisaab se kat-ta hai — train chalne se jitna pehle cancel karo, utna kam katauti.
3. Chart banne ke baad e-ticket aam taur par online cancel nahi hoti — uske liye TDR file karna padta hai, wo bhi nishchit samay ke andar.
4. Refund usi bank khate/card me aata hai jisse bhugtan hua tha — kuch din lag sakte hain.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Aadhaar me naam ek se zyada baar badal sakta hu kya

1. Naam, janm tithi jaise sudhaaron ki seema hoti hai — baar-baar nahi badalte.
2. Isliye pehli baar me hi bilkul sahi jaankari aur sahi kagaz lagao.
3. Seema khatm ho gayi ho to UIDAI ke kshetriya karyalay me vishesh aavedan ki prakriya hoti hai.
4. School ke kagaz ko mool mankar sab jagah ek naam final kar lo.
koi app sarkari kaam ke naam par paisa mang raha hai, kya kare

Pehle jaancho ki wo app sarkari hai bhi ya nahi — sarkari app ki jaankari vibhaag ki website par milti hai. Jin kaamo ki sarkari fees nahi hai, unke liye paisa mangne wala app fraud ho sakta hai — use uninstall karo aur Play Store par report karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
form ke liye documents ki PDF ek file me jodni hai (merge), kaise kare

1. Kai portal par har kagaz alag-alag manga jata hai — pehle nirdesh padho ki ek PDF chahiye ya alag file.
2. Ek PDF chahiye to phone ke scanner/PDF upkaran se sab page ek kram me jodo — pehla page wahi rakho jo manga gaya hai.
3. File ka size seema ke andar rakho — photo ko halka karke PDF banao.
4. Upload ke baad PDF khol kar khud dekho — page ulta ya kata hua to nahi hai.
railway ki shikayat (gandagi, paani, vyavhaar) kahan kare

RailMadad portal/app par PNR number ke saath shikayat darj hoti hai aur uska number milta hai — yatra ke dauran ki shikayat par train me hi madad milne ki koshish hoti hai. Helpline 139 par bhi shikayat aur jaankari milti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport par naam me sirf pehla naam hai, surname khaali hai — dikkat hogi kya

Kai logo ke kagaz me surname nahi hota — Passport usi hisaab se banta hai. Lekin videsh ke kuch formon me surname anivarya hota hai. Naam badalna ho to kagazon ke aadhar par 're-issue' me naam badalne ki prakriya hoti hai — pehle apne sabhi kagaz ek jaise kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ration card par photo nahi hai purani wali par, chalega kya

Purane card bhi chalte hain, lekin digital/e-ration card banwa lene se portability aur jaanch aasan ho jati hai. Portal se apna e-card download karke dekho — usme taaza jaankari dikhti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Driving Licence me pata badalna hai

1. Parivahan portal par DL sevaon me 'Change of Address' chuno.
2. Naye pate ka praman (Aadhaar me naya pata, bijli bill, kirayanama) upload karo.
3. Fees bhar kar aavedan bhejo — aavedan number se status dekho.
4. Naya pata darj hone ke baad chaaho to naya card (smart DL) bhi mangwa sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
PAN card shadi ke baad naam badalna hai (ladki ka surname)

1. NSDL/UTIITSL portal par correction form chuno aur naam wala hissa tick karo.
2. Naya naam bharo aur uska praman lagao — vivah praman patra ya ghoshna ke saath Aadhaar me badla naam.
3. Pehle Aadhaar me naam badal lena aasan rehta hai — phir wahi Aadhaar PAN sudhaar ka praman ban jata hai.
4. Sudhaar ke baad bank aur baaki jagah bhi naya naam update karwa lo.
dusri shakha/shahar me khata transfer kaise kare

1. Apni vartaman shakha me khata transfer ka aavedan do, ya nayi shakha me jaakar bhi prakriya shuru ho sakti hai.
2. Kai bank ab ye kaam internet banking se online bhi kar deti hain — IFSC aur nayi shakha ka naam sahi bharo.
3. Khata number wahi rehta hai, sirf shakha badalti hai; passbook nayi shakha se update karwa lo.
4. Transfer ke baad purani cheque book/ATM aam taur par chalte rehte hain — bank se pakka kar lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye single parent ke bacche ka aavedan kaise hoga

1. Portal par nabalig ke form me ek hi mata/pita ki jaankari dene ka vikalp hota hai.
2. Sthiti ke hisaab se kagaz lagte hain — jaise ek mata/pita ka ghoshna patra (Annexure) ya sambandhit praman.
3. Kendra par jaane se pehle portal ki kagaz-soochi me apni sthiti wala hissa dhyaan se padh lo.
4. Dusre mata/pita ki sahmati wala niyam sthiti ke hisaab se badalta hai — galat jaankari mat do, kendra ke adhikari sahi rasta batate hain.
licence test ke liye apni gaadi nahi hai, kya hoga

1. Test ke liye usi shreni ki gaadi chahiye jo licence ke liye hai — parichit/driving school se gaadi ki vyavastha ho sakti hai.
2. Driving school se seekhne par ve aksar test wale din gaadi aur prakriya me madad karte hain.
3. Gaadi ke kagaz (RC, beema, PUC) test wale din saath rakho — adhikari maang sakta hai.
4. Gaadi kisi aur ke naam ho to bhi chalti hai, bas kagaz pure hon.
PAN ko Aadhaar se link karna hai, kaise kare

1. Income Tax ke e-filing portal par 'Link Aadhaar' wala vikalp kholo — login kiye bina bhi ye suvidha milti hai.
2. Apna PAN number aur Aadhaar number bharo.
3. Dono par likha naam aur janm tithi milni chahiye — antar hai to pehle kisi ek me sudhaar karwao.
4. Mobile par aaye OTP se pushti karo; link ho jane ka sandesh aa jayega.
5. Status bhi usi portal par 'Link Aadhaar Status' se dekh sakte ho.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Voter ID aur Aadhaar ka naam alag hai, vote dalne me dikkat hogi kya

Vote naam soochi me hone par dalta hai — booth par pehchan ke liye kai kagaz chalte hain (Aadhaar, PAN, DL aadi). Lekin aage ki dikkaton se bachne ke liye dono ka naam ek jaisa karwa lo — jis kagaz me galti hai usme sudhaar karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye ECR/ECNR kya hota hai

Passport par ECR (Emigration Check Required) un par lagta hai jinki shiksha nishchit star (aam taur par 10vi paas) se kam ho — kuch desho me naukri ke liye jane par iski jaanch hoti hai. 10vi paas ke kagaz lagane par ECNR shreni banti hai. Apni sthiti portal ki kagaz-soochi se pakki karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
CSC par form bharwaya tha, aavedan number kho gaya — status kaise dekhe

CSC se mili parchi par number hota hai; parchi kho gayi ho to usi CSC par jaakar apne mobile number/Aadhaar se record nikalwa sakte ho. Aage se har parchi ki photo phone me le lene ki aadat dalo.
Agar ghar par internet/computer nahi hai to nazdeeki CSC (Common Service Centre) kendra par jaakar ye kaam thodi si seva-fees ke saath karwa sakte ho.
paani ka connection naye ghar ke liye kaise le

Nagar nigam/jal vibhaag me naya connection ka aavedan hota hai — ghar ke kagaz, pehchan patra aur kabhi-kabhi pichhle malik ka 'no dues' praman lagta hai. Jaanch ke baad connection aur meter lagta hai; har bhugtan ki sarkari parchi lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
Passport ke liye kya-kya kagaz chahiye

Aam taur par ye kagaz lagte hain:
1. Pate ka praman — Aadhaar, Voter ID, bijli/paani bill, bank passbook me se (vartaman pate wala).
2. Janm tithi ka praman — janm praman patra, 10vi ki marksheet, PAN ya Aadhaar.
3. Agar pichhle 1 saal me pata badla hai to purane pate ka praman bhi manga ja sakta hai.
4. Sarkari naukri walo ko apne vibhaag se anumati (NOC) bhi lagti hai.
Dhyaan do — kendra par asli kagaz ke saath unki ek-ek photocopy bhi lekar jani hoti hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
naam badalne ke baad purana PAN number chalega kya

Haan — PAN number jeevan bhar wahi rehta hai, sirf naam/jaankari badalti hai. Naya card usi number ke saath banta hai.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
ATM se paisa kata par nikla nahi, kya kare

Parchi/screen ka photo le lo aur turant bank ke helpline par shikayat karo — aisi rakam aam taur par kuch dino me apne aap wapas aa jati hai. Samay par na aaye to shikayat number ke saath shakha me likhit aavedan do. ATM ke andar kisi anjaan ki 'madad' kabhi mat lo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
galat train me chadh gaya, ab kya kare

Turant agle station par utar jao aur TTE/station master ko apni sthiti batao. Bina sahi ticket ke yatra jurmane ke dayre me hai — chhupne ki koshish mat karo. Sahi train ke liye station se nayi vyavastha karo.
Note: Fees aur niyam samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye aakhri jaankari ke liye sarkari website ya nazdeeki karyalay par taaza jaankari jaanch lo.
online form ke liye kagaz scan kaise kare phone se

Database kya hota hai simple bhasha me batao

Database matlab jaankari ko vyavasthit tareeke se rakhne ki jagah — jaise ek badi digital register.

Farak sirf itna hai: register me dhundhna dheere hota hai, database me computer lakhon records me se chahiye wala hissa ek pal me nikaal deta hai.

Example: school ke 5,000 students ka naam, umar, kaksha — ye sab ek database me rehta hai. Bank, WhatsApp, dukaan ke apps — sab peeche database hi use karte hain.
SQL kya hai aur ye kyun seekhna chahiye

SQL (Structured Query Language) wo bhasha hai jisse hum database se baat karte hain — data daalna, nikaalna, badalna, mitana.

Kyun seekhna chahiye:
1. Har app/website ke peeche database hota hai
2. Data wali har naukri me SQL sabse pehle manga jata hai
3. Seekhna aasan hai — English jaise chhote commands hote hain: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE

Jaise Hindi se hum insaan se baat karte hain, waise SQL se database se.
Table kya hota hai database me

Table database ka wo hissa hai jisme data pankti (row) aur stambh (column) me rakha jata hai — bilkul Excel sheet jaisa.

Example — students table:
- Column: id, naam, umar, kaksha (har column ek prakar ki jaankari)
- Row: ek student ki poori jaankari (1, Rahul, 14, 9)

Ek database me kai tables ho sakte hain — students, teachers, fees — sab alag-alag, zaroorat par jude hue.
Row aur column me kya farak hai database me

Column (stambh) = ek prakar ki jaankari, khada (vertical). Jaise 'naam' column me sabke naam, 'umar' column me sabki umar.

Row (pankti) = ek record ki poori jaankari, leti hui (horizontal). Jaise ek student: 1 | Rahul | 14 | 9

Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: column = sawal (kya jaanna hai), row = ek vyakti/cheez ka pura jawab.
Database aur Excel me kya farak hai

Dono me data table jaisa dikhta hai, par kaam alag hai:

**Excel:** chhote data ke liye, hisaab-kitab aur chart ke liye best. Ek samay par aam taur par ek hi aadmi kaam karta hai.

**Database (SQL):** lakhon-croreon records, ek saath hazaron log (jaise bank app ke saare graahak), aur data aapas me juda hua (graahak ↔ uske orders).

Saral shabdon me: Excel ek register hai, database ek poora record-room jisme computer pal bhar me kuch bhi dhundh deta hai.
SQL aur MySQL me kya farak hai

SQL ek **bhasha** hai, MySQL ek **software** hai.

Misaal: Hindi ek bhasha hai, aur radio ek saadhan hai jispar Hindi boli jati hai.

- SQL = database se baat karne ki bhasha (SELECT, INSERT...)
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite = wo software jo is bhasha ko samajhkar data rakhte hain

Achhi baat: SQL ek baar seekh lo, to teeno software me lagbhag waisi hi chalti hai.
Database kahan kahan kaam aata hai roz ki zindagi me

Lagbhag har digital cheez ke peeche database hai:

- **Bank:** tumhara khaata, balance, len-den
- **School:** students, fees, result, hajiri
- **Dukaan:** saaman ka stock, graahak, bill, udhaar
- **Railway:** ticket booking, seat khaali hai ya nahi
- **WhatsApp/Instagram:** tumhare dost, message, photo ki jaankari
- **Hospital:** mareez, dawa, report

Jahan bhi bahut saari jaankari surakshit rakhni aur jaldi dhundhni ho — wahan database.
Primary key kya hoti hai database me

Primary key table ka wo column hai jo **har row ko alag pehchan** deta hai — kisi do rows ki primary key ek jaisi nahi ho sakti, aur ye khaali bhi nahi reh sakti.

Example: students table me `id` — do students ka naam ek ho sakta hai (do Rahul), par id kabhi ek nahi hoga.

```sql
CREATE TABLE students (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  naam VARCHAR(50),
  umar INT
);
```

Misaal: jaise Aadhaar number — har aadmi ka alag, yahi database ki primary key jaisa hai.
Database me data surakshit kaise rehta hai copy se

Database data ko file me is tareeke se rakhta hai ki:

1. Ek saath kai log kaam karein to data aapas me takrata nahi
2. Bijli chali jaye to bhi likha hua data mit-ta nahi (ye disk par save hota hai)
3. Galti se aadha kaam ho to poora kaam wapas liya ja sakta hai (ise transaction kehte hain)

Isi liye bank jaise kaam kagaz ya Excel par nahi, database par chalte hain.
NULL matlab kya hota hai SQL me

NULL matlab **jaankari hai hi nahi** — ye 0 bhi nahi hai aur khaali '' bhi nahi hai.

Example: kisi graahak ka email abhi pata nahi — to email wale column me NULL rahega.

Dhyan do:
```sql
-- galat tareeka
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE email = NULL;

-- sahi tareeka
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE email IS NULL;
```

NULL ko check karne ke liye hamesha IS NULL ya IS NOT NULL likhte hain, = nahi.
SQL seekhne ke liye pehle kya aana chahiye

SQL ke liye zyada kuch pehle se aana zaroori nahi — ye sabse aasan bhashaon me se ek hai.

Bas ye samajh lo:
1. Table, row, column kya hai
2. Thodi si English (SELECT = chuno, WHERE = jahan, ORDER = kram)

Pehle ye 4 commands pakke kar lo — SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE — database ka 80% kaam inhi se hota hai. Baaki GROUP BY, JOIN dheere-dheere aa jayega.
Ek database me kitne table ho sakte hain

Koi pakki seema nahi — ek database me dason, sauon, hazaron tables ho sakte hain.

Har kaam ke liye alag table banana sahi tareeka hai:
- School: students, teachers, fees, hajiri — 4 alag table
- Dukaan: saaman, graahak, bill, udhaar — 4 alag table

Sab kuch ek hi table me bharna galat hai — data dohra hota hai aur dhundhna mushkil. Alag table baad me JOIN se jude jate hain.
Data type kya hota hai SQL me VARCHAR aur INT

Data type batata hai ki column me **kis prakar ka data** aayega:

- `INT` — poora number: umar, daam, ginti (14, 500)
- `VARCHAR(50)` — akshar wala data: naam, sheher — 50 matlab zyada se zyada 50 akshar
- `DECIMAL(8,2)` — dashamlav wala paisa: 499.50
- `DATE` — tareekh: 2026-01-15

Sahi type chunna zaroori hai — umar ko VARCHAR me rakhoge to uspar hisaab (jod, ausat) nahi chalega.
SQL me command bade aksharon me kyun likhte hain

SQL ke commands (SELECT, FROM, WHERE) bade aksharon me likhna ek **aadat/parampara** hai, majboori nahi.

```sql
select * from students;   -- ye bhi chalega
SELECT * FROM students;   -- ye padhne me saaf hai
```

Bade akshar isliye likhte hain taaki command aur table/column ke naam alag-alag saaf dikhen. Computer ke liye dono barabar hain, insaan ke padhne ke liye dusra wala behtar hai.

```sql
CREATE TABLE students (
  id INT,
  naam VARCHAR(50),
  umar INT,
  kaksha INT,
```

Samjho:
- `CREATE TABLE students` — is naam ka naya table banao
- Har line ek column hai: pehle column ka naam, phir uska type (id, naam, umar, kaksha, sheher)
- `VARCHAR(50)` matlab akshar wala data, zyada se zyada 50 akshar; `INT` matlab poora number

Har row ek fees-jama ki entry hogi — kis student ne, kis mahine ki, kitni rakam, kis tareekh ko di. Baad me SELECT se kisi bhi mahine ka kul hisaab nikaal sakte ho.
Table banate samay dhyan dene wali baatein batao SQL me

Table banate samay ye 5 baatein yaad rakho:

1. **Naam saaf rakho** — `students`, `saaman` jaise; beech me space nahi, underscore (_) chalega
2. **Har table me id** — `id INT PRIMARY KEY` taaki har row ki alag pehchan ho
3. **Sahi type chuno** — number ke liye INT, naam ke liye VARCHAR, tareekh ke liye DATE
4. **VARCHAR ki lambai** kaam ke hisaab se — naam ke liye 50 kaafi, mobile ke liye 15
5. **Semicolon** query ke aakhir me zaroor lagao
Agar table pehle se bana ho to CREATE TABLE par kya hoga

Agar usi naam ka table pehle se hai, to `CREATE TABLE` error dega — 'table already exists'. Purana data safe rehta hai, naya table nahi banta.

Is error se bachne ke liye:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  naam VARCHAR(50)
);
```

`IF NOT EXISTS` ka matlab — table hai to chhod do, nahi hai to bana do. Program chalate samay ye bahut kaam aata hai.

```sql
SELECT * FROM students;
```

- `SELECT` matlab 'chuno/dikhao'
- `*` matlab saare column
- `FROM students` matlab students table se

Ye SQL ki sabse zyada use hone wali query hai — pehle yahi pakki karo.
Sirf students ke naam aur umar dekhni hai poora table nahi

Sirf chahiye wale column ke naam likho, `*` ki jagah:

```sql
SELECT naam, umar FROM students;
```

Sirf naam aur umar wala hissa dikhega — id, kaksha, sheher nahi. Bade table me yahi tareeka tez aur saaf rehta hai: jo chahiye, bas wahi mango.
Saaman table me sirf naam aur daam dikhao

```sql
SELECT naam, daam FROM saaman;
```

Column ke beech comma (,) lagta hai. Graahak ko rate list dikhani ho to yahi query kaam aayegi — stock wala column chhup jayega.
SELECT * ka matlab kya hai SQL me

`*` ka matlab hai **saare column**.

```sql
SELECT * FROM students;
```

Ye query students table ke saare column (id, naam, umar, kaksha, sheher) aur saari rows dikha degi.

Chhote table me theek hai, par bade table (lakhon rows) me bina soche `SELECT *` chalana dheere pad sakta hai — jo column chahiye wahi likhna achhi aadat hai.
Kisi ek student ka data uske id se kaise nikale

Ek khaas row ke liye `WHERE` lagao:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE id = 5;
```

`WHERE id = 5` ka matlab — sirf wahi row dikhao jiska id 5 hai. Id har student ka alag hota hai (primary key), isliye bilkul ek hi row milegi. Bank me khaata number se ek graahak nikaalna bhi aise hi hota hai.
Teachers ke naam aur vishay dekhne ki query likho

```sql
SELECT naam, vishay FROM teachers;
```

Har teacher ka naam uske vishay ke saath dikhega. Agar sirf naam chahiye to `SELECT naam FROM teachers;` — column jitne kam, jawab utna saaf.
Graahak table se saare graahako ke naam aur mobile dikhao

```sql
SELECT naam, mobile FROM graahak;
```

Dukaan par call/message karne ke liye naam-mobile ki list chahiye hoti hai — yahi query wo list degi, baaki jaankari (sheher aadi) nahi dikhegi.
Table me kul kitni rows hai ye sirf ginati kaise pata kare

Ginati ke liye `COUNT(*)`:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students;
```

Jawab me sirf ek number aayega — jaise 450 — matlab table me kul 450 rows (students) hain. Poora data khiche bina ginati mil jati hai.
SELECT query ka sahi kram kya hota hai likhne ka

SELECT query ke hisse is kram me likhe jate hain:

```sql
SELECT naam, umar      -- kya dikhana hai
FROM students          -- kis table se
WHERE kaksha = 9       -- kaun si rows (shart)
ORDER BY umar;         -- kis kram me
```

Kram ulta-pulta karoge to error aayega. Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: pehle 'kya', phir 'kahan se', phir 'kaun se', phir 'kis kram me'.
Sirf kaksha 9 ke students dekhne hai query batao

```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE kaksha = 9;
```

`WHERE` shart lagata hai — sirf wahi rows aayengi jo shart puri karein. Yahan sirf kaksha 9 wale students dikhenge, baaki nahi.
Delhi ke saare graahak kaise nikale SQL me

```sql
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE sheher = 'Delhi';
```

Dhyan do — 'Delhi' akshar wala data hai, isliye '' (single quote) me likha hai. Number wali shart me quote nahi lagta (jaise `WHERE kaksha = 9`), akshar wali me lagta hai — ye sabse aam galti hai.
100 rupaye se mehenga saaman dhundho SQL query

```sql
SELECT * FROM saaman WHERE daam > 100;
```

`>` ka matlab 'se bada'. Aise hi:
- `<` — se chhota (daam < 100)
- `>=` — bada ya barabar
- `<=` — chhota ya barabar
- `=` — bilkul barabar
- `<>` ya `!=` — barabar nahi
Umar 15 se zyada wale students ki query likho

```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE umar > 15;
```

Sirf wahi students aayenge jinki umar 15 se zyada hai. Agar '15 ya usse zyada' chahiye to `>=` lagao: `WHERE umar >= 15` — ek chhota sa farak, par jawab badal jata hai.
Maths padhane wale teachers kaise dhundhe SQL me

```sql
SELECT * FROM teachers WHERE vishay = 'Maths';
```

Vishay akshar wala column hai, isliye 'Maths' ko '' me likha. Spelling bilkul waisi honi chahiye jaisi data me hai — 'maths' aur 'Maths' ko kuch database alag mante hain.
Do shart ek saath lagani hai kaksha 9 aur Delhi dono

Do shartein `AND` se jodte hain — dono sach honi chahiye:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students
WHERE kaksha = 9 AND sheher = 'Delhi';
```

Sirf wahi students aayenge jo kaksha 9 me bhi hain AUR Delhi ke bhi hain.

Agar `OR` lagao to dono me se **ek bhi** sach ho to row aa jayegi — AND sakht hai, OR dheela.
Kaksha 9 ya kaksha 10 dono ke students chahiye query

```sql
SELECT * FROM students
WHERE kaksha = 9 OR kaksha = 10;
```

`OR` matlab dono me se ek bhi shart mile to row le aao.

Yahi kaam chhota karke aise bhi likh sakte ho:
```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE kaksha IN (9, 10);
```

`IN` ka matlab — is list me se koi bhi ho.
Jinka naam R se shuru hota hai wo students kaise nikale

Naam ke hisse se dhundhne ke liye `LIKE` aur `%`:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE naam LIKE 'R%';
```

- `LIKE` — milta-julta dhundho
- `%` — iske baad kuch bhi chalega
- `'R%'` — R se shuru hone wala koi bhi naam (Rahul, Rohit, Rekha...)

Agar beech me dhundhna ho to `'%esh%'` — jisme beech me 'esh' aaye (Suresh, Mahesh).
Stock khatm wala saaman dhundhna hai SQL me

```sql
SELECT * FROM saaman WHERE stock = 0;
```

Jis saaman ka stock 0 hai — wahi khatm wala hai. Dukaan par roz ye query chalao to pata chal jayega kya mangwana hai. Agar 'khatm hone wala' (5 se kam) chahiye to `WHERE stock < 5`.
Tankhwah 20000 se kam wale karmachari ki list do SQL se

```sql
SELECT naam, tankhwah FROM karmachari WHERE tankhwah < 20000;
```

Sirf naam aur tankhwah dikhaye hain — poora table nahi. Aisi hi shartein salary, fees, number har jagah lagti hain: column, nishaan (<, >, =), aur value.
Do tareekhon ke beech ka data kaise nikale SQL me

Tareekh ki do shartein AND se jodo:

```sql
SELECT * FROM bill
WHERE tareekh >= '2026-11-01' AND tareekh <= '2026-11-30';
```

Ye November 2026 ke saare bill de dega. Tareekh hamesha '' me aur YYYY-MM-DD kram me likhi jati hai — pehle saal, phir mahina, phir din.
Jinka sheher Delhi nahi hai wo graahak chahiye

```sql
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE sheher <> 'Delhi';
```

`<>` ka matlab 'barabar nahi'. `!=` bhi yahi kaam karta hai:
```sql
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE sheher != 'Delhi';
```

Delhi ke alawa saare shehron ke graahak aa jayenge.
Students ko naam ke ABC kram me dikhao SQL query

```sql
SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY naam;
```

`ORDER BY` data ko kram me lagata hai. Naam ke aage peeche `ASC` (chhota se bada, A→Z) apne aap mana jata hai.

Ulta kram (Z→A) chahiye to:
```sql
SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY naam DESC;
```
Sabse mehenga saaman sabse upar dikhana hai query do

Daam ke ghate kram (bada se chhota) me lagao:

```sql
SELECT * FROM saaman ORDER BY daam DESC;
```

`DESC` = descending = bada pehle. Sabse mehenga saaman pehli row me hoga. Sirf sabse mehenga ek hi chahiye to aakhir me `LIMIT 1` jod do.
Sirf pehle 5 students dekhne hai LIMIT kaise lagega

```sql
SELECT * FROM students LIMIT 5;
```

`LIMIT` batata hai kitni rows chahiye — chahe table me 5000 rows ho, sirf pehli 5 aayengi.

Khaas kaam: sabse bade 3 number wale students —
```sql
SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY umar DESC LIMIT 3;
```

Pehle kram lagao, phir ginti rok do — ye jodi bahut kaam aati hai.
Sabse zyada tankhwah wale 3 teacher dhundho SQL me

```sql
SELECT naam, tankhwah FROM teachers
ORDER BY tankhwah DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

- `ORDER BY tankhwah DESC` — tankhwah badi se chhoti ki taraf
- `LIMIT 3` — bas pehli 3 rows

Yahi tareeka 'top 3 mehenga saaman', 'top 5 number wale bacche' har jagah chalega — bas column badal do.
Sasta saaman pehle dikhana hai ORDER BY kaise kare

```sql
SELECT naam, daam FROM saaman ORDER BY daam;
```

`ORDER BY daam` apne aap ASC (chhota se bada) hota hai — sabse sasta pehle. `ASC` likhna zaroori nahi, par likh bhi sakte ho: `ORDER BY daam ASC`.

Rate list graahak ko bhejni ho to yahi kram sabse samajh aata hai.
Do column se sort karna hai pehle kaksha phir naam

Do column comma se likho — pehle pehle wale se, phir dusre se kram lagega:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY kaksha, naam;
```

Pehle kaksha 6, 7, 8... ke group banenge, har kaksha ke andar naam A→Z. Result sheet aur hajiri register me yahi kram chalta hai.
Aakhri jama hue 10 bill dekhne hai sabse naye pehle

Naye bill pehle matlab bill_no ya tareekh ke ulte kram me:

```sql
SELECT * FROM bill ORDER BY bill_no DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Sabse bada bill_no = sabse naya bill. `LIMIT 10` se sirf 10 hi aayenge — poori dukaan ka purana hisaab nahi khulega.
ORDER BY aur WHERE ek saath kaise likhe kaksha 9 ke naam kram me

Dono ka kram pakka hai — pehle WHERE, phir ORDER BY:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students
WHERE kaksha = 9
ORDER BY naam;
```

Pehle kaksha 9 wale chune jayenge, phir unke naam A→Z lag jayenge. Kram ulta likhoge to error aayega — hamesha SELECT → FROM → WHERE → ORDER BY.
Ek student ki umar galat hai sahi karne ki query do SQL me

Data badalne ke liye `UPDATE`:

```sql
UPDATE students SET umar = 15 WHERE id = 3;
```

- `UPDATE students` — is table me badlaav
- `SET umar = 15` — umar ko 15 kar do
- `WHERE id = 3` — **sirf** id 3 wale student ka

⚠️ WHERE lagana sabse zaroori hai — aage iski chetaavni wala example zaroor samjho.
Saaman ka daam badalna hai SQL query likho

```sql
UPDATE saaman SET daam = 500 WHERE id = 2;
```

id 2 wale saaman ka daam 500 ho jayega, baaki saaman waise ka waisa.

Agar kisi khaas naam se badalna ho to `WHERE naam = 'Chawal 5kg'` bhi chalega — par id se badalna sabse surakshit hai, naam do logo ke ek ho sakte hain.
⚠️ UPDATE me WHERE bhool jaye to kya hoga SQL me

Ye SQL ki **sabse badi galti** hai:

```sql
UPDATE students SET kaksha = 10;
-- WHERE hi nahi hai!
```

Isse **table ke SAARE students** kaksha 10 ke ho jayenge — ek bhi nahi bachega. Aur ye badlaav turant pakka ho jata hai, undo ka button nahi hota.

Niyam bana lo: UPDATE ya DELETE likhte hi sabse pehle WHERE likho, phir SET. Pehle wahi shart SELECT karke dekh lo ki sahi rows chun rahi hai ya nahi.
Ek student ka record mitana hai DELETE query do

```sql
DELETE FROM students WHERE id = 7;
```

- `DELETE FROM students` — is table se mitao
- `WHERE id = 7` — sirf id 7 wala

⚠️ UPDATE ki tarah yahan bhi WHERE bhoolna matlab **poora table khaali**. Mita hua data wapas nahi aata — pehle soch kar, phir chalao.
Galti se poora table khali ho jaye DELETE se to data wapas aayega

Seedha jawab — **aam taur par nahi aayega.** Bina WHERE wala DELETE saari rows mita deta hai aur ye pakka (permanent) hota hai.

Bachne ke tareeke:
1. DELETE se pehle wahi WHERE lagakar SELECT chalao — jo rows dikhengi, wahi mitengi
2. Zaroori data ka backup rakho
3. Pehle ek row par aazmao

Isi liye badi companiyon me DELETE chalane se pehle khaas anumati leni padti hai.
Graahak ka mobile number badalna hai SQL me

```sql
UPDATE graahak SET mobile = '9000000001' WHERE id = 4;
```

Mobile akshar wala (VARCHAR) data hai isliye '' me likha. `WHERE id = 4` se sirf usi graahak ka number badlega — agar WHERE ki jagah naam likho aur do graahak ek naam ke ho, to dono ka badal jayega; isliye id hi surakshit hai.
Stock me 10 packet aur jodne hai UPDATE kaise kare

Purane stock me jodna hai to column ka naam hi istemal karo:

```sql
UPDATE saaman SET stock = stock + 10 WHERE id = 1;
```

`stock + 10` ka matlab — jo stock abhi hai, usme 10 aur. Agar seedha `SET stock = 10` likh diya to purana stock mitkar sirf 10 reh jayega — farak samajh lo, dukaan me yahi galti sabse zyada hoti hai.
Saare saaman ka daam 10 pratishat badhana hai ek query me

Jab badlaav jaan-boojh kar sab par karna ho, tab WHERE nahi lagta:

```sql
UPDATE saaman SET daam = daam * 1.10;
```

Har saaman ka daam uske purane daam ka 110% ho jayega. ⚠️ Par ye kadam soch kar lo — pehle SELECT se daam dekh lo, aur ho sake to pehle ek saaman par aazmao. Ek baar chal gaya to purane daam wapas nahi milenge.
UPDATE aur DELETE me kya farak hai SQL me

**UPDATE** — row rehti hai, uske andar ka data badalta hai.
```sql
UPDATE students SET umar = 15 WHERE id = 3;
```

**DELETE** — poori row hi mit jati hai.
```sql
DELETE FROM students WHERE id = 3;
```

Misaal: register me naam ke aage umar sudharna = UPDATE; poori line kaat kar hata dena = DELETE.

Ek aur hai — `TRUNCATE` poora table ek saath khali karta hai, par shuru me usse door hi raho.
Ek teacher ka vishay badalkar Science karna hai query

```sql
UPDATE teachers SET vishay = 'Science' WHERE id = 2;
```

Vishay akshar wala data hai — 'Science' '' me. Badlaav sirf id 2 wale teacher ka hoga. Badalne ke baad jaanch ke liye `SELECT * FROM teachers WHERE id = 2;` chala kar dekh lo.
Kaksha 9 me kul kitne students hai ginati kaise nikale

Shart ke saath ginati:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE kaksha = 9;
```

`COUNT(*)` rows ginta hai, `WHERE` usi ginati ko kaksha 9 tak rok deta hai. Jawab ek number aayega — jaise 42.
Dukaan ke saaman ka kul stock kitna hai jod kaise nikale

Kul jod ke liye `SUM`:

```sql
SELECT SUM(stock) FROM saaman;
```

Saare saaman ke stock jud kar ek number aayega. Isi tarah `SUM(daam)` se saaman ki kul keemat, `SUM(rakam)` se fees ka kul — column badal do, tareeka wahi.
Students ki ausat umar kaise nikale SQL me

Ausat ke liye `AVG`:

```sql
SELECT AVG(umar) FROM students;
```

Saari umar judkar kul students se bhaag — wahi kaam ek shabd me. Result dashamlav me aa sakta hai, jaise 13.6. Number wale column par hi AVG chalega, naam par nahi.
Sabse mehenga aur sabse sasta saaman ek query me kaise pata kare

Sabse bada ke liye `MAX`, sabse chhota ke liye `MIN`:

```sql
SELECT MAX(daam) AS sabse_mehenga, MIN(daam) AS sabse_sasta
FROM saaman;
```

`AS` se column ko apna naam diya hai taaki jawab saaf dikhe. Dhyan do — ye sirf daam batayega, saaman ka naam nahi; naam chahiye to ORDER BY + LIMIT wala tareeka lagta hai.
Har kaksha me kitne students hai alag alag ginati GROUP BY

Har kaksha ki alag ginati ke liye `GROUP BY`:

```sql
SELECT kaksha, COUNT(*) AS kul_students
FROM students
GROUP BY kaksha;
```

Jawab aisa aayega:
```
kaksha | kul_students
6      | 40
7      | 38
8      | 45
```

`GROUP BY kaksha` matlab — kaksha ke hisaab se samooh banao, phir har samooh ko gino. Yahi SQL ki sabse kaam ki kala hai.
Har sheher se kitne graahak hai ye report kaise banaye

```sql
SELECT sheher, COUNT(*) AS graahak_ginti
FROM graahak
GROUP BY sheher;
```

Har sheher ke aage uske graahako ki ginti aa jayegi — Delhi 120, Mumbai 85... Dukaan wala isi report se samajhta hai ki uske graahak kahan se zyada hain.
Har kaksha ki ausat umar alag alag chahiye SQL query

GROUP BY ke saath AVG:

```sql
SELECT kaksha, AVG(umar) AS ausat_umar
FROM students
GROUP BY kaksha;
```

Har kaksha ki ausat umar alag line me milegi. Tareeka yaad rakho: jo column GROUP BY me hai wahi SELECT me aayega, saath me COUNT/SUM/AVG jaisi ginati wali cheez.
Ek din ki kul bikri kitni hui bill table se kaise nikale

```sql
SELECT SUM(kul_daam) AS kul_bikri
FROM bill
WHERE tareekh = '2026-11-22';
```

Us din ke saare billo ki rakam jud jayegi. Mahine bhar ki bikri chahiye to tareekh ki jagah do shartein (mahine ki pehli aur aakhri tareekh) laga do.
Har vishay ke kitne teacher hai ginati batao SQL se

```sql
SELECT vishay, COUNT(*) AS teacher_ginti
FROM teachers
GROUP BY vishay;
```

Maths ke 4, Hindi ke 3, Science ke 5 — vishay ke hisaab se report taiyaar. Principal ko yahi report sabse zyada chahiye hoti hai.
COUNT SUM AVG ye teen SQL me kya karte hai fark batao

Teeno ginati-jod wale kaam hain, kaam alag:

- `COUNT(*)` — **kitni** rows hain (ginati): 50 students
- `SUM(daam)` — sab ka **kul jod**: saaman ki kul keemat 12,500
- `AVG(umar)` — sab ka **ausat**: ausat umar 13.5

Yaad karne ko: COUNT = kitne, SUM = kul kitna, AVG = ausat kitna. Teeno aksar GROUP BY ke saath milkar report banate hain.
Jin kakshaon me 40 se zyada students hai sirf wahi dikhao

Samooh par shart lagane ke liye `HAVING` (WHERE samooh par nahi chalta):

```sql
SELECT kaksha, COUNT(*) AS kul
FROM students
GROUP BY kaksha
HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;
```

- `WHERE` — row chunne ke liye (samooh banne se pehle)
- `HAVING` — samooh chunne ke liye (ginati ke baad)

Sirf wahi kaksha dikhengi jinme 40 se zyada bacche hain.
Mahine bhar ki fees kul kitni jama hui SUM se nikalo

```sql
SELECT SUM(rakam) AS kul_fees
FROM fees
WHERE mahina = 'November';
```

November ki saari fees entries jud jayengi. Agar saal ke har mahine ka alag hisaab chahiye to `GROUP BY mahina` laga do — 12 line ki saaf report ban jayegi.
JOIN kya hota hai SQL me simple bhasha me samjhao

JOIN matlab **do table ko jodkar** ek saath data nikaalna.

Kyun chahiye? School me student ka naam `students` table me hai, par uski fees `fees` table me — dono ek saath dekhne ke liye JOIN.

Dono table kisi ek jude hue column se bandhe hote hain — jaise student ka id.

```sql
SELECT students.naam, fees.rakam
FROM students
JOIN fees ON students.id = fees.student_id;
```

`ON` ke baad wo shart hai jo batati hai kaunsi row kis se judegi.
Students aur fees dono table se naam aur rakam ek saath dikhao

```sql
SELECT students.naam, fees.mahina, fees.rakam
FROM students
JOIN fees ON students.id = fees.student_id;
```

- Column se pehle table ka naam aur dot (.) — `students.naam` — taaki saaf rahe column kis table ka hai
- `ON students.id = fees.student_id` — fees wali row usi student ki hai jiska id barabar hai

Jawab me har fees entry ke saath student ka naam dikhega, sirf number nahi.
Graahak aur uske bill ek saath dekhne ki JOIN query do

```sql
SELECT graahak.naam, bill.saaman, bill.kul_daam
FROM graahak
JOIN bill ON graahak.id = bill.graahak_id;
```

Bill table me sirf graahak_id (number) rakha tha — JOIN ne us number ko asli naam me badal diya. Asal apps me har jagah yahi hota hai: data alag table me, dikhata jodkar hai.
JOIN me ON ka kya kaam hai SQL me

`ON` JOIN ki **jodne wali shart** hai — ye batata hai pehle table ki kaunsi row dusre table ki kis row se judegi.

```sql
JOIN fees ON students.id = fees.student_id
```

Matlab: fees ki wo row is student ke saath lagao jahan fees.student_id aur students.id barabar ho.

Agar ON galat likho to galat jod banega — naam kisi ka, fees kisi aur ki. Isliye ON hamesha pehchan wale column (id) par lagta hai.
Data alag alag table me kyun rakhte hai ek me kyun nahi

Ek hi table me sab rakhne se teen dikkat:

1. **Dohrana** — har fees entry ke saath student ka naam, sheher baar-baar likhna padega
2. **Galti ka darr** — ek jagah naam badla, dusri jagah purana reh gaya
3. **Jagah aur dheere** — table phool jata hai

Isliye: student ki jaankari ek baar `students` me, fees alag `fees` me — aur zaroorat par JOIN se jod liya. Isi ko database ki achhi design kehte hain.
SQL me semicolon bhool jaye to kya hota hai

Har query ke aakhir me `;` (semicolon) lagta hai — ye batata hai query yahan khatm.

Bhool jao to:
- Ek query me aksar chal bhi jata hai (kuch tool khud samajh lete hain)
- Par do query ek saath chalao to bina `;` ke dono aapas me jud jayengi aur error aayega

Aadat bana lo — query khatm, semicolon pakka. Jaise vaakya ke aakhir me poorna viraam.
SQL me '' aur "" me kya farak hai single double quote

SQL me akshar wala data (string) **single quote ''** me likha jata hai:

```sql
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE naam = 'Rahul';   -- sahi
SELECT * FROM graahak WHERE naam = "Rahul";   -- aksar galat
```

Double quote "" aam taur par column/table ke naam ke liye mana jata hai, data ke liye nahi. Kai jagah "Rahul" chalane par error ya khaali jawab milta hai.

Niyam: data = hamesha '' , number = bina quote ke.
Query me table ke naam ki spelling galti ho to kya hoga

Database spelling bilkul waisi hi dhundhta hai jaisi table banate samay rakhi thi.

```sql
SELECT * FROM student;   -- agar table ka naam 'students' hai to error
```

Error aayega: 'table does not exist' jaisa. Pareshan mat ho — error ka sandesh padho, wo aksar wahi batata hai jo galat hai. Table ke naam dekhne ke liye `SHOW TABLES;` (MySQL me) chal sakta hai.
SQL vs Excel kisme data rakhna behtar hai dukaan ke liye

Dukaan chhoti hai to dono ka apna sthan hai:

**Excel theek hai jab:** saaman 100-200 hai, ek hi aadmi hisaab rakhta hai, sirf jod-ghatav chahiye.

**SQL/Database behtar jab:** saaman hazaron me, bill roz bante hain, graahak-udhaar ka purana record dhundhna padta hai, do log ek saath kaam karte hain.

Asliyat: dukaan ki app (billing software) andar database hi use karti hai — tumhe SQL haath se likhna nahi padta, par samajh ho to galti pakadna aasan hota hai.
Bank me database kaise kaam karta hai SQL se

Bank ka har kaam database par chalta hai:

- Khaata khulta hai → `INSERT` se nayi entry
- Balance dekhte ho → `SELECT` se tumhari row
- Paise nikaale → `UPDATE` se balance kam
- Ek saath lakhon log — database sabko alag-alag sahi jawab deta hai, data takrata nahi

Aur sabse khaas: aadha kaam hokar bijli chali jaye to poora len-den wapas (transaction) — paisa na idhar kata na udhar gaya. Kagaz wale register se ye suraksha kabhi nahi mil sakti.
School ke result system me SQL ka kya kaam hai

Result system pura database par khada hai:

- `students` table — baccho ki jaankari
- `marks` table — har vishay ke number, student_id ke saath
- Result nikaalna — JOIN se naam + number jodkar
- Topper dhundhna — `ORDER BY kul_number DESC LIMIT 1`
- Pass/fail ginati — `GROUP BY` se kaksha ke hisaab se report

Jo kaam kagaz par hafto lagta tha, wahi query se minute me ho jata hai.
SQL me sabse aam galtiyaan kaun si hoti hai shuruaat me

Shuruaat me ye 5 galtiyaan sabse zyada hoti hain:

1. **WHERE bhoolna** UPDATE/DELETE me — poora table badal/mit jata hai
2. **Quote ki galti** — akshar wale data par '' na lagana, ya number par laga dena
3. **Spelling** — table/column ka naam galat (student vs students)
4. **Semicolon** bhoolna — do query jud jati hain
5. **Kram ulta** — ORDER BY ko WHERE se pehle likh dena

Ghabrao mat — error ka sandesh padhne ki aadat daal lo, aadhi galti wahi pakad me aa jati hai.
Keyword kya hote hai SQL me SELECT WHERE jaise shabd

Keyword matlab SQL ke **khaas shabd** jinka matlab pehle se tay hai — SELECT, FROM, WHERE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY.

Do baatein:
1. Inhe apne table/column ka naam rakhne se bacho — `order` naam ka table banaoge to hamesha pareshaani hogi (order khud ek keyword hai)
2. Keyword bade ya chhote akshar dono me chalega — `select` aur `SELECT` ek hi hai
Database seekhna hai to SQL ke baad kya aata hai

SQL pakka ho jaye to aage ka raasta:

1. **JOIN gehraai se** — kai table jodna, LEFT JOIN
2. **Subquery** — query ke andar query
3. **Index** — bade data me khoj tez karna
4. **Ek asal project** — apni dukaan ya school ka chhota database banao (table design se report tak)

Sabse zyada seekh project se milti hai — 4 table ka school database bana lo, aadha SQL haath me aa jayega.
MySQL aur SQLite me kya farak hai shuruaat ke liye kaunsa

**SQLite:** ek file wala database — mobile app aur chhote program ke andar chalta hai. Kuch install nahi karna, seekhne ke liye sabse aasan.

**MySQL:** alag server software — badi website/app ke liye, kai log ek saath use karte hain.

Shuruaat ke liye salah: pehle SQLite par haath saaf karo — SQL ki bhasha dono me ek hi hai, baad me MySQL par jana ek din ka kaam hai.

Do table join karne se pehle kya hona chahiye dono me common

Dono table me ek **jodne wala column** hona chahiye — ek table ki primary key, dusre me usi ka number.

Example:
- `students` me `id` (primary key)
- `fees` me `student_id` — jo batata hai ye fees kis student ki hai

Jod isi jodi par banta hai: `ON students.id = fees.student_id`. Bina is rishte ke JOIN ka koi matlab nahi — naam par jodna khatarnaak hai, naam do ke ek ho sakte hain.
JOIN aur WHERE me kya farak hai SQL me

**WHERE** — ek hi table ki rows me se chunna (shart).
```sql
SELECT * FROM students WHERE kaksha = 9;
```

**JOIN** — do table ko jodkar ek saath data lena.
```sql
SELECT students.naam, fees.rakam FROM students
JOIN fees ON students.id = fees.student_id;
```

Aksar dono ek saath aate hain — JOIN se jodo, WHERE se chuno: 'naam ke saath fees dikhao, par sirf November wali'.
Table ke naam chhote karke JOIN likhna hai alias kya hai

Table ko chhota naam (alias) dene se query saaf hoti hai:

```sql
SELECT s.naam, f.rakam
FROM students s
JOIN fees f ON s.id = f.student_id;
```

`students s` matlab students ko ab `s` kahenge, `fees` ko `f`. Kaam bilkul wahi — bas likhna-padhna aasan. Badi query me alias na ho to har jagah lamba naam likhna padta hai.
SELECT FROM WHERE in teeno ke bina query chalegi kya

Teeno ke kaam alag hain:

- `SELECT` — kya dikhana hai (ye to chahiye hi)
- `FROM` — kis table se (ye bhi chahiye)
- `WHERE` — kaun si rows (ye **marzi** hai — na lagao to saari rows)

```sql
SELECT naam FROM students;          -- chalegi, saare naam
SELECT naam FROM students WHERE kaksha = 9;  -- chalegi, sirf kaksha 9
```

Bina FROM ke `SELECT` adhura hai, bina WHERE ke query adhuri nahi — bas jawab bada aayega.
Data daala par dikh nahi raha INSERT ke baad kya check kare

Teen cheezein jaancho:

1. **Error to nahi aaya tha?** INSERT ke baad '1 row affected' jaisa sandesh aana chahiye — error aaya ho to data gaya hi nahi
2. **Sahi table me daala?** `SELECT * FROM students;` chalakar dekho
3. **Quote/spelling** — naam par '' lage the ya nahi

Aksar wajah pehli wali hoti hai — error chup-chaap nikal jata hai aur hum data dhundhte rehte hain.
Query bahut dheere chal rahi hai bade table par kya wajah ho sakti hai

3. Jis column par baar-baar khoj hoti hai uspar **index** na hona — index kitab ke aakhir wali suchi (index) jaisa hai, bina uske har baar pura table chhanna padta hai

Shuruaat me bas pehli do baatein sambhal lo — jo chahiye wahi mango, shart lagakar mango.
