Sawal ko todo: 'mujhe **kya** chahiye aur wo **kahan** pada hai?'

- Naam/umar → students
- Paise/hisaab → fees ya bill
- Cheez/daam → saaman

Jo cheez chahiye, usi ki table FROM me aayegi. Data do table me bikhra ho tabhi JOIN socho. Aadhi galtiyan galat table chunne se hoti hain, query se nahi.
SQL me WHERE 1=1 jaisi line kyun likhte hai kuch log

Ye ek chaal hai taaki baad wali shartein hamesha `AND` se jod sako:

```sql
SELECT * FROM students
WHERE 1=1 AND kaksha = 9 AND sheher = 'Delhi';
```

`1=1` hamesha sach hai, isliye jawab nahi badalta — bas program se query banate samay shartein jodna aasan ho jata hai. Haath se likhne me iski zaroorat nahi.
Ek student ke saare vishayo ke number ek saath marks table se

Marks table me har vishay ki alag row hoti hai:

```sql
SELECT vishay, number FROM marks WHERE student_id = 5;
```

Us student ki har vishay wali row aa jayegi. Kul number chahiye to `SELECT SUM(number) FROM marks WHERE student_id = 5;`
Database me password aise hi rakhna sahi hai ya nahi soch batao

Seedha password rakhna **galat aur khatarnaak** hai — database khula to saare password khule.

Sahi tareeka: password ko **hash** karke rakho — ek aisi ulta-na-ho-sakne wali shakl me badal kar. Login par daala gaya password hash karke rakhe hue hash se milaya jata hai, asal password kahin rakha hi nahi jata.

SQL tumhe column de sakta hai, par hash ka kaam app/program ka hai — ye farak samajh lo.
Table khali hai par query error nahi de rahi khaali jawab aaya kyun

Ye galti nahi hai — query sahi chali, bas **koi row mili hi nahi**.

Wajah aksar:
- Shart zyada sakht hai (galat id/sheher)
- Spelling data se nahi milti
- Table me data hai hi nahi

Jaanch: WHERE hatakar `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table;` chalao — ginati 0 hai to data hi nahi, ginati hai to shart galat hai.
Saaman ke naam me jagah space hai query me dikkat aayegi kya

Data ke andar space se koi dikkat nahi — 'Chawal 5kg' '' ke andar aaram se aata hai:

```sql
SELECT * FROM saaman WHERE naam = 'Chawal 5kg';
```

Dikkat **column/table ke naam** me space se hoti hai — isliye naam me space ki jagah underscore (_) lagate hain, jaise `graahak_naam`.
Har din ki bikri ki report hafte bhar ki GROUP BY tareekh se

```sql
SELECT tareekh, SUM(kul_daam) AS din_ki_bikri
FROM bill
GROUP BY tareekh
ORDER BY tareekh;
```

Har tareekh ki kul bikri alag line me, tareekh ke kram se. Mahine ki report chahiye to WHERE me mahine ki pehli-aakhri tareekh jod do.
Student transfer ho gaya record delete kare ya rakhe salah soch

Aksar **delete na karna** behtar hai:

- Purane result/fees ke record usi student se jude hain — delete karoge to hisaab bigdega
- Sahi tareeka: ek `sthiti` column rakho — 'Padh raha hai' / 'Chala gaya' UPDATE kar do

```sql
UPDATE students SET sthiti = 'Chala gaya' WHERE id = 12;
```

Data rahega, par roz ki list me `WHERE sthiti = 'Padh raha hai'` se wo nahi dikhega. Asal school/bank yahi karte hain.
SQL me seekhne wala pehla project kya banana chahiye salah do

Apni **dukaan ya school ka chhota database** banao — 3 table se shuru karo:

1. `students` ya `saaman` (CREATE + INSERT)
2. `fees` ya `bill` (id se juda hua)
3. Roz ke 10 sawal query me badlo — kul kitna, sabse zyada kiska, aaj ka hisaab

Jo kaam tum kagaz par karte ho wahi database me karna — do hafte me SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY haath me aa jayega, aur seekha hua kaam bhi aayega.
Mobile phone kaam kaise karta hai?

Mobile phone asal me ek chhota radio hai. Jab tum call karte ho, tumhari awaaz pehle digital signals me badalti hai, phir radio waves ke roop me sabse nazdeek wale mobile tower tak jati hai. Tower se ye signal fiber cable aur network ke through dusre bande ke tower tak pahuchta hai, aur wahan se uske phone tak. Isiliye jahan tower ka signal kamzor hota hai, wahan call katti hai ya awaaz saaf nahi aati.
Internet kya hota hai simple bhasha me?

Internet duniya bhar ke computers aur servers ka ek bahut bada jaal (network) hai. Jab tum koi website kholte ho, tumhara phone ya computer door rakhe ek server computer se wo jaankari mangta hai, aur server use bhej deta hai. Ye saara aadan-pradaan cables, fiber aur wireless signals se hota hai — bas itni tez ki humein turant lagta hai.
WiFi aur mobile data me kya farak hai?

WiFi ek chhote area ke liye hota hai — ghar ya office ke router se milta hai, aur router khud kisi broadband line se juda hota hai. Mobile data tumhare SIM ke through mobile tower se milta hai, isliye ye kahin bhi chal sakta hai. WiFi aam taur par ghar me sasta aur tez hota hai, mobile data safar me kaam aata hai par pack ki limit hoti hai.
5G kya hota hai aur 4G se kaise alag hai?

5G mobile network ki paanchvi peedhi (generation) hai. 4G ke mukable isme speed kai guna zyada, jawab ka samay (latency) bahut kam, aur ek saath kai guna zyada devices jud sakte hain. Iska fayda tez download, bina rukawat video call aur aane wali nayi technology jaise driverless gaadiyon me hoga. Par 5G ke liye 5G wala phone aur 5G coverage dono chahiye.
Phone ki battery jaldi kyun khatm hoti hai?

Kuch badi wajah: screen ki zyada brightness, background me chalte apps, kamzor network (phone baar-baar signal dhundhta hai aur zyada taakat khata hai), GPS aur Bluetooth hamesha on rehna, aur purani battery ka kamzor ho jana. Battery bachane ke liye brightness kam rakho, kaam ke baad location band karo, aur battery saver mode use karo.
Battery ko sahi rakhne ke liye charging kaise kare?

Kuch aasan baatein: phone ko hamesha 0 tak khaali ya 100 par ghanton lagaye rakhna battery ke liye best nahi mana jata; beech-beech me charge karna behtar hai. Asli (original) ya achhi company ka charger use karo, charge karte samay heavy game khelne se phone garam hota hai jo battery ko nuksan deta hai. Bahut garam jagah par phone mat chhodo.
RAM kya hoti hai phone me?

RAM phone ki woh asthayi (temporary) yaaddaasht hai jahan chal rahe apps aur unka data rakha jata hai. RAM zyada ho to phone ek saath zyada apps bina band kiye chala sakta hai aur apps jaldi khulte hain. Phone band karte hi RAM khaali ho jati hai. RAM kaam ki tez jagah hai, storage uski almari — dono alag cheezein hain.
Storage aur RAM me kya farak hai?

Storage (jaise 128 GB) me tumhari photos, videos, apps aur files hamesha ke liye rehti hain, phone band karne par bhi. RAM (jaise 8 GB) sirf chalte hue kaam ke liye hoti hai aur phone band hote hi saaf ho jati hai. Aasan misaal: storage almari hai jahan saaman rakha hai, RAM mez hai jahan kaam karte samay saaman phaila kar rakhte ho.
Processor kya hota hai phone me?

Processor phone ka dimaag hai — saare hisaab aur kaam wahi karta hai: app kholna, photo process karna, game chalana. Processor jitna tez aur naya, phone utna smooth chalta hai. Isi ko chip ya SoC bhi kehte hain. Game aur video editing jaise bhaari kaam me processor ki taakat sabse zyada matter karti hai.
OTP kya hota hai?

OTP ka matlab hai One Time Password — ek baar kaam aane wala code. Jab tum login ya payment karte ho, bank ya app tumhare registered number par 4 ya 6 ankon ka code bhejta hai. Ye isliye hota hai taaki pakka ho jaye ki kaam tum hi kar rahe ho, kyunki code sirf tumhare phone par aata hai. OTP kisi ke saath share karna matlab apni suraksha ka taala khol dena hai.
OTP kisi ko kyun nahi batana chahiye?

Kyunki OTP tumhare khate ki aakhri suraksha deewaar hai. Dhokhebaz aksar bank adhikari, police ya company wala bankar call karte hain aur OTP mangte hain. Yaad rakho: bank, police ya koi asli company kabhi OTP, PIN ya CVV nahi mangti. Jo OTP mange, samjho wahi chor hai. OTP batate hi khaate se paisa nikal sakta hai.
Koi mujhe call karke bank se bol raha hai aur OTP mang raha hai, kya karu?

Turant call kaat do. Bank kabhi phone par OTP, PIN ya CVV nahi mangta. Ye pakka dhokha hai. Number ko block karo aur chaaho to bank ki asli helpline par khud call karke batao. Galti se OTP bata diya ho to turant bank ko call karke khata band (block) karwao aur police ki cyber helpline 1930 par shikayat karo — jaldi report karne se paisa rukne ki sambhavna badhti hai.
Strong password kaise banaye?

Achha password lamba hota hai — kam se kam 12 akshar. Usme bade aur chhote akshar, ank aur nishan (@, #, !) milakar rakho. Apna naam, janm tithi, mobile number ya '123456' jaisi aasan cheezein kabhi mat rakho. Har app ke liye alag password rakho, taaki ek leak ho to baaki surakshit rahein. Ek aasan tareeka: kisi vaakya ke pehle akshar aur ank milakar password banao jo tumhe yaad rahe, dusro ko andaza na lage.
Two factor authentication kya hota hai?

Two Factor Authentication (2FA) matlab suraksha ki do paratein. Pehli parat tumhara password, dusri parat tumhare phone par aane wala OTP ya authenticator app ka code. Isse fayda ye hai ki kisi ko tumhara password mil bhi jaye, to bina tumhare phone ke wo login nahi kar sakta. Jahan bhi ye suvidha mile — email, bank, social media — use on kar lena chahiye.
Phishing kya hota hai?

Phishing ek dhokhe ka tareeka hai jisme chor asli jaisi dikhne wali nakli website, email ya message bhejta hai — jaise 'tumhara khata band ho jayega, yahan login karo'. Jaise hi tum wahan apna password ya OTP daalte ho, wo chor ke paas chala jata hai. Bachne ka tareeka: link par click karke login mat karo, khud app ya asli website kholkar check karo, aur bhejne wale ka naam-pata dhyaan se dekho.
Fake call aur scam message ko kaise pehchane?

Kuch nishaniyan: turant dar ya jaldi machana ('abhi nahi to khata band'), OTP/PIN/CVV mangna, ajnabi link par click karne ko kehna, bahut bada inaam ya lottery ki khabar, aur kharab angrezi/vyakaran wale message. Asli bank aur sarkari vibhag aise message nahi bhejte. Shak ho to khud official number par call karke pakka karo — message wale number par kabhi nahi.
AI kya hota hai simple bhasha me?

AI yani Artificial Intelligence — computer ko aise kaam sikhana jo aam taur par insaani samajh mangte hain, jaise bhasha samajhna, photo pehchanna, jawab likhna. AI ko bahut saare examples (data) dikhakar train kiya jata hai, jisse wo pattern seekh leta hai. Ye jaadu nahi hai — ye hisaab aur data par based technology hai, aur galti bhi kar sakta hai, isliye AI ke jawab ko aankh band karke sach nahi manna chahiye.
ChatGPT kya hai?

ChatGPT ek AI chatbot hai jo OpenAI naam ki company ne banaya hai. Ye ek bade language model par chalta hai — matlab isne bahut saari kitabein, websites aur text padhkar bhasha seekhi hai. Tum isse sawal puch sakte ho, essay likhwa sakte ho, code banwa sakte ho ya baat-cheet kar sakte ho. Ye internet se live jaankari hamesha nahi deta aur kabhi-kabhi galat jawab bhi de sakta hai, isliye zaroori baaton ko dusri jagah se bhi pakka kar lena chahiye.
AI se jhooti jaankari kyun milti hai kabhi kabhi?

AI model asal me agla shabd andaza lagakar jawab banata hai — use jo data se seekha hai usi ke pattern par. Isliye kabhi-kabhi wo bahut aatm-vishwas ke saath galat baat bhi bol deta hai; isko 'hallucination' kehte hain. Isiliye AI ko madadgar samjho, antim sach nahi. Khaas taur par ilaaj, kanoon aur paise ke mamlo me kisi asli visheshagya se salah lo.
App kaise banti hai?

App banane ke mukhya kadam: pehle idea aur design tay hota hai ki app kya karegi aur kaisi dikhegi. Phir programmer coding bhashao (jaise Kotlin, Java, Flutter, React Native) me code likhta hai. Phir testing hoti hai — galtiyan dhundhna aur theek karna. Aakhir me app Play Store ya App Store par dala jata hai jahan se log download karte hain. Chhoti app ek banda bhi bana sakta hai, badi apps ke peeche puri team hoti hai.
Website aur app me kya farak hai?

Website browser me khulti hai (jaise Chrome) aur use install nahi karna padta; har baar internet se load hoti hai. App phone me install hoti hai, phone ke camera/GPS jaise hisso ko behtar istemal kar sakti hai aur kuch apps bina internet ke bhi chalti hain. Kai services dono deti hain — jaise YouTube ki website bhi hai aur app bhi.
Cloud kya hota hai?

Cloud matlab tumhara data tumhare phone ki jagah internet par rakhe bade computers (servers) me save hona. Jaise Google Photos me photo cloud me jati hai — isliye phone kho jaye to bhi photo dusre phone se mil jati hai. 'Cloud' koi badal nahi hai, wo asal me bade-bade data center hain jahan hazaro computers rakhe hote hain.
GPS kaam kaise karta hai?

GPS aasmaan me ghoom rahe satellites ka system hai. Tumhara phone kam se kam 4 satellites se signal leta hai, aur har signal aane me lage samay se hisaab lagata hai ki tum dharti par kahan ho. Isi se map me tumhari jagah, rasta aur doori pata chalti hai. GPS ke liye internet zaroori nahi, par map load karne ke liye aksar chahiye hota hai.
QR code kya hota hai aur kaise kaam karta hai?

QR code ek chaukor (square) design wala code hai jisme jaankari chhupi hoti hai — jaise payment ka pata, website ka link ya menu. Phone ka camera use padhkar turant wo jaankari khol deta hai. Payment ke QR par dukaan wale ke khate ki jaankari hoti hai, isliye scan karte hi paisa sahi khate me jata hai. Ajnabi QR scan karke paisa bhejne se pehle naam zaroor check karo.
UPI kaam kaise karta hai?

UPI Bharat ka turant payment system hai jisme paisa ek bank khate se dusre me seedha chala jata hai, aksar kuch seconds me. Tum apne bank khate ko UPI app se jodte ho, ek UPI PIN banate ho, aur phir number, UPI ID ya QR code se payment karte ho. Paisa bhejne se pehle app khata-dharak ka naam dikhata hai — use hamesha pakka karo. UPI PIN sirf paisa bhejte samay apne phone me daalo, kisi ke kehne par kabhi mat daalo.
UPI PIN mangne wala call aaye to kya samjhe?

Pakka dhokha samjho. Paisa *lene* ke liye kabhi PIN nahi lagta — PIN sirf paisa *bhejne* par lagta hai. Dhokhebaz kehte hain 'aapko paisa bheja hai, PIN dalo to milega' — asal me PIN dalte hi tumhare khate se paisa nikal jata hai. Aisa call turant kaato, aur khud kabhi kisi anjaan ko paisa bhejne se pehle naam check karo.
Bluetooth kya hota hai?

Bluetooth ek kam doori wali wireless technology hai jisse aas-paas ke devices judte hain — jaise phone se earbuds, speaker ya dusra phone. Iski range aam taur par 10 meter ke aas-paas hoti hai aur ye internet ka istemal nahi karti. Kaam na ho to Bluetooth band rakhna battery aur suraksha dono ke liye achha hai.
Hotspot kya hota hai?

Hotspot chalu karne se tumhara phone ek chhota WiFi router ban jata hai — tumhare mobile data ko dusre log apne phone/laptop me WiFi ki tarah istemal kar sakte hain. Isme tumhara hi data pack kharch hota hai aur battery bhi jaldi girti hai. Hotspot par hamesha password rakho, warna aas-paas ka koi bhi tumhara data use kar sakta hai.
Airplane mode kya karta hai?

Airplane mode on karte hi phone ke saare wireless connection — mobile signal, WiFi, Bluetooth — band ho jate hain. Ye hawai jahaz me istemal ke liye bana tha. Aam zindagi me ye tab kaam aata hai jab signal ki dikkat ho (band karke on karne se network fir se judta hai) ya battery bachani ho. Airplane mode me call aur internet nahi chalega.
Software update kyun karna chahiye phone me?

Update me sirf naye features nahi aate, suraksha ki kamiyan (bugs) bhi theek hoti hain jinse chor phone me ghus sakte hain. Purana software choron ke liye aasan nishana hota hai. Isliye jab bhi phone ya apps ka update aaye, use kar lena chahiye. Update se pehle battery charge rakho aur WiFi se download karo taaki data bache.
Phone me virus aa sakta hai kya?

Haan, aa sakta hai — khaas taur par jab ajnabi websites se app (APK) download karo ya nakli links par click karo. Aise kharab software ko malware kehte hain; ye data chura sakta hai ya phone ko bigad sakta hai. Bachav: apps sirf Play Store se lo, ajnabi links mat kholo, aur phone ka Play Protect on rakho.
Phone ka backup kyun zaroori hai?

Backup matlab tumhare data ki dusri copy surakshit jagah par. Phone kho jaye, toot jaye ya kharab ho jaye, to backup se photos, contacts aur chats wapas mil jate hain. Bina backup ke saalon ki photos ek jhatke me ja sakti hain. Google account se auto-backup on kar do, taaki roz khud-ba-khud copy banti rahe.
Cache kya hota hai phone me?

Cache woh asthayi data hai jo apps tez khulne ke liye save karte hain — jaise pehle dekhi hui photos ya page ke hisse. Isse app dobara jaldi khulta hai. Kabhi-kabhi cache bahut badh jata hai ya kharab ho jata hai, tab app atakne lagta hai — aise me cache clear karne se app theek ho jata hai aur tumhara asli data (photos, account) nahi udta.
Incognito mode kya hota hai?

Incognito (private) mode me browser tumhari history, cookies aur form data save nahi karta — browser band karte hi sab mit jata hai. Par iska matlab ye nahi ki tum internet par adrishya ho gaye: tumhari internet company aur khuli hui website ko phir bhi pata chal sakta hai ki tumne kya dekha. Ye sirf usi phone par history na chhodne ke kaam ka hai.
Cookies kya hoti hain internet me?

Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites tumhare browser me rakhti hain taaki tumhe pehchan sakein — jaise login yaad rakhna, cart me dala saaman, ya tumhari pasand. Ye kaam ki bhi hain, par inhi se tumhari pasand track karke vigyapan bhi dikhaye jate hain. Ajnabi sites par 'sab cookies accept' karne se pehle soch lo; browser ki settings se cookies saaf bhi ki ja sakti hain.
Download aur upload speed me kya farak hai?

Download speed wo hai jis tez se data tumhare phone me aata hai — video dekhna, file lena. Upload speed wo hai jis tez se tum data bhejte ho — photo bhejna, video call me apni tasveer. Speed Mbps me napi jati hai. Aam taur par download speed upload se zyada hoti hai kyunki log lene ka kaam zyada karte hain.
Mbps kya hota hai?

Mbps matlab Megabits per second — internet ki speed napne ki ikai. Sankhya jitni badi, speed utni tez. Aasan andaz: aaram se video dekhne ke liye 5-10 Mbps kaafi hai, HD video ke liye lagbhag 10-25 Mbps, aur badi file download karne me zyada speed se samay bachta hai. Dhyaan do: MB (file ka size) aur Mbps (speed) alag hain — 1 Byte = 8 bits hota hai.
eSIM kya hoti hai?

eSIM phone ke andar bani hui digital SIM hoti hai — alag se plastic SIM card dalne ki zaroorat nahi. Company ka plan QR code scan karke activate ho jata hai. Isse SIM badalna aasan hota hai aur phone me ek aur SIM ki jagah bachti hai. Har phone me eSIM nahi hoti; ye suvidha wale phone me hi chalti hai.
IMEI number kya hota hai?

IMEI har mobile phone ka ek khaas pehchan number (15 ank) hota hai — jaise phone ka Aadhaar number. Phone chori ho jane par police aur company isi number se phone ko track aur band (block) kar sakti hai. Apna IMEI *#06# dial karke dekha ja sakta hai; use kahin likhkar rakhna kaam aata hai.
Fast charging kya hoti hai, kya ye battery ko kharab karti hai?

Fast charging me charger zyada taakat dekar battery ko jaldi bharta hai — jaise 30 minute me aadhi battery. Aaj ke phones me suraksha system taakat ko control karta hai, isliye aam istemal me isse khaas nuksan nahi hota. Haan, garam hona battery ke liye achha nahi, isliye fast charge ke samay phone ko hawa-daar jagah rakho aur bahut mota cover hata do to behtar.
Camera ke megapixel zyada matlab photo hamesha achhi?

Nahi. Megapixel sirf photo ka size (kitne chhote bindu) batata hai, quality nahi. Achhi photo ke liye sensor ka size, lens, roshni aur software processing zyada matter karte hain. Isiliye kabhi-kabhi kam megapixel wala phone zyada achhi photo leta hai. Photo ki quality dekhni ho to asli samples dekho, sirf sankhya par mat jao.
Online shopping me dhokhe se kaise bache?

Kuch pakki baatein: sirf bharosemand apps/websites se kharido; bahut sasta wala ajnabi link aksar nakli hota hai. Paisa bhejne se pehle seller aur reviews check karo. Cash on Delivery ka vikalp ho to behtar. Kabhi bhi advance paisa ajnabi ke personal khate me mat bhejo, aur apna OTP/card ki jaankari kisi ko mat do — asli company ye kabhi nahi mangti.
Fake news ko kaise pehchane?

Peeche ki jaanch karo: ye khabar kisi bharosemand akhbaar/channel par hai ya sirf WhatsApp forward hai? Bahut bhadkane wali, turant share karne ko kehne wali khabrein aksar jhooti hoti hain. Photo ko Google par ulta search (reverse image search) karke dekha ja sakta hai ki wo purani to nahi. Pakka na ho to aage share mat karo — jhooti khabar failana bhi nuksan hai.
App permissions kya hoti hain, kyun dhyaan de?

Jab app camera, mic, contacts ya location ki anumati mangta hai, use permission kehte hain. Har app ko sirf utni hi anumati do jitni uske kaam ke liye zaroori hai — jaise torch wale app ko contacts ki koi zaroorat nahi. Zyada anumati matlab zyada data khatre me. Settings me jakar purani apps ki permissions kabhi-kabhi check kar lena achhi aadat hai.
Email kya hota hai aur kaise kaam karta hai?

Email internet par chitthi bhejne ka tareeka hai. Tum message likhkar ek khaas pate (email address) par bhejte ho; wo pehle ek server par jata hai, phir lene wale ke account me pahuch jata hai, jahan se wo use kabhi bhi padh sakta hai. Isiliye email ke liye dono ka ek saath online hona zaroori nahi. Apna email password majboot rakho, kyunki email se aksar baaki accounts ka password badla jata hai.
Search engine kya hota hai?

Search engine (jaise Google) ek aisi seva hai jo pure internet ki jaankari ko pehle se gin-karke (index) rakhti hai. Jab tum kuch likhkar dhundhte ho, ye apni soochi se sabse milti-julti websites pal bhar me dikha deta hai. Ye khud jaankari nahi banata — dusro ki websites se dhundhkar lata hai, isliye mile hue jawab ki quality website par nirbhar karti hai.
Server kya hota hai?

Server ek aisa computer hai jo dusre computers ya phones ko seva deta hai — website ki files rakhna, email pahuchana, ya app ka data sambhalna. Jab tum koi website kholte ho, asal me tum kisi server se file mang rahe hote ho. Server aam taur par bade data centers me rakhe hote hain aur 24 ghante chalte rehte hain.
Phone garam kyun hota hai?

Phone ke processor ko zyada kaam karne par garmi paida hoti hai — heavy game, lamba video record, tez charging, ya kamzor signal me phone ka zyada zor lagana. Thodi garmi aam hai, par phone bahut zyada garam ho to use band karke thanda hone do, cover hata do, aur dhoop me to bilkul mat rakho. Baar-baar bahut garam hona battery aur phone dono ke liye nuksan hai.
Screen guard aur cover kyun lagate hain?

Screen guard screen ko kharonch aur halki chot se bachata hai; kuch guard girne par screen ki jagah khud tootkar jhatka kam kar dete hain. Cover phone ke kinaro aur peeche hisse ko girne ki chot se bachata hai. Ye sasti suraksha hai — phone ki screen badalna aksar bahut mehenga padta hai.
WhatsApp par kisi ajnabi ke link par click karna chahiye?

Nahi. Ajnabi link se nakli website khul sakti hai jo tumhara password ya OTP churane ke liye bani ho, ya phone me kharab app ghus sakta hai. 'Tumne inaam jeeta hai', 'account band ho jayega' jaise message khaas taur par dhokha hote hain. Koi bhi kaam ho, khud asli app kholkar check karo — link se kabhi login ya payment mat karo.
Apna purana phone bechne se pehle kya kare?

Pehle apne saare data ka backup lo — photos, contacts, chats. Phir saare accounts se logout karo, SIM aur memory card nikalo. Aakhir me settings se Factory Reset karo, jisse phone ka saara data mit jata hai aur phone naye jaisa khaali ho jata hai. Bina reset kiye phone bechna matlab apni niji jaankari ajnabi ko saunpna hai.
WiFi ka full form kya hai?
WiFi ka full form hai Wireless Fidelity. Ye bina taar ke internet jodne wali technology ka naam hai — iske through phone aur laptop router se judkar internet chalate hain.
GPS ka full form kya hai?
GPS ka full form hai Global Positioning System. Ye satellites se tumhari jagah (location) batane wala system hai, jiska istemal map aur navigation me hota hai.
USB ka full form kya hai?
USB ka full form hai Universal Serial Bus. Ye wo aam port hai jisse pendrive, charger cable aur dusre devices computer ya phone se judte hain.
PDF ka full form kya hai?
PDF ka full form hai Portable Document Format. Ye ek aisi file hoti hai jo har device par ek jaisi dikhti hai, isliye form, bill aur kitabein aksar PDF me bheji jati hain.
URL ka full form kya hai?
URL ka full form hai Uniform Resource Locator. Aasan bhasha me ye kisi website ya page ka internet par pata hota hai — jaise kisi ghar ka address.
CPU ka full form kya hai?
CPU ka full form hai Central Processing Unit. Ye computer ka dimaag hota hai jo saare hisaab aur kaam karta hai.
OTP ka full form kya hai?
OTP ka full form hai One Time Password. Ye ek baar kaam aane wala code hai jo login ya payment ki suraksha ke liye tumhare phone par aata hai. Ise kisi ke saath share kabhi mat karo.
UPI ka full form kya hai?
UPI ka full form hai Unified Payments Interface. Ye Bharat ka woh system hai jisse bank khate se turant paisa dusre khate me bheja jata hai.
SIM ka full form kya hai?
SIM ka full form hai Subscriber Identity Module. Ye chhoti chip tumhare number aur network ki pehchan rakhti hai, jisse phone network se judta hai.
IMEI ka full form kya hai?
IMEI ka full form hai International Mobile Equipment Identity. Ye har phone ka khaas 15 ankon ka pehchan number hota hai.
HDMI ka full form kya hai?
HDMI ka full form hai High Definition Multimedia Interface. Ye wo cable/port hai jisse TV par computer ya set-top box ki saaf tasveer aur awaaz ek saath jati hai.
IP address kya hota hai?
IP address har device ka internet par ek khaas number wala pata hota hai, jaise ghar ka address. Isi pate se data sahi device tak pahuchta hai. IP ka full form hai Internet Protocol.
ATM ka full form kya hai?
ATM ka full form hai Automated Teller Machine. Ye wo machine hai jisse bank khate se bina bank jaye paisa nikala aur jama kiya jata hai.
KYC ka full form kya hai?

KYC ka full form hai Know Your Customer. Iska matlab hai bank ya company dwara grahak ki pehchan pakki karna — jaise Aadhaar ya PAN se. KYC sirf asli bank/app par hi karo, ajnabi link par apne documents kabhi mat do.
PIN ka full form kya hai?
PIN ka full form hai Personal Identification Number. Ye tumhara gupt number hota hai — jaise ATM PIN ya UPI PIN. Ise kisi ko batana matlab apne khate ki chaabi de dena hai.
SMS ka full form kya hai?
SMS ka full form hai Short Message Service. Ye mobile par chhota text message bhejne wali purani aur bharosemand seva hai.
AI ka full form kya hai?
AI ka full form hai Artificial Intelligence — kritrim buddhi. Iska matlab hai computer ko data se seekhkar samajhdari wale kaam karna sikhana, jaise bhasha samajhna ya photo pehchanna.
LED ka full form kya hai?
LED ka full form hai Light Emitting Diode. Ye kam bijli khane wali roshni wali technology hai jo bulb, TV aur phone ki screen me istemal hoti hai.
QR ka full form kya hai?
QR ka full form hai Quick Response. QR code woh chaukor code hai jise camera se scan karke payment ya link turant khul jata hai — isiliye iska naam 'tez jawab' rakha gaya.
PAN card me PAN ka full form kya hai?

PAN ka full form hai Permanent Account Number. Ye aaykar (income tax) vibhag dwara diya gaya 10 aksharo-anko ka khaas number hai jo paise ke bade len-den me kaam aata hai. Apna PAN number ajnabiyo ke saath share mat karo.
Mausam kyun badalte hain?

Iski wajah hai dharti ka apni dhuri par lagbhag 23.5 degree jhuka hona. Dharti suraj ke chaaro ore ghumti hai; saal ke alag-alag samay par dharti ke alag hisse suraj ki taraf zyada jhuke hote hain. Jis hisse par suraj ki kirnein seedhi padti hain wahan garmi hoti hai, jahan tirchi padti hain wahan thand. Isi se garmi, sardi aur barsaat ke mausam bante hain.
Leap year kya hota hai?

Dharti ko suraj ke chaaro ore ek chakkar lagane me lagbhag 365 din aur 6 ghante lagte hain. Ye 6 ghante har saal judkar 4 saal me 24 ghante yani ek pura din ban jate hain. Isiliye har 4 saal me February me ek din badhakar 29 din kar diye jate hain, aur wo saal leap year (adhik varsh) kahlata hai — us saal me kul 366 din hote hain.
Chand ke aakar kyun badalte dikhte hain?

Chand apni roshni se nahi chamakta — wo suraj ki roshni ko paraavartit (reflect) karta hai. Chand dharti ke chaaro ore ghumta hai, isliye har raat hum uska alag hissa roshan dekhte hain: kabhi pura gol (purnima), kabhi bilkul andhera (amavasya), kabhi aadha. Inhi badalte aakaro ko chand ki kalayein kehte hain. Ek pura chakkar lagbhag 29.5 din ka hota hai.
Surya grahan kya hota hai?

Jab chand ghumte-ghumte suraj aur dharti ke beech me aa jata hai, to chand ki parchhayi dharti par padti hai aur kuch samay ke liye suraj dhak jata hai — ise surya grahan kehte hain. Ye amavasya ke din hi ho sakta hai. Grahan ko khaali aankh se dekhna aankho ke liye nuksandeh ho sakta hai, isliye khaas chashme se hi dekho.
Chandra grahan kya hota hai?

Jab dharti suraj aur chand ke beech me aa jati hai, to dharti ki parchhayi chand par padti hai aur chand dhundhla ya laal-sa dikhne lagta hai — ise chandra grahan kehte hain. Ye purnima ki raat ko hota hai. Surya grahan ke muqable chandra grahan khaali aankh se dekhna surakshit hota hai.
Baarish kaise hoti hai?

Suraj ki garmi se samundar, nadi aur talab ka paani bhaap bankar upar uthta hai. Upar thandi hawa me bhaap chhoti-chhoti boondon me badal kar badal banati hai. Jab boondein bhaari ho jati hain to gurutv ke kaaran neeche gir padti hain — yahi baarish hai. Isi pure chakkar ko jal chakra (water cycle) kehte hain.
Paani ka chakra kya hota hai?

Jal chakra prakriti ka paani ghumane ka system hai: (1) Suraj ki garmi se paani bhaap banta hai (vashpikaran). (2) Bhaap upar jaakar thandi hokar badal banti hai (sanghanan). (3) Baarish ke roop me paani wapas girta hai. (4) Paani nadiyo aur bhumigat roop se behta hua fir samundar me mil jata hai. Yahi chakkar hamesha chalta rehta hai, isiliye dharti ka paani khatm nahi hota, bas roop badalta hai.
Aakash me bijli kyun chamakti hai aur garaj kyun hoti hai?

Baadalo ke andar paani ki boondein aur barf ke tukde aapas me ragad khate hain, jisse baadal me bijli ka charge banta hai. Jab ye charge bahut badh jata hai to ek tez chamak ke saath dharti ki ore chhut-ta hai — yahi bijli (lightning) hai. Usi garam hawa ke achanak phailne se tez awaaz hoti hai, jise garaj (thunder) kehte hain. Roshni awaaz se tez chalti hai, isliye chamak pehle dikhti hai aur garaj baad me sunti hai.
Indradhanush kaise banta hai?

Baarish ke baad hawa me chhoti-chhoti paani ki boondein reh jati hain. Jab suraj ki safed roshni in boondo se guzarti hai to wo saat rango me bant jati hai — laal, narangi, peela, hara, neela, jamuni aur baingani. Ye rang dhanush (aadha gol) ke aakar me dikhte hain, isiliye ise indradhanush kehte hain. Indradhanush hamesha suraj ke vipreet disha me dikhta hai.
Samundar me jwar bhata kyun aata hai?

Jwar-bhata chand (aur kuch had tak suraj) ke gurutv khichaav se hota hai. Chand ka khichaav samundar ke paani ko apni taraf kheenchta hai, jisse wahan paani ka star badh jata hai — ye jwar hai. Din me lagbhag do baar jwar aur do baar bhata (paani ka utarna) hota hai. Isi liye samundar kinare ka paani roz kuch ghanto me aage-peeche hota rehta hai.
Bhookamp kyun aata hai?

Dharti ki upri parat badi-badi chattani takhto (plates) me banti hui hai jo bahut dheere-dheere hamesha sar-kati rehti hain. Jab ye takhtein aapas me takrati hain ya phas kar achanak chhut-ti hain, to dharti ke andar se urja nikalti hai aur zameen hilne lagti hai — yahi bhookamp hai. Bhookamp ke samay mazboot mez ke neeche ya khuli jagah par jana surakshit hota hai.
Jwalamukhi kya hota hai?

Jwalamukhi dharti ka woh ched ya pahaad hai jahan se andar ki garam pighli chattan (magma), raakh aur gasen bahar nikalti hain. Jab magma bahar aata hai to use laava kehte hain. Kuch jwalamukhi shant hote hain, kuch kabhi bhi phat sakte hain. Thanda hua laava baad me upjau mitti banata hai.
Ped-paudhe khana kaise banate hain?

Paudhe prakash sanshleshan (photosynthesis) se apna khana banate hain. Patto me maujood hari cheez (chlorophyll) suraj ki roshni pakadti hai. Paudha hawa se carbon dioxide aur jadon se paani lekar, roshni ki madad se glucose (khana) banata hai aur oxygen hawa me chhodta hai. Isi oxygen ko hum saans me lete hain — isiliye ped 'dharti ke fefde' kahe jate hain.
Ped lagana kyun zaroori hai?

Ped hawa se carbon dioxide lekar oxygen dete hain, hawa ko saaf karte hain, chhaav aur thandak dete hain, baarish me madad karte hain, mitti ko bandhe rakhte hain aur panchhi-jaanwaro ko ghar dete hain. Ped kam hone se garmi badhti hai aur hawa gandi hoti hai. Ek ped lagana aane wali peedhiyon ke liye tohfa hai.
Dil kya kaam karta hai?

Dil ek pump ki tarah kaam karta hai. Ye pure shareer se aya hua khoon fefdo me bhejta hai jahan khoon oxygen leta hai, fir oxygen-wale khoon ko pure shareer me pump karta hai. Dil ek din me lagbhag ek lakh baar dhadakta hai. Ye bina ruke jeevan bhar kaam karta hai — isiliye dil ko swasth rakhna bahut zaroori hai.
Fefde (lungs) kya kaam karte hain?

Fefde saans ka kaam karte hain. Jab hum saans andar lete hain, fefde hawa se oxygen nikalkar khoon me mila dete hain; jab saans bahar chhodte hain, khoon ki carbon dioxide bahar nikal jati hai. Insaan ke do fefde hote hain — dahina thoda bada, baayan thoda chhota (kyunki paas me dil hota hai).
Dimaag kya kaam karta hai shareer me?

Dimaag shareer ka control room hai. Sochna, yaad rakhna, faisle lena, bhavnaayein, aur shareer ke har ang ko nirdesh dena — sab dimaag karta hai. Ye shareer ke sanketo ko bijli jaise signals ke roop me leta aur bhejta hai. Neend, padhai aur sahi khana dimaag ko tez rakhne me madad karte hain.
Khoon ka kaam kya hota hai?

Khoon shareer ki parivahan (transport) seva hai. Ye fefdo se oxygen aur pet se poshak tatva har ang tak pahuchata hai, aur wahan se gandagi (carbon dioxide aur bekar cheezein) bahar nikalne ke liye lata hai. Khoon shareer ka taapman bhi santulit rakhta hai aur beemariyo se ladne wali koshikayein bhi isme hoti hain.
Liver (yakrit) kya kaam karta hai?

Liver shareer ki sabse badi andaruni granthi hai aur ek factory jaisa kaam karta hai: khoon ko saaf karna, khane se mile poshak tatvo ko sambhalna, pitta (bile) banana jo charbi pachane me madad karta hai, aur shareer ke liye zaroori cheezein store karna. Ye kharab cheezo ko be-asar banane ka kaam bhi karta hai.
Kidney (gurda) kya kaam karti hai?

Gurde khoon ko chhanne ka kaam karte hain. Ye khoon se bekar aur zyada cheezein (jaise urea aur zyada paani-namak) alag karke peshab (urine) banate hain, jisse shareer saaf rehta hai. Insaan ke do gurde hote hain. Paryapt paani peena gurdo ke kaam me madad karta hai.
Aankh kaise dekhti hai?

Aankh ek camera ki tarah kaam karti hai. Saamne wale hisse (lens) se roshni andar jati hai aur peeche wali parat (retina) par ulta chhota sa chitra banta hai. Retina us chitra ko bijli ke sanketo me badalkar dimaag ko bhejti hai, aur dimaag use seedha karke 'dekhna' banata hai. Aankh ki putli (pupil) roshni ke hisaab se chhoti-badi hoti hai — tez roshni me chhoti, andhere me badi.
Kaan se sunai kaise deta hai?

Jab koi awaaz hoti hai, hawa me kampan (vibration) banta hai. Kaan us kampan ko pakadta hai; andar ka parda (eardrum) hilta hai, usse judi chhoti haddiyan kampan ko aur andar tak pahuchati hain, aur andar ke ang use sanketo me badalkar dimaag ko bhejte hain — tab hum 'sunte' hain. Bahut tez awaaz lambe samay tak sunna kaan ke liye nuksandeh ho sakta hai.
Twacha (skin) ka kya kaam hai?

Twacha shareer ka sabse bada ang hai. Ye andar ke ango ko chot, garmi aur keetanuon se bachati hai, paseene ke dwara shareer ka taapman theek rakhti hai, aur chhoone ka ehsaas dimaag tak pahuchati hai. Dhoop me twacha shareer ki raksha ke liye rangat bhi badalti hai.
Haathi ke baare me kuch tathya batao

Haathi zameen par rehne wala sabse bada jaanwar hai. Iske baare me khaas baatein: haathi ki soond me haddi nahi hoti, ye uski naak aur upar wala hont milkar bani hai; haathi bahut achha tairak hota hai; iski yaaddaasht bahut tez mani jati hai; haathi ke bade kaan shareer ko thanda rakhne me madad karte hain. Bharat me haathi ko sanskritik roop se bahut mahatva mila hai.
Sher ko jungle ka raja kyun kehte hain?

Sher apni taakat, shikaar ki kala aur nirbhay swabhaav ke kaaran 'jungle ka raja' kahlata hai. Sher samuh (pride) me rehte hain aur aksar shernian shikaar karti hain. Bharat me sher sirf Gujarat ke Gir jungle me paye jate hain — inhe Asiatic lion kehte hain. Sher ki garaj kai kilometer door tak sunai de sakti hai.
Machhli paani me saans kaise leti hai?

Machhli ke paas fefde nahi hote; uske paas gills (galphade) hote hain. Paani me ghuli hui oxygen hoti hai. Machhli munh se paani lekar galphado se bahar nikalti hai, aur galphade paani se oxygen sokh kar khoon me mila dete hain. Isiliye machhli paani se bahar zyada der jeevit nahi reh sakti.
Panchhi udte kaise hain?

Panchhiyon ke pankh, khokhli (halki) haddiyan aur mazboot chhati ki manspeshiyan udne me madad karti hain. Pankh ko neeche ki ore maarne se hawa neeche dhakelti hai aur panchhi upar uthta hai; pankh ka aakar hawa ko upar se tez aur neeche se dheere behne deta hai, jisse uthaan (lift) milta hai. Har panchhi ud nahi sakta — shuturmurg aur penguin jaise panchhi nahi udte.
Saanp ke pair nahi hote to wo chalta kaise hai?

Saanp apne shareer ki manspeshiyon aur pet ke shalk (scales) ki madad se rengta hai. Wo shareer ko lehron ki tarah modkar zameen ko dhakelta hai aur aage badhta hai. Kuch saamp ped par chadh sakte hain aur kuch paani me tair bhi sakte hain. Saanp ka shareer lamba aur lachila hota hai isiliye ye mumkin hai.
Oont ko registan ka jahaz kyun kehte hain?

Oont registan me jeene ke liye khaas taur par bana hai: wo bina paani ke kai din reh sakta hai, uske pair ke talwe chaade hote hain jo ret me nahi dhaste, lambi palkein aur band hone wale naak ke ched ret ke toofan se bachate hain, aur wo ek baar me bahut saara paani pi sakta hai. Registan me safar aur bojh dhone ke kaam aane ke kaaran hi use 'registan ka jahaz' kehte hain.
Kutta insaan ka sabse purana dost kyun kahlata hai?

Kutta woh pehla jaanwar hai jise insaan ne hazaro saal pehle pala tha. Kutto ki soonghne ki shakti insaan se kai guna zyada hoti hai, isiliye wo police, senna aur khoj-bachav ke kaam me madad karte hain. Wo apne malik ke prati bahut wafadar hote hain — isiliye unhe insaan ka sabse achha dost kaha jata hai.
Suraj ke baare me batao

Suraj ek taara hai — humare saur mandal ke kendra me sthit garam gaso ka vishaal gola. Iska prakash dharti tak pahuchne me lagbhag 8 minute lagta hai. Suraj ki garmi aur roshni ke bina dharti par jeevan mumkin nahi — paudhe khana nahi bana pate aur dharti barf jaisi thandi ho jati. Suraj dharti se lagbhag 13 lakh guna bada hai.
Taare raat ko hi kyun dikhte hain?

Taare din me bhi aakash me hote hain, par suraj ki tez roshni ke saamne unki halki roshni dikhai nahi deti. Raat ko suraj doob jane par andhere me taare saaf chamakne lagte hain. Taare asal me bahut door ke suraj jaise gole hain — kuch taaro ki roshni ko hum tak pahuchne me hazaro saal lagte hain.
Aakash neela kyun dikhta hai?

Suraj ki safed roshni asal me saat rango ka mel hai. Jab roshni dharti ke vayumandal me ghusti hai, hawa ke chhote kan neele rang ko sabse zyada sab dishaon me bikhra dete hain. Wahi bikhri hui neeli roshni humari aankho tak har taraf se aati hai, isliye aakash neela dikhta hai. Subah-shaam suraj ke paas aakash isiliye laal-narangi dikhta hai kyunki tab roshni ko zyada doori tay karni padti hai.
Barf (snow) kaise banti hai?

Jab upar ke badalo me taapman bahut kam ho jata hai, to paani ki bhaap seedhe barf ke chhote-chhote sfatik (crystals) me badal jati hai. Ye sfatik judkar bade hokar neeche girte hain — yahi barf-bari hai. Har barf ka tukda (snowflake) ek khaas chhah-kona (hexagonal) design ka hota hai. Barf aam taur par pahadi aur thande ilaako me girti hai.
Hawa kya hai aur hawa kyun behne lagti hai?

Hawa humare chaaro ore maujood gaso ka mishran hai — isme sabse zyada nitrogen (lagbhag 78%) aur oxygen (lagbhag 21%) hoti hai. Suraj ki garmi se dharti ke alag hisse alag-alag garam hote hain; garam hawa halki hokar upar uthti hai aur thandi hawa uski jagah lene aati hai — isi behti hawa ko hum pawan kehte hain.
Chumbak lohe ko kyun kheenchta hai?

Chumbak ke chaaro ore ek adrishya shakti ka kshetra (magnetic field) hota hai jo lohe, nickel jaise kuch dhaatuon ko apni ore kheenchta hai. Chumbak ke do dhruv hote hain — uttar aur dakshin. Alag dhruv ek dusre ko kheench-te hain, ek jaise dhruv ek dusre ko dhakelte hain. Dharti khud bhi ek bahut bade chumbak ki tarah hai, isiliye compass ki sui hamesha uttar dikhati hai.
Awaaz khali jagah (space) me kyun nahi ja sakti?

Awaaz ko safar karne ke liye kisi madhyam — hawa, paani ya thos — ki zaroorat hoti hai, kyunki awaaz kampan se banti hai aur kampan ko aage badhane ke liye kan chahiye. Antariksh (space) me hawa hi nahi hai, isliye wahan awaaz safar nahi kar sakti — wahan poori khamoshi hoti hai. Roshni ko madhyam nahi chahiye, isliye suraj ki roshni space se hokar hum tak aati hai.
Ped ki umar kaise pata karte hain?

Ped ke tane ko kaatne par andar gol ghare (rings) dikhte hain. Har saal ped ek nayi parat banata hai, isliye jitne ghare, ped ki umar lagbhag utne saal. Ye tareeka purane pedo ki umar janne ke liye istemal hota hai. Jeete hue ped ki umar andaze se uske tane ki motai aur itihas se lagayi jati hai.
Mor ke baare me batao

Mor Bharat ka rashtriya pakshi hai. Nara mor ke lambe, rangeen pankh hote hain jinpar aankh jaise nishan bane hote hain. Baarish ke mausam me mor pankh phailakar nachta hai — ye drishya bahut prasiddh hai. Mor udne me zyada tez nahi hota, par zameen par achhi daud lagata hai. Ye keede aur chhote jeev khata hai.
Ganga nadi ke baare me batao

Ganga Bharat ki sabse pavitra aur lambe nadiyo me se ek hai — iski lambai lagbhag 2,525 kilometer hai. Ye Himalaya ke Gangotri himnad (glacier) se nikalti hai aur UP, Bihar, Bengal se hoti hui Bengal ki khaadi me mil jati hai. Karodo log iske kinare rehte hain aur ispar nirbhar hain. Ganga ko saaf rakhna hum sab ki zimmedari hai.
Budh (Mercury) grah ke baare me batao

Budh (Mercury) suraj ke sabse nazdeek ka grah hai aur saur mandal ka sabse chhota grah hai. Yahan din me bahut zyada garmi aur raat me bahut zyada thand hoti hai kyunki iske paas hawa (vayumandal) lagbhag nahi hai.
Budh grah ki khaas baat kya hai?

Budh (Mercury) ki khaas baat ye hai ki ye suraj ke sabse nazdeek ka grah hai aur saur mandal ka sabse chhota grah hai. Yahan din me bahut zyada garmi aur raat me bahut zyada thand hoti hai kyunki iske paas hawa (vayumandal) lagbhag nahi hai.
Shukra (Venus) grah ke baare me batao

Shukra (Venus) aakash ka sabse chamkeela grah hai aur saur mandal ka sabse garam grah hai. Ise subah-shaam aakash me dekha ja sakta hai, isiliye log ise 'bhor ka taara' bhi kehte hain — halanki ye taara nahi, grah hai.
Dharti (Earth) grah ke baare me batao

Dharti (Earth) abhi tak ki jaankari me ekmatra grah hai jahan jeevan hai. Iski doori suraj se aisi hai ki yahan paani behne wale roop me milta hai aur taapman jeevan ke liye theek rehta hai. Dharti ko 'neela grah' kehte hain kyunki iska zyada hissa paani se dhaka hai.
Dharti grah ki khaas baat kya hai?

Paheli sunao: Aisi kaun si cheez hai jo kharidte waqt kaali, istemal karte waqt laal aur phenkte waqt safed hoti hai?
Jawab hai: Koyla. Kharidte waqt kaala hota hai, jalte waqt laal angaara ban jata hai, aur bujh kar raakh ke roop me safed-gre rang ka ho jata hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo subah chaar pairo par, dopahar ko do pairo par aur shaam ko teen pairo par chalta hai?

Jawab hai: Insaan. Bachpan me ghutno ke bal rengta hai (chaar), jawaani me do pairo par chalta hai, aur budhape me lakdi (teesra pair) ka sahara leta hai. Ye prasiddh paheli jeevan ke teen charano ko dikhati hai.
Ek paheli bhoojho: Bina pairo ke chale, bina munh ke bole — wo kya?
Jawab hai: Hawa. Hawa bina pair ke har jagah chalti-phirti hai aur uski awaaz (seeti, garajna) sunai deti hai, par uska munh nahi hota.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo tumhara hai, par istemal dusre tumse zyada karte hain?
Jawab hai: Tumhara naam. Naam tumhara hota hai, par din bhar log tumhe usi naam se bulate hain — istemal dusre hi zyada karte hain.
Paheli sunao: Chhoti si cheez, par pure ghar ko roshan kar de — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Diya (ya bulb). Ek chhota sa diya andhere ghar me roshni phaila deta hai. Seekh ye bhi hai ki chhoti cheez bhi bada kaam kar sakti hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo paani me girne par bhi geela nahi hota?
Jawab hai: Parchhayi (saaya). Parchhayi paani par bhi banti hai par wo khud kabhi geeli nahi hoti, kyunki wo sirf roshni ki kami hai, koi cheez nahi.
Paheli bhoojho: Aankhein hain par dekh nahi sakta, wo kya hai?
Jawab hai: Aloo — aalu par bane chhote nishano ko 'aankh' kehte hain, par unse wo dekh nahi sakta. Ye shabd-wali paheli hai!
Paheli: Din me sota hai, raat ko jagta hai aur andhere me dekhta hai — kaun?
Jawab hai: Ullu. Ullu ek raatri-pakshi hai jo din me sota hai aur raat me shikaar karta hai; uski aankhein andhere me dekhne ke liye khaas bani hoti hain.
Paheli sunao: Gol hai par gend nahi, poonch hai par jaanwar nahi — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Patang. Patang gol ya chaukor aakar ki hoti hai, uski poonch bhi hoti hai, par wo jaanwar nahi hai — kagaz aur lakdi se banti hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo badhta hai par kabhi kam nahi hota?
Jawab hai: Umar. Har saal umar badhti hi hai, kabhi ghatti nahi. Isiliye samay ka sahi istemal sabse zaroori hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Khaana khaye bina jinda, paani piye bina mare nahi — kaun?
Jawab hai: Aag. Aag ko 'khaana' (lakdi, koyla) milta rahe to jalti rehti hai, aur paani padte hi bujh jati hai. Aag asal me jeevit nahi hoti, par paheli me use aise varnan kiya jata hai.
Paheli: Ek kamra bina darwaze ke, andar safed aur beech me peela khazana — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Anda. Bahar safed chhilka, andar safedi aur beech me peeli zardi — aur koi darwaza nahi hota!
Paheli sunao: Main har roz aata hoon par kabhi pahuchta nahi — main kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Kal (aane wala din). 'Kal' hamesha aane wala hota hai; jab wo din aa jata hai to wo 'aaj' ban jata hai. Isiliye kaam aaj hi karna chahiye, kal par nahi talna chahiye.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo todne par awaaz hoti hai par dikhta kuch nahi?
Jawab hai: Chuppi (khamoshi). 'Chuppi todna' ek muhavara hai — jab koi bolta hai to khamoshi toot jati hai, par use dekha nahi ja sakta.
Dimagi sawal: Ek train bijli se chalti hai aur purab se paschim ja rahi hai, hawa uttar se beh rahi hai. Train ka dhuaan kis disha me jayega?
Trick hai — bijli wali train se dhuaan nikalta hi nahi! Isiliye dhuaan kisi disha me nahi jayega. Paheliyo me pehle poori baat dhyaan se padhna chahiye.
Dimagi sawal: Agar ek mor ande de to wo anda kiska hoga — mor ka ya morni ka?
Jawab hai: Mor (nara) ande nahi deta — ande morni (maada) deti hai. To sawal hi trick hai; mor ke ande wali baat ho hi nahi sakti.
Paheli bhoojho: Jitna zyada nikalo, utna bada hota hai — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Gaddha. Gaddhe me se jitni mitti nikalo, gaddha utna hi bada aur gehra hota jata hai.
Paheli: Mere paas shahar hain par ghar nahi, jungle hain par ped nahi, nadiyan hain par paani nahi — main kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Naksha (map). Nakse me shahar, jungle aur nadiyan sab dikhte hain, par asal me wahan na ghar hota hai, na ped, na paani — wo sirf kagaz ya screen par bani tasveer hai.
Paheli sunao: Wo kaun sa shabd hai jo ulta seedha ek jaisa padha jata hai?
Aise shabdo ko palindrom kehte hain. Hindi me udaharan: 'naman' aur 'jahaj'; angrezi me 'madam', 'level' aur 'noon'. Aage se padho ya peeche se — shabd ek hi rehta hai!
Dimagi sawal: Ek ped par 10 panchhi baithe hain, shikari ne ek ko goli mari. Kitne bache?
Jawab hai: Ek bhi nahi bachega ped par. Ek gir jayega aur baaki sab goli ki awaaz se dar kar ud jayenge. Hisaab se pehle haal samajhna zaroori hai!
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo khaali ho to halka aur bhara ho to bhaari, par bacche use khelte hain?
Jawab hai: Balti. Khaali balti halki hoti hai, paani bharte hi bhaari ho jati hai, aur bacche aksar balti se khelte bhi hain. Aasan si paheli, par jawab turant dimag me nahi aata!
Paheli bhoojho: Kaatne par log royein, par main khana swad banau — main kaun?
Jawab hai: Pyaaz. Pyaaz kaat-te waqt uski gas se aankho me paani aata hai, par khane me pyaaz swaad badha deta hai.
Paheli: Upar se gira par toota nahi, paani me gira to gal gaya — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Kagaz. Kagaz upar se girne par toot-ta nahi (halka hokar tairta hua girta hai), par paani me padte hi bhigo kar gal jata hai.
Paheli sunao: Teen akshar ka mera naam, ulta seedha ek samaan — kya hai?
Jawab hai: 'Naman'. Naman ko aage se padho ya peeche se — ek hi rehta hai. Aise shabdo ko palindrom kehte hain. Ek aur udaharan hai 'jahaj'.
Dimagi sawal: Maa ke pet se nikla, bina pair ke chala, bina pankh ke uda — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Dhuaan. Yahan 'maa' ka matlab dharti (aag) hai — dhuaan usi se nikalta hai, bina pair ke rengta-chalta hai, aur bina pankh ke aakash me ud jata hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo har kisi ke paas hai, par koi use kho nahi sakta, aur bina uske koi dikh nahi sakta?
Jawab hai: Naam. Har kisi ke paas apna naam hota hai, use khoya nahi ja sakta, aur insaan ki pehchan usi naam se hoti hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Din bhar chale, raat bhar chale, par apni jagah se na hile — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Sadak (rasta). Sadak par din-raat gaadiyan aur log chalte rehte hain, par sadak khud apni jagah se kabhi nahi hilti.
Paheli: Ek jaanwar jo apna ghar apni peeth par liye ghumta hai — kaun?
Jawab hai: Kachhua. Kachhue ka kathor khol (shell) hi uska ghar hai — khatre ke samay wo apna sir-pair andar kar leta hai. Ghongha (snail) bhi apna ghar peeth par liye ghumta hai.
Paheli sunao: Safed hoon, meetha hoon, paani me ghul jau — main kya?
Jawab hai: Cheeni (shakkar). Safed hoti hai, meethi hoti hai, aur paani me daalte hi ghul jati hai — dikhai bhi nahi deti par swaad de jati hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ram ke paas 3 aam hain, Shyam ne 2 le liye, to Ram ke paas kitne aam bache aur Shyam ke paas kitne hue?
Hisaab aasan hai: Ram ke paas 3 − 2 = 1 aam bacha, aur Shyam ke paas 2 aam ho gaye (agar pehle uske paas koi aam nahi tha). Kul aam phir bhi 3 hi rahe — aam badhe nahi, sirf haath badle!
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo bolta nahi par sab bata deta hai, sunta nahi par sab dikha deta hai?
Jawab hai: Aaina (sheesha). Aaina bolta nahi, par tumhari asal tasveer dikha deta hai. Ek aur jawab kitab bhi hai — kitab bolti nahi par bahut kuch sikha deti hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Bina pankh ke udu, bina aankh ke rou — main kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Baadal. Baadal bina pankh ke aakash me udta (behta) hai, aur 'rota' hai yani baarish girata hai — par uske paas aankhein nahi hoti.
Paheli: Mera munh nahi par main khaata hoon, mera pet nahi par main badhta hoon — kaun?
Jawab hai: Aag. Aag lakdi-koyle ko 'khati' hai aur badhti jati hai, par uske paas na munh hai na pet.
Paheli sunao: Ek haathi ko fridge me rakhne ke kitne kadam (steps) hain?

Mazedaar jawab hai: Teen kadam — (1) Fridge kholo, (2) Haathi ko andar rakho, (3) Fridge band kar do. Ye paheli hasne ke liye hai — asal me to haathi fridge me aayega hi nahi, par jawab ki chaturai hi maza hai!
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo garam karne par jam jata hai?
Jawab hai: Anda. Thanda anda behta hua (liquid) hota hai, par garam (ubalne) par wo thos jam jata hai. Aam taur par cheezein garam hokar pighalti hain, anda iska ulta udaharan hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ek kamre me 3 bulb hain aur bahar 3 switch. Tum sirf ek baar kamre me ja sakte ho. Kaise pata karoge kaunsa switch kis bulb ka hai?

Chatur tareeka: Pehle switch ko kuch der on rakhkar band kar do. Dusre switch ko on karke kamre me jao. Jo bulb jal raha hai wo dusre switch ka; jo bulb band par garam hai wo pehle switch ka (kyunki wo der tak jala tha); jo thanda aur band hai wo teesre switch ka. Garmi yahan sanket (clue) hai!
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo sirf aage badhta hai, peeche kabhi nahi jata?
Jawab hai: Samay (waqt). Samay hamesha aage hi badhta hai — jo pal beet gaya wo wapas nahi aata. Isiliye kehte hain samay sabse keemti hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Jiski poonch kat jaye to wo phir ugti hai — kaun sa jaanwar?

Jawab hai: Chipkali (girgit nahi, ghar wali chipkali). Chipkali apni poonch khud chhod sakti hai taaki dushman poonch me ulajha rahe aur wo bhaag jaye; kuch hafto me nayi poonch ug aati hai, halanki wo pehle jitni lambi nahi hoti.
Paheli: Chhota sa sipahi, laal topi pehne, ek taang par khada — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Khumbi (mushroom). Khumbi ka upar wala hissa topi jaisa dikhta hai aur wo ek hi danthal (ek taang) par khadi hoti hai. Baarish ke mausam me ye khaali jagaho par ug aati hai.
Paheli sunao: Wo kya hai jo tum dekh sakte ho par chhoo nahi sakte, aur wo hamesha tumhare saath chalta hai?
Jawab hai: Parchhayi. Roshni ho to parchhayi saath chalti hai, par use pakda ya chhua nahi ja sakta. Andhere me wo gayab ho jati hai — kyunki wo roshni ki kami se banti hai.

Konark Surya Mandir ke baare me batao
Konark Surya Mandir Odisha me sthit 13vi shatabdi ka mandir hai jo surya dev ke rath ke aakar me bana hai — isme patthar ke bade pahiye aur ghode bane hain. Ise 'Black Pagoda' bhi kaha jata tha.
Konark Surya Mandir kahan hai aur kyun prasiddh hai?
Konark Surya Mandir — Odisha me sthit 13vi shatabdi ka mandir hai jo surya dev ke rath ke aakar me bana hai — isme patthar ke bade pahiye aur ghode bane hain. Ise 'Black Pagoda' bhi kaha jata tha.
Bharat me kul kitni bhashayein boli jati hain?

Bharat me 22 bhashao ko samvidhan me adhikarik manyata (scheduled languages) mili hai — jinme Hindi, Bangla, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu, Gujarati, Malayalam, Kannada, Odia aadi shamil hain. Asal me Bharat me sainkadon bhashayein aur hazaro boliyan boli jati hain — isiliye kaha jata hai ki Bharat me har kuch kilometer par bhasha aur paani ka swaad badal jata hai.
Bharat ki rashtrabhasha aur rajbhasha me kya farak hai?

Ek aam galatfehmi door kar lo: Bharat ki koi rashtrabhasha (national language) ghoshit nahi hai. Hindi aur Angrezi kendra sarkar ki rajbhasha (official language) hain — sarkari kaam inme hota hai. Har rajya apni rajbhasha khud chun sakta hai. Bharat ki takat hi uski bhashao ki vividhata hai.
Bharat ka sabse bada rajya kaunsa hai?

Kshetrafal (area) ke hisaab se Bharat ka sabse bada rajya Rajasthan hai. Jansankhya (population) ke hisaab se sabse bada rajya Uttar Pradesh hai — wahan ki aabadi kai desho se bhi zyada hai. Sabse chhota rajya kshetrafal me Goa hai.
Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi kaun si hai?

Bharat ke andar behne wali sabse lambi nadi Ganga hai — lagbhag 2,525 kilometer. Kul lambai ke hisaab se Sindhu aur Brahmaputra aur bhi lambi hain, par unka bada hissa dusre desho me behta hai. Dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi Godavari hai, use 'Dakshin Ganga' bhi kehte hain.
Bharat ka rashtriya pashu aur pakshi kaun hai?

Bharat ka rashtriya pashu Bengal tiger (baagh) hai aur rashtriya pakshi mor hai. Rashtriya phool kamal, rashtriya ped bargad, aur rashtriya nadi Ganga hai. Rashtriya geet 'Vande Mataram' aur rashtra gaan 'Jana Gana Mana' hai.
Jana Gana Mana kisne likha tha?

Bharat ka rashtra gaan 'Jana Gana Mana' Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore ne likha tha. Ye pehli baar 1911 me gaya gaya tha aur 1950 me ise rashtra gaan ke roop me apnaya gaya. Ise gaane ka aadarsh samay lagbhag 52 second hai. Tagore ekmatra vyakti hain jinhone do desho (Bharat aur Bangladesh) ke rashtra gaan likhe.
Tirange ke rangon ka kya matlab hai?

Bharat ke jhande ke teen rang: upar kesariya — tyag aur shakti ka prateek; beech me safed — satya aur shanti; neeche hara — samriddhi aur bhoomi se sambandh. Beech me bane navy neele Ashok Chakra me 24 teeliyan (spokes) hoti hain — ye batata hai ki jeevan me gatishilta hi satya hai, rukna nahi chahiye. Tirange ko Kendra me pehli baar 15 August 1947 ko fehraya gaya.
Bharat kab azaad hua aur pehle Pradhan Mantri kaun the?

Bharat 15 August 1947 ko angrezon ki gulami se azaad hua. Bharat ke pehle Pradhan Mantri Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru the, aur pehle Rashtrapati Dr. Rajendra Prasad the. Azaadi ki ladai me Mahatma Gandhi ke netratva me ahinsa ka rasta apnaya gaya tha.
Mahatma Gandhi ko Bapu kyun kehte hain?

Mahatma Gandhi ne Bharat ko ahinsa aur satya ke raste par azaadi dilane me sabse badi bhoomika nibhai. Unke tyag aur sadgi ke kaaran desh ne unhe 'Bapu' (pita) aur 'Rashtrapita' ki upadhi di. Unka janm 2 October 1869 ko Gujarat ke Porbandar me hua tha. Unhone hamesha kaha tha — 'Mera jeevan hi mera sandesh hai.'
Delhi Bharat ki rajdhani kab bani?

Delhi ko 1911 me angrezon ne Bharat ki rajdhani ghoshit kiya (us se pehle rajdhani Kolkata thi), aur Nai Delhi ka nirmaan uske baad hua. Azaadi ke baad bhi Delhi hi Bharat ki rajdhani rahi. Rashtrapati Bhavan aur Sansad Bhavan Nai Delhi me hi sthit hain.
Mumbai ko sapno ka shahar kyun kehte hain?

Mumbai Bharat ki aarthik rajdhani hai — yahan Bombay Stock Exchange, bade bank aur film industry (Bollywood) hai. Roz hazaro log rozgaar aur sapno ke liye yahan aate hain, isiliye ise 'sapno ka shahar' (City of Dreams) kehte hain. Mumbai ki local train ko shahar ki 'jeevan rekha' kaha jata hai kyunki roz lakhon log usse safar karte hain.
Kolkata ke baare me batao

Kolkata Paschim Bengal ki rajdhani hai aur kabhi angrezon ke samay Bharat ki rajdhani bhi raha. Ye apni sanskriti, mithaas (rasgulla), Howrah Bridge aur tram ke liye prasiddh hai. Kolkata ko 'City of Joy' bhi kehte hain. Durga Puja yahan ka sabse bada tyohar hai, jo UNESCO ki sanskritik virasat soochi me bhi shamil hai.
Chennai ke baare me batao

Chennai Tamil Nadu ki rajdhani hai aur Bharat ke sabse purane bade shahro me se ek hai. Ye apne mandiro, Marina Beach (duniya ke sabse lambe shahari samundar taton me se ek), film industry aur auto udyog ke liye jana jata hai. Chennai ko dakshin Bharat ka sanskritik kendra mana jata hai.
Bengaluru ko Silicon Valley of India kyun kehte hain?

Bengaluru (Karnataka) me Bharat ki sabse badi IT companiyan aur startups hain — jaise America ki Silicon Valley me hoti hain, isiliye ise 'Bharat ki Silicon Valley' kehte hain. Yahan ke mausam ko bhi bahut sukhad mana jata hai, aur ise 'Garden City' bhi kaha jata hai kyunki yahan bahut saare bagh hain.
Bharat ke char dham kaun se hain?

Hindu dharm ke char dham hain: Badrinath (Uttarakhand), Dwarka (Gujarat), Puri (Odisha) aur Rameshwaram (Tamil Nadu) — ye chaaro Bharat ki chaar dishaon me sthit hain. Iske alawa Uttarakhand ke chaar chhote dham — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath aur Badrinath — bhi bahut prasiddh hain.
Cricket me ek over me kitni gendein hoti hain?

Ek over me 6 sahi (legal) gendein hoti hain. Wide aur no-ball in 6 me nahi gini jati — wo dobara dalni padti hai. T20 match me har team ko 20 over (120 gendein) milte hain, aur ek gendbaaz zyada se zyada 4 over dal sakta hai.
LBW kya hota hai cricket me?

LBW ka matlab hai Leg Before Wicket. Jab gend seedha stump par lagne wali ho aur ballebaaz ke pair (ya shareer) beech me aa jaye, to umpire use out de sakta hai. Iske kuch niyam hain — gend kahan takrayi, kahan se aayi — isiliye LBW ke faisle par aksar DRS liya jata hai.
Wide ball kya hoti hai?

Jab gendbaaz ki gend ballebaaz se itni door (side me ya bahut upar) jaye ki wo aam taur par use khel na sake, to umpire use wide ghoshit karta hai. Wide par batting team ko 1 extra run milta hai aur wo gend over me gini bhi nahi jati — yani gendbaaz ko ek gend aur dalni padti hai.
No ball kya hoti hai aur free hit kya hai?

No ball tab hoti hai jab gendbaaz ka aage wala pair line (crease) se aage nikal jaye ya gend galat tareeke se dali jaye. No ball par batting team ko 1 extra run milta hai aur wo gend gini nahi jati. Ek din aur T20 cricket me no ball ke baad wali gend 'free hit' hoti hai — us par ballebaaz run-out ke alawa out nahi ho sakta, isliye wo bina dare bada shot khel sakta hai.
DRS kya hota hai cricket me?

DRS ka matlab hai Decision Review System. Jab kisi team ko umpire ka faisla galat lage, to wo use chunauti (review) de sakti hai. Phir TV umpire camera, ball-tracking aur sound technology se jaanch karke faisla deta hai. Har team ko seemit review milte hain, isliye soch-samajh kar istemal hota hai.
Test, ODI aur T20 me kya farak hai?

Test match 5 din tak chalta hai, dono teamein do-do baar batting karti hain aur safed kapdo me laal gend se khela jata hai — ye sabse purana aur mushkil format mana jata hai. ODI (One Day International) me har team ko 50 over milte hain. T20 me sirf 20 over hote hain — ye sabse tez aur manoranjan bhara format hai jo lagbhag 3-4 ghante me khatm ho jata hai.
Cricket me hat-trick kya hoti hai?

Jab koi gendbaaz lagatar teen gendo par teen ballebaazo ko out kar de, to use hat-trick kehte hain. Ye bahut hi durlabh aur khaas uplabdhi hoti hai. Dusri ore, ballebaaz ke liye lagatar chhakke marna bhi badi baat hoti hai — Yuvraj Singh ne 2007 me ek over me 6 chhakke mare the, jo aaj bhi sabko yaad hai.
Cricket World Cup Bharat ne kitni baar jeeta?

Bharat ne ODI World Cup do baar jeeta hai — 1983 me Kapil Dev ki kaptani me aur 2011 me Mahendra Singh Dhoni ki kaptani me. 2011 ka final Mumbai me khela gaya tha aur Dhoni ke chhakke ke saath jeet aaj bhi har Bharatiya ko yaad hai. T20 World Cup Bharat ne 2007 aur 2024 me jeeta.
Sachin Tendulkar ko cricket ka bhagwan kyun kehte hain?

Sachin Tendulkar ne 24 saal tak antarrashtriya cricket khela aur sabse zyada run aur sabse zyada shatak (100 shatak) banane ka record banaya. Unki mehnat, vinamrata aur lagatar pradarshan ke kaaran prashansak unhe pyaar se 'Cricket ka Bhagwan' aur 'Master Blaster' kehte hain. Unhe Bharat Ratna bhi mila hai — ye samman pane wale wo pehle khiladi hain.
Hockey me Bharat ka itihas kaisa hai?

Bharat hockey me duniya ka sabse safal desho me raha hai — Olympic me kul 8 swarna (gold) padak jeete hain, jo kisi bhi team ke liye record hai. Dhyan Chand jaise jadugar khiladi Bharat ne diye, jinki gend par chipki rehti thi aisa kaha jata hai. Unke janm din 29 August ko Bharat me Rashtriya Khel Diwas manaya jata hai.
Kabaddi khel kaise khela jata hai?

Kabaddi Bharat ka prachin khel hai. Ek khiladi (raider) dusri team ke hisse me jakar 'kabaddi-kabaddi' kehte hue virodhi khiladiyo ko chhukar wapas aane ki koshish karta hai — saans toote bina bolte rehna zaroori hai. Dusri team use pakadne ki koshish karti hai. Isme taakat, furti aur saans ka zabardast mel chahiye.
Football match kitne samay ka hota hai?

Football match kul 90 minute ka hota hai — 45-45 minute ke do hisse (half), beech me lagbhag 15 minute ka vishram. Aakhri me referee ruke hue samay ke badle kuch extra minute (stoppage time) jodta hai. Barabari par knock-out match me extra time aur penalty shootout se faisla hota hai. Ek team me 11 khiladi hote hain, jinme ek goalkeeper hota hai.
Olympic khel kya hote hain aur kitne saal me hote hain?

Olympic duniya ka sabse bada khel ayojan hai jisme hazaro khiladi sainkadon khelon me hissa lete hain. Ye har 4 saal me hota hai. Olympic ki shuruaat prachin Greece se hui thi; aadhunik Olympic 1896 se shuru hue. Olympic ke paanch ghare (rings) duniya ke bade mahadweepo aur ekta ke prateek hain.
Bharat ke kuch prasiddh khiladiyo ke naam batao

Bharat ke kuch bade khiladi: cricket me Sachin Tendulkar, MS Dhoni, Virat Kohli; hockey me Dhyan Chand; badminton me P. V. Sindhu; kushti me Bajrang Punia aur Sakshi Malik; mukkebaazi me Mary Kom; barchha phenk (javelin) me Neeraj Chopra — jinhone Olympic me swarna padak jeetkar itihas racha. In sab ne mehnat aur lagan se duniya me Bharat ka naam roshan kiya.
Phone ki screen tootne se bachane ke upay kya hain?

Achha cover aur tempered glass lagao — ye sabse sasta bachaav hai. Phone ko peeche ki jeb me rakhkar baithne se bacho, aur unchi jagah ke kinare par phone mat rakho. Phone ko dusre saaman (chaabi, sikke) ke saath ek hi jeb me rakhne se screen par kharonch aati hai. Girne par aksar kone se chot lagti hai, isliye kone wale cover behtar hote hain.
Mobile data kaise bachaye?

Data bachane ke upay: video ki quality kam (480p) par dekho; apps ki auto-update sirf WiFi par rakho; jo app zyada data khata hai uska background data band karo; WhatsApp me photo-video ka auto-download band karo; aur phone ka 'Data Saver' mode on kar do. Safar me offline map pehle se download kar lena bhi bada bachaav hai.
Phone slow ho jaye to kya kare?

Pehle phone ko restart karo — aadhi dikkat wahi theek ho jati hai. Storage lagbhag bhara ho to kuch jagah khaali karo (purani videos, bekar apps). Apps aur phone ka software update karo. Bahut purane phone me bekar apps hatana aur cache saaf karna bhi madad karta hai. Ant me, sab backup lekar factory reset ek antim upay hai.
Screenshot kaise lete hain phone me?

Zyadaatar Android phone me Power button aur Volume Down button ek saath dabane se screenshot banta hai. Kuch phone me teen ungliyon ko screen par neeche ghisne se bhi hota hai. Screenshot gallery me save ho jata hai. Lambi screenshot (scrolling) ka vikalp bhi kai phone me screenshot ke baad dikhai deta hai.
Phone kho jaye to sabse pehle kya kare?

Pehle kisi dusre phone se apne number par call karke dekho — aas paas ho to bajega. Phir Google ke 'Find My Device' se phone ki jagah dekho, lock karo ya zaroorat pade to data mita do. Bank aur UPI apps ke liye bank ko turant suchit karo aur SIM block karwao, kyunki OTP usi number par aata hai. Police me shikayat aur IMEI se phone block karwana bhi zaroori hai.
Public WiFi istemal karna surakshit hai?

Railway station ya cafe ke khule (open) WiFi par bank, UPI ya zaroori login wala kaam nahi karna chahiye — aise network par data churaya ja sakta hai. Aam browsing ke liye theek hai, par paise aur password wala kaam hamesha apne mobile data se karo. Apne aap judne (auto-connect) wala vikalp bhi band rakhna behtar hai.
Phone number badle bina WhatsApp dusre phone me kaise chalaye?

Jab naya phone lo, purane phone me WhatsApp ka backup (Google Drive par) on karke backup le lo. Naye phone me wahi number aur wahi Google account dalne par WhatsApp purana backup dhundh lega aur saari chats wapas aa jayengi. SIM wahi rehni chahiye kyunki OTP usi number par aata hai. Backup bina liye phone badalna matlab chats khona.
Email id ka password bhool jaye to kya kare?

Login page par 'Forgot password' par jao. Google tumse pehchan pakki karne ke liye phone par OTP ya dusra tareeka dega. Isiliye email me hamesha sahi mobile number aur recovery email jodkar rakho. Naya password majboot rakho aur kahin surakshit likhkar (ghar par) rakho. Kisi ajnabi ko password badalne ke liye paise mat do — ye seva muft aur khud karne wali hai.
Computer aur laptop me kya farak hai?

Computer (desktop) ek jagah rakhkar chalne wali machine hai — alag monitor, keyboard, CPU box. Laptop wahi sab ek halki band hone wali machine me hota hai, battery par chalta hai aur kahin bhi le jaya ja sakta hai. Kaam dono ek jaise kar sakte hain; desktop aam taur par sasta aur taqatwar hota hai, laptop suvidha ke liye behtar.
Pendrive kya hoti hai?

Pendrive (USB drive) ek chhota sa device hai jisme files — photo, video, document — rakhkar ek computer se dusre me le jayi ja sakti hain. Iski capacity GB me hoti hai. Ajnabi ki pendrive apne computer me lagane se virus aa sakta hai, isliye savdhaan raho. Aajkal cloud aur online bhejna zyada aasan ho gaya hai, par pendrive ab bhi kaam ki hai.
Video call ke liye kitna internet chahiye?

Aam video call ke liye lagbhag 1-3 Mbps ki speed kaafi hoti hai. Speed kam ho to video rukti hai ya dhundhli ho jati hai — aise me camera band karke sirf awaaz par baat karne se call saaf chalti hai. Group call aur HD quality ke liye zyada speed aur data chahiye. WiFi par video call karna data bachata hai.
Phone me airplane mode on karke charge karne se kya hota hai?

Haan, ek chhota fayda hai: airplane mode me network band rehta hai isliye phone kam taakat khata hai aur charging thodi tez ho jati hai, phone kam garam hota hai. Par is dauraan koi call ya message nahi aayega. Roz aisa karna zaroori nahi, bas jaldi ho to ye ek chhota upay hai.
2G 3G 4G 5G me G ka kya matlab hai?

G ka matlab hai Generation — yani peedhi. Har nayi peedhi ke saath speed aur suvidha badhti gayi: 2G me sirf baat aur message, 3G me dheema internet, 4G me tez internet aur video, aur 5G me usse kai guna zyada speed aur turant jawab. Purane network dheere-dheere band ho rahe hain taaki nayi technology ko jagah mile.
Samundar ka paani khara kyun hota hai?

Nadiyan behte hue mitti aur chattano se namak aur khanij ghulakar samundar me le jati hain. Samundar ka paani bhaap bankar udta hai par namak wahi reh jata hai. Lakhon saalo se ye namak judta gaya, isliye samundar ka paani khara ho gaya. Nadi ka paani isiliye meetha lagta hai kyunki wo behta rehta hai aur namak zyada nahi judta.
Aag jalne ke liye hawa kyun chahiye?

Aag ko jalne ke liye teen cheezein chahiye: tel/lakdi jaisi jalne wali cheez, garmi, aur hawa ki oxygen. In teeno ko 'aag ka trikon' kehte hain. Inme se ek bhi hata do to aag bujh jayegi — isiliye aag par kambal dalne ya paani dalne se wo bujh jati hai: kambal hawa rok deta hai, paani garmi kam kar deta hai.
Barf paani me tairti kyun hai?

Aam taur par thanda hone par cheezein sikudti hain, par paani ek ajeeb apvaad hai — jamne par wo phailta hai. Isse barf ka vajan usi aakar ke paani se kam (halki) ho jati hai, isliye barf paani me tairti hai. Isi khaasiyat ke kaaran talab ki upar wali barf ke neeche machhliyan jeevit reh pati hain.
Bulb jalne par garam kyun ho jata hai?

Purane balbon me bijli ek bareek taar (filament) se guzarti hai; taar itna garam ho jata hai ki chamakne lagta hai — zyada urja garmi me barbad hoti hai. LED bulb me roshni bina zyada garmi ke banti hai, isliye LED kam bijli khata hai aur kam garam hota hai. Isiliye ghar me LED lagana bijli ke bill ke liye achha hai.
Ped ke patte hare kyun hote hain?

Patto me chlorophyll naam ka hari cheez (pigment) hoti hai, jo khana banane (photosynthesis) ke liye roshni pakadti hai. Chlorophyll hare rang ko paraavartit (reflect) karta hai aur dusre rango ko sokh leta hai, isliye patte hare dikhte hain. Patjhad me chlorophyll khatm hone par patto ke dusre rang — peela, narangi — dikhne lagte hain.
Aasman me taare timtimate kyun hain?

Taare asal me nahi timtimate — ye dharti ke vayumandal ka khel hai. Taare ki roshni ko hawa ki alag-alag garam-thandi parato se guzarna padta hai, jahan wo baar-baar mudti (refract) hoti hai. Isse roshni kabhi tez kabhi kam lagti hai aur taara timtimata dikhta hai. Antariksh se taare sthir chamakte hain.
Suraj purab se kyun ugta hai?

Suraj asal me kahin nahi jata — dharti apni dhuri par paschim se purab ki ore ghumti hai. Is ghumne ke kaaran humein lagta hai ki suraj purab se ug raha hai aur paschim me doob raha hai. Ye bilkul waisa hi hai jaise chalti train me baithe hue ped peeche ki ore bhaagte dikhte hain, halanki ped apni jagah par hi hote hain.
Insaan ko neend kyun aati hai?

Neend shareer aur dimaag ki marammat ka samay hai. Din bhar ke kaam se dimaag thakta hai aur shareer me thakan wale tatva judte hain — neend me dimaag yaadon ko pakka karta hai, shareer ki marammat hoti hai aur urja wapas banti hai. Bado ko roz 7-8 ghante ki neend chahiye; neend kam ho to dhyaan, yaaddaasht aur sehat sab par asar padta hai.
Humein bhookh kyun lagti hai?

Jab pet khaali hota hai aur shareer ki urja kam hone lagti hai, to pet aur shareer dimaag ko sanket bhejte hain — yahi bhookh hai. Ye shareer ka batane ka tareeka hai ki ab khana chahiye. Samay par aur sahi khana khane se urja bani rehti hai; bahut der tak bhooka rehna sehat ke liye achha nahi.
Paseena kyun aata hai?

Paseena shareer ko thanda rakhne ka prakritik tareeka hai. Jab shareer garam hota hai — garmi, kaam ya bukhar se — to twacha se paseena nikalta hai; jaise hi wo hawa se udta (sookhta) hai, shareer ki garmi saath le jata hai aur thandak milti hai. Paseene ke saath paani aur namak bhi nikalta hai, isliye zyada paseene par paani peete rehna chahiye.
Baale (hair) safed kyun ho jate hain?

Baalon ko rang dene wali cheez (melanin) umar ke saath kam hone lagti hai; jab rang banna band ho jata hai to baal safed dikhne lagte hain. Ye aam taur par umar ke saath hota hai, par kuch logo ke baal tanav, khaan-paan ya vansh (parivaar) ke kaaran jaldi bhi safed ho sakte hain. Ye ek prakritik prakriya hai, beemari nahi.
Hichki kyun aati hai?

Hichki tab aati hai jab saans se judi manspeshi (diaphragm) achanak sikud jati hai aur gala band hone se 'hik' ki awaaz banti hai. Jaldi khana, zyada khana ya tez hansi iski aam wajah hain. Aam taur par hichki kuch minute me khud ruk jati hai; paani peena ya saans thodi der rokna madad kar sakta hai. Bahut lambe samay tak hichki na ruke to doctor ko dikhana chahiye.
Jamhai (yawning) kyun aati hai?

Jamhai aksar thakan, neend ya ubaasi (bore hone) par aati hai — gehari saans lene se dimaag ko zyada oxygen aur thandak milti hai aur hum thoda satark ho jate hain. Dilchasp baat: jamhai sankramak hoti hai — dusre ko jamhai lete dekhkar ya uske baare me padhkar bhi jamhai aa jati hai, jaise abhi tumhe aa sakti hai!
Aankh jhapkana kyun zaroori hai?

Hum har kuch second me aankh jhapkate hain — isse aankh ki satah par aansu ki halki parat phailti hai jo aankh ko nam aur saaf rakhti hai aur dhul se bachati hai. Screen dekhte samay hum kam jhapkate hain, isiliye aankhein sookhti aur thakti hain. Har 20 minute me thoda door dekhna aur aankhein jhapkana aankho ke liye achha hai.
Dard kya hota hai, shareer dard kyun mehsoos karta hai?

Dard shareer ka chetaavni sanket hai — ye batata hai ki kahin chot ya gadbad hai taaki hum us hisse ko bachayein. Chot wali jagah se sanket dimaag tak jata hai aur dimaag use dard ke roop me mehsoos karata hai. Dard ko dabana hi ilaaj nahi hota; wajah jaanna zaroori hai. Lagatar ya tez dard ho to doctor ko zaroor dikhao — main ilaaj nahi bata sakta, sirf aam jaankari de sakta hoon.
Bukhar kyun hota hai?

Bukhar asal me shareer ki raksha pranali hai. Bharat ka sabse uncha pahaad kaunsa hai?

Bharat ka sabse uncha pahaad Kangchenjunga hai (lagbhag 8,586 meter), jo Sikkim me sthit hai. Duniya ka sabse uncha pahaad Mount Everest (8,849 meter) hai jo Nepal me hai. Himalaya ko 'barf ka ghar' kaha jata hai aur ye Bharat ko uttar ki thandi hawao se bhi bachata hai.
Bharat me sabse zyada baarish kahan hoti hai?

Bharat ke Meghalaya rajya ke Mawsynram gaon me duniya bhar me sabse zyada ausat baarish hoti hai. Paas ka Cherrapunji bhi baarish ke liye bahut prasiddh hai. Meghalaya ka matlab hi hai 'baadalo ka ghar' — wahan ke log baarish se bachne ke liye baans ki khaas chhatri (knup) istemal karte hain.
