Bharat ki sabse purani bhasha kaun si mani jati hai?

Tamil ko Bharat ki sabse purani jeevit bhashao me se ek mana jata hai — iska sahitya hazaro saal purana hai. Sanskrit bhi bahut prachin bhasha hai jisse kai Bharatiya bhashao ke shabd aaye hain. Bharat ki har bhasha apne aap me ek khazana hai.
Holi kyun manayi jati hai?

Holi rango ka tyohar hai jo vasant (spring) ke aagman par manaya jata hai. Isse judi prasiddh katha bhakt Prahlad aur Holika ki hai — jisme achhai ki jeet hui thi, isiliye Holi se pehle raat Holika dahan hota hai. Holi par log purani kadwahat bhulakar rang-gulal se ek dusre ko milte hain.
Guru Nanak Dev ji ke baare me batao

Guru Nanak Dev ji Sikh dharm ke sansthapak aur pehle Guru the. Unhone 'Ek Onkar' — ek ishwar — aur sabki barabari ka sandesh diya. Unhone langar ki pratha shuru ki jahan sab ek saath baithkar khana khate hain, chahe koi bhi jaati ya dharm ka ho. Unka janm din Gurpurab ke roop me manaya jata hai.
Bharat ka rashtriya geet kaunsa hai aur kisne likha?

Bharat ka rashtriya geet 'Vande Mataram' hai, jo Bankim Chandra Chatterjee ne apne prasiddh upanyas 'Anandamath' me likha tha. Azaadi ki ladai me ye geet sangharsh ka naara ban gaya tha. Dhyaan do: rashtra gaan (Jana Gana Mana) aur rashtriya geet (Vande Mataram) dono alag hain aur dono ko barabar samman mila hai.
Bharat me pehli train kab chali thi?

Bharat me pehli train 16 April 1853 ko Mumbai se Thane ke beech chali thi — doori lagbhag 34 kilometer thi. Aaj Bharatiya Rail duniya ke sabse bade rail network me se ek hai aur roz karodo log isse safar karte hain. Rail ko Bharat ki 'jeevan rekha' kaha jata hai.
Bharat ka sabse bada dam (bandh) kaunsa hai?

Bhakra Nangal bandh Bharat ke sabse prasiddh aur bade bandho me se ek hai, jo Punjab-Himachal ki seema par Sutlej nadi par bana hai. Jawaharlal Nehru ne bandho ko 'aadhunik Bharat ke mandir' kaha tha kyunki inse bijli, sinchai aur paani ki suvidha milti hai. Unchai ke hisaab se Tehri bandh (Uttarakhand) Bharat ka sabse uncha bandh hai.
Bharat me kitne rajya aur kendra shasit pradesh hain?

Bharat me 28 rajya aur 8 kendra shasit pradesh (Union Territories) hain (2026 ki sthiti ke anusar). Rajya ki apni chuni hui sarkar hoti hai, jabki kendra shasit pradesh seedha kendra sarkar ke niyantran me hote hain (kuch me apni vidhan sabha bhi hai, jaise Delhi).
Sardar Patel ko Lauh Purush kyun kehte hain?

Azaadi ke samay Bharat me 560 se zyada chhoti-badi riyasatein thi. Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ne apni buddhi aur dridh ichha se un sab ko Bharat me milaya — bina is ke Bharat tukdo me banta rehta. Isi lohe jaise irade ke kaaran unhe 'Lauh Purush' (Iron Man) kaha jata hai.
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam ke baare me batao

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Bharat ke prasiddh vaigyanik aur poorv Rashtrapati the. Unhone Bharat ke missile aur antariksh karyakram ko aage badhaya, isiliye unhe 'Missile Man' kehte hain. Wo ek garib parivaar se aakar apni mehnat se is unchai tak pahunche. Unki kitab 'Wings of Fire' lakhon yuvao ko prerit karti hai. Unka prasiddh kathan hai — 'Sapne wo nahi jo neend me aate hain, sapne wo hain jo neend udaa dein.'
WhatsApp par kisi ko block karne se kya hota hai?

Jise tum block karte ho, wo tumhe message ya call nahi kar sakta, aur use tumhara profile photo aur last seen bhi nahi dikhega. Block karna tumhara adhikar hai — pareshan karne wale ya ajnabi number ko bina soche block kar do. Dhokhe wale number ki report bhi WhatsApp me ki ja sakti hai.
Phone ka software (Android) kya hota hai?

Android ek operating system hai — woh mukhya software jo pure phone ko chalata hai: screen, apps, settings sab usi ke under hota hai. Jaise ghar ka malik sab sambhalta hai, waise Android phone ko sambhalta hai. Google ise banata hai aur har saal naye version ke saath behtar suvidha aur suraksha lata hai.
Play Store ke bahar se app lena khatarnak kyun hai?

Play Store par apps ki jaanch (scan) hoti hai; bahar ki websites se mili APK file me virus ya data churane wala code ho sakta hai, aur koi jaanch bhi nahi hoti. 'Muft me premium app' wale lalach wale link sabse zyada khatarnak hote hain. Hamesha apps sirf Play Store se hi lo.
Mobile number port karna kya hota hai?

Port karne ka matlab hai apna purana number rakhte hue company (jaise Jio se Airtel) badal lena. Iske liye ek khaas code (UPC) manga jata hai jo SMS se milta hai. Port ke dauraan OTP aata hai — wo code sirf company ki asli prakriya me do; koi ajnabi mange to samjho dhokha hai.
Bank ka kaam phone se karna surakshit hai?

Haan, agar savdhaani rakho to: bank ka app sirf Play Store se lo; app par lock (PIN/fingerprint) rakho; public WiFi par bank ka kaam mat karo; OTP kisi ko mat do; aur har len-den ke SMS ko padha karo. Galat len-den dikhe to turant bank ko suchit karo. Suraksha tumhare haath me sabse zyada hai.
Fingerprint lock kitna surakshit hai?

Fingerprint lock aam istemal ke liye bahut surakshit aur aasan hai kyunki har insaan ki ungliyo ke nishan alag hote hain. Par iska matlab ye nahi ki PIN ki zaroorat nahi — phone restart hone par PIN hi manga jata hai. Majboot PIN aur fingerprint dono saath rakhna sabse behtar suraksha hai.
Phone me do SIM ka fayda kya hai?

Do SIM se tum do number ek phone me rakh sakte ho — jaise ek ghar ka, ek kaam ka; ya ek me sasta data pack, dusre me baat-cheet ka plan. Safar me dusre ilaake ki SIM bhi lagayi ja sakti hai. Dhyaan rahe, do SIM chalane se battery thodi zyada kharch hoti hai.
Internet bina phone ka GPS kaise chal sakta hai?

GPS signal seedha satellites se aata hai, iske liye mobile network ya internet ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Internet sirf map ki tasveer load karne aur raaste ki live jaankari (traffic) ke liye chahiye. Isiliye offline map pehle se download kar lo to bina net ke bhi navigation chal sakta hai.
Voice assistant kya hota hai?

Voice assistant (jaise Google Assistant ya Siri) ek AI software hai jo tumhari boli hui baat samajhkar kaam karta hai — call lagana, alarm rakhna, gaana bajana, sawal ka jawab dena. Ye pehle awaaz ko text me badalta hai, fir uska matlab samajhkar kaam karta hai aur bolkar jawab deta hai. Hindi me bhi ab ye kaafi achhe se kaam karte hain.
Video download karna aur streaming me kya farak hai?

Streaming me video internet se aate-aate hi chalta hai — file phone me save nahi hoti, aur net band to video band. Download me puri file phone me save ho jati hai, fir bina net ke bhi dekh sakte ho. Streaming turant shuru hoti hai, download me pehle intezaar par baad me suvidha rehti hai.
Mobile recharge aur data pack me dhokha kaise hota hai?

Dhokhebaz nakli website ya app banakar 'sasta recharge' ka lalach dete hain; paisa le lete hain par recharge nahi hota. Kuch log call karke 'offer activate karne ke liye OTP batao' kehte hain — ye bhi dhokha hai. Hamesha company ke asli app ya bharosemand app se hi recharge karo, aur OTP kabhi mat do.
Phone par baat karte samay dusra call aaye to use kya kehte hain aur kaise kaam karta hai?

Ise 'call waiting' kehte hain. Ye suvidha on ho to baat-cheet ke dauraan dusri call aane par halki beep sunti hai aur screen par dikhta hai — tum pehli call ko hold par rakhkar dusri utha sakte ho. Ye suvidha settings me jakar on karni padti hai; aam taur par ye muft hoti hai.
Ped raat ko oxygen kyun nahi dete din ki tarah?

Din me ped photosynthesis se oxygen chhodte hain. Raat me roshni nahi hoti, isliye ye prakriya ruk jati hai aur ped bhi dusre jeevo ki tarah saans me oxygen lekar carbon dioxide chhodte hain — par bahut kam matra me. Isiliye ye kehna ki raat ko ped ke neeche sona khatarnak hai, atishyokti hai; khaali band kamre me bahut saare paudhe hon to baat alag hai.
Aasmaan me sabse chamkeela taara kaunsa hai?

Raat ke aasmaan me sabse chamkeela taara Sirius (Vyaadh taara) hai. Ye humse lagbhag 8.6 prakash-varsh door hai. Iske alawa Shukra grah aksar taare se zyada chamakta hai, par wo grah hai taara nahi — use subah ya shaam ko dekha ja sakta hai.
Prakash varsh kya hota hai?

Prakash varsh doori napne ki ikai hai — samay nahi! Ek saal me roshni jitni doori tay karti hai (lagbhag 9.46 lakh crore kilometer), use ek prakash varsh kehte hain. Taare itne door hain ki unki doori kilometer me likhna mushkil hai, isliye prakash varsh ka istemal hota hai.
Dharti par sabse gehra samundar hissa kaunsa hai?

Prashant Mahasagar (Pacific Ocean) me sthit Mariana Trench dharti ka sabse gehra samudri hissa hai — lagbhag 11 kilometer gehra. Itna gehra ki Mount Everest ko isme rakha jaye to wo poori tarah doob jayega aur upar phir bhi paani bachega. Wahan poora andhera aur bhayankar dabaav hota hai, phir bhi kuch khaas jeev wahan jeete hain.
Sabse tez daudne wala, tairne wala aur udne wala jaanwar kaun hai?

Zameen par sabse tez cheetah hai. Paani me sabse tez machhliyo me sailfish bahut tez tairti hai. Aasmaan me sabse tez pakshi peregrine falcon (baaz ki ek prajati) hai — shikaar ke liye gotakhor (dive) lagate samay ye 300 kilometer prati ghanta se zyada ki speed pakad sakta hai, jo kisi bhi jeev ki sabse tez raftaaron me se hai.
Insaan ke shareer me sabse badi haddi aur sabse chhoti haddi kaun si hai?

Sabse badi aur mazboot haddi jaangh ki haddi (femur) hai. Sabse chhoti haddi kaan ke andar hoti hai, jise stapes kehte hain — ye chaawal ke daane se bhi chhoti hoti hai aur sunne me madad karti hai. Dono haddiyan apne-apne kaam me barabar mahatvapurna hain.
Hum khana kyun khate hain, khana shareer me kya karta hai?

Khana shareer ka indhan (fuel) hai. Pachan ke dwara khana chhote tatvo me tut-ta hai: kuch se urja milti hai (jaise chawal, roti ke carbohydrates), kuch se shareer banta aur marammat hoti hai (dal, doodh, ande ke protein), aur kuch se shareer ki raksha hoti hai (phal-sabzi ke vitamin). Santulit khana — sab kuch sahi matra me — sehat ki neev hai.
Paani peena kyun zaroori hai?

Humare shareer ka lagbhag 60% hissa paani hai. Paani khoon ko behne yogya rakhta hai, khana pachane me madad karta hai, paseene se taapman theek rakhta hai aur gandagi peshab ke dwara bahar nikalta hai. Kam paani peene se thakan, sir dard aur gurde ki dikkat ho sakti hai. Aam taur par din me 6-8 glass paani peena achha mana jata hai, garmi aur kaam ke hisaab se zyada bhi.
Suraj ki roshni se vitamin D kaise milta hai?

Jab suraj ki kirnein (khaas taur par UVB) humari twacha par padti hain, to twacha me maujood ek tatva se shareer vitamin D banata hai. Vitamin D haddiyon ke liye zaroori calcium ko shareer me sokhne me madad karta hai. Subah ki halki dhoop me kuch samay bitana iske liye faydemand hai; tez dopahar ki dhoop me zyada der rehna twacha ke liye nuksandeh ho sakta hai.
Chai ya coffee peene se neend kyun udti hai?

Chai aur coffee me caffeine naam ka tatva hota hai jo dimaag ko jagaye rakhta hai — ye neend lane wale sanketo ko kuch samay ke liye rok deta hai. Isiliye raat ko chai-coffee peene se neend der se aati hai. Zyada caffeine se ghabrahat aur neend ki gadbad ho sakti hai, isliye seemit matra hi theek hai.
Sabun se haath dhona kyun zaroori hai?

Humare haatho par din bhar me bahut saare keetanu lag jate hain jo dikhai nahi dete. Sabun ke kan keetanuon aur tel-gandagi ko todkar paani ke saath behne layak bana dete hain — sirf paani se ye kaam aadha hota hai. Khana khane se pehle aur bahar se aane ke baad sabun se haath dhona bahut si beemariyo se bachata hai.
Frige (refrigerator) khana thanda kaise rakhta hai?

Fridge ke andar ek gas wala chakra chalta hai jo andar ki garmi ko kheenchkar peeche se bahar nikal deta hai — isiliye fridge ke peeche garmi mehsoos hoti hai. Thande me keetanu bahut dheere badhte hain, isliye khana zyada din tak kharab nahi hota. Fridge ka darwaza baar-baar kholne se thandak nikalti hai aur bijli zyada kharch hoti hai.
Pankha ghoomkar hawa kaise deta hai?

Pankhe ke blade (pankh) tedhe-medhe aakar ke hote hain. Jab motor unhe ghumati hai, to blade hawa ko kaatkar neeche ki ore dhakelte hain — isse hum tak tez hawa aati hai aur paseena sookhkar thandak lagti hai. Dhyaan do: pankha kamre ko asal me thanda nahi karta, wo sirf humare shareer ko thandak ka ehsaas deta hai.
Baarish ke baad mitti ki sondhi khushboo kyun aati hai?

Soondhi mitti ki khushboo ko 'petrichor' kehte hain. Sookhi mitti me kuch khaas tel aur ek prakar ke jeevanu (bacteria) ke tatva hote hain; baarish ki boondein padte hi ye hawa me udkar humari naak tak pahuchte hain. Insaan ki naak is khushboo ko bahut door se aur halki matra me bhi pehchan sakti hai.
Samundar ki lehar kaise banti hai?

Zyadaatar lehrein hawa se banti hain — samundar ki satah par behne wali hawa paani ko dhakelkar chhoti-badi lehrein banati hai. Hawa jitni tez aur jitni door tak behti hai, lehrein utni badi hoti hain. Kinare par aakar lehrein toot-ti hain kyunki neeche ka hissa zameen se ragad khata hai aur upar wala aage gir padta hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo hamesha aata hai par kabhi pahuchta nahi?
Jawab hai: Kal. Aane wala kal kabhi 'aaj' ban jata hai, 'kal' bankar kabhi nahi pahuchta. Isiliye jo kaam karna hai, aaj hi kar lo.
Paheli: Ek hi jagah par safed bhi hai aur beech me kaala bhi — wo kya hai?
Jawab hai: Aankh. Ek hi aankh me safed hissa hota hai aur uske beech me kaali putli hoti hai — dono ek saath, ek hi 'thaali' me!
Paheli bhoojho: Bina dhage ke mala, bina suraj ke roshni — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Taaro bhara aakash. Taare bina dhage ki mala jaise bikhre hain aur bina suraj ke bhi raat me roshni dete hain.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jise khaane se pehle todna padta hai?
Jawab hai: Anda. Anda bina tode khaya hi nahi ja sakta — pehle chhilka todna padta hai, tab andar ka khana milta hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ek ghadi me din bhar me kitni baar ghante aur minute ki suiyaan ek dusre ke upar aati hain?

Jawab hai: 22 baar. 12 ghante me suiyaan 11 baar milti hain (har ghante me ek baar nahi — 11 aur 1 ke beech wali milan agli avadhi me chali jati hai). Din ke 24 ghante me 11 + 11 = 22 baar. Sochne par majedaar lagta hai!
Paheli: Mere paas chaabi hai par taala nahi khulta, jagah hai par kamra nahi, enter hai par ja nahi sakte — main kya hoon?

Jawab hai: Computer ka keyboard. Usme 'keys' (chaabiyan) hoti hain par taala nahi khulta, 'space' bar hota hai par kamra nahi, aur 'enter' key hoti hai par andar nahi ja sakte. Angrezi shabdo par bani chatur paheli hai!
Paheli sunao: Wo kya hai jo poori duniya ghoomta hai par ek kone me hi rehta hai?
Jawab hai: Daak ticket (postage stamp). Chitthi par laga ticket duniya bhar ka safar karta hai, par khud chitthi ke ek kone me hi chipka rehta hai.
Paheli: Usko dekha to dekha, na dekha to andhera — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Roshni. Roshni ho to sab dikhta hai, na ho to andhera. Ek aur jawab aankh bhi mana jata hai — aankh khuli to duniya dikhi, band to andhera.
Dimagi sawal: 5 machhliyon me se 2 doob gayi, kitni bachi?
Trick sawal hai — machhliyan doobti nahi hain, wo paani me hi rehti hain! To 5 ki 5 machhliyan bachi. Paheliyon me shabdo ke jaal se bachna chahiye.
Paheli bhoojho: Ek ped par baithe kabootar — ek udda to kitne bache? Ped par 2 the.
Jawab hai: Ek bhi nahi bacha — ek udda to dusra bhi uske saath ud jata hai, kabootar jhund me udte hain. Par hisaab ki nazar se jawab 1 hai. Ye paheli hasne aur sochne dono ke liye hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo tum tod sakte ho bina chhuye?
Jawab hai: Vaada (promise) — vaade ko 'toda' jata hai par use chhua nahi ja sakta. Ek aur jawab: khamoshi bhi bina chhuye todi jati hai.
Paheli: Main jeevit nahi, par main badhta hoon; mere paas fefde nahi, par mujhe hawa chahiye — main kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Aag. Aag jeevit nahi hoti par badhti hai, use jalne ke liye hawa (oxygen) chahiye, aur paani padne se wo 'mar' jati hai.
Paheli sunao: Do bhai, ek jaisa rang-roop, ek chale to dusra bhi chale — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Jooto ka joda. Dono joote ek jaise hote hain aur chalte samay dono baari-baari chalte hain — ek ruke to safar ruk jata hai!
Paheli: Jitna zyada ho, utna kam dikhta hai — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Andhera. Andhera jitna zyada hota hai, cheezein utni kam dikhti hain. Roshni iska bilkul ulta hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ek saal ke kuch mahino me 30 din hote hain, kuch me 31. Kitne mahino me 28 din hote hain?
Jawab hai: Saare 12 mahino me 28 din hote hain! Sawal ye nahi ki 'sirf 28 din' — har mahine me 28 tarikh aati hi hai. Dhyaan se padhne wali paheli hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Wo kya hai jo bina bole sab kuch keh deta hai?
Jawab hai: Chehra (bhaav). Insaan ke chehre ke bhaav bina shabdo ke khushi, dukh aur gussa sab bata dete hain. Kitab bhi bina bole bahut kuch kehti hai.
Paheli: Ek haath se taali nahi bajti — par main ek haath se bhi bajta hoon, main kya?

Ye kahawat par bani paheli hai. Jawab hai: Chutki! Chutki ek haath ki ungliyo se bajti hai aur awaaz bhi karti hai. Kahawat ka matlab hai ki bade kaam akele nahi hote — par chutki iska mazedaar apvaad hai.
Paheli: Laal dibbi me khade hain kaale sipahi — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Machhis ki dibbi. Dibbi aksar laal rang ki hoti hai aur andar khadi kaale sire wali tilliyan sipahiyon ki tarah khadi lagti hain.
Paheli sunao: Kaale ghode par safed sawaar — kya hai?
Ye ek purani prasiddh paheli hai. Jawab hai: Tawa aur roti! Kaala tawa ghoda hai aur uspar sekhti safed roti sawaar. Ghar ki cheezo par bani paheliyan sabse mazedaar hoti hain.
Dimagi sawal: Agar kal ke baad wala din shukrawaar hai, to aaj kaunsa din hai?
Hisab lagao: Kal ke baad wala din = aaj + 2 din = Shukrawaar. To kal = Budhwaar + 1... seedha hisaab: aaj + 2 = Shukrawaar, matlab aaj = Budhwaar (Wednesday). Peeche ki ore ginna hi iska trick hai.
Aadhaar card ki jaankari kisi ke saath share karna kaisa hai?

Aadhaar tumhari pehchan ka sabse zaroori dastavej hai. Iska number ajnabiyo, nakli website ya call par mangne walo ko kabhi mat do — isse tumhare naam par dhokha ho sakta hai. Jahan Aadhaar dena zaroori ho, wahan 'masked Aadhaar' (jisme sirf aakhri 4 ank dikhte hain) istemal karo. Bank ya sarkar kabhi phone par Aadhaar OTP nahi mangti.
SIM swap dhokha kya hota hai?

SIM swap me chor jhoothe dastavej se tumhare number ki nayi SIM nikalwa leta hai — fir tumhare saare OTP use milne lagte hain aur bank khata khali ho sakta hai. Nishani: tumhare phone ka signal achanak gayab ho jana. Aisa ho to turant apni company aur bank ko suchit karo. Apne dastavej ki copy kisi ajnabi ko mat do.
Spam aur dhokhe wale SMS ki shikayat kaise kare?

Dhokhe wale call/SMS ki shikayat sarkari Sanchar Saathi portal aur cyber helpline 1930 par ki ja sakti hai. Apne phone me bhi number ko block aur report kar sakte ho. Paisa kat gaya ho to turant bank aur 1930 par khabar karo — pehle kuch ghanto me paisa rukne ki sambhavna sabse zyada hoti hai, isiliye der mat karo.
Smart TV kya hoti hai?

Smart TV wo TV hai jisme internet judta hai — isiliye uspar seedha YouTube, OTT apps (jaise Netflix, JioCinema) aur gaane wali apps chalti hain, bina alag set-top box ke. Ye aam TV me computer jaisi suvidha jod deti hai. Purani TV ko bhi ek chhote streaming stick se smart banaya ja sakta hai.
Podcast kya hota hai?

Podcast internet par milne wale bolte hue karyakram (audio show) hain — jaise radio, par tum apni pasand ka vishay jab chaho sun sakte ho: kahaniyan, khabrein, seekh, hasi. Ye aam taur par muft hote hain aur phone ke apps se sune jate hain. Safar ya kaam ke saath seekhne ka ye badhiya tareeka hai.
Voice typing kya hoti hai?

Voice typing me tum bolte ho aur phone use shabdo me likh deta hai. Keyboard par bane mic ke nishan ko dabakar Hindi ya English me bola ja sakta hai. Ye unke liye bahut kaam ki hai jinhe type karna mushkil lagta hai — bade-buzurg aaram se message bhej sakte hain. Bolne ke baad ek baar padhkar theek kar lena chahiye, kyunki kabhi-kabhi shabd galat pakda jata hai.
Dark mode kya hota hai?

Dark mode me apps aur phone ki screen ka rang halke ki jagah gehra (kaala/grehra) ho jata hai. Isse raat me aankho par zor kam padta hai aur kuch phone (OLED screen wale) me battery bhi bachti hai. Din ki tez roshni me halka (light) mode zyada saaf dikhta hai — pasand aur samay ke hisaab se badal sakte ho.
Buzurg logo ke liye phone aasan kaise banaye?

Kuch aasan badlav: Settings me aksharo ka size (font size) bada kar do; home screen par sirf zaroori apps (call, WhatsApp, camera) rakho; tez awaaz wala ringtone rakho; aur emergency number speed dial par rakho. Kuch phone me 'Easy Mode' hota hai jisse sab kuch bada aur saral ho jata hai. Voice typing sikha do to message bhejna aur bhi aasan ho jayega.
Roaming kya hota hai mobile me?

Jab tum apne rajya ya desh se bahar jate ho aur wahan dusri company ke network se judte ho, use roaming kehte hain. Bharat ke andar aajkal zyadaatar plans me roaming muft jaisi hai, par videsh me roaming bahut mehengi pad sakti hai — videsh jane se pehle khaas pack lo ya wahan ki SIM/WiFi ka istemal karo, aur data roaming band rakhna bhi ek upay hai.
Battery saver mode kya karta hai?

Battery saver on karne par phone apne aap kharch kam kar deta hai: screen ki roshni kam, background me apps ka kaam seemit, aur kuch suvidhaayein band. Isse bachi hui battery zyada samay chalti hai. Ye tab bahut kaam aata hai jab charger door ho aur phone chalaye rakhna zaroori ho.
Google Lens kya hota hai?

Google Lens ek aisi suvidha hai jisme camera se photo dikhakar jaankari milti hai — kisi paudhe ya jaanwar ka naam, kisi board ka anuvaad, ya kisi cheez ko internet par dhundhna. Ye photo ko pehchankar kaam karta hai. Ajnabi paudhe-mashroom ko sirf Lens ki jaankari par khaana surakshit nahi — pehchan ke liye ye madad hai, antim faisla nahi.
Emoji kya hote hain?

Emoji chhote-chhote chinh (tasveer wale nishan) hain jo message me bhaavna dikhane ke liye istemal hote hain — khushi, hasi, dukh, hairani. Ye shabdo ke saath milkar baat ko spasht aur mazedaar banate hain. Har emoji ka matlab samay aur jagah ke hisaab se badal sakta hai, isliye gambheer baato me zyada emoji se bacho.
Mirchi teekhi kyun lagti hai?

Mirchi me capsaicin naam ka tatva hota hai. Jab ye jeebh ko chhoota hai, to dimaag ko aisa sanket jata hai jaise munh me aag lag gayi ho — asal me koi jalna nahi hota, ye dimaag ko mila jhootha 'garmi' ka sanket hai. Isiliye teekha khane par paseena aata hai. Paani se teekhapan kam nahi hota; doodh, dahi ya meetha khana zyada kaam karta hai.
Nimbu khatta kyun hota hai?

Nimbu me citric acid hota hai — wahi use khatta swaad deta hai. Khatta swaad jeebh ke khaas hisso se pehchana jata hai. Nimbu me vitamin C bhi hota hai jo shareer ki raksha pranali ke liye achha hai. Khatti cheezein khane se munh me laar (saliva) zyada banti hai, jo pachan ki shuruaat hai.
Doodh safed kyun dikhta hai?

Doodh me chhote-chhote protein (casein) aur charbi ke kan hote hain jo roshni ko sab dishaon me bikhra dete hain. Jab saare rang ek saath bikhar kar aankh tak aate hain to safed dikhta hai — bilkul jaise badal ya barf safed dikhte hain. Doodh ka safed rang usi bikhrav (scattering) ka kamaal hai.
Jugnu raat ko chamakta kyun hai?

Jugnu ke pet ke neeche ek khaas rasayanik prakriya hoti hai — luciferin naam ka tatva oxygen se milkar thandi roshni banata hai. Ye roshni bina garmi ke banti hai, isliye jugnu jalta nahi. Jugnu is chamak se dusre jugnuon ko sanket deta hai. Barsaat ke mausam me jugnu zyada dikhte hain.
Machhar kyun kaat-te hain aur khujli kyun hoti hai?

Sirf maada machhar khoon peeti hai — use ando ke liye protein chahiye. Kaat-te samay wo thodi laar shareer me chhodti hai taaki khoon jamme na; usi laar par shareer ki raksha pranali pratikriya karti hai, jisse wahan soojan, laalima aur khujli hoti hai. Machhar se bachav: jaali, machhardani, aur paani jama na hone dena — kyunki machhar ruke paani me ande dete hain.
Vaccine (teeka) kaam kaise karti hai?

Teeke me beemari ke kamzor ya mare hue keetanu (ya unka hissa) shareer me dala jata hai. Shareer ki raksha pranali use pehchankar usse ladna seekh leti hai aur yaad bana leti hai. Baad me asal keetanu aaye to shareer turant use hara deta hai. Teekakaran ne chechak jaisi khatarnak beemariyo ko duniya se khatm karne me sabse badi bhoomika nibhai hai.
Thermometer se bukhar kaise naapte hain?

Thermometer shareer ka taapman batata hai. Purane paro (mercury) wale thermometer me garmi se para ek bareek nali me upar chadhta tha; aaj ke digital thermometer sensor se taapman napkar screen par dikhate hain. Aam shareer ka taapman lagbhag 98.6°F (37°C) hota hai; isse zyada ho to bukhar mana jata hai. Sahi nap ke liye thermometer ko sahi jagah aur samay tak rakhna zaroori hai.
X-ray kya hota hai?

X-ray ek khaas prakar ki kirnein hain jo shareer ke andar ki tasveer lene ke kaam aati hain. Ye naram hisso se aaram se guzar jati hain par haddiyo me ruk jati hain, isliye photo me haddiyan saaf dikhti hain — tooti haddi ya andar ki dikkat dekhne me madad milti hai. X-ray doctor ki salah par hi karwana chahiye; bina zaroorat baar-baar karwana theek nahi.
Nabz (pulse) kya hoti hai?

Nabz dil ki dhadkan ka ehsaas hai jo kalai ya gale par ungli rakhkar mehsoos hota hai. Har dhadkan par khoon ki ek lehar nason me daudti hai — wahi nabz hai. Aaram ki sthiti me ek vayask ki nabz aam taur par 60-100 prati minute hoti hai. Nabz se dil ki gati ka andaza milta hai.
Ped ki jaddein paani kaise peeti hain?

Jado ke chhote-chhote baal (root hairs) mitti se paani aur khanij sokhte hain. Ye paani bareek naliyo (xylem) ke through tane se hota hua patto tak chadhta hai — kabhi-kabhi sau feet unche ped me bhi. Patto se paani ka udna (transpiration) is upar ki kheench ko banaye rakhta hai, jaise straw se juice peena.
Aam ped par hi kyun pakta hai aur toda hua aam kaise pakta hai?

Pakna ek rasayanik badlav hai jisme ek gas (ethylene) madad karti hai. Ped par aam dheere-dheere pakta hai. Toda hua kachha aam bhi is gas ke kaaran pak jata hai — isiliye aam ko kagaz ya chawal me rakhne se wo jaldi pakta hai kyunki gas andar hi rehti hai. Ek paka aam paas ke kachhe aamo ko bhi jaldi paka deta hai — isiliye kehte hain ek kharab aam saari tokri kharab kar deta hai.
Baarish ke baad keede-makode zyada kyun dikhte hain?

Baarish se nami badhti hai aur jagah-jagah paani bharta hai — ye keedo ke liye anukul mahaul hai. Unke bil aur chhupne ki jagaho me paani bhar jane se wo bahar aa jate hain. Machhar ruke paani me ande dete hain isliye barsaat me badh jate hain. Ghar ke aas-paas paani jama na hone dena hi sabse achha bachav hai.
Gehun aur chawal me kya farak hai poshan me?

Dono hi urja dene wale anaaj hain. Gehun me aam taur par chawal se zyada fiber aur protein hota hai, khaaskar jab aata chakki ka aur bina chhanna ho. Chawal aasani se pachta hai. Dono ka apna sthan hai — santulit khane me anaaj ke saath dal, sabzi aur doodh-dahi bhi hona chahiye, sirf ek anaaj par nirbhar rehna theek nahi.
Suraj ki garmi dharti tak kaise pahuchti hai jab beech me khaali jagah hai?

Garmi teen tareeko se safar karti hai: chhukar (conduction), behkar (convection) aur kirno se (radiation). Antariksh me na hawa hai na koi cheez, isliye suraj ki garmi kirno (radiation) ke roop me safar karke dharti tak aati hai — bilkul jaise aag ke saamne khade hone par door se hi garmi lagti hai. Ye kirnein roshni ke saath aati hain.
Jaipur ko gulabi shahar (Pink City) kyun kehte hain?

Jaipur ki purani shahar ki zyadaatar imaartein gulabi-balua rang se rangi hain. 1876 me England ke rajkumar ke swagat me shahar ko gulabi ranga gaya tha; tab se ye parampara ban gayi aur Jaipur 'Pink City' kahlaya. Aaj bhi purane shahar me ye rang banaye rakhna niyam hai.
Varanasi ke baare me batao

Varanasi (Banaras/Kashi) duniya ke sabse prachin jeevit shahro me se ek hai — hazaro saal purana. Ye Ganga nadi ke kinare basa hai aur Kashi Vishwanath mandir ke liye prasiddh hai. Yahan ke ghaat, Ganga aarti aur Banarasi saari duniya bhar me mashhoor hain. Maana jata hai ki ye shahar Bhagwan Shiv ke trishul par basa hai.
Rani Lakshmibai ke baare me batao

Jhansi ki Rani Lakshmibai 1857 ke pehle swatantrata sangram ki sabse prasiddh veerangana thi. Unhone angrezon se loha liya aur ranbhoomi me ladte hue veergati payi. Unki bahaduri dekhkar angrez adhikari ne bhi kaha tha ki wo sabse khatarnak aur bahadur neta thi. 'Khoob ladi mardani, wo to Jhansi wali rani thi' — ye pankti har Bharatiya ko yaad hai.
Bhagat Singh ke baare me batao

Bhagat Singh Bharat ke sabse priya krantikari the. Unhone naujawan umar me desh ke liye haste-haste faansi kubool ki — 23 March 1931 ko wo, Rajguru aur Sukhdev shaheed hue. Bhagat Singh sirf bandook wale nahi, gehre vicharak bhi the — wo bahut padhte the aur samaj ko badalne ke sapne dekhte the. 'Inquilab Zindabad' ka naara unhi se lokpriya hua.
Subhas Chandra Bose ke baare me batao

Subhas Chandra Bose, jinhe 'Netaji' kaha jata hai, ne azaadi ke liye Azad Hind Fauj (INA) banayi aur 'Delhi Chalo' ka naara diya. Unka prasiddh kathan tha — 'Tum mujhe khoon do, main tumhe azaadi dunga.' Unhone videsh me rehkar Bharat ki azaadi ke liye sainik takat khadi ki, jo apne aap me adbhut baat thi.
Bharat ka pehla upagrah (satellite) kaunsa tha?

Bharat ka pehla upagrah 'Aryabhata' tha, jo 19 April 1975 ko antariksh me bheja gaya tha. Iska naam prachin Bharat ke mahan ganitagya-khagolshastri Aryabhata ke naam par rakha gaya. Aaj Bharat ka ISRO chand aur mangal tak ke mission bhej chuka hai — Chandrayaan-3 ne 2023 me chand ke dakshin dhruv ke paas safal landing karke itihas racha, aisa karne wala Bharat pehla desh bana.
IST kya hota hai?

IST ka matlab hai Indian Standard Time — pure Bharat ka ek hi samay. Kuch bade desho me kai time zone hote hain, par Bharat me Kashmir se Kanyakumari tak ek hi ghadi chalti hai. IST ka hisaab Uttar Pradesh ke Mirzapur ke paas se guzarne wali rekha se rakha jata hai, aur ye duniya ke manak samay (UTC) se 5 ghante 30 minute aage hai.
Bharat ki sabse lambi sadak (highway) kaun si hai?

Rashtriya Rajmarg 44 (NH-44) Bharat ka sabse lamba highway hai — ye Kashmir ke Srinagar se shuru hokar Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu) tak jata hai, lagbhag 3,745 kilometer. Ye uttar se dakshin tak pure Bharat ko jodta hai. Isiliye kaha jata hai ki Bharat sadko se ek sutra me bandha hai.
Udaipur ko jheelo ka shahar kyun kehte hain?

Rajasthan ke Udaipur me kai khoobsurat jheelein hain — Pichola, Fateh Sagar, Udai Sagar — isiliye use 'Jheelo ka Shahar' (City of Lakes) kehte hain. Jheel ke beech bana Jal Mahal jaisa mahal aur aas-paas ki pahadiyan ise Bharat ke sabse khoobsurat shahro me se ek banati hain.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo bina pair ke daudta hai aur bina munh ke gaata hai?
Jawab hai: Nadi ka paani. Paani bina pair ke 'daudta' (tez behta) hai aur behte hue uski kal-kal awaaz gaane jaisi lagti hai.
Paheli: Ek bagh me 5 ped, har ped par 5 tehniyan, har tehni par 5 phal — kul kitne phal?
Hisaab: 5 ped × 5 tehniyan = 25 tehniyan; 25 × 5 phal = 125 phal. Guna ko jod-jod kar ginne se jawab jaldi milta hai — yahi is dimagi sawal ka maksad hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Main har rasoi me hoon, bina mere khana nahi banta, aur mera dhuaan aankhein jala deta hai — kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Aag (chulhe ki aag). Bina aag ke khana nahi pakta, aur aag ka dhuaan aankho me lagte hi paani aa jata hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ek dibbe me 10 laal aur 10 kaali moze (socks) hain. Andhere me kam se kam kitne moze nikalo ki ek joda (ek rang ke 2) pakka mil jaye?

Jawab hai: 3 moze. Pehle do moze alag rang ke ho sakte hain (ek laal, ek kaala), par teesra moza in do me se kisi ek rang ka zaroor hoga — aur joda ban jayega. Ye sambhavna (probability) ki prasiddh paheli hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo kal tha, aaj hai, par kal nahi rahega — ek hi cheez ke liye?
Jawab hai: Aaj ka din (vartaman pal). Har 'aaj' kal 'kal' (beeta hua) ban jata hai. Isiliye kehte hain — aaj ka kaam kal par mat talo, kyunki ye pal dobara nahi aayega.
Paheli sunao: Chaar bhai chaar disha me, chaaro ek dusre ko dekh na paye — kya hai?
Jawab hai: Ghar ki chaar deewarein. Chaaro deewarein chaar dishaon me hoti hain, ek dusre ke aamne-saamne hote hue bhi 'dekh' nahi sakti. Ek aur jawab: chaar pahiye bhi aisa hi hai.
Dimagi sawal: Ek aadmi bina barish ke bahar gaya, bina chhate ke, phir bhi uske baal geele nahi hue. Kaise?
Jawab hai: Wo aadmi ganja (bina baal wala) tha! Jiske baal hi nahi, wo geele kaise honge. Paheli ka jawab aksar sabse aasan jagah chhupa hota hai.
Paheli: Mere paas daant hain par kaat nahi sakta — main kya hoon?
Jawab hai: Kanghi (comb). Kanghi ke daant hote hain par wo kaat nahi sakti, baal suljhati hai. Aari (saw) ke bhi daant hote hain — wo lakdi kaatti hai, to yahan kanghi hi sahi jawab hai.
Paheli bhoojho: Wo kya hai jo upar jata hai par kabhi neeche nahi aata?
Jawab hai: Umar aur dhuaan — dono upar ki ore jate hain aur wapas nahi aate. Paheli ka sabse prasiddh jawab 'umar' hai: badhti hai, ghatti kabhi nahi.
Train ki patri (rail) lohe ki kyun hoti hai aur do patriyo ke beech gap kyun chhoda jata hai?

Loha mazboot hota hai aur bhaari train ka bojh utha sakta hai. Garmi me loha phailta hai — agar patriyo ke tukdo ke beech thoda gap na chhoda jaye to garmi me patri tedhi ho sakti hai aur durghatna ho sakti hai. Ye chhota sa gap garmi ke phailav ke liye hota hai. Thand me yahi gap thoda aur khul jata hai.
Bijli ke taar par baithe pakshi ko current kyun nahi lagta?

Current lagne ke liye bijli ko shareer se hokar jane ka pura raasta (circuit) chahiye. Pakshi ek hi taar par dono pair rakhta hai — uske shareer se hokar bijli ko koi dusra raasta nahi milta, isliye current nahi lagta. Par agar pakshi ek saath do taaro ko ya taar aur khambe ko chhu le, to use current lag sakta hai. Insaan ke liye bijli ke taar ko chhuna hamesha khatarnak hai — kabhi aisa mat karna.
Hawai jahaz itna upar kyun udta hai?

Hawai jahaz lagbhag 10-12 kilometer upar udta hai kyunki wahan hawa patli hoti hai — kam rukavat se jahaz tez aur kam tel me ud sakta hai. Wahan mausam ke badal aur toofan bhi zyadaatar neeche reh jate hain, isliye yatra shaant hoti hai. Itni unchai par bahar ki hawa me saans nahi li ja sakti, isliye jahaz ke andar dabaav aur oxygen ka khaas intzam hota hai.
Chai ki ketli me chai der tak garam kaise rehti hai kuch barto me?

Steel ke bartan chamakdar hote hain — chamakdar satah garmi ko kam bahar nikalne deti hai. Tharmas (flask) me to do parato ke beech khaali jagah (vacuum) hoti hai jahan se garmi ja hi nahi sakti, isliye chai ghanto garam rehti hai. Dhakkan band rakhna bhi garmi bachata hai.
Barish naapne ke liye kya istemal hota hai?

Baarish ko 'varsha-maapak' (rain gauge) se napa jata hai — ek khaas bartan me jama hue paani ki gehrai millimeter me naapi jati hai. Mausam vibhag jagah-jagah ye bartan lagata hai taaki pata chale kahan kitni baarish hui. Isi jaankari se kisano aur bandh ke prabandhan ko madad milti hai.
Kisano ke liye mausam ki jaankari kyun zaroori hai?

Mausam ki sahi jaankari se kisan fasal ki bovaai, sinchai aur kataai ka sahi samay tay kar sakta hai. Baarish, toofan ya paale (frost) ki pehle se khabar milne par fasal ko nuksan se bachaya ja sakta hai. Aaj kal mausam vibhag ki salah phone par SMS aur app se kisano tak muft pahuchti hai.
Phone ki torch (flashlight) kaam kaise karti hai?

Phone ki torch asal me camera ke saath laga LED flash hi hota hai. Aam taur par ye sirf photo ke samay chamakta hai; torch mode me phone use lagatar jalaye rakhta hai. LED bahut kam bijli khata hai isliye der tak chal sakta hai, par poori raat chalane par battery khatm ho sakti hai aur phone halka garam bhi ho sakta hai.
ATM se paisa nikalte samay kya savdhaani rakhe?

PIN dalte samay haath se keypad dhako taaki koi dekh na sake ya camera me na aaye. ATM ke andar koi ajnabi madad ka bahana kare to mana kar do. Card fas jaye to wahi se bank ke number par call karo, ajnabi ke diye number par nahi. Paisa nikalne ke baad SMS zaroor check karo. Raat me sunsaan ATM par akele jane se bacho.
Train me berth aur coach kya hota hai?

Coach train ka dibba hota hai — jaise sleeper coach, AC coach. Berth sone-baine ki seat ko kehte hain: neeche wali (lower), beech wali (middle) aur upar wali (upper). Ticket par coach number aur berth number likha hota hai. Sleeper me bina AC ke pankhe hote hain; AC coach me thandi hawa ka intzam hota hai aur khidkiyan band rehti hain.
Bharat me vote dene ki umar kitni hai aur kyun?

Bharat me 18 saal ki umar par vote dene ka adhikar milta hai. 18 saal ko vayask (adult) hone ki umar mana gaya hai — is umar me vyakti apne faisle khud lene yogya mana jata hai. Vote dena har nagrik ka adhikar bhi hai aur zimmedari bhi, kyunki isi se sarkar banti hai. Pehla vote dene ke liye voter list me naam aur voter ID zaroori hai.
Paheli: Wo kya hai jo tumhaare right hand me pakda ja sakta hai par left hand me kabhi nahi?

Jawab hai: Tumhari baayi (left) kohni! Soch kar dekho — daahine haath se baayi kohni pakdi ja sakti hai, par baayein haath se apni hi baayi kohni ko pakadna namumkin hai. Shareer par bani ye paheli sabko hairan kar deti hai.
Commerce lene ke baad kya-kya raaste khulte hain? Aur Science ke baad sirf doctor-engineer hi hote hain kya?

Pehle ek jhooth tod du: koi stream achhi ya buri nahi hoti, galat sirf wo chunav hai jo dusro ke dabav me ho. Science ke baad doctor, engineer, research, defence, computer — bahut raaste hain, par Science me maths aur mehnat bhaari hoti hai. Commerce ke baad CA, bank, business, accounts, company secretary jaise raaste khulte hain, hisaab-kitab pasand ho to best hai. Arts ke baad UPSC, teaching, law, journalism, design, sarkari naukri ki taiyari — ye sab hota hai, 'Arts me future nahi' purani soch hai. Chunav aise karo: pehla, kis vishay ko padhne me samay ka pata nahi chalta? Dusra, 12th ke baad tum kis kaam ki taraf jana chahte ho? Teesra, us stream ke vishay ek hafte padh kar dekho, dil lagta hai ya nahi. In teen se jawab khud mil jayega.
Mera naam Kunal hai, agle Somvaar ko interview hai, pichhli baar ki nakami baar-baar yaad aa rahi hai.

Sab theek jaane par bhi selection na hona sabse zyada confuse karta hai, par iske karan aksar tumse jude hi nahi hote: kabhi andar pehle se aadmi tay hota hai, kabhi budget ruk jata hai, kabhi unhe tumse zyada anubhav wala mil jata hai. Isliye is nakami ko apne upar mat lo. Karna ye hai: ho sake to wahan vinamrata se puchho ki kis cheez me sudhaar karu — jawab mile to sona. Apne resume aur bolne ke tareeke ko ek baar kisi anubhavi aadmi ko dikhao, bahar wala wohi dekhta hai jo hum nahi dekh pate. Aur sabse zaroori: is ek 'na' ko apni kahani ka ant mat banao. Naukri ek hoti hai, par naukriyaan hazaro hoti hain — tumhe sirf ek 'haan' chahiye.
Deepak naam hai mera, 21 saal ka hoon. Padhai chhod kar Delhi naukri ke liye jau ya pehle degree puri karu?

Dekho dost, ye faisla ek line me nahi hota, pehle apni haalat ko saaf dekho. Pehla kadam: ghar ki mahine ki zaroorat likho — agar tumhare bina ghar chal sakta hai to padhai ko pura waqt do, kyunki padhai ka fayda zindagi bhar milta hai. Dusra kadam: agar ghar ko abhi paiso ki sakht zaroorat hai to naukri le lo, par padhai band mat karo — open university ya distance course se padhai jaari rakho, hazaro ladke aise hi aage badhe hain. Teesra: kisi ke taane par faisla mat lo, log bolte rahenge, zindagi tumhari hai. Ek saal ka plan kagaz par likho, phir dekho dil halka lagega.
Main 25 saal ka hoon, galat career chun liya to baad me pachtawa hoga. Dil vs paisa ka faisla kaise lu?

Ek galti kabhi mat karna: sirf isliye koi kaam chunna ki 'usme paisa bahut hai' jabki tumhe usse nafrat hai. Roz 8-10 ghante nafrat wala kaam karna insaan ko andar se khokhla kar deta hai. Dusri galti: bina bazaar dekhe sirf junoon me kud jana. Samajhdari ye hai — apni pasand ki list banao, phir har pasand ke saamne usse judde kamai wale kaam likho. khel-kood pasand hai to usse jude 3-4 kaam zaroor honge jinme kamai bhi hai. Unme se wo chuno jahan pasand aur paisa sabse zyada milte hain. Aur faisle ko pathar ki lakeer mat samjho — 25-30 saal ki umar tak raasta badalna aam baat hai, duniya ke aadhe safal log dusre kaam se shuru hue the.
Sahil naam hai mera, board exam me nakami ke baad ghar wale bhi umeed chhod baithe hain.

'Log kya kahenge' — ye dar lakhon sapno ko kha chuka hai, par ek sach suno: log do din baat karte hain, teesre din apni zindagi me vyast ho jate hain. Tum apni puri zindagi do din ki baato ke liye nahi rok sakte. Ek hisaab lagao: aaj se 5 saal baad ye log tumhe yaad bhi nahi honge, par tumhe apni koshish ya apna pachtawa zaroor yaad hoga. Isliye faisla aise lo jaise log dekh hi nahi rahe. Aur ek baat: wahi log jo aaj has rahe hain, tumhari safalta par sabse pehle badhai denge — ye duniya ka tareeka hai. Logo ki baat ko khaad banao, deewar mat banao.
Mera sapna apna bada business khada karna hai, par main abhi gaon me rehne wala hoon. Wahan tak ka raasta kaise banau?

'Kal se' wala jaal sabse purana hai, aur iska tod hai: aaj, abhi, 10 minute. Suno, bada shuruaat ka din kabhi nahi aata, isliye pehla kadam itna chhota rakho ki mana karna mushkil ho — sirf 10 minute seekhna, sirf ek phone call, sirf ek page. Ek baar shuru ho jaye to dimag khud aage badhta hai, rukna hi mushkil hota hai. Dusra nuskha: apne sapne ke kaam ko roz ke ek tay samay aur jagah se bandh do, faisla roz nahi lena padega. Teesra: har roz ka kaam kisi ko batao ya copy me likho, hisaab dene ki aadat susti ko khatm karti hai. Kal ka intezaar chhodo — jo aadmi aaj ke 10 minute jeet leta hai, wahi ek din bada sapna jeetta hai.
Main graduation kiya hoon, naukri dhundhte dhundhte thak gaya hoon. Ab kya karu?

Sun dost, pehli naukri sabse mushkil hoti hai — ye tumhari kamzori nahi, har fresher ki kahani hai. Haar manne se pehle apna tareeka badal kar dekho. Pehla: roz 5 jagah andhe ki tarah apply karne ki jagah 2 jagah soch kar apply karo, jahan tumhari skill sach me fit ho. Dusra: apna resume ek kagaz me saaf banao — kya aata hai, kya seekha hai, chhota kaam bhi likho. Teesra: sirf online mat baitho, dukaanon, daftar aur pehchan walo tak khud jao, aadhi naukriyaan jaan-pehchan se milti hain. Chautha: intezaar ke samay ko skill seekhne me lagao, taaki agle interview me tum khaali haath na ho. Naukri milna ek din ka khel nahi hai, jo laga rehta hai usi ko milti hai.
Main college ka chhatra hoon, padhai ke liye roz 5 ghante chahiye par milte hi nahi. Samay kaise nikalu?

Mobile samay khane wala sabse bada chor hai, par use dushman mat banao, naukar banao. Teen kadam lo: pehla, phone ka wohi hissa band karo jo bina matlab hai — faltu suchna (notification) band kar do, sirf call aur zaroori cheez khuli rakho. Dusra, padhai/kaam ke samay phone dusre kamre me ya ghar wale ke paas rakho, paas rakha phone har 10 minute me kheenchta hai. Teesra, phone ke liye bhi samay tay karo — jaise khane ke baad aadha ghanta — taaki man ko lage mana nahi hai, samay hai. Pehle din mushkil lagega, ek hafte me tum khud hairaan hoge ki kitna samay bacha hua pada tha.
Sheher me rehna mehenga hai, meri bachat sirf 10000 rupaye hai. Kaise sambhalunga pehle mahine?

Dar lagna bilkul aam hai, har pehli baar sheher jane wala darta hai. Sach ye hai ki sheher me achhe log bhi hain aur thag bhi, bas aankhein khuli rakhni padti hai. Kuch suraksha niyam yaad kar lo: anjaan aadmi 'sasti naukri' ya 'double paisa' kahe to seedha mana kar do. Kamra lete samay pehchan wale ke dwara lo aur kiraya ki raseed lo. Apna paisa ek jagah mat rakho, kuch bank me kuch paas me. Ghar par roz phone karo taaki sab ko khabar rahe tum theek ho. Pehle 15 din ajeeb lagega, phir sheher apna lagne lagta hai. Himmat rakho, lakhon ladke aise hi aaye the, aaj unhi ka sheher hai.
Mera naam Sahil hai. Mujhe video banana aur editing ka kaam pasand hai par ghar wale sarkari naukri ke liye kehte hain.

Dost, ek kasauti yaad rakho: paisa 'kitna' se zyada zaroori hai paisa 'kahan tak badhega'. Kuch kaamo me shuruaat zyada hoti hai par 10 saal baad bhi wahi ruk jati hai; kuch me shuruaat kam par seekhne ke saath kamai dugni-tigni hoti hai. Isliye faisla aise lo: pehle apni pasand ke kaam ki 5 saal wali tasveer dekho — usme bade log kitna kama rahe hain aur wahan tak ka raasta kitna lamba hai. Phir apni majboori dekho — agar ghar ko abhi paisa chahiye to pehle kamai wala kaam pakdo, par pasand ko side me zinda rakho, samay milte hi udhar badho. Dil aur paisa dushman nahi hain, sahi kram me rakho to dono mil jate hain.
Rahul naam hai mera, pehli baar Lucknow ja raha hoon kaam ke liye. Wahan rehne-khane ka bandobast kaise karu?

Sheher jana bada kadam hai, par sahi taiyari ho to yehi kadam zindagi badal deta hai. Jane se pehle teen taiyari karo: ek, kam se kam 2 mahine ke kharche jitna paisa bachat me rakho, pehla mahina sabse mushkil hota hai. Do, jane se pehle hi kisi pehchan wale ya purane saathi se baat karo jo wahan ho — pehla thikana aur kaam ki jaankari wahi se milti hai. Teen, apne kagaz (Aadhaar, photo, bank khata) ki copy phone aur kagaz dono me rakho. Wahan pahuch kar pehle sasta kamra aur khana dhundho, shaan mat dikhao. Aur thago se bachne ka ek niyam: naukri ke naam par pehle paisa mange to samjho dhokha hai, asli naukri paisa leti nahi deti hai.
Ghar wale chahte hain main engineering karu, par mera sapna kala aur design ka kaam hai. Dono me santulan kaise banau?

Sawal ko 'ya wo ya main' mat banao, yehi sabse badi galti hai. Parivaar ke khilaf jaakar mili safalta bhi andar se khaali lagti hai, aur khud ko maar kar mili unki khushi bhi tikti nahi. Beech ka raasta ye hai: samay ka samjhota karo. Unse kaho: 'Mujhe itna samay do apne raaste ko parakhne ke liye, agar is samay me kuch na bane to main aapke raaste par puri taakat se chalunga.' Ye baat sun kar maa-baap ka dar kam hota hai, kyunki unhe lagta hai darwaza band nahi hua. Phir us samay ko jaan laga kar kaam me lagao — saboot hi sabse bada tark hai. Aur agar tum safal hue to sabse zyada khushi unhi ko hogi, ye pakka hai.
Ghar wale kehte hain ab kamao, par mera man padhne ka hai. Padhai aur naukri me se kaise chunu?

Dekho, dono raaste sahi hain, galat sirf bina soche chuna hua raasta hai. Apni haalat ka sach likho: ghar ki aamdani, tumhari padhai ka kharcha, aur tumhari asal dilchaspi. Phir ye dekho ki medical me jaane ke liye aur kitni padhai baaki hai. Agar 1-2 saal ki padhai se darwaza khulta hai to wo kar lo, utne samay ghar ko samjha lo ya part-time se sahara do. Agar padhai sirf degree ke liye hai aur dil nahi lagta, to kaam shuru karke skill seekhna behtar hai. Jo bhi chuno, pura dil laga kar chuno — aadha-adhura faisla hi sabse bada nuksan karta hai.
Meri kamai 15000 rupaye mahina hai, usme se bachat hoti hi nahi. cycle lene ka sapna kaise pura hoga?

Kitna jodna hai ye tumhare kaam par hai. cycle lete samay ye niyam rakho: sabse sasta wala mat lo jo 6 mahine me tang kare, aur sabse mehenga bhi mat lo jo sirf dikhave ke liye hai — beech ka wo model lo jo tumhare asal kaam ko 2-3 saal aaram se chale. Keemat tay karke usme thoda aur jodo (cover, marammat, zaroori saaman ke liye). Phir ulta hisaab lagao: kul rakam ko mahino se banto, pata chalega mahine kitna jodna hai. Agar wo rakam tumhari kamai ke 20 pratishat se zyada hai to samay badhao ya model thoda chhota karo. Jaldbazi me udhaar lekar lena sabse buri galti hai — apni cheez apne paiso se, chahe 2 mahine der se.
Mere dost naukri karne lage hain aur main abhi padh raha hoon. Kabhi lagta hai padhai chhod kar kaam kar lu. Kya karu?

Tumhari tension samajh sakta hoon, par ye socho: naukri aaj mil jayegi par bina padhai ke wahi naukri 10 saal baad bhi wahi ki wahi rahegi, tarakki ruk jayegi. Sahi tareeka ye hai — pehle ye tay karo ki tumhe teaching me jana hai ya nahi. Agar haan, to uske liye jitni padhai chahiye wo puri karo, chahe dheere ho. Agar ghar ki majboori hai to din me kaam aur raat ko 2 ghante padhai wala routine banao, mushkil hai par hota hai. Dost kama rahe hain to jalan mat karo, har kisi ki race alag hoti hai. Apna 2 saal ka naksha banao aur usi par chalo.
Interview me jaate hi ghabrahat ho jati hai, jo aata hai wo bhi bhool jata hoon. Iska ilaaj kya hai?

Sab theek jaane par bhi selection na hona sabse zyada confuse karta hai, par iske karan aksar tumse jude hi nahi hote: kabhi andar pehle se aadmi tay hota hai, kabhi budget ruk jata hai, kabhi unhe tumse zyada anubhav wala mil jata hai. Isliye is nakami ko apne upar mat lo. Karna ye hai: ho sake to wahan vinamrata se puchho ki kis cheez me sudhaar karu — jawab mile to sona. Apne resume aur bolne ke tareeke ko ek baar kisi anubhavi aadmi ko dikhao, bahar wala wohi dekhta hai jo hum nahi dekh pate. Aur sabse zaroori: is ek 'na' ko apni kahani ka ant mat banao. Naukri ek hoti hai, par naukriyaan hazaro hoti hain — tumhe sirf ek 'haan' chahiye.
Chhoti naukri mil rahi hai par man nahi hai, badi ke intezaar me baitha hoon. Sahi kya hai?

Sun dost, pehli naukri sabse mushkil hoti hai — ye tumhari kamzori nahi, har fresher ki kahani hai. Haar manne se pehle apna tareeka badal kar dekho. Pehla: roz 5 jagah andhe ki tarah apply karne ki jagah 2 jagah soch kar apply karo, jahan tumhari skill sach me fit ho. Dusra: apna resume ek kagaz me saaf banao — kya aata hai, kya seekha hai, chhota kaam bhi likho. Teesra: sirf online mat baitho, dukaanon, daftar aur pehchan walo tak khud jao, aadhi naukriyaan jaan-pehchan se milti hain. Chautha: intezaar ke samay ko skill seekhne me lagao, taaki agle interview me tum khaali haath na ho. Naukri milna ek din ka khel nahi hai, jo laga rehta hai usi ko milti hai.
Mujhe ganit vishay sabse pasand hai, 12th ke baad kaunsi stream lu?

Stream chunna bada faisla hai par 'zindagi barbaad' wali baat galat hai — bahut se log baad me raasta badal lete hain, bas thoda samay zyada lagta hai. Sahi tareeka ye hai: pehle apne 12th ke number nahi, apni pasand dekho. Jis vishay ki kitab kholne me man kare, wahi tumhari taakat hai. Phir har stream ke aage ke raaste likho: Science se technical aur medical, Commerce se paisa-hisaab aur business, Arts se sarkari seva, law, teaching aur creative kaam. Phir socho tum 25 saal ki umar me khud ko kya karte hue dekhna chahte ho. Us tasveer se jo stream milti hai wahi lo. Maa-baap aur rishtedaro ki suno sabki, par faisla apni pasand aur us kaam ke bazaar dono dekh kar lo.
Paisa jodna shuru to karta hoon, par beech me kharch ho jata hai. Bachat tikau kaise banau?

Bachat tootne ki sabse badi wajah hai: paisa haath ke paas hona. Iska ilaaj bandobast se hota hai, ichha-shakti se nahi. Teen bandobast karo: ek, bachat ka paisa alag khate me dalo jiska card tum ghar par nahi rakhte. Do, kharidne se pehle 2 din ka niyam rakho — jo cheez aaj chahiye lagti hai, 2 din baad bhi chahiye to lo, aadhi khwahishein wahi mar jati hain. Teen, apne lakshya ki tasveer ya naam phone aur kamre me rakho, taaki har kharch se pehle wo dikhe. Aur agar ek baar bachat toot bhi jaye to use ant mat samjho — agle mahine se phir shuru karo. Bachat ek aadat hai, aur aadat gir-gir kar hi pakki hoti hai.
Mujhe apne paiso se pehla cycle lena hai, ghar walo se mangna nahi chahta. Paisa jodne ka sahi tareeka batao?

Kamai kam ho to bachat ka hisaab pratishat me lagao, rakam me nahi. Pehle mahine sirf 10 pratishat alag karo — chhota lagega par aadat banegi. Phir har 2 mahine me 2-3 pratishat badhao. Saath me ek kaam aur karo: ek hafte ka pura kharcha likho, tum khud dekhoge ki 2-3 jagah paisa bina matlab beh raha hai — wahi tumhari bachat hai. Ek sach aur: cycle ke liye sabse mehenga model zaroori nahi, apne kaam ke hisaab se beech wala model samajhdari hai; bacha paisa aage kaam aayega. Dheere jodna sharm ki baat nahi hai — jo aadmi chhoti kamai me bacha sakta hai, wo badi kamai me kabhi barbaad nahi hota.
Rahul hoon main, roz ke 200 rupaye kharch ho hi jate hain. Itni chhoti kamai se second-hand bike ka paisa kaise judega?

Teen bandobast karo: ek, bachat ka paisa alag khate me dalo jiska card tum ghar par nahi rakhte. Do, kharidne se pehle 2 din ka niyam rakho — jo cheez aaj chahiye lagti hai, 2 din baad bhi chahiye to lo, aadhi khwahishein wahi mar jati hain. Teen, apne lakshya ki tasveer ya naam phone aur kamre me rakho, taaki har kharch se pehle wo dikhe. Aur agar ek baar bachat toot bhi jaye to use ant mat samjho — agle mahine se phir shuru karo. Bachat ek aadat hai, aur aadat gir-gir kar hi pakki hoti hai.
Dost kehte hain main bolne me achha hoon, par mujhe khud par yakeen nahi hota.

Bharosa janm se nahi milta, wo kamaya jata hai — chhoti jeeto se. Iska tareeka seedha hai: roz ek chhota kaam tay karo jo tum poora kar sako, aur use poora karke ek copy me likho. Ek mahine me 30 jeeto ki list ban jayegi — jab man kahe 'tumse kuch nahi hota', wo list padhna, wo jhooth nahi bolti. Dusra: jis cheez me kamzori hai use chhupao mat, use chhote hisso me seekho; kabiliyat badhti hai to bharosa khud aata hai. Teesra: apne aas-paas ke logo ko dekho — unme se zyadatar aam log hain, bas unhone koshish zyada ki hai. Bharosa matlab 'main kabhi nahi girunga' nahi, bharosa matlab 'gir kar bhi uth jaunga, pehle bhi utha hoon.'
Mera naam Sahil hai, agle Somvaar ko interview hai, pichhli baar ki nakami baar-baar yaad aa rahi hai.

Sab theek jaane par bhi selection na hona sabse zyada confuse karta hai, par iske karan aksar tumse jude hi nahi hote: kabhi andar pehle se aadmi tay hota hai, kabhi budget ruk jata hai, kabhi unhe tumse zyada anubhav wala mil jata hai. Isliye is nakami ko apne upar mat lo. Karna ye hai: ho sake to wahan vinamrata se puchho ki kis cheez me sudhaar karu — jawab mile to sona. Apne resume aur bolne ke tareeke ko ek baar kisi anubhavi aadmi ko dikhao, bahar wala wohi dekhta hai jo hum nahi dekh pate. Aur sabse zaroori: is ek 'na' ko apni kahani ka ant mat banao. Naukri ek hoti hai, par naukriyaan hazaro hoti hain — tumhe sirf ek 'haan' chahiye.
Meri kamai 6000 rupaye mahina hai, usme se bachat hoti hi nahi. cycle lene ka sapna kaise pura hoga?

Bachat tootne ki sabse badi wajah hai: paisa haath ke paas hona. Iska ilaaj bandobast se hota hai, ichha-shakti se nahi. Teen bandobast karo: ek, bachat ka paisa alag khate me dalo jiska card tum ghar par nahi rakhte. Do, kharidne se pehle 2 din ka niyam rakho — jo cheez aaj chahiye lagti hai, 2 din baad bhi chahiye to lo, aadhi khwahishein wahi mar jati hain. Teen, apne lakshya ki tasveer ya naam phone aur kamre me rakho, taaki har kharch se pehle wo dikhe. Aur agar ek baar bachat toot bhi jaye to use ant mat samjho — agle mahine se phir shuru karo. Bachat ek aadat hai, aur aadat gir-gir kar hi pakki hoti hai.
Ghar wale chahte hain main parivaar ki dukaan sambhalu karu, par mera sapna apna business khada karna hai. Dono me santulan kaise banau?

Sawal ko 'ya wo ya main' mat banao, yehi sabse badi galti hai. Parivaar ke khilaf jaakar mili safalta bhi andar se khaali lagti hai, aur khud ko maar kar mili unki khushi bhi tikti nahi. Beech ka raasta ye hai: samay ka samjhota karo. Unse kaho: 'Mujhe itna samay do apne raaste ko parakhne ke liye, agar is samay me kuch na bane to main aapke raaste par puri taakat se chalunga.' Ye baat sun kar maa-baap ka dar kam hota hai, kyunki unhe lagta hai darwaza band nahi hua. Phir us samay ko jaan laga kar kaam me lagao — saboot hi sabse bada tark hai. Aur agar tum safal hue to sabse zyada khushi unhi ko hogi, ye pakka hai.
Main Rampur gaon se hoon, Pune me factory ka kaam suna hai mil jayega. Jane se pehle kya taiyari karu?

Gaon ya sheher — ye faisla bhavnao se nahi, hisaab se lo. Gaon me kharcha kam hai, parivar paas hai, aur agar zameen ya dukaan ka koi raasta hai to wahan bhi bhavishya ban sakta hai, khaaskar ab jab online kaam gaon tak pahuch gaya hai. Sheher me mauke zyada hain, par kharcha aur akelapan bhi zyada hai. Ek tareeka ye hai: pehle 6 mahine ke liye sheher jaakar parakh lo, ghar se rishta aur gaon ka thikana banaye rakho. Kaam mil jaye aur man lag jaye to ruk jao, warna gaon lautna haar nahi hai. Jo log bina yojna ke jate hain wo pareshan hote hain, yojna banao: kaun sa kaam, kahan rahoge, kitna kharcha — teeno kagaz par likho phir niklo.
Meri bachat 50000 rupaye hai, kya itne me video editing ka kaam shuru ho jayega ya aur paisa jodu?

Sahi samay calender par nahi aata, wo taiyari se banta hai. Teen nishani dekho: ek, tumhare paas 4-6 mahine ke ghar-kharcha jitni bachat hai, taaki shuruaat ke dheeme mahino me ghabrahat na ho. Do, tumne apna kaam chhote paimane par parakh liya hai — kuch graahak pehle se hain ya kam se kam asal logo ne haan kaha hai, sirf doston ki tareef nahi. Teen, tumhe apne kaam ke kharche aur kamai ka kagaz par hisaab hai. Agar ye teen hai to samay sahi hai. Aur ek salah: naukri ekdum mat chhodo, pehle side me kaam khada karo, jab side ki kamai tankhwah ke aadhe tak pahunche tab chhodne ka socho. Aise kadam me dar bhi kam aur jokhim bhi kam.
Mera naam Aman hai. Mujhe khel-kood ka kaam pasand hai par ghar wale engineering ke liye kehte hain.

Ek galti kabhi mat karna: sirf isliye koi kaam chunna ki 'usme paisa bahut hai' jabki tumhe usse nafrat hai. Roz 8-10 ghante nafrat wala kaam karna insaan ko andar se khokhla kar deta hai. Dusri galti: bina bazaar dekhe sirf junoon me kud jana. Samajhdari ye hai — apni pasand ki list banao, phir har pasand ke saamne usse judde kamai wale kaam likho. khel-kood pasand hai to usse jude 3-4 kaam zaroor honge jinme kamai bhi hai. Unme se wo chuno jahan pasand aur paisa sabse zyada milte hain. Aur faisle ko pathar ki lakeer mat samjho — 25-30 saal ki umar tak raasta badalna aam baat hai, duniya ke aadhe safal log dusre kaam se shuru hue the.
ek badi company ke interview me kal fail ho gaya, computer ke sawal par atak gaya tha. Bahut mayoosi hai.

Pichhli nakami ko yaad karke darna aam hai, par is baar taiyari ka tareeka badal do, sirf zyada mat karo. Pehla din: pichhle interview ke sawal aur unke sahi jawab likho. Dusra-teeja din: is company aur is kaam ke baare me pata karo, taaki 'hamare yahan kyun kaam karna hai' ka jawab pakka ho. Chautha din: dost ke saath nakli interview karo, samay laga kar. Aakhri din: kapde, kagaz aur raasta pehle se tay karo, raat ko jaldi so jao. Aur man me ye baat baandh lo: ye interview zindagi ka aakhri mauka nahi hai, ek aur kadam hai. Jo aadmi nakami ke baad phir khada hota hai, interviewer ko wahi bharosa dikhta hai.
Mera naam Kunal hai, agle hafte ko interview hai, pichhli baar ki nakami baar-baar yaad aa rahi hai.

Jo aadmi nakami ke baad phir khada hota hai, interviewer ko wahi bharosa dikhta hai.
Maine 3 saal naukri ki hai, ab apna kapdo ka kaam shuru karna chahta hoon. Naukri kab chhodu?

Fail hone ka dar jhootha nahi hai — kuch kaam sach me band hote hain. Par dar ko is tarah dekho: fail tab bada hota hai jab tum sab kuch ek saath daav par lagate ho. Samajhdari ye hai ki chhote daav lagao. Naukri banaye rakho, kaam chhota shuru karo, kharcha kam rakho, taaki agar band bhi karna pade to zindagi na ruke. Dusri baat: fail hona aur seekhna ek hi sikke ke do pehlu hain — jo pehli baar me gir kar seekhta hai, dusri baar wohi galti nahi karta. Aur aakhri baat: naukri me man na lagna bhi ek ishara hai, use dabana mat, par bhaagna bhi mat — yojna bana kar niklo. Dar sabko lagta hai, kadam wahi uthata hai jo taiyari karta hai.
Ravi hoon main, mera sapna hai apna ghar banana. Ghar wale kehte hain ye hamare bas ka nahi.

Bada sapna dekh kar dar jana aam hai, kyunki dimag pure pahad ko ek saath dekhta hai. Ilaaj ye hai: pahad ko seedhiyo me todo. Kagaz par pehle aakhri manzil likho — apna ghar banana. Phir usse peeche chalo: usse pehle kya hoga, usse pehle kya — aise karte-karte tum aaj ke pehle kadam tak pahunchoge. Pehla kadam itna chhota rakho ki aaj hi ho jaye, jaise ek jaankari nikalna, ek aadmi se baat, ek ghanta seekhna. Roz ek seedhi chadho aur copy me nishan lagao. Ek saal me 365 seedhiya ho jayengi — wahi se pahad chhota lagne lagta hai. Sapna bada rakho, kadam chhota rakho, aur hisaab roz rakho.
Career me dil ki sunu ya paise ki? Mujhe likhna pasand hai par usme kamai kam sunayi deti hai.

Mera naam Rahul hai, main 19 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Par ek baat samjho: unke shabd aksar chinta aur thakaan se nikalte hain, wo tumhari asal kabiliyat ka faisla nahi hain. Tumhe do kaam karne hain: pehla, behes mat karo, kaam karke dikhao — ek chhoti safalta sau beheso se bhaari hoti hai. Dusra, apne liye ek bahari sahara banao — ek dost, ek shikshak, koi bada bhai-behen jo tumpar bharosa kare; ek aadmi ka bharosa bhi kaafi hota hai. Jo aadmi nakami ke baad phir khada hota hai, interviewer ko wahi bharosa dikhta hai.
Main school ka chhatra hoon, padhai ke liye roz 3 ghante chahiye par milte hi nahi. Samay kaise nikalu?

Routine tootne ki wajah tumhari kamzori nahi, routine ka zyada sakht hona hai. Niyam ye rakho: pehle sirf 2 aadat pakdo — ek uthne ka samay, ek padhne/kaam ka ek ghanta. Sirf itna 15 din chalao. Jab ye pakka ho jaye tab teesri aadat jodo. Dusra niyam: ek din toot jaye to dusre din se phir shuru karo, 'sab kharab ho gaya' soch kar pura chhodna sabse badi galti hai. Teesra: apni aadat ko kisi roz ke kaam se jodo — jaise chai ke baad hi padhai, nahane ke baad hi kaam ki list. Aadat 21 din me nahi, lagatar chhoti jeeto se banti hai. Khud ko har hafte chhoti safalta par shabaashi do, dimag usi se seekhta hai.
Career me dil ki sunu ya paise ki? Mujhe khel-kood pasand hai par usme kamai kam sunayi deti hai.

Filmo wali baat aadhi sach hai: pasand ka kaam karne wala zyada der tikta hai, aur jo tikta hai wahi aage jata hai. Par ek shart hai — pasand ke saath mehnat aur samajhdari bhi chahiye. Meri salah ka kram ye hai: ek, apni pasand wale kaam ki asal kamai aur raaste ki jaankari nikalo, logo se pucho jo wo kaam kar rahe hain. Do, ghar ki kam se kam zaroorat kitne paiso me puri hoti hai wo hisaab lagao. Teen, agar pasand wala kaam us zaroorat ko 2-3 saal me pura kar sakta hai to use chun lo aur ghar walo ko ye hisaab dikha do. Paisa zaroori hai, par zindagi bhar ka kaam sirf paise ke liye chunna bhi mehenge padta hai.
Meri bachat 2 lakh rupaye hai, kya itne me khane ka kaam shuru ho jayega ya aur paisa jodu?

Mera naam Deepak hai, main 19 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Mere dost Aman aur uske saathi roz raat bhar faltu ghumte karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Ek baar galti ho jana tumhe bura aadmi nahi banata, usi galti ko dohrana banata hai. Guilt ko taakat me badlo: pehle khud se saaf wada karo ki dobara nahi. Phir un bulane wale samay aur jagah se bachne ki yojna banao — us samay koi dusra kaam, ghar ka kaam ya khel rakh lo. Agar kisi ka nuksan hua ho to ho sake to use theek karo, man halka hoga. Dosto ko saaf bolo: 'Us din ho gaya, ab main nahi aaunga is kaam me.' Jo dost is par bhi dabav dale, usse doori hi ilaaj hai. Yaad rakho, ruka hua aadmi kamzor nahi hota — aadat ke aage jhuka hua aadmi hota hai. Tum rukne ka faisla kar rahe ho, yahi asli taakat hai.
Main dukaan ke kaam ke saath padhai bhi karni hai, dono ke liye samay ka hisaab kaise banau?

Jaldi uthna ek raat me nahi hota, wo raat ki aadat se hota hai. Pehla kadam: sone ka samay peeche le jao — roz 15 minute pehle, ek hafte me ghanta bhar badal jayega. Dusra: sone se ek ghanta pehle phone band, dimag ko shanti milegi to neend gehri hogi. Teesra: alarm ghadi/phone ko bistar se door rakho, uth kar band karna padega to neend khul jayegi. Chautha: uthte hi koi chhota kaam rakho — paani peena, bahar ki hawa, 5 minute chalna — bistar par lete rehne se neend wapas kheenchti hai. Aur subah ke pehle ghante ko apna sabse keemti samay samjho: usi me padhai ya apne sapne ka kaam rakho, din bhar ka bojh us samay nahi hota.
Main BCom ki padhai kar raha hoon, par ghar wale kehte hain ab naukri kar lo. Kya karu?

Is sawal ka jawab 'ya padhai ya naukri' nahi hai, jawab hai 'kis kram me'. Pehle apne se teen sawal pucho: ek, kya ghar abhi mere paiso par tika hai? Do, jo padhai main kar raha hoon kya wo mujhe asal me aage le jayegi? Teen, kya main kaam ke saath padhai ka bojh utha sakta hoon? In teeno ke jawab kagaz par likho. Agar padhai ka seedha fayda dikh raha hai to use pura karo, chhoti-moti part-time kamai side me chal sakti hai. Aur haan, ye faisla ek baar me antim nahi hota — 6 mahine baad haalat dekh kar badal bhi sakte ho. Ghabrana band karo, soch kar kadam uthao.
Dost sab lag gaye, main hi reh gaya. Ghar wale bhi taane marne lage hain, bahut bura lagta hai.

Jawab na aana matlab tum bekaar ho, ye bilkul nahi hai — matlab hai ki tumhari arzi sahi jagah sahi roop me nahi pahuch rahi. Teen cheezein theek karo: ek, resume me wahi likho jo us naukri ko chahiye, har jagah ek hi purana resume mat bhejo. Do, apply karne ka samay aur jagah badlo — subah ke samay aur seedha company/dukaan par jaakar baat karna online se zyada kaam karta hai. Teen, har hafte apne se pucho: is hafte maine naya kya kiya jo pichhle hafte nahi kiya tha? Agar jawab 'kuch nahi' hai to tareeka wahi purana hai. Naukri ki khoj bhi ek kaam hai, use roz ke niyam aur copy par hisaab ke saath karo, safalta achanak nahi, lagatar koshish se aati hai.
Mere chacha kehte hain Arts me koi future nahi, isliye Science hi lo. Unki baat kitni sahi hai?

Pehle ek jhooth tod du: koi stream achhi ya buri nahi hoti, galat sirf wo chunav hai jo dusro ke dabav me ho. Science ke baad doctor, engineer, research, defence, computer — bahut raaste hain, par Science me maths aur mehnat bhaari hoti hai. Commerce ke baad CA, bank, business, accounts, company secretary jaise raaste khulte hain, hisaab-kitab pasand ho to best hai. Arts ke baad UPSC, teaching, law, journalism, design, sarkari naukri ki taiyari — ye sab hota hai, 'Arts me future nahi' purani soch hai. Chunav aise karo: pehla, kis vishay ko padhne me samay ka pata nahi chalta? Dusra, 12th ke baad tum kis kaam ki taraf jana chahte ho? Teesra, us stream ke vishay ek hafte padh kar dekho, dil lagta hai ya nahi. In teen se jawab khud mil jayega.
Deepak hoon main, 12th me mere 90% number aaye. Ghar wale Science keh rahe hain, mera man Arts me hai.

Chalo teeno ka saaf hisaab deta hoon. Science: kharcha aur mehnat sabse zyada, raaste — engineering, medical, research, IT, defence; unke liye jinhe maths-science sach me pasand hai. Commerce: beech ka raasta, raaste — CA, CS, bank, accounts, apna business; unke liye jinhe number aur paiso ka khel samajh aata hai. Arts: kharcha kam, raaste — UPSC aur sarkari bharti, law, teaching, media; unke liye jo padhne-likhne aur samaj ke sawalo me ruchi rakhte hain. Ab apne aap ko dekho: tumhari pasand, ghar ka budget aur tumhara sabr — teeno mila kar jo stream fit baithe wahi sahi hai. Aur haan, 12th ke baad diploma aur skill course jaise darwaze bhi khule rehte hain, raasta ek nahi hota.
Mujhe itihaas vishay sabse pasand hai, 12th ke baad kaunsi stream lu?

Main apne pehle business me 2 baar fail ho chuka hoon, ab umeed hi nahi bachi.

Badi galti ko bhoolna nahi hai, usse seekh kar aage badhna hai — bhoolne ki koshish hi use baar-baar yaad dilati hai. Tareeka ye hai: galti ko ek baar kagaz par pura likho — kya hua, kyun hua, us samay tum kya soch rahe the. Phir uske neeche likho: 'agli baar main ye badlunga.' Ye likhna dimag ko sanket deta hai ki hisaab band ho gaya. Agar galti se kisi ka nuksan hua hai to maafi ya bharpai jahan ho sake karo, man ka bojh wahi se halka hota hai. Mujhe apne aap par bilkul bharosa nahi hai, lagta hai main kuch nahi kar sakta. Bharosa kaise banau?

Tulna ek aisi race hai jisme koi jeet hi nahi sakta, kyunki hamesha koi aage hoga. Ise rokne ka tareeka: apni tulna sirf apne kal se karo. Ek copy me mahine ki shuruaat me likho tum kahan ho — kya aata hai, kya haalat hai. Mahine ke ant me dekho kitna aage badhe. Yahi asal hisaab hai.
