Teesri baat: jis cheez me dusra aage hai, usse jalan ki jagah seekh nikalo — usne kya kiya jo tum kar sakte ho. Tulna ko shikshak bana lo, dushman nahi.
Mera naam Aman hai. Mujhe khel-kood ka kaam pasand hai par ghar wale bank ka kaam ke liye kehte hain.

Dost, ek kasauti yaad rakho: paisa 'kitna' se zyada zaroori hai paisa 'kahan tak badhega'. Kuch kaamo me shuruaat zyada hoti hai par 10 saal baad bhi wahi ruk jati hai; kuch me shuruaat kam par seekhne ke saath kamai dugni-tigni hoti hai. Isliye faisla aise lo: pehle apni pasand ke kaam ki 5 saal wali tasveer dekho — usme bade log kitna kama rahe hain aur wahan tak ka raasta kitna lamba hai. Phir apni majboori dekho — agar ghar ko abhi paisa chahiye to pehle kamai wala kaam pakdo, par pasand ko side me zinda rakho, samay milte hi udhar badho. Dil aur paisa dushman nahi hain, sahi kram me rakho to dono mil jate hain.
Mera naam Ravi hai, agle 3 din baad ko interview hai, pichhli baar ki nakami baar-baar yaad aa rahi hai.

Ek interview kharab hona tumhari kabiliyat ka faisla nahi hai, wo sirf ek din ka pradarshan hai. Ab karna ye hai: ghar aakar shanti se wohi sawal likho jahan atke the, aur unke jawab taiyaar karo — yehi nakami tumhari sabse achhi taiyari ban jayegi. Dusra, ye samjho ki interview lene wale ko bhi perfect aadmi nahi chahiye, use bharose wala aadmi chahiye jo seekh sake. Teesra, agli baar jaane se pehle dost ke saamne bol-bol kar practice karo, awaaz khul jayegi to ghabrahat aadhi reh jayegi. Sharmindagi ko bojh mat banao, use khaad banao — nakami ke baad jo taiyari hoti hai wo sabse pakki hoti hai.
Deepak naam hai mera, main din bhar dukaan ke kaam me uljha rehta hoon, apne liye samay hi nahi bachta.

Din nikal jane ki bimari ka ilaaj ek hi hai: din ko pehle se kagaz par banao. Raat ko sone se pehle kal ke 3 sabse zaroori kaam likho — zyada nahi, sirf 3. Subah uth kar sabse mushkil kaam pehle karo, jab dimag taaza ho. Din ko tukdo me banto: kaam ka samay, aaram ka samay, phone ka samay — sab ka apna ghanta. Aur shaam ko 5 minute hisaab karo: kya hua, kya reh gaya. Pehle hafte me hi farak dikhega. Ek galti mat karna: pure din ko minute-minute se bhar dena, aaram ka samay bhi yojna me rakho warna yojna 3 din me toot jayegi. Samay sabke paas 24 ghante hi hai, jeet usi ki hai jo use pehle se tay karta hai.
Mera naam Ravi hai, main 26 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Logo ke saamne haklana koi khaami nahi hai, ye sirf practice ki kami hai — bade-bade neta aur vakta shuruaat me aise hi the. Teen kadam wala ilaaj suno: pehla, akele me bolne ki practice — roz 5 minute kisi vishay par zor se bolo, sheeshe ke saamne ya phone me record karke suno. Dusra, chhoti mehfil se shuru karo — 2-3 bharose wale dosto ke saamne apni baat rakho, phir dheere-dheere dayra badhao. Teesra, ye samjho ki sunne wale tumhari galti nahi dhundh rahe, wo apni baari ka intezaar kar rahe hain — sab apne me lage hain. Bolna ek kala hai, kala practice se aati hai, aur practice ka koi chhota raasta nahi hota.
Apna kapdo ka kaam shuru karne ka man hai, par naukri chhodne ka dar hai. Kya karu?

Naukri chhodne ka dar har imandaar aadmi ko lagta hai, isliye koodo mat, seedhi banao. Pehla kadam: apne kapdo ka kaam ko naukri ke saath chhote roop me shuru karo — sham aur chhutti wale din. Dusra: pehle 10 graahako ko asal seva do, unse sikho ki bazaar chahta kya hai. Teesra: jab lagatar 3 mahine side kaam se kuch pakki kamai aane lage aur graahak badhne lage, tab naukri chhodne ka faisla lo. Is tareeke se tumhe pata chalega ki idea kagaz par achha hai ya asal me bhi. Aur haan, naukri walo se sambandh achhe rakho — vyapaar me wahi pehchan kaam aati hai, aur darwaza khula rehta hai.
Main 12th ke baad confuse hoon, aage padhu ya naukri karu? Ghar ki haalat bhi thodi tight hai.

Dekho dost, ye faisla ek line me nahi hota, pehle apni haalat ko saaf dekho. Pehla kadam: ghar ki mahine ki zaroorat likho — agar tumhare bina ghar chal sakta hai to padhai ko pura waqt do, kyunki padhai ka fayda zindagi bhar milta hai. Dusra kadam: agar ghar ko abhi paiso ki sakht zaroorat hai to naukri le lo, par padhai band mat karo — open university ya distance course se padhai jaari rakho, hazaro ladke aise hi aage badhe hain. Teesra: kisi ke taane par faisla mat lo, log bolte rahenge, zindagi tumhari hai. Ek saal ka plan kagaz par likho, phir dekho dil halka lagega.
Apna video editing ka kaam shuru karne ka man hai, par naukri chhodne ka dar hai. Kya karu?

Idea achha hai ya nahi, ye sochne se nahi, parakhne se pata chalta hai. Ek mahine ka parikshan karo: apne idea ki baat 20 asal logo se karo jo uske graahak ban sakte hain — unme se kitne asal me paisa dene ko taiyaar hain, ye ginno. Phir chhota sa namuna ya seva bana kar 5 logo ko becho ya do. Agar ajnabee log paisa de rahe hain to idea me dum hai, aur agar sirf 'idea achha hai' sunne ko mil raha hai paisa koi nahi de raha, to ruk kar idea ko sudharo. Faisla bhavna se nahi, is parakh se lo. Aur shuru karne ka sabse sahi samay wahi hai jab parakh paas ho aur bachat ka hisaab pura ho — usse pehle jaldi, uske baad deri, dono nuksan hain.
Main naukri ke saath padhne wala hoon, padhai ke liye roz 4 ghante chahiye par milte hi nahi. Samay kaise nikalu?

Routine tootne ki wajah tumhari kamzori nahi, routine ka zyada sakht hona hai. Niyam ye rakho: pehle sirf 2 aadat pakdo — ek uthne ka samay, ek padhne/kaam ka ek ghanta. Sirf itna 15 din chalao. Jab ye pakka ho jaye tab teesri aadat jodo. Dusra niyam: ek din toot jaye to dusre din se phir shuru karo, 'sab kharab ho gaya' soch kar pura chhodna sabse badi galti hai. Teesra: apni aadat ko kisi roz ke kaam se jodo — jaise chai ke baad hi padhai, nahane ke baad hi kaam ki list. Aadat 21 din me nahi, lagatar chhoti jeeto se banti hai. Khud ko har hafte chhoti safalta par shabaashi do, dimag usi se seekhta hai.
10th ke baad stream chunne me galti ho gayi to zindagi barbaad ho jayegi kya? Sahi tareeka batao.

Pehle ek jhooth tod du: koi stream achhi ya buri nahi hoti, galat sirf wo chunav hai jo dusro ke dabav me ho. Science ke baad doctor, engineer, research, defence, computer — bahut raaste hain, par Science me maths aur mehnat bhaari hoti hai. Commerce ke baad CA, bank, business, accounts, company secretary jaise raaste khulte hain, hisaab-kitab pasand ho to best hai. Arts ke baad UPSC, teaching, law, journalism, design, sarkari naukri ki taiyari — ye sab hota hai, 'Arts me future nahi' purani soch hai. Chunav aise karo: pehla, kis vishay ko padhne me samay ka pata nahi chalta? Dusra, 12th ke baad tum kis kaam ki taraf jana chahte ho? Teesra, us stream ke vishay ek hafte padh kar dekho, dil lagta hai ya nahi. In teen se jawab khud mil jayega.
Sahil hoon main, mera sapna hai apna bada business khada karna. Ghar wale kehte hain ye hamare bas ka nahi.

Logo ke hasne par ek sach yaad rakho: hasne wale apne sapne poore nahi kar paye, isliye dusro ke sapno ko chhota karte hain taaki unhe bura na lage. Tumhe do kaam karne hain: ek, apne sapne ki baat har kisi se karna band karo — chup chaap kaam karo, safalta khud bol degi. Do, apne aas-paas ek bhi aisa aadmi dhundho jo tumhare sapne ke raaste par aage hai, uski baat suno, hasne walo ki nahi. Sapna 'aukat' se nahi, mehnat aur samay se banta hai — aaj ke bade naam kabhi chhoti jagah se hi shuru hue the. Dil tootne par rukna mat, usi dil ko khaad banao. Ek din wahi hasne wale tumhari misaal denge.
Ghar me bhi sab kehte hain tumse kuch nahi hoga. Ab main khud bhi yahi manne laga hoon.

Bharosa janm se nahi milta, wo kamaya jata hai — chhoti jeeto se. Iska tareeka seedha hai: roz ek chhota kaam tay karo jo tum poora kar sako, aur use poora karke ek copy me likho. Ek mahine me 30 jeeto ki list ban jayegi — jab man kahe 'tumse kuch nahi hota', wo list padhna, wo jhooth nahi bolti. Dusra: jis cheez me kamzori hai use chhupao mat, use chhote hisso me seekho; kabiliyat badhti hai to bharosa khud aata hai. Teesra: apne aas-paas ke logo ko dekho — unme se zyadatar aam log hain, bas unhone koshish zyada ki hai. Bharosa matlab 'main kabhi nahi girunga' nahi, bharosa matlab 'gir kar bhi uth jaunga, pehle bhi utha hoon.'
Rahul hoon main, roz ke 300 rupaye kharch ho hi jate hain. Itni chhoti kamai se second-hand bike ka paisa kaise judega?

Kitna jodna hai ye tumhare kaam par hai. second-hand bike lete samay ye niyam rakho: sabse sasta wala mat lo jo 6 mahine me tang kare, aur sabse mehenga bhi mat lo jo sirf dikhave ke liye hai — beech ka wo model lo jo tumhare asal kaam ko 2-3 saal aaram se chale. Keemat tay karke usme thoda aur jodo (cover, marammat, zaroori saaman ke liye). Phir ulta hisaab lagao: kul rakam ko mahino se banto, pata chalega mahine kitna jodna hai. Agar wo rakam tumhari kamai ke 20 pratishat se zyada hai to samay badhao ya model thoda chhota karo. Jaldbazi me udhaar lekar lena sabse buri galti hai — apni cheez apne paiso se, chahe 2 mahine der se.
Kunal naam hai mera, board exam me nakami ke baad ghar wale bhi umeed chhod baithe hain.

Asafalta se seekh nikalne ka pakka tareeka sikha deta hoon, 4 sawal wala. Haar ke 2-3 din baad, shanti se kagaz par likho: ek, main chahta kya tha aur mila kya? Do, isme meri kaunsi galti thi — taiyari ki, samay ki, ya galat jaankari ki? Teen, agar dobara wahi sthiti aaye to main kya alag karunga? Chaar, is haar ne mujhe aisi kaunsi baat sikha di jo jeet kabhi nahi sikhati? In jawabon ko sambhal kar rakho aur agli koshish se pehle padh lo. Ek niyam aur: haar ka kaaran 'kismat' ya 'main hi bekaar hoon' kabhi mat likho — kaaran hamesha wo likho jo tum badal sakte ho. Yahi seekh haar ko khaad banati hai.
Main Kishanganj gaon se hoon, Delhi me dukaan ka kaam suna hai mil jayega. Jane se pehle kya taiyari karu?

Bachat kam hai to yojna aur sakht banani hogi, par ho jayega. Pehla mahina is hisaab se chalao: kamra kisi ke saath share karo taaki kiraya aadha ho, khana shuru me saste dhabe ya khud bana kar, aana-jaana paidal ya bus se. Pehle din se roz ka kharcha ek copy me likho — ye aadat hi bachat ki maa hai. Kaam milte hi pehli tankhwah se sabse pehle agle mahine ka kiraya alag rakho. Ek baat aur: sheher me shuruaat me chhota kaam milne par sharmana mat, pehla kaam sirf pehla kadam hai, wahi se jaan-pehchan banti hai aur behtar kaam milta hai. Hisab se chalne wala sheher me kabhi bhooka nahi sota.
Deepak hoon main, 12th me mere 70% number aaye. Ghar wale Science keh rahe hain, mera man Commerce me hai.

Chalo teeno ka saaf hisaab deta hoon. Science: kharcha aur mehnat sabse zyada, raaste — engineering, medical, research, IT, defence; unke liye jinhe maths-science sach me pasand hai. Commerce: beech ka raasta, raaste — CA, CS, bank, accounts, apna business; unke liye jinhe number aur paiso ka khel samajh aata hai. Arts: kharcha kam, raaste — UPSC aur sarkari bharti, law, teaching, media; unke liye jo padhne-likhne aur samaj ke sawalo me ruchi rakhte hain. Ab apne aap ko dekho: tumhari pasand, ghar ka budget aur tumhara sabr — teeno mila kar jo stream fit baithe wahi sahi hai. Aur haan, 12th ke baad diploma aur skill course jaise darwaze bhi khule rehte hain, raasta ek nahi hota.
Main 3 baar interview me fail ho chuka hoon. Ab lagta hai mujhse nahi hoga.

Pichhli nakami ko yaad karke darna aam hai, par is baar taiyari ka tareeka badal do, sirf zyada mat karo. Pehla din: pichhle interview ke sawal aur unke sahi jawab likho. Dusra-teeja din: is company aur is kaam ke baare me pata karo, taaki 'hamare yahan kyun kaam karna hai' ka jawab pakka ho. Chautha din: dost ke saath nakli interview karo, samay laga kar. Aakhri din: kapde, kagaz aur raasta pehle se tay karo, raat ko jaldi so jao. Aur man me ye baat baandh lo: ye interview zindagi ka aakhri mauka nahi hai, ek aur kadam hai. Jo aadmi nakami ke baad phir khada hota hai, interviewer ko wahi bharosa dikhta hai.
Ghar wale chahte hain main parivaar ki dukaan sambhalu karu, par mera sapna kala aur design ka kaam hai. Dono me santulan kaise banau?

Sawal ko 'ya wo ya main' mat banao, yehi sabse badi galti hai. Parivaar ke khilaf jaakar mili safalta bhi andar se khaali lagti hai, aur khud ko maar kar mili unki khushi bhi tikti nahi. Beech ka raasta ye hai: samay ka samjhota karo. Unse kaho: 'Mujhe itna samay do apne raaste ko parakhne ke liye, agar is samay me kuch na bane to main aapke raaste par puri taakat se chalunga.' Ye baat sun kar maa-baap ka dar kam hota hai, kyunki unhe lagta hai darwaza band nahi hua. Phir us samay ko jaan laga kar kaam me lagao — saboot hi sabse bada tark hai. Aur agar tum safal hue to sabse zyada khushi unhi ko hogi, ye pakka hai.
Mere dost Ravi aur uske saathi roz jua khelte karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

'Darpok' shabd ka ulta hai 'samajhdar', bas ye baat umar ke is mod par samajh kam aati hai. Ek hisaab lagao: aadat padne me ek pal lagta hai, chhodne me saal lag jate hain aur kuch log kabhi nahi chhod pate — shareer, paisa aur parivaar ki izzat, teeno girte hain. Jo has rahe hain wo tumhara bill nahi bharenge jab tum phasoge. Isliye apni line saaf rakho aur bina sharm ke rakho: 'Main nahi karta, baat khatam.' Saath me apni dusri pehchan banao — kaam, khel ya skill me aise aage badho ki logo ko tumhari izzat karni pade. Samay ke saath wahi hasne wale tumse salah lene aayenge, ye duniya ka niyam hai.
Main 4 baar interview me fail ho chuka hoon. Ab lagta hai mujhse nahi hoga.

Ek interview kharab hona tumhari kabiliyat ka faisla nahi hai, wo sirf ek din ka pradarshan hai. Ab karna ye hai: ghar aakar shanti se wohi sawal likho jahan atke the, aur unke jawab taiyaar karo — yehi nakami tumhari sabse achhi taiyari ban jayegi. Dusra, ye samjho ki interview lene wale ko bhi perfect aadmi nahi chahiye, use bharose wala aadmi chahiye jo seekh sake. Teesra, agli baar jaane se pehle dost ke saamne bol-bol kar practice karo, awaaz khul jayegi to ghabrahat aadhi reh jayegi. Sharmindagi ko bojh mat banao, use khaad banao — nakami ke baad jo taiyari hoti hai wo sabse pakki hoti hai.
Meri umar 21 saal hai, ab tak padh hi raha hoon. Log taane marte hain ki kab kamaoge. Bahut tension hai.

Ek baat hamesha yaad rakho: bina skill ki naukri tumhe aaj paisa degi, par padhai aur skill tumhe har saal badhti hui kamai degi. Isliye mera dostana mashwara hai — agar koi bahut badi majboori nahi hai to pehle padhai aur ek kaam ki skill pakki karo. Saath me chhota part-time kaam mil jaye to sone pe suhaga. Agar majboori hai to naukri pakdo, lekin hafte me kam se kam 6-8 ghante padhai ke liye bacha kar rakho, mobile ka time wahi se katega. Faisla jazbaat me nahi, hisaab laga kar lo. Aur parivaar ko baith kar apni yojna samjhao, wo maan jayenge.
Ghar wale chahte hain main kheti me haath bataun karu, par mera sapna kala aur design ka kaam hai. Dono me santulan kaise banau?

Dhokha dene wali bhavna isliye aati hai kyunki tum unse pyaar karte ho — ye bhavna galat nahi, par iska matlab ye nahi ki tum apni zindagi kisi aur ki marzi se jiyo. Ek sach samjho: maa-baap ki asal ummeed tumhari naukri ya kaam nahi hoti, tumhari khushi aur suraksha hoti hai. Jab tum apne sapne me safal aur khush hoge, to wahi unki ummeed puri hogi, bas raasta alag hoga. Isliye apna kaam chup kar ya jhooth bol kar mat karo — imaandari se baat rakho aur mehnat dikhao. Aur bojh ko akele mat uthao, parivaar me koi ek bhi (bada bhai, behen, chacha, maa) tumhari taraf ho jaye to raasta aasan ho jata hai. Farz aur sapna dushman nahi hain, bas dono ko samay aur sabr chahiye.
Sheher me rehna mehenga hai, meri bachat sirf 15000 rupaye hai. Kaise sambhalunga pehle mahine?

Dar lagna bilkul aam hai, har pehli baar sheher jane wala darta hai. Sach ye hai ki sheher me achhe log bhi hain aur thag bhi, bas aankhein khuli rakhni padti hai. Kuch suraksha niyam yaad kar lo: anjaan aadmi 'sasti naukri' ya 'double paisa' kahe to seedha mana kar do. Kamra lete samay pehchan wale ke dwara lo aur kiraya ki raseed lo. Apna paisa ek jagah mat rakho, kuch bank me kuch paas me. Ghar par roz phone karo taaki sab ko khabar rahe tum theek ho. Pehle 15 din ajeeb lagega, phir sheher apna lagne lagta hai. Himmat rakho, lakhon ladke aise hi aaye the, aaj unhi ka sheher hai.
Maine 3 saal naukri ki hai, ab apna video editing ka kaam shuru karna chahta hoon. Naukri kab chhodu?

Fail hone ka dar jhootha nahi hai — kuch kaam sach me band hote hain. Par dar ko is tarah dekho: fail tab bada hota hai jab tum sab kuch ek saath daav par lagate ho. Samajhdari ye hai ki chhote daav lagao. Naukri banaye rakho, kaam chhota shuru karo, kharcha kam rakho, taaki agar band bhi karna pade to zindagi na ruke. Dusri baat: fail hona aur seekhna ek hi sikke ke do pehlu hain — jo pehli baar me gir kar seekhta hai, dusri baar wohi galti nahi karta. Aur aakhri baat: naukri me man na lagna bhi ek ishara hai, use dabana mat, par bhaagna bhi mat — yojna bana kar niklo. Dar sabko lagta hai, kadam wahi uthata hai jo taiyari karta hai.
Mera sabse achha dost sigaret aur gutkha khate me fas gaya hai, use isse kaise nikaalu?

Ek baar galti ho jana tumhe bura aadmi nahi banata, usi galti ko dohrana banata hai. Guilt ko taakat me badlo: pehle khud se saaf wada karo ki dobara nahi. Phir un bulane wale samay aur jagah se bachne ki yojna banao — us samay koi dusra kaam, ghar ka kaam ya khel rakh lo. Agar kisi ka nuksan hua ho to ho sake to use theek karo, man halka hoga. Dosto ko saaf bolo: 'Us din ho gaya, ab main nahi aaunga is kaam me.' Jo dost is par bhi dabav dale, usse doori hi ilaaj hai. Yaad rakho, ruka hua aadmi kamzor nahi hota — aadat ke aage jhuka hua aadmi hota hai. Tum rukne ka faisla kar rahe ho, yahi asli taakat hai.
Maine 5 saal naukri ki hai, ab apna chai-nashte ki dukaan shuru karna chahta hoon. Naukri kab chhodu?

Paisa jodne ka hisaab aisa lagao: pehle apne kaam ka shuruaati kharcha likho — samaan, jagah, kagazi kaam. Phir usme 6 mahine ka ghar kharcha jodo, kyunki shuruaat me kamai dheemi hoti hai. Yahi kul rakam tumhara lakshya hai. Isse kam me shuru karna matlab har mahine ghabrahat. Par ek baat aur: bahut zyada jodne ke chakkar me saal mat gava do — hisaab pura hote hi shuru karo, kyunki asal seekh bazaar me hi milti hai, ghar baithe nahi. Naukri ke saath har mahine ek tay rakam alag khate me dalo, aur us paise ko chhuo mat. Jab rakam puri ho, chhote se shuru karo, pehle saal bada kharcha mat karo.
Main kheti ke kaam ke saath padhai bhi karni hai, dono ke liye samay ka hisaab kaise banau?

Mobile samay khane wala sabse bada chor hai, par use dushman mat banao, naukar banao. Teen kadam lo: pehla, phone ka wohi hissa band karo jo bina matlab hai — faltu suchna (notification) band kar do, sirf call aur zaroori cheez khuli rakho. Dusra, padhai/kaam ke samay phone dusre kamre me ya ghar wale ke paas rakho, paas rakha phone har 10 minute me kheenchta hai. Teesra, phone ke liye bhi samay tay karo — jaise khane ke baad aadha ghanta — taaki man ko lage mana nahi hai, samay hai. Pehle din mushkil lagega, ek hafte me tum khud hairaan hoge ki kitna samay bacha hua pada tha.
Padhai me paisa lagta hai aur naukri me time. Dono me se sahi faisla kaise lu, samjha do?

Is sawal ka jawab 'ya padhai ya naukri' nahi hai, jawab hai 'kis kram me'. Pehle apne se teen sawal pucho: ek, kya ghar abhi mere paiso par tika hai? Do, jo padhai main kar raha hoon kya wo mujhe asal me aage le jayegi? Teen, kya main kaam ke saath padhai ka bojh utha sakta hoon? In teeno ke jawab kagaz par likho. Agar padhai ka seedha fayda dikh raha hai to use pura karo, chhoti-moti part-time kamai side me chal sakti hai. Aur haan, ye faisla ek baar me antim nahi hota — 6 mahine baad haalat dekh kar badal bhi sakte ho. Ghabrana band karo, soch kar kadam uthao.
Har jagah experience mangte hain, fresher ko kaun dega kaam? Pehli naukri milegi kaise?

Jawab na aana matlab tum bekaar ho, ye bilkul nahi hai — matlab hai ki tumhari arzi sahi jagah sahi roop me nahi pahuch rahi. Teen cheezein theek karo: ek, resume me wahi likho jo us naukri ko chahiye, har jagah ek hi purana resume mat bhejo. Do, apply karne ka samay aur jagah badlo — subah ke samay aur seedha company/dukaan par jaakar baat karna online se zyada kaam karta hai. Teen, har hafte apne se pucho: is hafte maine naya kya kiya jo pichhle hafte nahi kiya tha? Agar jawab 'kuch nahi' hai to tareeka wahi purana hai. Naukri ki khoj bhi ek kaam hai, use roz ke niyam aur copy par hisaab ke saath karo, safalta achanak nahi, lagatar koshish se aati hai.
Main ghar ke kaam ke saath padhai bhi karni hai, dono ke liye samay ka hisaab kaise banau?

Din nikal jane ki bimari ka ilaaj ek hi hai: din ko pehle se kagaz par banao. Raat ko sone se pehle kal ke 3 sabse zaroori kaam likho — zyada nahi, sirf 3. Subah uth kar sabse mushkil kaam pehle karo, jab dimag taaza ho. Din ko tukdo me banto: kaam ka samay, aaram ka samay, phone ka samay — sab ka apna ghanta. Aur shaam ko 5 minute hisaab karo: kya hua, kya reh gaya. Pehle hafte me hi farak dikhega. Ek galti mat karna: pure din ko minute-minute se bhar dena, aaram ka samay bhi yojna me rakho warna yojna 3 din me toot jayegi. Samay sabke paas 24 ghante hi hai, jeet usi ki hai jo use pehle se tay karta hai.
Main board exam me 3 baar fail ho chuka hoon, ab umeed hi nahi bachi.

Asafalta se seekh nikalne ka pakka tareeka sikha deta hoon, 4 sawal wala. Haar ke 2-3 din baad, shanti se kagaz par likho: ek, main chahta kya tha aur mila kya? Do, isme meri kaunsi galti thi — taiyari ki, samay ki, ya galat jaankari ki? Teen, agar dobara wahi sthiti aaye to main kya alag karunga? Chaar, is haar ne mujhe aisi kaunsi baat sikha di jo jeet kabhi nahi sikhati? In jawabon ko sambhal kar rakho aur agli koshish se pehle padh lo. Ek niyam aur: haar ka kaaran 'kismat' ya 'main hi bekaar hoon' kabhi mat likho — kaaran hamesha wo likho jo tum badal sakte ho. Yahi seekh haar ko khaad banati hai.
Baar-baar asafalta milti hai, ab koshish karne ka man hi nahi karta. Himmat kahan se lau?

'Log kya kahenge' — ye dar lakhon sapno ko kha chuka hai, par ek sach suno: log do din baat karte hain, teesre din apni zindagi me vyast ho jate hain. Tum apni puri zindagi do din ki baato ke liye nahi rok sakte. Ek hisaab lagao: aaj se 5 saal baad ye log tumhe yaad bhi nahi honge, par tumhe apni koshish ya apna pachtawa zaroor yaad hoga. Isliye faisla aise lo jaise log dekh hi nahi rahe. Aur ek baat: wahi log jo aaj has rahe hain, tumhari safalta par sabse pehle badhai denge — ye duniya ka tareeka hai. Logo ki baat ko khaad banao, deewar mat banao.
Lucknow me naukri ke liye gaya tha, khaali haath laut aaya. Ab kya raasta hai?

Experience wala chakkar aise tootta hai: pehla kaam 'naukri' nahi, 'saboot' hota hai. Kisi dukaan, office ya online jagah chhota kaam, internship ya madad wala kaam pakdo — paisa kam mile to bhi 3-6 mahine ka anubhav aur ek achha naam mil jayega. Saath me apne kaam ke namune banao: agar computer ka kaam chahiye to kuch bana kar dikhane ko rakho, bolne se zyada dikhaya hua kaam bolta hai. Aur ek raaz ki baat: chhote sheher aur chhoti companiyo me fresher ko mauka zyada milta hai, badi jagah ki line me khade rehne se behtar hai wahan se shuru karna. Pehli seedhi chhoti hoti hai, par chadhna wahi se shuru hota hai.
Dost kehte hain main computer me achha hoon, par mujhe khud par yakeen nahi hota.

Tulna ek aisi race hai jisme koi jeet hi nahi sakta, kyunki hamesha koi aage hoga. Ise rokne ka tareeka: apni tulna sirf apne kal se karo. Ek copy me mahine ki shuruaat me likho tum kahan ho — kya aata hai, kya haalat hai. Mahine ke ant me dekho kitna aage badhe. Yahi asal hisaab hai. Dusri baat: dusro ki safalta me unki mehnat aur unki mushkilein dikhayi nahi deti, tum apni puri kahani ko unki ek tasveer se tol rahe ho — ye hisaab hi galat hai. Teesri baat: jis cheez me dusra aage hai, usse jalan ki jagah seekh nikalo — usne kya kiya jo tum kar sakte ho. Tulna ko shikshak bana lo, dushman nahi.
Mere paas ek business ka idea hai, par samajh nahi aa raha abhi shuru karu ya aur rukun.

Sahi samay calender par nahi aata, wo taiyari se banta hai. Teen nishani dekho: ek, tumhare paas 4-6 mahine ke ghar-kharcha jitni bachat hai, taaki shuruaat ke dheeme mahino me ghabrahat na ho. Do, tumne apna kaam chhote paimane par parakh liya hai — kuch graahak pehle se hain ya kam se kam asal logo ne haan kaha hai, sirf doston ki tareef nahi. Teen, tumhe apne kaam ke kharche aur kamai ka kagaz par hisaab hai. Agar ye teen hai to samay sahi hai. Aur ek salah: naukri ekdum mat chhodo, pehle side me kaam khada karo, jab side ki kamai tankhwah ke aadhe tak pahunche tab chhodne ka socho. Aise kadam me dar bhi kam aur jokhim bhi kam.
Main sarkari bharti ki pariksha me 3 baar fail ho chuka hoon, ab umeed hi nahi bachi.

Asafalta se seekh nikalne ka pakka tareeka sikha deta hoon, 4 sawal wala. Haar ke 2-3 din baad, shanti se kagaz par likho: ek, main chahta kya tha aur mila kya? Do, isme meri kaunsi galti thi — taiyari ki, samay ki, ya galat jaankari ki? Teen, agar dobara wahi sthiti aaye to main kya alag karunga? Chaar, is haar ne mujhe aisi kaunsi baat sikha di jo jeet kabhi nahi sikhati? In jawabon ko sambhal kar rakho aur agli koshish se pehle padh lo. Ek niyam aur: haar ka kaaran 'kismat' ya 'main hi bekaar hoon' kabhi mat likho — kaaran hamesha wo likho jo tum badal sakte ho. Yahi seekh haar ko khaad banati hai.
Apna chai-nashte ki dukaan shuru karne ka man hai, par naukri chhodne ka dar hai. Kya karu?

Naukri chhodne ka dar har imandaar aadmi ko lagta hai, isliye koodo mat, seedhi banao. Pehla kadam: apne chai-nashte ki dukaan ko naukri ke saath chhote roop me shuru karo — sham aur chhutti wale din. Dusra: pehle 10 graahako ko asal seva do, unse sikho ki bazaar chahta kya hai. Teesra: jab lagatar 3 mahine side kaam se kuch pakki kamai aane lage aur graahak badhne lage, tab naukri chhodne ka faisla lo. Is tareeke se tumhe pata chalega ki idea kagaz par achha hai ya asal me bhi. Aur haan, naukri walo se sambandh achhe rakho — vyapaar me wahi pehchan kaam aati hai, aur darwaza khula rehta hai.
Maine 5 saal naukri ki hai, ab apna khane ka kaam shuru karna chahta hoon. Naukri kab chhodu?

Idea achha hai ya nahi, ye sochne se nahi, parakhne se pata chalta hai. Ek mahine ka parikshan karo: apne idea ki baat 20 asal logo se karo jo uske graahak ban sakte hain — unme se kitne asal me paisa dene ko taiyaar hain, ye ginno. Phir chhota sa namuna ya seva bana kar 5 logo ko becho ya do. Agar ajnabee log paisa de rahe hain to idea me dum hai, aur agar sirf 'idea achha hai' sunne ko mil raha hai paisa koi nahi de raha, to ruk kar idea ko sudharo. Faisla bhavna se nahi, is parakh se lo. Aur shuru karne ka sabse sahi samay wahi hai jab parakh paas ho aur bachat ka hisaab pura ho — usse pehle jaldi, uske baad deri, dono nuksan hain.
Mere dost sharaab peete karte hain aur mujhe bhi zabardasti shamil karte hain. Mana karu to dosti tootne ka dar hai.

Chhote bhai ko samjhane me dant sabse kam kaam karti hai, kyunki us umar me dant sun kar kaan band ho jate hain. Tareeka ye rakho: pehle uska dost bano, pucho uske dost kaun hain, wo kya karta hai, bina toke suno. Phir apni ya kisi jaane wale ki asal kahani sunao jisme galat sangat ka anjaam dikhe — kahani lecture se zyada asar karti hai. Use khaali samay mat do: khel, kaam ya kisi skill me lagao, khaali dimag hi sangat dhundhta hai. Maa-baap ko bhi pyaar se samjhao ki sakhti se baat aur bigdegi. Aur sabse zaroori: khud uske saamne misal bano, chhote bade ko sunte kam, dekhte zyada hain.
Kya likhna ko shauk rakh kar, paisa wala kaam karna sahi rahega?

Ek galti kabhi mat karna: sirf isliye koi kaam chunna ki 'usme paisa bahut hai' jabki tumhe usse nafrat hai. Roz 8-10 ghante nafrat wala kaam karna insaan ko andar se khokhla kar deta hai. Dusri galti: bina bazaar dekhe sirf junoon me kud jana. Samajhdari ye hai — apni pasand ki list banao, phir har pasand ke saamne usse judde kamai wale kaam likho. likhna pasand hai to usse jude 3-4 kaam zaroor honge jinme kamai bhi hai. Unme se wo chuno jahan pasand aur paisa sabse zyada milte hain. Aur faisle ko pathar ki lakeer mat samjho — 25-30 saal ki umar tak raasta badalna aam baat hai, duniya ke aadhe safal log dusre kaam se shuru hue the.
Kunal hoon main, mere papa sapna dekhte hain ki main kheti me haath bataun karu, par main kala aur design ka kaam banna chahta hoon. Unhe dukhi bhi nahi karna.

Sawal ko 'ya wo ya main' mat banao, yehi sabse badi galti hai. Parivaar ke khilaf jaakar mili safalta bhi andar se khaali lagti hai, aur khud ko maar kar mili unki khushi bhi tikti nahi. Beech ka raasta ye hai: samay ka samjhota karo. Unse kaho: 'Mujhe itna samay do apne raaste ko parakhne ke liye, agar is samay me kuch na bane to main aapke raaste par puri taakat se chalunga.' Ye baat sun kar maa-baap ka dar kam hota hai, kyunki unhe lagta hai darwaza band nahi hua. Phir us samay ko jaan laga kar kaam me lagao — saboot hi sabse bada tark hai. Aur agar tum safal hue to sabse zyada khushi unhi ko hogi, ye pakka hai.
Mere papa kheti karte hain, ghar ki aamdani kam hai. Padhai jaari rakhu ya unka haath batau?

Dekho, dono raaste sahi hain, galat sirf bina soche chuna hua raasta hai. Apni haalat ka sach likho: ghar ki aamdani, tumhari padhai ka kharcha, aur tumhari asal dilchaspi. Phir ye dekho ki medical me jaane ke liye aur kitni padhai baaki hai. Agar 1-2 saal ki padhai se darwaza khulta hai to wo kar lo, utne samay ghar ko samjha lo ya part-time se sahara do. Agar padhai sirf degree ke liye hai aur dil nahi lagta, to kaam shuru karke skill seekhna behtar hai. Jo bhi chuno, pura dil laga kar chuno — aadha-adhura faisla hi sabse bada nuksan karta hai.
Sahil naam hai mera, 22 saal ka hoon. Padhai chhod kar Bangalore naukri ke liye jau ya pehle degree puri karu?

Is sawal ka jawab 'ya padhai ya naukri' nahi hai, jawab hai 'kis kram me'. Pehle apne se teen sawal pucho: ek, kya ghar abhi mere paiso par tika hai? Do, jo padhai main kar raha hoon kya wo mujhe asal me aage le jayegi? Teen, kya main kaam ke saath padhai ka bojh utha sakta hoon? In teeno ke jawab kagaz par likho. Agar padhai ka seedha fayda dikh raha hai to use pura karo, chhoti-moti part-time kamai side me chal sakti hai. Aur haan, ye faisla ek baar me antim nahi hota — 6 mahine baad haalat dekh kar badal bhi sakte ho. Ghabrana band karo, soch kar kadam uthao.
Mera naam Rahul hai, agle Somvaar ko interview hai, pichhli baar ki nakami baar-baar yaad aa rahi hai.

Sab theek jaane par bhi selection na hona sabse zyada confuse karta hai, par iske karan aksar tumse jude hi nahi hote: kabhi andar pehle se aadmi tay hota hai, kabhi budget ruk jata hai, kabhi unhe tumse zyada anubhav wala mil jata hai. Isliye is nakami ko apne upar mat lo. Karna ye hai: ho sake to wahan vinamrata se puchho ki kis cheez me sudhaar karu — jawab mile to sona. Apne resume aur bolne ke tareeke ko ek baar kisi anubhavi aadmi ko dikhao, bahar wala wohi dekhta hai jo hum nahi dekh pate. Aur sabse zaroori: is ek 'na' ko apni kahani ka ant mat banao. Naukri ek hoti hai, par naukriyaan hazaro hoti hain — tumhe sirf ek 'haan' chahiye.
Mere dost Aman aur uske saathi roz jua khelte karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Chhote bhai ko samjhane me dant sabse kam kaam karti hai, kyunki us umar me dant sun kar kaan band ho jate hain. Tareeka ye rakho: pehle uska dost bano, pucho uske dost kaun hain, wo kya karta hai, bina toke suno. Phir apni ya kisi jaane wale ki asal kahani sunao jisme galat sangat ka anjaam dikhe — kahani lecture se zyada asar karti hai. Use khaali samay mat do: khel, kaam ya kisi skill me lagao, khaali dimag hi sangat dhundhta hai. Maa-baap ko bhi pyaar se samjhao ki sakhti se baat aur bigdegi. Aur sabse zaroori: khud uske saamne misal bano, chhote bade ko sunte kam, dekhte zyada hain.
Main padhana karna chahta hoon par logo ke saamne khade hone se hi haath-pair kaanp jate hain.

Bharosa janm se nahi milta, wo kamaya jata hai — chhoti jeeto se. Iska tareeka seedha hai: roz ek chhota kaam tay karo jo tum poora kar sako, aur use poora karke ek copy me likho. Ek mahine me 30 jeeto ki list ban jayegi — jab man kahe 'tumse kuch nahi hota', wo list padhna, wo jhooth nahi bolti. Dusra: jis cheez me kamzori hai use chhupao mat, use chhote hisso me seekho; kabiliyat badhti hai to bharosa khud aata hai. Teesra: apne aas-paas ke logo ko dekho — unme se zyadatar aam log hain, bas unhone koshish zyada ki hai. Bharosa matlab 'main kabhi nahi girunga' nahi, bharosa matlab 'gir kar bhi uth jaunga, pehle bhi utha hoon.'
Mera naam Sahil hai, main 22 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Jab ghar wale hi aisi baat kehte hain to chot gehri lagti hai, samajh sakta hoon. Par ek baat samjho: unke shabd aksar chinta aur thakaan se nikalte hain, wo tumhari asal kabiliyat ka faisla nahi hain. Tumhe do kaam karne hain: pehla, behes mat karo, kaam karke dikhao — ek chhoti safalta sau beheso se bhaari hoti hai. Dusra, apne liye ek bahari sahara banao — ek dost, ek shikshak, koi bada bhai-behen jo tumpar bharosa kare; ek aadmi ka bharosa bhi kaafi hota hai. Aur sabse zaroori: unki baat ko apni awaaz mat banne do. Tum wo nahi ho jo log kehte hain, tum wo ho jo tum karte ho. Chhote kaam, pakki lagan — yahi jawab hai, aur ye jawab samay par sabko mil jata hai.
Mera sapna apna bada business khada karna hai, par main abhi chhoti naukri wala hoon. Wahan tak ka raasta kaise banau?

'Kal se' wala jaal sabse purana hai, aur iska tod hai: aaj, abhi, 10 minute. Suno, bada shuruaat ka din kabhi nahi aata, isliye pehla kadam itna chhota rakho ki mana karna mushkil ho — sirf 10 minute seekhna, sirf ek phone call, sirf ek page. Ek baar shuru ho jaye to dimag khud aage badhta hai, rukna hi mushkil hota hai. Dusra nuskha: apne sapne ke kaam ko roz ke ek tay samay aur jagah se bandh do, faisla roz nahi lena padega. Teesra: har roz ka kaam kisi ko batao ya copy me likho, hisaab dene ki aadat susti ko khatm karti hai. Kal ka intezaar chhodo — jo aadmi aaj ke 10 minute jeet leta hai, wahi ek din bada sapna jeetta hai.
Bangalore ke school me padhta hoon, 12th ke baad stream ka faisla lena hai. Science ke bina achhi naukri nahi milti kya?

Chalo teeno ka saaf hisaab deta hoon. Science: kharcha aur mehnat sabse zyada, raaste — engineering, medical, research, IT, defence; unke liye jinhe maths-science sach me pasand hai. Commerce: beech ka raasta, raaste — CA, CS, bank, accounts, apna business; unke liye jinhe number aur paiso ka khel samajh aata hai. Arts: kharcha kam, raaste — UPSC aur sarkari bharti, law, teaching, media; unke liye jo padhne-likhne aur samaj ke sawalo me ruchi rakhte hain. Ab apne aap ko dekho: tumhari pasand, ghar ka budget aur tumhara sabr — teeno mila kar jo stream fit baithe wahi sahi hai. Aur haan, 12th ke baad diploma aur skill course jaise darwaze bhi khule rehte hain, raasta ek nahi hota.
Mere dost Vikas aur uske saathi roz raat bhar faltu ghumte karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Dono ho sakta hai, bas dosti ki seema tumhe tay karni hogi. Pehla niyam: dosto ke saath samay bitao, par unki har baat me haan mat milao — chai, ghumna, khel, baatein, ye sab dosti hai; buri aadat dosti ki shart nahi. Dusra: mana karne par jo dost baar-baar apmaan kare ya zabardasti kare, usse doori bana lo — ye dushmani nahi, apni hifazat hai. Teesra: apne dost-mandal me 1-2 aise dost zaroor rakho jo sahi raaste par hain, sangat ka asar dono taraf hota hai. Ek baat hamesha yaad rakho: paanch saal baad tum unhi jaise ban jaoge jinke saath tum sabse zyada samay bitate ho. Isliye sangat chunna bhi ek faisla hai, aur ye faisla tumhara hai.
Mera sapna ek safal video creator banna hai, par main abhi chhoti naukri wala hoon. Wahan tak ka raasta kaise banau?

'Kal se' wala jaal sabse purana hai, aur iska tod hai: aaj, abhi, 10 minute. Suno, bada shuruaat ka din kabhi nahi aata, isliye pehla kadam itna chhota rakho ki mana karna mushkil ho — sirf 10 minute seekhna, sirf ek phone call, sirf ek page. Ek baar shuru ho jaye to dimag khud aage badhta hai, rukna hi mushkil hota hai. Dusra nuskha: apne sapne ke kaam ko roz ke ek tay samay aur jagah se bandh do, faisla roz nahi lena padega. Teesra: har roz ka kaam kisi ko batao ya copy me likho, hisaab dene ki aadat susti ko khatm karti hai. Kal ka intezaar chhodo — jo aadmi aaj ke 10 minute jeet leta hai, wahi ek din bada sapna jeetta hai.
Main roz ka routine banana chahta hoon par 3-4 din me toot jata hai. Aisi aadat kaise banau jo tike?

Kaam bahut ho to pehle ye samjho: sab kaam ek jaise zaroori nahi hote. Ek tareeka bahut kaam ka hai — har kaam ko do hisso me dekho: zaroori hai ya jaldi hai. Jo zaroori bhi hai aur jaldi bhi, wo pehle. Jo zaroori hai par jaldi nahi, uska samay tay karo. Jo jaldi hai par zaroori nahi, use chhota karo ya kisi ko do. Jo na zaroori na jaldi, use list se hata do — aadha bojh wahi hota hai. Roz subah 5 minute me din ke kaam is hisaab se laga lo. Aur ek din me 3 bade kaam se zyada ka bojh mat lo. Bhaagna band hoga jab likhna shuru hoga — dimag me rakha kaam hamesha zyada lagta hai, kagaz par wo ginati ka ho jata hai.
College ke dost nasha karte ke liye dabav dalte hain, mana karne par dosti khatre me lagti hai.

Pehle ye samajh lo: jo dost tumhe nuksan wali cheez ke liye majboor kare, wo dosti nahi, apni aadat ka saathi dhundhna hai. Mana karne ka tareeka ladai wala nahi, shanti wala rakho: 'Mujhe ye nahi jamta, tum karo, main paas baitha hoon' — saaf aur bina lecture ke. Pehli baar me kuch dost hasenge, dusri baar se aadat pad jayegi. Agar phir bhi zabardasti ho to dheere-dheere un mahfilon se samay kam kar do aur dusri sangat badhao — khel, kaam ya padhai wale dost. Ek kasauti yaad rakho: asal dost mana karne par bura nahi manta. Aur apne shareer aur paise ka hisaab khud rakho, kisi ki dosti itni badi nahi ki apni zindagi daav par lage.
Aman hoon main, 12th me mere 70% number aaye. Ghar wale Science keh rahe hain, mera man Arts me hai.

Stream chunna bada faisla hai par 'zindagi barbaad' wali baat galat hai — bahut se log baad me raasta badal lete hain, bas thoda samay zyada lagta hai. Sahi tareeka ye hai: pehle apne 12th ke number nahi, apni pasand dekho. Jis vishay ki kitab kholne me man kare, wahi tumhari taakat hai. Phir har stream ke aage ke raaste likho: Science se technical aur medical, Commerce se paisa-hisaab aur business, Arts se sarkari seva, law, teaching aur creative kaam. Phir socho tum 25 saal ki umar me khud ko kya karte hue dekhna chahte ho. Us tasveer se jo stream milti hai wahi lo. Maa-baap aur rishtedaro ki suno sabki, par faisla apni pasand aur us kaam ke bazaar dono dekh kar lo.
Sahil naam hai mera, 21 saal ka hoon. Padhai chhod kar Mumbai naukri ke liye jau ya pehle degree puri karu?

Ek baat hamesha yaad rakho: bina skill ki naukri tumhe aaj paisa degi, par padhai aur skill tumhe har saal badhti hui kamai degi. Isliye mera dostana mashwara hai — agar koi bahut badi majboori nahi hai to pehle padhai aur ek kaam ki skill pakki karo. Saath me chhota part-time kaam mil jaye to sone pe suhaga. Agar majboori hai to naukri pakdo, lekin hafte me kam se kam 6-8 ghante padhai ke liye bacha kar rakho, mobile ka time wahi se katega. Faisla jazbaat me nahi, hisaab laga kar lo. Aur parivaar ko baith kar apni yojna samjhao, wo maan jayenge.
Sheher me rehna mehenga hai, meri bachat sirf 8000 rupaye hai. Kaise sambhalunga pehle mahine?

Ghar walo ka dar pyaar se aata hai, unse ladna nahi, unhe yojna dikhani hai. Baith kar saaf batao: tum kis kaam ke liye ja rahe ho, kahan rahoge, kiske paas rahoge, aur kitne samay me kya karke dikhaoge. Unke saamne ek samay-seema rakho — 'mujhe 6 mahine do, kaam na lage to laut aaunga' — ye sun kar maa-baap ka dil halka ho jata hai. Wahan jaakar roz video call aur apni progress batate raho, bharosa badhega. Aur apne vyavhaar se unka dar galat sabit karo: paisa ghar bhejo, galat sangat se door raho. Bharosa shabdon se nahi, kaam se banta hai.
Mera sabse achha dost jua khelte me fas gaya hai, use isse kaise nikaalu?

Chhote bhai ko samjhane me dant sabse kam kaam karti hai, kyunki us umar me dant sun kar kaan band ho jate hain. Tareeka ye rakho: pehle uska dost bano, pucho uske dost kaun hain, wo kya karta hai, bina toke suno. Phir apni ya kisi jaane wale ki asal kahani sunao jisme galat sangat ka anjaam dikhe — kahani lecture se zyada asar karti hai. Use khaali samay mat do: khel, kaam ya kisi skill me lagao, khaali dimag hi sangat dhundhta hai. Maa-baap ko bhi pyaar se samjhao ki sakhti se baat aur bigdegi. Aur sabse zaroori: khud uske saamne misal bano, chhote bade ko sunte kam, dekhte zyada hain.
Meri bachat 2 lakh rupaye hai, kya itne me kapdo ka kaam shuru ho jayega ya aur paisa jodu?

Naukri chhodne ka dar har imandaar aadmi ko lagta hai, isliye koodo mat, seedhi banao. Pehla kadam: apne kapdo ka kaam ko naukri ke saath chhote roop me shuru karo — sham aur chhutti wale din. Dusra: pehle 10 graahako ko asal seva do, unse sikho ki bazaar chahta kya hai. Teesra: jab lagatar 3 mahine side kaam se kuch pakki kamai aane lage aur graahak badhne lage, tab naukri chhodne ka faisla lo. Is tareeke se tumhe pata chalega ki idea kagaz par achha hai ya asal me bhi. Aur haan, naukri walo se sambandh achhe rakho — vyapaar me wahi pehchan kaam aati hai, aur darwaza khula rehta hai.
Kunal naam hai mera, main din bhar ghar ke kaam me uljha rehta hoon, apne liye samay hi nahi bachta.

Routine tootne ki wajah tumhari kamzori nahi, routine ka zyada sakht hona hai. Niyam ye rakho: pehle sirf 2 aadat pakdo — ek uthne ka samay, ek padhne/kaam ka ek ghanta. Sirf itna 15 din chalao. Jab ye pakka ho jaye tab teesri aadat jodo. Dusra niyam: ek din toot jaye to dusre din se phir shuru karo, 'sab kharab ho gaya' soch kar pura chhodna sabse badi galti hai. Teesra: apni aadat ko kisi roz ke kaam se jodo — jaise chai ke baad hi padhai, nahane ke baad hi kaam ki list. Aadat 21 din me nahi, lagatar chhoti jeeto se banti hai. Khud ko har hafte chhoti safalta par shabaashi do, dimag usi se seekhta hai.
Mera pura din aise hi nikal jata hai, shaam ko lagta hai kuch kiya hi nahi. Samay ka sahi prabandhan kaise karu?

Routine tootne ki wajah tumhari kamzori nahi, routine ka zyada sakht hona hai. Niyam ye rakho: pehle sirf 2 aadat pakdo — ek uthne ka samay, ek padhne/kaam ka ek ghanta. Sirf itna 15 din chalao. Jab ye pakka ho jaye tab teesri aadat jodo. Dusra niyam: ek din toot jaye to dusre din se phir shuru karo, 'sab kharab ho gaya' soch kar pura chhodna sabse badi galti hai. Teesra: apni aadat ko kisi roz ke kaam se jodo — jaise chai ke baad hi padhai, nahane ke baad hi kaam ki list. Aadat 21 din me nahi, lagatar chhoti jeeto se banti hai. Khud ko har hafte chhoti safalta par shabaashi do, dimag usi se seekhta hai.
Naukri me man nahi lagta, apna kaam karna hai. Par agar fail ho gaya to? Bahut dar lagta hai.

Idea achha hai ya nahi, ye sochne se nahi, parakhne se pata chalta hai. Ek mahine ka parikshan karo: apne idea ki baat 20 asal logo se karo jo uske graahak ban sakte hain — unme se kitne asal me paisa dene ko taiyaar hain, ye ginno. Phir chhota sa namuna ya seva bana kar 5 logo ko becho ya do. Agar ajnabee log paisa de rahe hain to idea me dum hai, aur agar sirf 'idea achha hai' sunne ko mil raha hai paisa koi nahi de raha, to ruk kar idea ko sudharo. Faisla bhavna se nahi, is parakh se lo. Aur shuru karne ka sabse sahi samay wahi hai jab parakh paas ho aur bachat ka hisaab pura ho — usse pehle jaldi, uske baad deri, dono nuksan hain.
Deepak hoon main, mera sapna hai cricketer banna. Ghar wale kehte hain ye hamare bas ka nahi.

Sapne aur roz ki zindagi ko jodne wala pul hai: roz ka ek ghanta. Suno, bade sapne ek din ke bade kaam se nahi bante, roz ke chhote kaam se bante hain. Apne sapne se juda ek kaam chuno jo roz 1 ghanta ho sake — seekhna, banana, practice karna. Us ghante ko din ke ek tay samay par bandh do aur use kisi bhi haal me chhodo mat. Saath me ek copy rakho jisme roz likho: aaj sapne ke liye kya kiya. Mahine ke ant me wo copy hi tumhara bharosa hogi. Aur sapne ko sabke saamne ghoshna karne ki jaldi mat karo, pehle kuch kadam chal kar dikhao. Kaam bolta hai, baatein nahi.
Main ITI kiya hoon, naukri dhundhte dhundhte thak gaya hoon. Ab kya karu?

Jawab na aana matlab tum bekaar ho, ye bilkul nahi hai — matlab hai ki tumhari arzi sahi jagah sahi roop me nahi pahuch rahi. Teen cheezein theek karo: ek, resume me wahi likho jo us naukri ko chahiye, har jagah ek hi purana resume mat bhejo. Do, apply karne ka samay aur jagah badlo — subah ke samay aur seedha company/dukaan par jaakar baat karna online se zyada kaam karta hai. Teen, har hafte apne se pucho: is hafte maine naya kya kiya jo pichhle hafte nahi kiya tha? Agar jawab 'kuch nahi' hai to tareeka wahi purana hai. Naukri ki khoj bhi ek kaam hai, use roz ke niyam aur copy par hisaab ke saath karo, safalta achanak nahi, lagatar koshish se aati hai.
Rahul naam hai mera, pehli baar Jaipur ja raha hoon kaam ke liye. Wahan rehne-khane ka bandobast kaise karu?

Sheher jana bada kadam hai, par sahi taiyari ho to yehi kadam zindagi badal deta hai. Jane se pehle teen taiyari karo: ek, kam se kam 2 mahine ke kharche jitna paisa bachat me rakho, pehla mahina sabse mushkil hota hai. Do, jane se pehle hi kisi pehchan wale ya purane saathi se baat karo jo wahan ho — pehla thikana aur kaam ki jaankari wahi se milti hai. Teen, apne kagaz (Aadhaar, photo, bank khata) ki copy phone aur kagaz dono me rakho. Wahan pahuch kar pehle sasta kamra aur khana dhundho, shaan mat dikhao. Aur thago se bachne ka ek niyam: naukri ke naam par pehle paisa mange to samjho dhokha hai, asli naukri paisa leti nahi deti hai.
Meri umar 19 saal hai, ab tak padh hi raha hoon. Log taane marte hain ki kab kamaoge. Bahut tension hai.

Dekho, dono raaste sahi hain, galat sirf bina soche chuna hua raasta hai. Apni haalat ka sach likho: ghar ki aamdani, tumhari padhai ka kharcha, aur tumhari asal dilchaspi. Phir ye dekho ki teaching me jaane ke liye aur kitni padhai baaki hai. Agar 1-2 saal ki padhai se darwaza khulta hai to wo kar lo, utne samay ghar ko samjha lo ya part-time se sahara do. Agar padhai sirf degree ke liye hai aur dil nahi lagta, to kaam shuru karke skill seekhna behtar hai. Jo bhi chuno, pura dil laga kar chuno — aadha-adhura faisla hi sabse bada nuksan karta hai.
Mera naam Ravi hai. Mujhe computer par kaam ka kaam pasand hai par ghar wale sarkari naukri ke liye kehte hain.

Dost, ek kasauti yaad rakho: paisa 'kitna' se zyada zaroori hai paisa 'kahan tak badhega'. Kuch kaamo me shuruaat zyada hoti hai par 10 saal baad bhi wahi ruk jati hai; kuch me shuruaat kam par seekhne ke saath kamai dugni-tigni hoti hai. Isliye faisla aise lo: pehle apni pasand ke kaam ki 5 saal wali tasveer dekho — usme bade log kitna kama rahe hain aur wahan tak ka raasta kitna lamba hai. Phir apni majboori dekho — agar ghar ko abhi paisa chahiye to pehle kamai wala kaam pakdo, par pasand ko side me zinda rakho, samay milte hi udhar badho. Dil aur paisa dushman nahi hain, sahi kram me rakho to dono mil jate hain.
Aman naam hai mera, main din bhar ghar ke kaam me uljha rehta hoon, apne liye samay hi nahi bachta.

Routine tootne ki wajah tumhari kamzori nahi, routine ka zyada sakht hona hai. Niyam ye rakho: pehle sirf 2 aadat pakdo — ek uthne ka samay, ek padhne/kaam ka ek ghanta. Sirf itna 15 din chalao. Jab ye pakka ho jaye tab teesri aadat jodo. Dusra niyam: ek din toot jaye to dusre din se phir shuru karo, 'sab kharab ho gaya' soch kar pura chhodna sabse badi galti hai. Teesra: apni aadat ko kisi roz ke kaam se jodo — jaise chai ke baad hi padhai, nahane ke baad hi kaam ki list. Aadat 21 din me nahi, lagatar chhoti jeeto se banti hai. Khud ko har hafte chhoti safalta par shabaashi do, dimag usi se seekhta hai.
Ghar wale chahte hain main engineering karu, par mera sapna apna business khada karna hai. Dono me santulan kaise banau?

Sawal ko 'ya wo ya main' mat banao, yehi sabse badi galti hai. Parivaar ke khilaf jaakar mili safalta bhi andar se khaali lagti hai, aur khud ko maar kar mili unki khushi bhi tikti nahi. Beech ka raasta ye hai: samay ka samjhota karo. Unse kaho: 'Mujhe itna samay do apne raaste ko parakhne ke liye, agar is samay me kuch na bane to main aapke raaste par puri taakat se chalunga.' Ye baat sun kar maa-baap ka dar kam hota hai, kyunki unhe lagta hai darwaza band nahi hua. Phir us samay ko jaan laga kar kaam me lagao — saboot hi sabse bada tark hai. Aur agar tum safal hue to sabse zyada khushi unhi ko hogi, ye pakka hai.
Ghar wale kehte hain paisa wala kaam pakdo, mera dil padhana aur samjhana me hai. Beech ka raasta hai kya?

Dost, ek kasauti yaad rakho: paisa 'kitna' se zyada zaroori hai paisa 'kahan tak badhega'. Kuch kaamo me shuruaat zyada hoti hai par 10 saal baad bhi wahi ruk jati hai; kuch me shuruaat kam par seekhne ke saath kamai dugni-tigni hoti hai. Isliye faisla aise lo: pehle apni pasand ke kaam ki 5 saal wali tasveer dekho — usme bade log kitna kama rahe hain aur wahan tak ka raasta kitna lamba hai. Phir apni majboori dekho — agar ghar ko abhi paisa chahiye to pehle kamai wala kaam pakdo, par pasand ko side me zinda rakho, samay milte hi udhar badho. Dil aur paisa dushman nahi hain, sahi kram me rakho to dono mil jate hain.
Mere dost Sahil aur uske saathi roz sharaab peete karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Pehle ye samajh lo: jo dost tumhe nuksan wali cheez ke liye majboor kare, wo dosti nahi, apni aadat ka saathi dhundhna hai. Mana karne ka tareeka ladai wala nahi, shanti wala rakho: 'Mujhe ye nahi jamta, tum karo, main paas baitha hoon' — saaf aur bina lecture ke. Pehli baar me kuch dost hasenge, dusri baar se aadat pad jayegi. Agar phir bhi zabardasti ho to dheere-dheere un mahfilon se samay kam kar do aur dusri sangat badhao — khel, kaam ya padhai wale dost. Ek kasauti yaad rakho: asal dost mana karne par bura nahi manta. Aur apne shareer aur paise ka hisaab khud rakho, kisi ki dosti itni badi nahi ki apni zindagi daav par lage.
school ke interview me kal fail ho gaya, computer ke sawal par atak gaya tha. Bahut mayoosi hai.

Pichhli nakami ko yaad karke darna aam hai, par is baar taiyari ka tareeka badal do, sirf zyada mat karo. Pehla din: pichhle interview ke sawal aur unke sahi jawab likho. Dusra-teeja din: is company aur is kaam ke baare me pata karo, taaki 'hamare yahan kyun kaam karna hai' ka jawab pakka ho. Chautha din: dost ke saath nakli interview karo, samay laga kar. Aakhri din: kapde, kagaz aur raasta pehle se tay karo, raat ko jaldi so jao. Aur man me ye baat baandh lo: ye interview zindagi ka aakhri mauka nahi hai, ek aur kadam hai. Jo aadmi nakami ke baad phir khada hota hai, interviewer ko wahi bharosa dikhta hai.
Mere dost Ravi aur uske saathi roz sharaab peete karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Dono ho sakta hai, bas dosti ki seema tumhe tay karni hogi. Pehla niyam: dosto ke saath samay bitao, par unki har baat me haan mat milao — chai, ghumna, khel, baatein, ye sab dosti hai; buri aadat dosti ki shart nahi. Dusra: mana karne par jo dost baar-baar apmaan kare ya zabardasti kare, usse doori bana lo — ye dushmani nahi, apni hifazat hai. Teesra: apne dost-mandal me 1-2 aise dost zaroor rakho jo sahi raaste par hain, sangat ka asar dono taraf hota hai. Ek baat hamesha yaad rakho: paanch saal baad tum unhi jaise ban jaoge jinke saath tum sabse zyada samay bitate ho. Isliye sangat chunna bhi ek faisla hai, aur ye faisla tumhara hai.
Raat ko 2 baje tak jaagta hoon, subah uth hi nahi pata, pura din bigad jata hai.

Mobile samay khane wala sabse bada chor hai, par use dushman mat banao, naukar banao. Teen kadam lo: pehla, phone ka wohi hissa band karo jo bina matlab hai — faltu suchna (notification) band kar do, sirf call aur zaroori cheez khuli rakho. Dusra, padhai/kaam ke samay phone dusre kamre me ya ghar wale ke paas rakho, paas rakha phone har 10 minute me kheenchta hai. Teesra, phone ke liye bhi samay tay karo — jaise khane ke baad aadha ghanta — taaki man ko lage mana nahi hai, samay hai. Pehle din mushkil lagega, ek hafte me tum khud hairaan hoge ki kitna samay bacha hua pada tha.
Career me dil ki sunu ya paise ki? Mujhe padhana aur samjhana pasand hai par usme kamai kam sunayi deti hai.

Ek galti kabhi mat karna: sirf isliye koi kaam chunna ki 'usme paisa bahut hai' jabki tumhe usse nafrat hai. Roz 8-10 ghante nafrat wala kaam karna insaan ko andar se khokhla kar deta hai. Dusri galti: bina bazaar dekhe sirf junoon me kud jana. Samajhdari ye hai — apni pasand ki list banao, phir har pasand ke saamne usse judde kamai wale kaam likho. padhana aur samjhana pasand hai to usse jude 3-4 kaam zaroor honge jinme kamai bhi hai. Unme se wo chuno jahan pasand aur paisa sabse zyada milte hain. Aur faisle ko pathar ki lakeer mat samjho — 25-30 saal ki umar tak raasta badalna aam baat hai, duniya ke aadhe safal log dusre kaam se shuru hue the.
Ravi naam hai mera, pehli baar Patna ja raha hoon kaam ke liye. Wahan rehne-khane ka bandobast kaise karu?

Bachat kam hai to yojna aur sakht banani hogi, par ho jayega. Pehla mahina is hisaab se chalao: kamra kisi ke saath share karo taaki kiraya aadha ho, khana shuru me saste dhabe ya khud bana kar, aana-jaana paidal ya bus se. Pehle din se roz ka kharcha ek copy me likho — ye aadat hi bachat ki maa hai. Kaam milte hi pehli tankhwah se sabse pehle agle mahine ka kiraya alag rakho. Ek baat aur: sheher me shuruaat me chhota kaam milne par sharmana mat, pehla kaam sirf pehla kadam hai, wahi se jaan-pehchan banti hai aur behtar kaam milta hai. Hisab se chalne wala sheher me kabhi bhooka nahi sota.
Deepak hoon main, mera sapna hai apna bada business khada karna. Ghar wale kehte hain ye hamare bas ka nahi.

Logo ke hasne par ek sach yaad rakho: hasne wale apne sapne poore nahi kar paye, isliye dusro ke sapno ko chhota karte hain taaki unhe bura na lage. Tumhe do kaam karne hain: ek, apne sapne ki baat har kisi se karna band karo — chup chaap kaam karo, safalta khud bol degi. Do, apne aas-paas ek bhi aisa aadmi dhundho jo tumhare sapne ke raaste par aage hai, uski baat suno, hasne walo ki nahi. Sapna 'aukat' se nahi, mehnat aur samay se banta hai — aaj ke bade naam kabhi chhoti jagah se hi shuru hue the. Dil tootne par rukna mat, usi dil ko khaad banao. Ek din wahi hasne wale tumhari misaal denge.
Aman hoon main, roz ke 300 rupaye kharch ho hi jate hain. Itni chhoti kamai se smartphone ka paisa kaise judega?

Apne paiso se pehli cheez lene ka maza hi alag hai, aur iska tareeka pakka hai. Pehla kadam: lakshya ki keemat tay karo — smartphone kitne ka lena hai, wo rakam aur ek tareekh likho. Dusra: har mahine kamai aate hi sabse pehle bachat alag karo, kharch baad me — jo log 'bacha hua jodte' hain unka kabhi nahi bachta. Teesra: bachat ko alag khate ya alag jagah rakho jahan se nikalna mushkil ho. Chautha: chhote kharch par nazar rakho — roz ke 50-100 rupaye ke faltu kharch hi mahine ke hazaro ban jate hain. Agar ho sake to is dauraan ek chhoti extra kamai (part-time, purana saaman bechna) jodo, samay aadha ho jayega. Jab rakam puri ho to garv se lo — wo sirf smartphone nahi hoga, wo tumhari mehnat ka saboot hoga.
Main gaon se hoon, kaam ke liye Mumbai jane ka soch raha hoon. Wahan jaakar kya-kya mushkil aayegi aur taiyari kaise karu?

Gaon ya sheher — ye faisla bhavnao se nahi, hisaab se lo. Gaon me kharcha kam hai, parivar paas hai, aur agar zameen ya dukaan ka koi raasta hai to wahan bhi bhavishya ban sakta hai, khaaskar ab jab online kaam gaon tak pahuch gaya hai. Sheher me mauke zyada hain, par kharcha aur akelapan bhi zyada hai. Ek tareeka ye hai: pehle 6 mahine ke liye sheher jaakar parakh lo, ghar se rishta aur gaon ka thikana banaye rakho. Kaam mil jaye aur man lag jaye to ruk jao, warna gaon lautna haar nahi hai. Jo log bina yojna ke jate hain wo pareshan hote hain, yojna banao: kaun sa kaam, kahan rahoge, kitna kharcha — teeno kagaz par likho phir niklo.
Delhi ke school me padhta hoon, 12th ke baad stream ka faisla lena hai. Science ke bina achhi naukri nahi milti kya?

Chalo teeno ka saaf hisaab deta hoon. Science: kharcha aur mehnat sabse zyada, raaste — engineering, medical, research, IT, defence; unke liye jinhe maths-science sach me pasand hai. Commerce: beech ka raasta, raaste — CA, CS, bank, accounts, apna business; unke liye jinhe number aur paiso ka khel samajh aata hai. Arts: kharcha kam, raaste — UPSC aur sarkari bharti, law, teaching, media; unke liye jo padhne-likhne aur samaj ke sawalo me ruchi rakhte hain. Ab apne aap ko dekho: tumhari pasand, ghar ka budget aur tumhara sabr — teeno mila kar jo stream fit baithe wahi sahi hai. Aur haan, 12th ke baad diploma aur skill course jaise darwaze bhi khule rehte hain, raasta ek nahi hota.
Main naukri ke saath padhne wala hoon, padhai ke liye roz 3 ghante chahiye par milte hi nahi. Samay kaise nikalu?

Mobile samay khane wala sabse bada chor hai, par use dushman mat banao, naukar banao. Teen kadam lo: pehla, phone ka wohi hissa band karo jo bina matlab hai — faltu suchna (notification) band kar do, sirf call aur zaroori cheez khuli rakho. Dusra, padhai/kaam ke samay phone dusre kamre me ya ghar wale ke paas rakho, paas rakha phone har 10 minute me kheenchta hai. Teesra, phone ke liye bhi samay tay karo — jaise khane ke baad aadha ghanta — taaki man ko lage mana nahi hai, samay hai. Pehle din mushkil lagega, ek hafte me tum khud hairaan hoge ki kitna samay bacha hua pada tha.
Maine 3 saal naukri ki hai, ab apna chai-nashte ki dukaan shuru karna chahta hoon. Naukri kab chhodu?

Sahi samay calender par nahi aata, wo taiyari se banta hai. Teen nishani dekho: ek, tumhare paas 4-6 mahine ke ghar-kharcha jitni bachat hai, taaki shuruaat ke dheeme mahino me ghabrahat na ho. Do, tumne apna kaam chhote paimane par parakh liya hai — kuch graahak pehle se hain ya kam se kam asal logo ne haan kaha hai, sirf doston ki tareef nahi. Teen, tumhe apne kaam ke kharche aur kamai ka kagaz par hisaab hai. Agar ye teen hai to samay sahi hai. Aur ek salah: naukri ekdum mat chhodo, pehle side me kaam khada karo, jab side ki kamai tankhwah ke aadhe tak pahunche tab chhodne ka socho. Aise kadam me dar bhi kam aur jokhim bhi kam.
Ravi hoon main, 6 mahine se ghar baitha hoon naukri ke intezaar me. Ghar walo ke taane badh rahe hain.

Experience wala chakkar aise tootta hai: pehla kaam 'naukri' nahi, 'saboot' hota hai. Kisi dukaan, office ya online jagah chhota kaam, internship ya madad wala kaam pakdo — paisa kam mile to bhi 3-6 mahine ka anubhav aur ek achha naam mil jayega. Saath me apne kaam ke namune banao: agar computer ka kaam chahiye to kuch bana kar dikhane ko rakho, bolne se zyada dikhaya hua kaam bolta hai. Aur ek raaz ki baat: chhote sheher aur chhoti companiyo me fresher ko mauka zyada milta hai, badi jagah ki line me khade rehne se behtar hai wahan se shuru karna. Pehli seedhi chhoti hoti hai, par chadhna wahi se shuru hota hai.
College ke dost sharaab peete ke liye dabav dalte hain, mana karne par dosti khatre me lagti hai.

'Darpok' shabd ka ulta hai 'samajhdar', bas ye baat umar ke is mod par samajh kam aati hai. Ek hisaab lagao: aadat padne me ek pal lagta hai, chhodne me saal lag jate hain aur kuch log kabhi nahi chhod pate — shareer, paisa aur parivaar ki izzat, teeno girte hain. Jo has rahe hain wo tumhara bill nahi bharenge jab tum phasoge. Isliye apni line saaf rakho aur bina sharm ke rakho: 'Main nahi karta, baat khatam.' Saath me apni dusri pehchan banao — kaam, khel ya skill me aise aage badho ki logo ko tumhari izzat karni pade. Samay ke saath wahi hasne wale tumse salah lene aayenge, ye duniya ka niyam hai.
Ravi hoon main, 10th me mere 80% number aaye. Ghar wale Science keh rahe hain, mera man Arts me hai.

Pehle ek jhooth tod du: koi stream achhi ya buri nahi hoti, galat sirf wo chunav hai jo dusro ke dabav me ho. Science ke baad doctor, engineer, research, defence, computer — bahut raaste hain, par Science me maths aur mehnat bhaari hoti hai. Commerce ke baad CA, bank, business, accounts, company secretary jaise raaste khulte hain, hisaab-kitab pasand ho to best hai. Arts ke baad UPSC, teaching, law, journalism, design, sarkari naukri ki taiyari — ye sab hota hai, 'Arts me future nahi' purani soch hai. Chunav aise karo: pehla, kis vishay ko padhne me samay ka pata nahi chalta? Dusra, 12th ke baad tum kis kaam ki taraf jana chahte ho? Teesra, us stream ke vishay ek hafte padh kar dekho, dil lagta hai ya nahi. In teen se jawab khud mil jayega.
Mera sapna apna bada business khada karna hai, par main abhi padhne wala chhatra hoon. Wahan tak ka raasta kaise banau?

Sapne aur roz ki zindagi ko jodne wala pul hai: roz ka ek ghanta. Suno, bade sapne ek din ke bade kaam se nahi bante, roz ke chhote kaam se bante hain. Apne sapne se juda ek kaam chuno jo roz 1 ghanta ho sake — seekhna, banana, practice karna. Us ghante ko din ke ek tay samay par bandh do aur use kisi bhi haal me chhodo mat. Saath me ek copy rakho jisme roz likho: aaj sapne ke liye kya kiya. Mahine ke ant me wo copy hi tumhara bharosa hogi. Aur sapne ko sabke saamne ghoshna karne ki jaldi mat karo, pehle kuch kadam chal kar dikhao. Kaam bolta hai, baatein nahi.
Mera naam Kunal hai, main 26 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Bharosa janm se nahi milta, wo kamaya jata hai — chhoti jeeto se. Iska tareeka seedha hai: roz ek chhota kaam tay karo jo tum poora kar sako, aur use poora karke ek copy me likho. Ek mahine me 30 jeeto ki list ban jayegi — jab man kahe 'tumse kuch nahi hota', wo list padhna, wo jhooth nahi bolti. Dusra: jis cheez me kamzori hai use chhupao mat, use chhote hisso me seekho; kabiliyat badhti hai to bharosa khud aata hai. Teesra: apne aas-paas ke logo ko dekho — unme se zyadatar aam log hain, bas unhone koshish zyada ki hai. Bharosa matlab 'main kabhi nahi girunga' nahi, bharosa matlab 'gir kar bhi uth jaunga, pehle bhi utha hoon.'
Kya khel-kood ko shauk rakh kar, paisa wala kaam karna sahi rahega?

Filmo wali baat aadhi sach hai: pasand ka kaam karne wala zyada der tikta hai, aur jo tikta hai wahi aage jata hai. Par ek shart hai — pasand ke saath mehnat aur samajhdari bhi chahiye. Meri salah ka kram ye hai: ek, apni pasand wale kaam ki asal kamai aur raaste ki jaankari nikalo, logo se pucho jo wo kaam kar rahe hain. Do, ghar ki kam se kam zaroorat kitne paiso me puri hoti hai wo hisaab lagao. Teen, agar pasand wala kaam us zaroorat ko 2-3 saal me pura kar sakta hai to use chun lo aur ghar walo ko ye hisaab dikha do. Paisa zaroori hai, par zindagi bhar ka kaam sirf paise ke liye chunna bhi mehenge padta hai.
Aman hoon main, roz ke 500 rupaye kharch ho hi jate hain. Itni chhoti kamai se laptop ka paisa kaise judega?

Bachat tootne ki sabse badi wajah hai: paisa haath ke paas hona. Iska ilaaj bandobast se hota hai, ichha-shakti se nahi. Teen bandobast karo: ek, bachat ka paisa alag khate me dalo jiska card tum ghar par nahi rakhte. Do, kharidne se pehle 2 din ka niyam rakho — jo cheez aaj chahiye lagti hai, 2 din baad bhi chahiye to lo, aadhi khwahishein wahi mar jati hain. Teen, apne lakshya ki tasveer ya naam phone aur kamre me rakho, taaki har kharch se pehle wo dikhe. Aur agar ek baar bachat toot bhi jaye to use ant mat samjho — agle mahine se phir shuru karo. Bachat ek aadat hai, aur aadat gir-gir kar hi pakki hoti hai.
Maa chahti hain main kheti me haath bataun karu, papa chahte hain kheti-badi, aur mera dil apna business khada karna me hai. Main beech me phas gaya hoon.

Ye takrav lagbhag har ghar me hota hai, aur iska hal na pura jhukna hai na pura bagawat. Pehle ye samjho: ghar wale tumhare dushman nahi hain, wo bas suraksha chahte hain — kheti me haath bataun unhe pakka raasta lagta hai. Tumhara kaam hai apne sapne ko bhi utna hi pakka bana kar dikhana: uski yojna, uska kharcha, uska samay, aur agar na chale to dusra raasta — ye sab kagaz par likh kar shanti se baith kar dikhao. Dusra kadam: unhe kuch samay do aur us samay me chhota saboot do — sapne ki taraf badha ek kadam sau beheso se zyada bolta hai. Teesra: unki ummeed ka kuch hissa pura karo jahan ho sake, taaki unhe lage tum unke khilaf nahi ho. Santulan ladai se nahi, bharose se banta hai, aur bharosa samay mangta hai.
Rahul hoon main, 3 mahine se ghar baitha hoon naukri ke intezaar me. Ghar walo ke taane badh rahe hain.

Sun dost, pehli naukri sabse mushkil hoti hai — ye tumhari kamzori nahi, har fresher ki kahani hai. Haar manne se pehle apna tareeka badal kar dekho. Pehla: roz 5 jagah andhe ki tarah apply karne ki jagah 2 jagah soch kar apply karo, jahan tumhari skill sach me fit ho. Dusra: apna resume ek kagaz me saaf banao — kya aata hai, kya seekha hai, chhota kaam bhi likho. Teesra: sirf online mat baitho, dukaanon, daftar aur pehchan walo tak khud jao, aadhi naukriyaan jaan-pehchan se milti hain. Chautha: intezaar ke samay ko skill seekhne me lagao, taaki agle interview me tum khaali haath na ho. Naukri milna ek din ka khel nahi hai, jo laga rehta hai usi ko milti hai.
Kunal hoon main, mera sapna hai videsh jaakar kaam karna. Ghar wale kehte hain ye hamare bas ka nahi.

Logo ke hasne par ek sach yaad rakho: hasne wale apne sapne poore nahi kar paye, isliye dusro ke sapno ko chhota karte hain taaki unhe bura na lage. Tumhe do kaam karne hain: ek, apne sapne ki baat har kisi se karna band karo — chup chaap kaam karo, safalta khud bol degi. Do, apne aas-paas ek bhi aisa aadmi dhundho jo tumhare sapne ke raaste par aage hai, uski baat suno, hasne walo ki nahi. Sapna 'aukat' se nahi, mehnat aur samay se banta hai — aaj ke bade naam kabhi chhoti jagah se hi shuru hue the. Dil tootne par rukna mat, usi dil ko khaad banao. Ek din wahi hasne wale tumhari misaal denge.
Sheher me rehna mehenga hai, meri bachat sirf 20000 rupaye hai. Kaise sambhalunga pehle mahine?

Gaon ya sheher — ye faisla bhavnao se nahi, hisaab se lo. Gaon me kharcha kam hai, parivar paas hai, aur agar zameen ya dukaan ka koi raasta hai to wahan bhi bhavishya ban sakta hai, khaaskar ab jab online kaam gaon tak pahuch gaya hai. Sheher me mauke zyada hain, par kharcha aur akelapan bhi zyada hai. Ek tareeka ye hai: pehle 6 mahine ke liye sheher jaakar parakh lo, ghar se rishta aur gaon ka thikana banaye rakho. Kaam mil jaye aur man lag jaye to ruk jao, warna gaon lautna haar nahi hai. Jo log bina yojna ke jate hain wo pareshan hote hain, yojna banao: kaun sa kaam, kahan rahoge, kitna kharcha — teeno kagaz par likho phir niklo.
Career me dil ki sunu ya paise ki? Mujhe video banana aur editing pasand hai par usme kamai kam sunayi deti hai.

Ye sawal har samajhdar insaan puchta hai, aur sach ye hai ki jawab 'sirf dil' bhi nahi aur 'sirf paisa' bhi nahi. Pehla sach: jis kaam me dil nahi lagta, usme insaan 2-3 saal me thak jata hai aur beech me hi gir jata hai — paisa bhi nahi bachta. Dusra sach: sirf pasand se pet nahi bharta, ghar ki zarooratein asli hain. Beech ka raasta ye hai: pehle wo kaam chuno jisme dil bhi lage aur bazaar me uski mang bhi ho — pasand ko thoda mod do, todo mat. Jaise likhna pasand hai to content, teaching ya patrakarita; machine pasand hai to IT ya technical kaam. Aur shuruaat ke 2-3 saal kam kamai ko seekhne ka kharcha samjho, skill badhegi to paisa khud badhega.
Main 8 mahine se naukri dhundh raha hoon, kahin nahi mil rahi. Ab haar manne ka man karta hai.

Ek sach kadwa hai par kaam ka hai: khaali baith kar badi naukri ka intezaar karna, chhoti naukri se zyada nuksan deta hai. Khaali samay resume me khaali jagah ban jata hai aur aadat bhi bigadti hai. Chhoti naukri ke fayde samjho: pehla, khud ka kharcha nikalta hai, ghar par bojh kam hota hai. Dusra, kaam ka mahaul aur logo se vyavhaar seekhne ko milta hai. Teesra, andar rehte hue behtar naukri dhundhna aasan hota hai — kaam wale ko kaam jaldi milta hai. Isliye mashwara hai: mil rahi chhoti naukri pakdo, par apni badi manzil ko chhodo mat, roz ek ghanta usi ki taiyari karo. Pehla kaam tumhari pehchan nahi hai, wo sirf pehli seedhi hai.
Kya padhai ke saath-saath part-time kaam karna sahi rahega ya ek hi cheez par dhyan du?

Dekho, dono raaste sahi hain, galat sirf bina soche chuna hua raasta hai. Apni haalat ka sach likho: ghar ki aamdani, tumhari padhai ka kharcha, aur tumhari asal dilchaspi. Phir ye dekho ki teaching me jaane ke liye aur kitni padhai baaki hai. Agar 1-2 saal ki padhai se darwaza khulta hai to wo kar lo, utne samay ghar ko samjha lo ya part-time se sahara do. Agar padhai sirf degree ke liye hai aur dil nahi lagta, to kaam shuru karke skill seekhna behtar hai. Jo bhi chuno, pura dil laga kar chuno — aadha-adhura faisla hi sabse bada nuksan karta hai.
Mere dost Arjun aur uske saathi roz sigaret aur gutkha khate karte hain, mujhe bhi bulate hain. Kaise door rahu?

Dono ho sakta hai, bas dosti ki seema tumhe tay karni hogi. Pehla niyam: dosto ke saath samay bitao, par unki har baat me haan mat milao — chai, ghumna, khel, baatein, ye sab dosti hai; buri aadat dosti ki shart nahi. Dusra: mana karne par jo dost baar-baar apmaan kare ya zabardasti kare, usse doori bana lo — ye dushmani nahi, apni hifazat hai. Teesra: apne dost-mandal me 1-2 aise dost zaroor rakho jo sahi raaste par hain, sangat ka asar dono taraf hota hai. Ek baat hamesha yaad rakho: paanch saal baad tum unhi jaise ban jaoge jinke saath tum sabse zyada samay bitate ho. Isliye sangat chunna bhi ek faisla hai, aur ye faisla tumhara hai.
Aman naam hai mera, main din bhar naukri me uljha rehta hoon, apne liye samay hi nahi bachta.

Kaam bahut ho to pehle ye samjho: sab kaam ek jaise zaroori nahi hote. Ek tareeka bahut kaam ka hai — har kaam ko do hisso me dekho: zaroori hai ya jaldi hai. Jo zaroori bhi hai aur jaldi bhi, wo pehle. Jo zaroori hai par jaldi nahi, uska samay tay karo. Jo jaldi hai par zaroori nahi, use chhota karo ya kisi ko do. Jo na zaroori na jaldi, use list se hata do — aadha bojh wahi hota hai. Roz subah 5 minute me din ke kaam is hisaab se laga lo. Aur ek din me 3 bade kaam se zyada ka bojh mat lo. Bhaagna band hoga jab likhna shuru hoga — dimag me rakha kaam hamesha zyada lagta hai, kagaz par wo ginati ka ho jata hai.
Aman hoon main, 6 mahine se ghar baitha hoon naukri ke intezaar me. Ghar walo ke taane badh rahe hain.

Ek sach kadwa hai par kaam ka hai: khaali baith kar badi naukri ka intezaar karna, chhoti naukri se zyada nuksan deta hai. Khaali samay resume me khaali jagah ban jata hai aur aadat bhi bigadti hai. Chhoti naukri ke fayde samjho: pehla, khud ka kharcha nikalta hai, ghar par bojh kam hota hai. Dusra, kaam ka mahaul aur logo se vyavhaar seekhne ko milta hai. Teesra, andar rehte hue behtar naukri dhundhna aasan hota hai — kaam wale ko kaam jaldi milta hai. Isliye mashwara hai: mil rahi chhoti naukri pakdo, par apni badi manzil ko chhodo mat, roz ek ghanta usi ki taiyari karo. Pehla kaam tumhari pehchan nahi hai, wo sirf pehli seedhi hai.
Maine abhi 10th pass ki hai, aage Science lu, Commerce lu ya Arts? Bahut confuse hoon.

Stream chunna bada faisla hai par 'zindagi barbaad' wali baat galat hai — bahut se log baad me raasta badal lete hain, bas thoda samay zyada lagta hai. Sahi tareeka ye hai: pehle apne 10th ke number nahi, apni pasand dekho. Jis vishay ki kitab kholne me man kare, wahi tumhari taakat hai. Phir har stream ke aage ke raaste likho: Science se technical aur medical, Commerce se paisa-hisaab aur business, Arts se sarkari seva, law, teaching aur creative kaam. Phir socho tum 25 saal ki umar me khud ko kya karte hue dekhna chahte ho. Us tasveer se jo stream milti hai wahi lo. Maa-baap aur rishtedaro ki suno sabki, par faisla apni pasand aur us kaam ke bazaar dono dekh kar lo.
Rahul hoon main, 10th me mere 90% number aaye. Ghar wale Science keh rahe hain, mera man Arts me hai.

Arts ko kamzor samajhna sabse badi galti hai. Bharat ki sabse badi pariksha UPSC me zyadatar Arts ke vishay hi kaam aate hain, aur har saal ke toppers me Arts wale hote hain. Arts ke baad raaste hain: sarkari naukri ki taiyari, teaching, law, patrakarita, samaj seva, design, content likhna aur rajneeti tak. Haan, ek sach ye bhi hai: Arts lene ke baad khud par mehnat zyada karni padti hai, college ki degree ke bharose nahi baith sakte — saath me computer, English ya koi skill seekhni hogi. Chunav is hisaab se karo: agar tumhe padhna-likhna, samaj aur itihaas me ruchi hai aur lambi taiyari ka sabr hai, to Arts tumhe bahut aage le ja sakta hai.
Mera sabse achha dost nasha karte me fas gaya hai, use isse kaise nikaalu?

'Darpok' shabd ka ulta hai 'samajhdar', bas ye baat umar ke is mod par samajh kam aati hai. Ek hisaab lagao: aadat padne me ek pal lagta hai, chhodne me saal lag jate hain aur kuch log kabhi nahi chhod pate — shareer, paisa aur parivaar ki izzat, teeno girte hain. Jo has rahe hain wo tumhara bill nahi bharenge jab tum phasoge. Isliye apni line saaf rakho aur bina sharm ke rakho: 'Main nahi karta, baat khatam.' Saath me apni dusri pehchan banao — kaam, khel ya skill me aise aage badho ki logo ko tumhari izzat karni pade. Samay ke saath wahi hasne wale tumse salah lene aayenge, ye duniya ka niyam hai.
Lucknow ke school me padhta hoon, 10th ke baad stream ka faisla lena hai. Science ke bina achhi naukri nahi milti kya?

Phir har stream ke aage ke raaste likho: Science se technical aur medical, Commerce se paisa-hisaab aur business, Arts se sarkari seva, law, teaching aur creative kaam. Maa-baap aur rishtedaro ki suno sabki, par faisla apni pasand aur us kaam ke bazaar dono dekh kar lo.
Mera naam Deepak hai, main 22 saal ka hoon. Mujhme aatm-vishwas bilkul nahi hai, har kaam me peeche reh jata hoon.

Logo ke saamne haklana koi khaami nahi hai, ye sirf practice ki kami hai — bade-bade neta aur vakta shuruaat me aise hi the. Teen kadam wala ilaaj suno: pehla, akele me bolne ki practice — roz 5 minute kisi vishay par zor se bolo, sheeshe ke saamne ya phone me record karke suno. Dusra, chhoti mehfil se shuru karo — 2-3 bharose wale dosto ke saamne apni baat rakho, phir dheere-dheere dayra badhao. Teesra, ye samjho ki sunne wale tumhari galti nahi dhundh rahe, wo apni baari ka intezaar kar rahe hain — sab apne me lage hain. Bolna ek kala hai, kala practice se aati hai, aur practice ka koi chhota raasta nahi hota.
Rahul hoon main, 8 mahine se ghar baitha hoon naukri ke intezaar me. Ghar walo ke taane badh rahe hain.

Jawab na aana matlab tum bekaar ho, ye bilkul nahi hai — matlab hai ki tumhari arzi sahi jagah sahi roop me nahi pahuch rahi. Teen cheezein theek karo: ek, resume me wahi likho jo us naukri ko chahiye, har jagah ek hi purana resume mat bhejo. Do, apply karne ka samay aur jagah badlo — subah ke samay aur seedha company/dukaan par jaakar baat karna online se zyada kaam karta hai. Teen, har hafte apne se pucho: is hafte maine naya kya kiya jo pichhle hafte nahi kiya tha? Agar jawab 'kuch nahi' hai to tareeka wahi purana hai. Naukri ki khoj bhi ek kaam hai, use roz ke niyam aur copy par hisaab ke saath karo, safalta achanak nahi, lagatar koshish se aati hai.
Meri ek badi galti se sab bigad gaya. Us galti ko bhool hi nahi pata, roz yaad aati hai.

Asafalta se seekh nikalne ka pakka tareeka sikha deta hoon, 4 sawal wala. Haar ke 2-3 din baad, shanti se kagaz par likho: ek, main chahta kya tha aur mila kya? Do, isme meri kaunsi galti thi — taiyari ki, samay ki, ya galat jaankari ki? Teen, agar dobara wahi sthiti aaye to main kya alag karunga? Chaar, is haar ne mujhe aisi kaunsi baat sikha di jo jeet kabhi nahi sikhati? In jawabon ko sambhal kar rakho aur agli koshish se pehle padh lo. Ek niyam aur: haar ka kaaran 'kismat' ya 'main hi bekaar hoon' kabhi mat likho — kaaran hamesha wo likho jo tum badal sakte ho. Yahi seekh haar ko khaad banati hai.
Main gaon se hoon, kaam ke liye Bangalore jane ka soch raha hoon. Wahan jaakar kya-kya mushkil aayegi aur taiyari kaise karu?

Sheher me mauke zyada hain, par kharcha aur akelapan bhi zyada hai. Ek tareeka ye hai: pehle 6 mahine ke liye sheher jaakar parakh lo, ghar se rishta aur gaon ka thikana banaye rakho. Jo log bina yojna ke jate hain wo pareshan hote hain, yojna banao: kaun sa kaam, kahan rahoge, kitna kharcha — teeno kagaz par likho phir niklo.
Mera sapna bada officer banna hai, par main abhi chhoti naukri wala hoon. Wahan tak ka raasta kaise banau?

Bada sapna dekh kar dar jana aam hai, kyunki dimag pure pahad ko ek saath dekhta hai. Ilaaj ye hai: pahad ko seedhiyo me todo. Kagaz par pehle aakhri manzil likho — bada officer banna. Phir usse peeche chalo: usse pehle kya hoga, usse pehle kya — aise karte-karte tum aaj ke pehle kadam tak pahunchoge. Pehla kadam itna chhota rakho ki aaj hi ho jaye, jaise ek jaankari nikalna, ek aadmi se baat, ek ghanta seekhna. Roz ek seedhi chadho aur copy me nishan lagao. Ek saal me 365 seedhiya ho jayengi — wahi se pahad chhota lagne lagta hai. Sapna bada rakho, kadam chhota rakho, aur hisaab roz rakho.
Maine 3 baar time-table banaya, har baar toot gaya. Is baar pakka karna hai, tareeka batao.

Jaldi uthna ek raat me nahi hota, wo raat ki aadat se hota hai. Pehla kadam: sone ka samay peeche le jao — roz 15 minute pehle, ek hafte me ghanta bhar badal jayega. Dusra: sone se ek ghanta pehle phone band, dimag ko shanti milegi to neend gehri hogi. Teesra: alarm ghadi/phone ko bistar se door rakho, uth kar band karna padega to neend khul jayegi. Chautha: uthte hi koi chhota kaam rakho — paani peena, bahar ki hawa, 5 minute chalna — bistar par lete rehne se neend wapas kheenchti hai. Aur subah ke pehle ghante ko apna sabse keemti samay samjho: usi me padhai ya apne sapne ka kaam rakho, din bhar ka bojh us samay nahi hota.
Mujhe computer aur machine pasand hai, iske hisaab se kaunsi stream leni chahiye 12th ke baad?

Chalo teeno ka saaf hisaab deta hoon. Science: kharcha aur mehnat sabse zyada, raaste — engineering, medical, research, IT, defence; unke liye jinhe maths-science sach me pasand hai. Commerce: beech ka raasta, raaste — CA, CS, bank, accounts, apna business; unke liye jinhe number aur paiso ka khel samajh aata hai. Arts: kharcha kam, raaste — UPSC aur sarkari bharti, law, teaching, media; unke liye jo padhne-likhne aur samaj ke sawalo me ruchi rakhte hain. Ab apne aap ko dekho: tumhari pasand, ghar ka budget aur tumhara sabr — teeno mila kar jo stream fit baithe wahi sahi hai. Aur haan, 12th ke baad diploma aur skill course jaise darwaze bhi khule rehte hain, raasta ek nahi hota.
Mera naam Kunal hai. Mujhe computer par kaam ka kaam pasand hai par ghar wale bank ka kaam ke liye kehte hain.
